This paper presents Dendritic Recursive Pivoting (DeRP), a decentralized framework for multi-target network formation in robot swarms based solely on local communication and bearing-based sensing toward sinks. We envision a system in which robots, acting as a conduit, self-assemble a power network from a common source, forming branches at locally selected pivot points that approximate the Steiner points of Steiner trees to efficiently route to multiple Sinks. This branching operation is performed recursively to enable scalable and adaptive network formation without global planning. The proposed method is evaluated in terms of the total network length and estimated power loss, and is quantitatively compared against global baselines such as the Minimum Spanning Tree and Steiner tree solutions (GeoSteiner), which require complete knowledge of Sink locations. Specifically, we found that the networks formed by DeRP asymptotically form approximately 125\% of the global minimum length while reducing power losses to 65\% relative to Euclidean Steiner trees. In addition, we empirically characterize scaling behavior by measuring simulation completion time as the number of Sinks and robots increases, and find that this scaling was sub-linear for up to 100 sinks. The proposed approach enables resilient, adaptive power delivery in environments where deployment of traditional infrastructure is challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dendritic Recursive Pivoting (DeRP)，一种基于局部通信和方位感知的分布式框架，使机器人群体自主组装电源网络以向多个汇点供电。DeRP通过在局部选择的枢轴点递归分支形成近似Steiner树结构的网络，无需全局规划。实验表明其网络长度渐近约为全局最小长度的125%，功率损耗降至欧氏Steiner树的65%，且在100个汇点以内呈亚线性扩展。
AI.motivation: 在非结构化野外环境中，使用预布有线网络或电池方案为分布式设备持续供电面临重大的基础设施和后勤挑战。需要一种无需全局规划、能自适应部署的电源传输方案。
AI.method: DeRP框架基于局部通信和朝向汇点的方位感知，由机器人作为导体从公共电源自组装电源网络。在局部选择的枢轴点处形成分支，这些点近似Steiner树的Steiner点，并以递归方式执行分支操作以实现可扩展和自适应的网络形成。
AI.result: DeRP形成的网络长度渐近约为全局最小长度（MST/Steiner树）的125%，功率损耗相对于欧氏Steiner树降低至65%。在最多100个汇点的情况下，仿真完成时间呈亚线性扩展。
AI.conclusion: DeRP提供了一种在传统基础设施难以部署的环境中实现弹性、自适应电源传输的可行方案，在几乎不牺牲网络效率的前提下避免了全局规划的需求。

title: Knowing the Form, Not the Function: Automatically Auditing Answer--Authority Decoupling in Legal Benchmarks
summary: Legal benchmarks typically score final answers even when models also state legal authority. We test whether answer correctness can serve as a proxy for authority grounding. Under ordinary reasoning prompts that did not request statutory citations, four LLMs spontaneously produced authority markers across 238 Taiwan bar-examination items. Because each item has a verified governing provision, we automatically audit answer correctness and authority grounding jointly. The two dimensions dissociate in both directions. In criminal law, 24.0--42.4\% of valid responses were answer-correct but missed the gold authority, while 15.2--21.7\% were answer-incorrect but cited it. A separate statutory-retrieval probe and a permissive citation-abstention intervention further show that answer and citation behavior can move separately at the output level. Because this mismatch arises without adversarial or inconsistency-inducing prompting, answer-only scoring treats naturally occurring gold-authority misses as complete benchmark successes. Because statutory authority is structurally extractable and externally verifiable, the failure can be measured automatically. A preliminary PRC civil-law extension also observes citation-unrequested authority marking, motivating a full cross-jurisdictional joint audit. We therefore propose joint answer--authority evaluation for statute-grounded legal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现法律基准测试仅以最终答案正确性评分的做法存在问题：在未要求引用法条的情况下，四个LLM在238道台湾律师资格考试题目中自发产生法条标记，但答案正确性与法条依据引用两方面在双向解离——存在"答案正确但遗漏黄金法条"和"答案错误但正确引用"两种情况。作者提出对以成文法为基础的法律基准采用"答案-法条"联合评估。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准通常只对最终答案评分，即使模型同时陈述了法律依据。作者质疑答案正确性能否作为法条依据扎根性的代理指标，因为若答案正确性与法条引用脱节，仅凭答案评分会将自然的黄金法条遗漏误判为完全成功的基准表现。
AI.method: 在238道台湾律师资格考试题目上（每道题都有已验证的适用法条），以普通推理提示（不要求引用法条）驱动四个LLM生成回答；自动审计答案正确性与法条依据扎根性；同时进行独立的成文法检索探针测试和允许引用弃权的干预实验，以证明答案与引用行为在输出层面可独立变动；并在PRC民事法领域做了初步扩展验证。
AI.result: 在刑法中，24.0%-42.4%的有效回答是答案正确但遗漏黄金法条，15.2%-21.7%是答案错误但正确引用。成文法检索探针和引用弃权干预均表明答案与引用行为可在输出层面分离运动。PRC民事法的初步扩展也观察到在未要求引用时出现法条标记。
AI.conclusion: 由于该答案-法条失配是在无对抗性或非一致性诱导提示下自然产生的，仅答案评分会将自然出现的黄金法条遗漏视为完全成功。因为成文法依据在结构上可提取且外部可验证，此失败可以自动测量。作者提议对以成文法为基础的法律基准采用联合的"答案-法条"评估方案。

title: Learning Molecular Representations from Cellular Phenotypes with Structure Preservation
summary: Phenotypic drug discovery enables the discovery of functional relationships between molecular structures and cellular responses. However, existing multimodal representation learning methods often optimize cross-modal alignment without considering the intrinsic organization of chemical space, resulting in distorted molecular representations and loss of structural information. We propose \textbf{PhenMol}, a structure-preserving framework for phenotype-aware molecular representation learning. PhenMol disentangles molecular and cellular representations into shared and private components, enabling phenotype-guided alignment while preserving chemical structures through a dedicated molecular branch. This design integrates cellular phenotype information without disrupting molecular neighborhood organization. Experiments on approximately $3.04 \times 10^{4}$ molecule--cell morphology pairs demonstrate that PhenMol improves molecular property prediction across 270 bioactivity tasks, molecule--phenotype retrieval, and clinical trial outcome prediction. Moreover, ECFP4-based structural analysis shows that PhenMol better preserves molecular neighborhoods and reduces embedding distortion compared with existing multimodal alignment methods. These results highlight the importance of structure-aware constraints in multimodal molecular representation learning and provide an effective approach for integrating cellular phenotypes with chemical knowledge for drug discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhenMol，一个结构保持的表型感知分子表示学习框架，通过将分子和细胞表征解耦为共享与私有组件，在保持化学结构邻域组织的同时实现表型引导的对齐，在分子性质预测、分子-表型检索和临床试验结果预测上均优于现有多模态对齐方法。
AI.motivation: 现有表型药物发现中的多模态表示学习方法通常只优化跨模态对齐，未考虑化学空间的固有组织结构，导致分子表示扭曲和结构信息丢失。
AI.method: PhenMol 将分子和细胞表示解耦为共享组件和私有组件，通过专门的分子分支实现表型引导的对齐，同时保持化学结构的邻域组织不受干扰。
AI.result: 在约3.04×10^4对分子-细胞形态数据上，PhenMol 在270个生物活性任务的分子性质预测、分子-表型检索及临床试验结果预测上均取得改进；ECFP4结构分析表明其更好地保持分子邻域并减少嵌入扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 多模态分子表示学习中引入结构感知约束至关重要，PhenMol 为将细胞表型信息与化学知识整合用于药物发现提供了有效方案。

title: Towards a new paradigm of scientific discovery with socialized artificial intelligence
summary: Scientific discovery has advanced through successive transformations in the organization of knowledge. Observation and experimentation established the empirical foundations of science. Theory made it possible to derive general principles from particular phenomena. Computation extended inquiry into systems beyond direct observation, while data-intensive methods opened new spaces of pattern and prediction. Science now confronts a different frontier. The central challenge is no longer simply to produce more information, but to organize expanding knowledge, reasoning, and evidence into a coherent process of discovery. Here, we introduce Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation (BLAZE), a paradigm of socialized scientific intelligence. BLAZE conceives AI not as an assistant for isolated research tasks, but as an organizational infrastructure for scientific discovery. It connects persistent knowledge, collective reasoning, empirical validation, and human judgment within a continuous research lifecycle, transforming fragmented activities into a cumulative process of inquiry, criticism, and revision. The central premise of BLAZE is that scientific intelligence does not arise from computation alone. It emerges from the sustained interaction among knowledge, hypotheses, experiments, and collective verification. By organizing humans and machines within a shared scientific process, BLAZE makes discovery more traceable, reproducible, and cumulative while preserving human creativity, judgment, and responsibility. Socialized scientific intelligence may provide a foundation for the next era of science. Its purpose is not to replace human discovery, but to extend the scale, depth, and continuity of collective scientific inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLAZE（Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation），一种"社会化科学智能"范式，将AI从单点科研助手重新定位为科学发现的组织性基础设施，通过连接持久知识、集体推理、实证验证和人类判断，构建持续的研究生命周期，使科学发现更可追踪、可复现和累积，同时保留人类的创造力、判断力和责任。
AI.motivation: 科学发现经历了观察实验、理论、计算和数据密集型方法等多次知识组织方式的转型。当前科学面临的核心挑战不再是产生更多信息，而是如何将不断增长的知识、推理和证据组织成一个连贯的发现过程。现有的AI工具往往只服务于孤立的研究任务，缺乏将知识、假设、实验与集体验证整合为累积性研究流程的系统性框架。
AI.method: BLAZE提出"社会化科学智能"范式，将AI概念化为科学发现的组织性基础设施而非单个研究任务的辅助工具。它构建了一个持续的研究生命周期，连接四个核心要素：持久知识（persistent knowledge）、集体推理（collective reasoning）、实证验证（empirical validation）与人类判断（human judgment），将碎片化的研究活动转化为包含探究、批判和修订的累积过程。其核心前提是科学智能并非仅由计算产生，而是来源于知识、假设、实验与集体验证之间的持续交互。
AI.result: 该范式通过将人类和机器组织在共享的科学过程中，使科学发现更加可追踪（traceable）、可复现（reproducible）和累积（cumulative），同时保留人类的创造力、判断力和责任性。文中认为这为下一时代的科学提供了可能的基石。
AI.conclusion: BLAZE所倡导的社会化科学智能目标不是取代人类的科学发现，而是扩展集体科学探究的规模、深度和连续性，为科学的新时代奠定基础。

title: LPV Control for Dynamic Power Capping in High-Performance Computing under Mixed Workloads
summary: Balancing energy consumption and performance remains a critical challenge in High Performance Computing (HPC) systems. While static power capping mechanisms such as Intel's Running Average Power Limit (RAPL) offer basic control capabilities, they lack the flexibility to adapt to dynamically varying workloads. This work studies dynamic power regulation for mixed workload scenarios. We investigate two feedback strategies: a gain scheduled proportional-integral (PI) controller and a polytopic linear parameter-varying (LPV) controller synthesized via H$\infty$ control, both scheduled by a workload indicator that changes between memory and compute phase. We evaluate tracking performance, phase switching, and robustness under practical power cap constraints. While both controllers respect power limits, the LPV design achieves lower tracking error, lower control variance, and smoother transients during phase changes than gain scheduled PI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了HPC系统中面向混合工作负载场景的动态功耗调控，提出两种反馈控制策略：增益调度PI控制器和基于H∞控制的polytopic LPV控制器。两者均由工作负载指示器（内存/计算阶段）调度。结果表明，两种控制器均能满足功率限制，但LPV控制器在跟踪误差、控制方差和相位切换瞬态平滑性方面优于增益调度PI控制器。
AI.motivation: HPC系统中的能耗与性能平衡仍然是关键挑战。现有的静态功耗封顶机制（如Intel RAPL）缺乏对动态变化工作负载的适应性，因此需要研究能够适应混合工作负载场景的动态功耗调控策略。
AI.method: 针对混合工作负载场景，研究两种反馈控制策略：1) 由工作负载指示器（在内存和计算阶段之间切换）调度的增益调度PI控制器；2) 通过H∞控制综合的polytopic线性参数变化（LPV）控制器。评估了跟踪性能、相位切换和实际功耗封顶约束下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 两种控制器均能遵守功耗限制，但相比增益调度PI控制器，LPV设计实现了更低的跟踪误差、更低的控制方差以及相位切换时更平滑的瞬态响应。
AI.conclusion: LPV控制器在动态功耗调控的多个性能指标上优于增益调度PI控制器，为HPC系统混合工作负载下的功耗管理提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Security-First Evaluation of Text-to-Terraform: Benchmarking LLMs and SLMs for Secure IaC Generation
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, and 9 tables. The benchmark artifacts and CI/CD pipeline are publicly available at https://gitlab.com/repo-anon-iac/repo-anon-9ac. Accepted for publication at SBSeg 2026
summary: Cloud misconfiguration remains a leading cause of security incidents, yet whether LLMs and SLMs can generate security-compliant Infrastructure-as-Code is an open question. We benchmark seven models, three closed LLMs (Claude Opus 4, GPT-5.4, Gemini 2.5 Pro) and four open SLMs (Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, WizardCoder-33B, CodeLlama-13B, Magicoder-S-CL-7B), on AWS Terraform generation across 17 scenarios, integrating Checkov and Trivy scanners into a GitLab CI/CD pipeline and evaluating two prompt strategies at three security levels (pass@5). Syntactic validity and security compliance are largely orthogonal properties in LLM-generated IaC, a model that reliably produces well-formed Terraform does not necessarily produce secure Terraform: WizardCoder-33B achieves 77.8% validate rate yet zero Checkov compliance, while Claude Opus 4 reaches 23.1% Checkov and 92.5% Trivy pass rates under detailed security prompting. Consequently, prompt engineering alone is insufficient: automated multi-tool scanning remains a necessary complement to LLM-assisted IaC generation regardless of model family or prompt strategy. All artifacts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文基准测试了七个LLM/SLM（三个闭源LLM和四个开源SLM）在AWS Terraform生成任务中的安全合规能力，集成Checkov和Trivy扫描器于GitLab CI/CD流水线，发现语法有效性与安全合规性是几乎正交的属性，仅靠提示工程不足以确保安全，自动多工具扫描仍是必要补充。
AI.motivation: 云配置错误是安全事件的主要原因，但LLM和SLM能否生成安全合规的Infrastructure-as-Code（IaC）仍未得到充分回答，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对七个模型（Claude Opus 4、GPT-5.4、Gemini 2.5 Pro以及Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、WizardCoder-33B、CodeLlama-13B、Magicoder-S-CL-7B）在17个AWS Terraform生成场景中进行基准测试，将Checkov和Trivy扫描器集成到GitLab CI/CD流水线中，评估两种提示策略，采用pass@5指标在三个安全级别下进行评测。
AI.result: WizardCoder-33B的Terraform验证通过率达77.8%但Checkov合规率为零；Claude Opus 4在详细安全提示下达到23.1%的Checkov通过率和92.5%的Trivy通过率，表明语法有效性与安全合规性高度独立。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠提示工程不足以确保IaC生成的安全性，无论模型家族或提示策略如何，自动化多工具扫描都是LLM辅助IaC生成的必要补充。

title: Heterogeneous LLM Serving with General-Purpose Processing-Near-Memory for Retrieval-Based Sparse Attention
summary: This paper presents a heterogeneous decode-phase serving system that relocates the KV cache out of GPU memory, motivated by the retrieval-based sparse attention that recent frontier LLMs adopt to serve million-token contexts. It partitions a decode step by operation type: GPU nodes hold the model weights and execute the projections and MoE layers, while processing-near-memory (PNM) nodes hold the KV cache and index keys and execute every operation that reads them. We first show that the assumptions behind prior PIM and PNM designs no longer hold for these operations, and derive four design requirements for such a node. From these requirements, we propose KARAT (KV-cache-resident Accelerator for Retrieval-based ATtention), a general-purpose PNM design that is the design point meeting all four. A KARAT device combines large LPDDR capacity with general-purpose compute sized for the retrieval indexer, serving an operational intensity beyond what PIM/PNM designs built for low-intensity GEMV target while accommodating diverse sparse attention algorithms that fixed-function units cannot support as they evolve. To reduce pipeline bubbles as the two device types alternate between micro-batches, we further propose opportunistic, fine-grained micro-batch scheduling (OFMS), which hides expert all-to-all behind the other micro-batch's GEMMs, and context-length-aware micro-batch rebalancing (CMR), which equalizes their token counts despite the variance in context length. Across three state-of-the-art models and real agentic traces, our proposed system improves throughput per TDP under a service-level objective by 2.09-6.13x over a GPU-only baseline and runs training-free sparse attention methods with 1.36-3.21x improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KARAT，一种异构解码阶段服务系统，将KV缓存从GPU内存中迁移到处理近内存（PNM）节点上，利用检索式稀疏注意力来服务百万级token上下文。KARAT设备结合大容量LPDDR与通用算力，满足从检索式注意力中推导出的四个设计需求，并配合两种调度优化（OFMS和CMR），在三个SOTA模型和真实智能体轨迹上实现2.09-6.13x吞吐量提升和1.36-3.21x稀疏注意力方法加速。
AI.motivation: 近期前沿LLM采用检索式稀疏注意力来服务百万级token上下文，这使得KV缓存成为推理瓶颈。关键洞见是：这些读取KV缓存的操作与先前PIM/PNM设计所针对的低强度GEMV操作不同，先前设计的假设不再成立。因此需要重新审视并设计适用于检索式注意力操作的PNM方案。
AI.method: 1) 分析检索式注意力下KV缓存相关操作的特征，推导出四个设计需求；2) 提出KARAT设备：大容量LPDDR + 通用算力（为检索索引器定制规模），支持多样化稀疏注意力算法演进；3) 提出两种调度优化：OFMS（机会性细粒度微批调度，隐藏专家all-to-all通信）和CMR（上下文长度感知的微批重平衡，均衡不同微批的token数）。
AI.result: 在三个SOTA模型和真实agentic轨迹上，该系统在服务级别目标下相比GPU-only基线实现2.09-6.13x每TDP吞吐量提升；对于无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，实现1.36-3.21x改进。
AI.conclusion: KARAT验证了将KV缓存迁移出GPU、部署到专门PNM节点的架构方向是可行且高效的，为百万级上下文推理提供了一条可扩展的路径。通过异构计算划分和精细调度，突破了GPU内存容量和注意力操作效率的双重瓶颈。

title: In-Context Collapse in Vision-Language Models and How to Mitigate it?
summary: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) lets vision-language models (VLMs) adapt from image--label demonstrations without weight updates, and is widely assumed to improve as more demonstrations are supplied. We show the opposite: as demonstrations accumulate, a subset of VLMs undergo an \emph{in-context collapse}, a sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drop spanning synthetic classification, natural-image classification, and VQA benchmarks, in some models falling below chance while outputs remain well-formed. Across an open VLM panel ($0.5$B--$11$B) and a frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4.5), the collapse is graded. Two capabilities turn out to be dissociable: robustness to accumulating demonstrations and the ability to learn a novel rule in context, their combinations yield three reproducible regimes. A parameter-matched lesion-and-rescue causally localizes the collapse to the vision-language integration pathway: an adapter on the connector and early/mid layers restores genuine learning (remap accuracy $0.39!\rightarrow!0.91$ at 16 shots), while an equal-capacity adapter on the late readout does not. We propose \textsc{CircA}, whose core is a one-time integration vaccine: trained once on one synthetic task, it transfers collapse-resistance to unseen task families (chance$\rightarrow$$0.71$/$0.60$ on CIFAR/Fashion). The layers best for in-context integration are not the layers best for weight-based consolidation, the late readout achieves higher accuracy and less forgetting at fewer parameters. The collapse is an integration failure at the vision--language interface, correctable by a lightweight, transferable intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉-语言模型（VLM）在使用多示例上下文学习（ICL）时，随着演示样本增多会出现"上下文崩溃"现象——准确率骤降甚至低于随机水平。通过参数匹配的消融与挽救实验，将崩溃机制定位到视觉-语言整合通路，并提出CircA方法：一次训练即可获得跨任务族的崩溃抗性迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 传统假设认为多示例上下文学习中演示样本越多效果越好，但作者发现部分VLM存在相反的"上下文崩溃"现象——随着演示累积，模型出现急剧且有时灾难性的准确率下降，甚至低于随机水平。这一现象颠覆了普遍假设，需要系统性地理解其成因与解决之道。
AI.method: （1）在多个基准（合成分类、自然图像分类、VQA）上系统评估0.5B-11B的开源VLM及前沿模型Claude Sonnet 4.5，刻画崩溃的梯度性质；（2）通过参数匹配的消融-挽救实验，在视觉-语言整合通路（连接器及早期/中层）上添加适配器以定位崩溃来源；（3）提出CircA，其核心是"一次性整合疫苗"——在单一合成任务上训练一次，即可将崩溃抗性迁移到未见过的任务族。
AI.result: 崩溃鲁棒性与新规则上下文学习能力是可分离的两种能力，产生三种可复现的状态。在视觉-语言整合通路的连接器及早期/中层添加适配器可恢复真实学习（16-shot下重映射准确率从0.39提升至0.91），而同样容量的晚期读出层适配器无效。CircA在CIFAR/Fashion上从随机水平恢复至0.71/0.60。此外，上下文整合的最佳层与基于权重的巩固的最佳层不同——晚期读出层以更少参数达到更高准确率和更低遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 上下文崩溃本质上是在视觉-语言接口处的整合失败，而非模型容量或输出质量问题。通过轻量级、可迁移的干预（着眼于连接器及早期/中层适配），可以有效纠正该问题。这与基于权重巩固的最优层选择存在解离，暗示上下文学习与权重学习可能依赖不同的神经通路。

title: ValueFormer: A Causal Transformer Value Function with Stage-Aware Labels for Semi-Autonomous Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained by behavior cloning fail silently: from the action stream alone, a collapsing rollout looks much like one making clean progress, because imitation supplies no notion of progress. Reinforcement learning would supply one, but it is impractical here, where real-robot experience is costly and deformable food resists simulation. The cheap alternative, a terminal success / failure bit, is learnable in principle yet far too sparse to say when a rollout went wrong. We argue that the per-frame label, not the architecture, is the hard part: to be useful it must be dense, continuous, and correctly shaped. We present ValueFormer, a compact policy-agnostic causal transformer over a frozen DINOv3 backbone that emits two per-frame signals in one forward pass: a smooth Monte Carlo value, V_mc, for advantage estimation and a sharp binary value for online mistake detection, targets that pull in opposite directions by design. Failed episodes are labeled with a stage-aware, success-then-decay return that preserves the success curve before the failure stage, and detection is supervised from mistake intervals rather than a single failure time, so mistakes the policy recovers from also carry signal. On a real-robot bimanual sandwich-assembly task 1,427 episodes), a critic-derived per-frame training weight lifts task completion from 70% to 85% (within noise at n=20), and a batched bf16 encoder cuts the live serving cost 3~5 times so the critic runs at 2 Hz alongside the policy on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ValueFormer，一种策略无关的因果Transformer，在冻结的DINOv3骨干上单次前向同时输出平滑蒙特卡洛价值V_mc（用于优势估计）和尖锐的二值检测信号（用于在线错误检测），通过逐帧密集、连续且形状正确的标签解决VLA策略行为克隆的静默失败问题。在真实机器人双臂三明治组装任务（1427次试验）中，评论家推导的逐帧训练权重将任务完成率从70%提升至85%，且批量化bf16编码器将实时服务成本降低3~5倍。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通过行为克隆训练会静默失败——仅从动作流无法区分崩溃轨迹与正常进展，因为模仿学习缺乏进度概念。强化学习需要昂贵的真实机器人经验和难以模拟的形变食物，而稀疏的终端成功/失败比特位虽原则上可学习，但过于稀疏无法指出轨迹何时出错。作者认为关键难点在于逐帧标签而非架构，标签必须满足密集、连续、形状正确三个条件。
AI.method: 提出ValueFormer：一个策略无关的因果Transformer，基于冻结的DINOv3骨干，单次前向产生两个每帧信号——平滑的蒙特卡洛价值V_mc用于优势估计，以及尖锐的二值信号用于在线错误检测，两种目标在设计中刻意相互拉扯。失败episode使用阶段感知的成功-后-衰减回报进行标记，保留失败阶段前的成功曲线；检测从错误区间而非单一失败时间进行监督，因此策略能恢复的错误也携带信号。
AI.result: 在真实机器人双臂三明治组装任务（1427个episodes）上，评论家推导的逐帧训练权重将任务完成率从70%提升到85%（在n=20的噪声范围内）；批量化bf16编码器将实时推理成本降低3~5倍，使评论家能在单GPU上以2Hz频率与策略并行运行。
AI.conclusion: 作者的核心主张是：VLA策略失败的关键瓶颈不是架构而是逐帧标签的质量。通过设计密集、连续且形状正确的价值信号，并结合高效的推理优化，ValueFormer在真实物理机器人任务上验证了评论家驱动的逐帧加权能够实质性地提升行为克隆策略的任务完成率。

title: Speculative Correction: Draft-then-Refine Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can revise tokens bidirectionally, but standard decoding procedures often adapt them to left-to-right generation by producing text block by block. We study a simple plug-and-play inference pattern: first generate a complete draft, then refine the full response using bidirectional diffusion. Using LLaDA2.1-Flash and LLaDA2.1-Mini, we evaluate two configurations. In Flash-Flash, the same Flash model serves as both drafter and refiner, testing whether an existing model can improve its own block-autoregressive output through global refinement. In Mini-Flash, inspired by speculative decoding, we introduce speculative correction: Mini drafts a full response, and Flash revises it as an editable initialization. Flash-Flash improves GSM8K-384 accuracy from 0.848 to 0.899 while running 1.20 times faster than the selected Flash block-autoregressive baseline, and improves MBPP-384 from 0.545 to 0.693. Latency-window-matched Flash-only controls indicate that these gains persist after targeted tuning of block-autoregressive decoding. Causal ablations indicate that completed drafts provide useful initializations: refinement from a fully masked span performs poorly, full global refinement provides a clear additional gain on GSM8K, and local refinement captures much of the gain on MBPP and MATH. Mini-Flash provides useful quality-latency trade-offs, including MATH-384 performance of 0.294 versus 0.300 for Flash while running 2.17 times faster. These results support a Pareto-frontier interpretation rather than the claim that the heterogeneous cascade uniformly matches Flash quality. Overall, same-model draft-and-refine provides evidence that bidirectional refinement is a useful decoding primitive for DLMs, while speculative correction demonstrates a training-free route to fast DLM generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散语言模型（DLM）的一种简单的即插即用推理模式：先由模型自回归生成完整草稿，再通过双向扩散对整个响应进行全局精炼。实验使用LLaDA2.1-Flash和LLaDA2.1-Mini两种模型，评估了Flash-Flash（同模型草稿-精炼）和Mini-Flash（推测式修正）两种配置。结果显示Flash-Flash在GSM8K-384上准确率从0.848提升至0.899且快1.20倍，MBPP-384从0.545提升至0.693；Mini-Flash在MATH-384上以2.17倍的加速达到接近Flash的性能（0.294 vs 0.300）。支持帕累托前沿解释，证明双向精炼是DLM的有用解码原语。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散语言模型具备双向修正token的能力，但标准解码流程往往将其限制为从左到右的逐块生成，未能充分利用其全局精炼的潜力。作者旨在探索一种无需额外训练的简单推理模式，以释放DLM双向修正能力的价值，同时提供更快的生成速度。
AI.method: 提出草稿-精炼（draft-and-refine）的即插即用推理框架：首先用自回归方式生成一个完整的响应草稿，然后利用双向扩散模型对完整响应进行精炼。配置一为Flash-Flash（同一Flash模型既做草稿者又做精炼者），验证自改进能力；配置二为Mini-Flash（受推测解码启发），由小型Mini模型起草，Flash模型将草稿作为可编辑初始化进行修订。同时进行因果消融实验，分别检验完全掩码初始化、全局精炼和局部精炼的贡献。
AI.result: Flash-Flash将GSM8K-384准确率从0.848提升至0.899（快1.20倍），MBPP-384从0.545提升至0.693；在与延迟窗口匹配的Flash-only对照中增益仍然保持。因果消融表明完整草稿提供有效初始化（完全掩码初始化性能差），全局精炼在GSM8K上提供额外增益，局部精炼在MBPP和MATH上捕获大部分增益。Mini-Flash在MATH-384上达到0.294 vs Flash的0.300，但速度快2.17倍，提供了有用的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果显示，异构级联（Mini-Flash）并非在所有指标上统一匹配Flash质量，而是呈现帕累托前沿关系；同模型草稿-精炼（Flash-Flash）证明双向精炼是DLM有效的解码原语，推测式修正展示了无需训练的快速DLM生成路径。

title: GLOBE: Trajectory-Aligned Gradient Matching with Structured SparseOptimization for Coreset Selection
summary: On-device training of deep neural networks is fundamentally constrained by the computational and memory costs of large-scale datasets. Coreset selection offers a practical solution by retaining only a compact subset of real training samples. However, existing gradient-based methods commonly rely on gradients computed at a single model snapshot and employ greedy or pursuit-based selection procedures, limiting their ability to capture evolving optimization dynamics and handle strongly correlated samples. We propose GLOBE (Gradient Local-Balanced Extraction), a trajectory-aligned coreset selection framework that formulates sample selection as a globally optimized sparse weighting problem. GLOBE represents each sample by a gradient trajectory constructed across multiple training checkpoints, thereby capturing its influence throughout different stages of optimization. To preserve the training behavior of the full dataset, we introduce a multi-order matching objective that jointly aligns the first-order mean and projected uncentered second-order moments of gradient trajectories. GLOBE further combines Group LASSO, Elastic Net regularization, and nonnegative budget constraints to induce group- and sample-level sparsity while stabilizing the weights of correlated trajectories. Finally, class-balanced Top-K selection maintains adequate category coverage under limited sampling budgets. Experiments across six benchmarks and five evaluation architectures demonstrate that GLOBE consistently outperforms existing coreset selection methods in downstream test accuracy, particularly at low retention ratios. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining dynamic gradient information, multi-order distribution matching, and structured sparsity for data-efficient learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLOBE框架，一种轨迹对齐的coreset选择方法，通过构建梯度轨迹捕捉样本在整个训练过程中的动态影响，并利用多阶匹配目标联合对齐梯度轨迹的一阶均值和投影的未中心化二阶矩，结合Group LASSO、Elastic Net和预算约束实现结构化稀疏，最终通过类平衡Top-K选择在低保留率下显著提升下游测试精度。
AI.motivation: 设备端训练深度神经网络受限于大规模数据集的计算和内存成本，coreset选择是有效的解决方案。但现有基于梯度的方法通常依赖单个模型快照的梯度，并采用贪心或追踪式选择程序，难以捕捉不断演化的优化动态，也无法处理强相关的样本，限制了选择质量。
AI.method: GLOBE框架的核心方法包括：(1) 使用跨多个训练检查点的梯度轨迹表示每个样本，捕捉其在不同优化阶段的影响；(2) 设计多阶匹配目标，联合对齐第一阶均值和投影的未中心化第二阶矩；(3) 结合Group LASSO、Elastic Net正则化和非负预算约束，诱导组级和样本级稀疏性并稳定相关轨迹的权重；(4) 采用类平衡Top-K选择确保在有限采样预算下维持类别覆盖。
AI.result: 在六个基准和五种评估架构上的实验表明，GLOBE在下游测试精度上一致优于现有coreset选择方法，尤其在低保留率场景下优势更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 动态梯度信息、多阶分布匹配和结构化稀疏的结合对于数据高效学习是有效的，验证了GLOBE在实际设备端训练场景中的实用价值。

title: BAP-SQL: Budget-Aware Observation Planning for Agentic Text-to-SQL
summary: Tool-using agents do not merely consume observations: their actions determine what arrives next. In agentic text-to-SQL, a broad query can spend context and database work before useful evidence appears, while post-hoc compression cannot recover omitted rows or expended work. We present BAP-SQL, which treats observation formation as a budget-control stage: it estimates query risk, rewrites SQL when useful, and delegates hard limits to an independent runtime shield. Across general 4B, specialized FINER-SQL 4B, and 7B backbones, BAP-SQL improves tight-budget success. On the primary BIRD-derived setting, it gains 3.4/3.6 percentage points over matched SFT while using 4.5/5.0% fewer tokens. Matched retraining and task-level transfer associate the gain with policy-visible planning and budget-sensitive rescue. The benefit attenuates as model capability and budget increase, reverses at the loosest setting, and does not reduce database work.

AI.tldr: BAP-SQL 将观测形成视为预算控制阶段，通过估算查询风险、重写SQL并将硬限制委托给独立运行时防护层，在agentic文本转SQL任务中提升严格预算下的成功率，同时减少token消耗。
AI.motivation: 工具智能体不仅被动消费观测，其行为决定后续输入。在agentic文本转SQL中，宽泛查询会消耗上下文和数据库资源后才出现有用证据，而事后压缩无法恢复被省略的行或已消耗的工作。现有方法缺乏对观测形成的主动预算控制。
AI.method: BAP-SQL将观测形成视为预算控制阶段：首先估算查询风险，必要时重写SQL，并将硬性限制委托给独立的运行时防护层（runtime shield）。
AI.result: 在通用4B、专用FINER-SQL 4B及7B主干上均提升严格预算成功率。在BIRD派生主设定上，相比匹配的SFT提升3.4/3.6个百分点，同时token使用减少4.5/5.0%。匹配重训练和任务级迁移表明增益来源于策略可见的规划和预算敏感的救援机制。当模型能力和预算增加时收益减弱，在最宽松设定下出现逆转，且不减少数据库工作量。
AI.conclusion: BAP-SQL证明了在agentic文本转SQL中，将观测形成作为预算控制阶段能有效提升严格预算下的性能，但其收益随模型能力和预算增加而衰减，在最宽松环境下甚至反转，且不节省数据库开销。

title: FedRings: A Scalable and Topology-Aware Federated Learning Framework for LEO Satellite Constellations
summary: Federated learning over low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks is limited by frequent link changes, short contact times, and a highly dynamic topology, making centralized or synchronized training inefficient and hard to scale. To address this, we propose FedRings, a decentralized framework that organizes satellites into ring-based communication structures. It uses a spatio-temporal routing strategy with link-aware communication scheduling to align model exchange with actual visibility windows and time-varying connectivity patterns in LEO. Model updates are propagated along the ring using adaptive sparse incremental aggregation, which reduces communication overhead by progressively combining and compressing updates. To handle communication interruptions, a historical compensation mechanism maintains training continuity. By combining topology-aware routing, communication scheduling, and efficient aggregation, FedRings enables stable and efficient learning in dynamic LEO networks while reducing communication cost, and experiments show it consistently outperforms existing methods in realistic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedRings，一个面向近地轨道（LEO）卫星网络的去中心化联邦学习框架。它通过环形通信结构、时空路由、链路感知调度、自适应稀疏增量聚合和历史补偿机制，有效解决拓扑动态变化下的通信效率与训练稳定性问题，在真实场景中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星网络中频繁的链路变化、短接触时间和高度动态拓扑，使得集中式或同步训练效率低下且难以扩展，亟需一种适应动态拓扑的去中心化联邦学习方案。
AI.method: 1) 将卫星组织成环形通信结构实现去中心化；2) 采用时空路由策略与链路感知通信调度，使模型交换与实际可见窗口和时变连接模式对齐；3) 沿环使用自适应稀疏增量聚合逐步压缩合并模型更新以降低通信开销；4) 引入历史补偿机制应对通信中断，维持训练连续性。
AI.result: FedRings在动态LEO网络中实现稳定高效的学习，显著降低通信成本，并在真实场景的实验中持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合拓扑感知路由、通信调度与高效聚合，FedRings为动态LEO卫星网络提供了一种稳定、可扩展且通信友好的联邦学习解决方案。

title: Moving the Safety Barrier: Dynamic Routing Adaptive Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
summary: With the widespread deployment of large foundation models (LFMs) in open environments, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks toward white-box attacks that directly identify and disrupt internal safety neurons or routes. However, existing safety defenses often rely on static safety units or fixed refusal pathways, leaving models highly vulnerable to targeted route-level white-box attacks. For that, we propose dynamic routing adaptive alignment (DRAA), a framework that introduces dynamic compensatory routes to preserve robust refusal behavior when the safety route is compromised. Specifically, we first identify and localize the model's safety route by contrasting internal activations between safe and unsafe calibration samples. DRAA then masks this safety route to induce causal failure cases and selectively mines the resulting defense failures, thereby constructing failure-aware preference pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DRAA effectively restructures the underlying pathway dependence of model safety, substantially improving robustness against route-level white-box attacks, while preserving general utility.

AI.tldr: 针对大规模基础模型（LFM）在开放环境中面临的白盒攻击威胁，提出动态路由自适应对齐（DRAA）框架，通过动态补偿路由在安全路由被攻击破坏时仍能保持模型的稳健拒绝行为，有效提升模型对路由级白盒攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全防御大多依赖静态安全单元或固定的拒绝路径，导致模型在遭受针对性的路由级白盒攻击时极易被攻破。随着攻击方式从黑盒越狱转向直接定位并破坏内部安全神经元或路由的白盒攻击，亟需一种能够应对安全路由被破坏的动态防御机制。
AI.method: DRAA框架首先通过对比安全与不安全校准样本的内部激活，识别并定位模型的安全路由；然后对该安全路由进行掩码处理以诱导因果性失败案例；接着有选择性地挖掘由此产生的防御失败案例，构建包含失败信息的偏好对（failure-aware preference pairs），最终通过偏好对齐实现动态补偿路由的学习，重构模型安全行为的底层路径依赖。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DRAA能有效重构模型安全的底层路径依赖，显著提升模型对路由级白盒攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持模型的通用性能不受影响。
AI.conclusion: DRAA通过引入动态补偿路由打破了传统静态安全防御的局限，为大规模基础模型提供了一种动态、自适应的安全对齐方案，在抵御白盒路由级攻击与保持模型效用之间取得了良好平衡。

title: DiffPower: GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Switching Power Analysis and Optimization
summary: Accurate and scalable switching power analysis remains a critical bottleneck in modern physical design, often forcing a trade-off between computational speed and modeling fidelity. We present DiffPower, a GPU-accelerated framework for differentiable power analysis and optimization. DiffPower translates design netlists into a PDK-agnostic bytecode representation, enabling analytical gradient computation via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, achieving up to a $1{,}002\times$ speedup over single-threaded CPU propagation on the largest evaluated design, with the GPU advantage growing with design scale. A hybrid propagation methodology fusing analytical modeling with parallel simulation achieves a median toggle-rate correlation of $r{=}0.96$ across ten industrial and benchmark designs. The resulting \emph{power gradients}, computed up to $904\times$ faster than CPU finite-difference methods with near-perfect rank agreement, enable two downstream applications: (1) gradient-weighted cell sizing, which achieves up to $2.98\times$ improvement over local-power heuristics on industrial designs, with even stronger advantages at the 117K-cell scale where competing methods plateau; and (2) power virus generation via gradient ascent, which yields up to $2.13\times$ higher transition-weighted power, replacing a search process that traditionally requires hours.

AI.tldr: DiffPower是一个GPU加速的可微分功耗分析与优化框架，通过将设计网表转换为PDK无关的字节码表示并结合反向模式自动微分实现解析梯度计算，相比单线程CPU传播方法在最大评估设计上实现了高达1002倍的加速。该方法混合了解析建模与并行仿真，在十个工业和基准设计上实现了中位翻转率相关性r=0.96。该框架支持两种下游应用：梯度加权单元尺寸优化（相比局部功耗启发式方法提升高达2.98倍）和基于梯度上升的功耗病毒生成（转换加权功耗提升高达2.13倍）。
AI.motivation: 现代物理设计中，准确且可扩展的开关功耗分析仍是关键瓶颈，通常需要在计算速度和建模保真度之间进行权衡。传统方法要么计算速度慢，要么建模精度不足，缺乏一种既能快速计算又具备高保真度、同时能够提供解析梯度的功耗分析框架。
AI.method: DiffPower将设计网表转换为PDK无关的字节码表示，通过反向模式自动微分实现解析梯度计算。采用混合传播方法论，融合解析建模与并行仿真，利用GPU加速实现大规模设计上的快速功耗传播和梯度计算。
AI.result: 在最大评估设计上实现高达1002倍的加速（相比单线程CPU传播），GPU优势随设计规模增大而增长；中位翻转率相关性r=0.96；功耗梯度计算比CPU有限差分方法快904倍且具有近完美的秩一致性；梯度加权单元尺寸优化性能提升高达2.98倍（在117K单元规模下优势更明显）；功耗病毒生成提升高达2.13倍，且替代了传统需要数小时的搜索过程。
AI.conclusion: DiffPower证明了解析可微功耗分析框架在GPU上能够同时实现高速度和高保真度，所计算出的功耗梯度可直接支持多种下游优化任务（单元尺寸调整和功耗病毒生成），为物理设计中的功耗优化提供了新的范式。

title: CURV: Enhancing Chart Understanding Through Curriculum Visual Grounded Reasoning
summary: Chart question answering (CQA) requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to integrate visual comprehension with logical reasoning, yet current models struggle with accurate visual grounding and coherent reasoning chains. While extrinsic chain-of-thought prompting and visual cues significantly improve performance, current MLLMs lack intrinsic visual grounded reasoning capabilities, leading to inaccurate perception and reasoning disconnected from visual evidence. To address these limitations, we propose CURV, a curriculum learning framework that develops intrinsic visual reasoning capabilities by reformulating CQA as multi-step visual grounded reasoning, where each step coordinates logical reasoning with dynamic visual grounding through spatial attention concentration. To assist model learning, we further introduce CCQA, a three-level curriculum dataset with scalable synthetic generation across diverse chart types and reasoning patterns. Our curriculum systematically progresses from basic single-operation reasoning to complex multi-chart compositional tasks. Experiments demonstrate that CURV achieves up to $\uparrow20.50\%$ improvements over baselines and is generalizable to real-world benchmarks (up to $\uparrow12.30\%$) and out-of-domain multimodal reasoning tasks (up to $\uparrow10.20\%$), validating the effectiveness of internalizing visual reasoning with dynamic grounding for enhanced chart understanding capabilities. Code is available at: https://xhguo7.github.io/CURV/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CURV，一个课程学习框架，通过将图表问答（CQA）重新构架为多步视觉支撑推理任务，开发多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的固有视觉推理能力。同时引入CCQA三级课程数据集和可扩展的合成生成，从基础单步操作推理逐步过渡到复杂多图组合任务，在多个基准上实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLMs在图表问答中缺乏固有的视觉支撑推理能力：尽管外部链式思维提示和视觉线索能显著提升性能，但模型仍存在不准确的感知和与视觉证据脱节的推理，无法将视觉理解与逻辑推理有效整合。
AI.method: 1) 提出CURV课程学习框架，将CQA重构为多步视觉支撑推理，每一步通过空间注意力集中将逻辑推理与动态视觉支撑协调；2) 引入CCQA三级课程数据集，支持跨多种图表类型和推理模式的可扩展合成生成；3) 课程设计从基础单操作推理系统性地递进到复杂多图组合任务。
AI.result: CURV相较于基线实现了最高↑20.50%的性能提升，在真实世界基准上最高提升↑12.30%，在域外多模态推理任务上最高提升↑10.20%，验证了内化视觉推理与动态支撑机制对增强图表理解能力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过课程学习结合动态视觉支撑的内部推理训练，能够有效提升MLLMs在图表问答中的视觉锚定与逻辑推理一致性，且具有良好的跨域泛化能力。

title: EmbodiedVAE: Disentangled Video VAE for Efficient and Controllable Embodied Manipulation
summary: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) have recently significantly advanced embodied learning in constructing powerful embodied manipulation world models. However, despite the remarkable performance, existing LDMs predominantly rely on Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) optimized for natural scenes while failing to account for the unique characteristics of embodied manipulation scenarios, yielding latent representations that are neither compact nor controllable, thereby hindering efficient training of LDMs and precise robotic control. To solve this problem, we present EmbodiedVAE, a novel video VAE that provides compact yet controllable latent representations tailored for the robotic manipulation world models. Specifically, EmbodiedVAE adopts a dual-encoder, single-decoder architecture with an asymmetric spatio-temporal compression module, which automatically disentangles the robot arm's motion from background environment, resulting in overall compactness while providing explicit embodied latent to support fine-grained action control. To further preserve the temporal consistency of learned robotic motion latent, we introduce an optimal-transport-based consistency module that explicitly enforces motion fidelity and inter-frame coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed EmbodiedVAE achieves superior reconstruction quality with high compression rate, while enabling more precise action control in robotic manipulation scenarios with an average of 2dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art video VAEs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmbodiedVAE，一种专门为机器人操作世界模型设计的视频VAE，通过双编码器-单解码器架构和非对称时空压缩模块，将机械臂运动与背景环境解耦，提供紧凑且可控的潜在表示，在重构质量和动作控制精度上超越现有视频VAE。
AI.motivation: 现有潜扩散模型（LDMs）在具身操作场景中通常依赖为自然场景优化的VAE，未考虑机器人操作场景的独特特性，导致潜在表示既不紧凑也不可控，阻碍了LDM的高效训练和精确的机器人控制。
AI.method: EmbodiedVAE采用双编码器-单解码器架构，包含非对称时空压缩模块，可自动将机械臂运动与背景环境解耦，既保证整体紧凑性又提供显式的具身潜在表示以支持细粒度动作控制；同时引入基于最优传输的一致性模块来保持学习到的机器人运动潜在表示的时序一致性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，EmbodiedVAE在压缩率较高的情况下实现了优越的重构质量，并在机器人操作场景中实现了更精确的动作控制，相较于最先进的视频VAEs平均PSNR提升2dB。
AI.conclusion: EmbodiedVAE通过为机器人操作世界模型量身定制的紧凑且可控的潜在表示，有效解决了现有视频VAE在具身操作场景中表示不紧凑、不可控的问题，显著提升了重构质量和动作控制精度。

title: Stuck on "A": Diagnosing and Repairing Interface Injury in Attention-to-KDA Linearization of a 0.6B Language Model
comment: Code and models: https://github.com/Sisyphbaous-DT-Project/open-qingyi ; https://huggingface.co/shiershuihesaixiliya/qingyi-kda-0.6b . A version of this preprint is archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21722356)
summary: We convert 21 of 28 full-attention layers of Qwen3-0.6B-Base into KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) linear-attention layers on a single consumer-grade GPU budget, and ask a simple question: what exactly does the conversion break? After surgery, hidden-state alignment and end-to-end KL distillation drive the student close to its teacher in perplexity, yet multiple-choice accuracy stays near random chance (25-29% vs. the teacher's 50.6% on C-Eval). Using a four-permutation diagnostic that rotates answer options while holding content fixed, we show the model sticks to option labels (predicting "A" 81% of the time; 106/161 questions keep the same label under all four rotations) rather than following answer content -- an interface injury that standard distillation metrics cannot see. A 1,000-step format-targeted completion-only KL stage repairs the interface (+12.48 points on C-Eval, label-stickiness roughly halved), after which persona SFT and one round of on-policy DPO preserve benchmark scores within noise. We release code, weights, recipes, and the full audit trail, and distill the engineering lessons -- including an FP32-master failure mode in which bf16 optimizer updates are silently swallowed -- that made convergence possible at this budget.

AI.tldr: 本研究在单张消费级GPU上将Qwen3-0.6B-Base的28个全注意力层中的21个转换为KDA线性注意力层，探索了转换到底破坏了什么。尽管隐藏状态对齐和端到端KL蒸馏使困惑度逼近教师模型，但多项选择准确率（C-Eval上25-29%）仍接近随机水平；通过四重排列诊断发现模型"粘滞"于选项标签而非内容，这是一般蒸馏指标无法察觉的接口损伤。一个1000步的格式定向完成式KL阶段可修复该损伤（C-Eval提升+12.48分），随后的人格SFT和一轮on-policy DPO可在噪声范围内保持分数。文章还披露了FP32主权重模式下bf16优化器更新被静默吞掉这一失败模式及全套工程经验。
AI.motivation: 传统上认为线性注意力转换的代价主要在困惑度等语言建模指标上，但这些指标可能掩盖了更深层的认知能力损伤。作者希望精确回答：在将全注意力层转换为线性注意力后，到底发生了什么"看不见的"破坏？同时希望证明在极低预算（单张消费级GPU）下也能完成有诚意的审计。
AI.method: 将Qwen3-0.6B-Base中21/28个全注意力层替换为KDA线性注意力，经过手术后的隐藏状态对齐和端到端KL蒸馏进行训练恢复；设计四重排列诊断（旋转选项但保持内容固定）来测试模型是依赖选项标签还是答案内容；采用1000步格式定向的completion-only KL阶段修复接口；之后进行人格SFT和一轮on-policy DPO。
AI.result: 蒸馏后困惑度接近教师，但C-Eval准确率仅25-29%（教师为50.6%）；四重排列诊断发现模型81%时间预测"A"标签，161题中106题在四种旋转下保持同一标签；格式定向KL阶段后C-Eval提升+12.48分，标签粘滞约减半；随后的SFT和DPO在噪声范围内保持成绩。另发现FP32主权重模式中bf16优化器更新被静默吞掉的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 线性注意力转换会打破模型"读取选项内容"的接口能力，而传统蒸馏指标（困惑度、KL散度）无法捕捉此损伤；需要专门针对输出格式的校准阶段来修复。工作提供了完整的代码、权重、配方和审计轨迹，证明即使在消费级GPU预算下也能进行系统性的转换诊断与修复。

title: Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization
summary: The key-value (KV) cache has become a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context large language model inference, making ultra-low-bit quantization increasingly important. However, existing rotation-based INT2 methods optimize cache statistics or proxy errors before the complete attention readout, even though the model is ultimately affected by the error propagated through attention and the output projection $W_O$. To address this mismatch, we propose \textit{OptR}, an output-aware rotation method that minimizes post-$W_O$ attention-output error. OptR decomposes the post-$W_O$ attention-output error into key- and value-induced terms and learns per-head orthogonal corrections through the full INT2 quantization and attention path. OptR further applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization to reduce large channel-wise offsets without changing the softmax distribution. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, OptR consistently improves both QuaRot and OSCAR and strengthens long-context retrieval, while preserving the paged KV-cache format with negligible inference overhead.
