summary: Tool-using agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed not by a single operator but by many, side by side on shared infrastructure. This creates a population-level risk that single-agent safeguards miss: a handful of agents can quietly coordinate, rigging a market, boosting one another in a review process, or timing a joint data grab, while each one looks perfectly well-behaved. The difficulty is that the organisations running these agents cannot see inside one another's models, so any realistic detector must work from behaviour alone: black-box, trace-only, and often with only partial visibility. We treat covert coordination as an information-hiding problem and build a black-box steganalysis detector that combines cross-run mutual-information estimation, permutation tests, distributional-shift statistics, and timing and tool-call side channels, all calibrated to a fixed false-positive budget. Our central move is to stop testing against a single fixed code: we pit the detector against an adversary that continually rewrites its encoding to slip past whatever the detector has learned, and we run this red-versus-blue contest in tool-using, memory-carrying environments rather than toy games. Capacity theory then tells us what to expect, a detection-capacity frontier, a covert bit-rate below which black-box detection is provably no better than chance. We set out an experiment to map this frontier, report clearly labelled placeholder results pending measurement, and flag a practical evasion, spreading a payload across sessions, that current methods largely miss.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多LLM智能体在共享基础设施上运行时产生的隐性协调风险，提出一种基于黑盒行为特征的隐写检测器，并通过"红蓝对抗"框架研究检测能力边界（检测-容量前沿），指出跨会话载荷分发等实际规避手段。
AI.motivation: 单智能体防护措施无法应对群体层面的风险：多个看似行为正常的智能体可能悄悄协调，操纵市场、互刷评分或协同数据窃取。由于各组织无法看到彼此的内部模型，现实中的检测器只能依赖行为（黑盒、仅轨迹、部分可见）。
AI.method: 将隐性协调视为信息隐藏问题，构建黑盒隐写分析检测器，综合使用跨运行互信息估计、置换检验、分布偏移统计、时间与工具调用侧信道，并校准到固定假阳性预算。核心策略是不针对固定编码测试，而是让检测器与持续改写编码的对抗者进行红蓝对抗，在携带工具与记忆的真实环境中运行。
AI.result: 容量理论揭示了检测-容量前沿：存在一个隐写比特率下限，低于该速率时黑盒检测在证明意义上不比随机猜测更好。论文设计了前沿测绘实验，报告了待测量的明确标注的占位结果，并指出跨会话载荷分发是一种当前方法普遍未能检测到的实际规避手段。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将群体级隐性协调问题建模为信息隐藏问题并给出理论下界，其检测-容量前沿为多智能体部署的信任风险评估提供了理论框架，同时也提醒现有检测方法在跨会话攻击面前存在系统性盲区。

title: Material-Segmented Per-Pixel Emissivity Correction for Thermographic Anomaly Detection in Cultural Heritage Digital Twins
summary: Quantitative longwave thermography of heritage surfaces is limited by the global-constant emissivity assumption in inverse-Planck temperature retrieval; on heterogeneous surfaces emissivity varies within one field of view, producing apparent-temperature artifacts that mimic and mask subsurface anomalies. We present a training-free pipeline that derives per-pixel emissivity by applying SAM 3.1 open-vocabulary segmentation to a colocated, co-calibrated RGB channel, mapping segments to a material-keyed LWIR emissivity table compiled from primary measurement literature, and propagating the field into a per-pixel inverse-Planck solve on raw radiometric data. Lacking any public dataset with raw radiometry, a temperature reference, and a colocated RGB camera, we evaluate on a physics-based synthetic benchmark and four real datasets. On the benchmark, under a palette spanning the low-emissivity exceptions, the correction cuts mean absolute error from 1.97 K to 0.91 K at 20 K contrast and, with an accurate table, beats the best fitted global constant on every layout; on a heritage-realistic emissivity distribution it does not. We contribute a quantified operating-regime map, and a measurement-backed finding that tempers the heritage claim: weathered outdoor heritage emissivities cluster near the conventional default, so the correction is small on typical surfaces and concentrated on genuine low-emissivity exceptions. We characterize the dominant failure mode, in which open-vocabulary segmentation matches appearance rather than material, and the contraindicated regime in which emissivity-defined anomalies are suppressed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的长波热成像逐像素发射率校正管线：利用SAM 3.1开放词汇分割对共定位RGB图像进行材质识别，将分割结果映射到文献编译的材质发射率表，再在原始辐射数据上执行逐像素逆普朗克求解。综合物理仿真基准与四个真实数据集评估后发现：该校正可将20K温差下的平均绝对误差从1.97K降至0.91K，但在遗产文物典型表面（风化室外材质发射率接近常规默认值）上修正幅度有限，且开放词汇分割的"外观而非材质"匹配是主要失效模式。
AI.motivation: 传统长波热成像对遗产表面的定量分析受限于全局恒定发射率假设，在非均质表面上该假设会在逆普朗克温度反演中产生表观温度伪影，既可能模仿也可能掩盖地下异常，因此亟需逐像素发射率校正方法。
AI.method: 构建免训练管线：(1) 使用SAM 3.1开放词汇分割对共定位、共校准的RGB图像进行语义分割；(2) 将分割片段映射到从主要测量文献编译的材质键控LWIR发射率表；(3) 将发射率场传播到原始辐射数据上的逐像素逆普朗克求解中。因缺乏同时包含原始辐射、温度参考和RGB相机的公开数据集，采用物理仿真基准加四个真实数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 在仿真基准上，覆盖低发射率例外材质的调色板下，校正将20K对比度的平均绝对误差从1.97K降至0.91K；使用精确表格时在每种布局上均优于最佳拟合的全局常数。但在遗产真实发射率分布下并不占优，因为风化室外遗产表面发射率接近常规默认值。研究提供了定量化的工作区间图，并揭示主要失效模式是分割器按外观而非材质匹配。
AI.conclusion: 校正方法在低发射率例外材质上效果显著且优于全局常数方法，但对典型遗产表面修正幅度有限，因为其发射率本就接近默认值；同时明确指出开放词汇分割的材质-外观混淆是主导失效模式，且该方法在发射率定义异常被抑制的场景中应避免使用。

title: Passively Safe Convex Guidance for Cislunar Rendezvous and Proximity Operations
comment: Presented at the 2026 AAS/AIAA Astrodynamics Specialist Conference, Whistler, BC
summary: This paper presents purely convex programs for passively safe impulsive rendezvous and proximity operations in cislunar orbits. Approach, arrival, and abort maneuvers are all designed and validated in the context of maneuver execution error and navigation uncertainty, and formulated for efficient onboard execution in the autonomous scenario. The outlined methods form the baseline onboard guidance routines for NASA's CAPSTONE 02 mission planned to demonstrate autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations capabilities in the southern 9:2 synodic near rectilinear halo orbit. High fidelity closed loop Monte Carlo simulations using the planned relative navigation sensor suite and measurement cadence verify the intended maneuver design performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出纯凸优化框架，用于地月空间（cislunar）轨道中被动安全脉冲交会与近距操作，涵盖接近、到达和中止机动，并针对NASA CAPSTONE 02任务进行了高保真蒙特卡洛仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 地月空间轨道中的自主交会与近距操作需要在轨实时求解机动方案，而非凸优化问题难以保证计算效率和收敛性，因此需要将问题建模为纯凸规划以确保机载高效执行。
AI.method: 将接近、到达和中止机动设计表述为纯凸优化程序，在考虑机动执行误差和导航不确定性的条件下进行设计，并采用高保真闭环蒙特卡洛仿真结合规划的相对导航传感器套件和测量节奏进行验证。
AI.result: 所提出的凸优化方法形成了NASA CAPSTONE 02任务的基线机载制导程序，并通过高保真闭环蒙特卡洛仿真验证了机动设计性能满足预期要求。
AI.conclusion: 纯凸规划方法能够在地月空间南部9:2同步近直线晕轨道中实现被动安全的自主交会与近距操作，具备机载实时执行能力和鲁棒性保障。

title: Character Iconicity vs. Arbitrariness: An Arabic NLP Perspective
summary: Arabic script uses 28 letters, many of which share a common base shape (rasm) and are distinguished only by dot placement. Because early Arabic manuscripts were written without dots yet remained interpretable, dot removal offers a natural test of whether these visual distinctions are functionally necessary. Prior work has shown that dotless Arabic can remain readable and effective for natural language processing (NLP), but it remains unclear whether this success depends on preserving the original rasm groupings or whether arbitrary but consistent remappings to the same reduced rasm set can achieve comparable performance. We address this question by comparing standard dotted and dotless Arabic with arbitrary character remappings constrained to the same 19 undotted rasms. We generated 2,000 random remappings under word- and character-level tokenization and selected four representative mappings with the highest and lowest entropy values. These representations were evaluated across language modeling, text classification, sequence labeling, machine translation, and restoration to the original script. The results show that neither preserving original character distinctions nor retaining traditional rasm-based groupings is necessary for strong NLP performance. Random remappings achieve competitive performance while reducing vocabulary size, out-of-vocabulary (OOV) rates, model size, and training cost. These findings suggest that, from an NLP perspective, Arabic character form-function relationships are largely arbitrary: models rely more on stable distributional structure than on the visual iconicity of letter forms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了阿拉伯语无点化（dotless）文本在NLP任务中的字符映射任意性问题，发现随机但一致的字符重映射在多种NLP任务上能达到与保留原始rasm分组相当的性能，表明阿拉伯语字符的形-义关系在很大程度上是任意的。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明无点阿拉伯语在NLP中仍可读且有效，但不清楚这种成功是否依赖于保留原始的rasm（基础字母形状）分组，还是任意但一致的字符重映射也能实现相当的性能。本文旨在区分这两种可能性。
AI.method: 生成2,000个受限于19个无点rasm的随机字符重映射，在词级和字符级分词下选取四个代表性映射（最高和最低熵值），并在语言建模、文本分类、序列标注、机器翻译和原始脚本恢复五个任务上进行评估，与标准带点和无点阿拉伯语进行对比。
AI.result: 随机重映射在各类NLP任务中达到与保留原始字符区分或传统rasm分组相当的性能，同时降低了词表大小、OOV率、模型规模和训练成本。保留原始字符区分或rasm分组并非实现强NLP性能的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 从NLP角度看，阿拉伯语字符的形式-功能关系在很大程度上是任意的，模型更依赖稳定的分布结构而非字母形式的视觉象似性。

title: Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs for Efficient Options Pricing Models
summary: We present a novel application of Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs (NNLCI) to improve the efficiency of existing numerical methods for pricing multi-asset options. The most concise input format for NNLCI has been introduced, offering substantial convenience and efficiency. NNLCI uses a neural network to locally correct solutions from a coarse mesh and a refined mesh (relative to the coarse one), requiring only a minimal amount of high-fidelity training data. We demonstrate this approach on cash-or-nothing options under the Black-Scholes equation in one, two, and three spatial dimensions, and on single-asset down-and-out barrier call options under the Heston stochastic-volatility model (whose pricing PDE is two-dimensional in the spot price $S$ and the instantaneous variance $v$). In each case, NNLCI reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the refined-mesh numerical solution by a factor of approximately 4-12 on test sets, even when the neural network is trained on only a small subset of parameter combinations. These results demonstrate that NNLCI significantly reduces computational requirements for high-dimensional problems in real-time options trading and risk management, offering low training costs and strong generalization ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于局部收敛输入神经网络（NNLCI）的方法，用于提升多资产期权定价数值方法的效率。NNLCI利用神经网络对粗网格和细网格数值解进行局部修正，仅需少量高保真训练数据。在Black-Scholes方程下的一、二、三维现金或无期权以及Heston随机波动模型下的单资产下入出局障碍看涨期权上验证，RMSE降低约4-12倍，显著减少高维问题的计算需求。
AI.motivation: 多资产期权定价通常依赖数值方法，但高维问题（如多维Black-Scholes和Heston模型）的计算成本极高，难以满足实时交易和风险管理的时效性需求。现有数值方法在精度与计算效率之间存在根本性冲突，需要一种能够在不显著增加计算代价的前提下提升数值解精度的方法。
AI.method: NNLCI方法通过神经网络对粗网格与细网格数值解之间的差异进行局部修正。具体而言，引入最简洁的输入格式以提升便利性和效率；神经网络在粗网格解和细网格解的基础上学习局部误差修正项，仅需最少量的高保真训练数据即可实现精度提升。训练数据仅覆盖少数参数组合，但测试时具备泛化能力。
AI.result: 在三种场景中——Black-Scholes方程下的一维、二维、三维现金或无期权，以及Heston随机波动模型下的单资产下入出局障碍看涨期权（二维定价PDE）——NNLCI均将细网格数值解的均方根误差（RMSE）降低了约4-12倍，且仅使用少量参数组合进行训练即可实现。
AI.conclusion: NNLCI方法显著降低了高维期权定价问题的计算需求，具有低训练成本和高泛化能力，适用于实时期权交易和风险管理场景。该方法为数值方法与深度学习的结合提供了有效范式，可扩展到更多复杂金融模型。

title: On the missing benchmarks layer and a potential solution
summary: Latin America is missing a foundational layer for native AI development: the benchmark layer. The benchmark layer does two things no other layer can - it audits AI systems against regional social requirements and it directs AI optimization in economically relevant environments. Without it, public institutions cannot independently evaluate foreign AI systems, and companies cannot optimize AI systems to solve local problems with SOTA performance. The cost of the missing layer is dual: a loss of auditability and a loss of optimization direction over a technology that is increasingly critical infrastructure. We propose an EvalsHub, with LatamBoard as its first regional instance - an open, task-first benchmark infrastructure where universities, public institutions, professional communities, and companies can publish, execute, compare, and maintain evaluations across models, workflows, and agents. Built once, measured forever - re-run by institutions as new AI systems ship and by industry teams after every system change. Open by design and incentive-driven by construction.

AI.tldr: 拉丁美洲缺少AI基准测试层（benchmark layer），这导致公共机构无法独立审计外国AI系统、企业无法针对本地问题优化AI模型。本文提出EvalsHub基础设施，其首个区域实例为LatamBoard，一个开放、任务优先的基准平台，允许大学、公共机构、专业社区和企业发布、执行、比较和维护跨模型、工作流和智能体的评估。
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲缺乏AI开发的基础层——基准测试层。该层具有两项不可替代的功能：一是根据区域社会需求审计AI系统，二是在经济相关环境中引导AI优化方向。缺少这一层导致双重损失：可审计性丧失和优化方向丧失，公共机构无法独立评估外国AI系统，企业也无法以SOTA性能解决本地问题。
AI.method: 提出EvalsHub作为开放、任务优先的基准基础设施，其中LatamBoard是其首个区域实例。该平台支持大学、公共机构、专业社区和企业发布、执行、比较和维护针对模型、工作流和智能体的评估，采用"一次构建、永久测量"的模式，由机构在新AI系统发布时和行业团队在系统变更后反复运行评估。
AI.result: 论文提出的是一个基础设施方案而非具体实验结果。其核心价值主张是：该平台通过开放设计和激励驱动的机制构建，使得评估能够被反复执行，实现了对AI系统的持续审计和优化引导。
AI.conclusion: EvalsHub/LatamBoard为解决拉丁美洲AI基准层缺失问题提供了可操作的基础设施方案，旨在恢复区域内的AI可审计性和本地优化能力，使公共机构和产业界都能在该技术日益成为关键基础设施的背景下获得独立评估与定向优化的能力。

title: FedCARE: A Multi-Objective Personalised Federated Learning Framework for Smart Healthcare
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed healthcare institutions without centralising sensitive patient data. However, real-world healthcare federations are often characterised not only by non-IID data, but also by heterogeneous clinical objectives and partially overlapping feature spaces. Different hospitals may optimise distinct and potentially conflicting objectives, such as mortality risk prediction, readmission reduction, or length-of-stay estimation, while also retaining institution-specific clinical features that cannot be shared with other participants. Existing personalised FL methods mainly address statistical heterogeneity, whereas multi-objective FL approaches typically learn a shared global model without explicit client-level adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{FedCARE}, a multi-objective personalised FL framework for smart healthcare services. FedCARE follows a two-stage training strategy. First, it learns a shared global backbone from common clinical features using Pareto-driven multi-objective federated optimisation. Second, each client independently fine-tunes the shared backbone using its private features and local clinical objectives, enabling institution-specific personalisation without additional communication overhead. We implement FedCARE in a cloud-based client-server federated deployment on the Melbourne Research Cloud and evaluate it on two real-world healthcare datasets, MIMIC-III and Diabetes 130-US Hospitals. Experimental results show that FedCARE consistently outperforms standard FL, multi-objective FL, and personalised FL baselines, achieving up to 12.5% AUROC improvement and 32.0% MAE reduction over FedAvg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedCARE，一个面向智慧医疗服务的多目标个性化联邦学习框架，采用两阶段训练策略（先基于公共临床特征通过Pareto驱动多目标联邦优化学习共享骨干网络，再由各客户端利用私有特征和本地临床目标进行微调），在MIMIC-III和Diabetes 130-US Hospitals两个真实医疗数据集上验证，相比FedAvg实现最高12.5%的AUROC提升和32.0%的MAE降低。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习方法在真实医疗场景中存在不足：个性化FL方法主要处理统计异质性（非IID数据），忽略了不同医院间临床目标的异质性（如死亡风险预测、再入院预测、住院时长估计等可能相互冲突的目标）以及部分重叠的特征空间；多目标FL方法通常学习一个共享全局模型，缺乏客户端级别的个性化适配。因此需要一种同时处理目标和特征异构的联邦学习方法。
AI.method: FedCARE采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段，利用各机构共有的临床特征，通过Pareto驱动的多目标联邦优化学习一个共享的全局骨干网络，能够在多个可能冲突的临床目标间求取最优权衡；第二阶段，各客户端在本地独立地利用其私有特征和特定临床目标对共享骨干进行微调，实现机构特异的个性化适配，且不产生额外通信开销。系统实现基于云计算的客户端-服务器联邦部署架构（Melbourne Research Cloud）。
AI.result: 在两个真实医疗数据集（MIMIC-III和Diabetes 130-US Hospitals）上的实验表明，FedCARE在性能上一致优于标准FL（FedAvg）、多目标FL和个性化FL基线方法，在AUROC指标上最高提升12.5%，在MAE指标上最高降低32.0%。
AI.conclusion: FedCARE有效解决了真实医疗联邦中同时存在的目标异质性（多目标冲突）和特征空间部分重叠的问题，通过共享骨干+本地微调的两阶段策略，在保持通信效率的同时实现了个性化模型性能的显著提升，为智慧医疗服务中的分布式协作学习提供了可行的框架。

title: Privacy-Preserving AI Verification via Minimal Information Disclosure
summary: AI verification crosses a trust boundary: a verifier must learn enough to establish an authorized claim, yet the same evidence can reveal sensitive details about the model, workload, or hardware. We introduce minimal information disclosure (MID), which designs and quantifies the information content of verifier-facing evidence itself. MID measures collateral leakage with conditional mutual information: what the release reveals about the protected property after the authorized result is known. MID is general by design: it can accommodate different verification goals, protected properties, evidence sources, and deployment constraints. To demonstrate MID's practicality, we evaluate it on four physical measurements and six verification tasks spanning execution type, hardware identity, compute scale, and model identity. These experiments use three mechanism-design variables--the evidence channel, collection policy, and release transformation--but MID is not limited to these choices and can accommodate other deployable mechanisms. Across these tasks, MID produces three releases with perfect held-out verification and zero measured collateral leakage, while the remaining tasks yield explicit privacy--utility frontiers. MID also supports ZKP-certified releases: we demonstrate our proposed linear-projection mechanism using a Groth16 zk-SNARK.

AI.tldr: 本文提出最小信息泄露（MID）框架，用于设计和量化AI验证过程中面向验证者证据的信息内容，在保证验证目标达成的同时最小化对模型、工作负载或硬件等受保护属性的附带泄露。
AI.motivation: AI验证存在信任边界问题：验证者必须学习足够信息以确立授权主张，但同一证据可能泄露关于模型、工作负载或硬件的敏感细节。现有方法缺乏对验证者可见证据本身信息内容的系统化设计和量化手段。
AI.method: MID框架使用条件互信息量化附带泄露，即授权结果已知后，信息发布对受保护属性的泄露量。MID具有通用性，可适配不同验证目标、受保护属性、证据来源和部署约束。实验涵盖四种物理测量和六项验证任务，涉及执行类型、硬件身份、计算规模和模型身份，使用三个机制设计变量（证据通道、收集策略、发布变换），并支持Groth16 zk-SNARK的零知识证明认证发布。
AI.result: 在六项验证任务中，MID在三个任务上实现了完美保持验证的同时零附带泄露，其余任务则产生了明确的隐私-效用边界。此外，提出的线性投影机制成功通过Groth16 zk-SNARK实现零知识证明认证发布。
AI.conclusion: MID提供了一种通用且实用的框架来在AI验证中实现最小信息泄露，在验证效用与隐私保护之间取得可量化的平衡，并可扩展到基于零知识证明的部署场景。

title: Qwen-3D: A Generalist 3D Vision-Language Model for Spatial Understanding
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success on images and short videos, yet scaling them to long videos remains challenging due to frame-centric tokenization and limited context windows. 3D geometry provides a natural compression mechanism for visual streams: depth and camera pose enable observations from multiple views and time steps to be fused into a persistent, world-aligned representation. While recent 3D LMMs leverage geometry-aware representations to improve spatial reasoning, they continue to lag behind specialist 3D perception systems on grounding and segmentation tasks. We argue that a key limitation is geometry-aware decoding: existing methods communicate 3D predictions through language tokens, proposal selection, or lightweight grounding queries, creating a bottleneck between language reasoning and dense geometric prediction. Building on these insights, we introduce Qwen-3D, a geometry-aware LMM that compresses visual information within the Qwen backbone using multi-view geometric cues, enabling efficient long-horizon visual reasoning over static scenes. Qwen-3D augments visual tokens with 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings, allowing attention to operate directly in 3D scene space rather than across independent image frames and thereby facilitating scalable cross-view and temporal reasoning. To bridge language and geometry, Qwen-3D incorporates a query-based segmentation decoder that grounds language directly in the underlying 3D scene representation, unifying referential grounding, instance segmentation, and visual question answering across both images and videos. Across a diverse set of benchmarks, Qwen-3D surpasses existing 3D LMMs and outperforms several large proprietary 2D models. Notably, Qwen-3D achieves these improvements while maintaining strong performance on standard 2D vision-language benchmarks by jointly training on 2D and 3D data.

AI.tldr: Qwen-3D是一个基于几何感知的大多模态模型（LMM），通过多视角几何线索在Qwen骨干网络中进行视觉信息压缩，并利用3D旋转位置编码（3D RoPE）使注意力直接在3D场景空间中运行，配合基于查询的分割解码器实现语言到3D几何的桥接。该模型在3D推理任务上超越现有3D LMM和多个大型专有2D模型，同时在标准2D视觉-语言基准上保持强性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LMM在处理长视频时面临帧级Token化和上下文窗口限制的挑战；而当前的3D LMM虽然利用几何感知表示提升空间推理，但在接地（grounding）和分割任务上仍落后于专用3D感知系统。作者认为关键瓶颈在于几何感知解码——现有方法通过语言Token、候选框选择或轻量级接地查询传递3D预测，在语言推理与稠密几何预测之间形成了瓶颈。
AI.method: Qwen-3D采用以下核心设计：（1）利用多视角几何线索在Qwen骨干网络内压缩视觉信息，实现静态场景的长时程视觉推理；（2）为视觉Token引入3D旋转位置编码（3D RoPE），使注意力机制直接在3D场景空间中运行而非独立的图像帧之间，从而支持可扩展的跨视角与时序推理；（3）引入基于查询的分割解码器，将语言直接接地到底层3D场景表示中，统一了指代接地、实例分割和视觉问答任务；（4）通过2D和3D数据联合训练，保持2D视觉-语言基准上的性能。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，Qwen-3D超越了现有3D LMM，并优于多个大型专有2D模型。同时，通过2D和3D联合训练，Qwen-3D在标准2D视觉-语言基准上也保持了强性能。
AI.conclusion: Qwen-3D验证了几何感知解码和3D场景空间注意力可以有效弥补语言推理与稠密几何预测之间的鸿沟，展示了将3D几何压缩与语言模型结合在长时程视觉推理和空间任务（接地、分割、VQA）上的可行性。

title: A Hierarchical Approach to Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Requiring Time Varying Forces
summary: Diffusion policies have shown strong performance in learning complex, multi-modal behaviors for robotic manipulation. However, their application to contact-rich disassembly tasks remains limited by a key trade-off: the iterative denoising process introduces inference latencies that makes high frequency control difficult, which is essential for realizing dynamic interactions such as chiseling and prying. Recent action-chunking techniques mitigate latency but use an open-loop execution window, rendering the system blind to rapid force transients caused by fracture events. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Diffusion Policy Augmented by Fast Trajectory Generation (DPA-FTG). Compared to recent visual-tactile approaches that focus on positional correction, DPA-FTG decouples low-frequency planning from high-frequency force regulation. At the high level ($5$ Hz), a conditional diffusion model predicts a sequence of latent parameters for selecting a strategy from a learned vocabulary of task primitives. At the low level ($60$ Hz), a lightweight, force-conditioned policy acts as a neural impedance controller, modulating execution in real-time to maintain contact stability. We validate our approach on a bimanual battery disassembly task involving the separation of a compliant sheet. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that DPA-FTG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP).

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPA-FTG（扩散策略增强的快速轨迹生成）框架，通过将低频策略规划（5Hz）与高频力调节（60Hz）解耦，解决了扩散策略在接触丰富的拆卸任务中推理延迟与高频控制需求之间的矛盾，并在双臂电池拆卸任务中优于包括Reactive Diffusion Policy在内的SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略在复杂多模态机器人操作任务中表现优异，但在接触丰富的拆卸任务中面临关键权衡：迭代去噪过程引入推理延迟，难以实现高速（高频）控制，而这对于凿击、撬动等动态交互至关重要。现有的动作分块（action-chunking）技术虽降低了延迟，但采用开环执行窗口，无法感知断裂事件引起的快速力瞬变。
AI.method: DPA-FTG将低频规划与高频力调节解耦。高层（5Hz）：条件扩散模型预测一组潜在参数，用于从学习到的任务原语词汇表中选择策略；低层（60Hz）：轻量级、力条件策略作为神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行以维持接触稳定性。
AI.result: 在双臂电池拆卸任务（涉及分离柔性片材）中，DPA-FTG超越了包括Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP)在内的最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入分层控制架构，DPA-FTG在保持扩散策略强大表示能力的同时，实现了高频力调节能力，有效弥合了扩散策略在接触密集操作中的延迟瓶颈，为高速动态操作提供了可行的解决方案。

authors: A K M Ferdous Reza Habib
title: Aligned in Form, Not in Meaning: The Comprehension - Containment Decoupling of LLM Safety in Low-Resource Bangla Derogatory Speech
summary: We audit five frontier large language models on native Bangla derogatory speech (gali) across six protocols to test a single hypothesis: Comprehension-Containment Decoupling. We propose that contemporary safety alignment is bound to high-resource surface forms rather than harmful meaning, causing a model's capacity to comprehend a low-resource slur and its capacity to contain it to operate independently. Every protocol corroborates this hypothesis against a human-calibrated baseline (kappa = 0.84). At baseline, models exhibit a 7.92 percentage point comprehension deficit in Bangla while maintaining an identical 92.83% token leakage rate across both languages. Severity calibration tracks surface anatomical cues over compositional harm (+4.00 error on mild slang; -2.00 on threats), while apparent containment gains under orthographic perturbation prove to be a tokenizer-driven "containment mirage." Crucially, explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning rescues comprehension (94.72% Pass) while systematically dismantling containment (96.23% Use). Furthermore, expert-persona framing collapses refusal to 6.57%, revealing that keyword-based filters ignore dehumanizing communal slurs entirely. Our findings demonstrate that high-resource benchmarks cannot certify low-resource safety, necessitating meaning-grounded containment.

AI.tldr: 本文对五个前沿大语言模型在孟加拉语本土贬损性脏话（gali）上的表现进行了系统审计，提出并验证了"理解-遏制解耦"假说：当代安全对齐绑定的是高资源语言的表层形式而非有害语义，导致模型对低资源语言的脏话理解能力与遏制能力相互独立运行。所有六项协议均证实该假说，并揭示出tokenizer驱动的"遏制幻象"、关键词过滤器无法捕捉去人性化群体脏话等关键问题。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐基准几乎全部基于高资源语言（如英语），无法验证模型在低资源语言上的安全表现。作者希望检验安全对齐是否真正绑定有害语义，而非仅仅绑定到高资源语言的表面形式——若后者成立，则模型对低资源语言的"理解"与"遏制"能力可被解耦，现有基准无法认证低资源环境的安全。
AI.method: 选取五个前沿大语言模型，使用六项协议对孟加拉语脏话进行审计：基线评估（含跨语言对比）、严重性校准分析、正交扰动（拼写变形）下的遏制测试、显式Chain-of-Thought推理测试、专家人设框架测试，并以人类标注者基准（kappa=0.84）作为校准参照。
AI.result: 所有六项协议均证实"理解-遏制解耦"假说。模型在孟加拉语上存在7.92个百分点的理解缺陷，但两种语言的token泄漏率均高达92.83%；严重性校准偏向表层解剖线索而非组合性伤害（轻度俚语误差+4.00，威胁误差-2.00）；正交扰动下的遏制提升实为tokenizer驱动的"遏制幻象"；显式CoT将理解提升至94.72%但将遏制降至96.23%的"使用"率；专家人设框架将拒绝率崩溃至6.57%，揭示关键词过滤器完全忽略去人性化群体脏话。
AI.conclusion: 高资源语言的安全基准无法认证低资源语言的安全性能。现有对齐策略对有害语义的理解是浅层的、表面形式驱动的，必须转向"意义绑定"（meaning-grounded）的遏制机制，而非依赖表层关键词或拼写检测。

title: Evaluation Blindness: How Silent Measurement Failures Corrupt AI Systems from Training to Deployment
summary:
AI systems can fail silently. The failure propagates through training loops, evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring stacks until downstream harm makes it visible. This paper introduces evaluation blindness: a measurement function M exhibits evaluation blindness with respect to failure class F when it produces readings indistinguishable from a healthy state while the system is actually failing, with no auxiliary signal flagging the gap.
  The problem surfaces at two lifecycle stages the literature has treated separately. At training time, reward models are gamed, importance-sampling corrections are silently miscalculated, and benchmark contamination inflates fine-tuning evaluations, all while loss curves look healthy and gradient updates proceed normally. At deployment time, monitoring fails to catch six classes of production failure, including an Operational category that is 100% silent by structural definition.
  We provide a formal detectability predicate unifying both stages. Four training-time case studies trace concrete breakdowns, including a real implementation bug in TRL PR #6594 where gradients are corrupted as loss decreases normally. A six-class taxonomy validated against 50 real-world incidents from court documents and regulatory filings finds that 53% of verifiable public failures were silent. A failure budget framework ties acceptable failure rates to use-case risk class.
  The implication is direct: measurement infrastructure is a correctness concern across the full AI lifecycle, not just at evaluation time. Data, code, and taxonomy schema are at https://github.com/priyanka25aug/llm-failure-taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"评估盲区"（evaluation blindness）概念，指测量函数在系统实际故障时仍产生与健康状态无差别的读数且无辅助信号报警。论文统一了训练期和部署期两个生命周期阶段的检测失败问题，通过形式化的可检测谓词、四类训练期案例研究、六类生产故障分类法（验证50起真实事件，53%均为静默故障）及失败预算框架，论证了测量基础设施是整个AI生命周期中的正确性关切，而非仅限于评估阶段。
AI.motivation: AI系统可能以静默方式失败，故障在训练循环、评估管道和生产监控栈中传播，直到下游危害使其可见。以往文献将训练期和部署期的测量失败分开处理，缺乏统一框架。作者希望揭示"测量看起来正常但系统实际在失败"这一系统性盲区，并证明这是一个贯穿AI全生命周期的正确性问题。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义评估盲区及统一训练/部署两个阶段的可检测谓词；2) 通过四类训练期案例研究展示具体故障（包括TRL PR #6594中梯度被破坏但损失正常下降的真实实现bug）；3) 构建包含六个类别的生产故障分类法，基于50起真实事故（来源为法庭文件和监管文件）进行验证；4) 提出将可接受失败率与用例风险等级关联的失败预算框架。
AI.result: 六类分类法中包括一个"运维类"（Operational）类别，其静默率按结构性定义高达100%。在50起真实事件验证中，53%可核实的公开故障均为静默故障。训练期案例分析揭示了奖赏模型被博弈、重要性采样校正被静默错算、基准污染虚增微调评估等具体失败机制，以及真实代码bug导致梯度损坏而损失正常下降的案例。
AI.conclusion: 测量基础设施不仅是评估阶段的关注点，而是贯穿AI系统全生命周期的正确性关切。评估盲区在训练与部署阶段统一存在，需要将测量失败视为系统性风险进行管理与预算约束。论文已公开数据、代码和分类法schema以供复现与进一步研究。

title: ProPRL: Property-Aware Prerequisite Relation Learning in Educational Knowledge Graphs
summary: Prerequisite relation learning is central to adaptive instruction, yet existing methods often formulate it as conventional link prediction, limiting their ability to adaptively integrate complementary educational evidence for individual candidate pairs and to discourage contradictory reverse predictions. We propose ProPRL, a Property-aware Prerequisite Relation Learning framework. ProPRL first learns complementary concept representations from a concept-resource hypergraph and a directed learning-behavior graph, where direction-preserving personalized propagation aggregates multi-hop behavioral evidence. It then employs a Pair-conditioned Gate to adaptively weight and fuse the two views for each candidate ordered concept pair. Finally, an \textit{Irreversibility Constraint} introduces an anti-symmetry regularizer that penalizes simultaneously high confidence in both directions of the same concept pair. Experiments on multiple real-world educational datasets show that ProPRL achieves state-of-the-art performance on prerequisite relation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出ProPRL框架，通过概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图互补表征学习、Pair-conditioned Gate自适应融合双视图、Irreversibility Constraint反演约束，在多个真实教育数据集上实现先修关系学习的最新最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有先修关系学习方法通常将其建模为传统链接预测，无法针对每个候选概念对自适应地整合互补的教育证据，也缺乏机制抑制相互矛盾的逆向预测（即同一概念对两个方向的矛盾预测）。
AI.method: ProPRL包含三个核心模块：1）从概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图学习互补的概念表征，其中方向保持的个性化传播聚合多跳行为证据；2）Pair-conditioned Gate根据每个候选有序概念对自适应地加权融合两个视图的表征；3）Irreversibility Constraint引入反对称正则化项，惩罚同一概念对两个方向上同时出现高置信度预测。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL在先修关系学习任务上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: ProPRL通过属性感知的先修关系学习框架，有效解决了传统链接预测方法的局限性，证明了互补证据自适应融合与反对称约束对先修关系学习任务的重要性。

title: ReputationChain: Robust Trust Updating for Blockchain-Enabled Supply Chains
summary: Blockchain can preserve supply-chain records, but ledger integrity alone does not show whether a participant should be trusted in a future risk-sensitive transaction. Existing reputation systems mainly address product evidence, global feedback aggregation, or review authenticity, while giving less attention to repeated bilateral inflation, identity multiplicity, and unfair decay for honest participants with sparse histories. We present \RC, a participant trust framework that uses blockchain as an evidence and provenance layer rather than as the source of trust. Governed interaction outcomes are converted into bounded evidence. Repeated interactions between the same pair are discounted, low counterparty diversity is penalized, governance-supplied identity confidence weights positive evidence, and scores decay toward a neutral prior according to verified interaction volume. Identity, contract, outcome, and update provenance remain on chain, while nonlinear reputation computation is performed off chain and checked on chain for admissibility. In controlled simulations with 30 seeded runs and matched interaction traces, the full model reduces mean collusive gain to 0.1443, compared with 0.3688 for naive mean evidence and 0.3585 for static decay. With ten identities under one controller, the reputation inflation ratio falls to 0.8723, while three comparison baselines remain above 1.08. On identical newcomer traces, volume-aware decay increases mean newcomer reputation from 0.6626 to 0.7589 and reduces the false low-trust rate from 0.3633 to 0.1683. Paired analysis confirms these improvements across runs. The results support a bounded reduction in reputation distortion, not attacker detection. Deployment evaluation and calibration with operational data are still required before production use.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于区块链的参与者信任框架\RC，将链上治理互动的结果转换为有界证据用于声誉计算，通过折扣重复双边互动、惩罚低多样性的交易对手、按身份置信度加权正面证据以及按已验证互动量向中性先验衰减评分，来应对共谋通胀、身份多重性及稀疏历史参与者的不公平衰减等问题。模拟实验表明该模型在降低共谋收益、抑制身份通胀和改善新参与者的公平信任方面优于多个基线，但生产部署前仍需实际数据校准。
AI.motivation: 现有区块链声誉系统主要关注产品证据、全局反馈聚合或评论真实性，却忽视了重复双边通胀（两个参与者反复互相抬高评分）、身份多重性（一个控制者通过多个身份自我抬分），以及对历史稀疏但诚实的参与者的不公平衰减。区块链只能保证账本完整，不能表明参与者是否值得在未来的风险敏感交易中被信任，因此需要一个能够减轻这些声誉扭曲的参与信任评估框架。
AI.method: 将区块链定位为证据与溯源层而非信任来源。治理互动的结果被转换为有界证据；同一对参与者之间的重复互动进行折扣；低交易对手多样性受到惩罚；治理提供的身份置信度对正面证据进行加权；评分依据已验证的互动量向中性先验衰减。身份、合同、结果和更新溯源均在链上记录，非线性声誉计算在链外进行并在链上检查其可接受性。
AI.result: 在30次种子运行和匹配互动轨迹的受控模拟中，完整模型将平均共谋收益从朴素均值证据的0.3688和静态衰减的0.3585降至0.1443；在十身份单控制者场景下，声誉通胀比降至0.8723，而三个比较基线均高于1.08；在相同新参与者轨迹上，体量感知衰减将平均新参与者声誉从0.6626提升至0.7589，并将虚假低信任率从0.3633降至0.1683。配对分析确认这些改进在运行间是显著的。该结果支持对声誉扭曲的有界降低，而非攻击者检测。
AI.conclusion: \RC作为一种参与信任框架，以区块链为证据和溯源层，能系统性地减轻声誉通胀、身份多重性和对新参与者不公平衰减造成的声誉扭曲。但该工作目前局限于模拟验证，生产使用前仍需进行部署评估和运营数据校准。

title: Fast Object Removal Attacks on Safety-Critical Video-based Perception Systems
summary: By leveraging data from video-based perception systems, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) support safety-critical applications that improve road safety. However, adversaries may manipulate video frames to compromise downstream perception modules, causing failures in safety-critical functions and increasing risks to vulnerable road users. This paper presents a novel attack model and an end-to-end framework for near-real-time targeted object removal attack on a video-based safety-critical system. The end-to-end attack pipeline consists of four stages: localizing targets in each frame, retrieving coherent patches from earlier frames, blending them using context-aware alpha compositing, and reconstructing attacked frames. Experiments at an intersection on the South Carolina Connected Vehicle Testbed (SC-CVT) show that reconstructed frames have high global similarity to the originals, with frame-level Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 40 dB and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) above 0.996. Using the YOLO-based detector, the attack reduces object detections by up to 97.59% and achieves a frame-level attack success rate of 94.48%. Across the evaluated detectors and frame resolutions, the mean execution time ranges from 0.074 to 0.172 seconds per frame on GPU hardware, indicating near-real-time performance in testing. The forensic evaluation using several pretrained tamper-detection models shows limited ability to distinguish reconstructed from authentic frames. The findings suggest that video-based perception is vulnerable to stealthy object removal attacks that can degrade the performance of safety-critical applications by reducing object detectability. These findings can help develop mitigation strategies against adversarial object removal attacks that threaten safety-critical applications, such as vision-based pedestrian safety systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对视频智能交通系统的端到端近实时目标移除攻击框架，通过四阶段流水线（定位、补丁检索、上下文感知alpha合成、帧重建）在SC-CVT测试交叉口实现了高达97.59%的目标检测减少率和94.48%的帧级攻击成功率，同时保持PSNR>40dB、SSIM>0.996的高视觉相似性，且现有篡改检测模型难以区分重建帧与真实帧。
AI.motivation: 视频感知系统支撑智能交通中的安全关键应用，但攻击者可操纵视频帧以破坏下游感知模块，导致安全功能失效并增加弱势道路使用者的风险。现有研究缺乏针对视频安全关键系统的近实时目标移除攻击模型，因此需要揭示此类漏洞以推动防御策略的开发。
AI.method: 提出端到端攻击流水线，包括四个阶段：1）在每帧中定位目标；2）从先前帧检索连贯的图像块；3）使用上下文感知alpha合成进行混合；4）重建被攻击帧。在南卡罗来纳州互联车辆测试平台（SC-CVT）交叉口进行实验验证。
AI.result: 重建帧的PSNR>40dB、SSIM>0.996；基于YOLO检测器，攻击将目标检测减少高达97.59%，帧级攻击成功率达94.48%；GPU上的平均执行时间为每帧0.074-0.172秒，接近实时；多个预训练篡改检测模型难以区分重建帧与真实帧。
AI.conclusion: 视频感知系统易受隐蔽的目标移除攻击，该类攻击可显著降低安全关键应用中目标的可检测性。研究结果为开发针对对抗性目标移除攻击的缓解策略提供了依据，尤其有助于保护基于视觉的行人安全系统。

title: V-FIND: Revealing the Intrinsic Forgery Knowledge Encoded in Video Forgery Detectors
summary: As generated videos become increasingly realistic, reliable video forgery detection is increasingly important. Existing studies typically optimize and use video forgery detectors as black boxes, while the latent forgery-discriminative knowledge inside them remains largely unexplored. Instead of continuing to rely on resource-intensive full-model retraining to steadily improve detection performance, we ask whether video forgery detection can also be achieved by uncovering and activating sparse forensic knowledge within the detector. We find that forgery-discriminative knowledge is not uniformly distributed across the full representation space, but is concentrated in a sparse set of functionally specialized neurons. Based on this insight, we propose a video forgery-intrinsic neuron discovery (V-FIND) framework. V-FIND first localizes critical layers that exhibit pronounced discrepancies between real and forged videos, and then identifies latent anchor neurons that consistently carry forgery-discriminative signals, organizing them into a compact forensic subspace. With the original backbone frozen and only a lightweight linear classifier trained, this subspace still delivers strong detection performance across multiple external benchmarks for generated videos. Further neuron intervention experiments provide direct evidence for the functional specificity of the discovered neurons. Overall, these results suggest that video forgery detectors contain sparse, extractable, and reusable forgery-discriminative knowledge, offering a new perspective on understanding and exploiting their intrinsic forensic capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V-FIND框架，通过发现视频伪造检测器中稀疏的功能特化神经元，仅用冻结主干加轻量线性分类器即可实现强检测性能，揭示了伪造判别知识在检测器中是可提取、可复用的稀疏资源。
AI.motivation: 现有视频伪造检测研究通常将检测器视为黑盒进行全量重训练以提升性能，忽略了检测器内部潜在的伪造判别知识。这种方法资源消耗大且未深入理解检测器内部机制。作者提出一个问题：是否可以通过发现和激活检测器内的稀疏取证知识来实现视频伪造检测，而非依赖资源密集的全模型重训练。
AI.method: V-FIND框架包含两个关键步骤：(1) 定位真实与伪造视频之间表现出显著差异的关键层（critical layers）；(2) 识别持续携带伪造判别信号的潜在锚点神经元（anchor neurons），并将其组织成一个紧凑的取证子空间（forensic subspace）。在推理阶段，冻结原始主干网络，仅训练一个轻量线性分类器在该子空间上进行分类。
AI.result: 冻结主干并仅训练轻量线性分类器的情况下，V-FIND在多个外部生成视频基准上仍取得强检测性能。此外，神经元干预实验直接验证了所发现神经元的功能特异性，证明这些神经元确实专门负责伪造判别。
AI.conclusion: 视频伪造检测器包含稀疏、可提取且可复用的伪造判别知识，为理解和利用检测器内在取证能力提供了新视角，挑战了以往依赖全模型重训练的范式。

title: Shooting for Contact: Contact-Implicit Multiple Shooting for Dynamic Motion Retargeting
comment: Project website with additional material: https://shooting-for-contact.github.io/
summary: Motion retargeting approaches often prioritize kinematic similarity over whole-body dynamics, contact consistency, and actuation limits, yielding references that are difficult for reinforcement learning (RL) policies to reproduce, particularly for contact-rich behaviors. We present a contact-implicit, direct simulation-based multiple shooting (DSMS) framework that transforms kinematically feasible references into dynamically feasible whole-body trajectories. By embedding a differentiable simulator within a nonlinear program, DSMS resolves contact, friction, impacts, self-collision, and joint limits internally while enforcing tracking, actuation, and task constraints without prescribing a contact schedule or introducing explicit contact constraints. Compared with existing retargeting methods, DSMS accelerates motion-imitation RL training and yields policies with high success rates and low tracking error. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree G1 through command-conditioned contact-rich crawling and a highly dynamic 180-degree jump-turn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于接触隐式直接模拟的多重射击（DSMS）框架，通过将可微分模拟器嵌入非线性规划中，将运动学上可行的参考轨迹转化为动力学上可行的全身运动轨迹，无需预设接触时序或显式接触约束，显著加速了运动模仿强化学习训练，并在Unitree G1上实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有运动重定向方法过度关注运动学相似性，忽视全身动力学、接触一致性和执行器限制，导致生成的参考轨迹难以被强化学习策略复现，尤其是在接触丰富的行为中表现不佳。
AI.method: DSMS框架将可微分模拟器嵌入非线性规划（NLP）中，通过接触隐式方式在内部解析接触、摩擦、冲击、自碰撞和关节限位等问题，同时施加跟踪、执行器和任务约束，无需预设接触时序或引入显式接触约束。
AI.result: 与现有重定向方法相比，DSMS加速了运动模仿强化学习训练，所生成策略具有高成功率和低跟踪误差；在Unitree G1上实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移，包括命令调节的接触丰富爬行和高速180度跳转。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接基于仿真生成动力学可行的参考轨迹，而非仅追求运动学相似性，可以显著提升强化学习策略的训练效率和任务成功率，并支持向真实机器人平台的零样本迁移。

title: OPTD: On-Policy Transition Distillation with Consistency-Guided Adaptive Compression for Few-Step Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) can predict many tokens in parallel, but accurate generation still requires many iterative denoising steps. Few-step distillation accelerates decoding by compressing multiple teacher steps into a single student transition. However, existing methods construct supervision on off-policy trajectories. At inference, the student's early parallel commitments alter the context of later predictions, so the states it actually visits drift away from the supervised ones--precisely when step compression is most aggressive. On-policy distillation is a natural remedy for this mismatch, but it leaves open how far each transition should advance: matching only the teacher's next action limits compression, while indiscriminately merging future actions can violate intermediate dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose OPTD, On-Policy Transition Distillation with consistency-guided adaptive compression. It samples partial states from the few-step student's own trajectories, uses a frozen, question-only teacher to identify outcome-aligned future candidates, and orders them by current-state confidence. The method then selects the longest prefix whose joint commitment preserves the teacher's rollout outcome. A set-bottleneck objective promotes every verified future candidate to the decoder's release threshold, while a frozen-teacher KL anchor regularizes all other active positions. Neither target construction nor training uses a gold response. Across four mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, OPTD consistently improves the quality--efficiency trade-off and attains the strongest overall quality-constrained AUP among the evaluated few-step baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出OPTD（On-Policy Transition Distillation），一种基于一致性引导自适应压缩的在线策略过渡蒸馏方法，用于扩散语言模型的少步加速。通过从学生自身轨迹采样部分状态，利用冻结教师模型识别结果对齐的未来候选并按置信度排序，选择保持教师rollout结果的最长前缀进行联合承诺，从而解决现有少步蒸馏中off-policy轨迹导致的训练推理不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽可并行预测多个token，但准确生成仍需大量迭代去噪步骤。现有少步蒸馏方法在off-policy轨迹上构建监督，推理时学生早期并行承诺会改变后续预测的上下文，导致实际访问的状态偏离监督状态——尤其是在步压缩最激进时。因此需要一种on-policy的蒸馏方法，同时解决过渡步长选择问题：仅匹配教师下一动作会限制压缩程度，不加区分地合并未来动作可能违反中间依赖关系。
AI.method: OPTD方法包含以下核心组件：1）从少步学生自身的轨迹中采样部分状态（on-policy）；2）使用冻结的仅依赖问题的教师模型识别结果对齐的未来候选token；3）按当前状态置信度对候选项排序；4）选择保持教师rollout结果的最长前缀作为联合承诺；5）采用set-bottleneck目标促进已验证的未来候选项达到解码器的释放阈值；6）通过冻结教师KL锚点正则化所有其他活跃位置。训练和目标构建均不依赖黄金响应。
AI.result: 在四个数学推理和代码生成基准上，OPTD一致性地改善了质量-效率权衡，在评估的少步基线上取得了最强的总体质量约束AUP（Area Under the quality-constraint Performance curve）。
AI.conclusion: OPTD通过on-policy采样与一致性引导的自适应压缩，有效解决了少步蒸馏中状态漂移与步压缩之间的根本矛盾，在不使用黄金响应的条件下显著提升了扩散语言模型的少步生成质量与效率权衡。

title: Topological Simplification in Predictive Coding Networks
comment: Accepted to the 2nd Annual Conference on Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS 2026); to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research
summary: We study the topology of learned representations in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a neuro-inspired bidirectional architecture, using a quantitative layer-wise persistent homology analysis. We train well-performing PCNs on a synthetic classification dataset ($\geq 99.9\%$ test accuracy) and on MNIST ($\geq 95\%$ test accuracy), and measure how topological features change across layers for different architectures and activation functions. We find that smaller PCNs collapse connected components across layers earlier than larger models (Spearman $\unicode{x1D70C} \in [0.72, 0.79]$ across activations), with model size measured as the sum of hidden-layer widths. We also observe a strong negative correlation ($\unicode{x1D70C} = -0.58$) between the depth at which simplification occurs and reconstruction error; i.e., architectures that simplify later reconstruct better. Finally, a seed-level bootstrap comparison across architectures and activations shows that PCNs consistently collapse connected components later than matched MLPs, with an average difference of $3.6$ layers. These results suggest that persistent homology offers a useful quantitative lens on the compression--reconstruction tradeoff in PCNs, and that both model capacity and the recurrent, bidirectional dynamics of predictive coding inference shape when this tradeoff is resolved across layers.

AI.tldr: 本文使用逐层持久同调分析研究了预测编码网络（PCNs）学习表示的拓扑结构，发现更小的PCN更早地在各层中坍缩连通分量，简化发生深度与重建误差呈负相关，且PCN比匹配的MLP更晚坍缩连通分量（平均差3.6层），表明持久同调为理解PCN中压缩-重建权衡提供了定量视角。
AI.motivation: 预测编码网络作为一种神经启发的双向架构，其学习表示的拓扑结构尚未被充分理解。作者希望借助持久同调这一拓扑数据分析工具，定量刻画PCN在不同架构和激活函数下跨层表示的拓扑变化，从而揭示模型容量和双向推理机制对表示压缩-重建权衡的影响。
AI.method: 采用逐层持久同调分析，在合成分类数据集（测试准确率≥99.9%）和MNIST（≥95%）上训练高性能PCN，测量不同架构和激活函数下拓扑特征在各层间的变化。使用Spearman相关系数衡量模型大小（隐藏层宽度之和）与组件坍缩层的关系，并通过基于种子（seed）的bootstrap比较在不同架构和激活函数间进行统计推断。
AI.result: （1）较小PCN比大模型更早坍缩连通分量（Spearman ρ ∈ [0.72, 0.79]，跨激活函数一致）；（2）简化发生的深度与重建误差呈强负相关（ρ = -0.58），即越晚简化重建越好；（3）PCN比匹配的MLP平均晚3.6层坍缩连通分量，且这一差异在种子级bootstrap下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 持久同调为PCN的压缩-重建权衡提供了有效的定量视角；模型容量以及预测编码中循环、双向推理的动力学会共同决定该权衡在层间被解决的位置。

title: UrbanAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Cross-System Urban Tasks
summary: Modern cities rely on an increasing number of digital services to operate, but residents' daily needs are still difficult to meet. Services are fragmented and have little interoperability, placing a heavy operational burden on users. Existing digital platforms, urban foundation models, and intelligent assistants each address only isolated aspects of an urban task. But they struggle to reliably convert complex natural-language requests into executable cross-system workflows. We propose Urban-Agent, a tool-augmented agent framework for cross-system urban tasks. It couples the cognitive and reasoning capabilities of a large language model with a tool-set supporting code execution, API calls, and Model Context Protocol. Through one adaptive closed loop, it clarifies missing information before acting, grounds tool use in live observations, and aligns the final response with observed evidence and task constraints. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce Urban-Eval, a benchmark specifically designed for cross-system urban request. Unlike prior benchmarks that assess either general tool use or urban knowledge and reasoning, Urban-Eval evaluates both task results and execution quality, including required tool coverage, dependency validity, and evidence traceability. Experimental results indicate that Urban-Agent reaches a 71% task success rate, 10 points above the strongest baseline. This lead holds across GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-V4-flash, and Qwen3-235B-A22B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Urban-Agent，一个工具增强的智能体框架，用于跨系统城市任务，通过闭环自适应流程将大语言模型的推理能力与代码执行、API调用和MCP工具集相结合，同时引入Urban-Eval基准来评估跨系统城市请求的任务结果和执行质量。
AI.motivation: 现代城市依赖数字服务但服务碎片化且互操作性差，现有数字平台、城市基础模型和智能助手只能解决城市任务的孤立方面，难以可靠地将复杂的自然语言请求转换为可执行的跨系统工作流，存在明显的评估缺口。
AI.method: Urban-Agent框架采用大语言模型结合工具集（代码执行、API调用、Model Context Protocol），通过一个自适应的闭环流程：在执行前澄清缺失信息、基于实时观测进行工具接地、将最终响应与观测证据和任务约束对齐。同时构建Urban-Eval基准，评估任务结果和执行质量（工具覆盖率、依赖有效性、证据可追溯性）。
AI.result: Urban-Agent达到71%的任务成功率，比最强基线高出10个百分点，该优势在GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-V4-flash和Qwen3-235B-A22B等多个模型上保持一致。
AI.conclusion: Urban-Agent通过工具增强和闭环自适应机制有效解决了跨系统城市任务的复杂自然语言请求转换问题，Urban-Eval为跨系统城市任务评估提供了更全面的基准，实验结果证明了框架的稳定优越性。

title: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Through Model Poisoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is an increasingly important component of AI safety stacks but relies on the assumption that a model's reasoning trace is informative about its actions. This work studies the limits of CoT monitoring through the lens of model poisoning. We demonstrate that backdoors can be implanted into reasoning models to elicit an attacker-chosen behavior while their CoT traces appear entirely benign. We find that these CoT-Hidden backdoors can be induced through simple fine-tuning recipes across reasoning-model architectures and sizes. When direct poisoning is ineffective, we introduce a curriculum training approach that progressively teaches the model to produce an attacker-chosen output while concealing the behavior from its reasoning traces. These findings suggest that CoT monitoring may be better framed as a question about the consistency between a model's reasoning trace and its final response than as anomaly detection within a trace. We further examine the mechanisms that allow models to suppress evidence of the target behavior from their reasoning traces. Causal interventions locate a trigger-conditioned activation pathway that does not depend on the visible reasoning, and residual stream verbalizations provide an anomaly warning near answer generation, but do not identify the trigger, target, or backdoor mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，通过简单的微调配方可以在推理模型（reasoning models）中植入"CoT隐藏后门"（CoT-Hidden backdoors），使模型执行攻击者选定的行为但其思维链（CoT）痕迹看似完全正常。当直接投毒无效时，作者提出了一种课程式训练方法渐进地教会模型在隐藏行为的同时掩盖推理痕迹。因果干预实验发现触发条件激活通路不依赖于可见推理，残差流言语化在答案生成附近提供异常警告但无法识别触发词、目标或后门机制。作者建议CoT监控应更侧重于推理痕迹与最终回答之间的一致性检查，而非痕迹内的异常检测。
AI.motivation: CoT监控是AI安全栈中日益重要的组成部分，但它依赖于一个假设：模型的推理痕迹能反映其行动。本研究旨在测试这一假设的边界，探究通过模型投毒是否可以使推理模型在产生良性CoT痕迹的同时执行攻击者选择的行为，从而揭示CoT监控的局限性。
AI.method: 作者采用两种方法：(1) 简单的微调配方，直接植入CoT隐藏后门，涵盖多种推理模型架构和规模；(2) 当直接投毒无效时，引入课程式训练（curriculum training），渐进式地训练模型产生攻击者选择的输出同时从推理痕迹中隐藏该行为。此外，使用因果干预和残差流分析来研究模型抑制目标行为证据的机制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明CoT隐藏后门可以通过简单微调在多种推理模型上成功植入。因果干预揭示了存在一个不依赖可见推理的触发条件激活通路，残差流言语化在答案生成附近提供了异常警告，但无法识别触发词、目标或后门的具体机制。
AI.conclusion: CoT监控应当被重新定义为关于模型推理痕迹与最终回答之间一致性的问题，而不是对推理痕迹内部的异常检测。现存的CoT监控方法在面对精心构造的后门攻击时存在根本性局限。

title: Clinically-Grounded Hierarchical Classification for Consistent Chest X-ray Interpretation
comment: MICCAI 2026 Accepted. First & Corresponding author: Jong Hak Moon (jh.moon@yejix.com)
summary: Accurate chest X-ray interpretation is inherently hierarchical. Clinical decisions depend not only on what abnormality is present but where it is situated, requiring reasoning from broad anatomical systems down to specific pathological findings. Yet existing automated systems largely treat this as a flat classification problem, failing to capture inter-level dependencies or enforce coherence between coarse and fine predictions. We propose CHASE (Classification with Hierarchical Analysis and Structured Enforcement), a unified single-stage framework that mirrors radiologists' coarse-to-fine reasoning through a clinically driven three-level taxonomy of 9 anatomical regions, 17 sub-regions, and 28 pathological findings. CHASE jointly optimizes multi-level supervision, cross-level probability alignment, and a hierarchy-violation penalty within a shared Vision Transformer backbone. This ensures that fine-grained findings are anatomically supported by their coarser-level context rather than predicted in isolation. Experiments demonstrate that CHASE outperforms flat and hierarchical baselines across all levels while achieving superior probabilistic hierarchy consistency, with level-wise attention maps confirming anatomically grounded predictions. Code is available at: https://github.com/yejix-ai/CHASE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHASE框架，将胸部X光片解读建模为层级分类任务，通过三个层级（9个解剖区域、17个子区域、28个病理发现）的联合优化与跨层级一致性约束，在共享Vision Transformer骨干上实现粗到细的推理，实验表明其优于平面与层级基线方法。
AI.motivation: 胸部X光解读本质上是层级化的——临床决策不仅取决于存在何种异常，还取决于其位置，需要从解剖系统推理到具体病理发现。然而现有自动化系统大多将其视为平面分类问题，未能捕捉层级间依赖关系或强制执行粗粒度与细粒度预测间的一致性。
AI.method: 提出CHASE（Classification with Hierarchical Analysis and Structured Enforcement），一个统一单阶段框架。具体包括：1）临床驱动的三层级分类体系：9个解剖区域、17个子区域、28个病理发现；2）共享Vision Transformer骨干上的多层级监督联合优化；3）跨层级概率对齐；4）层级违例惩罚机制，确保细粒度发现由粗粒度上下文支撑而非孤立预测。
AI.result: 实验表明CHASE在所有层级上均优于平面与层级基线方法，同时取得更优的概率层级一致性；层级级注意力图证实了预测具有解剖依据。
AI.conclusion: CHASE通过结构化层级建模和一致性约束，有效模拟了放射科医生的粗到细推理过程，在提升分类精度的同时保证了预测的解剖学合理性。

title: DigitCode: Symbolic Tokenization of Hand Motion by Anatomical Units
summary: Hand motion carries the finest-grained information in human activity, yet the representations behind hand generation, understanding, and robot learning are overwhelmingly continuous--joint angles or MANO parameters. These are accurate but unstructured: a finger cannot be indexed or edited as a symbol, and nothing marks a pose as anatomically valid. Discrete symbolic representations supply exactly this structure, and Hand Labanotation (HL) has shown they are feasible for the hand, writing motion as a T x 40 grid of one fixed direction symbol per bone. Building on this grid, we ask the question underneath it: the anatomical unit a symbol should span--bone, finger, or whole hand. DigitCode answers it by adapting, grouping, and layering HL's alphabet along the hand's unit hierarchy within one code, cutting the symbolic representation's quantization error by three quarters. The lever is the unit, not the quantizer family: at a fixed unit, training-free and learned strong quantizers are interchangeable on reconstruction, while moving down the anatomical hierarchy is what shifts accuracy. The hierarchy also tracks what downstream tasks need. Because a finger is a genuine, enumerable unit, one per-finger token doubles as a training-free, editable handle for jobs a continuous representation cannot address--repairing malformed generated hands, and retargeting them onto robots. We release HandTok, a reproducible testbed, so hand tokenizers can be compared unit-for-unit. Project page: https://digitcode-demo.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DigitCode，一种基于Hand Labanotation (HL)的离散符号化手部运动表示方法。通过沿手部解剖单元层级（骨骼、手指、整只手）适配、分组和分层HL的字母表，将符号表示的量化误差降低四分之三。论文核心发现是解剖单元（而非量化器族）是影响精度的关键杠杆；每个手指token可作为免训练的可编辑手柄，用于修复畸形生成手部和将动作重定向到机器人。作者发布HandTok可复现测试平台以供单元级比较。
AI.motivation: 手部运动包含人类活动中最细粒度的信息，但现有的手部生成、理解和机器人学习表示（如关节角度或MANO参数）是连续且非结构化的：手指无法作为符号被索引或编辑，也没有机制标记姿态是否符合解剖学有效。离散符号表示（如Hand Labanotation）能提供这种结构，但其符号应跨越的解剖单元（骨骼、手指或整只手）这一问题尚未被回答。DigitCode旨在探究并利用解剖层级这一核心杠杆来构建更优的手部符号化表示。
AI.method: DigitCode基于HL的T×40网格（每根骨骼一个固定方向符号），通过沿手部解剖单元层级适配、分组和分层HL的字母表，将符号统一编码到一个代码中。论文通过实验验证：在固定解剖单元时，免训练和学习的强量化器在重建上可互换；而沿解剖层级下移（从整手到手指到骨骼）才是提升精度的关键。每个手指作为可枚举的解剖单元，被设计为一个per-finger token，同时充当免训练、可编辑的句柄。
AI.result: DigitCode将符号化手部运动表示的量化误差比HL降低了四分之三。研究揭示解剖单元是精度提升的关键杠杆而非量化器族。该表示支持两类连续表示无法完成的任务：修复形态畸形/不合理的生成手部，以及将手部动作重定向到机器人上。同时发布了HandTok可复现测试平台，支持不同手部tokenizer的单元级比较。
AI.conclusion: 手部离散符号化表示的关键设计维度是符号所跨越的解剖单元层级。选择手指作为单元能同时获得高重建精度和可编辑性（每指一个token），使符号化表示在实际下游任务（手部修复和机器人重定向）中展现出超越连续表示的结构化优势。

title: Every Wrong Answer Counts: Option-Level Psychometrics for LLM Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
summary: Most multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) only by whether they select the correct answers. This binary scoring treats all incorrect responses alike, even though an LLM's preferences among incorrect options may contain systematic and useful information about its behavior and ability. We introduce the LLM Nominal Response Model (LLM-NRM), an option-aware psychometric framework that models the full distribution over answer choices to jointly estimate LLM ability and option-level item characteristics, while separating model-specific response calibration sharpness, positional preference, and difficulty-dependent fallback behavior. Across 189 LLMs and 31,554 items from 14 benchmarks, LLM-NRM predicts held-out LLM-item interactions more accurately than binary Item Response models and conventional nominal-response baselines, and its ability estimates achieve the strongest Spearman correlation of 0.920 with the external human-preference Arena.ai Elo leaderboard. Distractor identity contributes +101% additional Fisher Information per item beyond correctness, and incorrect responses alone recover full-information ability estimates with Spearman 0.943. The learned item parameters also enable efficient benchmarking, where 41 selected items preserve the full-bank ranking with Kendall's correlation 0.85, corresponding to a 770 times reduction. In conclusion, we show that incorrect answers carry distinct and useful measurement information rather than representing equivalent mistakes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-NRM（LLM名义反应模型），一个选项感知的心理测量学框架，通过建模LLM在选择题上的完整答案分布而非仅二值正确/错误，联合估计LLM能力与题目选项级特征，并分离响应校准锐度、位置偏好和难度依赖的"掉线"行为。在14个基准的189个LLM和31,554道题目上，LLM-NRM比二值IRT模型和传统名义反应基线预测更准确，能力估计与Arena.ai Elo外部人类偏好排名的Spearman相关达0.920；干扰项身份提供较正确性多101%的Fisher信息，仅用错误答案恢复全信息能力估计（Spearman 0.943）；41道精选题目能以Kendall相关系数0.85保留全题目库排序，实现770倍题目缩减。
AI.motivation: 现有MCQ基准仅以是否选对来评估LLM，将所有错误答案视为等价。作者认为错误的选项偏好中包含关于LLM行为和能力的系统性、有价值的信息，而现有二值评分框架无法捕捉这些信息，因此需要一种能建模完整答案分布的选项感知心理测量框架。
AI.method: 提出LLM-NRM，一种基于名义反应模型的选项感知心理测量框架：对每个题目，建模LLM在所有选项上的完整概率分布，而非仅正确/错误二值。框架联合估计：(1) LLM能力参数；(2) 选项级题目特征（如干扰项吸引力）；(3) 模型特定的响应校准锐度；(4) 位置偏好；(5) 依赖难度的fallback行为。通过将LLM的类别响应与选项相对吸引力关联，分离这些因素以得到更纯净的能力估计。
AI.result: 在189个LLM和31,554道题目（14个基准）上：(1) LLM-NRM对留出交互的预测准确率优于二值IRT模型和传统名义反应基线；(2) 能力估计与Arena.ai Elo外部人类偏好排名Spearman相关达0.920；(3) 干扰项身份提供较正确性多101%的Fisher信息；(4) 仅用错误答案即可恢复全信息能力估计（Spearman 0.943）；(5) 41道精选题目以Kendall相关0.85保留全题库排序，实现770倍缩减。
AI.conclusion: 错误的答案并不等价——不同错误选项间的偏好模式携带显著的测量信息。LLM-NRM证明通过建模完整的名义响应分布，可以更精确地估计LLM能力、更深入地理解题目特征，并大幅提升基准测试效率。这挑战了传统二值评分的做法，为LLM评估提供了更丰富的心理测量学视角。

title: Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't
summary: Model families train every size from scratch. Can a pretrained large model be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in the Pythia family end-to-end: (i) representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly; (ii) dense weight projection is functionally destructive -- provably not an assembly artifact -- because basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure; (iii) after the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls; (iv) conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers -- least-squares compensation (function: best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics: best endpoints). Compensation is a token-efficient, low-budget win rather than a universal one: at 30M tokens it beats the strongest subcloning variant on both a width-reduced pair (84.0 +/- 1.8 vs. 89.7 +/- 3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds), reaching a given quality with fewer tokens; at a 33x larger budget the two converge to parity (40.0 vs. 40.0), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer initialization always beats -- by up to 18x at low budget, the margin narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale. We further map the method's boundary: at ~5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, which we trace to ill-conditioning of the compensation solve at large width, pointing to dimension-aware regularization as the fix. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen evaluation corpus are released.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大型预训练模型向更小模型的转换问题，以Pythia家族1.4B->410M转换为范例，发现表示层对齐强而参数层对齐弱，转换价值在于初始化而非参数直接投影；提出将转换分解为最小二乘补偿与方差保持重缩放两个独立杠杆，前者在低预算下显著优于子克隆变体（30M token时3/3种子胜出），但二者在33倍预算下收敛至同等水平，且转换初始化始终优于从零训练。在6.9B->1.4B尺度下，由于补偿求解的病态条件导致过度校正，需引入维度感知正则化。
AI.motivation: 模型家族通常从零训练每个规模，但能否将预训练大模型高效转换为更小的兄弟模型？这一问题的核心在于理解大模型知识压缩到小模型的可行性与机制，以节省小模型训练的计算成本。
AI.method: 以Pythia家族1.4B->410M转换为例进行端到端表征：(i)通过ridge回归分析表示对齐（R^2=0.84）与参数对齐的差异；(ii)验证稠密权重投影的功能破坏性并排除组装伪影，归因于基混合破坏rotary、逐头、GELU与LayerNorm结构；(iii)用打乱对照证明最佳线性算子后的权重残差与噪声不可区分；(iv)将转换分解为两个独立杠杆——最小二乘补偿（优化零样本功能）与方差保持重缩放（优化动态端点），并在匹配预算的持续预训练中进行评估。
AI.result: 在30M token预算下，补偿策略在宽度缩减对（84.0±1.8 vs 89.7±3.7）和深度缩减对（109.3 vs 117.9）上均以3/3种子胜过最强子克隆变体，以更少token达到同等质量；在33倍预算下二者收敛至同等水平（40.0 vs 40.0），且远优于从零训练——转换初始化在低预算下可带来高达18倍的提升。在更大尺度（6.9B->1.4B）上，叠加两个杠杆导致过度校正，根因是宽度增大时补偿求解的病态条件。
AI.conclusion: 预训练大模型到小模型的转换价值实质上存在于初始化阶段，而非参数空间的直接近似。最小二乘补偿是token高效的低预算策略而非通用胜者，预算充足时与重缩放收敛至同等效果。转换方法的边界由补偿求解的病态条件决定，维度感知正则化是可行修复方向。

title: LoCA: Forward-Only LLM Tuning after One-Shot Calibration with Local Credit Assignment
summary: Parameter-efficient post-training reduces the number of trainable parameters, but still requires repeated end-to-end backpropagation through the frozen backbone. Every adaptation step therefore needs backward-capable hardware and must store or recompute activations. We ask whether this repeated backward chain can be replaced by a one-time calibration. We introduce Local Credit Assignment (LoCA), a two-stage method for small-shift adaptation. One probe backward pass fits a low-rank map at each transformer block from the final prediction error to a local hidden-state correction. LoCA then reuses these maps to form blockwise regression targets from forward activations and fits low-rank adapters with closed-form ridge solves. No further backbone backward pass is required. We evaluate LoCA on five discriminative benchmarks with Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 14B. In 16 of 25 reported task--scale comparisons, LoCA yields lower evaluation cross-entropy than the corresponding LoRA run. Its measured full-run GPU peak, including calibration, is 26--29\% lower than LoRA's. After calibration, its CPU steady-state memory is 36--52\% lower and its per-pass time is 43--48\% lower. A shared scale-normalized candidate set is reused across all tested Qwen2.5 sizes and on SmolLM2-1.7B. LoCA thus amortizes global credit assignment into one calibration and enables later forward-only tuning when repeated backpropagation is impractical. The code associated with this paper is available \href{https://github.com/Xia12121/LoCA}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Local Credit Assignment (LoCA)方法，用一次前向探测和低秩映射的闭式岭回归替代传统后训练中反复的反向传播。在五个判别基准上对Qwen2.5（0.5B至14B）进行评估，结果在16/25的task-scale比较中优于LoRA，GPU峰值内存降低26-29%，校准后CPU稳态内存降低36-52%，单遍时间降低43-48%。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数高效后训练（如LoRA）虽然减少了可训练参数数量，但仍需要对冻结的骨干网络进行端到端的重复反向传播，这意味着每次适配步骤都依赖支持反向传播的硬件，且必须存储或重计算激活值。作者希望用一次性校准替代这种重复的反向传播链，以减少硬件需求和计算开销。
AI.method: LoCA是一种两阶段的小偏移适应方法。第一阶段进行一次探针反向传播，在每个Transformer块中拟合一个从最终预测误差到局部隐藏状态修正的低秩映射；第二阶段复用这些映射，从前向激活中形成分块回归目标，并用闭式岭回归拟合低秩适配器。整个过程无需再进行骨干网络的反向传播。
AI.result: 在五个判别基准上使用Qwen2.5（0.5B至14B）进行评估，16/25的task-scale对比中LoCA的评估交叉熵低于LoRA。完整运行的GPU峰值（含校准阶段）比LoRA低26-29%；校准后CPU稳态内存降低36-52%，单遍时间降低43-48%。统一的尺度归一化候选集可复用于所有Qwen2.5尺寸及SmolLM2-1.7B。
AI.conclusion: LoCA将全局信用分配摊销为一次性校准，使得在重复反向传播不切实际的场景下也能进行仅前向的调优，在降低资源消耗的同时，在多数情况下保持了与LoRA相当或更优的效果。

title: Resume Means Resume: A Machine-Checked Conformance Contract for Checkpoint, Interrupt, and Resume Semantics in Workflow Persistence Layers
comment: 26 pages, 11 tables, 1 figure. Supplementary material included as an ancillary file
summary: A framework that persists execution state so a run can be interrupted, survive a crash, and continue must decide what a resume means for effects that already fired. Five widely deployed agent workflow frameworks answer differently, none exposes a machine-checkable contract, and behavior violates even the fragments they state. The RESUME CONTRACT states six properties over the persistence API (prefix continuation, effect exactly-once, fork determinism, checkpoint validity, consume-once, recovery determinism), plus fork-intent and liveness obligations. A TLA+ model checks a reference semantics exhaustively, unchanged at scaled bounds (7.4 million states); a 39-cell fault matrix yields the separating models independence requires, and consume-once splits, its consumption clause independent of all six others. A deterministic, LLM-free harness measures them at pinned releases. LangGraph 1.2.9 durably records a second resume value and never consults it, persists schema-invalid state silently, and re-executes durably recorded work after a real SIGKILL: exactly-once across interrupts, at-least-once across crashes, on one API. CrewAI 1.15.2 re-executes completed effect-bearing methods against its written claim; pydantic-graph 1.x cannot resume after a mid-node crash; no two probed frameworks share a conformance profile. Consume-once holds sequentially and fails under concurrent delivery: k processes resuming one parked interrupt fire the gated effect k times, saturation 1.0 in 36 of 40 cells, and the failure crosses hosts. REMIT, a reference sequencer whose Verus-verified recovery core is line-identical to the shipped executable, repairs the fork and validity cells. The cross-process cell is repaired at the read path, and that repair ships: an opt-in gate claims consumption in the shared store, serving one racer and refusing the rest before any node executes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RESUME CONTRACT，为持久化执行状态的恢复语义定义了六条性质（前缀延续、效果恰好一次、分叉确定性、检查点有效性、消费一次、恢复确定性）及分叉意图和活性义务，并用TLA+模型穷举验证（716万状态）。通过对五个主流agent工作流框架的确定性无LLM测量，发现存续性恢复语义不兼容且违反自身声明，例如LangGraph在中断时恰好一次、崩溃时至少一次；consume-once在并发递送下失效（saturation 1.0）；并给出Verus验证的参考实现REMIT修复相关缺陷。
AI.motivation: agent工作流框架需要持久化执行状态以支持中断恢复和崩溃容错，但对"恢复对已触发效应意味着什么"的语义核心问题，现有框架各执一词、缺乏机器可检查的契约，甚至违反自身声明的行为语义。
AI.method: 定义RESUME CONTRACT六性质+分叉意图和活性义务；用TLA+模型对参考语义做穷举状态检查（规模上界716万状态）；构造39格故障矩阵刻画模型区分度；构建确定性LLM-free测量工具，在锁定版本上测量LangGraph、CrewAI、pydantic-graph等框架；实现REMIT参考定序器，其Verus验证的恢复核心与发布可执行文件逐行一致。
AI.result: LangGraph 1.2.9持久记录第二个恢复值但从不读取、静默持久化schema无效状态、SIGKILL后重执行已持久化工作，即同一API上中断时恰好一次、崩溃时至少一次；CrewAI 1.15.2对已完成的效应型方法重复执行；pydantic-graph 1.x无法在节点中途崩溃后恢复；无两个框架共享同一合规画像。consume-once在顺序下成立、并发递送下失败（k个进程各触发k次被门控效应）；REMIT修复分叉和有效性单元，跨进程单元在读取路径修复并已发布（opt-in门在共享存储中声明消费，先服务一个竞逐者并拒绝其余）。
AI.conclusion: 持久化agent工作流的恢复语义是未解决且被违反的核心问题；需要一个机器可检查的RESUME CONTRACT以及能修复并发消费缺陷的可验证参考实现REMIT，跨进程问题的修复可在读取路径落地并随产品发布。

title: What the Detector Can See: Evaluating CPS Anomaly Detectors Independently of the Decision Rule
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Code and data: https://zenodo.org/records/20653309
summary:
Anomaly detectors are often the last line of defense for cyber-physical systems (CPS). But detectors built in very different ways, from deep neural networks to invariant templates, are usually compared using precision, recall, or F1 at a single operating point. These scores mix two separate things: how well the detector represents the physical process, and how well its alarm threshold is set. We therefore treat a CPS anomaly detector as a two-stage pipeline: Stage 1 maps observations to residuals, and Stage 2 maps residuals to alarms. Instead of scoring only the final alarms, we evaluate Stage 1 directly using normalized residual energy, which has an exact connection to the Kullback-Leibler divergence from the trained-normal reference distribution. Because it does not depend on a specific alarm rule, it can separately measure attack separation, stability across the train-test gap, and the compactness with which a detector encodes the plant.
  Without any per-detector tuning, we apply this evaluation to five detectors -- GDN, FuSAGNet, TranAD, NSIBF, and GeCo -- across three CPS benchmarks: SWaT, WADI, and HAI. Although the detectors have similar ROC-AUC values on SWaT, their performance differs by more than an order of magnitude at a common false-alarm rate. Rankings also change across testbeds: TranAD ranks first on HAI but last on SWaT, while NSIBF ranks first on WADI but last on HAI. On WADI, localized attacks can evade detectors that pool evidence across all channels, helping explain why NSIBF outperforms methods that do well on other benchmarks. These results show that detection failure can come from different sources: a weak representation, poor threshold calibration, or an attack with little physical effect. A decision-rule-free analysis helps separate these causes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将CPS异常检测器视为两阶段流水线（阶段1：观测→残差；阶段2：残差→告警），直接使用归一化残差能量评估阶段1，该指标与KL散度有精确联系，不受告警阈值影响。通过对五个检测器在三个基准上的评估发现：ROC-AUC相同时真实性能可差一个数量级以上，排名随测试平台变化，检测失败源于表示能力弱、阈值校准差或攻击物理影响小等不同原因。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测器比较使用基于单一工作点的precision/recall/F1分数，这些分数混淆了检测器对物理过程的表示能力和告警阈值设定两个独立因素，无法区分检测失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 将CPS异常检测器视为两阶段流水线：阶段1将观测映射为残差，阶段2将残差映射为告警。使用归一化残差能量直接评估阶段1，该指标与训练正态参考分布的KL散度有精确关联，不依赖具体告警规则，可分别度量攻击分离度、跨训练测试间隔的稳定性以及检测器编码物理过程的紧凑性。在无需逐检测器调参的情况下，对GDN、FuSAGNet、TranAD、NSIBF和GeCo五个检测器在SWaT、WADI、HAI三个基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 五个检测器在SWaT上ROC-AUC相似，但公共误报率下性能差异超过一个数量级。排名随测试平台变化：TranAD在HAI上第一但在SWaT上垫底，NSIBF在WADI上第一但在HAI上垫底。WADI上局部攻击可规避跨通道汇聚证据的检测器，解释NSIBF为何优于其他基准上表现好的方法。
AI.conclusion: 检测失败可来自不同来源：表示能力弱、阈值校准不佳，或攻击物理影响小。无决策规则的评估方法有助于分离这些原因，为改进CPS异常检测器提供更清晰的方向。

title: Standalone DINOv3 for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing semantic segmentation is hindered by costly pixel-level annotations, motivating training-free open-vocabulary methods. Recently, the recent release of DINOv3 brings DINO.txt, which equips the standalone DINO backbone with image-text contrastive learning and thus opens up the possibility of open-vocabulary segmentation. We propose DinoSplat-OV, a training-free framework that adapts DINOv3 to remote sensing without fine-tuning or additional pretraining. Targeting the dense distribution, multi-scale nature, and large size of remote sensing imagery, we design two core modules. Its Text-aware Laplacian Propagation module de-noises patch-level predictions by combining textual semantic affinities with local visual similarity, improving regional consistency while preserving boundaries. Its Gaussian Splatting Upsampling module reconstructs pixel-level features through RGB-guided anisotropic aggregation and test-time optimization. A global-anchor sliding-window strategy further supports large-scale imagery. Experiments on UDD5, DOTA, and LoveDA demonstrate competitive or superior performance over existing training-free methods, effectively filling the gap of DINO-series models in training-free open-vocabulary segmentation and providing a viable new path for further advances in this direction.

AI.tldr: DinoSplat-OV是一个无需训练的开放词汇语义分割框架，将DINOv3适配到遥感图像，通过Text-aware Laplacian Propagation模块去噪patch级预测和Gaussian Splatting Upsampling模块重建像素级特征，在UDD5、DOTA和LoveDA数据集上达到或超越现有训练-free方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 遥感语义分割受限于昂贵的像素级标注成本，现有的开放词汇方法需要额外训练，而新发布的DINOv3（DINO.txt）虽具备独立backbone的图文对比学习能力，但尚未被有效应用于遥感场景中无需训练的分割任务。
AI.method: 提出DinoSplat-OV训练-free框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Text-aware Laplacian Propagation模块，结合文本语义亲和度与局部视觉相似性对patch级预测去噪，提升区域一致性并保持边界；(2) Gaussian Splatting Upsampling模块，通过RGB引导的各向异性聚合和测试时优化重建像素级特征。另采用全局锚点滑动窗口策略支持大规模遥感影像。
AI.result: 在UDD5、DOTA和LoveDA三个遥感数据集上的实验表明，DinoSplat-OV在训练-free方法中表现出竞争性或更优的性能，填补了DINO系列模型在训练-free开放词汇分割领域的空白。
AI.conclusion: DinoSplat-OV为遥感开放词汇分割提供了一条无需训练的新路径，验证了DINOv3在遥感场景中的可迁移性，为该方向后续研究提供了可行基础。

title: POMDPs for Autonomous Science Exploration
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Autonomous exploration missions require decision-making under sensor uncertainty and computational constraints, yet integrating scientific representations into POMDP planning has remained intractable due to high-dimensional observation spaces. Information-theoretic planners overcome this by assuming deterministic observations, sacrificing the principled uncertainty quantification that POMDPs provide. We introduce the Science Hypothesis Map POMDP (SHM-POMDP), which makes science-driven belief-space planning more tractable by branching on inferred physical properties rather than raw sensor data. This preserves full sensor information through learned observation models while enabling the planner to reason jointly about navigation and scientific properties under uncertainty. On an extended RockSample domain with 50-dimensional observations, SHM-POMDP achieves 18.6\% higher rewards and 32.9\% reduced computation time per step than continuous-observation baselines. On realistic geologic exploration using Cuprite hyperspectral data, SHM-POMDP achieves 2.5$\times$ higher information gain than the best information-theoretic baseline by maintaining beliefs and replanning adaptively---reaching 80\% of oracle performance using only uniform priors. These results demonstrate that integrating hierarchical probabilistic models into belief-space planning enables tractable, principled autonomous science that outperforms both traditional POMDP methods and science-aware information-theoretic approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHM-POMDP，一种使科学驱动的置信空间规划更具可计算性的新框架。它通过在高维观测分支时推断物理属性来减少规划复杂度，同时利用学习到的观测模型保留完整传感器信息。在扩展RockSample域和Cuprite高光谱地质勘探任务上，SHM-POMDP分别比连续观测基线提升18.6%奖励、减少32.9%计算时间，并比最佳信息论基线获得2.5倍的信息增益。
AI.motivation: 自主勘探任务需要在传感器不确定性和计算约束下进行决策，但将科学表征整合到POMDP规划中因高维观测空间而难以计算。信息论规划器通过假设确定性观测来规避这一问题，却牺牲了POMDP提供的严谨不确定性量化。作者旨在弥合这两个方向之间的鸿沟：既要保持POMDP在不确定性下的原则性推理能力，又要使科学驱动的规划在计算上可行。
AI.method: SHM-POMDP的核心思想是在推断的物理属性（而非原始传感器数据）上分支，从而大幅降低用于规划的状态空间维度。它通过学习观测模型保留全部传感器信息，使规划器能够在不确定性下联合推理导航和科学属性。该框架引入了层次概率模型，将高维连续观测空间压缩为低维离散科学假设空间，实现可计算的置信空间规划。
AI.result: 在具有50维观测的扩展RockSample域中，SHM-POMDP比连续观测基线获得18.6%更高的奖励，每步计算时间减少32.9%。在Cuprite高光谱数据的真实地质勘探中，SHM-POMDP比最佳信息论基线获得2.5倍更高的信息增益，且仅使用均匀先验即达到oracle性能的80%，展示了其通过维持置信并自适应重规划的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将层次概率模型整合到置信空间规划中，可以实现可计算的、有原则的自主科学探索，在性能上同时超越传统POMDP方法和科学感知的信息论方法。这一结果表明，推断科学属性而非处理原始高维观测是解决科学驱动规划可扩展性的关键路径。

title: Mapping the City Through the Lens of Language Models
summary: Language models often complete an underspecified reference to a city with unstated assumptions about urban size, form, infrastructure, environment, and function. We measure those assumptions without naming places. Ten open-weight checkpoints rate anonymized profiles derived from real morphological urban centres across 40 audited indicators and seven domains. The design combines constrained probability-based ratings, prespecified reliability screens, lineage-aware aggregation, multiple population weightings, an independent replication sample, and whole-profile validation. The clearest shared tendency favours urban profiles with larger developed area, faster recent growth, greater mapped infrastructure and non-residential capacity, and less sparse form. Most eligible directions recur in the replication data, and direct ratings of complete profiles show moderate agreement with the indicator-wise construction. Geographic differences shrink after accounting for city scale and development, while reliably measured paired tasks indicate that typicality and desirability are often closely aligned. The framework makes an otherwise vague notion of what models regard as an ordinary city empirically traceable. The resulting evidence delineates a shared yet model-dependent portrait of the city through the lens of language models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过10个开源权重语言模型对40项指标、7个域度的匿名城市画像进行概率化评分，测量语言模型对"普通城市"的隐含假设。结果显示模型共同偏好更大建成区、更快近期增长、基础设施更密集、非住宅容量更大、城市形态更不稀疏的城市，且典型性与可取性往往高度一致。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在完成指代不明的城市引用时，往往会带入对城市规模、形态、基础设施、环境和功能等方面的未言明假设。这些假设此前缺乏系统性测量方法，且难以在不引入地名偏见的情况下被量化追踪。
AI.method: 研究设计了约束概率评分、预设可靠性筛选、谱系感知聚合、多种人口加权、独立复制样本及整体画像验证相结合的框架。使用10个开源权重检查点，对来自真实城市形态中心的匿名化画像在40项审计指标和7个域度上进行评分。
AI.result: 最显著的共同倾向偏向于建成区面积更大、近期增速更快、地图化基础设施与非住宅容量更多、形态更不稀疏的城市画像。大多数合格方向在复制数据中重现，完整画像直接评分与指标构造方式呈现中度一致性。地理差异在控制城市规模与发展水平后缩小，典型性与可取性在可可靠测量的配对任务中密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使"模型认为的普通城市"这一模糊概念变得可经验追踪，揭示了语言模型视角下共享但随模型而异的城市画像。

title: NOMADD: Numerical Optimization of Models Adapting to Data Drift
summary: Tabular model performance degrades when feature distributions change over time or the relationship between features and outcome variables change over time, known as data drift and concept drift, respectively. These issues are challenging to mitigate in real time because labeled data may not be immediately available, or re-training a model could be impractical. While tools exist to reduce drift, they are typically bespoke to neural network architectures and adapt how models are trained. In this paper, we offer an alternative post-hoc method to reduce concept drift, which is applicable to a variety of models, from trees to neural networks to tabular foundation models. This new tool is especially useful when constraints, such as high model accuracy, bounded inference time, or model size requires users to choose between different models for their specific use-cases. Our algorithm fits the base model separately on each labeled training period, measures how its parameters evolve against a single anchor model pooled over all of those periods, compresses those changes with a low-rank factorization, and extrapolates each latent factor forward with a damped, regularized forecast. On the 18-dataset Drift-Resilient TabPFN benchmark, evaluated under that benchmark's own protocol and metric, the extrapolation improves every base family it is applied to, and achieves performance competitive with the state-of-the-art Drift-Resilient TabPFN with seconds of training. In contrast, Drift-Resilient TabPFN requires pre-training on millions of synthetic datasets over approximately 1,300 GPU-hours, and is orders of magnitude slower in inference (depending on the model). In the discussion, we explore the promise and challenges of extending this tool to other modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种后置式的概念漂移缓解方法，通过对每个标注训练期独立拟合基础模型，测量参数演变，用低秩分解压缩变化，并对每个潜伏因子进行阻尼正则化外推预测。在18数据集基准上优于所有基模型，且训练时间仅需数秒。
AI.motivation: 表格模型在数据漂移或概念漂移下性能会退化，而实时缓解困难（标签不可得或重训练不现实）。现有漂移缓解工具通常专门针对神经网络架构，且只能通过调整训练过程实现，缺乏适用于多种模型（树、神经网络、表格基础模型）的后置式通用方案。
AI.method: 算法流程：(1) 在每个标注训练时期分别拟合基础模型；(2) 以全时期池化的单一锚模型为基准，测量模型参数的演变；(3) 用低秩分解压缩参数变化；(4) 对每个潜伏因子使用阻尼、正则化的预测器进行前向外推。
AI.result: 在Drift-Resilient TabPFN基准的18个数据集上，按照该基准自身的协议和指标评估，该方法提升了所应用的所有基模型家族的性能，并与SOTA的Drift-Resilient TabPFN表现相当，但训练仅需数秒。相比之下，Drift-Resilient TabPFN需要在上百万合成数据集上预训练约1300个GPU小时，且推理速度慢若干个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法作为一种后置式的通用概念漂移缓解工具，在精度、推理时间和模型规模等约束下为不同模型的选型提供了灵活性；同时讨论了将该工具扩展到其他模态的潜力与挑战。

title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusio
summary: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.

AI.tldr: DiffImaginE将多模态命名实体识别（MNER）的类型验证建模为条件潜变量扩散推理，通过类型条件去噪器预测标准化潜变量中注入的噪声，以去噪误差作为ELBO一致的类型条件负对数似然代理，从而对不同类型假设进行排名。在Twitter-2015和Twitter-2017上相比确定性ImaginE对照取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的"想象-比较"（imagine-and-compare）验证器将每个（跨度, 类型）对映射为单一的预测视觉特征，把多种视觉实现压缩成单个原型，仅提供兼容性得分而缺乏显式的概率语义。这种压缩丢失了视觉证据的多样性和不确定性。
AI.method: DiffImaginE将MNER类型验证形式化为条件潜变量扩散推理。具体包括：(1) 给定跨度局部化的视觉证据，类型条件去噪器预测注入到标准化潜变量中的噪声；(2) 去噪误差提供ELBO一致的类型条件负对数似然代理，用于对竞争类型假设排序；(3) 保留标准多模态编码器栈，用无分类器引导的扩散评分器替换确定性验证器，采用Min-SNR加权训练；(4) 直接以每类型扩散分数作为分类logits进行监督，学习跨噪声水平的聚合，并使用对偶采样减少蒙特卡洛比较方差。
AI.result: 在Twitter-2015和Twitter-2017数据集上，DiffImaginE相比在相同编码器、辅助目标和评估协议下的确定性ImaginE对照取得一致性能提升，并通过消融实验和配对显著性检验验证了各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明无分类器引导能够锐化诱导的类型后验分布，并刻画了在对等去噪器成本下对偶配对何时能减少方差。DiffImaginE以概率化的扩散推理替代确定性原型比较，为MNER类型验证提供了更合理的不确定性建模框架。

title: Decidability of Parameterised Dolev-Yao Secrecy
summary:
We study the verification of parameterised secrecy for cryptographic protocols in the Dolev-Yao model, where the number of protocol sessions is unbounded and treated as a parameter. This differs fundamentally from classical Dolev-Yao secrecy, which asks whether a protocol leaks a secret irrespective of the number of executions; our question is whether secrecy holds uniformly across all system sizes, where such a size is a parameter. This parameterised perspective captures how attacks scale with the number of participants and provides a formal basis for the empirical effectiveness of small-instance analysis.
  Secrecy (parameterised or not) is undecidable in general, even under bounded freshness or bounded message size. We identify two structural restrictions that make parameterised secrecy decidable: (i) global bounded freshness per role, and (ii) a Dolev-Yao intruder restricted to well-typed substitutions. Under these assumptions, protocol executions admit a finite representation up to a collapsing map on agents and terms.
  Our main result is that parameterised secrecy is decidable in this setting. We obtain a cut-off theorem: secrecy violations in systems with arbitrarily many sessions are always witnessed in systems of bounded size. The cut-off is self-contained; more strongly, the induced transition system forms a well-structured transition system (WSTS) under a bound-based ordering, so secrecy also reduces to a coverability problem in WSTS. This provides a structural explanation for the existence of finite witnesses in symbolic protocol analysis and connects Dolev-Yao verification with parameterised verification techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Dolev-Yao模型中密码学协议的参数化保密性验证问题。在会话数量无界且作为参数的情况下，作者证明了在两种结构限制（每角色的全局有界新鲜性和Dolev-Yao入侵者的良类型替换限制）下，参数化保密性是可判定的，并给出了截断定理：任意多会话系统中的保密性违规总能在有界大小的系统中被观察到。该结论进一步通过良结构迁移系统（WSTS）的覆盖性问题得到结构性解释。
AI.motivation: 经典Dolev-Yao保密性只关注协议是否泄露秘密，而不考虑会话数量参数。然而从参数化视角看，攻击如何随参与者数量扩展是一个根本性且实践相关的问题——它为小实例分析的实证有效性提供了形式化基础。尽管参数化保密性在一般情况下（即使有界新鲜性或消息大小）不可判定，但识别出使问题可判定的结构限制是重要的理论贡献。
