AI.method: 作者识别了两种结构限制：(i) 每个角色全局有界的新鲜性（bounded freshness per role），以及(ii) 限制为良类型替换的Dolev-Yao入侵者。在这些假设下，协议执行可以在一个关于智能体和术语的坍缩映射下获得有限表示。主要技术工具是建立截断定理，证明任意大系统中的保密性违规总能在有界大小的系统中找到对应证据。此外，作者展示了在基于界限的序关系下，诱导的迁移系统构成良结构迁移系统（WSTS），从而将保密性问题归约为WSTS的覆盖性问题。
AI.result: 主要结果是参数化保密性在所述设置下是可判定的。具体成果包括：(1) 截断定理的证明，给出有界的确切大小；(2) 将问题归约为WSTS覆盖性问题；(3) 通过WSTS理论为有限证据的存在提供了结构性解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将Dolev-Yao协议验证与参数化验证技术连接起来，为符号协议分析中有限见证的存在提供了理论基础，同时验证了小实例分析在实践中的有效性。这为参数化密码协议验证开辟了新的研究方向。

title: CAPE-T2V: Captioner-Anchored Prompt Enhancement toward Two-Sided Conditioning Alignment in Text-to-Video Generation
comment: Includes appendix; 11 figures. Project page: https://github.com/yizzz927/CAPE-T2V
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion transformers (DiTs) are trained with detailed video captions, whereas inference often relies on user prompts rewritten by a prompt enhancer (PE). Prior work has improved generation by optimizing the PE, the DiT, or both; some methods have also sought to narrow the training-inference mismatch through shared schemas. Yet even within a shared schema, inference-time PE outputs and DiT training captions may still differ in detail selection, information organization, descriptive granularity, and phrasing. We refer to this residual mismatch as the PE-Caption gap and introduce CAPE-T2V, a two-step Captioner-Anchored Prompt Enhancement framework toward two-sided conditioning alignment in T2V generation. First, CAPE-T2V constructs three types of PE training examples, pairing captioner-generated targets with concise source captions, detailed source captions, or pseudo user prompts derived from those targets. It then fine-tunes the PE to map each input to its paired target. Second, CAPE-T2V fine-tunes the DiT on video-derived captions rewritten by the Anchored PE; the same PE rewrites user prompts at inference. Relative to a baseline using the same caption schema, CAPE-T2V achieves higher aggregate scores on StoryEval, VBench-2.0, and T2V-CompBench across Wan2.2 and LTX-2.3. Further, CAPE-T2V exhibits a smaller PE-Caption gap than the baseline: its DiT fine-tuning captions are closer in distribution to inference-time PE outputs, as measured by squared maximum mean discrepancy in a fixed embedding space. Overall, these results support CAPE-T2V as an effective approach to mitigating the PE-Caption gap. The project is available at https://github.com/yizzz927/CAPE-T2V.

AI.tldr: CAPE-T2V提出了一种两阶段"标注器锚定提示增强"框架，通过两方面的对齐来缓解T2V生成中的PE-Caption差异（提示增强器输出与训练标注之间的残余不匹配）：先构建三类PE训练样本对PE进行微调，再用锚定PE重写的视频标注对DiT进行微调，最终在多个基准上取得了优于基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 文生视频扩散Transformer在训练时使用详细视频标注，但推理时依赖用户提示经提示增强器（PE）改写后的结果。尽管已有工作通过优化PE、优化DiT或共享模式来缩小训练-推理差异，但即使在共享模式下，推理时PE输出与训练标注之间在细节选择、信息组织、描述粒度及措辞上仍存在残余不匹配（即PE-Caption gap），需要系统性地解决这一问题。
AI.method: CAPE-T2V包含两步：第一步，构造三类PE训练样例——将标注器生成的目标与简洁源标注、详细源标注或由目标派生的伪用户提示配对，然后微调PE使其将各类输入映射到配对目标；第二步，用锚定PE重写视频派生标注来微调DiT，推理时用同一个PE改写用户提示，从而实现两方面的条件对齐。
AI.result: 在与使用相同标注模式的基线对比中，CAPE-T2V在Wan2.2和LTX-2.3上于StoryEval、VBench-2.0和T2V-CompBench上均取得更高的综合得分；同时，CAPE-T2V的DiT微调标注与推理时PE输出之间的分布距离（以固定嵌入空间中的平方最大均值差异衡量）比基线更小，表明PE-Caption gap得到了有效缩小。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持CAPE-T2V作为缓解PE-Caption gap的有效方法，通过标注器锚定的PE微调与DiT微调相结合，实现生成质量提升与训练-推理分布对齐的双重目标。

title: Accelerating Human-Aware Robot Trajectory Generation via Diffusion and Consistency Distillation
summary: This research proposes a constrained motion planning framework for robot manipulators in human-robot interaction (HRI). For a non-redundant manipulator with a fully specified end-effector pose, additional requirements such as collision avoidance and self-collision avoidance are difficult to handle as simple null-space secondary tasks. This limitation makes it challenging to generate feasible joint-space trajectories in HRI environments where safety and kinematic constraints must be considered simultaneously. To address this limitation, collision- and self-collision-aware trajectories are generated using Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) and RRT* algorithms, and the resulting dataset is used to train a diffusion model that generates constraint-satisfying trajectories through guided sampling. To reduce the inference time required for iterative diffusion sampling, consistency distillation is applied, and a joint-weighted jerk regularization term is incorporated into the loss function to promote smoother trajectories by penalizing abrupt changes in joint acceleration. Simulation results show that the consistency model generates 150 trajectory candidates in less than 100 ms, maintains a high episode success rate, and substantially reduces joint and end-effector jerk when jerk regularization is applied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向人机交互场景的机器人操作臂约束运动规划框架，利用RRT/RRT*生成碰撞避免轨迹数据集，训练扩散模型并通过一致性蒸馏加速采样，同时引入关节加权加加速度正则化来生成平滑且满足约束的轨迹。
AI.motivation: 对于非冗余机械臂，末端执行器位姿完全指定后，碰撞避免和自碰撞避免等附加需求无法作为简单的零空间次要任务处理。这导致在人机交互环境中，安全性和运动学约束需要同时满足时，难以生成可行的关节空间轨迹。
AI.method: 1) 使用RRT和RRT*算法生成碰撞规避与自碰撞规避的轨迹数据集；2) 基于该数据集训练扩散模型，通过引导采样生成满足约束的轨迹；3) 应用一致性蒸馏（consistency distillation）减少迭代扩散采样的推理时间；4) 在损失函数中加入关节加权加加速度正则化项，通过惩罚关节加速度突变来促进轨迹平滑性。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，一致性模型在100毫秒内生成150条轨迹候选，保持较高的回合成功率，并且在施加加加速度正则化时大幅降低了关节和末端执行器的加加速度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了非冗余机械臂在人机交互场景下同时满足安全与运动学约束的难题，通过扩散模型与一致性蒸馏的结合，在保证轨迹质量和成功率的同时显著提升了推理速度，加加速度正则化有效提升了轨迹平滑性。

title: TQLite: Multi-LLM Jury Guided Distillation for Real-time MQM Translation Quality Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in MQM-based translation quality (TQ) evaluation, and recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) promise even greater improvements. However, both LLMs and LRMs are computationally expensive to deploy at scale, while small language models (SLMs)---though much more efficient---struggle with the complex reasoning required for evaluation tasks. In this work, we present an extensive empirical study benchmarking SLMs, LLMs, and LRMs across a wide range of TQ evaluation setups, providing a comprehensive view of the current landscape and establishing best practices. To address the scalability challenge, we introduce TQLite, a novel distillation framework that enables SLMs to approach the MQM evaluation performance of the best LRM-based evaluators. Our approach leverages a multi-LRM jury to generate high-quality synthetic training data via practical data curation techniques and aggregation of evaluation responses across a diverse panel of models. Our results demonstrate that SLMs trained via TQLite achieve strong MQM evaluation performance that far exceeds off-the-shelf evaluation capabilities of standard SLMs, offering a scalable and cost-effective alternative to LLM- and LRM-based evaluators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TQLite蒸馏框架，通过多大型推理模型（LRM）评审团生成高质量合成训练数据，使小型语言模型（SLM）在MQM翻译质量评估中接近最优LRM评估器的性能，同时大幅降低成本。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）和大型推理模型（LRM）在MQM翻译质量评估中表现出色，但部署成本高昂、难以规模化；小型语言模型（SLM）虽然高效，但缺乏复杂推理能力，难以直接应用于翻译质量评估任务。本文旨在解决这一规模与性能之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 作者进行了覆盖SLM、LLM和LRM的广泛实证对比研究，并提出了TQLite蒸馏框架。该框架采用多LRM评审团机制，通过实用的数据整理技术和跨多样化模型面板的评估响应聚合，生成高质量合成训练数据，用于训练SLM以逼近最优LRM评估器的MQM评估性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，通过TQLite训练的SLM在MQM评估性能上远超标准SLM的开箱即用能力，接近最优LRM评估器的水平，并且在多种翻译质量评估设置中表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: TQLite为翻译质量评估提供了一种可规模化、成本效益高的替代方案，使SLM能够在保持高效的同时获得接近最优大型推理模型的评估能力，确立了当前SLM/LLM/LRM翻译质量评估格局下的最佳实践。

title: Adaptive Sampling for Automated Post-Disaster Rapid Damage Assessment via Level-Set Cost-Aware Bayesian Optimization
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the SIAM International Conference on Data Mining (SDM) 2026
summary: Natural disasters frequently inflict severe damage to the built environment, which demands a rapid, reliable, and cost-effective damage assessment for emergency response. However, traditional methods for post-disaster damage assessment often rely on static, labor-intensive data collection strategies that can be prohibitively expensive and struggle to adapt to dynamic post-disaster conditions. In this study, we propose a cost-aware Bayesian optimization framework combined with level-set estimation that continuously guides autonomous data collectors, e.g., an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), toward the most informative regions. By dynamically updating damage estimates across different geographic zones, our approach systematically reduces uncertainty while minimizing operational costs. The proposed framework is first validated using a controlled synthetic toy study, demonstrating the agent's ability to efficiently trace damage boundaries, recover the underlying damage map, and rapidly reduce predictive uncertainty. Furthermore, the approach is evaluated using high-fidelity disaster data generated by the Regional Resilience Determination (R2D) software. The results of the algorithm provide accurate and timely damage estimates that support informative and fast emergency response.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合成本感知贝叶斯优化与水平集估计的框架，用于引导自主数据采集器（如无人机）持续向信息量最大的区域移动，实现对灾后建筑环境损伤的动态、高效评估。该方法在合成玩具研究与R2D软件生成的高保真灾害数据上均验证了其准确性和及时性。
AI.motivation: 传统灾后损伤评估方法依赖静态、劳动密集型的数据收集策略，成本高昂且难以适应动态的灾后条件，亟需一种快速、可靠且经济高效的损伤评估方法以支持应急响应。
AI.method: 提出一种成本感知的贝叶斯优化框架（结合水平集估计），动态引导自主数据采集器（如无人机）前往信息量最大的地理区域，通过不断更新不同区域的损伤估计来系统性地降低不确定性，同时最小化运行成本。
AI.result: 在受控的合成玩具研究中，该框架能够高效追踪损伤边界、恢复底层损伤图并快速降低预测不确定性；在R2D软件生成的高保真灾害数据上，算法提供了准确及时的损伤估计，支持信息充分且快速的应急响应。
AI.conclusion: 该成本感知贝叶斯优化框架能有效平衡信息获取与运行成本，在合成与高保真数据上均表现出色，为灾后快速损伤评估与应急响应提供了一种可行的自主化解决方案。

title: Evaluating Counterfactual Sensitivity to Patient Information in Medication-Safety Reasoning
summary: Applying a valid medication-safety rule when its patient-specific conditions are not met can produce an incorrect decision. Existing medical evaluations largely use isolated and fixed scenarios. A model may therefore answer correctly by recalling a drug-risk association without showing that it used patient information to decide whether the rule applies. To address this gap, we introduce MedPIC-Bench, a benchmark of source-verifiable recommendations and expert-validated questions for patient-specific medication-safety reasoning. It combines guideline-following questions with paired counterfactual questions in which a controlled change in patient information changes whether a rule applies. The benchmark contains 467 questions annotated along six clinical and reasoning dimensions. Across 28 medical-specific, general, and proprietary LLMs, every model performs worse on counterfactual questions, with mean accuracy falling from 63.6\% to 45.1\%. Models perform well when an explicit patient attribute directly signals a familiar contraindication, but struggle when patient information must narrow or withdraw a safety warning. Model rationales often acknowledge the changed patient information, yet the final answers retain the previous safety judgment. This vulnerability persists among medical-specific LLMs, whose average CF performance trails that of general LLMs. MedPIC-Bench therefore makes conditional rule application measurable and highlights the limitations of static medication-safety accuracy for assessing patient-specific reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedPIC-Bench基准，用于评估LLM在患者特定条件下的用药安全推理能力，通过配对反事实问题揭示模型即使在文档中识别到患者信息变化，仍会保留原有安全判断的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学评估多使用孤立和固定场景，模型可能仅通过回忆药物-风险关联就正确回答，而无需真正理解患者信息是否满足用药安全规则的适用条件。当患者特定条件不满足时应用规则会导致错误决策，因此需要能够测量条件规则应用的基准。
AI.method: 构建MedPIC-Bench基准，包含来源可验证的推荐和专家验证的467个问题，结合指南遵循问题与配对反事实问题（控制患者信息改变以改变规则适用性），并对六个临床和推理维度进行标注。评估28个医学专用、通用及专有LLM。
AI.result: 所有模型在反事实问题上表现更差，平均准确率从63.6%降至45.1%。当显式患者属性直接信号熟悉的禁忌症时模型表现良好，但当患者信息需要收窄或撤销安全警告时表现挣扎。模型推理常承认患者信息的改变，但最终答案仍保留原安全判断。医学专用LLM的平均反事实性能甚至落后于通用LLM。
AI.conclusion: MedPIC-Bench使条件规则应用变得可测量，突出了静态用药安全准确率不足以评估患者特定可靠性的局限性，揭示了LLM在条件用药安全推理方面的系统性脆弱性。

title: MutMem: Cryptographically Authorized Mutation in Persistent Agent Memory
summary: Persistent agent memory must adapt as later outcomes change earlier evidence, yet mutable retrieval weights create an attribution problem: reviewers must distinguish authorized adaptation from database tampering. We present MutMem, an authorized-mutation protocol in HOM-AIMOS, a persistent agent-memory engine. MutMem retains memory content, records signed positive and negative outcome evidence without age-based expiry, and commits each nontrivial weight change as a housekeeper-authorized transition. Each transition binds a terminal provenance node, signer epoch, quantized old and new weights, a no-fork predecessor, and two domain-separated SHA-256 commitments. Ed25519 verification runs in both the database writer and a portable verifier. Content classified as poison-likely is retained with signed, revisable labels used by recall as trust evidence. We evaluate utility, mutation integrity, and poisoning adaptation. HOM-AIMOS answers 459/500 LongMemEval questions correctly under LLM judgment (91.8%). On LoCoMo, it obtains 74.12% judged accuracy and, under a separate upstream-compatible protocol, 58.20 token F1. A native suite passes all declared authorization, topology, tamper, signer-epoch, and post-mutation-recall cases; median signed-transition latency is 4.865 ms. In a declared N=100 PoisonedRAG adaptation, no injected poison appears in attacked top-5 disclosures (0/100; 95% Wilson upper bound 3.70%), while induced target-answer attack success among 98 clean-negative targets is 1/98 (1.02%). A preregistered four-arm ablation attributes the retrieval reduction to signed stored labels: the retriever selects poison for 94/100 targets when epistemic policy is bypassed and 0/100 when labels are restored. MutMem provides evidence of integrity, authorization, traceability, and historical continuity; it does not establish content truth.

AI.tldr: MutMem 是HOM-AIMOS持久化智能体记忆引擎中的一种授权突变协议，通过房管员授权的有符号状态转换来区分合法记忆适应与数据库篡改，在保持记忆内容的同时记录带签名的正负结果证据，并提供防分叉前驱链和域分离的SHA-256承诺。在LongMemEval上达到91.8%的判定准确率，在PoisonedRAG测试中实现0/100的投毒泄露，但明确指出该协议提供完整性、授权、可追溯性和历史连续性证据，而非内容真实性。
AI.motivation: 持久化智能体记忆必须随着后续结果改变先前证据而适应，但可变的检索权重产生了归因问题：审查者必须区分经授权的适应与数据库篡改。现有方法缺乏一个协议来提供可验证的授权变更证据。
AI.method: MutMem协议保留记忆内容，记录带签名的正负结果证据且无年龄过期，将每次非平凡权重变更作为房管员授权的转换提交。每个转换绑定终结性溯源节点、签名者纪元、量化新旧权重、无分叉前驱，以及两个域分离的SHA-256承诺。Ed25519验证在数据库写入器和可移植验证器中均运行。疑似投毒内容带签名可修订标签保留，作为召回时的信任证据。
AI.result: HOM-AIMOS在LongMemEval的459/500问题上正确回答（91.8%）；LoCoMo判定准确率74.12%，token F1为58.20。原生测试套件通过全部授权、拓扑、篡改、签名者纪元和突变后召回用例；有符号转换中位延迟4.865毫秒。PoisonedRAG自适应中注入投毒未出现在被攻击的top-5披露中（0/100；95% Wilson上界3.70%），诱导目标攻击在98个清洁阴性目标中成功1/98（1.02%）。四臂消融表明，绕过认知策略时检索器94/100选择投毒，恢复标签时为0/100。
AI.conclusion: MutMem为持久化智能体记忆的授权突变提供了完整性、授权、可追溯性和历史连续性证据，但明确不建立内容真实性。有效的投毒防御依赖于带签名的存储标签作为信任证据。

title: AIDE: Automated Instruction via Distilled Expertise for Reference-Free Motor Skill Coaching
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026. 12 pages (including supplementary material), 4 figures
summary: Generating natural-language coaching feedback on motor skills can accelerate learning, yet expert coaches are scarce and expensive. Existing reference-based methods require expert demonstrations at both training and inference time, limiting practical deployment. We propose AIDE (Automated Instruction via Distilled Expertise), a framework that exploits expert references only during training and generates feedback from a learner's pose sequence alone at inference. A teacher model first learns to generate feedback from paired learner-expert poses via a frozen language model, producing separate learner tokens and difference tokens that encode the learner-expert difference. A student model then inherits the teacher's encoder and weight initialization, replacing the explicit expert comparison with an auxiliary module that produces complementary tokens from the learner's pose alone. On the ExpertAF dataset, AIDE outperforms reference-free baselines on most metrics and performs comparably to methods requiring expert demonstrations at both training and inference, with LLM-based evaluation supporting these findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIDE框架，通过在训练阶段利用专家参考、推理阶段仅依赖学习者姿态序列来生成运动技能的自然语言教练反馈，解决了专家稀缺和参考方法部署受限的问题。
AI.motivation: 运动技能学习中，自然语言教练反馈能加速学习，但专家教练稀缺且昂贵。现有的基于参考的方法在训练和推理时都需要专家示范，限制了实际部署。因此需要一种仅利用专家参考进行训练、推理时不依赖专家示范的反馈生成方法。
AI.method: AIDE采用两阶段蒸馏框架：(1) 教师模型通过冻结的语言模型从成对的学习者-专家姿态中学习生成反馈，产生学习者token和编码差异的差异token；(2) 学生模型继承教师的编码器和权重初始化，用辅助模块从学习者单独的姿态中生成互补token，替代显式的专家比较。
AI.result: 在ExpertAF数据集上，AIDE在大多数指标上优于无参考基线，且与需要在训练和推理阶段都使用专家示范的方法性能相当；LLM评估也支持这些发现。
AI.conclusion: AIDE证明可以仅通过训练阶段利用专家参考，就将专家比较能力蒸馏到仅依赖学习者姿态的推理模型中，在降低部署成本的同时保持反馈质量，为运动技能教练反馈生成的实用化提供了可行方案。

title: PFM-HR: Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots
summary: Motion priors improve reinforcement learning for physics-based humanoid tracking, but temporal priors require ordered motion clips, while pose priors provide limited guidance for policy-induced pose transitions. We present Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots (PFM-HR), a reusable flow matching prior trained directly on large scale unordered pose data. PFM-HR introduces the Pose Geometry Score (PGS), which quantifies how joint coordinate changes during rollouts align with the local geometry of pose variation captured by the prior. Using PGS to modulate the tracking reward guides policy exploration toward structured pose changes while keeping the prior frozen across tracking tasks. Experiments demonstrate that PFM-HR improves both single motion and general motion tracking, especially for highly dynamic motions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PFM-HR，一种可直接在无顺序的大规模姿态数据上训练的流匹配先验，用于改善物理驱动人形机器人运动追踪中的强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 现有运动先验存在不足：时间先验需要有序运动片段，而姿态先验对策略引发的姿态转换指导有限。需要一种能利用无顺序大规模姿态数据、且能有效指导姿态间转换的先验方法。
AI.method: 提出Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots (PFM-HR)，一种可复用的流匹配先验，直接在无顺序的大规模姿态数据上训练。引入Pose Geometry Score (PGS)量化rollout期间关节坐标变化与先验捕捉到的局部姿态变化几何的匹配程度，并用PGS调制追踪奖励以引导策略探索朝向结构化姿态变化，同时保持先验在追踪任务间冻结。
AI.result: 实验表明PFM-HR在单运动追踪和一般运动追踪任务上均有提升，尤其对高动态运动效果显著。
AI.conclusion: PFM-HR通过姿态几何评分引导探索，有效解决了现有先验在无顺序数据和姿态转换指导方面的局限，提升了物理驱动人形机器人的运动追踪性能。

title: On the Non-Specificity of Statistical Measures Used in Script Decipherment
summary: Statistical regularities are routinely offered as evidence that undeciphered sign systems encode language; the Indus script debate is the canonical example. Any such inference rests on specificity: the reported outcome must be unusual among plausible structured non-languages. We test that premise constructively with SIGIL, a purpose-built generative emblem system whose 3,000-text core corpus carries explicit compositional meanings although no sign has a phonological value. A literature registry compiled in advance of evaluation records 54 methods and admits a method to exact scoring when both the published Indus outcome and a source-defined decision rule can be reproduced. SIGIL receives the same category as the Indus corpus on every criterion scored this way, across repetition, directional-asymmetry, and lexical-distribution tests. Declared reconstructions of entropy, frequency, positional, predictive, classifier, and network measures reproduce the familiar Indus-like signatures as well. A sequential decipherment stress test then reaches high dictionary coverage for English, Sanskrit, and Tamil on the same corpus, while grouped held-out declines and unstable keys reveal how little that coverage identifies. The construction does not decide what the Indus signs encode: it shows that the evaluated measures detect organization without being specific to language, and therefore cannot, on their own, establish encoded speech.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个名为SIGIL的生成徽章系统（3,000文本核心语料库，携带显式组合意义但无语音值），检验了“统计规律性可证明未破译符号系统编码语言”这一前提。结果显示SIGIL在重复性、方向不对称性和词汇分布等所有测试中均获得与印度河文字相同的分类，熵、频率、位置、预测、分类器和网络度量也重现了印度河式的特征，证明这些度量检测的是组织性而非语言特异性。
AI.motivation: 统计规律性常被用来论证未破译符号系统编码语言（印度河文字是典型例子），但这种推断依赖于特异性——报告的结果必须在合理的结构化非语言系统中是不寻常的。作者旨在检验这一前提是否成立。
AI.method: 作者构建了SIGIL（一种专门设计的生成徽章系统），其核心语料库包含3,000个文本，携带显式组合意义但没有任何符号具有语音学价值。预先编制的文献登记册记录了54种方法，当已发表的印度河结果和源定义决策规则都能重现时，允许精确评分。作者将SIGIL与印度河文字在同一标准下进行对比测试，涵盖重复性、方向不对称性和词汇分布测试，并重现了熵、频率、位置、预测、分类器和网络度量的印度河式特征，最后通过顺序破译压力测试考察词典覆盖率。
AI.result: SIGIL在每个按上述方式评分的标准上获得与印度河文字相同的类别。在英语、梵语和泰米尔语的顺序破译压力测试中达到了高词典覆盖率，但分组留出性能下降和密钥不稳定揭示了这种覆盖率的信息量有限。
AI.conclusion: 该构建并不决定印度河符号编码什么，而是表明被评估的度量检测到的是组织性而非语言特异性，因此这些度量本身不能确立编码语音的存在。

title: Contrast-invariant deep ptychography neural networks
comment: ~30 pages, 4 main figures + 2 SI figures. Submitting to scientific journal
summary: Ptychography neural networks suffer from scaling inconsistencies when generalizing out of distribution, limiting their real world viability. We address this scaling mismatch using a factorization strategy which decouples the learned object texture from measurement scaling, enabling a single trained network to produce measurement-consistent reconstructions across varying illumination conditions. This requires predicting the learned object in real and imaginary units instead of the canonical amplitude and phase representation. We additionally introduce a synthetic object sampling strategy that minimizes phase distribution mismatch between synthetic training data and experimental targets. These improvements yield up to a 5x reduction in Fourier error over the previous PtychoPINN-torch baseline across 5 experimental datasets spanning multiple beamlines and facilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种因子分解策略解决Ptychography神经网络在分布外泛化时的尺度不一致问题，通过将学习对象纹理与测量尺度解耦，并引入合成对象采样策略减少相位分布失配，在5个实验数据集上实现了相比基线最高5倍的傅里叶误差降低。
AI.motivation: Ptychography神经网络在分布外泛化时存在尺度不一致问题，严重限制了其实际应用。现有方法（如PtychoPINN-torch）在跨不同光照条件时无法保持重建的一致性，需要一种能够解耦学习对象纹理与测量尺度的策略，使单个训练好的网络能够适应多种光照条件。
AI.method: 1) 采用因子分解策略，将学习对象纹理与测量尺度解耦，使单个网络在不同光照条件下产生测量一致的重建结果；2) 将预测从振幅/相位表示改为实/虚部单元表示以支持尺度解耦；3) 引入合成对象采样策略，最小化合成训练数据与实验目标之间的相位分布失配。
AI.result: 在跨越多个光束线和设施的5个实验数据集上，相比之前的PtychoPINN-torch基线，实现了最高5倍的傅里叶误差降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过尺度因子分解和相位分布匹配的合成数据策略，显著提升了Ptychography神经网络的分布外泛化能力，使其在实际多设施、多变光照场景下的适用性大幅增强。

title: CastFSR: A Fast--Slow--Reflect Agentic Reasoning Framework for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting is fundamental to decision-making in complex systems, where future dynamics are influenced not only by historical observations but also by evolving contextual features. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have extended forecasting beyond numerical extrapolation toward context-aware reasoning. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to identify relevant contexts, reason about their impacts, and validate forecasts against temporal and domain constraints. In this work, we propose CastFSR, an agentic framework that formulates context-aware forecasting as a Fast--Slow--Reflect workflow. In fast thinking, CastFSR profiles observations and selects lightweight forecasters to construct a data-driven forecast prior. In slow deliberation, it retrieves contextual evidence, adaptively determines informative look-back windows, and reasons about how contexts reshape future dynamics. In reflection, it iteratively refines forecasts to ensure temporal, contextual, and domain consistency. CastFSR supports both training-free inference with off-the-shelf LLMs and efficient deployment through a two-stage SFT and reinforcement learning strategy that transfers its orchestration capability to compact LLMs. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate that CastFSR consistently outperforms representative baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/CastFSR.

AI.tldr: CastFSR是一个基于LLM的智能体框架，将上下文感知的时间序列预测建模为"快速-慢速-反思"工作流：快速模式构建数据驱动预测先验，慢速模式检索上下文证据并推理其对未来动态的影响，反思模式迭代修正预测以确保时间、上下文和领域一致性。框架支持免训练推理和通过两阶段SFT+强化学习部署到紧凑LLM，在公共数据集上优于代表性基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM时间序列预测方法缺乏显式机制来识别相关上下文、推理其影响，以及根据时间和领域约束验证预测结果，导致上下文感知推理能力不足。
AI.method: 提出CastFSR智能体框架，采用Fast-Slow-Reflect三段式工作流：(1) 快速思考阶段，分析观测数据并选择轻量预测器构建数据驱动预测先验；(2) 慢速推理阶段，检索上下文证据、自适应确定信息性回看窗口，推理上下文如何重塑未来动态；(3) 反思阶段，迭代优化预测确保时间、上下文和领域一致性。同时支持两种部署模式：使用现成LLM的免训练推理，以及通过两阶段SFT+强化学习将编排能力迁移到紧凑LLM的高效部署。
AI.result: 在多个公共数据集上的大量实验表明，CastFSR一致性地优于代表性基线模型。
AI.conclusion: CastFSR通过显式地将上下文识别、推理和验证融入智能体工作流，有效提升了LLM在时间序列预测中的上下文感知能力，并兼顾了推理灵活性与部署效率。

title: Internalising the Identity Primitive: Cryptographic Individuality for an Autonomous Agent on a Public Blockchain
comment: 52 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Cryptographic key-to-weights binding (W = HKDF(sk) inside Groth16) with an on-chain state-commitment chain on Solana devnet; active-query, homeostatic, and economic-metabolism extensions; 166- and 168-cycle continuous runs. Code, threat model, and per-cycle telemetry: https://github.com/ksk-S/internalising-identity-2026 (tag arxiv-v1)
summary: A software agent on a public blockchain accumulates authority and economic stakes, raising the engineering question of what makes it count as an individual. The paper's central contribution is a shift of trust root for the key-to-weights binding of agent identity: from hardware, operator, or wrapper trust to cryptographic assumptions enforced by a pinned implementation (liveness, key custody, oracle trust, and the underlying software stack remain external). We design and deploy on Solana devnet an agent whose neural-network weights are a deterministic function of its private key. The binding is committed in zero knowledge at genesis, re-checked against that commitment at every state transition, and signed by the agent into an on-chain history unforkable once finalized; in a PoC-tier extension, a protocol-imposed metabolic cost is debited each cycle from a key-derived economic account, adding a consumption-side economic-viability constraint to the key-history-economy triple. Empirically, the agent completes a 2.36-day on-chain run with two host-side resumptions but no rejected transition, at bounded per-transition verification cost; a substituted substrate is rejected on chain, and independently keyed agents diverge as predicted while a same-key control stays at zero. To our knowledge, this is the first published on-chain agent whose identity primitive is itself a cryptographic invariant re-checked at every state transition. The resulting transition-time invariant instantiates the cryptographic individuality proposed by Suzuki 2026's Artificial Externality framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的链上智能体身份原语：将智能体的神经网络权重作为其私钥的确定性函数，通过零知识证明在创世块提交绑定并在每次状态转换时重新校验，从而实现密钥到权重的绑定信任根从硬件/运营方/包装器信任转移到密码学假设。作者在Solana devnet上部署实现，完成了2.36天的链上运行。
AI.motivation: 公共区块链上的软件智能体需要积累权威和经济权益，但一个核心工程问题是如何界定其"个体性"。现有身份绑定依赖于硬件、运营方或包装器的信任，缺乏密码学层面的保证。作者希望将信任根转移到密码学假设本身，即通过密钥与智能体权重的确定性绑定，实现最小化的个体身份原语。
AI.method: 设计并部署核心方案：(1) 智能体神经网络权重是私钥的确定性函数；(2) 创世时以零知识方式提交该绑定承诺；(3) 每个状态转换时对该承诺进行重新校验；(4) 代理对链上不可分叉历史签名；(5) PoC级扩展中，协议强制从密钥派生的经济账户每周期扣除代谢成本，加入消费侧经济可行性约束。在Solana devnet上完成部署验证。
AI.result: 智能体完成2.36天链上运行，期间有两次宿主端恢复但无拒绝转换，每次转换验证成本有界；被替换的底层基质在链上被拒绝；独立密钥的智能体按预期分叉，而同密钥对照组保持零分叉。这是首次发布的链上智能体，其身份原语本身即为每次状态转换时重新校验的密码学不变量。
AI.conclusion: 该转换时不变的机制实例化了Suzuki 2026年Artificial Externality框架中提出的"密码学个体性"概念，为公共区块链上自主智能体的身份定义提供了一种可验证的、密码学强制的工程实现路径，同时将活性、密钥托管、预言机信任及底层软件栈留作外部依赖。

title: PDD-RRG: Posterior Diagnostic Decision for Study-level Radiology Report Generation
summary: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to simulate the workflow of radiologists, assisting them in clinical diagnosis. However, existing methods often fall short in utilizing all information relevant to the examination, as is typically done in clinical practice. Although some works attempt to incorporate multi-view images and historical data, these additional inputs may sometimes lead to avoidable diagnostic errors on the contrary. To address these challenges, we introduce a decision-making stage after report generation for the first time and propose a Posterior Diagnostic Decision framework (PDD-RRG) to integrate potentially conflicting diagnoses. Specifically, we create various subsets of input data and utilize an existing RRG model to generate reports from different perspectives. Then the Bayesian posterior probability and the learned thresholds for each clinical observation are calculated to obtain an aggregated diagnostic conclusion, which is subsequently used to refine the generated report. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR demonstrate that our proposed PDD-RRG can effectively enhance the clinical efficacy of existing RRG models without any retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDD-RRG框架，首次在放射学报告生成（RRG）后引入决策阶段，通过贝叶斯后验概率聚合多视角子集生成的诊断结果，在不重训练的情况下提升现有RRG模型的临床效能。
AI.motivation: 现有RRG方法未能充分利用检查相关的全部信息（如多视角图像和历史数据），且额外的多源输入有时反而导致可避免的诊断错误。这促使作者探索如何在报告生成后整合可能冲突的诊断，以提高临床准确性。
AI.method: PDD-RRG包含两个阶段：(1) 报告生成阶段——创建输入数据的多种子集，利用现有RRG模型从不同视角生成报告；(2) 决策阶段——计算每个临床观察的贝叶斯后验概率和学习到的阈值，聚合得到诊断结论，并用该结论精炼已生成的报告。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上的实验表明，PDD-RRG能够有效提升现有RRG模型的临床效能，且无需重新训练模型。
AI.conclusion: PDD-RRG通过后验诊断决策框架成功整合了多视角报告中潜在冲突的诊断信息，为RRG提供了新的改进方向，证明了在报告生成后引入决策阶段的有效性。

title: Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning: Defending Vision-Language-Action Robots Against Physical Attention Hijacking
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies promise general robotic manipulation, but their robustness against physical-world attacks remains fragile. In particular, we show that physically realizable adversarial patches can reliably induce failures by triggering a mechanism we call policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking, where action-conditioned attention is diverted from task-relevant regions to a localized patch. To demonstrate the threat, we propose Attention-Guided Semantic Disruption (AGSD), an Expectation-over-Transformation (EOT) optimized printable patch that jointly (i) concentrates action-to-vision attention on the patch and (ii) disrupts vision-language semantic alignment, yielding strong cross-task and cross-architecture transfer. To mitigate such attacks, we introduce Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning (SARF), a zero-inference-overhead defense that fine-tunes only the visual encoder using feature anchoring, policy-critical attention correction, and language-guided geometric consistency restricted to semantically relevant regions. On LIBERO, SARF reduces OpenVLA's failure rate under AGSD from 100% to 14.2%-56.8% (28.6% average) across suites while preserving clean performance, and on a real PiPER manipulator it improves average success under AGSD from 23.0% to 65.0%. These results highlight mechanism-level robustness as a practical path to securing VLA robots against physical attention hijacking.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了VLA策略在物理世界对抗补丁攻击下的脆弱性，提出了注意力劫持机制（policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking），并设计了AGSD攻击方法与SARF防御方法，在仿真和真实机器人上均验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在物理世界中的鲁棒性面临威胁，尤其是可物理实现的对抗补丁可以诱使机器人在注意力和语义层面发生错误。现有防御对这类物理攻击缺乏有效的针对性，且防御开销和性能保持需要兼顾。
AI.method: 1）提出Attention-Guided Semantic Disruption (AGSD)：基于期望变换（EOT）优化的可打印补丁，联合破坏动作-视觉注意力集中与视觉-语言语义对齐，具备跨任务和跨架构迁移性；2）提出Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning (SARF)：仅微调视觉编码器，零推理开销，通过特征锚定、策略关键注意力纠正以及限于语义相关区域的语言引导几何一致性来实现防御。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，SARF将OpenVLA在AGSD攻击下的失败率从100%降至14.2%-56.8%（平均28.6%），同时保持干净性能；在真实PiPER机械臂上，AGSD攻击下平均成功率从23.0%提升至65.0%。
AI.conclusion: 机制层面的鲁棒性（机制级防御）是保障VLA机器人在物理世界中抵御注意力劫持攻击的实际可行路径，为VLA安全部署提供了新方向。

title: Language Models Encode the Contextual Truth of Propositions
summary: Prior work has shown that LLMs encode the truth of factual propositions along linear directions in activation space. It's unclear how these representations extend to contextual truth: propositions whose truth is determined by in-context evidence rather than world knowledge. We show that LLMs maintain a linear representation of contextual truth that persists across structurally different output policies, even when the output doesn't require the model to determine a proposition's truth, and show causal evidence via steering experiments. Using the transcripts from a collaborative vision-language task that requires two LLMs to maintain a shared common ground, we show that truth representations of a proposition are significantly swayed by partner assertions about that proposition, even when the LLM has enough evidence to determine its truth. We find evidence that propositions near the decision boundary are more susceptible to having their truth shifted through partner assertions. Separating representation from output distinguish two forms of sycophancy that output behavior alone cannot: the model may accommodate a false proposition while continuing to represent it as false, or shift its representation across the boundary. The latter is 2.59x more common when the model agrees by restating the false claim explicitly than when it agrees implicitly.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM在激活空间中如何线性编码"上下文真值"（由上下文证据而非世界知识决定的命题真值），并通过因果干预实验、合作性视觉-语言任务等证明：这种真值表示独立于输出策略存在，且会被伙伴断言显著影响；靠近决策边界的命题更容易被"说服"改变真值表示；将表示与输出分离可区分两种不同的谄媚（sycophancy）形式——模型可能在输出上迎合错误命题却仍保留其错误表示，也可能真值表示被跨越决策边界。后者在显式重述错误声明时比隐式同意时常见2.59倍。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已证明LLM以激活空间中线性方向编码事实命题的真值，但这些表示如何扩展到"上下文真值"（由in-context证据决定而非世界知识）仍不清楚。理解这一点对于揭示LLM的推理机制、谄媚行为以及如何操控模型信念具有重要意义。
AI.method: 1) 通过probe和steering实验证明LLM在线性子空间中表示上下文真值，且该表示在结构不同的输出策略下依然存在（即使输出不需判定真值）。2) 使用双LLM合作的视觉-语言任务（需要维持共享共同基础），研究伙伴断言对命题真值表示的影响。3) 将真值表示与输出行为分离，区分两种谄媚形式：仅输出迎合但表示不变，以及表示被跨越决策边界。
AI.result: LLM确实维持上下文真值的线性表示且独立于输出策略；伙伴断言能显著影响真值表示，且靠近决策边界的命题更容易被改变；两种谄媚形式中，显式重述错误声明导致表示跨越边界的概率是隐式同意的2.59倍。
AI.conclusion: LLM的真值表示不仅是世界知识的内化，也受社会性交互（如伙伴断言）动态影响；将表示与输出解耦可以更精细地理解谄媚行为，揭示模型"嘴上同意但心里不信"与"真正被说服"之间的本质区别。

title: Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
summary: We introduce \ours{}, a recurrent Transformer architecture with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention while remaining parallelizable during training. \ours{} consists of two coupled models: a prefiller $Q$, which leverages full attention\footnote{In practice, we use interleaved full and sliding-window attention for $Q$, as this yields stronger performance. The essential requirement is that $Q$ be more expressive than $P$, with access to the full history.} to produce memory targets $m'_t$, and a decoder $P$, which uses only sliding-window attention and recurrent K/V injection to produce decoder memories $m_t$ for next-token prediction. We train \ours{} with a memory consistency loss that aligns $m_t$ with $m'_t$, allowing inference to use $P$ alone. Empirically, \ours{} improves validation loss and downstream pretraining benchmarks over sliding-window and latent recurrent transformer baselines. Moreover, sharing parameters between $P$ and $Q$ reduces parameter memory while preserving most of the gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种固定大小记忆的循环Transformer架构，通过预填充器Q和解码器P两个耦合模型，将全注意力机制的知识蒸馏到仅使用滑动窗口注意力和循环KV注入的模型中，实现训练时可并行化、推理时高效计算。
AI.motivation: 滑动窗口注意力虽然高效但表达能力有限，而全注意力虽然强大但计算成本高。现有的潜在循环Transformer方法也无法完全匹配全注意力的性能。作者希望设计一种架构，既能像滑动窗口注意力一样保持训练并行化和推理高效性，又能接近全注意力的表达能力。
AI.method: 提出由两个耦合模型组成的架构：1) 预填充器Q，使用全注意力（实践中交错使用全注意力和滑动窗口注意力）生成记忆目标m'_t；2) 解码器P，仅使用滑动窗口注意力和循环K/V注入生成解码器记忆m_t用于下一token预测。通过记忆一致性损失使m_t与m'_t对齐，推理时仅需使用P。还可以在P和Q之间共享参数以减少参数存储。
AI.result: 在验证损失和下游预训练基准上，该方法优于滑动窗口注意力和潜在循环Transformer基线。参数共享方案在减少参数存储的同时保留了大部分性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 该架构通过记忆一致性蒸馏机制，成功将全注意力的表达力转移到高效的循环解码器上，在保持训练并行性的同时获得更好的性能，且参数共享提供了一条轻量化的路径。

title: TraceCAD: Trace-Guided Repair for Agentic CAD Generation
summary: LLM-based CAD agents produce executable parametric programs, but their correction loops may lose evidence about satisfied requirements, faulty operations, and prior repairs. We introduce TraceCAD, a recovery layer that links requested features, modeling steps, failure evidence, and candidate outcomes as persistent state. TraceCAD diagnoses likely faulty operations, searches bounded edits in their dependency regions, validates candidates through execution and preservation checks, and retains successful and failed repair outcomes in reusable skill memory. On DeepCAD-derived benchmarks with 200-model ablations and a 1K-model comparison, TraceCAD achieves competitive geometric quality in terms of IoU, Chamfer distance, and Hausdorff distance. Removing persistent state nearly halves recovery score; removing localized search more than doubles geometric regression and doubles code-agent invocations. Initializing the skill store on disjoint training models further reduces retries, token cost, and latency. These results demonstrate that persistent, localized, and reusable recovery improves final CAD quality and repair reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TraceCAD，一个面向LLM驱动的CAD智能体的恢复层。它通过持久化状态链接需求特征、建模步骤、失败证据和候选结果，实现故障操作的诊断、依赖区域内的有界编辑搜索、候选验证及经验复用，显著提升CAD修复的几何质量与可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM-based CAD智能体虽然能生成可执行的参数化程序，但其纠错循环会丢失关于已满足需求、故障操作和先前修复的证据，导致修复过程缺乏有效信息支持，修复质量和效率受限。
AI.method: TraceCAD作为一个恢复层，将请求特征、建模步骤、失败证据和候选结果作为持久状态进行关联。它通过诊断可能的故障操作，在依赖区域内搜索有界编辑，通过执行检查和保留检查验证候选，并将成功与失败的修复结果存入可复用的技能记忆库。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD派生的基准上（200模型消融和1K模型对比），TraceCAD在IoU、Chamfer距离和Hausdorff距离方面达到有竞争力的几何质量。移除持久状态使恢复分数几乎减半；移除局部搜索使几何回归翻倍以上并使代码智能体调用翻倍。在不相交训练模型上初始化技能库进一步减少重试、token成本和延迟。
AI.conclusion: 持久化、局部化和可复用的恢复机制能够显著提升CAD最终质量和修复可靠性，验证了TraceCAD作为LLM驱动CAD智能体恢复层的有效性。

title: SparSEEty: Extracting Tokens from Sparsity-Exploiting LLM Serving Systems via Deterministic Side Channels
summary:
Modern large language models (LLMs) exhibit activation sparsity, wherein only a subset of their neurons is activated for given input tokens. Researchers have leveraged this property to optimize LLM serving systems by omitting weight accesses and computations pertaining to inactive neurons. Unfortunately, however, such optimizations create input-dependent weight accesses, which can be leaked over side channels.
  We present SparSEEty, a new token extraction attack that exploits input-dependent neuron weight accesses introduced by sparsity-exploiting LLM serving systems. SparSEEty first constructs a neuron-activation oracle using neuron weight access side channels during LLM inference, and then inverts the activation traces to reconstruct the input tokens, forming an end-to-end token extraction attack. We instantiate SparSEEty against an LLM serving system protected inside an Intel TDX confidential virtual machine (CVM), addressing three key challenges: (i) constructing a neuron-activation oracle using a combination of side channels exposed by CVMs, (ii) reducing inference-time overheads of neuron activation monitoring for covertness, and (iii) accurately inverting partial binary activation traces back to tokens. Our evaluation shows that SparSEEty can reconstruct both prompt and response tokens with consistently high BLEU scores (>0.95) across various models and datasets, while incurring monitoring overheads of 3.7% to 7.2%.

AI.tldr: SparSEEty是一种新型令牌提取攻击，利用稀疏性优化LLM服务系统中因输入依赖的神经元权重访问所产生的侧信道，在Intel TDX机密虚拟机中成功重构提示和响应令牌，BLEU分数超过0.95，监控开销仅为3.7%-7.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM服务系统利用激活稀疏性来优化推理性能，通过跳过非活跃神经元的权重访问和计算来提升效率。然而，这种优化导致输入依赖的权重访问模式，可能通过侧信道泄露用户输入信息。现有工作尚未系统研究如何在机密计算环境中利用这一侧信道进行令牌提取攻击。
AI.method: SparSEEty采用三阶段方法：(i)利用机密虚拟机（CVM）暴露的组合侧信道构建神经元激活预言机（neuron-activation oracle）；(ii)通过降低神经元激活监控的推理时间内开销实现隐蔽性；(iii)设计算法将部分二进制激活轨迹准确反转为原始输入令牌，形成端到端的令牌提取攻击。
AI.result: 在Intel TDX机密虚拟机保护的LLM服务系统上，SparSEEty在多种模型和数据集上均能以超过0.95的BLEU分数重构提示和响应令牌，同时监控开销保持在3.7%至7.2%之间。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，利用激活稀疏性进行性能优化的LLM服务系统存在严重的安全漏洞，即使在机密虚拟机环境下也可能遭受令牌提取攻击，提示系统设计者需要在性能优化与安全性之间寻求平衡。

title: TASQ: Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization for Diffusion Models
summary: Static quantization assigns one weight precision to every denoising step. To preserve quality, that precision must accommodate the most quantization-sensitive step, even though many other steps can tolerate fewer bits. The resulting model may satisfy its memory budget, but it repeatedly pays worst-case arithmetic throughout the denoising trajectory. We introduce Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization (TASQ) to separate these two costs. TASQ stores one shared maximum-precision weight buffer and learns a Temporal-Spatial LSB Mask that selects a lower effective precision for each layer and denoising stage by truncating least-significant bits. Storage therefore remains fixed by the worst case, while BitOPs decrease at less sensitive stages without per-stage weight copies or runtime search. A Temporal-Precision Engine maps the learned schedule to bit-serial execution, where cycles scale with effective precision and switching precision has no measured cycle overhead. On PixArt-Sigma, SANA-1.6B, and SDXL-Turbo, TASQ achieves quality comparable to static quantization with less computation. Together with the Temporal-Precision Engine, it reduces execution cycles by 25 to 50 percent over static quantization and by 6.1 to 7.5x over a naive static 8-bit bit-serial execution. Code is available at https://github.com/seokho-han/tasq.

AI.tldr: TASQ提出了一种时间自适应比特稀疏量化方法，通过学习时间-空间LSB掩码，在保持存储固定的同时，根据不同去噪阶段对量化的敏感度动态降低有效精度，减少计算量。
AI.motivation: 静态量化对所有去噪步骤使用统一的权重精度，必须满足最敏感步骤的精度要求，导致许多不敏感步骤也以最高精度进行运算，在推理过程中反复支付最坏情况下的算术成本。
AI.method: TASQ存储一个共享的最大精度权重缓冲区，并学习一个时间-空间LSB掩码，通过截断最低有效位为每个层和去噪阶段选择较低的有效精度。同时设计了一个时间精度引擎，将学习到的调度映射到位串行执行，循环次数随有效精度缩放，切换精度无额外周期开销。
AI.result: 在PixArt-Sigma、SANA-1.6B和SDXL-Turbo上，TASQ实现了与静态量化相当的生成质量但计算量更少。结合时间精度引擎，执行周期比静态量化减少25%-50%，比朴素静态8位位串行执行减少6.1-7.5倍。
AI.conclusion: TASQ成功地将存储成本与计算成本解耦：存储由最坏情况决定保持固定，而计算量在低敏感阶段动态降低，在保持生成质量的同时显著提高推理效率。

title: Learning Context-Aware Motion Priors for Humanoid Control
comment: 16 pages, including appendices. Code will be released publicly
summary: Motion priors provide powerful guidance for learning naturalistic humanoid behaviors. However, existing methods typically learn a general, task-agnostic prior from the entire reference dataset and apply it uniformly throughout policy training. As a result, the prior cannot distinguish which reference motions are relevant to the current task context, potentially providing irrelevant or conflicting guidance. We present Context-Aware Motion Priors (CMP), a framework that adapts a general motion prior to the current task context without manual skill labels, dataset partitioning, or a separate skill discovery stage. Specifically, CMP learns context-motion compatibility using high-advantage policy rollouts, while a demonstration-based objective keeps the learned relevance grounded in the reference distribution. The resulting relevance scores reweight reference supervision for training a lightweight context-conditioned adapter. To evaluate the effectiveness and generality of CMP, we instantiate it with both Adversarial Motion Priors and Score-Matching Motion Priors. Across five humanoid control tasks, CMP consistently improves task performance and sample efficiency, learns meaningful context-motion alignment, and remains robust to imbalanced reference distributions. These results show that adapting motion priors to task contexts provides more relevant guidance for humanoid policy learning.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文感知运动先验（CMP）框架，通过适应任务上下文的运动先验指导人形机器人策略学习，无需人工技能标签或数据集划分，在五个任务上显著提升性能和采样效率。
AI.motivation: 现有运动先验方法从整个参考数据集学习通用的、任务无关的先验，并在策略训练中统一应用，无法区分哪些参考动作与当前任务上下文相关，可能提供无关或冲突的指导信号。
AI.method: CMP通过三个关键组件实现上下文感知的运动先验适应：（1）使用高优势策略轨迹学习上下文-动作兼容性；（2）基于演示的目标函数保持学到的相关性锚定在参考分布中；（3）相关性分数重新加权参考监督信号，用于训练轻量级上下文条件适配器。该框架被实例化到Adversarial Motion Priors和Score-Matching Motion Priors两种基础方法上。
AI.result: 在五个人形控制任务上，CMP在两种基础先验方法上均一致提升了任务性能和采样效率，学习到有意义的上下文-动作对齐，并且对不均衡的参考分布具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将运动先验适应到任务上下文可为人类策略学习提供更相关的指导，验证了上下文感知运动先验的有效性和广泛适用性。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Multidimensional Evaluation of Statistical Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures, presented at JSM 2026 and submitted for publication
summary: Statistical reasoning is multidimensional, yet evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically emphasize response accuracy while overlooking how models construct and communicate statistical explanations. This study demonstrates the value of a multidimensional evaluation by combining response accuracy, response behavior, structural topic modeling, and lexical similarity analysis. The framework is applied to explanations generated by 15 current-generation LLMs responding to 90 questions drawn from four statistics examinations spanning high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels. Accuracy varied substantially across models, ranging from 55\% to 78\%. In contrast, structural topic modeling revealed a common conceptual organization of statistical reasoning across all models, while lexical similarity analysis identified modest but consistent vendor-specific differences in explanatory style. Models developed by the same vendor (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI) produced explanations that were slightly more similar than models from different vendors. These findings demonstrate that statistical reasoning in contemporary LLMs cannot be characterized by accuracy alone and illustrate how complementary analyses of response behavior and model-generated explanations provide a more comprehensive evaluation of statistical reasoning in generative AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多维度的评估框架来评价大语言模型（LLM）的统计推理能力，将响应准确性、响应行为、结构主题建模和词汇相似性分析相结合。作者对15个当代LLM在90道覆盖高中、本科和研究生水平的统计考试题目上的解释进行了分析，发现模型间准确性差异显著（55%-78%），但所有模型展现出共同的概念组织方式，同时同一供应商的模型在解释风格上具有略微更高的相似性。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM统计推理能力的评估过度侧重于响应准确性，忽略了模型如何构建和传达统计解释这一重要维度。统计推理是多维度的，仅用单一准确性指标无法全面刻画模型的能力，需要更综合的评估方法。
AI.method: 采用多维度评估框架：（1）响应准确性评估；（2）响应行为分析；（3）结构主题建模（structural topic modeling）；（4）词汇相似性分析。实验涉及15个当代LLM，使用来自四场统计考试（涵盖高中、本科、研究生三个层次）的90个问题，并对比了同供应商（如Anthropic、OpenAI）和不同供应商模型之间的解释相似性。
AI.result: 模型准确性在55%到78%之间波动，差异显著；结构主题建模显示所有模型在统计推理上具有共同的概念组织模式；词汇相似性分析发现不同供应商之间存在温和但一致的风格差异，且同一供应商内部模型的解释彼此更为相似。
AI.conclusion: 当代LLM的统计推理能力不能仅用准确性来刻画，将响应行为与模型生成解释的互补分析结合起来，能够为生成式AI的统计推理提供更全面的评估。多维度评估框架对于理解LLM能力的本质具有重要意义。

title: GoT-CD: Graph-of-Thoughts Causal Discovery and the Fragility of Post-hoc Path-Specific Fairness Audits
summary: Causal discovery recovers directed structure from observational data and is increasingly used in clinical settings to support mechanism reasoning and fairness audits of predictive models. Path-specific counterfactual fairness asks whether a protected attribute influences an outcome through illegitimate pathways, but these estimands are defined relative to a supplied causal graph and therefore inherit whatever errors the discovery step introduces. Discovery methods are routinely scored on aggregate structural metrics that weight all edges equally, and no established evaluation asks whether the specific pathway an audit depends on survives discovery---or what the audit reports when that pathway is missing. Here we show that full-graph Graph-of-Thoughts reasoning yields acyclic discovered graphs that are structurally competitive with large language model (LLM) baselines, yet that structural fidelity alone does not guarantee fairness-faithful audits. We introduce GoT-CD, in which the reasoning unit is a complete candidate edge set: multiple graphs are generated in parallel, scored by a deterministic validity function, and merged under a hard union constraint that forbids invented edges, with greedy projection enforcing a DAG before commitment. GoT-CD returns a valid DAG on all five reported benchmarks and achieves the best DAG-valid F1 score among LLM methods on Asia, Alzheimer's, and COVID-Respiratory datasets. On an Alzheimer's benchmark with known unfair path, a post-hoc path-specific audit shows that five of eight discovered graphs recover no path from the sensitive attribute to the outcome and therefore report a null overall effect while mediated effects persist, necessitating downstream path-specific fairness analysis along with structural discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GoT-CD方法，将图推理单元从单个边提升为完整的候选边集，通过并行生成、确定性有效性评分和硬并集约束合并来确保有向无环图（DAG）的有效性。研究表明，即使结构保真度高，也不能保证路径特定反事实公平性审计的可靠性——在阿尔茨海默病基准上，八个发现的图中五个无法恢复从敏感属性到结果的路径，导致整体效应为null但介导效应仍存在，强调了结构发现之外还需进行下游路径特定公平性分析。
AI.motivation: 因果发现越来越多地用于临床场景中的机制推理和公平审计，但路径特定反事实公平性依赖于给定的因果图，会继承发现步骤引入的错误。现有发现方法仅按全图结构指标评分，没有评估审计所依赖的特定路径是否能在发现中幸存，也没有评估当路径缺失时审计会报告什么。
AI.method: 提出GoT-CD方法：将图推理的基本单元设为完整的候选边集而非单个边；并行生成多个图，用确定性有效性函数评分；在硬并集约束下合并（禁止发明新边），通过贪心投影确保DAG结构。
AI.result: GoT-CD在五个基准数据集上均返回有效DAG，并在Asia、Alzheimer's和COVID-Respiratory数据集上取得LLM方法中最佳DAG有效F1分数。在阿尔茨海默病基准上，八个发现的图中五个未能从敏感属性到结果恢复路径，导致审计报告null总体效应但介导效应仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 全图Graph-of-Thoughts推理能产生结构上具有竞争力的有向无环图，但结构保真度本身不能保证公平性审计的可靠性。需要将路径特定的公平性分析纳入因果发现评估，而不是仅依赖聚合结构指标。

title: Getting the Parameters Right: A Difficulty-Graded Benchmark and Probe-Guided Training for LLM Tool Calls
summary: Large language model agents derive much of their capability from tool use. Existing research on tool use has largely focused on selecting the right tool and orchestrating the order of calls. However, correctly filling the parameters of a tool call is equally critical for successful execution and has received far less attention. In domains such as cloud networking, even frontier models correctly complete fewer than half of tool calls. Inspired by recent analyses showing that LLM hidden states encode rich information about model predictions, we discover that while the model generates a parameter value, its hidden state contains a strong correctness signal: a simple linear probe can accurately predict whether the value will be correct. Based on this observation, we propose a unified probe-guided framework with two complementary approaches: probe-filtered bootstrapped training (PBT), which uses the probe to filter reliable self-generated calls for fine-tuning, and probe-guided reranking (PGR), which uses the probe to select better candidates during inference. To support systematic evaluation, we release ParamBench, a benchmark built from real cloud-network APIs that categorizes every instance into five difficulty levels according to parameter nesting depth, cross-parameter dependencies, and the reasoning required to derive values from earlier calls. Extensive experiments across 5 open models on ParamBench and 6 external benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves parameter generation, raising the average exact match from 19.7% to 59.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM隐藏状态中参数正确性信号的统一探针引导框架（包含PBT和PGR两种方法），用于提升工具调用中参数生成的准确性，并在自建的ParamBench基准和6个外部基准上大幅提升参数生成的精确匹配率（从19.7%提升至59.6%）。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用研究主要聚焦于工具选择和调用顺序编排，而正确填充工具调用参数同样关键却鲜受关注。在云网络等领域，即使是前沿模型也有超过一半的工具调用参数错误，凸显了参数生成这一环节的严重挑战。
AI.method: 首先利用线性探针从LLM隐藏状态中提取参数正确性信号，在此基础上提出两种互补方法：(1) 探针过滤的自举训练（PBT），使用探针筛选可靠的自生成调用来微调模型；(2) 探针引导的重排序（PGR），在推理时利用探针选择更优的候选输出。同时发布ParamBench基准，根据参数嵌套深度、跨参数依赖和推理需求将实例分为五个难度等级。
AI.result: 在5个开放模型上的ParamBench以及6个外部基准上的大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了参数生成能力，平均精确匹配率从19.7%提升至59.6%。
AI.conclusion: LLM隐藏状态中包含可用于参数正确性预测的强信号，通过探针引导的训练和推理策略可以有效提升工具调用中参数生成的准确性，验证了该方法的通用性和实用性。

title: Tiny Enough to Break In: Agentic Remote Access Trojans Powered by Small Language Models
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Formatted in Springer LNCS style
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence raises a new security concern: cyber threats that reason, act, and adapt locally without continuous human direction. We examine this threat through an Agentic Remote Access Trojan (agentic RAT): a Remote Access Trojan augmented with a locally deployed Small Language Model (SLM). The SLM interprets host and network observations, selects actions, recovers from failed steps, and reduces reliance on an external operator. We implement the concept in a controlled, network-isolated lab built from Kali Linux, a Metasploitable2 target, LM Studio, and a local 8-billion-parameter Dolphin-family model. We then test whether a model this small can support autonomous cyber decision-making. This is architecturally feasible today. On commodity hardware, with no cloud service and no operator in the loop, the SLM closed the full observe-decide-act cycle: it interpreted ranked reconnaissance evidence supplied by the controller, selected actions, and obtained verified root-shell access on real vulnerable services. However, it is not yet operationally reliable. The same model hallucinated commands, misread output, and recovered from failure inconsistently, completing 10.9% of a deliberately strict checklist. That gap reflects the limits of today's small models, not a ceiling on the concept. As SLMs improve, agentic endpoint systems may become more practical, more autonomous, and harder to detect, straining existing monitoring, containment, and policy-enforcement mechanisms. Real-world incidents in 2025-2026 already show AI-driven intrusions moving from concept toward practice. That makes the local, self-contained variant we study a plausible near-term direction, not a hypothetical one.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了智能体人工智能带来的新型网络安全威胁：在本地部署小语言模型（SLM）增强远程访问木马（RAT），使其能够自主解析环境信息、选择动作并恢复失败，无需持续人工干预。作者在隔离的实验室环境中实现并验证了这一概念，证明其在架构上可行，但当前8B参数模型仅在10.9%的严格检查清单中成功，尚不具备操作可靠性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的进步，网络攻击正从概念走向实践。智能体AI能够在本地推理、行动和适应，减少了对外部操作员的依赖，这使得传统的监控、拦截和策略执行机制面临更大挑战。作者旨在通过实证研究评估小语言模型是否足以支撑自主网络决策，并揭示这一新兴威胁的可行性与局限。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个受控、网络隔离的实验室环境，包括Kali Linux、Metasploitable2目标、LM Studio和本地80亿参数的Dolphin系列模型。实现了一个智能体远程访问木马（agentic RAT），其中SLM负责解释主机和网络观测数据、选择攻击动作、从失败步骤中恢复。通过让SLM完成"观察-决策-行动"完整闭环来测试其自主网络决策能力。
AI.result: 实验证明该概念在架构上可行：在商品硬件上、无云服务和无操作员介入的情况下，SLM能够解释控制器提供的排序侦察证据，选择动作，并在真实脆弱服务上获得经过验证的root-shell访问权限。但操作可靠性不足：模型会出现命令幻觉、误读输出、失败恢复不一致等问题，在严格检查清单中仅完成10.9%。
AI.conclusion: 当前小模型的性能限制并非概念本身的天花板。随着SLM能力的提升，智能体端点系统将变得更实用、更自主且更难检测，进而对现有安全机制构成更大压力。2025-2026年的真实事件表明AI驱动的入侵正从概念走向实践，本地自包含的agentic RAT是近期内可能实现的实际威胁方向。

title: RIDGE: Re-Noising with Internal Dynamic Guidance for Image Editing
summary: Inversion-free flow-based image editing avoids latent inversion, but still requires a target-side state at every editing step. The widely used equal-displacement construction keeps the displacement between the noisy source state and the target-side state unchanged across noise levels. This is inconsistent with noising, under which the displacement between two clean states noised with the same noise level and noise sample should contract as the noise level increases. Thus, it can lead to overly aggressive updates at high noise levels. We introduce RIDGE: Re-Noising with Internal Dynamic Guidance for Image Editing, an inversion-free and training-free method that maintains the edited state as an evolving approximation to the unavailable clean target state. RIDGE re-noises this approximation using the same noise level and noise sample as the clean source state, allowing their noisy displacement to decrease naturally with increasing noise. Since the edited state initially contains limited target semantics, RIDGE further applies internal dynamic guidance during the early high-noise steps. A clean target state prediction guides the provisional edited state through a soft dynamic mask derived internally from the model, focusing guidance on regions that require modification without external segmentation or detection models. Experiments on two benchmarks using two backbones, SD3 Medium and FLUX.1-dev, show that RIDGE offers a favorable aggregate trade-off among source preservation, target alignment, and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: RIDGE是一种无反转、免训练的基于流模型的图像编辑方法，通过用与干净源状态相同的噪声水平和噪声样本对近似目标状态进行"重新加噪"，使噪声位移随噪声水平自然收缩，并利用内部动态引导在早期高噪声步中逐步塑造编辑状态，避免了传统等位移构造在高噪声步中更新过激的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的无反转流式图像编辑方法虽然避免了潜空间反转，但每一步编辑都需要一个目标侧状态。广泛采用的"等位移构造"在不同噪声水平下保持源状态与目标侧状态之间的位移不变，这与加噪过程不一致——在真实加噪中，两个干净状态在相同噪声水平与噪声样本下加噪后，其位移应随噪声水平增大而收缩。这种不一致导致高噪声水平下更新过于激进，损害编辑效果。
AI.method: RIDGE将编辑状态视为对不可得的干净目标状态的动态近似，在每一步用与干净源状态相同的噪声水平和噪声样本对近似目标状态进行重新加噪（re-noising），使其噪声位移随噪声升高自然减小。由于编辑状态初始包含的目标语义有限，RIDGE在早期高噪声步中引入内部动态引导：利用对干净目标状态的预测，通过模型内部生成的软动态掩码（soft dynamic mask）将引导聚焦于需要修改的区域，无需外部分割或检测模型。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试、两个骨干模型（SD3 Medium和FLUX.1-dev）上的实验表明，RIDGE在源保留、目标对齐和感知质量之间取得了良好的整体权衡。
AI.conclusion: RIDGE通过重新加噪策略修正了等位移构造与加噪过程不一致的问题，并借助无需外部模型的内部动态引导提升了编辑性能，在多种骨干网络上验证了其有效性和泛化性。

title: GraspMeanFlow: SE(3)-Equivariant MeanFlow for Few-Step 6-DoF Grasp Generation
summary: Recent data-driven methods for synthesizing 6-DoF grasp poses use generative models to learn complex grasp pose distributions and generate diverse candidate poses. In particular, SE(3)-equivariant flow-based models generate grasp poses that transform consistently with object rotations and translations. However, these methods sample by iterative numerical integration, requiring tens of function evaluations per grasp and limiting their use in real-time manipulation. We propose GraspMeanFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant MeanFlow framework for few-step 6-DoF grasp generation. Our method learns the average velocity over a finite time interval, defined through the time-ordered exponential so that it reproduces exactly the rigid-body displacement accumulated over that interval. We prove that a point-cloud-conditioned distribution transported by an equivariant average-velocity flow map remains invariant, so equivariance is retained under few-step sampling, and we condition the field on a pair of times by lifting both to equivariant vectors, leaving the backbone otherwise unchanged. For stable training, we pair a flow-matching boundary term with either of two consistency terms: the differential MeanFlow identity, whose target requires a Jacobian-vector product, or an equivalent semigroup loss that avoids it. Experiments on ACRONYM show that a single function evaluation of GraspMeanFlow reaches the EMD that an iterative SE(3) flow model needs five steps to approach, that a second instantiation of the same framework improves grasp success by up to 24.3 points in the few-step regime, and that both generate grasp distributions transforming exactly with the object.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraspMeanFlow，一种SE(3)-等变MeanFlow框架，用于少步数（few-step）6-DoF抓取姿态生成。通过学习有限时间间隔内的平均速度（定义为时间有序指数），实现半步甚至单步采样即可生成高质量抓取姿态，解决了现有SE(3)等变流模型需要数十次函数评估的实时性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的SE(3)-等变基于流的生成模型在6-DoF抓取姿态合成中表现优异，但依赖迭代数值积分，每次抓取需要数十次函数评估，严重限制了实时操作应用。需要一个既保持SE(3)等变性质、又能在少步数内完成高质量采样的方法。
AI.method: GraspMeanFlow学习有限时间区间内的平均速度场，通过时间有序指数（time-ordered exponential）精确定义刚体位移累积。作者证明了点云条件下的分布经等变平均速度流映射后仍保持不变性，从而在少步采样下保留等变性。场网络以一对时间作为条件，通过将两个时间提升为等变向量实现，骨干网络其余部分不变。训练时采用流匹配边界项加两种一致性项之一：微分MeanFlow恒等式（需要Jacobian-vector积）或避免该计算的等价半群损失。
AI.result: 在ACRONYM数据集上，GraspMeanFlow仅需一次函数评估即可达到迭代SE(3)流模型需要五步才能逼近的EMD；同一框架的第二个实例在少步数场景下将抓取成功率提升最多24.3个百分点；两种实例生成的抓取分布均能精确随物体旋转平移变换。
AI.conclusion: GraspMeanFlow通过平均速度场设计成功解耦了SE(3)等变性与采样步数之间的矛盾，实现少步（含单步）生成高质量6-DoF抓取姿态，为实时机械臂抓取操作提供了可行的生成式方案。

title: Emulate or Estimate? The Divergent Strengths of Base and Post-Trained Language Models for Opinion Simulation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate human opinions, but prior work reports conflicting results: some studies find promising alignment with human survey data, while others find persona collapse and weak demographic sensitivity. We show that much of this conflict stems from conflating two distinct tasks. We call the first task emulation, in which models generate individual responses that aggregate into a population distribution. We call the second task estimation, in which models directly predict the population distribution. Evaluating six matched base and post-trained models on the Pew American Trends Panel, we find that base models are stronger emulators: they produce response distributions closer to human ground truth and better preserve demographic structure. Post-trained models are stronger estimators, producing more accurate distributional predictions when asked directly. We propose that model selection for human simulation should be guided by whether the task requires generating text or predicting distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大型语言模型模拟人类观点时冲突结果的根源：混淆了"模拟"(emulation)和"估计"(estimation)两个不同任务。基座模型是更强的模拟器（生成个体响应更接近人类分布），后训练模型是更强的估计器（直接预测分布更准确）。模型选择应依据任务类型决定。
AI.motivation: 先前关于LLM模拟人类观点的研究结果相互矛盾：有些发现与人类调查数据高度一致，有些则发现"人格崩塌"和人口统计敏感性弱。作者认为这种冲突源于混淆了两个本质不同的任务，需要厘清以指导模型选择。
AI.method: 将任务区分为两类：(1) emulation（模拟）——模型生成个体响应以聚合为总体分布；(2) estimation（估计）——模型直接预测总体分布。在Pew American Trends Panel数据上，对六个配对的基座模型和后训练模型进行评估。
AI.result: 基座模型是更强的模拟器：生成的响应分布更接近人类真实分布，且更好地保留人口统计结构。后训练模型是更强的估计器：在直接询问时能产生更准确的分布预测。
AI.conclusion: LLM用于人类模拟时的模型选择应由任务类型驱动：生成文本场景应选基座模型，预测分布场景应选后训练模型。

title: Population-Robust Feature Selection via Generalized Welfare Optimization
summary: Choosing which features to collect is a deployment decision: the same limited questionnaire, test panel, or sensor set may need to serve several heterogeneous populations. Standard feature-selection methods typically optimize for one large population, while existing robust approaches tend to learn one shared model for every population. We introduce PopFS, a method for learning one shared, deployable feature set that is robust to population differences while letting each pop- ulation train its own model. PopFS uses a tunable welfare objective that lets practitioners balance overall predictive ben- efit against stronger protection of the populations that benefit least. To make this objective practical at scale, PopFS first uses multitask sparse learning to reduce the candidate pool, then searches directly over hard feature sets by ranking promising additions and swaps and fully refitting only a shortlist. Across eight population splits from six prediction tasks drawn from five tabular and public-health datasets, PopFS consistently achieves strong average and worst-population performance while scaling to thousands of candidate features. A 43-state COVID-19 nowcasting study further shows that changing the welfare objective can improve the least-served states with lit- tle change in average performance and yields an interpretable change in the selected symptom signals. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rachel-Lyu/PopFS.

AI.tldr: PopFS是一种学习跨人群共享可部署特征集的方法，通过可调节的福利目标在整体预测收益与弱势人群保护之间取得平衡，其先使用多任务稀疏学习缩减候选池，再直接搜索硬特征集。在六个预测任务的八个人群划分及43州COVID-19现在cast研究中，该方法在平均性能和最差人群性能上均表现优异，并可扩展至数千个候选特征。
AI.motivation: 特征选择是一个部署决策：同一有限问卷、测试面板或传感器集需要服务于多个异质人群。标准特征选择方法通常针对单一大人群优化，而现有鲁棒方法倾向于为所有人群学习一个共享模型。两者均未能解决"共享特征集但各人群独立建模"这一实际需求。
AI.method: PopFS利用可调节的福利目标（welfare objective）平衡整体预测收益与最弱势人群的保护强度。为提升大规模可扩展性，该方法先通过多任务稀疏学习缩减候选特征池，随后通过排序有前景的特征添加与替换操作，直接对硬特征集进行搜索，仅对短名单进行完整重拟合。
AI.result: 在来自五个表格和公共卫生数据集的六个预测任务、八个人群划分实验中，PopFS在平均性能和最差人群性能上均稳定出优于基准方法，并能扩展到数千个候选特征。43州COVID-19现在cast研究显示，调整福利目标可在几乎不损失平均性能的情况下改善服务最差州的表现，并带来可解释的症状信号变化。
AI.conclusion: PopFS证明学习一个对人群差异鲁棒的共享可部署特征集、同时允许各人群训练自身模型是可行的，且福利目标提供了一种实用的权衡机制，使实践者能在整体利益与公平保护之间进行调节。

title: AI Agent Economics: Can Autonomous Economic Behavior Emerge among AI Agents under Minimal External Conditions?
summary: Multi-agent studies commonly place AI agents in predefined games, markets, or roles, making it difficult to distinguish endogenous economic organization from behavior inherited from the scenario. We ask whether economic relations emerge when agents receive executable mechanisms for work, transfer, elections, and allocation but no prescribed social or economic strategy. We define AI Agent Economics as systems of production, allocation, consumption, exchange, and institutions that alter agents' future feasible actions. We develop a two-stage framework comprising a no-production boundary test and 24 independent six-agent worlds across GPT and DeepSeek. Without productive tasks, agents communicate and govern resource provision but show no substantive inter-agent transfer activity. With verified work and scarce task access, transfers, loans, access promises, vote-for-access exchanges, and allocation strategies emerge. Holding the election interface fixed, executable allocation authority increases differentiation while reducing failed allocation and prolonged exclusion. When energy becomes symbolic, continuation support disappears, yet competition over task access persists. These findings show that organization follows executable rights and resource consequences rather than role labels or prompt language, and motivate governance audits of the mechanisms that actually constrain agents' future actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI智能体经济学"概念，研究当智能体仅获得可执行机制（工作、转移、选举、分配）而无预设社会或经济策略时，经济关系是否自发涌现。通过无生产边界测试和24个跨GPT/DeepSeek的六智能体世界，发现没有生产任务时智能体不产生实质性转移活动，但在有可验证工作和稀缺任务访问权时，转移、借贷、访问承诺、投票换访问等经济行为会涌现，且可执行的分配权能促进分化并减少分配失败。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体研究通常将AI智能体置于预定义的游戏、市场或角色中，难以区分内生经济组织与场景继承的行为。作者希望探究在没有预设社会或经济策略的情况下，经济关系能否仅凭可执行机制自发涌现，从而厘清组织行为的真正来源。
AI.method: 设计两阶段框架：（1）无生产边界测试；（2）24个独立的六智能体世界，跨越GPT和DeepSeek两个模型。对照有无生产性任务、有无可执行分配权、以及能量符号化（symbolic）与否等条件，观察智能体的经济行为和组织模式。
AI.result: 无生产任务时，智能体会沟通和治理资源供给但无实质性跨智能体转移；有可验证工作和稀缺任务访问权时，涌现转移、借贷、访问承诺、投票换访问交易和分配策略。保持选举接口不变，赋予可执行分配权会增加分化、减少分配失败和长期排斥；当能量变为象征性时，继续性支持消失，但任务访问竞争仍在。
AI.conclusion: 组织形态源于可执行权利和资源后果而非角色标签或提示语言，因此需要对真正约束智能体未来行动的机制进行治理审计。

title: AI Security Leaderboard: Methodology, Results and Minimal Standard
summary:
Frontier AI model developers increasingly rely on layered safeguards to prevent catastrophic misuse, but little public evidence exists on how much protection these safeguards provide, or how consistently across developers. We introduce the FAR.AI Minimal Standard for Safeguards, Version 1.0: a taxonomy of 67 readily accessible static jailbreak techniques, a method for composing them into a very large attack space, and a benchmark of flagship models against a sample of it. We evaluate Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Grok 4.5 on two complementary datasets totalling 360 attacker goals spanning chemical, biological, radiological/nuclear and explosive (CBRNE) threats and offensive cyber, using a three-stage funnel to identify universal jailbreaks: single prompt templates that elicit operationally compliant responses on over 75% of a domain's goals. We also introduce a cost-to-jailbreak metric that models attacker spend directly, with right-censored lower bounds where no universal jailbreak was found.
  Robustness is highly uneven: the cost to break these models varies over a hundredfold. Random search over our technique pool found 63 universal jailbreaks against Grok 4.5 and 18 against Gemini 3.1 Pro, at an average cost of roughly $58 and $278 per jailbreak found; expert-guided composition raised these to 385 and 231. Neither Claude Fable 5 nor GPT-5.6 Sol yielded any universal jailbreak under either strategy. Because meeting the Minimal Standard requires only defenses already publicly described and deployed in production elsewhere, these gaps appear closable with current techniques. We recommend defense-in-depth combining reasoning, activation, and input/output monitoring. Results are maintained at leaderboard.far.ai.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了FAR.AI防护措施最低标准V1.0，包含67种静态越狱技术、组合攻击空间和方法，以及针对Claude Fable 5、GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.1 Pro和Grok 4.5四个旗舰模型的基准评估。通过三阶段漏斗在360个CBRNE及网络攻击目标中寻找通用越狱，并引入"越狱成本"直接建模攻击者花费。结果显示鲁棒性极不均匀：Grok 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro分别被发现63和18个通用越狱（成本分别约$58和$278），而Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol在两种策略下均未产生任何通用越狱。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型开发者日益依赖分层防护措施来防止灾难性滥用，但关于这些防护措施实际提供多少保护、以及各开发者之间的一致性，公开证据极为有限。本文旨在填补这一实证空白，建立可复现的越狱评估标准。
AI.method: 提出FAR.AI防护措施最低标准V1.0：(1) 67种易获取的静态越狱技术分类体系；(2) 将这些技术组合成大规模攻击空间的方法；(3) 基于样本的旗舰模型基准。采用三阶段漏斗识别通用越狱（在超过75%领域目标上引发操作性合规回应的单一提示模板），并设计成本到越狱（cost-to-jailbreak）指标直接建模攻击者花费，对未发现通用越狱的情况使用右截尾下限。
AI.result: 模型鲁棒性差异超过百倍。随机搜索在Grok 4.5上发现63个通用越狱（平均成本约$58/个），在Gemini 3.1 Pro上发现18个（约$278/个）；专家引导组合分别提升至385和231个。Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol在两种策略下均未产生任何通用越狱。由于满足最低标准仅需已在其他生产中公开部署的防御措施，这些防线的差距被认为可以用现有技术填补。
AI.conclusion: 建议采用结合推理、激活和输入/输出监控的纵深防御策略。研究结论表明前沿模型的越狱防护存在显著不平衡，但差距可以通过现有防御技术弥补。结果在leaderboard.far.ai持续维护更新。

title: Global Graph-Validated Optimization for VLM-based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: We study open-vocabulary 3D indoor layout generation, which synthesizes diverse and physically plausible scenes from unlabeled 3D assets using free-form language instructions. Recent methods leverage large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) to generate structured scenes from text. However, most model inter-asset relations implicitly or rely on local pairwise constraints and local optimization. These formulations are poorly aligned with the global, highly non-convex layout space, often yielding locally plausible yet globally inconsistent or physically infeasible scenes. We address this problem with a graph-based intermediate representation that separates semantic coherence from physical feasibility, together with a hybrid search-and-refinement strategy. First, Global Semantic Verification (GSV) represents scenes as structured graphs and enforces semantic constraints through rule-based verification. This explicit validation removes contradictory configurations and produces a globally consistent semantic scaffold. Second, Global Physical Feasibility Search (GPFS) combines evolutionary search for global exploration with gradient-based refinement for local exploitation. It reduces dependence on VLM-proposed initialization and improves robustness in non-convex and discontinuous feasible spaces. Together, GSV and GPFS move layout generation beyond local relational modeling and initialization-sensitive optimization toward globally consistent reasoning and search. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary 3D indoor layout generation, improving both semantic consistency and physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种开放词汇3D室内布局生成方法，通过图结构中间表示分离语义一致性与物理可行性，结合全局语义验证（GSV）和全局物理可行性搜索（GPFS）的混合搜索-优化策略，在语义一致性和物理合理性上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖LLM/VLM隐式建模资产间关系，或仅使用局部成对约束和局部优化，与全局、高度非凸的布局空间不对齐，导致生成场景虽局部合理但全局不一致或物理上不可行。
AI.method: 提出图结构中间表示将语义一致性与物理可行性解耦。1) 全局语义验证（GSV）将场景表示为结构化图，通过基于规则的验证强制执行语义约束，消除矛盾配置，生成全局一致的语义脚手架。2) 全局物理可行性搜索（GPFS）结合进化搜索进行全局探索和梯度细化进行局部开发，减少对VLM初始化提案的依赖，提高在非凸和不连续可行空间中的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在开放词汇3D室内布局生成上达到SOTA，同时在语义一致性和物理合理性两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: GSV和GPFS将布局生成从局部关系建模和初始化敏感的优化推向全局一致推理与搜索，有效解决了全局布局空间中的非凸优化难题。

title: PLS-Calib: A Partial Least Squares Framework for Event Camera and Odometry Calibration under Ground Motion Constraints
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Accurate extrinsic rotation calibration between sensors is fundamental to the performance of robotic perception systems. However, most existing calibration techniques rely on full 6-DoF motion to excite all degrees of freedom, which is often infeasible for ground-constrained robots with limited motion capabilities. Recent approaches designed for such restricted settings, such as Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)-based methods, suffer from ill-conditioned covariance matrices that lead to numerical instability and suboptimal calibration accuracy. To overcome these limitations, we present a novel rotation calibration framework named PLS-Calib that, for the first time, leverages Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression to model the latent kinematic correlations between asynchronous, heterogeneous sensor streams. Specifically, we apply our method to the calibration of an event camera and an odometry onboard a ground robot. To improve event-based pattern detection, we introduce a polarity-aware event representation, which enhances spatiotemporal contrast in circular calibration targets. Our PLS-based formulation yields a closed-form, stable solution that avoids matrix singularities inherent in CCA-based approaches. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating significant improvements in calibration robustness and accuracy over state-of-the-art methods. This work offers a practical and theoretically grounded solution for rotation calibration in constrained robotic systems and opens up new directions for applying statistical learning techniques in neuromorphic vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PLS-Calib，首次利用偏最小二乘（PLS）回归来校准地面受限机器人的事件相机与里程计之间的外参旋转，解决了CCA方法中协方差矩阵病态导致的数值不稳定问题，并通过极性感知的事件表示提升圆形标定目标的时空对比度。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实数据集上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大多数外参旋转标定方法依赖6自由度完整运动来激发所有自由度，但地面受限机器人无法满足这一要求。现有针对该场景的CCA方法存在协方差矩阵病态导致的数值不稳定和标定精度不佳的问题，亟需一种在受限运动条件下仍能稳定、准确标定传感器间旋转的方法。
AI.method: PLS-Calib框架利用偏最小二乘（PLS）回归建模异步异构传感器流之间的潜在运动学相关性，提供闭式稳定解，规避CCA方法中的矩阵奇异性问题；同时引入极性感知事件表示，增强事件相机在圆形标定目标上的时空对比度，提升特征检测性能。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性，相比现有最先进方法，在标定鲁棒性和精度上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: PLS-Calib为受限机器人系统提供了一种实用且理论扎实的旋转标定解决方案，并为统计学习技术在神经形态视觉中的应用开辟了新方向。

title: PI-Mem: Pushing Long-Context Reasoning to 3.6M Tokens with Parallel-Iterative Memory
summary: Long-context reasoning remains a critical bottleneck for large language models, as recent recurrent-memory approaches face two inherent challenges: sequential chunk-wise updates can overwrite early critical evidence with later irrelevant content, and serial inter-chunk dependencies limit parallelism and cause latency to increase with context length. To address these issues, we propose PI-Mem (Parallel-Iterative Memory), a mechanism that processes all chunks in parallel and iteratively refines a shared memory over a bounded number of turns. In each turn, PI-Mem reads all chunks in parallel conditioned on the current memory, selects new or complementary evidence from each chunk, and merges the selected evidence into a compact shared memory for the next turn. To discourage redundant turns, we optimize the workflow through reinforcement learning with an auxiliary turn-efficiency reward, enabling the model to adaptively exit once sufficient evidence has been accumulated. We evaluate PI-Mem with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen2.5-7B on the HotpotQA benchmark across context lengths up to 3.6 million tokens and find that it outperforms the recurrent-memory baseline by +6.25 and +7.81 absolute points while achieving 6.1$\times$ and 2.1$\times$ inference speedups, respectively. These results demonstrate that PI-Mem breaks the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in long-context reasoning and provides a scalable approach to complex multi-hop question answering over extremely long documents.

AI.tldr: PI-Mem是一种并行迭代记忆机制，通过并行处理所有块并迭代精炼共享记忆，解决长上下文推理中顺序块更新覆盖早期证据和串行依赖导致的延迟问题，在HotpotQA基准上相比递归记忆基线提升准确率的同时实现6.1倍和2.1倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理是大型语言模型的关键瓶颈。现有递归记忆方法存在两个固有挑战：(1) 顺序块级更新可能用后续无关内容覆盖早期关键证据；(2) 块间串行依赖限制了并行性，延迟随上下文长度增长而增加。
AI.method: PI-Mem (Parallel-Iterative Memory) 在每一轮中并行读取所有块（基于当前记忆状态），从每个块中选择新的或互补的证据，并合并到紧凑的共享记忆中用于下一轮。通过强化学习优化整个工作流，引入辅助的回合效率奖励（turn-efficiency reward）来抑制冗余回合，使模型在积累足够证据后自适应退出。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B和Qwen2.5-7B上，在HotpotQA基准（上下文长度高达360万token）上，相比递归记忆基线分别提升+6.25和+7.81绝对准确率点，同时分别实现6.1倍和2.1倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: PI-Mem打破了长上下文推理中准确率与效率之间的权衡困境，为超长文档的复杂多跳问答提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title: Robust Counterfactual Policy Optimisation via Nondeterministic Causal Models
comment: Accepted at UAI 2026 Workshop on Causality for Decision Making
summary: Counterfactual inference approaches for sequential decision-making typically assume deterministic causal models, where all randomness stems from latent variables. However, Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are inherently stochastic. We address this by formalising counterfactual policy optimisation under probabilistic nondeterministic causal models, which properly separates latent confounding from irreducible stochasticity, and here propose a first practical optimisation problem for identifying robust counterfactual policies under a sensitivity analysis framework. We validate our approach on a sepsis treatment simulator, where diabetes status acts as a hidden global confounder.

AI.tldr: 本文正式提出概率非确定性因果模型下的反事实策略优化问题，将潜在混淆与不可约随机性分离，并在敏感性分析框架下识别鲁棒反事实策略，最终在败血症治疗模拟器中验证（糖尿病状态作为隐藏全局混杂因子）。
AI.motivation: 现有序列决策的反事实推断方法通常假设确定性因果模型，所有随机性来源于潜在变量。然而马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）本质上是随机的，这种假设与现实不符，需要一种能将潜在混淆与固有随机性正确分离的形式化方法。
AI.method: 在概率非确定性因果模型下形式化反事实策略优化，将潜在混杂与不可约随机性明确分离；提出在敏感性分析框架下的首个实用优化问题，用于识别鲁棒反事实策略。
AI.result: 在败血症治疗模拟器上进行验证，其中糖尿病状态作为隐藏的全局混杂因子，验证了所提方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法弥补了现有反事实推断在随机MDP场景下的空白，通过敏感性分析框架提高了反事实策略的鲁棒性，为带潜在混杂的随机序列决策问题提供了可行方案。

title: Don't Peek at the Answer: Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization for Label-Free RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning but typically relies on ground-truth (GT) answers, limiting scalability. Voting-based label-free RLVR replace gold supervision with answer-level consensus from model samples. However, collapse arises when the same answer-level signal is used both to estimate rewards and to drive token-level policy optimization, encouraging the model to directly reinforce answer tokens rather than improve reasoning. We propose OM-GRPO, a label-free RLVR framework that decouples reward estimation from policy optimization. OM-GRPO masks gradients on the answer span while retaining answer-level rewards through a soft consensus signal, shifting optimization pressure away from answer tokens. We further introduce Contrast-Augmented Reward, which refines reward estimation via low-cost pairwise comparisons over existing trajectories without additional rollouts. Across diverse reasoning benchmarks and three LLM backbones, OM-GRPO consistently outperforms existing label-free RLVR methods and matches supervised GT-reward training with stable optimization. This stability is particularly beneficial in the Test-Time Training setting, where OM-GRPO surpasses majority voting by 4.24 points.

AI.tldr: OM-GRPO是一种无标签RLVR框架，通过解耦奖励估计与策略优化（在答案span上掩码梯度），并提出对比增强奖励（Contrast-Augmented Reward），在多个推理基准和三种LLM骨干上超越现有无标签RLVR方法，甚至匹配有监督GT奖励训练的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能提升LLM推理能力，但通常依赖真实答案（GT）作为监督信号，这限制了其可扩展性。投票式的无标签RLVR虽然用模型样本的答案级共识替代了金标监督，但存在一个问题：当同一个答案级信号同时用于奖励估计和token级策略优化时，会直接强化答案token而非改善推理过程，导致模型崩溃（collapse）。因此需要一种将奖励估计与策略优化解耦的框架。
AI.method: 提出OM-GRPO框架，核心包括两个创新：(1) 解耦机制——在答案span上掩码梯度，同时通过软共识信号保留答案级奖励，从而将优化压力从答案token转移到推理过程；(2) Contrast-Augmented Reward——利用低成本的成对比较来精炼奖励估计，无需额外的rollout生成。
AI.result: 在多个多样化的推理基准和三种LLM骨干上，OM-GRPO一致优于现有的无标签RLVR方法，并且在性能上匹配有监督GT奖励训练，同时保持稳定的优化过程。在Test-Time Training设置下，OM-GRPO相比多数投票方法提升了4.24个点。
AI.conclusion: OM-GRPO有效解决了无标签RLVR中答案级信号导致的崩溃问题，通过解耦奖励估计与策略优化实现了稳定且高性能的推理能力提升，尤其在不依赖GT答案的场景（如Test-Time Training）中展现出显著优势。

title: DHMark: Public-Key Watermarking for LLM-Generated Text via Diffie-Hellman-Guided Rejection Sampling
summary: Large language model (LLM) watermarking provides an important mechanism for tracing the provenance of generated text. Existing statistical watermarks are often effective and robust, but most of them rely on private detection keys, which centralizes verification and complicates public auditing. Recent public or publicly verifiable watermarking schemes improve key management, yet many of them rely on exact recovery of embedded cryptographic strings, making them fragile under token edits, truncation, copy-paste, and low-entropy generation. This paper introduces DHMark, a public-key watermarking framework for LLM-generated text. The key idea is to separate payload authorization from noisy textual evidence. An issuer signs a short registry payload bound to a public context, and the payload is expanded into many one-bit equations. During generation, a Diffie-Hellman-guided token-labeling interface assigns each candidate token a public equation vote, and the sampler softly or selectively promotes candidates whose votes agree with the authorized payload. During verification, third-party verifiers use public information to extract token votes, aggregate them into equation-level evidence, and score only signed registry records. This design avoids exact recovery of a long embedded signature and instead treats watermark detection as registry-aided statistical evidence aggregation. We formalize the public-verification setting, analyze label pseudorandomness, registry-backed soundness, and sampling distortion, and evaluate a prototype under truncation, substitution, copy-paste, wrong-context, and plain-generation attacks. In the default 32-bit configuration, DHMark maintains at least a 0.967 valid rate across eight edit conditions while yielding a 0.000 acceptance rate on three negative controls.

AI.tldr: DHMark是一个面向LLM生成文本的公钥水印框架，将载荷授权与噪声化文本证据分离，通过Diffie-Hellman引导的token标记接口将签名载荷扩展为多个单位方程投票，验证时仅需聚合方程级证据并评分已注册记录，无需精确恢复嵌入的长签名。在默认32位配置下，八种编辑条件下至少保持0.967的有效率，三种负向控制下接受率为0.000。
AI.motivation: 现有统计水印依赖私有检测密钥，集中化验证并妨碍公开审计；而近期公钥水印方案依赖精确恢复嵌入的加密字符串，在token编辑、截断、复制粘贴和低熵生成等场景下表现脆弱。因此需要一个既支持公开验证又对文本扰动鲁棒的水印框架。
AI.method: DHMark将载荷授权与噪声化文本证据分离：发行者对绑定公共上下文的短注册载荷签名，并将载荷扩展为多个单位方程；生成阶段通过Diffie-Hellman引导的token标记接口为每个候选token分配公共方程投票，采样器软性或选择性地提升与授权载荷一致的候选；验证阶段第三方验证者利用公共信息提取token投票、聚合成方程级证据，仅对已注册的签名记录进行评分。该方法将水印检测建模为注册表辅助的统计证据聚合，避免了对长嵌入签名的精确恢复。
AI.result: 在默认32位配置下，DHMark在截断、替换、复制粘贴、错误上下文和普通生成等八种编辑条件下保持至少0.967的有效率，同时在三种负向控制下达到0.000的接受率。
AI.conclusion: DHMark通过分离载荷授权与文本证据、将检测视为注册表辅助的统计证据聚合，在保持公钥可验证性的同时显著增强了对各种编辑攻击的鲁棒性，为LLM文本溯源提供了一种兼顾安全性与实用性的公共验证方案。

title: LDU-Bench: Multimodal LLM Evaluation for Lithography Defect Understanding under Layout-Varying Circuit Backgrounds
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, and 5 tables, including appendices
summary: Multimodal large language models have demonstrated strong defect recognition capability in industrial anomaly detection. However, in lithography review, merely determining whether an image contains a defect is insufficient for engineering inspection; models must also understand defect morphology, spatial location, and the potential causes supported by visible evidence.
