AI.method: 提出五种非排他性语言功能角色（Specification、Embodied Representation、Action Orchestration、Grounding Regulation、Execution Coupling），为每种角色追踪从语言内容到具身消费者的路径，并识别可检验该声明责任的观测或干预措施。以角色声明而非架构作为比较单元，逐项评估语言贡献的实证支持。
AI.result: 应用该框架审阅文献后发现，功能使用与证据支持之间存在持续差距：可解释或修订的语言中间变量可能不正确、未被使用或无法影响后续行为；即使动作直接以语言为条件，系统级成功也无法单独隔离语言的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 按声明逐项评估接地性，允许在不过度外推结论的前提下比较模块化与端到端的具身智能体。

title: ATFlash: Per-RoPE-Wavelength Attention Windows for Compute/Memory-Efficient LLM Inference
summary: The attention score with rotary position embeddings (RoPE) decomposes exactly into a sum over its 2D-rotation frequency pairs, and each pair's wavelength limits how far it can discriminate position. Aligned with this structure, we propose the per-RoPE-wavelength distance window: it prunes the query--key inner-product terms beyond a wavelength-proportional distance. Unlike a sliding window, every key remains reachable, at least through the low-frequency pairs. The reduction rate is input-independent, with a closed form logarithmic in the sequence length $N$, in contrast to dynamic-sparse methods like MInference. Such token-level selection is orthogonal to our frequency-level pruning. The window can therefore be applied on top of those methods. On Qwen2.5-0.5B and Llama-3.2-3B, the window prunes 37--48\% of the query--key inner-product terms within each model's native context length. Relative to full attention, the top-1 match rate stays at 96--98\% and the mean output-distribution KL at the $10^{-3}$-nat level on LongBench-v2 contexts. We examine absolute scores on long-context benchmarks such as RULER, OpenAI-MRCR, LongCodeQA, and $\infty$Bench: they are broadly preserved. We implement the window as a slice of the query--key contraction axis, leaving the online-softmax recurrences untouched, and port it with minimal diffs into the released FlashAttention-4 prefill and FlashInfer decode. On RTX PRO 6000 with Llama, both ports outpace stock with gains growing with context length, up to $1.29\times$ at 128K. End to end on Qwen2.5-7B-1M, with 57\% of the inner-product terms pruned, the speedup reaches $1.31\times$ at a 1M-token context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于RoPE波长分解的注意力剪枝窗口（per-RoPE-wavelength distance window），按波长比例距离剪除query-key内积项，保留所有key可达性，剪枝率呈序列长度的对数闭式，并在FlashAttention-4和FlashInfer中实现，最高获得1.31倍加速。
AI.motivation: RoPE的注意力分数可精确分解为2D旋转频率对之和，每个频率对的波长限制了其位置判别距离。现有滑动窗口会切断远距离key的访问，动态稀疏方法（如MInference）剪枝率依赖输入且不可预测。作者希望利用RoPE的结构特性，实现输入无关、可预测的剪枝。
AI.method: 利用RoPE注意力分数分解为各频率对贡献之和的结构，提出per-RoPE-wavelength距离窗口：对每个频率对，按波长比例的距离阈值剪除查询-键内积项。低频率对波长长，可覆盖远距离key，因此所有key至少通过低频对保持可达。该token级选择与已有的频率级剪枝正交，可叠加使用。剪枝率有输入无关的闭式，对序列长度N呈对数增长。实现上将窗口作为query-key收缩轴的一个切片，不修改online-softmax递推，移植到FlashAttention-4 prefill与FlashInfer decode。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-0.5B和Llama-3.2-3B上，原生上下文长度内剪除37%-48%的query-key内积项；top-1匹配率保持96%-98%，输出分布KL均值在10^-3 nat量级。在RULER、OpenAI-MRCR、LongCodeQA和∞Bench长上下文基准上分数基本保持。在RTX PRO 6000上，Llama实现相比stock版本最高1.29倍加速（128K上下文）；Qwen2.5-7B-1M端到端剪除57%内积项，1M上下文达1.31倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了RoPE频率分解结构可用于设计高效的注意力剪枝策略，兼具可预测的剪枝率、所有key可达性以及与现有稀疏方法正交的组合性，在实际硬件上实现了显著且随上下文长度增长的加速效果。

title: Surrogate Substitution Preserves PHI Detectability: A Multi-Detector Equivalence Study
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code, data, and interactive dashboard: https://custodianai.pages.dev ; repository: https://github.com/Custodian-Labs/guardian-layer-phi-benchmark
summary: Structure-preserving de-identification replaces protected health information (PHI) with realistic same-type surrogates -- "Anna S." becomes "Maria S.", not [NAME] -- so that clinical text stays fluent and downstream tools keep working. But this only helps if the substitution does not itself corrupt the signal those tools rely on. We ask a narrow, testable question: on the spans a de-identifier actually masks, can downstream PHI detectors still find the surrogate? We introduce a paired, multi-detector evaluation protocol that (i) scores utility only on masked spans, decoupling coverage from utility; (ii) uses equivalence testing (TOST) rather than null-hypothesis significance testing, which is uninformative at our sample size (57k paired spans); and (iii) builds a surrogate-failure typology separating fixable generator defects from intrinsic detector limits. Across 11 detectors, 7 benchmarks, and 7 languages (1,750 documents), recall on masked spans moves from 76.1% to 74.9% -- a change our equivalence test shows is statistically equivalent to zero within a +/-2-point margin (p ~ 3e-9), with detector ranking preserved. The residual loss does not reflect detectors getting worse at PHI: it concentrates in malformed and out-of-distribution surrogates (truncation Chicago -> Illino, salience loss Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant). A redaction floor and an open-source surrogate baseline indicate the effect is a property of well-formed substitution, not of one tool. We release the evaluation subsets, scoring code, and an interactive dashboard at https://custodianai.pages.dev so the protocol can audit any structure-preserving transform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种保持结构去标识化（structure-preserving de-identification）的多检测器评估协议，通过在掩码跨度上仅评估效用、使用等价检验（TOST）代替NHST，并构建替代失败类型学，在11个检测器、7个基准、7种语言、1750篇文档上验证了真实替代（如"Anna S."→"Maria S."）不会显著破坏下游PHI检测信号（掩码跨度召回率从76.1%到74.9%，统计等价于零，p≈3e-9），残余损失主要集中于畸形成果（如截断"Chicago"→"Illino"）和分布外替代（如显著性丢失"Cedars-Sinai"→"Vidant"）。
AI.motivation: 保持结构去标识化用同类型逼真替代词替换受保护健康信息（PHI），以保持临床文本流畅性和下游工具可用性。但关键在于：这种替代本身是否会被下游PHI检测器重新识别为PHI？现有评估方法存在两个问题：(1) 效用评估覆盖了未掩码跨度，混淆了覆盖率与效用；(2) 在大样本（57k配对的跨度）下使用传统的零假设显著性检验没有意义。因此需要一个更严谨、可推广的评估协议。
AI.method: 提出配对多检测器评估协议，包含三个关键设计：(i) 仅在掩码跨度上评分效用，将覆盖率与效用解耦；(ii) 使用等价检验（TOST, two one-sided tests）而非NHST，用于在57k配对跨度的大样本量下验证效应是否统计等价于零；(iii) 构建替代失败类型学，区分可修复的生成器缺陷与内在的检测器局限性。实验覆盖11个检测器、7个基准、7种语言，共1750篇文档。
AI.result: 掩码跨度上的召回率从76.1%降至74.9%，等价检验显示该变化在±2个百分点范围内统计等价于零（p≈3e-9），且检测器排名保持不变。残余损失并非检测器对PHI能力的下降，而是集中在两类surrogates：畸形替代（如截断导致"Chicago"→"Illino"）和分布外替代（如显著性丢失"Cedars-Sinai"→"Vidant"）。消融实验（redaction floor）和开源baseline表明该效应是结构良好的替代的固有性质，而非单一工具的问题。
AI.conclusion: 该协议验证了结构保持去标识化在PHI检测场景下不会损坏下游工具依赖的信号，残余损失可归因于具体的生成器缺陷而非检测器能力退化。作者发布了评估子集、评分代码和交互式仪表盘，使该协议可被用于审计任何结构保持变换，为去标识化技术的可靠评估提供了可复用的方法论框架。

title: Test-time reasoning effort and unauthorized tool use in language-model agents: a prespecified equivalence study
summary: Language-model agents that execute multi-step workflows through tool calls operate under access-control policies that restrict which operations each role may perform. The APIs serving these agents expose a reasoning-effort parameter that operators adjust for cost and latency. Whether this parameter also changes the rate of unauthorized tool use has not been tested by direct manipulation within a single model. We vary reasoning effort (low, max) inside GPT-5.6 across the 14 confirmatory scenarios of TRIO-20, a suite of 20 matched workplace triads in which a policy-prohibited tool call is effective and its effect on the target metric is stated in the environment, effective but discoverable only through rule inspection, or ineffective. The three conditions derive from one code base and differ in two configuration fields, with identical prompts and tool sets. All analyses were prespecified in a frozen plan before confirmatory collection. Across 840 trajectories and two model tiers, no unauthorized tool call occurred. Exact one-sided 95% limits place each arm's violation rate below 3.50% (Terra, n = 84) and 5.21% (Sol, n = 56). The interaction estimand, with a simultaneous exact 95% interval of $\pm 4.34$ percentage points on Terra, lies inside the $\pm 7.01$-point equivalence margin. Raising effort did change behaviour, but only in inspection: rule-probe rates rose in all conditions, most where probing carried no instrumental payoff, a pattern inconsistent with the hypothesis of targeted search ($-14.3$ points, 95% CI $-27.4$ to $+1.2$). Raw trajectories are released at https://github.com/WenJing95/trio-20.

AI.tldr: 本文在GPT-5.6的两个模型层级上，通过TRIO-20套件中的14个确认性场景，直接操纵推理努力参数（低/最大）来检验其对工具调用违反访问控制策略比率的影响。在840条轨迹中未观察到任何违规调用，精确95%单侧上限将各臂违规率限制在3.50%以下（Terra层）和5.21%以下（Sol层），且推理努力对违规率的交互效应落在等效边界内，表明提高推理努力不会增加违规工具使用率。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体通过工具调用执行多步工作流时受访问控制策略约束，而API暴露的推理努力参数会被操作者调整以控制成本与延迟。关键问题是：这一参数是否会同时改变未经授权的工具使用率？此前尚未在单一模型内通过直接操纵来检验该问题。
AI.method: 使用TRIO-20套件中的14个确认性工作场所三合一（triad）场景，在GPT-5.6上操纵推理努力（低/最大）两个层级，覆盖三种条件：策略禁止的工具调用有效且效果在环境中明确陈述、有效但仅可通过规则检查发现、以及无效。三种条件源自同一代码库，仅有两个配置字段不同，提示和工具集完全一致。所有分析在收集前以冻结计划预注册。共收集840条轨迹，覆盖Terra和Sol两个模型层级。
AI.result: 在所有840条轨迹中未发生任何未经授权的工具调用。精确单侧95%上限显示各臂违规率低于3.50%（Terra，n=84）和5.21%（Sol，n=56）。交互估计量在Terra上的同时精确95%区间为±4.34个百分点，落在±7.01个百分点的等效边界内。提高推理努力仅在检查行为上产生变化：规则探查率在所有条件下上升，且在探查无工具性回报时上升最明显，与定向搜索假设不一致（差异为-14.3点，95% CI -27.4至+1.2）。
AI.conclusion: 提高推理努力不会增加语言模型智能体的未授权工具调用率，即使在策略禁止但对目标指标有效的工具调用场景下也如此。推理努力的变化主要影响规则的主动探查行为而非违规行为，且该模式不支持"定向搜索违规工具"的假设。原始轨迹数据已公开在GitHub。

title: FaithIR: Rethinking Infrared Image Super-Resolution from Perceptual Sharpness to Task Relevant Fidelity
comment: 14 pages: 7 pages of main text, 2 pages of references, and 5 pages of supplementary material
summary: Infrared image super-resolution (IISR) is important for downstream tasks such as object detection and semantic segmentation. Existing IISR methods often produce artificial textures, over-sharpened edges, and spurious high-frequency details that distort authentic thermal structures and semantic information. To address this issue, we propose FaithIR, a faithful infrared super-resolution framework for reliable machine perception. FaithIR consists of a patch-level conditioning branch that captures global thermal and structural information and a pixel-level restoration branch that performs dense local reconstruction under structural guidance. The entire restoration process is performed directly in the pixel domain to preserve infrared-specific structures and task-relevant information. Extensive experiments on FLIR-IISR, M3FD, and FMB demonstrate strong reconstruction fidelity, cross-dataset generalization, and superior performance in object detection and semantic segmentation. These results show that demonstrate that preserving faithful infrared structure preservations is more important for reliable machine perception than merely pursuing perceptual sharpness alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FaithIR，一种忠实红外图像超分辨率框架，通过补丁级条件分支捕获全局热/结构信息，像素级复原分支在结构引导下进行局部重建，在像素域中直接执行复原以保留红外特有结构，在FLIR-IISR、M3FD和FMB数据集上取得优于现有方法的重建保真度和跨数据集泛化能力，并在下游目标检测与语义分割任务中表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有红外图像超分辨率方法常产生人工纹理、过度锐化边缘和虚假高频细节，扭曲了真实热结构和语义信息，影响下游感知任务的可靠性。作者希望解决生成结果失真问题，强调忠实保留红外结构比单纯追求感知锐度更重要。
AI.method: FaithIR包含两个分支：补丁级条件分支用于捕获全局热力学和结构信息；像素级复原分支用于在结构引导下进行稠密局部重建。整个复原过程直接在像素域中执行，以保留红外特有结构和任务相关信息。
AI.result: 在FLIR-IISR、M3FD和FMB三个数据集上的大量实验表明，FaithIR在重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力以及目标检测和语义分割下游任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 忠实保留红外结构对可靠机器感知比单纯追求感知锐度更重要，FaithIR验证了该观点并提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Pivot-Centric Trajectory Prediction: Bridging Long Horizons via Dynamical Guidance
comment: Spatiotemporal Forecasting, Autonomous Driving, Trajectory Prediction
summary: Forecasting precise future motion of surrounding agents is essential for reliable autonomous vehicles. However, as the demand for longer prediction horizons increases, existing endpoint-completion or iterative-refine methods increasingly struggle with weak guidance and compounding errors. To tackle the long-horizon prediction challenge, we propose Pivot-Centric Trajectory Prediction (PCTP). By introducing ``pivots'' and focusing on predicting pivot points along extended trajectories, we divide the long-term prediction task into short-term sub-tasks at various scales. Specifically, PCTP decouples the long-term trajectory predicting process into two processes: pivot prediction and pivot-based trajectory refinement. The pivot prediction process aims to utilize global map context and agent-to-agent interactions to identify these ``pivot points'', while the pivot-based trajectory refinement process focuses on local map details and refines the short-term trajectory based on predicted ``pivot points''. Compared with existing methods, PCTP provides more intermediate guidance while reducing compounding errors. Moreover, PCTP is a flexible approach that can be integrated into most state-of-the-art trajectory prediction models. Experimental results show that PCTP improves the prediction accuracy of leading models on both Argoverse I and Argoverse II datasets with minimal impact on model size. Specifically, PCTP combined with QCNet outperforms all published ensemble-free methods on the Argoverse II leaderboard at submission.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCTP（Pivot-Centric Trajectory Prediction）方法，通过引入"枢轴点"将长时程轨迹预测分解为不同尺度的短时程子任务，以应对长预测视野下现有方法存在的弱引导和误差累积问题。PCTP将预测过程解耦为枢轴预测和基于枢轴的轨迹细化两个过程，可灵活集成到大多数SOTA轨迹预测模型中，并在Argoverse I和Argoverse II数据集上显著提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 随着预测时程增长，现有的端点补全（endpoint-completion）和迭代细化（iterative-refine）方法面临两大挑战：一是缺乏足够的中间引导导致预测弱化，二是误差累积问题加剧。长时程预测需要在保持精度的同时提供更多中间监督信息，以克服这些瓶颈。
AI.method: PCTP将长时程轨迹预测解耦为两个过程：(1) 枢轴预测过程——利用全局地图上下文和智能体间交互来识别轨迹沿程的"枢轴点"；(2) 基于枢轴的轨迹细化过程——聚焦局部地图细节，根据预测的枢轴点细化各段的短时程轨迹。通过这种方式，将长时程任务分解为不同尺度的短时程子任务，提供更多中间引导并减少误差累积。
AI.result: 在Argoverse I和Argoverse II数据集上的实验表明，PCTP在几乎不增加模型规模的情况下提升了多个领先轨迹预测模型的精度。其中，PCTP结合QCNet在Argoverse II排行榜上超越了所有已发布的非集成方法。
AI.conclusion: PCTP通过枢轴点机制有效解决了长时程轨迹预测中的弱引导和误差累积问题，且具有高度的通用性和灵活性，可作为一种即插即用的增强模块集成到现有SOTA模型中，为长时程预测提供了新的范式。

title: HomoEnsNER: Does Language Alignment Outperform Architectural Complexity in Gujarati Named Entity Recognition?
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for Gujarati remains underexplored, hindered by the absence of capitalization cues, rich morphology, lexical ambiguity, and free word order. Prior ensemble work has emphasized architectural diversity by combining heterogeneous classifiers, multilingual encoders, or classical sequence models, rather than exploiting language-aligned monolingual pretraining. This study asks whether, for a low-resource, morphologically rich language like Gujarati, a homogeneous ensemble of a single monolingual encoder outperforms such architectural diversity. We propose HomoEnsNER, a homogeneous ensemble of five independently fine-tuned GujaratiBERT models combined via majority voting, evaluated against a single GujaratiBERT baseline and six heterogeneous alternatives, including combinations with MuRIL-base, MuRIL-large, IndicBERT, mBERT, BiLSTM, CRF, and a stacked BiLSTM-CRF-GujaratiBERT architecture. All eight models were trained under a consistent budget and evaluated using entity-level F1 on the Naamapadam Gujarati test split. HomoEnsNER achieved the highest F1 (0.8442), surpassing the baseline (0.8347) and every heterogeneous alternative (lowest: 0.7855), indicating that language alignment is a more effective, budget-conscious ensembling strategy than architectural complexity for low-resource Indian language NER.

AI.tldr: 针对古吉拉特语这一低资源、形态丰富的语言，本文提出HomoEnsNER——一个由五个独立微调的GujaratiBERT模型同构集成（多数投票）的命名实体识别系统，在Naamapadam古吉拉特语测试集上取得0.8442的实体级F1，优于单一GujaratiBERT基线（0.8347）及所有六种异构集成方案（最低0.7855），证明语言对齐的同构集成为低资源印度语NER提供了比架构多样性更高效且预算友好的策略。
AI.motivation: 古吉拉特语NER研究不足，受限于缺乏大小写线索、丰富的形态学、词汇歧义和自由语序等挑战。以往集成工作强调架构多样性（结合异构分类器、多语言编码器或经典序列模型），而非利用语言对齐的单语预训练。本文探究在低资源、形态丰富的语言（如古吉拉特语）中，单一单语编码器的同构集成是否优于此类架构多样性。
AI.method: 提出HomoEnsNER，即五个独立微调的GujaratiBERT模型通过多数投票组成的同构集成。在统一训练预算下，将其与单一GujaratiBERT基线及六种异构替代方案（包括与MuRIL-base、MuRIL-large、IndicBERT、mBERT、BiLSTM、CRF及堆叠式BiLSTM-CRF-GujaratiBERT架构的组合）进行对比评估，均以实体级F1在Naamapadam古吉拉特语测试集上衡量。
AI.result: HomoEnsNER取得最高F1（0.8442），超过基线（0.8347）和所有异构替代方案（最低0.7855），表明语言对齐是同构集成在低资源印度语NER中优于架构复杂性的关键因素，且更具预算意识。
AI.conclusion: 对于古吉拉特语等低资源、形态丰富的语言，语言对齐的单语预训练同构集成比架构多样性集成策略更有效且更经济实惠，为低资源印度语言NER的集成学习提供了新的方向。

title: Rubrics as Privileged Information for Open-Ended Generation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a single model acts as both student and teacher with different contexts, has shown promise in verifiable domains like math, where hard privileged information (PI) in the form of ground-truth answers structurally constrains valid continuations. We extend OPSD to open-ended generation using soft PI in the form of rubrics that guide preferences but admit many valid responses. Rubrics have served as scalar rewards for reinforcement learning (RL); we show that they provide substantially richer signal as dense PI for distillation, and contrary to intuition, soft rubric PI provides a larger and more effective training signal on student roll-outs than hard reference completion PI in this regime. A reference completion is one point in a set of valid responses, so distilling towards it over-constrains the student, while rubrics specify the preference structure shared across the set of valid responses. We show the effectiveness of using rubrics as PI for open-ended generation across Qwen and Llama model families and show that it outperforms rubric-as-reward (RaR) RL using HealthBench, a benchmark that grades open-ended health responses against physician-created rubrics, providing dense token-level supervision for open-ended tasks; RuPI beats RaR RL by up to +0.10 absolute score and, under matched recipe and KL direction, beats reference-PI by +0.034 to +0.079 absolute score across three models. We further show that these findings generalize to training on the RubricHub Science corpus and evaluating on ResearchQA: soft rubric PI outperforms both reference-PI distillation and RaR RL (66.6% vs. 64.2% and 57.6%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出将on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)扩展至开放域生成任务，利用rubric形式的主观特权信息（soft PI）替代硬参考完成（reference completion）作为蒸馏信号。实验表明，soft rubric PI在多个模型（Qwen、Llama）上优于rubric作为奖励的强化学习（RaR RL）和基于参考完成的蒸馏，在HealthBench和ResearchQA等基准上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的OPSD在可验证数学领域表现良好，依赖硬PI（如真实答案）结构化约束生成。但开放域生成任务中不存在唯一正确答案，硬参考完成只是有效响应集合中的一个点，过度约束了学生模型。本文旨在将OPSD推广至开放域任务，利用rubric（评分标准/量规）作为软PI，既能引导偏好又允许多样性，解决参考完成蒸馏过约束的问题。
AI.method: 使用rubric作为密集特权信息（soft PI）用于自我蒸馏。与将rubric作为标量奖励用于RL（RaR）不同，RuPI将rubric作为逐token级别的稠密监督信号。在on-policy框架下，同一模型分别作为学生和教师（基于rubric上下文），通过rubric提供的偏好结构指导学生的roll-out。实验涉及Qwen和Llama模型家族，在HealthBench和RubricHub Science/RResearchQA数据集上验证。
AI.result: 1) RuPI在HealthBench上比RaR RL高出最多+0.10绝对分数；2) 在匹配配方和KL方向下，RuPI比reference-PI高+0.034至+0.079绝对分数（三个模型）；3) 在RubricHub Science/RResearchQA上，软rubric PI优于reference-PI蒸馏和RaR RL（66.6% vs 64.2%和57.6%）。
AI.conclusion: rubric作为软PI为开放域生成任务提供了比硬参考完成更丰富且有效的蒸馏信号。参考完成是有效响应集合中的一个点，蒸馏时过约束学生；而rubric编码了有效响应集合共享的偏好结构。soft rubric PI在多个基准和模型家族上一致优于rubric-as-reward RL和reference-PI蒸馏，证明了其在开放域生成中作为稠密监督信号的有效性。

title: Diversity is Not Ambiguity: Toward Accurate and Efficient Ambiguity Detection for Open-Domain QA
summary: How can question answering (QA) systems determine whether a query is ambiguous? Ambiguity detection is essential in open-domain QA, as misclassification leads to answering the wrong interpretation or unnecessary clarification. However, existing methods conflate answer diversity with ambiguity, leading to inaccurate predictions. They also process queries uniformly, resulting in wasteful computation. We propose ARCHIVE (Ambiguity Recognition via Cascaded Hypothesis Inspection and Conflict Verification), an accurate and efficient framework that detects ambiguity via logical conflict: a query is ambiguous when its valid answers cannot all be true under a single interpretation. ARCHIVE combines a lightweight early-exit encoder for surface-detectable cases with a conflict reasoning module that models logical relations among answers, reinforced by an invariance objective for robustness to noisy answer sets. We present QuireQA, a 4,703-query benchmark spanning factoid, non-factoid, and ill-formed queries. Experiments show ARCHIVE outperforms competitors, improving F1-amb by up to 10.4% and F1-unamb by up to 21.6%, while operating 16$\times$ faster than the best competitor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARCHIVE框架，通过逻辑冲突（而非答案多样性）来检测开放域问答中的歧义查询，并结合轻量级早退编码器和冲突推理模块实现高准确率与高效率。作者还构建了包含4,703条查询的QuireQA基准，实验显示ARCHIVE在F1-amb和F1-unamb上分别提升高达10.4%和21.6%，且比最强基线快16倍。
AI.motivation: 现有歧义检测方法将答案多样性与歧义混为一谈，导致预测不准确；同时对所有查询统一处理，计算浪费严重。作者旨在提出一种更准确且高效的歧义检测框架。
AI.method: ARCHIVE通过逻辑冲突定义歧义：当查询的有效答案无法在同一解释下同时为真时该查询即为歧义。框架包含两部分：(1) 轻量级早退编码器处理表面可直接检测的案例；(2) 冲突推理模块建模答案间的逻辑关系；并通过不变性目标增强对噪声答案集的鲁棒性。同时构建了QuireQA基准，涵盖事实型、非事实型和格式不当的查询。
AI.result: 实验表明，ARCHIVE在F1-amb上提升最高10.4%，在F1-unamb上提升最高21.6%，且运行速度比最强竞争方法快16倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过逻辑冲突检验替代简单的答案多样性统计，能够更准确地识别歧义查询，同时早退机制有效降低计算开销，验证了该框架在准确性和效率上的双重优势。

title: Attribute-based Undetectable Watermarking for Generative AI Models
summary:
Generative AI systems increasingly produce content whose provenance is difficult to verify, motivating watermarking techniques for identifying model-generated outputs. Existing cryptographic watermarking methods provide strong undetectability guarantees: without a detection key, watermarked outputs are computationally indistinguishable from unwatermarked ones. However, these approaches do not address the crucial deployment challenge of how to safely delegate detection capabilities. With an unrestricted detection key, a malicious detector may use the detection key beyond its intended scope, enabling watermark sanitization, scope abuse, and user profiling.
  To mitigate this safety concern, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first \emph{attribute-based watermarking} for generative AI models, providing fine-grained, policy-controlled watermark detection. In our approach, each generated output is associated with attributes, and each detection key is \emph{constrained by a policy} on potential attributes. A detection key can only be used to detect watermarked outputs whose attributes satisfy the corresponding policy, while watermarked outputs that fall outside the policy remain computationally indistinguishable from unwatermarked ones. We construct such an attribute-based watermarking scheme and formalize its security properties, including consistency, adaptive robustness to bounded corruptions, undetectability, and soundness, along with a security proof under standard cryptographic assumptions. Our construction integrates constrained pseudorandom functions, pseudorandom error-correcting codes, and randomness recovery procedures with generative AI models. Finally, we implement a prototype and an empirical evaluation, demonstrating that attribute-based watermarking is both effective and practical.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出了面向生成式AI模型的属性基水印（Attribute-Based Watermarking）方案，使得检测密钥受到策略约束，只能在满足指定属性条件的输出上执行水印检测，从而解决现有密码学水印在安全委派检测能力方面的部署难题。
AI.motivation: 现有密码学水印虽能提供强不可检测性保证，但未解决如何安全委派检测能力的关键问题。若将不受限的检测密钥交给不诚实的检测者，可能导致水印清洗、范围滥用和用户画像等恶意行为。
AI.method: 构建属性基水印方案，将约束伪随机函数（CPRF）、伪随机纠错码和随机性恢复过程整合到生成式AI模型中。每个生成输出关联属性，每个检测密钥受策略约束，密钥仅能检测符合对应策略的水印输出。形式化定义了安全性（一致性、自适应鲁棒性、不可检测性和可靠性），并在标准密码学假设下给出安全证明。
AI.result: 实现了原型系统并进行实证评估，证明属性基水印既有效又实用；同时提供了在标准密码学假设下的安全性证明。
AI.conclusion: 属性基水印为AI生成内容的检测能力委派提供了细粒度、策略可控的安全机制，在不牺牲强不可检测性的前提下解决了现有方法未覆盖的部署安全问题。

title: A Unified Resolution-Conditioned Framework for Orthogonal Line-Scanning Image Fusion
summary: Laser line-scanning microscopy enables fast volumetric imaging but produces anisotropic lateral resolution. Orthogonal line scans provide complementary directional information that can recover near-isotropic resolution, yet existing deep-learning methods require a separate model for each optical configuration. We present a unified, resolution-conditioned fusion framework based on Rank Enhanced Linear Attention (RELA). Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) conditions the network continuously on the resolving-power ratio, enabling one model to adapt across slit widths. We further introduce Adaptive RELA, which replaces fixed-kernel rank enhancement with ratio-conditioned multi-scale depthwise convolutions and uses a learnable attention temperature to adjust selectivity with degradation severity. Training data spanning multiple slit configurations are generated using a physics-grounded separable point-spread-function model verified against measured optical data at 48.3 dB accuracy. The resulting model achieves 34-40 dB PSNR across configurations, whereas unconditioned multi-slit training collapses to 24.3 dB and per-slit specialists lose 4-9 dB outside their training setting. It also generalizes smoothly to unseen intermediate configurations without interpolation artifacts. Ablations show that FiLM resolves configuration ambiguity, global linear attention captures long-range directional correspondences, and adaptive temperature yields an additional 2 dB in the challenging near-isotropic regime, where complementary signals are weak.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于秩增强线性注意力（RELA）的统一分辨率条件化融合框架，用于解决激光线扫描显微镜中各向异性分辨率问题。通过特征线性调制（FiLM）按分辨率比连续条件化网络，并引入自适应RELA模块（基于比例条件化多尺度深度卷积与可学习注意力温度），使单一模型能跨不同狭缝宽度（光学配置）泛化，实现近各向同性分辨率恢复。
AI.motivation: 激光线扫描显微镜可实现快速体积成像，但产生各向异性的横向分辨率。正交线扫描可提供互补方向信息以恢复近各向同性分辨率，但现有深度学习方法针对每种光学配置需单独训练模型，缺乏跨配置的泛化能力和统一解决方案。
AI.method: 1）提出基于秩增强线性注意力（RELA）的统一分辨率条件化融合框架；2）采用特征线性调制（FiLM）将分辨力比（resolving-power ratio）作为连续条件输入，使单一模型适应不同狭缝宽度；3）引入自适应RELA，用比例条件化的多尺度深度卷积替代固定核秩增强，并以可学习注意力温度调节选择性；4）基于物理可分离点扩散函数模型生成跨多种狭缝配置的训练数据，以48.3 dB精度验证。
AI.result: 模型在多种配置下达到34-40 dB PSNR，而无条件多狭缝训练降至24.3 dB，单配置专用模型在其训练设置之外损失4-9 dB。模型能平滑泛化至未见过的中间配置而无插值伪影。消融实验表明：FiLM解决配置歧义，全局线性注意力捕获长距离方向对应关系，自适应温度在信号较弱的近各向同性区域额外带来2 dB增益。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分辨率条件化统一框架能用一个模型处理多种光学配置，显著优于无条件训练和专用模型，并在未见配置上保持良好泛化能力，为线扫描显微图像的各向同性重建提供了高效统一的解决方案。

title: Tired Actor: Fatigue-Informed Character Control
summary: Replicating human behavior with physics simulation has been a long-expected goal in character animation. Existing efforts have achieved impressive performance in imitating a wide span of general motions. However, most existing efforts could still suffer from unnatural movements due to the lack of biomechanical and physiological priors. Given this, we project our sights to advances in behavioral energetics, which demonstrate how energy use shapes human movements. In contrast, current character controllers typically assume the character is equipped with infinite energy over time. Inspired by these, we propose to adopt fatigue as a proxy of the finite energy limit, inject it into general character animation, and thoroughly investigate how fatigue introduces new characteristics to physics-based character control. Leveraging the Three-Compartment Controller (3CC) model, we managed to obtain a policy for general motion imitation under different fatigue statuses. Furthermore, extensive analyses are conducted to demonstrate how fatigue could influence the naturalness, scalability, and robustness of character animation. Our code will be made public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将疲劳（fatigue）作为有限能量代理引入物理模拟的角色动画控制中，利用Three-Compartment Controller (3CC)模型实现不同疲劳状态下的通用动作模仿策略，并系统分析了疲劳对动画自然度、可扩展性和鲁棒性的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有物理模拟角色动画方法虽能模仿大量通用动作，但缺乏生物力学和生理学先验知识，导致动作不自然。此外，现有控制器通常假设角色拥有无限能量，这与真实人类行为中能量有限且疲劳会影响动作的事实不符。作者希望通过引入行为能量学（behavioral energetics）中能量使用塑造人类动作的观点，弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 作者将疲劳作为有限能量极限的代理（proxy）注入到通用角色动画中，利用Three-Compartment Controller (3CC)模型构建一个能够根据不同疲劳状态模仿通用动作的策略。3CC模型将能量系统分为三个隔室来模拟能量消耗和疲劳积累过程。
AI.result: 通过大量分析实验，论文展示了疲劳对物理模拟角色动画的自然度、可扩展性和鲁棒性的影响。实验表明引入疲劳能够使角色运动更接近真实人类行为，并改变了控制策略在不同状态下的表现特征。
AI.conclusion: 将疲劳作为有限能量代理引入物理模拟角色控制是可行且有效的，能够提升动画的自然度，并为此方向提供了新的研究范式。代码将开源以促进后续研究。

title: From SQL Errors to Concept Gaps: An AI-Powered Knowledge Graph Analytics Platform for Personalized Feedback
summary: This innovative practice full paper describes an AI-powered knowledge graph platform that connects SQL errors to conceptual gaps in undergraduate and graduate database systems courses. Students learning Structured Query Language (SQL) frequently struggle with semantic errors that reflect conceptual misunderstandings rather than syntax mistakes. A query may execute yet return incorrect results due to gaps spanning related concepts; misusing NATURAL JOIN in place of an explicit subquery reflects intertwined misunderstandings of JOIN, GROUP BY, and HAVING. Autograding systems detect correctness but provide surface-level feedback without connecting errors to the conceptual structure of the course. Educational knowledge graph research has shown the value of structured concept representations for curriculum analysis and adaptive learning, but these approaches have not been applied to diagnosing SQL misconceptions from student submissions. We present a platform that automatically extracts course concepts and relations from instructional materials, links them to student submission traces through a graph database, and classifies errors at the concept level. We evaluate the platform across two database systems courses at two universities, one using real student submissions and one using simulated submissions, through an expert study with five participants and an automated evaluation using an LLM as a judge. Results show that 95.7% of extracted nodes were rated as at least somewhat valid and 63.8% of triplets were rated fully correct. Expert feedback confirmed that the generated graphs align with instructor mental models and that mapping errors to course concepts provides actionable diagnostic insight; evaluating impact on student learning remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个AI驱动的知识图谱平台，将SQL错误自动关联到数据库系统课程中的概念缺口，帮助诊断学生错误背后的概念理解问题，而非仅提供表层语法反馈。
AI.motivation: 学生在学习SQL时常犯语义错误，这些错误反映的是概念理解缺失（如NATURAL JOIN误用可能同时涉及JOIN、GROUP BY和HAVING的概念纠缠），而非单纯的语法问题。现有自动评分系统只能检测正确性，无法将错误映射到课程的概念结构上，无法提供深层诊断性反馈。教育知识图谱研究虽已展示结构化概念表示的价值，但尚未应用于从学生提交中诊断SQL误解。
AI.method: 该平台自动从教学材料中提取课程概念及其关系，通过图数据库将概念与学生的提交轨迹进行关联，并在概念层面分类错误。评估在两所大学的两个数据库系统课程中进行，一个使用真实学生提交，一个使用模拟提交；评估方法包括五位专家的评审研究和以LLM作为评判者的自动化评估。
AI.result: 95.7%的提取节点被评为至少"有一定有效性"，63.8%的三元组被评定为完全正确。专家反馈确认生成的图谱与教师的心智模型一致，将错误映射到课程概念能够提供可操作的诊断洞见。
AI.conclusion: 该平台证明了从SQL学生提交中自动诊断概念层面错误的可行性，图谱与专家心智模型的对齐也验证了方法的有效性。但评估其对学生学习效果的实际影响仍是未来工作。

title: Schedule-Informed Temporal Fusion Forecasting of Hourly Airport Security-Checkpoint Throughput
summary: Checkpoint staffing requires accurate forecasts of when screening demand will occur, yet flight schedules record departure times rather than passenger arrival times at security checkpoints. This study develops a framework that converts known flight schedules into temporally aligned signals for forecasting hourly checkpoint throughput. Using 2023-2024 Transportation Security Administration throughput data and Cirium Diio flight schedules for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, domestic and international seat capacity was distributed across pre-departure hours using truncated Poisson kernels. A Temporal Fusion Transformer then combined these schedule-derived arrival-intensity signals with historical throughput, scheduled activity, and temporal variables. Models were trained chronologically, with July-December 2024 reserved for testing, and evaluated against recurrent neural network and long short-term memory models across five random seeds. For direct six-hour forecasts, the proposed model achieved a weighted mean absolute percentage error of 9.33%, compared with 12.16% for the recurrent neural network and 11.37% for long short-term memory, while also producing the lowest errors during peak periods. With six-hour recursive updates, errors remained between 10.60% and 11.04% across 24-96 hour horizons, although longer horizons contained fewer valid forecast origins. By transforming scheduled departures into interpretable pre-departure screening-load signals without requiring passenger-flight matching, the framework supports advance staffing, lane-opening, and multiday checkpoint planning. Because observed throughput reflects realized processing rather than unconstrained arrivals, the forecasts should be interpreted together with local staffing, capacity, queue, and wait-time information.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个将航班时刻表转化为安全检查站小时吞吐量预测信号的框架。利用截断泊松核将航班座位容量分配到起飞前各时段，并结合Temporal Fusion Transformer对2023-2024年亚特兰大机场的TSA吞吐量数据进行建模。直接六小时预测的加权平均绝对百分比误差为9.33%，优于RNN（12.16%）和LSTM（11.37%）。
AI.motivation: 安检站人员配置需要准确预测安检需求的到达时间，但航班时刻表记录的是起飞时间而非旅客到达安检口的时间，两者之间存在时间错位，因此需要一种能将航班计划转换为时间对齐信号的框架来支持安检人力调度。
AI.method: 使用截断泊松核将国内外航班座位容量分配到起飞前各小时，生成到达强度信号；将Temporal Fusion Transformer与历史吞吐量、计划活动和时间变量结合进行建模。按时间顺序训练模型，以2024年7-12月为测试集，并与RNN和LSTM模型在五个随机种子上进行对比评估。
AI.result: 直接六小时预测的加权平均绝对百分比误差为9.33%，低于RNN（12.16%）和LSTM（11.37%），且在高峰时段误差最低。六小时递归更新在24-96小时预测范围内误差保持在10.60%-11.04%之间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需旅客-航班匹配即可将航班计划转化为可解释的起飞前安检负荷信号，支持提前人员配置、通道开放和跨日安检规划。但由于观测吞吐量反映的是实际处理而非无约束到达，预测结果应结合本地人员配置、容量、队列和等待时间信息进行解读。

title: TumorBoard: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Decision Support for Longitudinal Neuro-Oncology
summary: Neuro-oncology decisions require coordinated interpretation of serial MRI, pathology, molecular markers, treatment history, performance status, and evolving guidelines. We present TumorBoard, a multi-agent decision-support system built around a shared longitudinal case state and an auditable claim-evidence ledger. Specialist agents for radiology, neuropathology, molecular diagnosis, guidelines, and therapy planning produce atomic claims with provenance. An adversarial critic exposes contradictions, and a safety governor releases, qualifies, or defers recommendations according to evidence sufficiency and temporal validity. On a 360-case hidden benchmark at a matched token budget, TumorBoard achieved an action F1 of 0.772 and evidence entailment of 0.914. It exceeded the strongest typed-council baseline by 3.1 percentage points (95% CI: 1.6 to 4.7, adjusted p = 0.0012), while recommendation-to-evidence coverage reached 0.927. Under evidence deletion, the system deferred 84.2% of unsafe cases and limited harmful recommendations to 5.8%. The safety governor reduced harmful release by 7.8 percentage points at a false-deferral cost of 4.3 percentage points. Ablation studies of the ledger, critic, and governor produced the predicted failure patterns, establishing structured coordination as the source of the measured multi-agent advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TumorBoard，一个用于神经肿瘤学决策的多智能体决策支持系统。该系统围绕共享的纵向病例状态和可审计的声明-证据账本构建，包含放射学、神经病理学、分子诊断、指南和疗法规划等专科智能体，通过对抗批判器揭示矛盾，并由安全治理器根据证据充分性和时间有效性发布、限定或推迟建议。在360例隐藏基准上，TumorBoard的动作F1达到0.772，证据蕴含达到0.914，超过最强类型化委员会基线3.1个百分点，在证据删除情境下推迟84.2%的不安全病例，安全治理器以4.3个百分点的误推迟代价将有害发布降低7.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 神经肿瘤学决策需要协调解读序列MRI、病理学、分子标志物、治疗史、体能状态和不断演进的指南，这些信息来自多个专业领域且高度复杂，现有的单一模型或简单委员会系统难以在保证证据可追溯性和安全性的前提下进行多模态、多时点的综合决策。
AI.method: TumorBoard采用多智能体架构，围绕共享的纵向病例状态和可审计的声明-证据账本构建。系统包含五个专科智能体（放射学、神经病理学、分子诊断、指南和疗法规划），产生携带来源信息（provenance）的原子声明。另外部署对抗批判器以揭露声明之间的矛盾，以及安全治理器根据证据充分性和时间有效性来决定建议的发布、限定或推迟。系统通过账本、批判器和治理器三个组件的结构化协作实现多智能体协同优势。
AI.result: 在360例隐藏基准上，TumorBoard动作F1为0.772，证据蕴含为0.914，超过最强类型化委员会基线3.1个百分点（95% CI: 1.6-4.7，调整后p=0.0012），建议-证据覆盖率0.927。在证据删除压力测试下，系统推迟84.2%的不安全病例，将有害建议限制在5.8%。安全治理器以4.3个百分点的误推迟代价换取有害发布降低7.8个百分点。消融实验证实账本、批判器和治理器各自移除后产生预期的失败模式，验证了结构化协调是多智能体优势的来源。
AI.conclusion: 结构化协调——即通过共享状态、可审计账本、对抗批判和安全治理的组合——是多智能体系统在临床决策支持中取得优势的关键来源。TumorBoard展示了在不牺牲安全性的前提下实现高性能神经肿瘤学决策支持的可行性，其安全治理机制在高风险场景中尤为有效。

title: MalTotal: Cost-Effective and Language-Agnostic Malicious Code Poisoning Detection for Millions of Repositories
summary: The widespread adoption of open source software (OSS) has introduced significant security risks, with malicious code poisoning attacks increasingly targeting public package registries and open-source platforms. Existing detection approaches, including heuristic-, learning-, and LLM-based methods, suffer from language-specific designs, limited generalization, and high analysis costs, making them unsuitable for large-scale multi-language analysis. To address these challenges, we propose MalTotal, a scalable and cost-effective framework for language-agnostic malicious code detection. MalTotal leverages LLM-assisted semantic reasoning to identify sensitive APIs, perform hybrid semantic slicing, and reconstruct malicious behavior contexts while reducing analysis overhead. Our evaluations show that MalTotal outperforms 8 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average F1-score of 93.1% across 5 mainstream languages. Its hybrid slicing reduces LLM token consumption by 94.0%, lowering the analysis cost from \$86.25 to \$5.19 on 2,168 repositories. In a large-scale study of 120K GitHub repositories containing over 7.3 million files, MalTotal discovered 564 previously unknown malicious repositories across multiple languages at a total cost of \$338. These results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and cost-efficiency of MalTotal in mitigating large-scale code poisoning attacks.

AI.tldr: MalTotal是一个语言无关的恶意代码检测框架，利用LLM辅助语义推理进行敏感API识别、混合语义切片和恶意行为上下文重建，在5种主流语言上的平均F1-score达93.1%，混合切片将LLM token消耗降低94.0%，并在12万GitHub仓库的大规模研究中发现564个此前未知的恶意仓库。
AI.motivation: 开源软件（OSS）的广泛采用带来了显著的安全风险，恶意代码投毒攻击日益 targeting 公共包注册表和开源平台。现有的检测方法（基于启发式、学习和LLM）存在语言特定设计、泛化能力有限和分析成本高等问题，不适合大规模多语言分析场景。
AI.method: MalTotal提出一个可扩展且成本高效的框架，核心方法包括：1) 利用LLM辅助语义推理识别敏感API；2) 执行混合语义切片；3) 重建恶意行为上下文，同时降低分析开销。
AI.result: MalTotal在5种主流语言上超越了8个SOTA基线方法，平均F1-score达93.1%；混合切片技术将LLM token消耗降低94.0%，使2,168个仓库的分析成本从$86.25降至$5.19；在12万GitHub仓库（含730万+文件）的大规模研究中，以$338的总成本发现564个此前未知的恶意仓库。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了MalTotal在缓解大规模代码投毒攻击方面的有效性、可扩展性和成本效率，为解决多语言环境下的恶意代码检测提供了实用方案。

title: Multimodal Plant Root Phenotyping with Integration of 3D Skeleton Extraction and Language Analysis
summary: Plant root phenotyping is fundamental to understanding below-ground structures, optimizing crop management, and improving agricultural sustainability. This paper presents a multimodal robotic AI framework that integrates 3D skeleton extraction with language-guided reasoning for interpretable and data-efficient root analysis. We develop an unsupervised skeleton extraction network based on Weighted Laplacian Contraction (W-LBC) to generate high-fidelity structural representations from dense point clouds captured by robotic 3D sensing platforms. Quantitative morphological descriptors, including root count, length, branching angle, and density, are computed from the reconstructed skeleton graph to capture geometric and topological characteristics. Building on these features, we introduce an Evidence-First language modeling framework that fine-tunes GPT as an interactive analytical chatbot using automatically generated instruction--response pairs. Each training sample provides measurable evidence before natural-language reasoning, enabling the model to ground interpretation in quantitative morphology. Through supervised fine-tuning, GPT associates numerical structure with semantic meaning, producing biologically consistent explanations of growth patterns and adaptive traits. Experiments show that the structure-guided framework achieves robust, interpretable reasoning across 12 plant species with diverse root architectures. By integrating unsupervised 3D geometric perception with large-scale language understanding, our approach bridges quantitative analysis and semantic interpretation, establishing a unified paradigm for explainable robotic plant root phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多模态机器人AI框架，将3D骨架提取与语言引导推理相结合，用于可解释的植物根系表型分析。采用基于加权拉普拉斯收缩的无监督骨架提取网络从稠密点云生成高保真结构表示，并通过Evidence-First语言建模框架微调GPT作为交互式分析聊天机器人，实现量化形态与语义解释的统一。
AI.motivation: 植物根系表型分析对理解地下结构、优化作物管理和提升农业可持续性至关重要，但现有方法缺乏将定量几何特征与语义解释相结合的可解释、数据高效的统一分析框架。
AI.method: 1) 基于加权拉普拉斯收缩(W-LBC)的无监督骨架提取网络，从3D机器人感测平台的稠密点云生成高保真结构表示；2) 从重建的骨架图计算定量形态描述符（根数、长度、分支角度、密度）以捕捉几何与拓扑特征；3) Evidence-First语言建模框架，通过自动生成的指令-响应对微调GPT作为交互式分析聊天机器人，每个训练样本在自然语言推理前提供可测量证据，使模型基于定量形态学进行语义解释。
AI.result: 实验表明该结构引导框架在12种具有不同根系架构的植物物种上实现了稳健、可解释的推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过将无监督3D几何感知与大规模语言理解相结合，该方法弥合了定量分析与语义解释之间的鸿沟，为可解释的机器人植物根系表型分析建立了统一范式。

title: Human Centric Embodied Intelligence for Soft Wearable Robotics
comment: Review article; 48 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, and 2 supplementary tables
summary: Soft wearable robots have evolved rapidly from proof-of-concept devices into promising platforms for rehabilitation, occupational assistance, and human augmentation. As the field matures, its central challenge extends beyond the development of softer materials and more capable actuators to the integration of sensing, intelligence, and human adaptation into systems that users can wear comfortably, trust, and benefit from over extended periods. This transition motivates the concept of Human-Centric Embodied Intelligence (HCEI), in which intelligence emerges from the coupled human-robot system through the interaction of morphology, multimodal sensing, adaptive cognition, compliant actuation, and the wearer's own physiological and behavioral adaptation. To organize this perspective, this review introduces the Perception-Cognition-Actuation-Augmentation (PCAA) framework, which positions perception and cognition as the primary drivers of design, shifting development beyond the conventional actuator-first paradigm. Using this framework, the review synthesizes advances in soft materials, wearable sensing, artificial intelligence, actuation, human-robot interaction, digital twins, clinical translation, manufacturing, regulation, and ethics, highlighting how these interdependent components collectively shape long-term personalization and real-world deployment. By providing a unified conceptual framework and design perspective, this review aims to guide future research, foster interdisciplinary collaboration, and accelerate the translation of next-generation soft wearable robots toward personalized, predictive, and human-centric wearable intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文从执行器优先的范式转向以感知和认知为核心的设计理念，提出了人本具身智能（HCEI）概念和感知-认知-执行-增强（PCAA）框架，系统综述了软体可穿戴机器人在材料、传感、AI、驱动、人机交互、数字孪生、临床转化、制造、监管与伦理等方面的进展，旨在为下一代个性化、预测性和以人为本的可穿戴智能提供统一的设计视角。
AI.motivation: 软体可穿戴机器人已从概念验证发展为康复、职业辅助和人体增强的实用平台。随着领域走向成熟，核心挑战已从开发更软的材料和更强的执行器，转向如何将感知、智能与人类适应性集成到用户可长期舒适佩戴和信任的系统中。这需要超越传统执行器优先的范式，建立以人为中心的设计框架。
AI.method: 提出人本具身智能（HCEI）概念，认为智能通过形态学、多模态感知、自适应认知、柔性执行与佩戴者生理和行为适应性的耦合交互而涌现。在此基础上引入感知-认知-执行-增强（PCAA）框架，将感知和认知作为设计的主要驱动力，并以此框架综合综述软材料、可穿戴传感、人工智能、驱动、人机交互、数字孪生、临床转化、制造、监管和伦理等交叉领域的进展。
AI.result: 通过PCAA框架将多个相互依赖的技术领域整合为一个统一的系统视图，阐明了感知与认知驱动设计如何替代传统的执行器优先方法，并指出这些组件的协同作用对长期个性化和实际落地部署的关键影响。
AI.conclusion: 该综述通过提供统一的概念框架和设计视角，旨在指导未来研究、促进跨学科合作，并加速下一代软体可穿戴机器人向个性化、预测性和以人为本的可穿戴智能的方向转化。

title: Internalizing Academic Writing Workflows for Introduction Generation via Struct-Aware Policy Learning
summary: Generating a rigorous paper introduction with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging, since it requires coordinating background, gap identification, method and contribution within a coherent narrative. Existing solutions externalize this process as multi-stage prompts or agent workflows which are expensive and vulnerable to cross-stage drift. We propose StructPO, a struct-aware policy learning framework that internalizes the entire multi-stage writing workflow into a single-pass policy controlled by explicit stage tokens. StructPO introduces struct-aware credit assignment to decouple local stage quality from global coherence and refinement-guided optimization to internalize revision behavior into the first-pass policy. Experiments show that StructPO improves semantic alignment, structural rationality and inference efficiency over workflow-based baselines, generalizes to out-of-domain settings, and remains competitive with GPT-5.1 in human evaluation when scaled to Qwen3-32B. These results show that internalizing academic writing workflows through fine-grained policy optimization offers a viable alternative to costly external orchestration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StructPO，一种结构感知的策略学习框架，通过显式阶段token将多阶段论文引言写作工作流内化为单次前向策略，并引入结构感知信用分配与精炼引导优化，提升语义对齐、结构合理性和推理效率，且可扩展至大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 使用LLM生成严谨的论文引言仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要协调背景、缺口识别、方法和贡献于一个连贯的叙事中。现有的解决方案通过多阶段提示或代理工作流将这一过程外部化，但这些方法成本高昂且容易受到跨阶段漂移的影响。
AI.method: StructPO框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 将整个多阶段写作工作流内化为由显式阶段token控制的单次前向策略；(2) 结构感知信用分配（struct-aware credit assignment），用于解耦局部阶段质量与全局连贯性；(3) 精炼引导优化（refinement-guided optimization），将修改行为内化到首轮前向策略中。
AI.result: 实验表明StructPO在语义对齐、结构合理性和推理效率上优于基于工作流的基线方法，能够泛化到域外设置，并且在扩展到Qwen3-32B时，人工评估中与GPT-5.1表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度策略优化将学术写作工作流内化，是昂贵的外部编排的一种可行替代方案。

title: SP3O: Reinforcement Learning from Segment Preferences without Reward Modeling
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) for general stochastic MDPs often requires training a reward model. Existing reward-model-free methods are either restricted to bandits or deterministic MDPs, such as DPO or P3O, or use zeroth-order, gradient-free optimization, which in general exhibits a slower convergence rate than gradient-based algorithms. Furthermore, existing reward-model-free preference-based RL algorithms almost exclusively use trajectory-level feedback, which can require significant effort from a human evaluator when trajectories are long. On the other hand, segments are much shorter, so they are easier to compare and evaluate. In this paper, we introduce a novel reward-model-free, critic-free, and gradient-based PbRL algorithm compatible with segment preferences named Segment Pairwise Proximal Policy Optimization (SP3O). SP3O utilizes segment-level preference feedback to construct an accurate policy value difference estimator via off-policy importance sampling, and then uses the estimator to compute the policy gradient via a PPO-type loss function. We provide a theoretical basis for the algorithm and analyze the tradeoff in choosing the segment length. We also evaluate it experimentally against other PbRL/RLHF algorithms in robotic control and LLM finetuning settings to show its improved performance, especially in long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SP3O，一种新颖的免奖励模型、免评论家、基于梯度的偏好强化学习算法，兼容段级偏好反馈。通过离策略重要性采样构建策略值差异估计器，并使用PPO型损失函数计算策略梯度，在机器人控制和LLM微调任务中展现了改进的性能，尤其在长时域任务中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有的免奖励模型偏好强化学习方法要么局限于bandit或确定性MDP（如DPO、P3O），要么使用零阶无梯度优化导致收敛速度慢；且现有算法几乎都依赖轨迹级反馈，当轨迹较长时人工评估成本高。段级反馈更短、更易于比较和评估。
AI.method: 提出SP3O算法：利用段级偏好反馈，通过离策略重要性采样构建准确的政策值差异估计器，再通过PPO型损失函数计算策略梯度。算法免奖励模型、免评论家、基于梯度，并提供了理论基础，分析了段长选择的权衡。
AI.result: 在机器人控制和LLM微调场景下与其他PbRL/RLHF算法进行实验对比，SP3O展现了更好的性能，尤其在长时域任务中改进明显。
AI.conclusion: SP3O有效解决了现有免奖励模型偏好强化学习在一般随机MDP中的梯度计算问题，同时利用段级反馈降低人工评估成本，理论上提供了算法依据，实验证实了其优越性。

title: When Refusal Looks Safe: The Refusal-Cue Shortcut in Safety Guard Models
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, and 14 tables. Includes supplementary material in the appendix
summary: Safety guards are widely used to filter harmful content and are typically trained via supervised fine-tuning on labeled prompt-response pairs. We audit two widely used safety-guard training datasets, WildGuardMix and GR-Train, and find that among responses to harmful prompts, refusal expressions co-occur almost exclusively with unharmful labels. This imbalance motivates what we term the refusal-cue shortcut: inserting a refusal cue into a harmful response could flip the guard's verdict from harmful to unharmful. The shortcut affects not only guards trained on these datasets but also officially released models such as LlamaGuard3 and Qwen3Guard whose training data is undisclosed. It persists across response positions and is generally stronger in smaller variants within a family. To mitigate it, we adapt sparse complementary masking as a lightweight post-hoc intervention that identifies and suppresses a small set of shortcut-associated attention heads and MLP neurons without retraining. On two primary benchmarks, the intervention achieves an approximately 79% relative reduction in response-initial detection failures induced by refusal cues, while preserving standard detection performance. Although optimized using cues at a single response position, the suppression effect transfers to unseen positions and datasets, suggesting that shortcut manifestations across positions are partly mediated by shared internal components. Further analysis provides evidence that shortcut reliance and legitimate refusal recognition are partially functionally separable, as suppressing the shortcut broadly preserves the guard's ability to recognize genuine refusals.

AI.tldr: 本文发现安全护栏模型存在"拒绝对齐捷径"（refusal-cue shortcut）问题：在有害提示下，拒绝表达几乎只与"无害"标签共现，导致在有害回复中插入拒绝线索即可翻转安全判定。作者提出基于稀疏互补掩码的后处理干预方法，无需重新训练即可识别并抑制少量与捷径相关的注意力头和MLP神经元，在两个主要基准上实现了约79%的响应初始检测失败率的相对降低，同时保持标准检测性能。
AI.motivation: 安全护栏模型的训练数据（WildGuardMix和GR-Train）存在标签与拒绝表达几乎完全共现的不平衡问题，这可能导致模型学习到"拒绝表达即无害"的捷径而非真正理解内容有害性。这种捷径容易被攻击者利用（通过在有害回复中注入拒绝线索绕过防护），因此需要深入研究并加以缓解。
AI.method: 首先审计训练数据集揭示拒绝线索与无害标签的共现失衡；其次提出"拒绝线索捷径"假设并通过实验验证（在有害回复中插入拒绝表达可翻转判定）；然后采用稀疏互补掩码（sparse complementary masking）作为轻量级后处理干预，定位并抑制与捷径关联的少量注意力头和MLP神经元，无需重新训练模型。
AI.result: 该干预在两个主要基准上实现约79%的拒绝线索诱导的响应初始检测失败率相对降低，同时保持标准检测性能。抑制效果可迁移到未见位置和数据集，说明不同位置上的捷径表现部分由共享内部组件介导。此外，抑制捷径后模型仍能识别真实拒绝，证明捷径依赖与合法拒绝识别在功能上部分可分离。
AI.conclusion: 安全护栏的训练数据中存在系统性的拒绝线索捷径，影响包括数据未公开的官方模型（LlamaGuard3、Qwen3Guard）在内的多种模型。所提出的后处理干预能有效缓解该问题且不损害正常检测能力，为改进安全护栏的可信度提供了可行路径。

title: ShielDroid: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Machine and Deep Learning for Android Malware Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of modern technology has led to a significant increase in the use of smart devices, such as smartphones and tablets, resulting in the widespread adoption of mobile applications. Although applications are required to undergo malware screening before being published on official app stores, many malicious applications successfully evade detection by concealing sophisticated malware variants. These malicious behaviors are often activated only during runtime, making them difficult to identify through conventional static analysis. As a result, malware may remain undetected until after installation, potentially causing irreversible damage to users and their devices. This study presents a real-time Android malware detection framework that analyzes application behavior to accurately identify and classify complex malware. The proposed approach employs a hybrid dynamic analysis technique to distinguish malicious applications from benign ones. After preprocessing and filtering the collected dataset, the applications are classified using multiple machine learning algorithms. A comprehensive performance evaluation is conducted to compare the effectiveness of different classification techniques in terms of detection accuracy and execution time. Experimental results demonstrate that a hybrid model combining Random Forest and a Multilayer Perceptron achieves the best overall performance, attaining an accuracy of 97.5% with an execution time of 22.945 seconds. The proposed framework can enhance mobile device security by enabling timely detection of malicious applications and reducing the risk of cyberattacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于混合动态分析技术的实时Android恶意软件检测框架，通过分析应用行为并结合多种机器学习算法进行分类，其中随机森林与多层感知器混合模型在检测准确率和执行时间上取得最佳性能（准确率97.5%，执行时间22.945秒）。
AI.motivation: 传统静态分析难以识别仅在运行时激活的复杂恶意行为，导致恶意应用可绕过官方应用商店的筛查，在安装后对用户和设备造成不可逆损害，因此需要一种能够实时检测运行时恶意行为的动态分析方案。
AI.method: 采用混合动态分析技术分析应用运行时的行为特征，对收集的数据集进行预处理和过滤后，使用多种机器学习算法对应用进行分类，并通过全面的性能评估比较不同分类技术在检测准确率和执行时间方面的效果。最终混合模型结合了随机森林和多层感知器两种算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，随机森林与多层感知器（Multilayer Perceptron）混合模型表现最佳，检测准确率达到97.5%，执行时间为22.945秒。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够通过及时检测恶意应用来增强移动设备安全性，降低网络攻击风险，弥补传统静态分析的不足。

title: Adaptive Two-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Inference in Video-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models excel at image and video understanding but suffer from high inference latency due to the need to process thousands of tokens per image, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices and in real-time surveillance applications. This challenge is further amplified in video processing, where multiple frames must be analyzed simultaneously. Existing token reduction techniques are largely developed for single-image inputs and therefore fail to account for the temporal and inter-frame redundancies present in video sequences. In addition, these methods generally rely on a fixed, uniform pruning ratio applied across all inputs, which is suboptimal because the degree of redundancy can vary significantly between different videos, necessitating content-dependent pruning levels to preserve critical information. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage adaptive token pruning strategy specifically designed for video processing. In the first stage, we prune out the redundant frames, and in the second stage, token-level pruning is applied within the retained frames. Crucially, the pruning ratio in the second stage is determined adaptively based on the content of each video. This is achieved by analyzing the correlation structure of token embeddings to quantify redundancy, which is used to determine the ratio. Importantly, our method is entirely post-hoc and requires no additional training or fine-tuning, while achieving strong empirical gains; notably, it improves accuracy by +7\% on a video captioning benchmark at 10\% token retention, while reducing computation TFLOPs by 95\%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种专为视频处理设计的两阶段自适应token剪枝策略，第一阶段剪除冗余帧，第二阶段基于内容自适应决定token层剪枝比例，无需训练即可在保持甚至提升精度的同时大幅降低计算量。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在图像和视频理解中表现出色，但处理大量token导致推理延迟高，限制了在边缘设备和实时监控等资源受限场景的部署。现有token剪枝方法主要为单图像设计，未能利用视频中的时间与帧间冗余；且依赖固定的统一剪枝比例，忽略了不同视频间冗余程度的差异，导致次优效果。
AI.method: 提出两阶段自适应token剪枝策略：(1) 第一阶段进行帧级剪枝，去除冗余帧；(2) 第二阶段在保留帧内进行token级剪枝，剪枝比例根据每个视频的内容自适应确定，通过分析token嵌入的相关性结构来量化冗余度，进而决定剪枝比例。该方法完全事后(post-hoc)应用于已有模型，无需额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 在视频字幕生成基准上，以10%的token保留率下准确率提升7%，同时计算量(TFLOPs)减少95%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过自适应内容感知的剪枝策略，在无需训练的情况下显著提升了视频处理效率，证明了考虑时间冗余和内容相关剪枝对视频token高效压缩的重要价值。

title: Unified Visuomotor Targets: Supervising VLAs Beyond Physical Actions
summary: VLA models are trained to predict robot actions from visual and language observations. This is a natural choice, but it creates a mismatch: VLMs encode rich, high-level representations of scenes and goals, while robot actions are low-level signals with limited task structure. We ask whether changing what the policy is trained to predict, rather than how it is architecturally designed, can yield better and more efficiently trained policies. We propose UVT (Unified Visuomotor Target), a unified latent prediction target that jointly encodes motor control and visual scene transition information, requiring no architectural changes and no additional data. Applied to two representative VLA systems across simulation benchmarks and real bimanual manipulation tasks, UVT improves training efficiency, final task performance, and policy robustness, with particularly strong gains under limited training budgets and challenging environmental conditions. Rollout videos and additional qualitative results are available at our project webpage: https://unified-visuomotor-targets.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出UVT（Unified Visuomotor Target），一种统一的潜在预测目标，用于解决VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在训练时因动作预测目标过于低级而损失视觉语义信息的问题，仅通过改变预测目标而非架构，即可提升训练效率和最终任务性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型通常以预测机器人动作为训练目标，但动作是低层信号，缺乏任务结构，而VLM编码的是丰富的场景与目标高层表示，两者存在不匹配。作者质疑：改变策略的预测目标而非架构设计，是否能带来更好且训练更高效的策略。
AI.method: 提出UVT，一种统一的潜在预测目标，同时编码电机控制信息和视觉场景转换信息。该方法不改变VLA架构，也不需要额外数据，仅替换训练时的预测目标。作者在两个代表性VLA系统上、跨越仿真基准和真实双臂操作任务进行验证。
AI.result: UVT在训练效率、最终任务性能和策略鲁棒性三方面均有所提升，尤其在有限训练预算和具有挑战性的环境条件下，其优势最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一电机控制和视觉场景转换信息的潜在预测目标，可在不改架构、不加数据的条件下显著提升VLA策略的训练效率与性能表现，为VLA策略训练提供了一种新的优化视角。

title: ANCHOR-RE: An Agentic Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Grounded Biomedical Relation Extraction
comment: Submitted to Journal of Biomedical Informatics (under review)
summary: Biomedical relation extraction (BioRE) extracts structured knowledge from biomedical literature for applications such as knowledge base construction and hypothesis generation. Traditional symbolic systems such as SemRep provide high precision but limited recall, while large language models (LLMs) offer stronger contextual reasoning but remain prone to false-positive predictions. We developed ANCHOR-RE, a framework that integrates ontology-guided reasoning, external knowledge grounding, and data-driven verification rules into LLM inference. We evaluated it on three BioRE benchmarks (SemRepGS, DDI, and ChemProt) using both proprietary and open-weight LLMs. To assess generalizability beyond benchmark datasets while reducing potential evaluation bias from LLM pretraining contamination, we conducted a temporal evaluation using 100 biomedical articles published in 2026. With the proprietary backbone, ANCHOR-RE outperformed direct LLM prompting, improving micro-F1 from 0.654 to 0.676 on SemRepGS, from 0.769 to 0.872 on DDI, and from 0.939 to 0.941 on ChemProt. On DDI and ChemProt, it also outperformed previously reported inference-only methods and approached fine-tuned or instruction-tuned systems without parameter updates. Similar performance gains observed with open-weight LLMs indicate that the benefits were not limited to the proprietary backbone. On the post-cutoff set, manual assessment of 500 randomly sampled predictions yielded a precision of 69%, maintaining consistent precision on previously unseen biomedical literature. Neuro-symbolic reasoning can improve the reliability of LLM-based BioRE without fine-tuning. Results across multiple benchmarks, model families, and post-cutoff literature support ANCHOR-RE as a practical training-free approach to biomedical literature mining.

AI.tldr: ANCHOR-RE是一个无需微调的神经符号推理框架，将本体引导推理、外部知识grounding和数据驱动验证规则集成到LLM推理中，用于生物医学关系抽取（BioRE）。在三个基准（SemRepGS、DDI、ChemProt）上均优于直接LLM提示，并在2026年发表的100篇文献上验证了其泛化性和抗预训练污染能力。
AI.motivation: 传统符号系统（如SemRep）精度高但召回率有限，而LLM具备更强上下文推理能力却容易产生假阳性预测。现有方法缺乏一种既能利用LLM推理优势、又能通过结构化知识约束其可靠性的训练无关框架。
AI.method: ANCHOR-RE框架将三类外部信号集成到LLM推理过程中：本体引导推理（ontology-guided reasoning）、外部知识grounding（external knowledge grounding）以及数据驱动的验证规则（data-driven verification rules）。在多个专有和开源LLM backbones上进行评估，并设计了基于2026年发表的100篇文章的时间评估集以规避LLM预训练数据污染带来的评估偏差。
AI.result: 使用专有LLM时，ANCHOR-RE在SemRepGS上micro-F1从0.654提升至0.676，DDI上从0.769提升至0.872，ChemProt上从0.939提升至0.941。在DDI和ChemProt上超越已有推理方法，逼近微调或指令微调系统。开源LLM上同样观察到性能提升。在2026年发表的文献上，500条随机抽样预测的人工评测精度为69%。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号推理能够在无需微调的情况下显著提升基于LLM的BioRE可靠性，且其效果跨多个基准、模型家族和截止日期后的文献均一致验证，ANCHOR-RE可作为实用的无训练生物医学文献挖掘方案。

title: Inverted Detection and Control in Steering Vectors
summary: Steering vectors (SVs) are widely used to influence the expression of concepts (e.g., truthfulness) in large language model outputs. A key assumption underpinning SVs is that they are linearly discriminative with respect to the concept: representations of texts that exhibit the concept are more aligned with the SV than those that do not, motivating shifts along the positive or negative SV direction to respectively promote or suppress the concept. In this work, we identify an inverted detection-control phenomenon in which some highly discriminative SVs that are aligned with positive representations can consistently promote the opposite behavior. We refer to such vectors as inverted-steering vectors (ISVs). We provide a geometric characterization of ISVs' effects, finding that steering along these directions systematically pushes representations in discriminative downstream heads as if the concept were absent, even prior to decoding. Motivated by this analysis, we propose an approach for distinguishing ISVs without requiring generation or associated response scoring. This enables targeted sign flips, which we use to improve a foundational detection-based steering pipeline via Inference Time Intervention (ITI). Our approach improves results in 27/30 experiments, ranging from +0.9% to +138%. We evaluate our findings on Gemma 3 12B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Olmo 3 7B across 5 concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一种"倒置检测-控制"现象：部分高度可判别性的转向向量（SV）虽然与正样本表征对齐，却能持续促进相反行为，称为"倒置转向向量"。作者提供了其几何特征化，并提出一种无需生成或打分即可区分ISV的方法，通过定向翻转符号改进了基于推理时干预（ITI）的检测式转向流水线，在30个实验中27个取得提升（+0.9%至+138%）。
AI.motivation: 转向向量（SV）被广泛用于调控大语言模型输出中概念的表达，其核心假设是SV对概念具有线性可判别性：表达概念的表征与SV对齐程度更高，沿正/负方向移动可分别促进/抑制该概念。然而这一假设在某些情况下可能不成立，需要识别并理解这种异常现象。
AI.method: 作者首先识别了ISV（倒置转向向量）现象，即高判别性SV与正表征对齐但促进相反行为；随后提供了几何特征化，表明沿这些方向转向会在判别性下游头中有系统性地将表征推向"概念缺失"的状态（甚至在解码前）。基于此分析，提出一种无需生成或响应评分即可区分ISV的方法，实现精准的符号翻转，并将其集成到基于推理时干预（ITI）的检测式转向流水线中。
AI.result: 该方法在Gemma 3 12B、Qwen 2.5 14B和Olmo 3 7B三个模型上针对5个概念进行评估，在30个实验中27个取得了改进，提升幅度从+0.9%到+138%不等。
AI.conclusion: SV的线性判别性假设并非总是成立，存在ISV这一反直觉现象。通过几何分析和无需生成的ISV识别方法，配合符号翻转，可以显著提升检测式转向流水线的性能，为基于SV的可解释干预提供了更稳健的实践指导。

title: The Agent Operating System (AOS): A Reference Operating Architecture for Distributed Agentic Systems
summary: Large language models have transformed artificial intelligence from isolated prediction services into components of long-running, distributed systems that reason, invoke tools, retrieve external state, delegate tasks, and act on behalf of users and organizations. The surrounding ecosystem has responded with agent frameworks, workflow engines, model-serving platforms, memory systems, communication protocols, and observability tools. These technologies improve execution, but they do not provide a stable, implementation-independent operating architecture for governing intent, selecting capabilities, preserving authority across delegation, controlling uncertainty, coordinating runtime behavior, and reconstructing why consequential actions occurred. This paper proposes the Agent Operating System (AOS), a vendor-neutral reference operating architecture for distributed agentic systems. AOS contains two internal planes: a Control & Governance Plane responsible for intent, policy, trust, authority, confidence, auditability, observability, and human oversight; and a Runtime & Coordination Plane responsible for agent lifecycle, workflow coordination, model and tool routing, context and memory coordination, scheduling, traffic management, and runtime assurance. Platform services, Linux or Windows, container runtimes, and physical infrastructure remain outside the AOS boundary and are integrated through explicit interfaces. The paper specifies AOS concepts, invariants, interface objects, optimization objectives, deployment profiles, and reliability responsibilities. It also identifies tradeoffs and unresolved research questions. AOS is not presented as a replacement for existing frameworks or infrastructure; it is proposed as the operating architecture through which heterogeneous components can be composed into governable, reliable, observable, and interoperable agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agent操作系统（AOS），一个厂商中立的参考操作系统架构，用于分布式代理系统。AOS包含两个内部平面：控制与治理平面（负责意图、策略、信任、权限、审计等）和运行时与协调平面（负责代理生命周期、工作流协调、模型/工具路由、调度等），旨在将异构组件组合成可治理、可靠、可观测、可互操作的代理系统。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型已从孤立的预测服务演变为长时间运行的分布式系统的组成部分，能够推理、调用工具、检索外部状态、委托任务并代表用户和组织行动。虽然现有的代理框架、工作流引擎、模型服务平台、记忆系统等改善了执行效率，但它们缺乏一个稳定的、独立于实现的操作系统架构来治理意图、选择能力、跨委托维护权限、控制不确定性、协调运行时行为以及回溯关键行动的原因。
AI.method: 论文提出了Agent Operating System（AOS），一个包含两个内部平面的参考操作系统架构：1）控制与治理平面（Control & Governance Plane）：负责意图、策略、信任、权限、置信度、可审计性、可观测性和人类监督；2）运行时与协调平面（Runtime & Coordination Plane）：负责代理生命周期、工作流协调、模型与工具路由、上下文与记忆协调、调度、流量管理和运行时保障。平台服务（如Linux/Windows、容器运行时、物理基础设施）位于AOS边界之外，通过明确接口集成。论文规定了AOS的概念、不变量、接口对象、优化目标、部署配置文件和可靠性职责。
AI.result: AOS被定义为异构组件可以组合成可治理、可靠、可观测和可互操作的代理系统的操作系统架构。论文还识别了权衡因素和未解决的研究问题，表明AOS并非替代现有框架或基础设施，而是作为它们之上的一层组合架构。
AI.conclusion: AOS为分布式代理系统提供了一个稳定的、供应商中立的参考架构，填补了现有代理生态系统中缺乏运行时代理系统（operating architecture）的空白。它明确区分了控制/治理与运行时/协调两大职责域，并将基础设施层隔离在边界之外，通过显式接口集成，从而支持异构组件的可组合性和系统的可治理性。

title: FedGSA: Geometry-Consistent Subspace Aggregation for Differentially Private Federated LoRA
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables communication-efficient federated fine-tuning of pretrained language models. However, integrating differential privacy (DP) into federated LoRA remains challenging: independently perturbing and aggregating its two low-rank matrices can cause aggregation mismatch and the quadratic noise term. Existing methods mitigate these issues by freezing one low-rank matrix but still rely on Euclidean aggregation, which is basis-dependent and may distort the global update. To address this limitation, we propose FedGSA, a geometry-consistent aggregation framework for differentially private federated LoRA. FedGSA represents each privatized client update as a basis-invariant subspace on the Grassmann manifold. In each communication round, clients extract low-dimensional subspaces capturing dominant update directions and encode them as projection matrices. The server aggregates these representations to estimate a geometry-consistent global update subspace and reconstructs the global LoRA factors within it, reducing distortion caused by basis misalignment, privacy noise, and heterogeneous client updates. We prove that FedGSA incurs no additional privacy loss beyond client-side DP training and establish its convergence under standard assumptions. Experiments on four GLUE tasks and a language generation benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements across privacy budgets and degrees of data heterogeneity. In particular, FedGSA improves average accuracy over the strongest baseline by 2.17% and 2.27% under $ε=6$ and $ε=3$, respectively.

AI.tldr: FedGSA是一个用于差分隐私联邦LoRA的几何一致聚合框架，通过在Grassmann流形上表示客户端更新子空间，实现基无关的全局更新聚合，在不增加额外隐私损失的前提下提升模型精度和收敛性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦LoRA结合差分隐私时存在两个核心问题：(1) 独立扰动和聚合两个低秩矩阵会导致聚合不匹配和二次噪声项；(2) 现有的冻结一个低秩矩阵的方法仍依赖欧几里得聚合，这种聚合方式依赖于基的选择，可能扭曲全局更新。因此需要一种几何一致且基无关的聚合方法来克服这些局限。
AI.method: FedGSA将每个私有化的客户端更新表示为基础不变（basis-invariant）的Grassmann流形上的子空间。每个通信轮次中：(1) 客户端提取捕获主导更新方向的低维子空间并将其编码为投影矩阵；(2) 服务器聚合这些表示以估计几何一致的全局更新子空间；(3) 服务器在该子空间内重建全局LoRA因子，从而减少基错位、隐私噪声和异构客户端更新带来的扭曲。
AI.result: 在4个GLUE任务和一个语言生成基准上，FedGSA在不同隐私预算和数据异质性程度下均取得一致改进。在ε=6时平均准确率比最强基线提高2.17%，在ε=3时提高2.27%，同时证明了无需额外隐私损失并建立收敛性保证。
AI.conclusion: FedGSA通过Grassmann流形上的几何一致聚合，有效解决了差分隐私联邦LoRA中欧几里得聚合的基依赖问题，在隐私预算和数据异质性变化下均能稳定提升性能，且不增加额外隐私成本。

title: Non-Destructive Quantification of Urea Adulteration in Bovine Milk Using Transmittance Multispectral Imaging
summary: Adulteration of bovine milk using urea remains a major food quality and health concern, motivating the development of rapid and quantitative screening tools. Conventional approaches, including laboratory-based analytical methods and spectroscopic techniques, have been used for urea detection; however, many remain less suitable for rapid, low-cost routine screening due to requirements such as specialized instrumentation, sample preparation, chemical reagents, or laboratory operation. This study introduces a pragmatic, cost-effective, accurate, and laboratory-validated MSI-based method for quantitative urea estimation under controlled density conditions using a multispectral-imaging-based regression framework. An in-house-built multispectral imaging system operating in twelve discrete spectral bands (365--940~nm) was used to acquire multispectral images of milk samples prepared with controlled urea addition and water for density balancing. Fresh milk was obtained on the day of image acquisition, and the specific gravity of the milk was verified to be 1.032 at 20°C using a hydrometer. Multiple linear regression provided an initial mapping with a high validation $R^2$ of 0.9599, while a feed-forward neural network further improved predictive performance with a validation $R^2$ of 0.9773. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmittance multispectral imaging for accurate, non-destructive urea quantification under controlled density-balanced conditions, supporting its potential as a rapid screening approach for milk-quality assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于多光谱成像（MSI）的定量尿素检测方法，用于快速筛查牛奶掺假。在受控密度条件下，利用自建的多光谱成像系统（365–940 nm，12个离散波段）获取牛奶样品图像，结合多元线性回归（R²=0.9599）和前馈神经网络（R²=0.9773）进行定量预测，证明了透射多光谱成像用于牛奶品质快速无损评估的可行性。
AI.motivation: 牛奶掺尿素的掺假行为是重大的食品质量和健康隐患，现有检测方法（实验室分析和光谱技术）大多需要专用仪器、样品制备、化学试剂或实验室操作，难以满足快速、低成本、常规筛查的需求，因此亟需开发简洁实用的定量筛选工具。
AI.method: 采用自建的多光谱成像系统，在12个离散光谱波段（365–940 nm）采集牛奶样品的透射多光谱图像。牛奶样品通过受控添加尿素并用水调节密度（比重在20°C下验证为1.032）制备。使用多元线性回归建立初始映射，并进一步采用前馈神经网络提升预测性能。
AI.result: 多元线性回归模型验证R²为0.9599，前馈神经网络将验证R²提升至0.9773，二者均展示了高精度的定量预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 透射多光谱成像在受控密度平衡条件下能够实现准确、无损的尿素定量检测，具备作为牛奶质量快速筛查方法的潜力。

title: Active Stiffness Control of a Supportive Continuum Robot
summary: Supportive continuum robots (SCRs) enhance the load-bearing capability of an operative continuum robot by mechanically coupling it with a supportive arm. However, their passive stiffness is determined by the mechanical configuration and cannot be adjusted online for varying payloads or interaction forces. Active stiffness control is therefore needed to regulate the load response and maintain positioning accuracy. Meanwhile, the closed-chain structure introduces kinematic constraints that complicate task-space regulation and stiffness control. This paper presents an active task-space stiffness control framework for a tendon-driven SCR. An existing geometric variable strain model describes the closed-chain dynamics, which are projected onto the constraint-consistent motion subspace. A projected sliding mode controller regulates the operative arm tip while preserving the constraints, and closed-loop stability is established through Lyapunov analysis. After position regulation, active apparent stiffness is introduced through a virtual Cartesian spring based on position-error feedback to shape the force--displacement response. The framework is evaluated in simulation and experimentally validated under prescribed external loads and different desired configurations. Results show that increasing the commanded stiffness gain reduces load-induced tip deflection and increases apparent directional stiffness, thereby improving load resistance and positioning robustness under external loading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对腱驱动支撑式连续体机器人（SCR）的主动任务空间刚度控制框架，通过将闭环动力学投影到约束一致的运动子空间，结合投影滑模控制器实现操作臂末端的位置调节，并利用虚拟笛卡尔弹簧引入主动表观刚度以调节力-位移响应，从而提升外部载荷下的负载抵抗力和定位鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 支撑式连续体机器人（SCR）通过机械耦合支撑臂来增强操作臂的承载能力，但其被动刚度由机械构型决定，无法在线调整以适应变化的负载或交互力，因此需要主动刚度控制来调节载荷响应并维持定位精度；同时闭环链结构引入的运动学约束使任务空间调节和刚度控制变得复杂。
AI.method: 首先利用已有的几何变量应变模型描述闭环链动力学，并将其投影到约束一致的运动子空间；随后设计投影滑模控制器用于调节操作臂末端同时保持约束，并通过Lyapunov分析建立闭环稳定性；在位置调节完成后，基于位置误差反馈引入虚拟笛卡尔弹簧来塑造力-位移响应，实现主动表观刚度控制。
AI.result: 仿真与实验均在预设外部载荷和不同期望构型下进行了验证。结果表明，增大指令刚度增益可减少载荷引起的末端偏转并提高表观方向刚度，从而在外部加载下改善负载抵抗力和定位鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了SCR被动刚度不可调的问题，实现了任务空间中主动可调的刚度特性，增强了机器人对外部载荷的适应性和定位精度保持能力。

title: Aligning Large Vision-Language Models at Test Time: A Trajectory-Guided Structured Sampling Approach
summary: Post-training reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are commonly used to align large vision-language models (LVLMs) with human intent and the requirements of visual reasoning tasks. However, existing RL-based alignment methods are often resource-intensive and encounter mismatches between training objectives and inference-time distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel test-time alignment approach that leverages trajectory-guided structured sampling for dynamic inference-time refinement, achieving better alignment with visual grounding and ensuring logical consistency. Our approach begins with curating a reasoning memory bank via a trajectory learning algorithm, which decomposes complex question solving into ordered sequences of predefined reasoning patterns. It subsequently accomplishes inference-time alignment by first collecting trajectories from reasoning memory bank to establish a global structural reasoning prior, and then using an iterative Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm for localized multi-objective refinement of the reasoning trace. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly improves accuracy without incurring prohibitive inference overhead. These results establish trajectory-guided test-time sampling as a scalable and effective alternative to traditional post-training alignment, particularly for complex visual reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的测试时对齐方法，利用轨迹引导的结构化采样实现动态推理细化，通过推理记忆库和迭代MCMC算法，在复杂视觉推理任务中显著提升准确性且不引入过高推理开销，作为传统后训练对齐的可扩展替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于强化学习的后训练对齐方法资源消耗大，且存在训练目标与推理时分布不匹配的问题，亟需一种更高效且能实现动态推理对齐的方法。
AI.method: 首先通过轨迹学习算法构建推理记忆库，将复杂问题分解为有序的推理模式序列；然后从记忆库中收集轨迹建立全局结构推理先验；最后使用迭代马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛(MCMC)算法进行局部多目标推理轨迹细化，实现测试时对齐。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了推理准确性，且没有带来过高的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹引导的测试时采样是传统后训练对齐的一种可扩展且有效的替代方案，尤其适用于复杂视觉推理任务。

title: Reachability Is Not Realization: Tracing the Sources of LLM Benchmark Gains
summary: Benchmark gains are often treated as evidence of greater LLM capability. Yet the same gain can reflect different changes in model behavior. A model may reach new answers, or produce answers that were already within reach. Aggregate scores do not distinguish these changes question by question. We establish a question-level audit under fixed budgets, temperatures, and answer formats. A question is realized when the default deployment procedure produces the correct answer. A question is reachable when a specified probe finds that answer within a fixed budget. We first test whether inference-time layer routing can expand reachability. Under a matched budget, random routes match or exceed structured search in all 43 model and task settings. Answer-blind procedures retain almost none of this gain, which instead requires access to the correct answer. We then ask why reachable answers sometimes fail to appear. Across six cases spanning 0.5B to 31B, silencing one identified MLP block repairs 68 to 92 percent of a predefined failure set. We next test whether training closes the gap by expanding reachability. In five of six matched evaluations, deployed performance rises while the reachable ceiling remains flat or falls. For DAPO, the deployed score rises by 14.7 points while the reachable ceiling falls by 13.3 points. Across the settings we audit, realization and reachability therefore do not always change together. Claims of capability expansion should report both realized performance and reachability under matched evaluation conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/reachability-not-realization

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种问题级审计框架，区分"已实现"(realized)与"可达到"(reachable)的能力，发现推理时层路由扩展可达到性需要访问正确答案、特定MLP块静默可修复大部分失败案例、训练常提升已实现性能但可达到上限持平或下降，因此能力扩展声明应同时报告两类指标。
AI.motivation: 基准分数提升常被视为LLM能力增强的证据，但相同的分数提升可能反映不同的行为变化——模型可能得出新答案，也可能只是触及了原本就在能力范围内的答案。聚合分数无法逐题区分这些变化，导致对模型真实能力变化的误判。
AI.method: 在固定预算、温度和答案格式下建立问题级审计：默认部署流程产出正确答案定义为"已实现"(realized)，指定探针在固定预算内找到该答案定义为"可达到"(reachable)。测试推理时层路由能否扩展可达到性（对比随机路由与结构化搜索）；通过静默单个MLP块定位失败原因；并比较训练前后已实现性能与可达到上限的变化。
AI.result: 在43个模型与任务设置中，匹配预算下随机路由达到或超过结构化搜索；答案不可见的程序几乎无法保留可达到性增益，必须访问正确答案。在0.5B到31B的六个案例中，静默一个MLP块修复了68%-92%的预定义失败集。六组匹配评估中有五组显示训练后已实现性能上升但可达到上限持平或下降；DAPO场景中已实现分数上升14.7分，而可达到上限下降13.3分。
AI.conclusion: 已实现能力与可达到能力并不总是同步变化，能力扩展声明应在匹配评估条件下同时报告已实现性能与可达到性，而非仅依赖聚合基准分数。

title: Breaking ACDGV MinRank Gabidulin encryption schemes over matrix codes
summary: Enhanced Gabidulin Matrix Codes (EGMC), introduced by Aragon, Couvreur, Dyseryn, Gaborit, and Vincotte at Asiacrypt 2024, were designed to hide the algebraic structure of Gabidulin matrix codes while enabling very compact McEliece- and Niederreiter-type encryption schemes, with ciphertexts as small as $65$ bytes at the claimed 128-bit security level. Their security relies on the assumption that a masked EGMC code is hard to distinguish from a random matrix code. We show that this enhanced construction leaves enough structure for an equivalent code of the secret key to be recovered. Unlike previous cryptanalysis, our attack combines combinatorial and algebraic techniques to recover a Gabidulin-equivalent compressed code. This code can then be extended to a full-length equivalent secret key in polynomial time. As a result, the attack provides both a distinguisher and a key-recovery attack against the EGMC encryption schemes. The attack breaks all 16 proposed EGMC parameter sets by large margins. For example, for the claimed 128-bit parameter set $(2,17,37,4,0)$, it reduces the security level from 186 bits to 35 bits. In our implementation, the equivalent secret key is recovered in less than 10 minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文对Asiacrypt 2024提出的Enhanced Gabidulin Matrix Codes（EGMC）加密方案进行了密码分析，表明该方案仍保留了足够的结构信息，使得攻击者可以恢复与秘密密钥等价的编码。攻击结合组合与代数技术，恢复Gabidulin等价的压缩编码，再多项式时间内扩展为全长度等价密钥。该攻击对所有16个提出的EGMC参数集均构成区分攻击和密钥恢复攻击，例如将声称的128-bit安全级别从186比特降至35比特。
AI.motivation: EGMC是由Aragon等人于Asiacrypt 2024提出的密码方案，旨在隐藏Gabidulin矩阵编码的代数结构，同时实现极紧凑的McEliece和Niederreiter型加密方案（密文小至65字节）。其安全性依赖于"掩码后的EGMC编码难以与随机矩阵编码区分"这一假设。本文旨在检验这一安全性假设是否成立。
AI.method: 与以往仅使用单一技术的密码分析不同，本文提出了一种结合组合技术和代数技术的混合攻击方法。攻击流程包括：(1) 通过组合技术恢复一个Gabidulin等价的压缩编码；(2) 在多项式时间内将该压缩编码扩展为全长度的等价秘密密钥。该方法同时提供区分器和密钥恢复攻击两种效果。
AI.result: 攻击成功破解了全部16个EGMC参数集。例如，对于声称128-bit安全级别的参数集(2,17,37,4,0)，实际安全级别从186比特降至仅35比特。在实际实现中，恢复等价秘密密钥所需时间不超过10分钟。
AI.conclusion: EGMC加密方案未能实现其所声称的安全性，其增强构造虽然旨在隐藏代数结构，但残留的结构信息足以使攻击者恢复等价的秘密密钥，因此该方案需要重新设计或加强其安全假设。

title: SeCo-SBIR: Semantically Consistent Prompt Learning for Zero-Shot Sketch-Based Image Retrieval
summary: Adapting CLIP for zero-shot sketch-based image retrieval (ZS-SBIR) via prompt learning faces a fundamental tension: the model must bridge the sketch-photo domain gap through task-specific adaptation, yet the added flexibility risks overfitting to seen training categories and eroding CLIP's zero-shot generalization. We present SeCo-SBIR, a semantically consistent prompt learning framework that resolves this tension from both sides. First, a text-guided multi-modal prompting strategy routes learnable prompt vectors through CLIP's text encoder and projects the resulting intermediate representations into the visual encoder at every layer via learnable coupling functions. Because the text encoder has already learned robust, abstract category-level semantics from large-scale language supervision, this mechanism injects transferable semantic knowledge directly into the visual pathway - adapting the model to the sketch-photo domain while inherently favoring generalization to unseen classes. Second, a perturbation-based consistency constraint addresses the residual overfitting risk from the learnable coupling functions by aligning the adapted model with a frozen CLIP reference branch using an asymmetric InfoNCE objective - augmented inputs feed the frozen branch while clean inputs feed the trainable branch - anchoring the learned representations to CLIP's generalizable feature space. Together with lightweight adapters and a multi-objective loss combining triplet, NT-Xent, and classification terms, SeCo-SBIR achieves state-of-the-art results on all three standard ZS-SBIR benchmarks across categorical, generalized, and across-dataset settings.

AI.tldr: SeCo-SBIR提出了一个语义一致的提示学习框架，通过文本引导的多模态提示策略和基于扰动的一致性约束，解决了ZS-SBIR中任务适配与零样本泛化之间的根本性矛盾，在三个标准基准上取得了SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: CLIP用于零样本草图画检索（ZS-SBIR）时面临根本性矛盾：任务特定适配需要桥接草图-照片领域差距，但增加的灵活性可能导致对已见训练类别的过拟合，从而削弱CLIP的零样本泛化能力。
AI.method: SeCo-SBIR从两个方面解决这一矛盾：(1) 文本引导的多模态提示策略——将可学习的提示向量路由通过CLIP文本编码器，通过可学习的耦合函数在每个层将中间表示注入视觉编码器，利用文本编码器在大规模语言监督中学到的抽象类别语义来注入可迁移的知识；(2) 基于扰动的一致性约束——使用非对称InfoNCE目标将适配模型与冻结的CLIP参考分支对齐，增强输入进入冻结分支而干净输入进入可训练分支，锚定学习表示到CLIP的可泛化特征空间。此外结合轻量适配器和多目标损失（triplet、NT-Xent、分类损失）。
AI.result: 在三个标准ZS-SBIR基准（categorical、generalized、across-dataset）上均取得了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过双重机制（语义知识注入+特征空间锚定）成功兼顾了任务适配与零样本泛化，验证了在提示学习框架中利用CLIP文本编码器的抽象语义和冻结参考分支进行一致性约束的有效性。

title: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World-action modeling has emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control, as it empowers models to go beyond reacting to observations and anticipate how a scene will evolve. However, existing WAMs often incur substantial computational overhead. Pixel-space methods often allocate substantial capacity to visual details that may not be directly relevant to control, while some latent-space methods require multi-stage training to construct the reasoning space. The resulting training cost can make such methods difficult to train under modest computational budgets. In this work, we propose LiLa-WAM, a lightweight world-action model that reasons about the future in a compact latent space and can be trained end-to-end on a single 24GB GPU. Its core design is a compact latent reasoning space jointly shaped by future-state prediction and action generation, which keeps the model lightweight while remaining well aligned with control. For task specification, we further propose the Visual Transition Token(VTT), a language-free task representation that encodes each task as a direction in visual feature space. Experiments on RoboTwin~2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot tasks demonstrate LiLa-WAM's effectiveness, achieving 90.48\% success across 50 RoboTwin tasks with single-GPU training.

AI.tldr: LiLa-WAM是一种轻量级世界-动作模型（WAM），在紧凑潜空间中推理未来状态，可在单张24GB GPU上端到端训练，并通过Visual Transition Token（VTT）实现无需语言的视觉任务表征，在RoboTwin、LIBERO和真实机器人任务上表现出色，其中在50个RoboTwin任务上达到90.48%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）存在较大的计算开销：像素空间方法将大量容量分配给与控制无关的视觉细节，而部分潜空间方法需要多阶段训练来构建推理空间，导致训练成本高昂，难以在有限计算预算下训练。
AI.method: 提出LiLa-WAM，其核心是一个由未来状态预测和动作生成共同塑造的紧凑潜推理空间，使模型保持轻量同时与控制任务良好对齐。此外提出Visual Transition Token（VTT），一种无语言的任务表示方式，将每个任务编码为视觉特征空间中的一个方向。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO和真实机器人任务上验证了有效性，其中在50个RoboTwin任务上通过单GPU训练达到90.48%的成功率。
