AI.conclusion: LiLa-WAM证明了一种轻量级世界-动作模型可以通过紧凑潜空间端到端训练实现高效且有效的机器人控制，同时VTT作为一种语言无关的任务表征方式为任务指定提供了新思路。

title: ICO: Enhancing Semantic-Shift Jailbreaks via Iterative Context Optimization
summary: Foundation models have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable. To investigate such vulnerabilities, semantic-shift jailbreaks have recently emerged as a promising attack paradigm. They bypass explicit safety mechanisms by replacing harmful terms in original harmful questions with benign alternatives and leveraging contextual information to induce the target model to reinterpret these alternatives as their corresponding harmful concepts. However, existing semantic-shift jailbreaks often achieve limited effectiveness. In this work, we reveal that this limitation arises from overlooking the semantic-shift capability of contexts. Through systematic analysis, we find that contexts exhibit substantially different abilities in inducing semantic shifts: contexts with stronger semantic-shift capabilities are more likely to guide models toward recovering harmful meanings and achieving successful jailbreaks. Based on this finding, we systematically identify and distill the characteristics of effective contexts and propose a black-box context-aware semantic-shift jailbreak framework with Iterative Context Optimization (ICO). In each iteration, ICO leverages these characteristics and feedback from the target model to optimize contexts. Extensive experiments on three datasets and eight target foundation models demonstrate that ICO consistently outperforms eight state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average attack success rate of 74.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种黑盒上下文感知的语义偏移越狱框架（ICO），通过迭代优化上下文来增强语义偏移攻击的效果，在三个数据集和八个目标模型上平均攻击成功率达74.6%，优于八个SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义偏移越狱攻击效果有限，作者发现这是因为忽略了上下文的语义偏移能力。不同上下文在诱导模型进行语义偏移时表现出显著差异，更强的上下文更容易引导模型恢复有害语义并实现越狱成功。
AI.method: 首先系统分析并识别了有效上下文的特征，然后提出黑盒上下文感知语义偏移越狱框架ICO（Iterative Context Optimization）。在每一轮迭代中，ICO利用所识别的上下文特征和目标模型的反馈来优化上下文，逐步提升语义偏移攻击的成功率。
AI.result: 在三个数据集和八个目标基础模型上的大量实验表明，ICO一致性地优于八个SOTA基线方法，平均攻击成功率达到74.6%。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了上下文的语义偏移能力对语义偏移越狱攻击有效性的关键影响，并提出了一个简单有效的黑盒优化框架ICO，显著提升了语义偏移越狱攻击的性能。

title: A Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator for Transient Magnetization Prediction in Power Magnetics
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Preprint prepared for possible submission to IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics
summary: Magnetic components in high-frequency, high-power-density converters are increasingly driven by non-sinusoidal flux-density waveforms with fast transitions, minor-loop operation, dc bias, and temperature variation. Under these conditions, steady-state core-loss formulas and single-valued material curves cannot fully capture transient magnetization responses. This work proposes the Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO), a compact material-specific neural model with B-H energy-consistency regularization for core-loss-oriented transient magnetization prediction. Given the measured B(t)-H(t) history, the input B(t) series over the prediction interval and operating-condition information, PI-HNO predicts the H(t) series and the corresponding reconstructed B-H trajectory. The model integrates a local recurrent branch for boundary-state representation and rate-dependent response evolution with a Preisach-inspired global branch that extracts waveform-level hysteresis context. Evaluation on the MagNetX transient database using material-specific models for 14 ferrite materials demonstrates that PI-HNO achieves a compact trade-off between sequence accuracy and B(t)-H(t) energy consistency, with the mean and 95th percentile B(t)-H(t) energy consistency errors of 1.92% and 7.60%, respectively, using only 4777 trainable parameters per model. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the local, global, and energy-aware regularized components provide distinct contributions to transient magnetization prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），一种紧凑的材料特定神经网络模型，用于预测高频功率变换器中磁性元件在非正弦磁通密度波形下的瞬态磁化响应，在MagNetX瞬态数据库的14种铁氧体材料上实现了1.92%的平均和7.60%的95百分位B-H能量一致性误差，仅需4777个可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 高频高功率密度变换器中的磁性元件常受非正弦磁通密度波形驱动，包含快速过渡、小磁滞回环运行、直流偏置和温度变化等复杂条件。在这些条件下，传统的稳态铁芯损耗公式和单一值材料曲线无法充分捕捉瞬态磁化响应，因此需要能够准确预测瞬态磁化行为的模型。
AI.method: PI-HNO将局部循环分支（用于边界状态表示和率依赖响应演化）与受Preisach启发的全局分支（提取波形级别的磁滞上下文）相结合。模型以测量的B(t)-H(t)历史、预测区间的B(t)序列输入及运行条件信息，预测H(t)序列及重构的B-H轨迹，并通过B-H能量一致性正则化进行训练。
AI.result: 在MagNetX瞬态数据库上，对14种铁氧体材料分别训练材料特定模型，PI-HNO在序列精度与B(t)-H(t)能量一致性之间实现了紧凑的权衡，平均能量一致性误差为1.92%，95百分位误差为7.60%，每模型仅4777个可训练参数。消融研究证明局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测各有独特贡献。
AI.conclusion: PI-HNO通过物理信息正则化和混合网络架构，以极小的模型参数实现了高精度的瞬态磁化预测，为高频磁性元件建模提供了一种兼具精度、紧凑性和物理一致性的解决方案。

title: UniNav: A Unified World-Action Diffusion Model for Visual Navigation
summary: Image-goal visual navigation is a fundamental capability for embodied agents. Existing navigation policies efficiently predict waypoint trajectories but lack visual foresight, while navigation world models can anticipate future observations but often require costly planning rollouts. We present UniNav, a unified world-action model that generates future visual observations and continuous waypoint trajectories through a single diffusion process. Given history frames and a goal image, UniNav jointly denoises visual and waypoint tokens within a single transformer, unifying future prediction and action generation in a shared framework. To improve spatial grounding, we incorporate geometry-aware camera tokens. We also train on both trajectory-labeled navigation data and video-only data, enabling the model to benefit from diverse videos without waypoint annotations. Based on this unified framework, we introduce two variants: UniNav-Full jointly predicts interpretable future observations and their corresponding trajectories, while UniNav-Fast removes future-image tokens at inference for efficient trajectory prediction. Experiments on navigation benchmarks show that UniNav outperforms the strongest baseline in ATE across all datasets. With one-step inference, UniNav-Fast achieves a latency of 0.1s without a substantial accuracy drop. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: UniNav是一个统一的世界-动作模型，通过单一扩散过程同时生成未来视觉观测和连续航点轨迹，解决了现有导航策略缺乏视觉预见性、导航世界模型规划成本高的问题。基于统一框架提出UniNav-Full和UniNav-Fast两种变体，在导航基准上全面优于最先进基线，一步推理延迟仅0.1秒。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像目标视觉导航方法存在两难：导航策略虽然能高效预测航点轨迹但缺乏视觉前瞻能力；而导航世界模型虽然能预测未来观测但通常需要昂贵的规划滚动。作者旨在统一这对矛盾的范式，让模型同时具备视觉预见性和高效的动作生成能力。
AI.method: UniNav通过单一扩散过程在同一个Transformer中联合去噪视觉token和航点token。具体包括：(1) 引入几何感知的相机token增强空间定位能力；(2) 同时在带轨迹标注的导航数据和纯视频数据上训练，无需航点标注也能受益于多样化的视频；(3) 提出两种变体：UniNav-Full联合预测可解释的未来观测及其轨迹，UniNav-Fast在推理时移除未来图像token以实现高效轨迹预测。
AI.result: 在导航基准上，UniNav在所有数据集的ATE（平均轨迹误差）指标上优于最强基线。UniNav-Fast通过一步推理实现0.1秒的低延迟，且不会导致显著的精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 统一的世界-动作建模框架能够同时兼顾未来观测预测和动作生成的效率，在保持高精度的同时实现实时导航性能，为视觉导航提供了一种新的架构范式。

title: SkillSentry: Adaptive Honey Worlds for Dynamic Safety Testing of Agent Skills
summary: External skills extend the capabilities of large language model agents, but also introduce an execution-time attack surface: a skill that appears benign under inspection may reveal harmful behavior only after particular environmental states, resources, or interaction histories are encountered. Existing scanners primarily rely on static analysis, predefined rules, or one-shot semantic judgments, making such conditional behavior difficult to elicit and attribute. We present SkillSentry, a dynamic safety-testing framework based on adaptive honey worlds. SkillSentry infers the intended capability boundary of a skill, constructs an LLM-simulated environment with controlled decoy resources, and adaptively generates tasks to explore its behavioral states. It then compares skill-enabled trajectories with matched no-skill executions, grounding suspicious behaviors in source code and verified execution traces before making a final decision. We evaluate SkillSentry against seven scanner configurations. SkillSentry achieves 99.50% Recall and 96.26% average F1 on standard benchmarks. Under semantics-preserving evasion, it reaches 92.95% average F1, compared with 80.07% for the strongest baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/nizhangli062-jpg/SkillSentry-Adaptive-Honey-Worlds-for-Dynamic-Safety-Testing-of-Agent-Skills.

AI.tldr: SkillSentry是一个基于自适应蜜罐世界的动态安全测试框架，用于检测大语言模型智能体外置技能中的条件性恶意行为。它通过推断技能预期能力边界、构建LLM模拟环境并生成适应性任务来挖掘技能行为状态，并通过与无技能执行轨迹的对比来归因可疑行为。在标准基准上达到99.50%召回率和96.26%平均F1，在语义保持规避下达到92.95%平均F1，显著优于最强基线（80.07%）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体的外置技能引入了执行时攻击面：技能在静态检查时看似良性，但可能在特定环境状态、资源或交互历史下才表现出有害行为。现有扫描器主要依赖静态分析、预定义规则或一次性语义判断，难以有效诱发和归因这种条件性恶意行为。
AI.method: SkillSentry采用四步流程：(1)推断技能预期的能力边界；(2)构建带有受控诱饵资源的LLM模拟环境（蜜罐世界）；(3)自适应生成任务以探索技能的不同行为状态；(4)将技能启用的执行轨迹与匹配的无技能执行轨迹进行对比，将可疑行为追溯到源代码和验证过的执行痕迹后再做最终判定。
AI.result: 在七个扫描器配置上评估，SkillSentry在标准基准上达到99.50%召回率和96.26%平均F1；在语义保持规避攻击下达到92.95%平均F1，而最强基线仅为80.07%。
AI.conclusion: SkillSentry通过动态、环境感知的测试方法有效弥补了传统静态扫描器在检测条件性恶意技能方面的不足，为智能体外置技能的安全性测试提供了一种更可靠、更具鲁棒性的解决方案。

title: Rectify Then Diffuse: Disentangling Concepts Before Denoising Trajectory Unfolds
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate individual concepts well, but they often omit or merge concepts incorrectly with multiple concepts. We trace these failures to an early coordination bottleneck: before denoising begins, prompt-conditioned attention may allocate different concepts to strongly overlapping spatial support, which can keep their attention coupled as denoising proceeds. This observation motivates treating compositional generation as a boundary-condition problem rather than repeatedly controlling the evolving trajectory. To this end, we propose Rectify-then-Diffuse (RTD), a training-free framework that rectifies the initial allocation once before standard denoising. Firstly, we propose Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD), which converts normalized overlap between pilot concept maps into a differentiable and layout-agnostic separation objective. Secondly, we introduce Isotropic Gradient Rectification (IGR), which normalizes the SOD gradient and applies a bounded latent displacement with a consistent scale across prompts and initializations. Extensive experiments show that RTD achieves state-of-the-art compositional fidelity and robust gains. On the AE-Bench object pair subset, RTD improves BLIP-VQA by 45.8% and ImageReward by 19.6% over CO3 while running 2.3$\times$ faster. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/rectify-then-diffuse

AI.tldr: 提出Rectify-then-Diffuse (RTD)，一种无需训练的组合式文生图框架，通过在去噪开始前一次性纠正初始注意力分配来解决多概念合成时的概念遗漏/合并问题。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图扩散模型在生成单个概念时表现良好，但在多个概念组合时经常出现概念遗漏或合并。作者追踪到根本原因在于去噪前的早期协调瓶颈：提示词条件注意力可能将不同概念分配到高度重叠的空间支持区域，导致后续去噪过程中注意力持续耦合。
AI.method: 将组合生成视为边界条件问题而非反复控制演化轨迹。RTD包含两个核心组件：(1) Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD)，将归一化的概念图重叠转化为可微分的布局无关分离目标；(2) Isotropic Gradient Rectification (IGR)，对SOD梯度进行归一化，并施加跨越提示词和初始条件均一致的缩放的有界潜空间位移。整个方法只需在标准去噪前执行一次，无需训练。
AI.result: 在AE-Bench对象对子集上，RTD相比CO3在BLIP-VQA上提升45.8%，在ImageReward上提升19.6%，同时推理速度快2.3倍。实验表明RTD达到了最先进的组合保真度和稳健性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证了组合生成的失败根源在于初始注意力分配的过早耦合，通过在去噪前一次性修正初始分配而非反复干预去噪轨迹，可以更高效且更有效地提升组合保真度。

title: Track4Action: Distilling World-Centric 3D Tracker into Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Action labels tell a vision-language-action (VLA) policy which robot commands to imitate, but not how those commands change the 3D world. The aligned demonstration clip contains this missing supervision because its $K$ frame transitions record the geometry, motion, visibility, and camera change produced during the corresponding $K$ actions. We introduce Track4Action, a framework that distills this realized transition from a frozen world-centric 3D tracker into a current-observation VLA policy. During training, Track4World encodes the clip $V_{t:t+K}$ into a pooled tracker feature. Learnable track queries infer this feature from current VLA hidden states, match it in a shared space, and condition a flow-matching action head through a feature-wise gate. The tracker feature only defines the alignment target, so neither the clip nor the tracker is used at deployment. Track4Action reaches 82.3% on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, improving the alignment-free variant by 7.6 points and LaMP by 3.0 points. It obtains 80.44% and 81.48% on the clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 splits, and 67.5% average success across four physical bimanual tasks, 25.0 points above the alignment-free variant. The gains across simulation and physical tasks support action-aligned 3D tracker features as privileged supervision for tracker-free VLA deployment. Our project page is available at https://wing0night.github.io/track4action-project-page.

AI.tldr: Track4Action 提出从冻结的3D世界中心跟踪器中蒸馏动作实现的转移信息（几何、运动、可见性与相机变化）到当前观测的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中。训练时通过可学习的track查询将当前VLA隐藏状态与剪辑的pooled tracker特征对齐，并采用特征门控条件化流匹配动作头；推理时无需使用剪辑或跟踪器。在LIBERO-Plus零样本（82.3%）、RoboTwin 2.0（80.44%/81.48%）及物理双臂任务（67.5%）上均优于对齐无关基线。
AI.motivation: 动作标签只告诉VLA策略模仿哪些机器人命令，却不说明这些命令如何改变3D世界；而对齐的示范剪辑包含这一缺失监督。作者希望利用剪辑中K帧转移所记录的真实世界变化来提供更丰富的对齐监督。
AI.method: 1) Track4World在训练时将剪辑V_{t:t+K}编码为pooled tracker特征；2) 可学习的track queries从当前VLA隐藏状态推断该特征，并在共享空间中匹配；3) 通过特征级门控（feature-wise gate）调节流匹配动作头；4) 跟踪器特征仅定义对齐目标，部署时无需剪辑和跟踪器。
AI.result: LIBERO-Plus零样本达82.3%，较对齐无关变体提升7.6点，较LaMP提升3.0点；RoboTwin 2.0干净/随机分割分别达80.44%和81.48%；物理双臂任务平均成功率67.5%，较对齐无关变体高25.0点。
AI.conclusion: 跨仿真与物理任务的增益表明，与动作对齐的3D跟踪器特征可作为特权监督，支持无需跟踪器部署的VLA策略，验证了动作对齐跟踪特征的有效性与泛化性。

title: On the Diversity of Analogy Making in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for analogy making, a core cognitive capability that drives novelty and creativity. While prior research has extensively investigated the applications and underlying mechanisms of LLM-based analogy making, its output diversity remains largely unexplored, despite being essential for broadening cross-domain connections and fostering scientific innovation. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of analogy diversity across ten state-of-the-art open- and closed-source LLMs. Our findings highlight a concerning issue of domain homogeneity, a prevalent tendency for LLMs to generate analogies from a narrow set of target domains, limiting both inter-query and intra-model diversity. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a fundamental trade-off in existing LLM diversity-enhancement methods: increasing output diversity often comes at the expense of output quality. Finally, our causal analysis of LLM information flow reveals substantial differences in the model-sensitive regions governing analogy diversity across LLMs, suggesting a potential mechanism for the observed diversity-quality trade-off. To our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate output diversity in LLM-based analogy making.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了十个先进大语言模型在类比生成任务中的输出多样性，发现领域同质化问题普遍存在，并揭示了多样性增强方法与输出质量之间的根本性权衡，同时通过信息流因果分析探索了这一权衡背后的机制。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在类比生成方面展现了巨大潜力，但此前研究主要关注其应用和底层机制，输出多样性这一对跨领域连接和科学创新至关重要的维度却被忽视。
AI.method: 对十个最新的开源和闭源LLM进行类比多样性综合评估；结合因果分析研究LLM信息流，考察控制类比多样性的模型敏感区域在不同LLM间的差异。
AI.result: 发现LLM存在领域同质化问题，倾向于从狭窄的目标领域生成类比，限制了查询间和模型内多样性；现有多样性增强方法面临多样性-质量权衡；信息流因果分析显示不同LLM中控制类比多样性的敏感区域存在显著差异，可能解释了观察到的权衡现象。
AI.conclusion: 这是首批系统研究LLM类比生成中输出多样性的工作之一，揭示了领域同质化这一普遍问题及多样性-质量权衡的内在机制，为未来改进LLM类比生成的多样性提供了理论基础。

title: Temporal Leakage in LLM Backtesting: Measurement, Validation, and Adjusted Scores
comment: 12 pages main content, 45 pages in total
summary: The standard check for contamination in LLM backtests is simple: compare scores before and after the training cutoff. We show this check is uninformative. Four flagship models fail it on questions they cannot have memorized: every scored question resolved after their cutoffs. The reason is structural. Models legitimately know more about times near their cutoff, so recency mimics leakage, and we prove no passive backtest can separate the two from genuine skill. Measurement, not just detection, requires information from outside the backtest. We supply it in two forms. A known cutoff identifies leakage at the boundary; a matched clean control identifies it globally and yields a leakage-adjusted score. We also derive where leakage hides: it concentrates on outcomes that surprised the crowd and were well covered in training, and partial memorization is disproportionately rewarded. We validate the estimators against ground truth by planting leakage in twin models, where they recover the injected dose and return null on clean questions. Deployed on frontier models, they detect one cutoff-localized signature and, at the audit's power floor, clear five models whose apparent advantages were recency alone. Backtests need not be discarded; they need one defensible reference.

AI.tldr: 本文指出LLM回测中常用的数据污染检测方法（比较训练截止前后得分）实际上无法有效区分记忆与真实能力，因为模型对临近截止时间点的知识天然更多，使得"近因效应"伪装成泄漏。作者提出两种外部信息源来改善测量：已知截止点识别边界泄漏，匹配的干净对照组实现全局检测并给出泄漏校正分数。验证实验表明该方法可恢复注入的泄漏剂量，并在前沿模型审计中发现一个截止点局部特征，同时清除了五个模型的虚假优势。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM回测中的污染检测方法过于简单且具有误导性——仅对比训练截止前后的得分无法区分真正的记忆泄露与模型对近期事件的自然知识优势（近因效应）。由于模型对接近截止时间的信息天然了解更多，这种结构性偏差会使简单的泄漏检测失效，因此需要引入回测外部的信息才能实现准确测量。
AI.method: 1) 理论上证明仅靠被动回测无法区分近因效应与真实泄漏引发的分数差异；2) 提出两种外部信息源：已知截止点用于识别边界泄漏，匹配的干净对照组用于全局检测并计算泄漏调整分数；3) 推导泄漏的分布规律——集中在令大众惊讶且训练中覆盖充分的结果上，部分记忆会获得不成比例的奖励；4) 通过孪生模型注入泄漏作为ground truth进行估计器验证。
AI.result: 验证实验表明估计器能准确恢复注入的泄漏剂量，并在干净问题上返回空结果。部署于前沿模型时，检测到一个截止点局部化的统计特征；在审计的功率下限下，五个模型的表观优势被判定为仅由近因效应造成而非真实能力。简单的截止前后分数对比方法对所有四个旗舰模型在截止后问题上也未能给出有效信号。
AI.conclusion: LLM回测不需要被废弃，只需一个可辩护的外部参考（或其等效信息）。该研究提供了从回测外部获取信息的系统性方法框架，使得泄漏测量和校正成为可能。

title: One Knob to Rule Them All: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Cold-Start Active Learning
summary: Cold-Start Active Learning (CSAL) aims to select a valuable subset from an unlabeled pool without any prior knowledge or human assistance. Existing methods take diverse routes based on typicality, coverage, or diversity. Each rests on its own inductive bias and therefore performs well on some tasks yet poorly on others. We argue that the real challenge is not to design yet another selection heuristic, but to make CSAL adapt automatically to the data and task at hand. To this end, we revisit CSAL through the lens of optimal transport. First, we propose a generalized transport selection framework that reveals the shared allocation structure of existing methods and exactly subsumes representative formulations. Second, we introduce a theoretical analysis that characterizes the trade-off controlled by entropic regularization and establishes a task-agnostic minimax bound for cold-start selection. These results provide a principled foundation for adapting the regularization strength to the unlabeled data. Third, we derive a data-adaptive regularization rule and present a novel Sinkhorn-based CSAL algorithm, termed $ε$-Adaptive Selection ($ε$-AS). Extensive experiments on six public datasets and multiple annotation budgets show that $ε$-AS consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. On ImageNet-1k, it improves the average accuracy over ActiveFT by 1.29% while reducing selection time by 56.2%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/OT-CSAL

AI.tldr: 本文提出ε-AS算法，通过最优传输理论重新审视冷启动主动学习（CSAL），将现有方法的分配结构统一到广义传输选择框架下，并推导出数据自适应的熵正则化规则，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CSAL方法基于典型性、覆盖性或多样性等不同归纳偏置，每个方法只在部分任务上表现良好而其他任务上表现不佳。作者认为真正的挑战不是设计新的选择启发式方法，而是让CSAL能够自动适应数据和任务，因此需要一种更统一且自适应的框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出广义传输选择框架，统一了现有方法的共享分配结构并精确包含代表性公式；2) 引入理论分析刻画熵正则化控制的权衡，建立任务无关的minimax下界；3) 基于这些理论基础推导出数据自适应的正则化规则，提出基于Sinkhorn的ε-AS算法。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集和多个标注预算下，ε-AS一致达到SOTA性能。在ImageNet-1k上比ActiveFT平均准确率提升1.29%，选择时间减少56.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过最优传输理论统一了现有CSAL方法，并提供了数据自适应的理论依据和实用算法，证明基于理论指导的自适应方法优于依赖固定归纳偏置的现有方法。

title: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents increasingly convert interaction histories into reusable skills that persist beyond individual tasks. While prior work studies memory and retrieval poisoning, such attacks only affect agents when poisoned records are retrieved as context. We uncover a new and more fundamental risk: poisoned experiences can be transformed by the agent itself into durable behavioral artifacts. We present \textbf{SkillJack}, the first attack that exploits the experience-to-skill pipeline of self-evolving agents. Instead of directly manipulating runtime context, SkillJack hijacks the agent's own learning process to implant malicious behaviors into its reusable skill repertoire. We identify three key properties of this transformation: \emph{sanitization whitewashing}, where malicious intent is obscured during skill extraction; \emph{cross-layer promotion}, where transient experiences become persistent capabilities; and \emph{persistence isolation}, where the attack survives removal of its original source records. We evaluate SkillJack on two representative systems, SkillX and Anything2Skill, using a shared dataset of 150 trajectories across four policy-risk categories. Results show that skill extraction substantially reduces attack detectability: in SkillX, safety detection drops from 98.5\% for poisoned trajectories to 11.4\% for extracted skills, while Anything2Skill shows a similar effect. Meanwhile, the implanted skills remain effective, achieving attack success rates of 56.2\% and 89.2\% on the two systems, respectively. Furthermore, 80.0\% of skill-mediated attacks persist after deleting the original poisoned records, and some skills unintentionally activate on benign queries. Our findings reveal skill evolution as a new attack surface and motivate provenance-aware skill lifecycle protection. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/research/skilljack.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SkillJack，首个针对自进化智能体经验转技能管道的攻击方法，通过劫持智能体自身的学习过程将恶意行为植入其可复用技能库中，使攻击在原始恶意记录被删除后仍然持久存在。
AI.motivation: 现有针对自进化智能体的攻击（如记忆和检索投毒）只在有毒记录被检索作为上下文时才有效，存在根本性的局限性。作者发现了一个更根本的风险：被投毒的经验可以被智能体自身转化为持久的行为工件。这一新攻击面此前未被探索。
AI.method: 作者提出了SkillJack攻击框架，利用自进化智能体的经验-技能管道进行攻击，并识别了该转化过程中的三个关键属性：消毒白化（恶意意图在技能提取中被掩盖）、跨层提升（短暂经验变成持久能力）、持久隔离（攻击在删除原始来源记录后仍存活）。在SkillX和Anything2Skill两个系统上使用150条轨迹、跨四个策略风险类别进行评估。
AI.result: 技能提取大幅降低了攻击可检测性：SkillX中安全检测从投毒轨迹的98.5%降至提取技能的11.4%；Anything2Skill也呈现类似效果。植入技能的attack success rate在两个系统上分别达到56.2%和89.2%；80.0%的技能介导攻击在删除原始记录后仍持续存在，部分技能还会在良性查询上意外激活。
AI.conclusion: 技能进化构成了一个新的攻击面，需要来源感知的技能生命周期保护机制。作者已公开代码以促进进一步研究。

title: Frozen High-Resolution Inference for Cross-City Object Detection: An AI City Challenge 2026 Study
summary: Cross-city object detection requires a detector trained in one city to generalize to an unlabeled target city. In AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, we analyze archived configurations of a single RF-DETR-Large detector inside an air-gapped Training-as-a-Service platform whose server returns only an aggregate COCO-style AP over a hidden mixture of source- and target-city images. Frozen 1120 x 1120 inference of a checkpoint trained at 704 x 704 achieved the highest aggregate AP among the evaluated configurations (0.3272 -> 0.3654, +0.0382) without any parameter update, with the largest relative gain on small objects and the largest absolute gain on medium objects, at 2.53x the input pixels. A warm-start 1120px fine-tuning recipe reached 0.3470 while its in-domain validation AP rose (0.767 -> 0.789), a caution that in-domain validation is an unreliable model-selection signal under aggregate-only cross-city feedback. Because that run's evaluation used a higher confidence threshold than the inference-only runs (0.05 vs. 0.01), we treat its score as a descriptive archived outcome rather than a controlled verdict on fine-tuning. Gray-world normalization did not meaningfully change the frozen-1120 result, and a rectangular run was found by audit to have used an unintended portrait orientation. We release verbatim platform commands, configuration snapshots, and an explicit evidence boundary for every claim. Each configuration was submitted once and the best was selected on the hidden server, so these are exploratory, audited findings about the aggregate mixture; they do not establish target-city-specific improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了在气隙训练即服务平台上对单一RF-DETR-Large检测器进行跨城市目标检测的存档配置审计。关键发现是：冻结的1120×1120推理（训练于704×704）无需任何参数更新，即获得最高聚合AP（0.3272→0.3654，+0.0382），小目标相对增益最大、中目标绝对增益最大，代价是输入像素的2.53倍。热启动微调及灰世界归一化等实验结果均未超越该推理配置，且揭示领域内验证在仅聚合反馈下是不可靠的模型选择信号。
AI.motivation: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6中，跨城市目标检测需要让在一个城市训练的检测器泛化到未标注的目标城市。由于平台是气隙环境且服务器仅返回隐藏在混合源/目标城市图像上的聚合COCO-style AP，作者旨在通过审计存档配置来探索：在不进行参数更新的情况下，单纯依靠推理分辨率缩放能否带来跨城市检测性能提升，并评估各种配置策略的有效性。
AI.method: 在气隙的Training-as-a-Service平台中对单一RF-DETR-Large检测器进行多组存档配置的实证比较。具体包括：(1) 冻结的1120×1120推理（模型训练于704×704，无参数更新）；(2) 热启动的1120px微调配方；(3) 灰世界归一化与冻结-1120结合；(4) 一次矩形运行（审计发现使用了意外的纵向方向）。每次配置仅提交一次，最佳配置在隐藏服务器上被选定。
AI.result: 冻结1120×1120推理获得最高聚合AP 0.3654（较0.3272提升+0.0382），相比2.53倍输入像素的代价，在小型物体上获得最大相对增益、中型物体上获得最大绝对增益。热启动1120px微调达到0.3470，但其领域内验证AP反而上升（0.767→0.789），且该运行使用了更高的置信阈值（0.05 vs 0.01），故仅视为描述性存档结果而非受控结论。灰世界归一化几乎不影响冻结-1120结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的核心结论是：在仅聚合跨城市反馈的条件下，推理时分辨率放大（而不更新参数）是一种简单有效的跨城市泛化增强手段；而领域内验证AP在聚合反馈设置下是误导性的模型选择信号。作者强调所有发现均为探索性、经审计的观察结果，不建立目标城市专属改进的因果结论，并公布了完整命令、配置快照及每个声明的证据边界以保证可复现性与透明度。

title: GORDON: Graph-based Object-centric Rewards for Decomposition of Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Learning long-horizon manipulation skills with reinforcement learning remains challenging due to the complexity of reward design, the limited guidance of sparse rewards, and the high cost of manual subtask annotation. Visual demonstrations can provide supervision for reward learning, but rewards learned from raw pixels can be brittle and sensitive to visual variation, background appearance, and robot motion. In this work, we propose GORDON, a graph-based object-centric reward learning framework that learns dense rewards from action-free video demonstrations. Each visual scene is represented as a graph of detected objects and spatial relations, and a graph neural network is trained in a self-supervised manner to embed these graphs into a task-aligned latent space. To align the representation with semantic task progress, we introduce an activity-aware weighted pooling mechanism that emphasizes task-relevant objects while masking robot-dominated motion. The dense reward is then computed as distances in the learned latent space of the current state to demonstrated goal configurations, providing a measure of task progress. In long-horizon tasks, the temporal profile of this reward reveals stage-wise object-state transitions, enabling automatic subtask discovery without manual segmentation. The discovered segments are then used to train subtask-specific rewards and specialized policies that are composed sequentially. Experiments on seven manipulation tasks on MAGICAL and ManiSkill3 benchmarks show that our object-centric reward improves reinforcement learning in short-horizon settings and enables successful policy learning in complex long-horizon tasks through automatic decomposition, achieving an average success rate of 74.4% across the long-horizon tasks (on average approximately +35 p.p. vs. best learned baseline and approximately +25 p.p. vs. oracle).

AI.tldr: 本文提出GORDON，一个基于图的对象中心奖励学习框架，从无动作视频演示中学习密集奖励。通过将视觉场景表示为检测对象和空间关系的图，用自监督方式训练图神经网络嵌入任务对齐的潜在空间，并引入活动感知加权池化机制强调任务相关对象。奖励计算为当前状态到演示目标构型在潜在空间中的距离。在长时序任务中，该奖励的时间分布可揭示阶段性的对象状态转换，实现自动子任务发现。在MAGICAL和ManiSkill3基准的七个操作任务中，长时序任务平均成功率达74.4%，比最强学习基线高约+35个百分点，比oracle高约+25个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长时序操作技能强化学习面临奖励设计复杂、稀疏奖励指导有限、手动子任务标注成本高等挑战。虽然视觉演示可为奖励学习提供监督，但从原始像素学习的奖励往往脆弱，对视觉变化、背景外观和机器人运动敏感。
AI.method: 1) 将每个视觉场景表示为检测对象及空间关系的图；2) 用自监督方式训练图神经网络将图嵌入任务对齐的潜在空间；3) 引入活动感知加权池化机制，强调任务相关对象并屏蔽机器人主导的运动；4) 密集奖励计算为当前状态与演示目标构型在潜在空间中的距离；5) 利用奖励的时间分布特征发现阶段性的对象状态转换，实现自动子任务发现；6) 用发现的子任务段训练子任务特定奖励和专门策略，按顺序组合执行。
AI.result: 在MAGICAL和ManiSkill3基准的七个操作任务上验证：(1)对象中心奖励在短时序设置中能改善强化学习；(2)通过自动分解实现了长时序复杂任务的成功策略学习，平均成功率达74.4%，比最佳学习基线高约+35个百分点，比oracle高约+25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GORDON通过对象中心的图表示和活动感知池化机制，有效缓解了像素级奖励的脆弱性问题，同时通过奖励时间分布自动发现子任务，避免了手动标注成本，在短时序和长时序操作任务中都展现了显著优势。

title: Relational Priors as Convergence Pressure in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) are designed through roles, debate protocols, and aggregation rules. These choices create implicit social expectations: agents may be expected to trust, challenge, defer to, or collaborate with peers. We study the effects of making inter-agent relation semantics explicit. We use a minimal signed-network formulation of relational priors and inject natural-language renderings into agent system prompts while holding the task protocol fixed. Across a commons-governance simulation and multi-agent debate, relational priors primarily act as convergence pressure: increasing relational positivity tends to make agents coordinate or agree more readily. This pressure can help when utility rewards behavioral alignment, as in sustainable resource governance and subjective consensus. It does not, however, reliably improve accuracy. In objective QA debates, higher positivity can increase agreement even when correctness-conditioned agreement does not improve and may decline in some settings. Effects vary by model backbone, relation type, and topology; explicit neutrality is not equivalent to omitting relational framing. We argue that relational priors should not be a default add-on for LLM-MAS. Their safer use is diagnostic and task-specific: compare against a no-prior baseline, monitor correctness-conditioned metrics when truth matters, and omit the relational layer when validation does not justify it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在大语言模型多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）中显式注入智能体间关系语义（关系先验）的影响。通过在有符号网络框架中表达关系先验并将其以自然语言形式注入系统提示，发现关系先验主要起"收敛压力"作用：正向关系促使智能体更易协调或达成一致。这种压力在奖励行为对齐的任务（如资源治理、主观共识）中有帮助，但不能稳定提升准确率，在客观问答辩论中甚至可能以牺牲正确条件一致性为代价。作者主张关系先验不应作为默认增强，而应作为诊断性和任务特定的工具使用。
AI.motivation: LLM-MAS通过角色、辩论协议和聚合规则设计，这些隐式选择创造了社会期望（信任、挑战、服从、协作等），但缺乏对智能体间关系语义的明确研究。作者希望弄清显式表达这些关系先验是否会根本性改变系统行为，以及这种变化是有益还是有害。
AI.method: 使用极简有符号网络（signed network）表述关系先验，将自然语言渲染注入智能体系统提示，在保持任务协议固定的条件下，在常识治理模拟和多智能体辩论两个场景中系统变化关系先验的符号（正/负/中性/无）、类型和拓扑，并比较不同模型骨干的效果。
AI.result: 关系先验主要充当收敛压力：正向关系促使智能体更易协调或一致。在奖励行为对齐的任务中（可持续资源治理、主观共识）有帮助；但在客观问答辩论中，更高正向关系可增加协议但正确条件一致性（correctness-conditioned agreement）可能持平或下降。效果因模型骨干、关系类型和拓扑而异；显式中性不等同于省略关系框架。
AI.conclusion: 关系先验不应作为LLM-MAS的默认附加配置。更安全的用法是诊断性和任务特定的：与无先验基线对照，在真理重要的任务中监控正确条件指标，若验证不支持则省略关系层。

title: TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning
summary: Long-context inference with large language models is constrained by the linear growth of the key-value cache to sequence length. While pruning offers mitigation, prevailing methods determine query-specific token importance that cannot be reused across unseen queries. In contrast, we introduce TaskPress, a framework for task-guided, query-agnostic KV cache eviction. Instead of optimizing the cache for a single query, TaskPress constructs a reusable memory representation conditioned on a high-level task guide. The guide functions as a meta-query during prefill to filter irrelevant tokens before downstream queries are issued. In addition, TaskPress leverages quantization scale factors as a zero-cost signal for detecting influential representation outliers, providing an efficient proxy for token importance. Experiments on conducted on various tasks with long context input demonstrate that TaskPress efficiently creates a compact, reusable cache across diverse queries.

AI.tldr: TaskPress是一个任务引导、查询无关的KV缓存驱逐框架，通过在预填充阶段使用高层任务指南作为元查询来过滤无关token，并利用量化缩放因子作为零成本信号检测重要表示离群值，从而构建跨查询可复用的紧凑缓存，缓解长上下文推理中KV缓存随序列长度线性增长的问题。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中，LLM的key-value缓存随序列长度线性增长，成为推理瓶颈。现有的剪枝方法通常确定查询相关的token重要性，这类重要性无法在未见过的查询之间复用，导致每次新查询都需要重新评估。
AI.method: TaskPress引入任务引导、查询无关的KV缓存驱逐机制。核心思想是：用一个高层任务指南（guide）作为预填充阶段的元查询（meta-query），在后续查询下发之前过滤无关token，从而构建可复用的内存表示。此外，TaskPress利用量化缩放因子作为零成本信号来检测有影响力的表示离群值，作为token重要性的高效代理。
AI.result: 在多种长上下文输入任务上的实验表明，TaskPress能够高效地创建紧凑的、跨不同查询可复用的缓存，在保持性能的同时显著降低KV缓存开销。
AI.conclusion: TaskPress验证了任务级引导的查询无关缓存驱逐策略的有效性，通过元查询过滤和量化缩放因子代理信号，实现了KV缓存的高效压缩与跨查询复用，为长上下文LLM推理优化提供了新思路。

title: AI Forensics Across White-, Grey-, and Black-Box Access: A Process Model and Research Agenda for Post-Incident Investigation of AI Systems
summary: AI systems are increasingly involved in decisions and actions that may later require investigation. When an AI related incident occurs, investigators need to reconstruct what the system did, why it behaved that way, and which part of the system or supply chain contributed to the outcome. Existing work on AI forensics remains fragmented, often focusing on a specific system type, artifact, or analysis technique. This paper argues that investigator access is a useful starting point for organizing the field. We distinguish white box, grey box, and black box access and show how each access level changes what can be collected, preserved, analyzed, and reported. Based on this distinction, we propose a process model matrix for AI forensics across four phases: collection, preservation, analysis, and reporting. We also introduce an order of volatility for AI systems, covering runtime state, context windows, logs, retrieval stores, model artifacts, and training lineage. From this matrix, we derive an access conditioned examination framework and identify open research problems, including black box preservation, model version attestation, uncertainty quantification for surrogate based analysis, and chain of custody for mutable AI artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以调查者访问权限（白盒、灰盒、黑盒）作为组织AI取证领域的核心框架，构建了涵盖收集、保存、分析、报告四个阶段的流程模型矩阵，并引入AI系统易失性排序，最终推导出访问条件化的检验框架及若干开放研究问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI取证研究碎片化严重，往往针对特定系统类型、工件或分析技术展开，缺乏统一的组织框架。随着AI系统深度介入决策与行动，事故调查亟需系统化重建AI行为及其成因的方法论，访问权限为此提供了自然的分类起点。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性分析方法：首先区分白盒、灰盒、黑盒三种调查者访问级别，阐明不同访问级别对取证各环节的影响；进而构建四阶段（收集、保存、分析、报告）的流程模型矩阵；同时引入AI系统的易失性排序（涵盖运行时状态、上下文窗口、日志、检索存储、模型工件及训练谱系），据此推导出访问条件化的检验框架。
AI.result: 提出了基于访问权限分类的AI取证过程模型矩阵，建立了针对AI系统取证的四阶段方法论；定义了AI系统的易失性排序层次；形成了访问条件化检验框架；识别出包括黑盒保存、模型版本证明、基于替代模型分析的预测不确定性量化、可变AI工件取证链管理等开放研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 访问权限是组织AI取证领域的有力起点，将取证过程与访问条件结合能够为调查实践提供结构化指导；但该领域仍面临黑盒场景下取证保真的根本性挑战，需要更多跨学科研究推动方法论成熟。

title: From Routes to Steps: Separating Semantic Progress from Local Execution in Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow a route-level instruction by executing its constituent steps from egocentric visual observations. Existing VLM-based navigators typically supervise both capabilities through next-action prediction alone, making progress-tracking errors difficult to distinguish from execution errors. When an agent deviates from the route, a corrective action label may recover the next movement but does not indicate whether the agent selected the wrong sub-instruction or failed to execute the correct one. Consequently, the agent may continue making decisions from an erroneous progress state. To resolve this ambiguity, we propose \textbf{Route2Step}, a framework that decouples semantic progress tracking from action generation through an explicit step-level interface. The Instruction Analysis Module ($\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{IA}}$) predicts this state from the global instruction and visual history. Conditioned on the predicted state and recent observations, the Action Generation Module ($\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{AG}}$) generates local action chunks. To supervise the progress state without manual temporal labels, E-SPA, a step-alignment procedure, associates sub-instructions with their corresponding portions of route-level demonstrations. These alignments enable state supervision for incorrect progress estimates, while direct action supervision is reserved for rollout groups that repeatedly fail under the correct active sub-instruction. On R2R-CE, Route2Step improves SR from 48.1\% to 55.3\% and SPL from 43.3\% to 48.2\%, using 190K state-level corrective samples while requiring only 11.5K directly action-supervised states. Experiments in real-world indoor and outdoor environments further demonstrate the practical applicability of Route2Step. The project page is: https://sisyphus-hxy.github.io/Route2Step/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Route2Step框架，将视觉-语言导航（VLN）中的语义进度跟踪与动作生成解耦，通过显式的步骤级接口解决进度跟踪错误与执行错误难以区分的问题。该方法在R2R-CE基准上将SR从48.1%提升至55.3%，SPL从43.3%提升至48.2%，并在真实室内外环境中验证了实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM导航器仅通过下一动作预测来同时监督进度跟踪和动作执行两种能力，使得进度跟踪错误与执行错误难以区分。当智能体偏离路线时，纠正性动作标签虽能恢复下一步移动，但无法指示智能体是选择了错误的子指令还是未能执行正确的子指令，导致智能体可能持续基于错误的进度状态做决策。
AI.method: Route2Step包含两个核心模块：(1) 指令分析模块（M_IA）从全局指令和视觉历史预测语义进度状态；(2) 动作生成模块（M_AG）基于预测状态和近期观测生成局部动作块。为监督进度状态，提出E-SPA步骤对齐程序，将子指令与路线级演示的对应部分关联，为错误的进度估计提供状态监督；直接动作监督则仅保留给在正确活动子指令下反复失败的rollout组。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE基准上，Route2Step将SR从48.1%提升至55.3%（+7.2%），SPL从43.3%提升至48.2%（+4.9%），仅需190K状态级纠正样本和11.5K直接动作监督状态。在真实室内外环境的实验中进一步验证了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: Route2Step通过解耦语义进度跟踪与动作生成，并结合E-SPA步骤对齐监督策略，有效解决了VLN中进度跟踪与执行错误的混淆问题，显著提升了导航性能，且在实际应用中表现出良好的泛化能力。

title: Design and Evaluation of an AI-Enabled Cloud-Edge Architecture for Connected Precision Agriculture Farms
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable AI for Social Impact and Global Development (SASIGD 2026), Hyderabad, India, 13-14 August 2026
summary: Plant diseases cause significant yield losses worldwide, with tomato crops particularly susceptible to early blight, late blight, and leaf mold. Manual monitoring is practical only for small-scale farms and becomes unmanageable at larger scales. To tackle this limitation, an artificial intelligence (AI) enabled cloud-edge architecture is proposed for autonomous crop monitoring. This proposed architecture integrates Internet of Things (IoT) sensors, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), deep learning, Azure IoT Hub-based cloud analytics, and multi-platform (mobile app, web app, and embedded edge device platform) interfaces to enable real-time detection of tomato diseases. For training and validation, we used publicly available datasets, such as PlantVillage and Kaggle. A TensorFlow model trained on a collected dataset is deployed across mobile, web, and edge-device platforms. Experimental results show detection effectiveness around 92-95%, with consistent performance over diverse environments and device platforms. The proposed system improves disease detection effectiveness, lowers dependence on manual inspection, and enables prompt interventions, thereby supporting sustainable, connected precision agriculture farms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AI的云边协同架构，整合物联网传感器、无人机、深度学习、Azure IoT Hub云分析和多平台接口（移动端、网页端、嵌入式边缘设备），实现番茄病害的实时检测，实验结果显示检测准确率约92-95%。
AI.motivation: 番茄作物易受早疫病、晚疫病和叶霉病等多种病害影响，造成全球范围内重大产量损失。人工监测仅适用于小规模农场，在更大规模上变得不可管理，亟需自动化作物监测方案。
AI.method: 提出AI驱动的云边端架构，集成IoT传感器、无人机、深度学习模型、Azure IoT Hub云分析以及移动端、Web端和嵌入式边缘设备等多平台接口。使用TensorFlow模型，基于公开数据集（PlantVillage和Kaggle）进行训练与验证，并跨多个平台部署。
AI.result: 实验结果显示病害检测准确率约为92-95%，且在不同环境和设备平台上表现稳定一致。
AI.conclusion: 该系统提升了病害检测效率，减少了对人工检查的依赖，支持及时干预，有助于可持续的、互联的精准农业农场建设。

title: MoEGen: Mixture-of-Experts for Instance-Adaptive LoRA Generation
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of large language models, but existing MoE-based PEFT methods typically improve capacity by storing multiple full LoRA experts, causing adapter storage to grow linearly with the number of experts and restricting adaptation to a fixed expert pool. We ask whether MoE-based PEFT can produce instance-specific adaptations without explicitly storing a separate LoRA module for each expert. To address this gap, we propose MoEGen, an adaptation framework that shifts MoE-based PEFT from expert selection to expert-conditioned parameter generation. Instead of storing each expert as a full LoRA adapter, MoEGen represents each expert as a small learnable vector, termed an expert code. It routes each input over these vectors and uses their weighted combination to condition a lightweight hypernetwork that generates input-specific low-rank updates. This design decouples expert capacity from adapter storage while enabling instance-conditioned adaptation. Experiments on eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong static and MoE-based PEFT baselines across three backbones. MoEGen also performs strongly in joint medical and legal-domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: MoEGen是一种将MoE-based PEFT从专家选择转变为专家条件参数生成的适配框架，通过轻量级超网络为每个输入生成条件化的低秩更新，解耦了专家容量与适配器存储，在八个常识推理基准上优于现有PEFT方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MoE的PEFT方法通常需要为每个专家存储完整的LoRA模块，导致适配器存储随专家数量线性增长，且局限于固定的专家池，无法在不显著增加存储开销的情况下实现实例特定的适应性。
AI.method: MoEGen将每个专家表示为一个小的可学习向量（专家编码），通过路由机制对输入进行加权组合，再利用轻量级超网络基于这些加权向量生成输入特定的低秩更新，从而将专家能力与适配器存储解耦，实现实例条件化适配。
AI.result: 在八个常识推理基准上，MoEGen在三个骨干模型上一致优于强静态和MoE-based PEFT基线；在医疗和法律领域的联合适配中也表现出色。
AI.conclusion: MoEGen通过专家编码加超网络生成的方式，在保持MoE能力增益的同时避免了存储随专家数线性增长的问题，为MoE-based PEFT提供了一种更高效、更具泛化性的适配范式。

title: Joint Affine Spectral Shaping: Coupling Weight and Bias Updates Beyond Weight-Only Muon
summary: Matrix spectral optimizers reshape weight-update spectra but usually delegate vector-valued biases to a separate optimizer. We study whether this separation is neutral. We formulate each affine layer as a joint momentum matrix $A=[M_W,αm_b]$ and apply a capped regularized-inverse spectral map to the complete matrix, producing both the weight and physical bias updates. A strict five-seed ablation on a four-layer BERT-mini trained from scratch on IMDb compares exact-SVD Muon, weight-only inverse shaping, affine-probe inverse shaping, and the proposed joint regularized inverse (JRI). Weight-only inverse shaping raises validation-loss-selected test accuracy from $84.903\pm0.242\%$ to $85.562\pm0.308\%$ and lowers selected test loss from $0.3479$ to $0.3345$. Allowing bias to alter the joint SVD while retaining an independent Adam bias update does not improve over weight-only inverse shaping. Using the transformed bias jointly raises selected test accuracy to $85.738\pm0.180\%$ and lowers test loss to $0.3291$, with all five seeds improving relative to the probe baseline. During the peak-performance window, JRI preserves the eligible weight-update norm while reducing the bias-update norm from $0.02095$ to $0.00301$, lowers boundary-function share from $86.58\%$ to $78.97\%$, and changes the cosine between weight-induced boundary motion and explicit bias from $+0.030$ to $-0.137$. An independent 22-seed replication yields $85.743\pm0.203\%$ selected test accuracy. These results identify joint affine spectral allocation as a small but consistent extension to weight-only spectral optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究矩阵谱优化器中权重与偏置分开优化的合理性，提出对仿射层整体（权重+偏置）施加联合正则化逆谱映射（JRI）的方法，在BERT-mini IMDb任务上将验证集选择的测试准确率从84.90%提升至85.74%，并降低了测试损失。
AI.motivation: 现有的矩阵谱优化器（如Muon）仅对权重矩阵进行谱变换，而将向量偏置委托给独立的优化器（如Adam）。作者质疑这种分离是否最优，即是否应该将权重和偏置作为一个联合矩阵进行统一的谱优化。
AI.method: 将每个仿射层构造为联合动量矩阵A=[M_W, αm_b]，对完整矩阵施加带截断的正则化逆谱映射，同时生成权重和物理偏置的更新。通过严格的五种子消融实验比较了精确SVD Muon、仅权重逆整形、仿射探针逆整形和提出的联合正则化逆（JRI）；此外还进行了22种子的独立复现。
AI.result: 仅权重逆整形将测试准确率从84.903%提升至85.562%，测试损失从0.3479降至0.3345。联合正则化逆（JRI）进一步将准确率提升至85.738%，测试损失降至0.3291，所有五种子均优于探针基线。JRI在峰值性能窗口将偏置更新范数从0.02095降至0.00301，将边界函数占比从86.58%降至78.97%，偏置与权重诱导边界运动间余弦从+0.030变为-0.137。22种子复现得到85.743%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 联合仿射谱分配是仅权重谱优化的一个虽小但一致的扩展，表明将偏置纳入联合谱映射可以带来稳定的性能提升。

title: AgentPanel: Toward a New Paradigm for Human--AI Collaboration in Exploring Scientific Questions
summary: Identifying promising scientific ideas remains an important challenge in research practice. Researchers commonly rely on small-group discussions or one-to-one interactions with a single large language model, yet these approaches often expose them to only a limited range of perspectives and directions. We present AgentPanel, a multi-agent forum for human--AI collaboration in scientific exploration. Heterogeneous agents asynchronously discuss scientific questions in a forum-style environment, while researchers can submit questions, browse and organize candidate ideas, engage agents in follow-up interactions, and optionally generate post-hoc summary reports. We evaluate AgentPanel in terms of idea quality, exploration breadth, interaction effectiveness, candidate-selection efficiency, and practical utility. Offline experiments show that AgentPanel outperforms a centralized multi-agent debate baseline. A human study with 20 participants further shows that users value AgentPanel for perspective diversity and exploration support. In experience-based comparisons with commonly used LLM tools, 65\% of participants favored AgentPanel for both breadth of research directions and overall suitability for early-stage exploration. The platform is publicly available at https://agentpanel.cc/.

AI.tldr: AgentPanel 是一个用于人类与AI协作科学探索的多智能体论坛平台。异构智能体以异步论坛形式讨论科学问题，研究者可提交问题、浏览组织候选想法、跟进互动并生成总结报告。离线实验显示其优于集中式多智能体辩论基线，20人用户研究及65%参与者的偏好对比表明其在视角多样性和早期探索方面具有实用价值。
AI.motivation: 识别有前景的科学思想是研究实践中的重要挑战。研究者通常依赖小组讨论或与单一LLM的交互，但这些方式往往只暴露有限范围的视角和方向，缺乏系统性的多视角探索支持。
AI.method: 提出AgentPanel多智能体论坛平台，采用异构智能体在论坛风格环境中异步讨论科学问题；研究者可以提交问题、浏览和组织候选想法、与智能体进行后续互动，并可选择生成事后总结报告。通过离线实验和20名参与者的人类研究进行系统评估。
AI.result: 离线实验表明AgentPanel优于集中式多智能体辩论基线；人类研究显示用户重视其视角多样性和探索支持；在与常用LLM工具的经验对比中，65%的参与者在研究方向广度及早期探索整体适用性方面更偏好AgentPanel。
AI.conclusion: AgentPanel通过多智能体异步论坛形式有效扩展了科学探索的视角广度和候选想法的多样性，是一种在早期科研探索阶段具有实际实用价值的人机协作平台。

title: A Challenge-Nonce Freshness Gap in Project Veraison's TPM Reference Schemes, Found by Appraising Application-Layer Action Evidence End-to-End
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures. Responsible disclosure: veraison/services#427, fixed in PR #432. Artifact and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.20998730
summary: When an automated agent (an AI agent, say) takes a consequential action, the record it leaves behind is produced by the very software stack whose integrity is in question. A signed log proves which key wrote the record, not what the runtime was. Prior work proposed treating that record (an Action Evidence Package, AEP: a signed append-only record of an action, its authorising principal, and its outcome) as application-layer Evidence under the IETF Remote ATtestation procedureS (RATS) architecture (RFC 9334), binding the outcome into a hardware-rooted TPM quote so that swapping it invalidates the quote. But that prior work appraised the result only against a minimal Verifier stand-in. This article closes that gap. We drive an AEP quote, produced on an emulated software TPM, end-to-end through a conformant Project Veraison RATS Verifier. We generate an EC P-256 attestation key, measure the AEP outcome digest into a PCR, pack a genuine quote into Veraison's tpm-enacttrust format, provision a Concise Reference Integrity Manifest (trust anchor plus golden reference value), and obtain a signed EAT Attestation Result (EAR). Good evidence yields affirming; an outcome-swap or a one-byte signature tamper yields contraindicated. Along the way we uncover, responsibly disclose, and fix a security-relevant finding: the reference scheme does not enforce challenge-nonce freshness, so a replayed quote still appraises as affirming. We give an exact, upstreamable two-part fix and validate it end-to-end. With the fix active, the same valid quote that is affirming in its own session flips to contraindicated when replayed to a fresh one. The pipeline is fully reproducible; the Attester remains an emulated swtpm, not a hardware guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文在符合规范的Project Veraison RATS验证器上端到端跑通了Action Evidence Package（AEP）的TPM引用验证流程，验证了其作为RATS证据的可行性，并发现、披露并修复了一个安全漏洞：参考方案未强制挑战随机数新鲜度，导致重放的引用仍被判定为affirming。修复后，重放到新会话的同一合法引用会被正确判定为contraindicated。
AI.motivation: 自动化代理（如AI智能体）采取关键行动时，其留下的记录由受到质疑的软件栈本身产生。签名日志只能证明哪个密钥写了记录，不能证明运行时是什么。先前工作提出将AEP作为RATS架构下的应用层证据，通过硬件根TPM引用绑定结果，但仅用最小化Verifier替身进行过评估，缺乏对符合规范的真实验证器的端到端验证。
AI.method: 在模拟软件TPM（swtpm）上生成AEP引用，端到端驱动符合规范的Project Veraison RATS Verifier：生成EC P-256认证密钥，将AEP结果摘要写入PCR，将真实引用打包为Veraison的tpm-enacttrust格式，配置Concise Reference Integrity Manifest（信任锚加黄金参考值），获取签名的EAT Attestation Result（EAR）。同时进行故障注入测试（结果交换、单字节签名篡改）和重放攻击测试。
AI.result: 良好证据得到affirming裁决；结果交换或单字节签名篡改得到contraindicated裁决。发现并修复了参考方案未强制挑战随机数新鲜度的安全缺陷——重放的引用仍被判为affirming。给出了一个精确的、可上流的上游修复方案并经端到端验证：修复后，同一合法引用在其自身会话中为affirming，但重放到新会话时翻转为contraindicated。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线完全可复现，填补了AEP证据此前未经符合规范的真实RATS Verifier评估的空白。但需注意，Attester仍是模拟swtpm而非硬件保证，硬件信任根基的安全属性仍待进一步验证。

title: CROSS: Cascaded Distillation and Dual-Constraint Grounding for Remote Sensing Referring Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Tingzhang Luo and Ruizhong Liu contributed equally. Jianyuan Guo is the corresponding author. Project page: https://clarence-cv.github.io/CROSS/
summary: Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) has achieved significant progress through the integration of VLMs and the Segment Anything Model (SAM). However, this progress largely relies on strong pre-trained capabilities, while leaving two fundamental limitations insufficiently addressed: (1) Architectural Weak-Coupling, where the unidirectional flow forces reliance on coarse VLM prompts and wastes SAM's pixel-level structural guidance, causing localization drift; and (2) Object-Centric Semantic Bias, where models overemphasize dominant object semantics while remaining insensitive to spatial reasoning crucial for RRSIS. Motivated by these observations, we propose CROSS, a tightly integrated paradigm for RRSIS. First, we introduce Linguistic-Guided Cascaded Distillation (LGCD) to bridge the architectural gap, which distills SAM's geometric affinities as soft regularizers into VLM intermediate layers, injecting dense structural priors to refine localization. Second, Perspective-Spatial Contrastive Learning (PSCL) imposes cross-anchored constraints by mining mask-filtered deceptive distractors and spatial-linguistic counterfactuals as hard negatives, explicitly shattering semantic shortcuts to enforce genuine logical consistency. Extensive experiments on RRSIS benchmarks demonstrate that CROSS achieves state-of-the-art performance and maintains precise localization even under severe spatial description perturbations, standing as a robust new paradigm for RRSIS.

AI.tldr: CROSS是一个针对指代遥感图像分割(RRSIS)的紧密集成范式，通过语言引导级联蒸馏(LGCD)桥接VLM与SAM的结构性耦合差距，以及视角-空间对比学习(PSCL)打破目标中心语义偏差，在RRSIS基准上达到SOTA性能并保持鲁棒的定位能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管RRSIS通过结合VLMs和SAM取得了显著进展，但仍存在两个根本性局限：(1)架构弱耦合——单向信息流导致依赖粗糙的VLM提示，浪费SAM的像素级结构引导，造成定位漂移；(2)目标中心语义偏差——模型过度强调主导目标语义，对RRSIS关键的细粒度空间推理不敏感。这些局限在依赖强预训练能力时被掩盖，未得到充分解决。
AI.method: 提出CROSS范式，包含两大核心组件：(1)语言引导级联蒸馏(LGCD)——将SAM的几何亲和力作为软正则化项蒸馏到VLM中间层，注入稠密结构先验以精化定位，弥合架构差距；(2)视角-空间对比学习(PSCL)——通过挖掘掩膜过滤的欺骗性干扰物和空间-语言反事实作为硬负样本，施加跨锚定约束，打破语义捷径以强制真实的逻辑一致性。
AI.result: 在RRSIS基准上的大量实验表明，CROSS实现了SOTA性能，即使在严重的空间描述扰动下仍能保持精确的定位能力，验证了其作为RRSIS鲁棒新范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CROSS通过紧密耦合的架构设计和针对性的对比学习策略，同时解决了RRSIS中的架构弱耦合和目标中心语义偏差两个关键瓶颈，为RRSIS提供了一种更稳健、语义逻辑更一致的解决方案。

title: Designing Social Robots for Inclusive Child Wellbeing Assessment: Insights from Communities Supporting Developmental Language Disorder and Forced Migration
summary: Assessing children's wellbeing and mental health can be particularly challenging for children experiencing communication barriers, such as children with Developmental Language Disorder (DLD) and children with forced migration backgrounds. During the assessment process, traditional self-report questionnaires place substantial demands on language comprehension and verbal expression. In this context, social robots have emerged as a promising tool for supporting wellbeing assessment without solely relying on self-report questionnaires, yet limited research has examined how such interactions can be designed to be inclusive, appropriate, and ethically acceptable for children with diverse communication needs. To address this gap, we created candidate child--robot interaction activities as design probes and conducted focus groups with parents and professionals supporting children with DLD and children with forced migration backgrounds. Through thematic analysis, we identified considerations relating to robot role and capabilities, interactional dynamics, individual differences, and child agency, alongside population-specific considerations shaped by children's communication needs and lived experiences. Based on these findings, we derive a set of ethical and inclusive design recommendations for robot-mediated wellbeing assessment. By foregrounding these considerations and recommendations, this work contributes design guidance for inclusive robot-mediated wellbeing assessments for children with diverse communication needs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对有沟通障碍（如发展性语言障碍DLD和强迫迁移背景）儿童的幸福感评估难题，提出利用社交机器人作为评估工具。研究通过设计儿童-机器人互动活动探针，并与支持这些儿童的父母和专业人士进行焦点小组访谈，通过主题分析识别出机器人角色与能力、互动动态、个体差异和儿童自主性等方面的考量，以及基于人群特征的特定考量，最终提出一套伦理且包容性的机器人介导幸福感评估设计建议。
AI.motivation: 传统自陈式问卷对语言理解和表达能力要求较高，对患有DLD或有强迫迁移背景等存在沟通障碍的儿童尤其困难；社交机器人虽被认为是有前景的替代评估工具，但鲜有研究探讨如何为具有多样化沟通需求的儿童设计包容、适当且伦理可接受的儿童-机器人互动评估方式。
AI.method: 创建候选儿童-机器人互动活动作为设计探针；组织支持DLD儿童和强迫迁移背景儿童的家长及专业人士开展焦点小组；运用主题分析法对焦点小组数据进行深入分析。
AI.result: 通过主题分析识别出与机器人角色和能力、互动动态、个体差异和儿童自主性相关的考量因素，以及由儿童沟通需求和实际经历塑造的人群特定考量；据此提出一套伦理且包容性的机器人介导幸福感评估设计建议。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为面向具有多样化沟通需求儿童的包容性机器人介导幸福感评估提供了设计指导，填补了该领域研究空白，有助于推动更公平、更适切的儿童心理健康评估实践。

title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Testing the Predictive Validity of Commonsense Benchmarks
summary: Predicting LLM's capabilities on real-world tasks is essential, yet the extent to which performance on commonsense benchmarks predicts downstream performance remains underspecified. To establish the practical usability of widely adopted commonsense benchmarks, we evaluate 23 models from six families on four established commonsense benchmarks, four reworked variants, three non-commonsense controls, and eight downstream tasks requiring implicit social, pragmatic, temporal, or physical reasoning. We compare model rankings, compute controlled correlations, and use leave-one-family-out cross-validation to assess the criterion validity of commonsense benchmarks. Our results show that revised benchmarks largely preserve original model rankings and do not improve downstream predictive power. Commonsense benchmarks show consistent cross-family predictive validity for only a narrow subset of downstream tasks, with smaller or metric-specific gains elsewhere. Overall, standardized commonsense benchmarks provide task-dependent rather than broad evidence of downstream commonsense competence.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了23个模型在四个常识基准、四个改良变体、三个非常识对照及八个下游任务上的表现，通过排名比较、受控相关性和留一族交叉验证评估常识基准的标准效度。结果显示改良基准基本保留原始模型排名且未提升下游预测力，常识基准仅对少数下游任务具有跨家族的预测有效性。
AI.motivation: 预测大语言模型在真实世界任务中的能力至关重要，但常识基准得分在多大程度上能预测下游任务表现仍缺乏明确界定。作者旨在建立常用常识基准的实际可用性。
AI.method: 选取6个模型家族共23个模型，在4个已确立的常识基准、4个改良变体、3个非常识对照和8个下游任务上进行评估。通过比较模型排名、计算受控相关性，并使用留一族交叉验证来衡量常识基准的标准效度（criterion validity）。
AI.result: 改良后的基准大体上保留了原始模型的排名顺序，且未显著提升对下游任务的预测能力。常识基准仅在少数下游任务子集上显示出一致的跨模型家族预测有效性，其他方面的提升幅度较小或仅针对特定指标。
AI.conclusion: 标准化常识基准对下游常识能力提供的是任务依赖性的证据，而非广泛通用的预测能力，研究者在使用这类基准时应谨慎解读其结果。

title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
summary: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which attention induces a weighted graph over tokens, while token hidden states define signals on its nodes. Quantitative graph-spectral diagnostics and qualitative token-graph visualizations reveal that representations become more clearly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context length increases. Simpler inputs produce attention-induced token graphs with stronger global connectivity and smoother, spectrally concentrated hidden-state signals, whereas more complex inputs produce more localized graphs and hidden-state signals with broader spectral support and greater high-frequency energy. Together, these findings point to systematic, context-dependent internal signatures associated with numerical ICL that are conserved across model families.

AI.tldr: 本文采用图信号处理视角，研究大型语言模型在上下文学习中进行数值推理时，其内部表征如何组织数值信息。通过注意力诱导的token图及隐藏状态信号的图谱诊断，发现表征随上下文长度增加而按输入动力学复杂度分化，且此现象跨模型家族守恒。
AI.motivation: 此前研究对LLM在数值序列上的上下文学习能力主要通过输出级评估（如预测误差）来刻画，但对其内部表征中数值信息的组织方式知之甚少。理解内部组织是揭示ICL工作机制的关键。
AI.method: 采用图信号处理框架：注意力矩阵诱导token上的加权图，token隐藏状态作为图节点上的信号。使用定量图谱谱诊断（如谱集中度、高频能量等）和定性的token图可视化来分析表征结构，并对比不同输入动力学复杂度与上下文长度的条件。
AI.result: 随着上下文长度增加，表征按输入动力学复杂度分化更明显：简单输入产生全局连通性更强的注意力图和更平滑、谱集中的隐藏状态信号；复杂输入产生更局部的图和谱支撑更宽、高频能量更高的信号。该现象跨模型家族保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 数值上下文学习在LLM内部存在系统性的、依赖上下文的表征签名，且这些图谱特征在不同模型家族间守恒，为理解ICL的内部计算机制提供了新的谱分析与可视化工具。

title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning
summary: Long Document Visual Question Answering (LongDocVQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to locate, integrate, and reason over heterogeneous document elements distributed across multiple pages. Existing approaches, including end-to-end MLLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and document agents, often lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify how grounded evidence is progressively composed during reasoning, limiting both answer accuracy and traceability. In this paper, we cast LongDocVQA as an explicit evidence graph reasoning problem rather than implicit answer prediction. To this end, we propose DocTrace, a hierarchical framework that progressively performs evidence localization, structured document parsing, and evidence graph reasoning to enable explicit evidence provenance. To effectively learn these capabilities, we develop a two-stage training framework: joint Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) first initializes evidence localization and graph reasoning abilities, followed by task-specific Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with dedicated rewards to further optimize these capabilities. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, and SlideVQA demonstrate that DocTrace consistently outperforms both existing open-source baselines and proprietary MLLMs. Compared with the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone, DocTrace achieves absolute improvements of 14.4, 11.3, and 11.7 points on the three benchmarks, respectively. Beyond competitive performance, DocTrace constructs traceable evidence graphs with explicit node-level provenance, enabling transparent and verifiable reasoning for long document understanding.

AI.tldr: DocTrace是一个层次化框架，将长文档视觉问答(LongDocVQA)建模为显式证据图推理问题，通过渐进式证据定位、结构化文档解析和图推理实现可追溯的证据来源，并采用两阶段训练（联合SFT + 任务特定GRPO）优化，在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL和SlideVQA基准上显著超越现有开源和专有MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（端到端MLLM、RAG流水线、文档智能体）缺乏对跨页面异构文档元素在推理过程中渐进式证据组合的显式表示与验证机制，导致答案准确性和可追溯性受限。
AI.method: DocTrace是一个层次化框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)证据定位——定位相关文档证据；(2)结构化文档解析——解析文档结构；(3)证据图推理——构建显式证据图进行推理。训练采用两阶段策略：第一阶段联合SFT初始化证据定位和图推理能力，第二阶段使用任务特定的GRPO策略优化（配备专门设计的奖励函数）。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL和SlideVQA三个基准上，DocTrace相比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct骨干分别取得14.4、11.3和11.7个百分点的绝对提升，一致优于现有开源基线和专有MLLM。此外，DocTrace生成具有显式节点级来源的可追溯证据图，支持透明可验证的推理。
AI.conclusion: 将LongDocVQA重新定义为显式证据图推理问题而非隐式答案预测，结合层次化架构和两阶段强化学习训练，不仅能显著提升推理准确性，还通过节点级来源标注实现了推理过程的可追溯性和可验证性，为长文档多模态理解提供了新的范式。

title: Surface Keypoint Representation for Multi-Object and Articulated Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Daily activities require humans to coordinate whole-body motion with the motion of surrounding objects. Despite recent progress in human-object interaction (HOI) generation, most existing methods assume interactions with a single rigid object and do not extend well to scenarios involving a variable number of objects or articulated objects with diverse joint mechanisms. We propose surface keypoint trajectories as an object motion representation: for each rigid component, whether a standalone object or one part of an articulated assembly, we track a small set of non-collinear surface points over time. This representation handles multi-object coordination and diverse articulation mechanisms directly from point dynamics without requiring explicit joint-type specification. To model when and where each body region contacts each object, we introduce a spatio-temporal contact distance field that extends distance-based contact modeling to whole-body, multi-object, and articulated settings. We factorize HOI generation into three stages: generating object motions from text or waypoints, predicting the contact distance field, and synthesizing whole-body motion with contact-guided optimization. Experiments on ParaHome, HIMO, ARCTIC, and OMOMO demonstrate better or comparable performance to existing methods across single-object, multi-object, and articulated interaction settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出表面关键点轨迹作为物体运动表示，配合时空接触距离场，将人-物交互生成分解为三阶段（物体运动生成、接触距离场预测、接触引导的全身运动合成），在ParaHome、HIMO、ARCTIC和OMOMO数据集上实现了对单物体、多物体和关节物体交互的更好或相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的人-物交互（HOI）生成方法大多假设交互对象是单一刚体，无法扩展到可变数量物体或具有不同关节机制的关节物体。这限制了模型在现实场景中的应用，因为日常活动中人类常需要协调全身运动与多个或可活动的周围物体。
AI.method: 1) 提出表面关键点轨迹表示：对每个刚性组件（独立物体或关节物体的部件）跟踪一组非共线表面点，直接从点动力学处理多物体协调和多样关节机制，无需显式指定关节类型。2) 引入时空接触距离场，将基于距离的接触建模扩展到全身、多物体和关节场景。3) 将HOI生成分解为三个级联阶段：从文本或路径点生成物体运动、预测接触距离场、通过接触引导优化合成全身运动。
AI.result: 在ParaHome、HIMO、ARCTIC和OMOMO四个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在单物体交互、多物体交互和关节物体交互场景中均取得了优于或与现有方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 表面关键点轨迹作为一种通用的物体运动表示能够统一处理多种交互场景，结合接触距离场进行接触建模和三阶段分解策略，是解决多物体和关节物体人-物交互生成问题的有效方案。

title: EvoHIL: Self-Evolving Reward and Flow-Matched Policy Optimization for Robust Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) enables robots to learn contact-rich manipulation from limited real-world interaction, but deployment exposes three coupled limitations: static visual reward models fail under scene changes; independently sampled actions cause temporally inconsistent motion; and vision-based policies remain sensitive to appearance shifts. We present EvoHIL, a unified framework that adapts the reward model, action generator, and visual do main within a staged human-in-the-loop learning process. First, self-evolving reward (SER) adapts the success classifier from human-confirmed positives and provisional weak negatives. Second, Action Flow Stabilization (AFS) generates temporally coherent action chunks through flow matching, grounding policy updates in executed action prefixes and demonstrated behavior. Third, retention-aware offline fine-tuning replays relit interaction data while anchoring the AFS actor-critic to prior behavior, adapting the visual domain without additional robot interaction. Across six manipulation tasks on Franka FR3 and SO-101 arms under a controlled lighting shift, EvoHIL improves task success, agreement with human-confirmation labels, motion smoothness, and completion time relative to human-in-the-loop and imitation baselines.Project page: https://anonymous4366.github.io/EvoHIL/

AI.tldr: EvoHIL是一个统一框架，通过分阶段的类人在环学习过程自适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉域，以解决基于人类反馈的强化学习（HIL-RL）在接触丰富的操控中的三个耦合限制：静态视觉奖励模型在场景变化下失效、独立采样动作导致时间不一致性、视觉策略对外观变化敏感。
AI.motivation: HIL-RL使机器人能从有限的真实世界交互中学习接触丰富的操控，但实际部署中面临三个相互耦合的限制：静态视觉奖励模型无法适应场景变化；独立采样的动作导致时间上不一致的运动；基于视觉的策略对外观变化敏感。这些问题阻碍了HIL-RL系统在真实世界中的鲁棒部署。
AI.method: EvoHIL包含三个关键组件：(1) 自进化奖励（SER）从人类确认的正样本和临时弱负样本中自适应成功分类器；(2) 动作流稳定化（AFS）通过流匹配（flow matching）生成时间连贯的动作块，将策略更新锚定在已执行的动作前缀和示范行为上；(3) 保留感知的离线微调通过重放重新光照的交互数据同时锚定AFS actor-critic到先前行为，在无需额外机器人交互的情况下适应视觉域变化。
AI.result: 在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上，跨越六个操纵任务并在受控光照变化条件下，EvoHIL相比在环人类和模仿学习基线，在任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间方面均取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: EvoHIL通过统一的自适应机制同时解决奖励模型、动作生成和视觉域三个层面的耦合限制，显著提升了机器人接触丰富操控在环境变化下的鲁棒性，且无需额外的机器人交互即可完成视觉域适应。

title: ArtECulture: Benchmarking Culture-Conditioned Visual Emotion Understanding in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Existing visual emotion understanding methods typically ignore cultural variations in emotional perception. We introduce culture-conditioned visual emotion understanding, a task that predicts the culture-specific emotional perception of a given image and explains the underlying rationale. Although related benchmarks exist, they are limited by inconsistent individual annotations, which hinder the derivation of majority-supported culture-level emotion labels, and imbalanced cultural coverage. Thus, we present ArtECulture, a benchmark containing 6,792 artworks with culture-specific emotion labels and explanations across English, Chinese, and Arabic cultures, with balanced Western and non-Western content. Evaluations of 16 open- and closed-source Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) under a zero-shot setting reveal that the task remains challenging, with the best model achieving below 50\% accuracy. To address this limitation, we introduce a retrieval-augmented culture-conditioned emotion understanding framework, which leverages a concept-based cultural emotion knowledge base to inject explicit cultural knowledge into MLLMs without additional training. The framework improves both culturally aligned emotion prediction and grounded explanation generation. Our benchmark and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文化条件视觉情感理解任务及ArtECulture基准，包含6,792幅覆盖英中阿三种文化的艺术品，评估了16种多模态大模型（最佳准确率低于50%），并提出检索增强的文化条件情感理解框架，通过概念化文化情感知识库无需额外训练即可提升模型的文化对齐情感预测和可解释性生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉情感理解方法忽略了文化差异在情感感知中的影响，而已有基准受限于个体标注不一致（难以推导群体层面主流情感标签）和文化覆盖不均衡的问题。
AI.method: 构建ArtECulture基准（6,792幅艺术品，覆盖英、中、阿拉伯三种文化的专属情感标签与解释，平衡西方与非西方内容）；引入检索增强的文化条件情感理解框架，利用基于概念的文化情感知识库向MLLMs注入显式文化知识，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 对16种开源/闭源多模态大模型在零样本设置下的评估显示任务具有挑战性，最佳模型准确率低于50%；所提框架在文化对齐情感预测和接地解释生成方面均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 文化条件视觉情感理解仍是一项困难任务，检索增强的知识注入方式能有效提升MLLMs的文化情感理解能力；基准和代码将公开以推动该领域研究。

title: Paired Recipient-based Evaluation of Survival Prediction for Deceased Donor Kidney Transplants
comment: To appear at the Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC) 2026
summary: There has been significant interest in using machine learning algorithms to predict kidney transplant outcomes, such as the number of years until a graft inevitably fails. These prediction algorithms could possibly be used for pre-transplant donor-recipient matching to identify more compatible donors and recipients and thus improve post-transplant outcomes. In this study, we explore the use of survival prediction models trained on deceased donor kidney transplant data from the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR). We propose a novel paired recipient-based evaluation framework that compares graft outcomes between two recipients who received kidneys from the same deceased donor, allowing us to evaluate the counterfactual benefit of changing the recipient for a certain donor. We find that five different survival prediction models, ranging in complexity from linear to deep learning-based models, all result in ~60% paired recipient-based accuracy. We further translate this accuracy into an interpretable quantity of post-transplant years gained. We also highlight major limitations of the commonly used concordance index (C-index) metric for evaluating survival prediction accuracy in this setting and demonstrate that our proposed paired recipient-based accuracy metric is more clinically relevant and better reflects real-world allocation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的配对受体评估框架来评价肾移植存活预测模型，在SRTR尸体供体肾移植数据上，五种不同复杂度的存活预测模型均达到约60%的配对受体准确性，并将准确性转化为移植后获得的年数，同时指出了C-index指标在该场景下的局限性。
AI.motivation: 肾移植结局预测算法有望用于移植前供体-受体匹配以改善移植结果，但现有的评估指标（如C-index）无法很好地反映真实世界分配场景中更换受体带来的反事实获益，需要一个更临床相关的评估框架来衡量预测模型的实用性。
AI.method: 基于SRTR尸体供体肾移植数据训练五种不同复杂度的存活预测模型（从线性到深度学习），提出一种新颖的配对受体评估框架：将同一尸体供体的两个受体进行配对比较，评估更换受体的反事实获益，并将预测准确性转化为移植后获得的年数。
AI.result: 五种存活预测模型均实现约60%的配对受体准确性；该准确性可转化为可解释的移植后年限获益；证明了常用的C-index指标在此场景下的主要局限性，所提出的配对受体准确性指标更符合临床实际和真实世界分配场景。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的配对受体评估框架比C-index更临床相关、更能反映真实世界的肾移植分配场景，为评估肾移植存活预测模型提供了更合理的评价标准。

title: Distractor-Aware Truncation: Disentangling Context-Length Effects from Signal Loss in Long-Context LLM Benchmarks
summary: A standard claim in the literature on retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented language models is that shorter context is better when the relevant information is preserved. We test this claim by running every sample of two long-context benchmarks -- BABILong and GraphWalks (BFS) -- at four context-retention fractions (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%) under two truncation protocols. The first is the naive protocol implicitly used in much prior work: drop content from the middle of the prompt. The second is distractor-aware: identify the task-relevant content for each sample and drop only the rest. We evaluate three sizes of the Claude family (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7) and, to test cross-provider generality, GPT-5.5 from a different provider; we apply the same protocol to two further benchmarks (MRCR v2, Oolong). Under naive truncation, score collapses monotonically (paired Wilcoxon, Holm-corrected p_adj < 0.05 in all eight BABILong and GraphWalks cells). Under the distractor-aware protocol -- which preserves the signal by construction -- performance is preserved or improves: the two smaller Claude models show statistically significant gains on BABILong, while the larger models (Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5) sit at their full-context ceiling. The naive collapse and its distractor-aware recovery replicate on GPT-5.5, ruling out a single-provider artifact. The mechanism is direct: under the naive protocol the answer-bearing content survives in fewer than 1% of samples at 25% retention; under the distractor-aware protocol it is preserved by construction. The naive protocol is therefore not a measurement of context-window effects; it is a measurement of how often middle-removal happens to spare the answer. We conclude that future studies of context-length effects must specify how they distinguish signal from distractor, or they are at best ambiguous between two opposite hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种截断协议（naive中间删除 vs distractor-aware保留信号删除）在四个长上下文基准、五个模型上测试"短上下文更好"这一普遍假设，发现naive截断导致的性能崩溃并非上下文长度效应，而是因为答案内容被误删（25%保留率下仅<1%样本幸存），而distractor-aware截断下性能不变或提升，推翻了以往研究的结论。
AI.motivation: 检索增强和记忆增强语言模型文献中普遍认为"保留相关信息时短上下文更好"，但这一说法缺乏严格检验。作者怀疑以往实验中使用的naive中间截断协议混淆了"上下文长度效应"与"信息被删除效应"，需要设计对照实验来区分这两种完全相反的假设。
AI.method: 使用BABILong和GraphWalks(BFS)两个长上下文基准的全部样本，在四种上下文保留比例（100%/75%/50%/25%）和两种截断协议下运行：（1）naive协议——删除prompt中间内容；（2）distractor-aware协议——识别每个样本的任务相关内容并仅删除其余部分。评估Claude家族三个规模模型（Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7）及跨供应商的GPT-5.5，并在MRCR v2和Oolong上复现。使用配对Wilcoxon检验和Holm校正进行统计显著性分析。
AI.result: naive截断下所有8个BABILong和GraphWalks单元的得分单调崩溃（Holm校正p_adj<0.05）；distractor-aware截断下，两个较小Claude模型在BABILong上有显著提升，较大模型（Opus 4.7和GPT-5.5）处于全上下文表现的天花板。现象在GPT-5.5上完全复现，排除单一供应商伪影。机制分析表明：naive协议在25%保留率下仅<1%样本保留答案内容，而distractor-aware协议通过构造确保信号保留。
AI.conclusion: naive截断协议测得的不是上下文窗口效应，而是"中间删除恰好放过答案"的概率。未来研究上下文长度效应必须明确说明如何区分信号与干扰内容，否则结果在"短上下文更好"和"信息被删除"两个相反假设之间是模糊的。

title: CAN Disabler: Hardware-based Prevention method of Unauthorized Transmission in CAN and CAN-FD networks
comment: 7 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Presented at escar USA 2016
summary: There have been a quite number of security attack cases against Controller Area Network (CAN) reported in recent years, but in the meantime no security function is included in the ECU in the current in-vehicle control network. Thus, in-vehicle control networks particularly require cost-effective security features. In this paper, therefore, we propose a method to block unauthorized CAN-bus access using a CAN controller that is modified to prevent the ECU from transmitting messages to the CAN-bus at abnormal frequency. Then, we have also demonstrated the effectiveness of the disabler on CAN with flexible data-rate (CAN-FD) buses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于修改CAN控制器的方案，通过限制ECU向CAN总线发送消息的频率来阻止未经授权的CAN总线访问，并在CAN-FD总线上验证了该方案的有效性。
AI.motivation: 近年来针对CAN总线的安全攻击事件频发，但当前车载控制网络中的ECU没有内置任何安全功能，因此需要一种经济有效的安全方案来保护车载控制网络。
AI.method: 提出一种对CAN控制器进行修改的方法，使ECU无法以异常频率向CAN总线发送消息，从而阻断未授权的CAN总线访问。
AI.result: 在CAN-FD（带灵活数据速率的CAN）总线上验证了该禁用机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过限制异常频率的消息发送，可以有效阻止未经授权的CAN总线访问，且该方案适用于CAN-FD总线，是一种具有成本效益的车载网络安全防护方法。

title: Frequency-Decorrelated Temporal Ensembles for EEG--fNIRS Imagined-Handwriting Decoding
summary: Imagined handwriting offers a temporally rich paradigm for non-invasive neural decoding, yet reliable recognition across unseen participants remains difficult because scalp EEG is noisy and internally generated stroke sequences vary across individuals. The Multimodal Brain-Computer Interface Grand Challenge provides synchronized EEG and fNIRS for four-class subject-independent handwriting-trajectory classification. We propose FRED, a task-adapted system that models imagined handwriting as a multi-second motor sequence and trains a compact multi-scale temporal network on three complementary EEG frequency views. With three seeds per view, cross-band members produce substantially less-correlated errors than same-band replicas, yielding a clean nine-member ensemble accuracy of 0.8076/0.7242/0.7492 on the public/private/overall test partitions without test-set adaptation or output constraints. The submitted pipeline further incorporates transductive pseudo-label training, three EEG-Conformer members, posterior aggregation, and a paradigm-aware decoder. Because every 12-trial randomization block contains three instances of each class, the final predictions are obtained by Hungarian assignment under the known block quota. On one fixed posterior pool, independent, session-constrained, and block-constrained decoding achieve 0.7600, 0.7758, and 0.7952 overall accuracy, respectively. The complete system reaches 0.8498/0.7718/0.7952, ranking fourth on the private split. A modality audit finds fNIRS-only decoding at chance (0.2511 overall), while adding fNIRS to EEG changes accuracy by only +0.0025. These results identify frequency-diverse temporal EEG modeling and protocol-matched structured inference as the principal sources of performance in this sparse-montage EEG--fNIRS setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/XiuFan719/EEG-fNIRS-fuse-method-for-MM-challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FRED系统，用于跨被试的想象手写轨迹四分类任务（EEG+fNIRS）。通过构建紧凑的多尺度时间网络，在三个互补的EEG频率视图上训练，并用9成员集成达到0.8076/0.7242/0.7492的公开/私有/总体准确率；完整系统结合转导伪标签训练、EEG-Conformer集成、后验聚合和基于分块配额的匈牙利分配解码，在私有测试集上排名第四。消融实验表明fNIRS单独解码为随机水平，EEG频率多样的时间建模和协议匹配的结构化推断是性能的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 想象手写为神经解码提供了时间上丰富的范式，但头皮EEG噪声大且内部生成的笔画序列因人而异，导致跨被试（subject-independent）的可靠识别仍然困难。作者针对多模态脑机接口大挑战赛（EEG+fNIRS同步、四类、被试无关的想象手写轨迹分类任务）提出任务自适应系统，以解决这一跨个体泛化难题。
AI.method: FRED系统包括：1) 将想象手写建模为多秒运动序列，训练紧凑的多尺度时间网络；2) 使用三个互补的EEG频率视图，每视图三个种子，跨频带成员比同频带副本产生更低相关性的错误，形成9成员集成；3) 提交管线进一步加入转导伪标签训练、三个EEG-Conformer成员、后验聚合和范式感知解码器；4) 利用每个12试次随机化块包含每类三个实例的先验，通过匈牙利分配在块配额约束下获得最终预测。
AI.result: 9成员集成在公开/私有/总体测试集上达到0.8076/0.7242/0.7492准确率。在固定后验池上，独立、会话约束和块约束解码分别为0.7600、0.7758和0.7952总体准确率。完整系统达到0.8498/0.7718/0.7952，在私有测试集上排名第四。模态审计显示fNIRS单独解码接近随机水平（0.2511总体准确率），而向EEG添加fNIRS仅改变+0.0025。
AI.conclusion: 频率多样的时间EEG建模和协议匹配的结构化推断（匈牙利分配）是稀疏蒙太奇EEG-fNIRS设置下性能的主要来源。fNIRS在此任务中的贡献可忽略不计，EEG的频率域多样性和块配额约束的后处理是跨被试分类成功的关键因素。

title: ETA: A New Agentic Paradigm for Embodied Tasks
summary:
When will robots have their ChatGPT moment? Such a breakthrough requires a general-purpose robot that can handle unfamiliar tasks in unfamiliar environments, remain controllable over long interactions, and learn from experience.
  Today's embodied systems largely follow an end-to-end observation-to-action path. Despite rapid progress, they remain far from this goal: their generalization depends heavily on the coverage of robot training data, while long task execution remains difficult to control and inspect. To realize this goal, we introduce the Embodied Task Agent (ETA), a new paradigm for extending digital agents into the physical world, and release OpenETA as its open-source implementation. ETA centers the robot around a Planner that chooses one Tool call at a time, an Interface that controls execution, and a World that returns the result and a fresh observation. This loop allows the agent to verify outcomes, adapt its plan, and turn successful and failed interactions into reusable experience. OpenETA provides replaceable Planners, composable Tools and Skills, auditable memory, replayable trajectories, and common interfaces for simulation and real robots. For Codex, OpenETA can operate as a lightweight plugin that exposes only observe, mark_point, and move_to.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"具身任务智能体"(ETA)这一新范式，通过"规划器-接口-世界"循环将数字智能体扩展到物理世界，并发布其开源实现OpenETA，使机器人能处理陌生任务、保持可控性并积累经验。
AI.motivation: 现有具身系统采用端到端的"观测-动作"路径，其泛化能力严重依赖训练数据覆盖率，且长任务执行难以控制和检查，难以实现如ChatGPT般的机器人突破。需要一个能让机器人应对陌生环境任务、保持长期可控并可从经验中学习的新范式。
AI.method: ETA范式以规划器(Planner)为核心，每次选择一个工具调用，通过接口(Interface)控制执行，并由世界(World)返回结果和新观测。这一闭环循环使智能体能验证结果、调整计划，并将成功与失败的交互转化为可复用的经验。OpenETA提供可替换的规划器、可组合的工具和技能、可审查的记忆、可回放的轨迹，以及适用于仿真和真实机器人的通用接口。对Codex可作为轻量插件运行，仅暴露observe、mark_point和move_to三个操作。
AI.result: OpenETA作为开源实现，支持可替换规划器、可组合工具/技能、可审计记忆、可回放轨迹、仿真及真实机器人通用接口；并可作为Codex的轻量插件提供最简接口。
AI.conclusion: ETA范式为通用具身智能提供了"规划-执行-验证-学习"的闭环路径，使机器人任务的执行过程可控制、可检查、可积累经验，是通往"机器人ChatGPT时刻"的重要一步。

title: FACTWASH: Catching AI Rewrites That Wash Hearsay into Fact
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/collapseindex/factwash
summary: AI systems rewrite information constantly: conversations become stored memories, documents become answers. The rewrite can keep a claim while washing away what made it checkable, who said it, how sure they were, when it held. We call that failure factwashing, and release factwash, an open-source write-time gate that catches it deterministically, with named flags and evidence rather than an LLM judge. Building it answers a practical question: when does a cheap check suffice, and when do you need a model? What decides is whether the property has a bounded surface-cue inventory. Explicit negation cues are close to enumerable, so a word list finishes and transfers, reaching 0.91 F1 on untuned text. Hedging and attribution have open-ended realizations, so vocabulary plateaus near half recall, and a one-question LLM witness recovers +17 and +15 points of cue-detection recall at equal precision. Deployed, that witness may only lower a verdict, so it buys precision rather than coverage. We measure cue detection on 105,596 independently annotated sentences. A blind-labelled corpus of memory writes then locates the failure: 55% of bad writes in conversational hearsay, 7% in business email (p < 0.001), so the first deployment question is not which detector to use but whether the failure occurs at all. On unmodified mem0 2.0.7, the gate flags 5 of 8 hedged-hearsay writes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"factwashing"（事实漂洗）概念，指AI系统重写信息时保留陈述却丢失可检验性（谁说的、确定度、时间）的失败模式。作者发布开源工具factwash，一个确定性的写入时检查门，用命名标志和证据而非LLM裁判来检测事实漂洗。核心洞见是：当属性具有有界表面线索清单时，廉价检查即可胜任（如显式否定线索接近可枚举，词表可达到0.91 F1）；而措辞和归因的开销式实现（open-ended）使词表召回率减半，需借助单问题LLM见证者恢复+17/+15点线索检测召回。在105,596句独立标注句子上测量线索检测，并用盲标注的记忆写入语料定位失败场景：55%的错误写入来自对话性传闻，7%来自商务邮件。在未修改的mem0 2.0.7上，该门可标记8个措辞性传闻写入中的5个。
AI.motivation: AI系统（如记忆存储、文档生成）在改写信息时，可能保留陈述却丢失使其可检验的元数据（说话人、确信度、时效性），这种失败尚未被系统命名和工具化检测。作者希望回答一个实用问题：何时廉价规则检查足够，何时需要调任模型。
AI.method: 发布open-source的写入时检查门factwash，采用确定性检测（命名标志+证据），而非LLM裁判。对可枚举的否定线索用词表；对开放式措辞和归因线索，词表达到近似半召回后，引入单问题LLM见证者提升线索检测召回。在105,596句人工标注数据上评估线索检测，并通过盲标注记忆写入语料分析失败分布。
AI.result: 词表达0.91 F1于未调优文本的否定线索检测；词表在措辞/归因上召回率减半，单问题LLM见证者分别恢复+17和+15点召回（等精度下）。失败定位显示55%的错误写入在对话性传闻、7%在商务邮件（p<0.001）。在未修改mem0 2.0.7上，该门标记8个措辞性传闻写入中的5个。
AI.conclusion: factwashing是分布不均的实用失败：主要发生在对话性传闻类写入。检测器选择取决于属性是否具有有界表面线索清单：可枚举线索用规则，开放式线索用轻量LLM见证。部署中见证者仅能降低结论，因此换取的是精度而非覆盖率。首个部署问题不是选哪个检测器，而是失败是否发生。

title: PLAN: Parallel Liquid-Inspired Approximation Network for Efficient Representation Learning in Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for flexible job shop scheduling (FJSP) heavily rely on attention-centric architectures to achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, these models suffer from excessive parameter counts and prohibitive inference latency as problem scales expand. While liquid neural networks (LNNs) offer a parameter-efficient alternative for modeling adaptive state evolution, their inherently sequential dynamics bottleneck computational efficiency. To resolve this trade-off, we propose PLAN (Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network), a lightweight representation learning framework that reformulates continuous liquid-state dynamics into a discretized and parallelizable formulation. PLAN structurally decouples state evolution from context aggregation, where liquid-inspired updates handle the primary evolving state representation, and a lightweight context aggregation module provides complementary global context.
