Furthermore, PLAN acts as a versatile, plug-and-play backbone that generalizes to complex FJSP variants, pairing with a compact stochastic module for stochastic FJSP and replacing heavy heterogeneous graph transformers in multi-faceted dynamic FJSP. Extensive evaluations across deterministic, stochastic, and multi-faceted dynamic FJSP benchmarks show that PLAN reduces the average makespan by 1.2%, 1.4%, and 2.3%, respectively, compared with the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines, with the improvement reaching 10.2% in one benchmark setting. PLAN also reduces average inference latency by 13.2%, 31.7%, and 26.9%, respectively, with a maximum reduction of 69.2% on the largest instances, while using only 22$-$47% of the baseline parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PLAN（Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network），一种轻量级表示学习框架，将液态神经网络（LNN）的连续动态系统重构为可并行的离散化形式，在保持柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）性能的同时大幅减少参数和推理延迟。PLAN解耦状态演化与上下文聚合，可作为即插即用的骨干网络推广到随机FJSP和多面动态FJSP等复杂变体。实验表明PLAN在确定性、随机和动态FJSP基准上分别将平均makespan降低1.2%、1.4%和2.3%，推理延迟降低13.2%、31.7%和26.9%，而参数量仅为基线的22%-47%。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于深度强化学习（DRL）的FJSP方法依赖注意力架构虽取得最优性能，但随问题规模扩大存在参数量过大和推理延迟过高的问题。液态神经网络（LNN）虽然为参数高效的替代方案，但其本质上的序列化动态过程限制了计算效率。如何在保持性能的同时兼顾参数效率与并行计算能力，是本文试图解决的权衡问题。
AI.method: PLAN将连续的液态状态动态重新表述为离散化且可并行化的形式。结构上解耦状态演化与上下文聚合：液体启发的更新模块负责主要的动态状态表征，轻量级上下文聚合模块提供补充性全局上下文。PLAN还可作为即插即用的骨干网络，通过配对一个紧凑的随机模块处理随机FJSP，并在多面动态FJSP中替代厚重的异构图Transformer。
AI.result: 在确定性、随机和多面动态FJSP基准上，PLAN相比各自SOTA基线分别将平均makespan降低1.2%、1.4%和2.3%（某个基准设置下最高达10.2%）；平均推理延迟分别降低13.2%、31.7%和26.9%（最大实例上最高降低69.2%）；参数量仅为基线的22%-47%。
AI.conclusion: PLAN成功解决了注意力架构在FJSP中参数冗余与推理瓶颈的问题，通过将液态神经网络连续动态转化为可并行离散形式，实现了性能、参数效率和推理速度的同步提升，并展现了在多种FJSP复杂变体上的通用性与即插即用能力。

title: SeaSlides: Semantic Abstraction Layer for Agentic Slide Generation
summary: Agentic presentation generation must preserve source content, maintain coherent visual design, render specialized objects, and produce usable artifacts. Existing systems meet only part of this requirement: templates preserve regularity but restrict adaptation, whereas free-form HTML or SVG gives models flexibility at the cost of low-level rendering decisions. This mismatch makes long technical decks brittle, especially when slides contain formulas, code, or data graphics. We present SeaSlides, an agentic slide-generation framework built around a semantic abstraction layer. Rather than authoring coordinates, inline styles, or raw SVG geometry, the model writes structured slide content through reusable components and capability modules, while templates own layout, style, and rendering. We instantiate this principle separately in HTML and Typst: SeaSlides-HTML uses template-defined DOM components, whereas SeaSlides-Typst uses template functions and package-backed modules. Capability modules route equations, code, and charts to dedicated renderers, and three feedback stages localize build errors, project-constraint violations, and visual defects before export. The two systems retain backend-specific syntax and contracts while sharing the same authoring boundary. For evaluation, we combine the 128-task UltraPresent validation setting with SeaSlidesBench-Rich, a new 32-task benchmark stressing mathematics, code, pseudocode, tables, charts, and diagrams. Across four generation models, both SeaSlides backends produce more readable, content-oriented source than SVG-heavy generation. A SeaSlides backend attains the highest rich-content macro-average under three of the four models while maintaining competitive overall qualitative performance. These results support semantic abstraction as a practical authoring principle across presentation backends.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeaSlides，一个基于语义抽象层的智能体幻灯片生成框架。该框架通过让模型编写结构化内容而非底层坐标/样式，同时由模板负责布局和渲染，解决了现有系统在内容保真度、视觉一致性和专业对象渲染之间的权衡问题。SeaSlides在HTML和Typst两个后端分别实例化，支持公式、代码、图表等专业对象的专用渲染，并通过三级反馈机制定位构建错误、约束违规和视觉缺陷。实验表明两个后端在内容可读性上优于SVG密集型生成，在四种模型下三个取得了最好的富内容宏平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体演示文稿生成系统存在根本性失衡：模板系统保持规律性但限制了适配性，而自由式HTML或SVG为模型提供灵活性却牺牲了底层渲染决策质量。这种不匹配导致包含公式、代码或数据图表的长技术类幻灯片脆弱且难以生成，需要一种既能保持内容保真度又能实现专业对象高质量渲染的架构。
AI.method: SeaSlides框架围绕一个语义抽象层构建：模型通过可复用组件和能力模块编写结构化幻灯片内容，而模板负责布局、样式和渲染。具体实例化为两个后端：(1) SeaSlides-HTML使用模板定义的DOM组件；(2) SeaSlides-Typst使用模板函数和包支持模块。能力模块将方程、代码和图表路由到专用渲染器，三级反馈阶段在导出前分别定位构建错误、项目约束违规和视觉缺陷。两个系统共享同一编写边界，同时保留后端特有的语法和契约。
AI.result: 评估结合了128任务的UltraPresent验证集和新提出的SeaSlidesBench-Rich（32任务，侧重数学、代码、伪代码、表格、图表和图表）。在四种生成模型下，两个SeaSlides后端生成的源代码比SVG密集型生成更具可读性和内容导向性。SeaSlides后端在四种模型中的三种下取得最高的富内容宏平均性能，同时保持有竞争力的整体定性表现。
AI.conclusion: 语义抽象层是跨演示文稿后端的一种实用编写原则。通过分离内容作者（模型）与布局/渲染负责（模板），SeaSlides验证了在保持后端灵活性的同时实现高质量专业对象渲染的可能性，为智能体演示文稿生成提供了可行的架构方向。

title: Secure Long-Range Autonomous Valet Parking: A Reservation Scheme With Three-Factor Authentication and Key Agreement
summary: Long-range autonomous valet parking (LAVP) is increasingly adopted to alleviate traffic congestion and parking difficulties. For large-scale parking demand, reservation can improve parking management. However, existing schemes mainly focus on parking request verification and parking check-in, and do not adequately protect identity legitimacy and communication security during passenger drop-off and pick-up. To address this problem, we propose SecLAVP, a provably secure three-factor authentication and key agreement protocol for LAVP reservation services. SecLAVP combines passwords, biometrics, and smart cards. With assistance from the drop-off/pick-up point (DP), the passenger and the autonomous vehicle (AV) achieve mutual authentication and establish a session key for secure communication. In the Real-Or-Random (ROR) model, we formally prove that SecLAVP provides session-key security. AVISPA simulations show that SecLAVP resists man-in-the-middle attacks, while informal analysis demonstrates that it satisfies 15 defined security goals. Finally, performance evaluation in terms of communication overhead, computational overhead, and scheduling shows that SecLAVP is feasible for practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SecLAVP，一个用于长距离自主代客泊车（LAVP）预约服务的三因素认证与密钥协商协议，结合密码、生物特征和智能卡，在旅客与自动驾驶车辆之间实现相互认证和安全通信，并通过形式化证明和仿真验证其安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LAVP停车预约方案主要关注停车请求验证和停车签到，但在乘客上下车过程中未能充分保护身份合法性和通信安全性，存在安全隐患。
AI.method: SecLAVP采用三因素（密码、生物特征、智能卡）身份认证机制，以下客/上客点（DP）为辅助节点，实现乘客与自动驾驶车辆（AV）之间的双向认证，并协商会话密钥用于后续安全通信。通过ROR模型进行形式化安全证明，使用AVISPA进行仿真验证，并结合非正式安全分析评估其安全性。
AI.result: 在Real-Or-Random（ROR）模型中证明了会话密钥安全性；AVISPA仿真表明SecLAVP能抵抗中间人攻击；非正式分析显示满足15项定义的安全目标；性能评估（通信开销、计算开销和调度）表明该协议在实际部署中是可行的。
AI.conclusion: SecLAVP为LAVP预约服务提供了一种可证明安全的三因素认证与密钥协商方案，在保障乘客与AV之间通信安全的同时，具有良好的实际部署可行性。

title: EditFlow3D: Automated Local Editing of 3D Assets with Trajectory Preservation
summary: Controllable local editing of 3D assets requires precise target localization and appropriate visual guidance. However, existing methods lack a simple yet accurate way to obtain 3D masks and struggle to achieve the desired edit while faithfully preserving the structure and appearance of non-target regions. To address these challenges, we present EditFlow3D, a training-free framework for local 3D editing. Given a source asset and an edit instruction, a VLM-driven workflow interprets the editing intent and automatically constructs a visual guidance image and a refined 3D editing mask, enabling localized editing in the native representation space of a pretrained 3D generative model. Specifically, mask-guided differential flow focuses the edit on the target region, while step-wise trajectory preservation maintains consistency between non-target regions and the source asset without directly replacing intermediate features. Since the existing Edit3D-Bench covers only a limited range of local editing categories, we further introduce EditFlow-Bench as a complementary benchmark encompassing a broader variety of structural and appearance edits, and evaluate EditFlow3D on both benchmarks. Quantitative results, qualitative comparisons, and a user study demonstrate that EditFlow3D achieves more accurate target-region editing and better preserves non-target regions than existing 3D editing methods.

AI.tldr: EditFlow3D是一个无需训练的3D局部编辑框架，利用VLM驱动的流程自动构建视觉引导图像和精细3D编辑掩码，通过掩码引导的差分流动聚焦目标区域编辑，并采用逐步轨迹保持来确保非目标区域的一致性。作者还引入了补充基准EditFlow-Bench，涵盖更多结构性和外观编辑类别，定量和定性实验均表明其优于现有3D编辑方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D局部编辑方法缺少简单而精确获取3D掩码的方式，且难以在实现期望编辑的同时忠实保持非目标区域的结构和外观。这两个核心挑战限制了局部3D编辑的精度和可用性。
AI.method: EditFlow3D采用训练免费框架：(1) 利用VLM（视觉语言模型）驱动的工作流解释编辑意图，自动构建视觉引导图像和精细3D编辑掩码；(2) 掩码引导的差分流动（mask-guided differential flow）将编辑聚焦于目标区域；(3) 逐步轨迹保持（step-wise trajectory preservation）在不直接替换中间特征的情况下维持非目标区域与源资产的一致性；(4) 在预训练3D生成模型的原始表示空间中进行局部编辑，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在Edit3D-Bench和新增的EditFlow-Bench两个基准上，通过定量指标、定性对比和用户研究验证，EditFlow3D在目标区域编辑的准确性和非目标区域的保真性方面均优于现有3D编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: EditFlow3D通过VLM驱动的自动掩码构建和基于差分流动的局部编辑策略，有效解决了3D局部编辑中目标定位和非目标区域保持两大难题，其无训练特性也使其具有较好的实用性和可推广性。同时EditFlow-Bench的引入弥补了现有基准在局部编辑类别覆盖上的不足。

title: Bimanual Manipulation Within an 8 GB Budget: Zero-Copy Sensing and Quantized ACT on an Entry-Level Jetson
comment: 9 pages, 8 tables. Work conducted at the Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI), Aerospace, Transportation and Advanced Systems Laboratory (ATAS)
summary: Bimanual manipulation policies trained with imitation learning are typically evaluated on workstation or datacenter-class GPUs, leaving the cost of deploying them on embedded hardware largely uncharacterized. We present a bimanual SO-101 system running entirely on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super (8 GB), the entry-level tier of NVIDIA's embedded line, using a desktop GPU (RTX 3070) only for offline training, evaluated on pick-and-place of a deformable beanbag. First, we build a GStreamer capture pipeline backed by NVMM buffers that removes redundant host-device copies from three-camera sensing. Contrary to expectation, the conventional path fit the memory budget and dropped no frames; what zero-copy sensing recovers is CPU headroom (peak single-core utilization 98.0% to 77.0%) and worst-case latency (117.31 ms to 101.52 ms). Second, we train ACT and Diffusion Policy on identical demonstrations, each at its own reference budget (100k gradient steps for ACT, 200k for Diffusion Policy). ACT converges to a task-competent policy (19/20 trials) while Diffusion Policy does not converge to a usable one (0/10) even at twice the step count, which we attribute to differing convergence costs rather than an accuracy ceiling. Third, we convert ACT to TensorRT. FP16 reduces mean inference latency from 114.02 ms to 17.93 ms (6.4x) and INT8 to 12.65 ms (9.0x), with task success preserved at all three precisions (19/20, 18/20, 19/20). We report two findings not previously documented for ACT: TensorRT's general-purpose INT8 calibration quantizes the ResNet18 backbone but accepts zero of 145 transformer layers, explaining INT8's negligible size reduction over FP16 (0.9%) despite a further 28% latency gain; and the need for quantization is conditional on ACT's action-chunking configuration, feasible in full precision at n_action_steps = 100 but not at the per-step re-prediction temporal ensembling requires.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双臂操作模仿学习策略在嵌入式设备上的部署问题，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super（8GB）上运行SO-101双臂系统进行抓取放置任务。构建了基于NVMM缓冲区的GStreamer采集管线实现零拷贝传感，对比了ACT和Diffusion Policy两种策略的收敛性，并将ACT转换为TensorRT进行FP16和INT8量化加速，推理延迟从114ms降至12.65ms，同时保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于模仿学习的双臂操作策略通常在桌面级或数据中心级GPU上评估，其部署到嵌入式硬件的成本（内存、延迟、CPU占用）在很大程度上未得到刻画。随着机器人系统向边缘计算方向演进，了解此类策略在低功耗设备上的运行特性对于实际部署至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于NVMM缓冲区（零拷贝）的GStreamer三摄像头采集管线，与传统路径对比CPU占用和延迟。2) 在相同演示数据上分别以参考预算训练ACT（100k梯度步）和Diffusion Policy（200k梯度步）。3) 将ACT转换为TensorRT，在FP16和INT8精度下评估推理延迟与任务成功率，并分析INT8校准对各层（ResNet18骨干 vs transformer层）的量化覆盖情况。
AI.result: 零拷贝管线在内存上无优势（传统路径已满足内存要求且不丢帧），但降低峰值单核CPU占用（98.0%→77.0%）和最坏情况延迟（117.31ms→101.52ms）。ACT收敛到任务可用策略（19/20次成功），而Diffusion Policy即使双倍步数仍不收敛（0/10）。TensorRT推理：FP16将延迟从114.02ms降至17.93ms（6.4x），INT8降至12.65ms（9.0x），三种精度均保持任务成功率。INT8校准只量化了ResNet18骨干，145个transformer层全部不接受量化，因此INT8相对FP16体积仅减少0.9%，但延迟进一步降低28%。量化需求取决于ACT的action-chunking配置：n_action_steps=100时全精度可行，但每步重新预测的时间集成方案则需要量化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统刻画了双臂模仿学习策略在入门级嵌入式GPU上的完整部署流程。关键发现包括：零拷贝传感主要带来CPU和延迟收益而非内存收益；ACT在资源受限场景下比Diffusion Policy更具实用性；TensorRT INT8量化对ACT的transformer层无效但仍有显著延迟收益；量化必要性取决于ACT的动作分块配置。这些发现为在边缘平台部署视觉运动策略提供了实践指导。

title: Don't Let Me Ask for It: LLMs Show Deficiencies in Active Multi-Turn Information Acquisition for Abductive Inference
summary: Abductive reasoning requires forming hypotheses that explain observed evidence and revising them as new evidence becomes available. While large language models (LLMs) are often evaluated on whether they solve abductive reasoning tasks correctly, less is known about how they acquire evidence, update their hypotheses, and decide when to stop. We introduce Alien Abduction game, an interactive probe for studying these behaviours under different interaction modes. The modes vary in whether evidence is provided upfront or across turns, and whether queries are selected by the model or examples are provided by the oracle. Across models, providing evidence upfront leads to higher success rates than distributing it across turns. In multi-turn settings, some models commit before using the available evidence, while others exhaust the turn budget without converging. Models also achieve higher success rates when examples are provided by the oracle than when they select their own queries, although their final hypotheses are more consistent with the evidence they selected. These findings suggest that models may form hypotheses that fit self-selected evidence without sufficiently distinguishing them from alternatives, and may struggle to validate and refine their hypotheses or determine when to stop.

AI.tldr: 该论文引入"外星人绑架"游戏，作为交互式探针来研究大语言模型（LLM）在溯因推理中的行为——包括如何获取证据、更新假设以及决定何时停止。研究发现：预先提供证据比跨回合分布证据成功率更高；多回合中部分模型过早承诺或耗尽回合预算而不收敛；由预言机提供示例比模型自选查询成功率更高，但模型最终假设与自选证据更一致，表明模型可能过度拟合自选证据而难以验证替代假设。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM溯因推理的评估主要关注是否正确解决任务，而对其推理过程——如何获取证据、何时更新假设、如何决定停止——缺乏深入了解。作者希望通过交互式设定揭示这些过程性行为。
AI.method: 设计Alien Abduction游戏作为交互式探针，通过操控两种交互维度（证据是预先提供还是跨回合分布；查询由模型自选还是由预言机提供示例）来系统比较不同模式下LLM的溯因推理行为。
AI.result: 1) 预先提供证据比跨回合分布证据成功率更高；2) 多回合场景中，部分模型在利用可用证据之前就做出承诺，而另一些模型耗尽回合预算仍未收敛；3) 预言机提供示例比模型自选查询成功率更高，但模型最终假设与自选证据更一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM可能形成仅拟合自选证据的假设，未能充分区分替代假设，且在验证、细化假设以及判断何时停止方面存在困难。这揭示了溯因推理中"过程性"能力（证据获取、假设更新、停止决策）的不足。

title: Exploiting Separability in Multi-Scale Grey-Box Bayesian Optimization
summary: We consider grey-box optimization problems where the decision variables naturally partition into black-box variables (as arguments to an expensive black-box function) and white-box variables, governed by a set of explicit, closed-form equations that also depend on the output of the black-box function. We exploit this separability through a bilevel reformulation: an outer Bayesian optimization (BO) to optimize the scalar objective as a function of black-box variables alone, while an inner problem solves the white-box subproblem via global optimization. The Gaussian process surrogate used in BO is therefore defined rather than and white-box constraints are satisfied exactly whenever the inner optimizer converges to a feasible point---without penalty functions, chance constraints, or moment approximations. On a suite of 13 benchmark problems, bilevel BO achieves lower regret, with fewer iterations and wall clock time. This advantage is robust to initialization set size, exploration parameters, and inner-solver choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双层贝叶斯优化（bilevel BO）方法，用于灰盒优化问题——其中决策变量分为黑盒变量和白盒变量（白盒变量由闭式方程显式约束且依赖黑盒函数输出）。外层用BO优化仅以黑盒变量为自变量的标量目标，内层通过全局优化求解白盒子问题。高斯过程代理定义在黑盒变量空间而非白盒变量空间，白盒约束在内层优化收敛到可行点时被精确满足，无需罚函数、机会约束或矩近似。在13个基准问题上，bilevel BO以更少迭代和更短墙钟时间获得更低遗憾，且对初始化规模、勘探参数和内层求解器选择均稳健。
AI.motivation: 灰盒优化问题中决策变量天然分为黑盒和白盒两类，白盒变量受显式闭式方程约束且依赖黑盒函数输出。现有方法通常将两类变量混在一起处理，导致白盒约束难以精确满足，常需依赖罚函数、机会约束或矩近似等近似手段。
AI.method: 提出双层优化重组：外层使用贝叶斯优化（BO）优化仅以黑盒变量为自变量的目标函数；内层通过全局优化求解依赖于黑盒函数输出的白盒变量子问题。高斯过程代理定义在黑盒变量空间中，白盒约束在内层优化收敛到可行点时被精确满足，无需罚函数、机会约束或矩近似。
AI.result: 在13个基准问题上，双层BO相比基线方法获得更低的遗憾，且所需的迭代次数和墙钟时间更少。该方法对初始化集大小、勘探参数以及内层求解器的选择均表现出稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 利用决策变量天然的黑盒/白盒分离结构，通过双层重组可显著提升优化效率和约束满足的精确性，且无需引入任何近似约束处理技术。

title: Screenshots or Tools? Eliciting Tool Use and Managing Multimodal Context in Hybrid GUI-MCP Computer-Use Agents
summary: Hybrid computer-use agents can act through screenshots or call text tools. We find that having a tool available does not settle which way the effect goes. Under one identical GUI-MCP harness on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark (309 tasks), the same MCP tools improve a reasoning model by +4.0pp and degrade a non-reasoning model by -5.9pp (5 runs each, both beyond 2 SE). What separates the two is tool-decision behavior. The non-reasoning policy ignores, misnames, or falsely terminates around tools. The reasoning model avoids these failures, yet still calls a tool on only 55/309 tasks, 23.9% of the tool-reachable ones. We call this shortfall the adoption gap. Both levels of the problem share one cause: the model already has a cheaper route and is never trained to take it. Multi-turn RL probes that cause. At the action level, a dense tool bonus raises spreadsheet adoption 0.03 -> 0.33 and carries into greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not follow. Behavior is steerable; competence is not. The bottleneck lies in tool-call semantics. At the context level, a successful tool call often makes the next screenshot redundant. Dropping it and halving image history cuts input tokens by about a third, at a small accuracy cost. Retraining under the same observation rule removes that cost. The compressed agent then reaches 37.8% against 33.0% for the uncompressed operating point, at 53% of the input cost, and closes the rich-lean gap on a pre-registered degraded subset to zero. Tools help when the model chooses and integrates them, and current hybrid agents leave many such choices unused.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合计算机使用代理（可同时通过截图和文本工具操作）中工具采用的行为差异。同一套MCP工具能提升推理模型4.0pp却使非推理模型下降5.9pp，关键差异在于工具决策行为。非推理模型存在忽略、误命名或错误终止工具的问题，而推理模型虽避免这些错误，但仅在309个任务中55个使用工具（占工具可达任务的23.9%），即"采纳缺口"。多轮RL探针表明行为可被引导（密集工具奖励可将电子表格采纳率从0.03提升至0.33）但能力不可被引导，瓶颈在于工具调用语义。上下文层面，成功工具调用常使下一截图冗余，删除冗余截图并将图像历史减半可将输入token减少约1/3且损失很小，重新训练可消除该损失，压缩代理以53%的成本达到37.8%对比未压缩的33.0%。结论：工具在模型选择并整合时才有效，当前混合代理浪费了大量此类选择。
AI.motivation: 混合计算机使用代理既有截图能力又有文本工具能力，但工具的可用性并不能决定其效果方向——同一工具集对不同模型产生截然不同的影响（+4.0pp vs -5.9pp）。作者希望探明这一差异的根本原因，并解决模型"有工具却不用"的采纳缺口问题。
AI.method: 在OSWorld-MCP基准（309个任务）上使用同一GUI-MCP框架进行对比实验，对推理和非推理模型设置5次重复运行（差异均超过2个标准误）。采用多轮RL探针在动作层面（施加密集工具奖励）和上下文层面（移除工具调用后的冗余截图、减半图像历史）分别干预，并通过重新训练消除压缩带来的准确性损失。
AI.result: 推理模型因工具获得+4.0pp提升，非推理模型则下降-5.9pp。非推理模型存在忽略、误命名、虚假终止等工具决策故障；推理模型仅55/309任务使用工具（工具可达任务的23.9%）。密集工具奖励将电子表格采纳率从0.03提升至0.33且泛化到贪心解码，但保留集准确率未提升。压缩后代理以53%输入成本达到37.8%准确率（对比未压缩33.0%），并在预先注册的退化子集上将丰富-贫乏差距归零。
AI.conclusion: 工具采纳问题分为行动层和上下文层，两层共同根源是模型已有更廉价的路径且从未被训练去使用工具。行为可被引导（steerable）但能力（competence）不可被引导，瓶颈在于工具调用语义本身。工具只有在模型主动选择并正确整合时才带来收益，当前混合代理在大量场景下浪费了工具选择的潜力。

title: DiagChain: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Evidence-Grounded Attack Chain Reconstruction
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a promising approach to attack chain reconstruction by retrieving and interpreting heterogeneous telemetry to infer ordered attacker actions. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate final outputs or aggregate accuracy, providing limited insight into how errors arise and propagate across intermediate reasoning stages. We present DiagChain, a diagnostic benchmark for evidence-grounded attack chain reconstruction that enables stage-wise evaluation of LLM agents. DiagChain includes MAIN-69, a suite of 69 scenarios spanning multiple operating systems, evidence noise levels, and chain lengths. It further introduces Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ECRAG), which couples evidence retrieval with an evolving structured representation of the reconstructed chain. Five complementary metrics are introduced to assess distinct stages of the reconstruction process and support systematic failure diagnosis. Based on evaluations using 6 LLMs, DiagChain reveals that even the strongest configuration succeeds on only 39.6% of the 849 reference steps in MAIN-69. Our analysis further shows that smaller models struggle with the more basic task of incorporating retrieved evidence into their outputs, whereas larger models can proceed to later steps, where correctly ordering that evidence becomes the main bottleneck. These results validate the importance of diagnostic evaluation beyond end-to-end accuracy and provide actionable insights for improving evidence-grounded cybersecurity agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiagChain，一个用于证据驱动的攻击链重建任务的诊断基准，包含MAIN-69场景套件和Evidence-Centric RAG（ECRAG）方法，通过五个互补指标在六个LLM上进行阶段式评估，揭示了最强配置也仅能成功完成39.6%的参考步骤，并发现小模型难以将检索证据整合到输出中，而大模型的主要瓶颈在于证据排序。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM代理攻击链重建基准主要评估最终输出或整体准确率，无法提供关于错误如何在中间推理阶段产生和传播的深入见解，缺乏阶段级别的诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建DiagChain诊断基准，包含：(1) MAIN-69场景套件，覆盖多种操作系统、证据噪声等级和链长度；(2) Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ECRAG)，将证据检索与演化中的链结构化表示相结合；(3) 五个互补指标用于评估重建过程的不同阶段并支持系统性失败诊断。
AI.result: 基于6个LLM的评估显示，即使最强配置在MAIN-69的849个参考步骤中也仅成功39.6%。小模型在将检索证据整合到输出这一基础任务上表现不佳，而大模型能推进到后续步骤，此时正确的证据排序成为主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了超越端到端准确率的诊断评估的重要性，并为改进证据驱动的网络安全代理提供了可操作的见解。

title: CRIL-U-Net: Compact Ratio-Interaction Learning for Focal Cortical Dysplasia Segmentation from T1w and FLAIR MRI
summary: Focal cortical dysplasia (FCD) type II is an important structural cause of drug-resistant focal epilepsy, but its small size, heterogeneous appearance, and subtle MRI characteristics make automated segmentation challenging. Conventional multimodal networks commonly concatenate T1-weighted (T1w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) images, requiring subsequent layers to learn useful cross-modal relationships implicitly. We propose CRIL-U-Net, a 3D U-Net incorporating a Compact Ratio-Interaction Learning module that combines local spatial features, voxel-wise cross-modal mixing, and bidirectional ratio-inspired interactions. CRIL-U-Net was compared with a conventional 3D U-Net and an input self-attention U-Net using five-fold cross-validation on 85 FCD subjects and 25 healthy controls. Each architecture was trained independently using Dice-binary cross-entropy (Dice-BCE) and Focal Tversky-Focal (FTF) losses. With FTF, CRIL-U-Net achieved the highest mean Dice score (0.196 +/- 0.262), compared with 0.136 +/- 0.224 for the U-Net and 0.135 +/- 0.214 for the attention comparator. It produced nonzero lesion overlap in 44 of 85 cases, compared with 36 for the U-Net. Under FTF, CRIL-U-Net significantly outperformed both comparison architectures after false-discovery-rate correction. These findings suggest that compact cross-modal representation learning can improve FCD segmentation within a controlled U-Net setting when combined with an imbalance-aware objective, although the remaining zero-overlap rate of 48.2% highlights the need for further validation and methodological development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRIL-U-Net，一种集成紧凑比率交互学习模块（CRIL）的3D U-Net，用于局灶性皮质发育不良（FCD）II型病灶的自动化分割。与传统3D U-Net和输入自注意力U-Net相比，在85名FCD患者和25名健康对照的五折交叉验证中，CRIL-U-Net在Focal Tversky-Focal（FTF）损失下取得了最高的平均Dice分数（0.196），并在FDR校正后显著优于两个对比架构。
AI.motivation: FCD II型是药物难治性局灶性癫痫的重要结构性病因，但其病灶体积小、外观异质且MRI特征细微，导致自动分割极具挑战。传统多模态网络通常将T1w和FLAIR图像简单拼接，需要后续层隐式学习跨模态关系，缺乏显式的跨模态特征交互设计。
AI.method: 提出CRIL-U-Net，在3D U-Net中嵌入紧凑比率交互学习（CRIL）模块。该模块结合局部空间特征、体素级跨模态混合和双向比率启发式交互，以显式建模T1w与FLAIR之间的跨模态关系。训练采用Dice-BCE和FTF两种损失函数，通过五折交叉验证在85例FCD患者和25例健康对照上与常规3D U-Net及输入自注意力U-Net对比。
AI.result: 在FTF损失下，CRIL-U-Net的平均Dice分数最高（0.196±0.262），优于常规U-Net（0.136±0.224）和注意力对比架构（0.135±0.214）。在85例中44例产生非零病灶重叠（常规U-Net为36例），且经FDR校正后CRIL-U-Net显著优于两个对比架构。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的跨模态表示学习结合不平衡感知的目标函数，能在受控的U-Net框架下改善FCD分割性能。但零重叠率仍高达48.2%，表明该方法的临床可用性仍需进一步验证和方法学改进。

title: Stochastic Multiple Shooting Trajectory Optimization via Sequential Local Policy Evaluation
summary: Stochastic single shooting trajectory optimization methods such as Model Predictive Path Integral control (MPPI) have been widely adopted in robotics due to their ability to reason about probabilistic dynamics and provide solutions where model gradients are noisy, costly to evaluate, or unavailable. However, satisfaction of terminal constraints when shooting over long action sequences is often sample inefficient, requiring a large number of iterations for convergence. In this paper, we present a stochastic multiple shooting method that optimizes short control action sequences connected via local feedback policies to improve sample efficiency and convergence to a terminal set. Additionally, we show that we are able to synthesize approximate system Jacobians purely from rollouts, making the method suitable for model-based reinforcement learning with black-box dynamics. We demonstrate the algorithm has improved sample efficiency and terminal set convergence for three nonlinear, underactuated optimization problems: a classic cartpole swingup task with analytical dynamics, a cartpole swingup task with learned neural network dynamics, and a VTOL quadplane performing a high angle-of-attack, precision post-stall landing maneuver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种随机多片段射击（stochastic multiple shooting）轨迹优化方法，通过短控制动作序列与局部反馈策略的连接，提高了长时间动作序列规划中终端约束满足的样本效率与收敛速度，并可从rollouts中合成近似系统雅可比矩阵，适用于黑箱动力学的模型强化学习。
AI.motivation: 随机单射击轨迹优化方法（如MPPI）在机器人领域广泛应用，但其在长动作序列上射击时，终端约束的满足往往样本效率低下，需要大量迭代才能收敛。
AI.method: 提出一种随机多片段射击方法，将短控制动作序列通过局部反馈策略连接起来进行优化；同时从rollouts中纯合成近似的系统雅可比矩阵，使方法适用于黑箱动力学的模型强化学习场景。
AI.result: 在三个非线性欠驱动优化问题上验证了算法：解析动力学的经典cartpole摆动上升任务、学习型神经网络动力学的cartpole任务，以及VTOL四翼飞行器执行高攻角精确失速后着陆机动。结果表明算法在样本效率和终端集合收敛方面均有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 随机多片段射击方法相比传统随机单射击方法（如MPPI），在长动作序列下具有更好的样本效率和终端约束收敛性能，且无需显式梯度信息即可进行优化，拓展了其在黑箱动力学模型强化学习中的应用。

title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
summary: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model's true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechanistic conflicts, such as memory-context misalignment, that are fundamental indicators of uncertainty. To address this, we introduce \textbf{D}ecoupled \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{(DUD)}, a framework that explicitly decouples FFN and Attention contributions via noise-induced causal interventions. By quantifying the independent restoration capabilities of each module, we construct a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures the model's internal fragility. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both uncertainty estimation and calibration, while exhibiting superior cross-dataset generalization, validating decoupled dynamics as a robust proxy for model faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DUD（解耦更新动力学）的框架，通过噪声诱导的因果干预显式解耦LLM中前馈网络（FFN）和注意力机制的贡献，构建双流动态画像以更准确地量化模型不确定性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于概率的不确定性指标无法捕捉LLM的真实认知状态，而现有机制方法通常聚合残差流更新，混淆了参数记忆（FFN）和上下文处理（注意力）的不同角色，掩盖了记忆-上下文错位等细粒度机制冲突，这些冲突恰恰是不确定性的关键指标。
AI.method: DUD框架通过噪声诱导的因果干预显式解耦FFN和Attention的贡献，分别量化各模块的独立恢复能力，构建双流动态画像以捕捉模型内部脆弱性。
AI.result: 在不确定性估计和校准方面显著优于最先进的基线方法，并展现出优越的跨数据集泛化能力，验证了解耦动力学作为模型忠实度稳健代理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦FFN与Attention的动态更新是比聚合残差流更有效的LLM不确定性量化方法，为机制层面的不确定性估计提供了新思路。

title: Revisiting TD Target Aggregation under Uncertainty in Q-Learning
comment: Accepted in the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI)
summary: Deep Q-Networks (DQNs) learn value functions through bootstrapped temporal-difference updates, where future returns are approximated using a greedy maximization over next-state action values. While effective, this aggregation rule is inherently sensitive to estimation noise: when Q-values are uncertain, the maximization operator deterministically favors the largest estimate, regardless of its reliability, leading to amplified errors through bootstrapping. In this work, we propose the \textbf{S}uccessor Rollout \textbf{A}ggregation \textbf{D}eep \textbf{Q}-Network (SADQ), a simple modification to Q-learning that regularizes how the TD target is formed. SADQ uses one-step rollout predictions from a learned dynamics model to guide the comparison among candidate next-state actions, introducing additional structure into the aggregation step without altering the underlying learning framework. The resulting mixed Bellman update attenuates unreliable maxima while preserving the standard fixed point under diminishing model error. We provide theoretical analysis showing that SADQ reduces bootstrap-induced overestimation in a pointwise manner. Empirically, SADQ consistently improves training stability across classical control tasks, real-world vector-based environments, and Atari benchmarks when compared to strong DQN variants.

AI.tldr: 提出SADQ（Successor Rollout Aggregation Deep Q-Network），通过学习到的动力学模型进行一步rollout预测来引导TD目标中候选动作的比较，从而正则化Q-learning的聚合步骤，抑制自举引起的过估计，提高训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 标准DQN中的max运算对估计噪声敏感：当Q值不确定时，最大化算子会确定性地偏向最大估计值而不考虑其可靠性，通过自举（bootstrapping）放大误差。需要一种机制来正则化TD目标的形成，降低不可靠最大值的影响。
AI.method: SADQ使用学习到的动力学模型进行单步rollout预测，在下一状态候选动作的比较中引入额外结构，形成混合Bellman更新。该方法不改变底层学习框架，在模型误差递减的情况下保持标准不动点，并从理论上证明其能在逐点意义上减少自举诱导的过估计。
AI.result: 在经典控制任务、真实世界向量环境和Atari基准上，SADQ相比强DQN变体一致地提升了训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: SADQ通过引入动力学模型rollout来引导聚合步骤，是一种简单有效的DQN改进方法，在不改变学习框架的前提下抑制过估计并提升稳定性。

title: Long-term Traffic Scene Prediction via Polynomial Representations in Autonomous Driving
summary: This thesis addresses fundamental challenges in traffic scene prediction for autonomous driving by introducing robust and computationally efficient models based on polynomial representations. While conventional sequence-based representations often struggle with noise and generalization, this work demonstrates that polynomial representations offer significant advantages in computational efficiency, generalization, and prediction plausibility. Through theoretical analysis and empirical validation, this thesis demonstrates that moderate-degree polynomials capture real-world motion dynamics with high fidelity without constraining predictive performance. Building on this foundation, a prediction model representing both trajectories and map geometry with polynomial representations achieves near state-of-the-art accuracy on standard benchmarks while substantially improving generalization under distribution shift. Extending this concept, a diffusion- based generative framework enables multi-agent scene generation, producing traffic continuations that are more plausible and kinematically consistent than those generated by conventional baselines. Evaluations on the Argoverse 2 and Waymo Open datasets confirm that polynomial representations reduce computational cost, enhance cross-dataset generalization, and yield smoother trajectories and higher behavioral plausibility. The findings reveal that standard in-distribution evaluation and regression-based metrics may fail to reflect true model generalization and prediction plausibility. By providing theoretical justification and empirical validation, this dissertation estab- lishes polynomial trajectory representations as an efficient, expressive, and generalizable foundation for traffic scene prediction in safety critical autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于多项式表示的轨迹预测方法，在自动驾驶场景预测中兼顾计算效率、泛化能力和预测合理性，在Argoverse 2和Waymo Open数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于序列的轨迹表示方法对噪声敏感且泛化能力有限，难以满足自动驾驶在安全关键场景下对高效、鲁棒预测的需求。
AI.method: 采用多项式表示来同时刻画轨迹和地图几何；在此基础上构建基于扩散的生成式框架，实现多智能体场景生成。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2和Waymo Open数据集上达到接近最先进的精度，同时显著提升分布偏移下的泛化能力，降低计算成本，生成更平滑且运动学一致的轨迹；并发现标准分布内评估和回归指标可能无法真实反映模型泛化能力与预测合理性。
AI.conclusion: 多项式轨迹表示可作为自动驾驶交通场景预测中高效、可表达且可泛化的基础表示方法。

title: A Security-Oriented Lifecycle Model for Large Language Model Systems
comment: Accepted as: Batzolis, E., Drosatos, G., Katsouros, V., & Rantos, K. (2026). A Security-Oriented Lifecycle Model for Large Language Model Systems. In: Kieseberg, P., Skopik, F., Atli, B., Schrittwieser, S., & Asplund, M. (Eds.), Availability, reliability and security---ARES 2026 EU Projects Symposium workshops (Lecture Notes in Computer Science, pp. 1-18). Springer Nature Switzerland
summary: Large language models are being integrated into critical infrastructure and enterprise workflows at unprecedented scale,yet the lifecycle frameworks governing their development and operations were designed for operational efficiency rather than security analysis. As a result, security-relevant activities such as data provenance verification, artifact signing, agentic permission control, and decommissioning are often left implicit or assumed to receive due care. Governance frameworks, in turn, organise requirements around risk levels or management processes without clearly linking them to the lifecycle stages where they apply. This paper addresses both deficiencies. We propose a lifecycle model for LLM systems that supports security analysis by structuring it around security-relevant boundaries rather than workflow optimisation. The model comprises 32 stages across four core pipeline layers (Data, Model, Distribution, Application), supported by a 12-stage LLMOps pillar and a 9-category governance pillar. Thirteen stages are introduced here as separate units because they expose distinct security concerns that existing frameworks do not clearly distinguish. A governance mapping synthesising the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001 reveals a structural property of the current regulatory landscape: governance evidence concentrates at deployment-facing stages, where systems are visible to regulators, while the most consequential decisions, data selection, alignment strategy, and capability boundaries, are made at development-facing stages, where regulatory visibility is lowest.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向安全分析的大型语言模型（LLM）系统生命周期模型，包含跨四个核心流水线层（数据、模型、分发、应用）的32个阶段，以及12个阶段的LLMOps支柱和9个类别的治理支柱。该模型将生命周期组织在安全相关的边界上而非工作流优化上。通过将NIST AI RMF、欧盟AI法案和ISO/IEC 42001的治理映射整合，揭示了当前监管格局的结构性特征：治理证据集中在面向部署的阶段，而数据选择、对齐策略和能力边界等最具决定性影响的决策却发生在面向开发的阶段，而这些阶段的监管可见性最低。
AI.motivation: LLM正在以前所未有的规模集成到关键基础设施和企业工作流中，但现有的生命周期治理框架是为运营效率而非安全分析设计的。安全相关活动（如数据溯源验证、工件签名、代理权限控制、退役处理）往往被隐性处理，而治理框架按风险等级或管理流程组织需求，却未与适用阶段明确关联。作者针对这两个缺陷提出解决方案。
AI.method: 提出基于安全相关边界而非工作流优化的LLM系统生命周期模型。该模型由四个核心流水线层（数据、模型、分发、应用）共32个阶段构成，辅以12阶段的LLMOps支柱和9类别的治理支柱。其中13个阶段作为独立单元被引入，因为它们暴露出现有框架未能清晰区分的不同安全关切。同时构建了整合NIST AI RMF、欧盟AI法案和ISO/IEC 42001的治理映射。
AI.result: 治理映射分析揭示了一个结构性属性：当前监管格局中，治理证据集中在面向部署的阶段（系统对监管者可见），而最具决定性影响的决策（数据选择、对齐策略、能力边界）发生在面向开发的阶段，该区域的监管可见性最低。这构成了监管覆盖与决策重要性之间的系统性错配。
AI.conclusion: 现有监管框架对LLM生命周期中决策影响力最大的开发阶段缺乏有效监管覆盖，而治理证据多集中于部署阶段，造成安全治理的结构性偏差。本文提出的生命周期模型为未来更精准的安全分析和监管设计提供了结构化基础。

title: Bridging Online and Offline Handwriting via Differentiable Physical Rendering
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026, Project page: https://seonmip.github.io/onoff
summary: Realistic handwritten text generation plays an important role in numerous applications, such as font design, biometric authentication, and robotic calligraphy. Existing methods are typically divided into two independent paradigms: online approaches that estimate handwriting trajectories and offline approaches that synthesize realistic handwriting images. While online models capture structural and temporal dynamics, they often lack fine-grained textures, whereas offline models reproduce realistic appearance but discard stroke order. However, unifying online and offline models remains challenging due to (1) the lack of an explicit physical model linking stroke kinematics to pixel-level appearance and (2) the absence of paired trajectory-image datasets. Moreover, enabling end-to-end learning requires a differentiable rendering process across motion and appearance domains. To address these challenges, we propose a compact physical brush model that bridges stroke dynamics and visual appearance, together with a differentiable rendering module that converts stroke trajectories into stylized images. By integrating these components, we propose a unified online-offline handwriting generation framework via differentiable brush rendering. The proposed framework consists of four core modules: 1) a text-to-stroke generator that predicts the target stroke conditioned on the given text and style image, 2) a brush parameter observer that extracts brush model parameters from style references, 3) a differentiable brush renderer that maps a stroke sequence and physical brush parameters into a handwritten image, and 4) a zero-shot image refiner that refines rendered images via diffusion models. Extensive experiments and real-world robotic calligraphy demonstrations validate our approach, achieving both structural and visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的在线-离线手写体生成框架，通过紧凑的物理笔刷模型和可微分渲染模块，将笔画运动轨迹转化为风格化手写图像，包含文本到笔画生成器、笔刷参数观察器、可微分笔刷渲染器和扩散模型图像精炼器四个核心模块。
AI.motivation: 现有手写体生成方法分为在线（轨迹估计）和离线（图像合成）两种独立范式：在线模型捕捉结构和时间动态但缺乏细粒度纹理，离线模型生成逼真外观但忽略笔画顺序。统一两者面临三个挑战：缺乏连接运动学与像素级外观的显式物理模型、缺少成对的轨迹-图像数据集、需要可微分的渲染过程以支持端到端学习。
AI.method: 1) 提出紧凑的物理笔刷模型，将笔画动态与视觉外观联系起来；2) 设计可微分渲染模块，将笔画轨迹转换为风格化图像；3) 构建统一框架，包含四个模块：文本到笔画生成器（根据文本和风格图预测笔画）、笔刷参数观察器（从风格参考提取笔刷参数）、可微分笔刷渲染器（将笔画序列和物理笔刷参数映射为手写图像）、零样本图像精炼器（通过扩散模型细化渲染图像）。
AI.result: 大量实验和真实机器人书法演示验证了该方法的有效性，在结构保真度和视觉逼真度两方面均取得了良好表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理笔刷建模和可微分渲染，成功弥合了在线和离线手写生成范式之间的鸿沟，实现了兼具结构和视觉保真的统一手写体生成框架。

title: Dynamically Allocating Evaluation Effort for Model Ranking
summary: While human evaluation is the gold standard in many NLP tasks, it suffers from prohibitive costs and poor scalability. When identifying top-performing models, typical evaluation protocols waste effort by exhaustively evaluating all models on the entire benchmark, a safe but inefficient approach. In this work, we formalize multi-model human evaluation as a best-arm identification problem in a multi-armed bandit setup with correlated arms, where pulling an arm corresponds to human-evaluating a model. By sampling adaptively based on the intermediate model rankings obtained on the samples so far, we can focus the annotation budget on the most competitive models. We prove the optimality of the proposed algorithms and show that it improves discrimination between top-performing models. This makes evaluations faster, cheaper and more aligned with large-scale competition evaluation goals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将多模型人工评估形式化为多臂老虎机中最佳臂识别问题，通过自适应采样将评估预算集中在最具竞争力的模型上，从而更高效地识别顶级模型。
AI.motivation: 人工评估虽然被视为NLP任务的黄金标准，但成本高昂且可扩展性差。传统的评估协议对所有模型在完整基准上进行穷举评估，虽然安全但效率低下，浪费了大量标注预算。
AI.method: 将多模型人工评估形式化为带相关臂的多臂老虎机（multi-armed bandit）设置下的最佳臂识别（best-arm identification）问题，其中拉动一个臂对应于对某个模型进行人工评估。通过基于当前样本得到的中间模型排名进行自适应采样，将标注预算集中在最具竞争力的模型上。
AI.result: 证明了所提出算法的最优性，并展示了该算法能够改善顶级模型之间的区分度，使得评估更快、更便宜。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使人工评估更快速、成本更低，并且更符合大规模竞赛评估目标，为多模型评估提供了一种理论上有保证的高效方案。

title: SynEnergy: Anomaly Semantic-Guided Diffusion for Synthetic Energy Data Generation
summary: Fine-grained energy consumption data are essential for applications such as demand forecasting, demand response planning, and grid reliability assessment. However, access to such data is often restricted by privacy concerns and data-sharing constraints, motivating growing interest in synthetic energy data generation. Although existing methods can reproduce overall consumption distributions and recurring temporal patterns, they often smooth out or underrepresent anomalous events caused by extreme weather, infrastructure failures, and behavioral shifts. Preserving these events is challenging because they are sparse, localized in time and space, and shaped by heterogeneous dependencies across geographical proximity and regional attributes. To address these challenges, we propose SynEnergy, a two-stage diffusion-based framework for anomaly-preserving energy consumption data generation. The first stage, Heterogeneous Graph-based Anomaly Semantic Learning (HG-ASL), extracts region-specific anomaly semantics from sparse residual structures by jointly modeling spatial and attribute dependencies across urban regions. The second stage, Anomaly Semantic-guided Diffusion (AS-Diff), injects the learned anomaly semantics into the denoising process to generate realistic consumption sequences while preserving anomalous patterns. This design enables controllable generation for individual regions and scales naturally to city-wide settings. We evaluate SynEnergy on four real-world energy consumption datasets against 11 general-purpose and energy-specific generation baselines. Experimental results show that SynEnergy improves anomaly preservation fidelity by an average of 12.21% and downstream quality by 2.96%, while maintaining competitive overall generation fidelity compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SynEnergy，一个两阶段基于扩散模型的合成能源数据生成框架，用于保留异常事件（如极端天气、基础设施故障等）的细粒度能源消耗数据生成。通过异构图表征异常语义学习（HG-ASL）和异常语义引导的扩散模型（AS-Diff）两阶段设计，在四个真实数据集上实现了12.21%的异常保真度提升和2.96%的下游任务质量提升。
AI.motivation: 细粒度能源消耗数据对需求预测、需求响应规划和电网可靠性评估至关重要，但隐私和数据共享限制阻碍了数据访问。现有合成数据生成方法虽能复现总体分布和周期性时间模式，但常平滑掉或低估由极端天气、基础设施故障和行为变化导致的异常事件。这些事件稀疏、在时间和空间上局部化，且受地理邻近性和区域属性的异构依赖影响，因此保真困难。
AI.method: 提出SynEnergy两阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段HG-ASL（异构图表征异常语义学习），通过联合建模城市区域间的空间依赖和属性依赖，从稀疏残差结构中提取区域特异性异常语义；(2) 第二阶段AS-Diff（异常语义引导的扩散模型），将学习到的异常语义注入去噪过程，生成保留异常模式的真实消耗序列。设计支持对单个区域的可控生成，并自然扩展到城市级规模。
AI.result: 在四个真实能源消耗数据集上，与11个通用和能源专用的生成基线相比，SynEnergy将异常保真度平均提升12.21%，下游任务质量提升2.96%，同时保持了与基线相当的整体生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: SynEnergy通过显式建模和注入异常语义，有效解决了合成能源数据生成中异常事件被平滑或低估的问题，在保留异常的同时维持整体生成质量，为隐私受限场景下的细粒度能源数据应用提供了可行方案。

title: Traceable Multi-Agent System for Knowledge-Based Forecasting
comment: Accepted at KDD 2026 Workshop on Enterprise AI Agents (Oral)
summary: Enterprise forecasting increasingly relies on autonomous agents that interpret documents, search for data, generate code, and revise models. While this autonomy helps build adaptive forecasting pipelines, it also makes it difficult for practitioners to inspect why a forecast changed, which evidence supported the change, and how data and modeling choices were revised. We present TraceMAS, an interactive demo system for traceable multi-agent forecasting. TraceMAS organizes agent outputs around two causal-loop representations: an Ideal Causal Loop Diagram (Ideal CLD), which captures key factors and their causal relations extracted from domain documents, and a Data-Grounded Causal Loop Diagram (Data-Grounded CLD), which links those factors to internal variables, external data, or documented proxies. The Data-Grounded CLD guides feature construction and model design while preserving the connection between textual evidence, data choices, and model revisions. We demonstrate TraceMAS on crude oil price forecasting. The demo interface allows users to compare forecasting iterations, inspect agent-level revisions, explore causal maps, review feature-data mappings and model architecture, and connect scenario forecasts to market narratives. This demonstration shows how autonomous forecasting agents can retain flexibility while making the evidence-to-forecast process inspectable.

AI.tldr: TraceMAS是一个交互式演示系统，用于可追溯的多智能体预测。它通过两种因果循环图（理想CLD和基于数据的CLD）组织智能体输出，连接文本证据、数据选择和模型修订，使自主预测过程可检查。
AI.motivation: 企业预测日益依赖自主智能体进行文档解释、数据搜索、代码生成和模型修订，虽然增强了预测管道的适应性，但从业者难以检查预测为何变化、支撑变化的证据是什么，以及数据和建模选择如何被修订。现有的自主预测缺乏可追溯性和可解释性。
AI.method: TraceMAS围绕两种因果循环表示组织智能体输出：理想因果循环图（Ideal CLD）从领域文档提取关键因素及其因果关系的抽象表示；基于数据的因果循环图（Data-Grounded CLD）将这些因素与内部变量、外部数据或文档化代理联系起来。Data-Grounded CLD指导特征构建和模型设计，同时保持文本证据、数据选择和模型修订之间的联系。系统提供交互界面，允许用户比较预测迭代、检查智能体级修订、探索因果图、审查特征-数据映射和模型架构，并将情景预测与市场叙事连接。
AI.result: 在原油价格预测任务上进行了演示。结果表明TraceMAS能够展示自主预测智能体在保持灵活性的同时，使从证据到预测的整个过程可检查。界面支持用户比较预测迭代、检查各层修订、探索因果映射及审查模型设计。
AI.conclusion: TraceMAS展示了自主预测智能体可以同时兼顾灵活性与可追溯性，但中间证据到预测的过程是可检查的。它为预测系统的透明度和可审计性提供了一种可行方案。

title: Empirical Analysis of Evasion and Poisoning Against Malware Data Drift Detection
summary: As concept drift due to malware evolution presents challenges for malware classification, machine learning-based data drift detection tools are developed to mitigate this problem. These data drift detector tools are designed for a different purpose and built with different techniques compared to malware classifiers. Although evasion and poisoning attacks against machine learning-based malware classifiers can cause misclassification of malware samples, it is not clear how these attacks work against data drift detectors and malware classifiers in combination. This work investigates the effect of evasion and poisoning attacks on the data drift detector along with the malware classifier. We demonstrate how unique characteristics of data drift detectors cause attacks against malware classifiers to work differently against them.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究逃避攻击和投毒攻击如何同时作用于数据漂移检测器和恶意软件分类器，揭示数据漂移检测器的独特特性会使针对恶意软件分类器的攻击在它们身上产生不同的效果。
AI.motivation: 恶意软件演化带来的概念漂移对恶意软件分类构成挑战，机器学习驱动的数据漂移检测工具被用于缓解这一问题。然而，尽管逃避攻击和投毒攻击已被证明能导致恶意软件分类器误分类，但这些攻击如何同时作用于数据漂移检测器和恶意软件分类器尚不清楚。
AI.method: 本文通过实验系统地研究逃避攻击和投毒攻击对数据漂移检测器与恶意软件分类器组合系统的影响，重点分析数据漂移检测器的独特特性（如统计分布监控、时间序列分析等）如何改变攻击在组合环境下的表现。
AI.result: 演示了数据漂移检测器的独特特性会导致针对恶意软件分类器的攻击在它们身上产生不同的效果，表明攻击对组合系统的影响与对单独分类器的影响存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 攻击者可以利用数据漂移检测器与恶意软件分类器之间的技术差异，使得针对组合系统的攻击产生与单独攻击分类器时不同的后果，这对恶意软件防御系统的整体安全性设计提出了新挑战。

title: DRIFT: Derailing Denoising Trajectories of Flow-Matching VLAs with Adversarial Patch Attack
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as pi0 generate robot actions by integrating a learned denoising velocity field, and have been reported to resist adversarial perturbations that readily fool autoregressive VLAs. We show that this robustness is largely illusory: it stems from prior attacks ignoring the multi-step denoising ODE. We introduce DRIFT (Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory), a test-time universal adversarial patch placed on the robot's gripper that attacks the denoising velocity field of an off-the-shelf policy. Our central finding is counterintuitive: attacking only the first denoising step is both stronger and cheaper than attacking a wider window of steps, which we explain through a gradient conflict unique to input-space optimization and which is exactly opposite to the training-time backdoor regime. On pi0 and pi0.5 across four LIBERO suites, DRIFT breaks essentially all originally-solvable tasks with a small single patch, far exceeding action- and embedding-space attack baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRIFT攻击方法，揭示流匹配VLA模型（如pi0）对对抗扰动的鲁棒性是"虚假的"——先前攻击失败是因为忽略了多步去噪ODE。DRIFT通过在机器人夹爪上放置测试时通用对抗补丁，仅攻击去噪第一步即可破坏几乎所有本可解决的任务，且比攻击更宽时间窗口更强更便宜。
AI.motivation: 流匹配VLA模型（如pi0）此前被认为能抵抗对抗扰动，但作者认为这种鲁棒性很大程度上是假象，源于先前攻击方法忽略了多步去噪ODE这一关键机制。因此需要设计一种针对流匹配去噪轨迹的攻击方法来验证其真实的脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出DRIFT（Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory），一种测试时通用对抗补丁，放置在机器人夹爪上，攻击离线策略的去噪速度场。核心发现：仅攻击第一个去噪步骤比攻击更宽的时间窗口更强且更便宜，这种现象源于输入空间优化中特有的梯度冲突，与训练时后门攻击场景恰好相反。
AI.result: 在pi0和pi0.5上，覆盖四个LIBERO任务套件，DRIFT以单个小补丁就能破坏几乎所有原本可解决的任务，性能远超动作空间和嵌入空间的攻击基线。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配VLA模型在此类对抗攻击面前是脆弱的，先前的鲁棒性结论需要被修正；同时"仅攻击第一步"这一反直觉发现揭示了流匹配去噪轨迹的独特攻击面，为未来VLA安全性研究提供了新方向。

title: Predicting Multilingual Classification and Translation Performance of LLMs with Cross-Lingual Alignment $\unicode{x2013}$ Is English Enough?
summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform better on non-English classification tasks when the representations of the given language are more aligned to English within the model. Several cross-lingual alignment (CLA) scores have been proposed for use with LLMs, along with multiple approaches for extracting embeddings from the models. We provide a comparative analysis of 27 CLA score variants, examining how they differ and how well each predicts downstream performance across three tasks. Crucially, while LLMs are widely used for generative tasks such as machine translation, prior work has focused almost exclusively on classification. We therefore investigate whether CLA scores are similarly predictive of translation performance. To enable computing correlations across target languages, we propose a PMI-based translation metric, which is less dependent on the target language and correlates strongly with chrF. We find that CLA with English predicts translation quality comparably to or better than source-target CLA, providing new evidence that LLMs use English as an internal pivot language.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了27种跨语言对齐（CLA）分数变体，首次将其预测能力从分类任务扩展到机器翻译等生成任务，并提出一种基于PMI的翻译评估指标，发现英语作为内部枢轴语言可有效预测翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 以往研究几乎只关注CLA分数对多语言LLM分类任务的预测能力，但LLM广泛用于机器翻译等生成任务。作者希望探究CLA分数是否同样能预测翻译性能，并解决跨语言相关性计算的目标语言依赖问题。
AI.method: 对27种CLA分数变体进行系统比较分析，涵盖不同的嵌入提取方法和CLA计算方法；将CLA分数与三类下游任务（包括分类和翻译）的表现进行相关性评估；提出一种基于PMI（点互信息）的翻译指标用于跨目标语言计算相关性，并验证其与chrF的强相关性。
AI.result: 发现CLA分数在预测翻译质量方面同样有效，且英语-目标语言CLA（英语作为枢轴）的预测能力与源语言-目标语言CLA相当甚至更好，这为LLM以英语作为内部枢轴语言的假设提供了新证据；提出的PMI翻译指标与chrF强相关且对目标语言依赖更弱。
AI.conclusion: CLA分数不仅适用于分类任务的性能预测，也能有效预测机器翻译质量。英语-目标语言对齐反映了LLM内部的枢轴机制，为理解多语言LLM的跨语言表征结构提供了新视角，同时提出的PMI指标可用于跨语言场景下更可靠的翻译质量评估。

title: SMOPD: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning via Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation
summary: We aim to improve model performance in multi-reward reinforcement learning training process. Existing Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) has mitigated the issue of reward signals masking one another during direct scalarization by normalizing each reward dimension separately before aggregation. However, our experiments show that GDPO still struggles to balance reward signals with different granularities. Specifically, in some particular training tasks, the model may receive a dense reward that assigns fine-grained scores ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, together with a sparse reward that provides only binary feedback of either 0 or 1. In such cases, we find that the sparse reward may provide an insufficient optimization signal, preventing its corresponding capability from being effectively reinforced. Therefore, how can we strengthen the optimization signal from the sparse reward without sacrificing the capability already learned from the fine-grained reward? To overcome this limitation, we propose Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation (SMOPD), a two-stage training method for multi-reward optimization. Stage1-Specialize: SMOPD first employs reward-priority configurations to train multiple reward-specialized teachers, allowing each reward to be learned under conditions where its signal can effectively drive optimization. Stage2-Merge: SMOPD then utilizes online policy distillation to combine the reward-specialized capabilities of these teachers into a single student policy, while maintaining balanced task-level optimization. To validate our method, we conduct experiments on two multi-reward settings: complementary rewards(tool-calling accuracy and format) and conflicting rewards (helpful and harmless rewards). Based on above settings, SMOPD outperforms GDPO across 1.5B, 3B and 7B backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation (SMOPD)，一种两阶段多奖励强化学习训练方法，解决GDPO在混合稠密/稀疏奖励场景下优化信号不足的问题。SMOPD先通过奖励优先级配置训练多个奖励专用教师模型，再通过在线策略蒸馏将各教师的能力合并到单一学生策略中，在1.5B/3B/7B规模上均优于GDPO。
AI.motivation: 现有的GDPO虽通过各奖励维度分别归一化后再聚合缓解了奖励信号相互掩盖的问题，但在不同粒度（如稠密奖励0.1-1.0与稀疏二元奖励0/1）混合的场景下，稀疏奖励提供的优化信号不足，导致其对应的能力无法被有效强化。核心挑战在于：如何在不牺牲稠密奖励已学得能力的前提下，增强稀疏奖励的优化信号。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练方法SMOPD。Stage1-Specialize阶段：采用奖励优先级配置为每个奖励分别训练专门的教师模型，使各奖励在能有效驱动优化的条件下被充分学习。Stage2-Merge阶段：利用在线策略蒸馏（online policy distillation）将各奖励专用教师的能力合并到单一学生策略中，同时保持任务层面的平衡优化。
AI.result: 在两组多奖励设置下验证：互补奖励（工具调用准确率与格式）和冲突奖励（有用性与无害性）。SMOPD在1.5B、3B和7B三种骨干模型规模上均优于GDPO。
AI.conclusion: SMOPD通过"分工-整合"两阶段范式有效解决了多奖励训练中不同粒度奖励信号失衡的问题，在不牺牲稠密奖励已学能力的情况下增强了稀疏奖励的优化效果，在多种模型规模和多类奖励场景下均展现出优于GDPO的性能。

title: MMLongBench-Doc-V2: A Corrected-Annotation, Semantics-Aware Revision of MMLongBench-Doc
summary: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-document QA benchmark of 1,082 questions over 135 PDFs. Two properties of it push measured scores away from the quantity they are meant to capture: the reference metric compares extracted answers, so 1,358,000 loses to 1358000; and a non-trivial share of ground-truth annotations are wrong, ambiguous, or incomplete --- concentrated, because of how they were found, in exactly the questions capable systems answer correctly. MMLongBench-Doc-V2 corrects 106 annotations, each published with the page and arithmetic that settle it, and replaces the string metric with a pinned LLM judge asked whether a response means the reference. Ten questions whose document ships under the wrong filename are removed rather than counted wrong, along with one duplicated question, leaving 1,071 questions over 134 documents. The most reusable contribution is a decision procedure for when an empty set key may be widened and when widening would destroy a deliberate negative sample; applied to all 208 rows, it widened 14. V2 scores are not comparable with published V1 numbers. The corrected corpus, the per-entry correction record and the evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/VectifyAI/MMLongBench-Doc-V2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MMLongBench-Doc-V2，一个修正版的长文档问答基准，修复了原版 MMLongBench-Doc 中的指标误判、标注错误及文件命名问题，并引入固定 LLM 评判器替代字符串匹配。
AI.motivation: MMLongBench-Doc 作为长文档 QA 基准存在两个核心缺陷：其一，参考指标比较提取后的字符串，导致数值格式差异（如 1,358,000 与 1358000）被误判为错误；其二，相当比例的 ground-truth 标注存在错误、歧义或不完整，且这类错误恰恰集中在有能力系统能答对的题目上（由于标注产生方式的偏差），严重扭曲了评测分数所反映的真实能力。
AI.method: MMLongBench-Doc-V2 采取三项修正措施：(1) 修正 106 条标注，每条均附带裁决所用的页码与算术过程；(2) 用固定（pinned）的 LLM 评判器替换字符串匹配指标，评判器回答"回答是否意指参考答案"；(3) 删除 10 道文档文件名错误的问题及 1 道重复问题，得到 1,071 道题、134 份文档。此外，作者提出一个可复用的决策流程：判断何时允许扩大空集键（empty set key）、何时扩大会破坏刻意构造的负样本，应用于全部 208 行后扩大了 14 行。
AI.result: 修正后的 V2 版本包含 1,071 道题、134 份文档，修正了 106 条标注并移除 11 道问题；空集键扩大决策流程应用于 208 行，其中 14 行被扩大。作者明确指出 V2 分数与已发表的 V1 分数不可直接比较。
AI.conclusion: 通过修正标注、替换评估指标并移除有缺陷的问题，MMLongBench-Doc-V2 使评测分数更接近其想要衡量的真实能力。该工作的可复用贡献在于空集键扩大决策流程，且全部语料、逐条修正记录及评测框架均已开源。

title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
summary: Persona skills distill personal interaction histories into portable and executable artifacts for downstream agents. While enabling flexible personalization, this process concentrates fragmented personal signals, amplifies their impact through reuse, and challenges defenses designed for individual records or retrieval-based memory. To systematically investigate the safety of the persona-skill pipeline, we introduce AntiSkillBench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating risks and defenses across the persona-skill pipeline. It comprises: (i) a dataset of 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces, constructed from 50 behaviorally rich profiles spanning diverse task scenarios; (ii) an evaluation suite that measures skill-level privacy leakage and agent-level attribute disclosure and behavioral impersonation across three skill-distillation strategies; and (iii) a defense evaluation covering four configurations across online and post-hoc interventions, including active risk suppression and passive provenance protection. Experiments across three frontier agents show that persona-skill risks persist across agent backbones and distillation protocols, extending from explicit attributes to communication styles and personality traits. Existing defenses exhibit limited and distillation-dependent effectiveness, failing to generalize across risk and distillation strategies. These results highlight AntiSkillBench as a challenging benchmark for developing privacy-preserving and authenticity-aware persona skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AntiSkillBench，一个端到端基准测试，用于系统评估人格技能流水线（persona-skill pipeline）中的隐私泄露和防御机制。该基准包含7500条基于人格的对话轨迹、覆盖三种技能蒸馏策略的评估套件，以及四种防御配置，实验表明人格技能风险在多个前沿智能体上持续存在，现有防御效果有限且难以泛化。
AI.motivation: 人格技能（persona skills）将个人交互历史提炼为可移植、可执行的构件，虽然实现了灵活个性化，但这一过程会集中碎片化的个人信号并通过复用放大其影响，给仅针对单个记录或基于检索的记忆设计的防御机制带来挑战。目前缺乏对整个人格技能流水线安全性的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建了AntiSkillBench，包含三部分：(i)由50个行为丰富的人设档案构建的7500条人格对话轨迹数据集，覆盖多样化任务场景；(ii)评估套件，跨三种技能蒸馏策略测量技能级隐私泄露和智能体级属性披露及行为模仿；(iii)防御评估，覆盖四种配置，包括在线和后置干预，涉及主动风险抑制和被动来源保护。
AI.result: 在三个前沿智能体上的实验表明，人格技能风险在不同智能体骨干和蒸馏协议上持续存在，风险从显性属性延伸到沟通风格和人格特质。现有防御方法效果有限且依赖于蒸馏策略，无法在风险和蒸馏策略之间泛化。
AI.conclusion: AntiSkillBench是一个具有挑战性的基准测试，为开发隐私保护和真实性感知的人格技能（persona skills）提供了重要评测平台，凸显了该领域安全防御的不足和未来研究需求。

title: CrossScope: A Role-Asymmetric World Model for Joint Dual-Scope Surgical Video Prediction
summary: Visual world models typically learn future dynamics from a single observation stream, limiting their ability to model cooperative systems with multiple independently moving observers. We investigate this challenge in Mother--Child endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), where two flexible scopes provide complementary yet role-dependent views without a calibrated stereo relationship. Unlike conventional multi-view fusion that assumes symmetric information exchange, we formulate \textbf{role-asymmetric dual-scope future prediction}, where cross-view evidence is selectively transferred according to the prediction target and its underlying spatial requirements. We propose \textbf{CrossScope}, a dual-stream surgical world model that preserves view-specific experts while enabling target-specific evidence routing through geometry-guided residual interactions. CrossScope learns two complementary communication directions: geometric motion cues from the Mother view guide Child-view future dynamics, while pose-aligned Child appearance supports Mother-view prediction only when valid spatial correspondence is established. This design allows each scope to contribute task-relevant evidence without compromising its view-specific representation. To evaluate this problem, we establish a paired dual-scope benchmark comprising synchronized phantom and real-world ERCP episodes, with evaluations assessing visual fidelity, structural preservation, target localization, and motion consistency. Experiments demonstrate that CrossScope consistently outperforms strong surgical video generation baselines, validating the importance of role-aware evidence routing for multi-observer visual world modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossScope，一个针对ERCP手术中母镜-子镜双内窥镜系统的角色非对称未来预测框架。不同于传统多视角融合假设对称信息交换，CrossScope通过几何引导的残差交互实现按需、按角色的跨视角证据路由，在不破坏各视角专用表示的前提下提升双流未来预测质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉世界模型通常从单一观测流学习未来动态，无法建模多个独立移动观察者组成的协作系统。在Mother-Child ERCP手术中，两个柔性内窥镜提供互补但角色依赖的视图，且缺乏校准的立体关系。传统多视图融合假设对称信息交换，不符合该场景下预测目标不同、空间需求不同的现实需求。
AI.method: CrossScope采用双流手术世界模型架构：1）保留各视图专属专家表示；2）通过几何引导的残差交互实现目标特定的证据路由；3）学习两条互补通信方向——Mother视图的几何运动线索引导Child视图未来动态，Child视图的位姿对齐外观仅在建立有效空间对应关系时辅助Mother视图预测。
AI.result: 在包含同步phantom与真实ERCP序列的双视角基准上，CrossScope在视觉保真度、结构保持、目标定位和运动一致性等评估指标上持续优于强基线外科手术视频生成方法，验证了角色感知证据路由对多观察者视觉世界建模的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 角色不对称的证据路由机制是多观察者视觉世界建模的关键。CrossScope通过按需、按角色传递跨视角信息，使每个内窥镜在不损害其专用表示的前提下贡献任务相关证据，为ERCP等协作手术场景的视频预测提供了新范式。

title: Probing Character-level Transformers for the Spanish L-shaped Morphome
summary: When a transformer learns an irregular morphological pattern, what has it learned? Our test case is the Spanish \emph{L-shaped morphome}, a complex irregular pattern in which the verb's stem alternates in exactly the first-person singular indicative and all subjunctive forms, and whose membership no phonological, semantic, or syntactic feature predicts. Prior studies have shown that character-level transformers can reproduce this pattern, but that evidence describes what models produce, not what they represent. Probing five architectures, twelve trained models each, under lemma-disjoint cross-validation with controls and surface baselines, we show that the models encode the L-shaped class itself, not just its visible alternations. It is decodable above every surface baseline, survives instances in which every form shows the same stem, and probes trained on alternating instances still classify non-alternating ones. The encoding is localized where the stem choice is made, at the stem-final consonant position of the middle decoder, before the alternant is read. And it is item-specific: which verbs a model learned matters far more than which architecture it is. The models store the morphome as an item-specific lexical abstraction, sufficient to reproduce the pattern but not to generalize it as humans do.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Transformer模型在学习西班牙语L形形态词素时，究竟学习到了什么表征。通过对五种架构、每种12个模型的探测分析，证明模型不仅在输出层面复现了这一不规则的L形交替模式，而且在内部表征中编码了L形类别本身，该编码位于词干选择发生的中层解码器的词干末尾辅音位置，且具有词项特异性而非架构特异性。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明字符级Transformer能够复现西班牙语L形形态词素这一复杂的、无法用音系/语义/句法特征预测的不规则交替模式，但现有证据仅描述了模型的输出行为，而未揭示模型内部表征的本质。作者希望探明：模型是仅仅学到了表面可见的交替形态，还是在表征层面真正编码了L形类别这一抽象的层次。
AI.method: 采用探测法（probing）研究五种不同架构的Transformer，每种架构训练12个模型，在词位不相交（lemma-disjoint）的交叉验证设定下进行实验，并设置表面基线（surface baselines）作为对照。通过三类关键证据检验L形类别的可解码性：（1）类别在所有表面基线之上可解码；（2）在所有形式呈现相同词干的实例中仍能解码；（3）用交替实例训练的探测器能对非交替实例进行分类。同时分析编码的空间位置和跨模型/跨架构的变异性。
AI.result: 研究结果显示：模型确实在内部表征中编码了L形形态词素类别本身，而非仅编码表面交替。该编码存在于词干末尾辅音位置的中层解码器中，恰好位于词干选择发生的时刻（在交替形式被读出之前）。编码具有词项特异性，即模型学习了哪些具体动词对其表征的影响远大于模型架构本身的影响。
AI.conclusion: 模型将L形形态词素存储为一种词项特异性的词汇抽象表征，足以复现该不规则模式，但无法像人类一样将其泛化到新词项。这揭示了神经网络模型在习得复杂形态不规则性时的表征本质——它们构建了逐词项的抽象类别，而非生成性的规则系统。

title: Convex-Hull-Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization: Controlling Local Correction Propagation in Offline RL
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (offline RL) can benefit from nearby out-of-distribution (OOD) actions, but estimation errors at these actions may be amplified by bootstrapping. Existing regularization and local-generalization methods control either the admissible OOD region or the influence of generalized targets, often through separate mechanisms. We propose Convex Hull Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization (CSDG), which expresses the Bellman backup as an in-sample value target plus a CHN-local correction. This formulation makes the generalized contribution explicit and separates it from the in-sample reference path. The correction is obtained by smoothing in-sample-oriented and OOD-oriented candidates sampled at different perturbation radii. A mixture coefficient lambda scales its contribution to each backup, while the recursive discount remains gamma. Under boundedness and fixed perturbation kernels, we derive an exact one-step correction identity, a time-varying iterate bound, and a fixed-point bound that depends only on the branch discrepancy at the fixed point. We further characterize the implicit policies induced by the idealized operators and give a conditional non-degradation criterion. The practical algorithm approximates these quantities using asymmetric bounded noise and expectile regression, without exact support classification or an additional pessimistic OOD penalty. Experiments on Gym-MuJoCo and AntMaze show strong aggregate performance and stable value estimation. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/CSDG

AI.tldr: 本文提出凸包邻域平滑对偶泛化（CSDG）方法，通过将离线强化学习的Bellman备份表示为样本内值目标与CHN局部修正之和，使泛化贡献显式化并分离于样本内参考路径，从而同时控制OOD区域和泛化目标的影响。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习虽能受益于邻近分布外（OOD）动作，但bootstrap会放大这些动作处的估计误差，现有正则化与局部泛化方法通常通过分离机制分别控制OOD区域或泛化目标的影响，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 将Bellman备份分解为样本内值目标加CHN（Convex Hull Neighborhood）局部修正；通过在不同扰动半径下采样样本内导向与OOD导向候选并结合平滑处理获得修正项；用混合系数lambda控制其对每次备份的贡献，递归折扣保持为gamma。在有界性和固定扰动核假设下推导精确一步修正恒等式、时变迭代界及仅依赖不动点处分差的不动点界；实际算法采用非对称有界噪声和期望回归近似，无需精确支持分类或额外悲观OOD惩罚。
AI.result: 在Gym-MuJoCo和AntMaze基准上取得强聚合性能与稳定的值估计。
AI.conclusion: CSDG提供了一种统一、可分析且实用的离线RL泛化框架，兼顾理论保证与实验性能。

title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance
summary: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, thereby enabling agents to use tools more robustly and effectively. ExpG consists of three phases: (1) experience acquisition, which analyzes tool invocation quality from historical execution trajectories, producing structured learnable experiences through multi-aspect attribution; (2) experience distillation, which keeps the experience pool effective by filtering unhelpful experiences, selecting representative ones with an equivalence-class-based method, and summarizing them into generalizable guidance; and (3) experience reuse, which applies the guidance adaptively during future task solving. Extensive experiments show that ExpG brings consistent improvements across the tool selection, tool calling, and response generation tasks, enabling smaller agents to outperform larger ones that do not use ExpG. Moreover, ExpG achieves particularly strong gains in challenging settings, suggesting a promising path toward more robust tool use. Our code, experiments, and results are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExpG机制，通过构建和精炼自适应引导来捕捉每个工具的能力边界和最佳实践，从而增强智能体在不同运行时条件下使用工具的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 智能体的性能瓶颈正从模型能力转向执行过程的鲁棒性。工具作为智能体与外部环境交互的主要接口，其使用方式在多样的运行时条件下缺乏鲁棒性保障，而现有方法很少关注这一关键问题。
AI.method: ExpG包含三个阶段：(1)经验获取——从历史执行轨迹中分析工具调用质量，通过多方面归因产生结构化可学习经验；(2)经验蒸馏——通过过滤无帮助经验保持经验池有效性，使用基于等价类的方法筛选代表性经验并总结为可泛化的引导；(3)经验复用——在未来任务求解中自适应地应用引导。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ExpG在工具选择、工具调用和响应生成任务中带来一致的改进，使较小的智能体能够超越不使用ExpG的较大智能体。此外，ExpG在具有挑战性的场景中取得了特别显著的增益。
AI.conclusion: ExpG为实现更鲁棒的工具使用提供了一条有前景的路径，通过经验驱动的自适应引导机制有效解决了智能体工具使用的鲁棒性问题。

title: Dependency Triad: A Metric to Quantify the Dependencies Between Attributes for Local Differential Privacy
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (ACM CCS 2026)
summary: Collecting multidimensional user data is essential for extracting rich insights across various applications. Local Differential Privacy (LDP) has emerged as a de facto standard for mitigating privacy risks in such scenarios. A key challenge in privacy-preserving multidimensional data collection lies in inter-attribute dependencies, as they can inadvertently reveal correlated information and increase privacy vulnerabilities. Therefore, accurately measuring correlation-induced privacy leakage (CPL) is essential for privacy analysis and privacy-utility trade-off. However, existing CPL analysis solutions either require accurate prior knowledge or face scalability challenges for large numbers of attributes and high-cardinality attributes. These limit their practical applicability in real data. To address this research gap, we propose a novel metric, ``Dependency Triad'' (DT), which summarizes the pairwise dependency information relevant to CPL using three parameters and yields a \emph{constant-time} conservative estimator of pairwise CPL. DT explicitly models uncertainty in prior distributional knowledge through its parameters, delivering robust leakage estimates. Moreover, its robustness to sparse distributions makes it particularly suitable for high-cardinality attributes, while the pairwise formulation serves as a tractable building block for assessing total leakage in multidimensional settings. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that DT consistently estimates CPL across diverse dependency regimes and prior uncertainties.

title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
summary: Query-based mask transformers assemble segmentation outputs through pixel-wise competition among query predictions of the final layer, yet this inference process is not explicitly optimized during training. We identify two key mismatches: the query with the highest probability-mask score does not necessarily produce the most accurate mask, and final-layer decoding may discard superior predictions from intermediate layers. To address these issues, we propose Inference-Aware Learning (iFAN), a general training framework for plain mask transformers. iFAN introduces Adjusted Probability-Mask Ranking (APMR), which aligns query competition with predicted mask quality and suppresses high-confidence but inaccurate competitors. We further employ Cross-Layer Self-Distillation (CLSD) to transfer stronger intermediate predictions to the final layer. The ranking and distillation objectives are training-only, while inference retains efficient final-layer decoding. Experiments on COCO, ADE20K, and Cityscapes demonstrate consistent improvements across panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation, as well as across different architectures, backbone scales, and input resolutions. Overall, iFAN improves performance by an average of 1.20 PQ, 1.30 AP, and 0.63 mIoU, with negligible additional parameters, FLOPs and inference latency.

AI.tldr: iFAN是一个面向普通掩码Transformer的通用训练框架，通过调整概率-掩码排名（APMR）和跨层自蒸馏（CLSD）解决推理与训练目标不一致的问题，在COCO、ADE20K和Cityscapes上分别平均提升1.20 PQ、1.30 AP和0.63 mIoU，且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 查询基础的掩码Transformer在推理时通过最终层查询预测之间的像素级竞争来组装分割输出，但这一推理过程在训练中并未被显式优化。作者识别出两个关键不匹配：(1) 概率-掩码分数最高的查询不一定是掩码质量最优的预测；(2) 最终层解码可能丢弃中间层的更优预测。
AI.method: iFAN包含两个核心组件：1) 调整概率-掩码排名（APMR）：将查询竞争与预测掩码质量对齐，并抑制高置信度但不准确的竞争者；2) 跨层自蒸馏（CLSD）：将更强中间层的预测知识迁移到最终层。两个训练目标仅在训练阶段生效，推理时仍保持高效的最终层解码。
AI.result: 在COCO、ADE20K和Cityscapes数据集上，iFAN在全景、实例和语义分割任务中，以及不同架构、骨干网络规模和输入分辨率下均取得一致的性能提升。平均提升1.20 PQ、1.30 AP和0.63 mIoU，且额外参数、FLOPs和推理延迟可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: iFAN通过训练阶段显式对齐推理过程中的查询竞争行为，有效弥合了掩码Transformer训练与推理之间的gap，是一种即插即用、通用且高效的分割训练框架。

title: Efficient Multilingual Neural Machine Translation via Corpus-Driven Vocabulary Pruning: An English-Arabic Case Study
summary: The adoption of large pre-trained multilingual models for neural machine translation (MNMT) faces a major challenge: excessive memory and computational consumption due to overly large vocabularies and embedding layers. Although existing compression methods like pruning, quantization and knowledge distillation reduce parameter redundancy, they mainly preserve the structure of the original vocabulary, thereby leaving a major source of inefficiency unresolved. We propose in this paper a general optimization framework that combines a vocabulary pruning method with a targeted fine-tuning protocol for MNMT models. We evaluate the proposed framework using three models (M2M100, NLLB-200, mBART-50) on the English-Arabic language pair. Our approach reduces the vocabulary size from over 128,000 to approximately 10,000 tokens, enabling a 60% memory saving without any loss in performance. Results show that optimized multilingual models can match or exceed the performance of dedicated bilingual baselines. In particular, the pruned and fine-tuned M2M100 model achieves a competitive BLEU score of 42.04 (against 44.59 for the OPUS-MTen- ar bilingual model) while it significantly outperforms it on the COMET metric (0.8730 vs 0.7911) revealing superior semantic adequacy and fluency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多语言神经机器翻译（MNMT）模型的通用优化框架，通过词汇表剪枝与针对性微调相结合，将词汇量从超过12.8万缩减至约1万，实现60%的内存节省且性能无损，优化后的模型甚至能在某些指标上超越专用双语模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MNMT模型因词汇表和嵌入层过大导致严重的内存和计算开销。虽然已有剪枝、量化和知识蒸馏等压缩方法，但它们主要保留原始词汇表结构，未解决词汇表本身带来的低效问题，这是MNMT实际部署的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一个通用优化框架，包含两部分：(1) 词汇表剪枝方法，将大规模多语言词汇表缩减至目标语言相关的核心词汇（从128,000降至约10,000个token）；(2) 针对性的微调协议，使压缩后的模型在不损失性能的情况下适应目标语言对。
AI.result: 在M2M100、NLLB-200和mBART-50三个模型上对英语-阿拉伯语语言对进行评估：词汇量从超过128K降至约10K，实现60%内存节省且无性能损失。剪枝并微调后的M2M100 BLEU达到42.04（对比双语基线OPUS-MTen-ar的44.59），但在COMET指标上显著优于基线（0.8730 vs 0.7911），展现出更好的语义充分性和流畅度。
AI.conclusion: 通过词汇表剪枝结合针对性微调，多语言模型可以被高效压缩并在目标语言对上达到或超越专用双语模型的性能，特别是在语义质量（COMET）方面表现优异。这表明词汇表优化是MNMT模型压缩中一个尚未充分开发但极具潜力的方向。

title: Double Descent in Gradient Boosting Decision Trees via Split-Candidate Scaling
summary: Double descent is commonly studied by scaling an explicit capacity parameter, such as neural-network width. For gradient boosting decision trees (GBDTs), however, an analogous single-axis capacity parameter has not been established. We propose the number of split candidates as an operational capacity parameter for GBDTs. Holding other training controls fixed, increasing the split-candidate budget refines the feature-quantization grid and expands the dictionary of root-to-leaf paths from which boosting selects its updates. To analyze this expansion, we construct an empirical tree-kernel diagnostic that summarizes how candidate-induced paths group the training examples. A regime in which the empirical kernel rank grows toward the sample size and very small positive eigenvalues emerge exposes noise-sensitive directions; in this regime, test error peaks before decreasing again at larger split-candidate budgets. This perspective predicts that deeper trees should reach the regime with fewer split candidates, larger training sets should require finer grids, and label noise should make the peak more pronounced. Experiments support these predictions and show test-error peaks at intermediate split-candidate budgets across XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, whereas a random-forest control improves monotonically under the same split-candidate sweep. Taken together, our analysis and experiments support split-candidate scaling as a single-axis capacity intervention for studying GBDTs and suggest that the observed double descent arises from an interaction between candidate-induced geometry and boosting dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将分裂候选数量（split candidates）作为梯度提升决策树（GBDT）的操作性容量参数，通过实证树核诊断揭示候选诱导的路径几何与提升动态之间的交互作用导致了双下降现象，并在XGBoost、LightGBM和CatBoost上验证了测试误差的中间峰行为。
AI.motivation: 双下降现象通常通过缩放显式容量参数（如神经网络宽度）来研究，但对GBDT而言，尚未建立类似的单轴容量参数。本文旨在填补这一空白，为GBDT的双下降研究提供一个可操作的单轴容量干预手段。
AI.method: 提出分裂候选数量作为GBDT的容量参数；构造经验树核诊断工具，通过核秩增长、微小正特征值的出现来识别噪声敏感方向；并利用该视角对树深度、训练集规模和标签噪声的影响做出预测，进而在XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验验证了理论预测：更深的树在更少的分裂候选数下到达双下降区域，更大的训练集需要更细的量化网格，标签噪声使峰值更显著。在三种GBDT实现中均观察到中间分裂候选预算处的测试误差峰，而随机森林对照组在相同的候选扫描下呈单调改善。
AI.conclusion: 分裂候选缩放可作为研究GBDT的单轴容量干预手段；观察到的双下降源于候选诱导的几何结构与提升动态之间的相互作用。

title: Enactive Artificial Intelligence: A Decision-Centric Architecture for Complex Systems
summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to evolve and mature, recent AI practices have moved beyond large language models (LLMs) and text or image generation tasks, increasingly integrating tools, agents, and harnesses to solve real business and industrial problems. However, the power of AI is not verified under these real-world complex systems for various reasons, considering reliability, feasibility, resilience, and responsibility requirements in real commercial and industrial operations. This study synthesizes adjacent research and introduces Enactive AI as a conceptual framework for enterprise and industry reasoning, site-level decision support, and execution feedback. Four complementary roles organize the framework: an Organizational World defines operations management logic and an organizational behavior world model behind an enterprise from a strategic-institutional horizon; a Site World defines a physically bounded industrial optimization and execution world model from an operational-realization horizon; Schema Intelligence provides the coupling mechanism between two world models to weave various AI applications via two models; and Enactive Decision Cycle triggers the self-evolving dynamic process to update and audit the entire framework. By foregrounding decision intelligence in complex systems, Enactive AI expands the frontier of AI from model capability to system-aware action, opening new possibilities for scalable, governable, and socially valuable AI deployment. Enactive AI points toward a future in which AI progress is measured not only by what models can generate or automate, but by how reliably intelligent systems can support consequential action, responsible governance, and durable social value in the complex systems that shape modern life, which we believe will define the next frontier of AI research for enterprise-level and industrial complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Enactive AI"（行动式AI）作为面向企业和工业复杂系统的概念框架，通过"组织世界模型"、"站点世界模型"、"模式智能"和"行动决策循环"四个互补角色，将AI从模型能力扩展到系统感知行动，实现可扩展、可治理且具有社会价值的AI部署。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI已从大语言模型和内容生成扩展到工具、代理和系统集成，用以解决真实商业和工业问题，但受可靠性、可行性、韧性和责任等要求制约，AI在真实复杂系统中的能力尚未得到充分验证。现有AI研究缺乏一个统一框架来支撑企业层面的推理、站点级决策支持和执行反馈。
AI.method: 通过综合邻近领域研究，提出Enactive AI概念框架，包含四个互补角色：(1) 组织世界（Organizational World）——从战略-制度视角定义运营管理逻辑和组织行为世界模型；(2) 站点世界（Site World）——从运营-实现视角定义物理有界的工业优化与执行世界模型；(3) 模式智能（Schema Intelligence）——作为两个世界模型之间的耦合机制，编织各类AI应用；(4) 行动决策循环（Enactive Decision Cycle）——触发自演化动态过程，更新和审计整个框架。
AI.result: 该研究提供了Enactive AI作为企业和工业复杂系统的概念性理论框架，将AI前沿从模型能力扩展至系统感知行动，为可扩展、可治理且具有社会价值的AI部署开辟了新的可能性，并指出衡量AI进步的标准应不仅限于生成或自动化能力，还应包括智能系统在复杂系统中支持关键行动、负责任治理和持久社会价值的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: Enactive AI指向一个以系统感知行动为核心的AI研究新前沿，强调通过决策智能处理复杂系统，为企业级和工业级复杂系统中的AI部署提供了可治理、可演化、可审计的底层架构思路。作者认为这将成为AI研究的下一个前沿方向。

title: Delay Attacks on the German Smart Metering Infrastructure: A Security Analysis of CLS Channel Timing Constraints
summary:
This work analyzes the feasibility of delay attacks on control signals transmitted via the Controllable Local System (CLS) channel of the German Smart Metering Infrastructure (SMI). It combines theoretical analysis with experimental validation under a threat model aligned to the Common Criteria Protection Profile for the Smart Meter Gateway (SMGW) and assess the potential impact on the power grid if the identified attack vector is exploited across multiple CLS channels simultaneously. We also outline mitigation strategies, including SMGW configuration restrictions, implementation-level changes, and protocol extensions.
  Our results show that an on-path attacker in the Wide Area Network (WAN) with sufficient contextual knowledge can feasibly execute delay attacks, with a theoretical upper bound of roughly 48 hours for some deployed protocol configurations. Projecting from a single CLS to several hundred thousand CLS devices indicates such an adversary could cause a significant frequency deviation potentially resulting in load shedding. Scaling the attack requires contextual knowledge for each targeted implementation and configuration; whether this knowledge can be broadly reused across CLS channels is uncertain but may become easier to obtain as standardization progresses.
  Time restricted transmissions in the FNN Steuerbox and in applications using CLS.EEDI are implementation-specific and can therefore be addressed by manufacturers. By contrast, ensuring application-data time limitations in TLS~1.3 requires protocol-level extensions. The TLS extensions proposed here offer a sustainable mitigation while preserving backward compatibility.
  Other communication channels outside the SMI (for example, proprietary remote terminal units used to control a CLS) are outside this work's scope and may exhibit similar or worse vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了德国智能计量基础设施中可控本地系统（CLS）通道上控制信号的延迟攻击可行性，结合理论分析与实验验证，结果显示在WAN中的路径攻击者可在若干部署配置下实现最长约48小时的延迟攻击，若同时攻击数十万个CLS设备可能导致电网显著频率偏差并触发甩负荷。文章提出包括SMGW配置限制、实现层变更和TLS 1.3协议扩展在内的缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 智能电网的可靠运行依赖于实时控制信号，而德国SMI中的CLS通道是控制信号传输的关键链路。以往研究与部署假设该通道的安全机制足以抵御延迟攻击，但缺乏对延迟攻击可行性的系统性分析。此外，随着SMI标准化推进和CLS设备大规模部署，评估这类攻击对电网稳定性的潜在影响至关重要，以便在设计阶段就嵌入必要的安全防护。
AI.method: 结合理论分析与实验验证：（1）在符合Common Criteria Protection Profile威胁模型下分析CLS通道的安全性；（2）通过实验验证WAN中on-path攻击者执行延迟攻击的可行性；（3）从单个CLS场景外推至数十万CLS设备，评估对电网频率偏差的影响；（4）提出缓解措施，区分可制造商量身定制的实现级方案（如FNN Steuerbox和CLS.EEDI的时间限制传输）与需要协议扩展的方案（如TLS 1.3中的应用数据时间限制）。
AI.result: （1）WAN中具备充分上下文知识的on-path攻击者可可行地执行延迟攻击，某些部署协议配置下理论上限约为48小时；（2）从单个CLS外推至数十万设备，攻击者可导致显著频率偏差，可能触发甩负荷；（3）攻击扩展需要针对每个目标实现和配置的上下文知识，这些知识能否在CLS通道间广泛复用尚不确定，但随标准化推进可能变得更容易获取；（4）FNN Steuerbox和CLS.EEDI的时间限制属性现已具备且可实现级修补，而TLS 1.3中的应用数据时间限制需协议级扩展。
AI.conclusion: 延迟攻击对德国SMI的CLS通道构成切实威胁，且在大规模部署场景下可能危及电网稳定。缓解需分层进行：制造商的实现级修改可解决特定应用，而TLS 1.3协议扩展提供了可持续且向后兼容的通用方案。本文提出的TLS扩展是可行的长期缓解路径。同时应注意，SMI之外的专有远程终端单元控制链路可能存在类似或更严重的漏洞，属于未来工作范畴。

title: Self-Supervised Representation-Guided Generative Dataset Distillation
summary: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while retaining its downstream utility. Most existing methods target randomly initialized networks, whereas modern vision systems often adapt frozen pretrained encoders with lightweight modules. Distilled samples should therefore preserve the discriminative geometry of the pretrained representation space, which existing generative objectives do not explicitly consider. We propose self-supervised representation-guided generative dataset distillation (SRG), a framework that translates the SSL geometry into diffusion guidance.
