Specifically, SRG constructs class-wise prototypes from real-image SSL representations and performs guidance through three SSL-space objectives for prototype alignment, inter-class discrimination, and intra-class assignment. During diffusion sampling, it adopts a stage-wise guidance strategy: early denoising is anchored to the latent of the real image whose SSL representation is nearest to the assigned prototype, whereas later denoising is guided by the SSL-space objectives. This division preserves the visual realism provided by the generative prior while progressively steering samples toward representative and class-discriminative regions of the SSL representation space. SRG consistently outperforms the evaluated generative baselines across multiple datasets and IPC settings. A cross-encoder evaluation further indicates transfer across pretrained representation spaces. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of representation-guided generation for dataset distillation with pretrained SSL models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRG（自监督表征引导的生成式数据集蒸馏）框架，将SSL表征空间的几何结构转化为扩散模型的引导信号，通过三阶段SSL空间目标（原型对齐、类间判别、类内分配）及分阶段引导策略，在扩散采样过程中逐步将生成图像引导至具有代表性和类判别性的表征区域，在多个数据集和IPC设置下优于现有生成式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏方法主要针对随机初始化网络，而现代视觉系统通常适配冻结的预训练编码器。蒸馏样本需要保留预训练表征空间的判别几何结构，但现有生成式目标并未显式考虑这一点。
AI.method: SRG框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 从真实图像的SSL表征构建类别级原型；(2) 通过三个SSL空间目标（原型对齐、类间判别、类内分配）进行引导；(3) 采用分阶段引导策略——早期去噪阶段锚定到SSL表征最接近分配原型的真实图像潜变量，后期去噪阶段由SSL空间目标引导。这种划分在保留生成先验视觉真实感的同时，逐步将样本引导至SSL表征空间中具有代表性和判别性的区域。
AI.result: SRG在多个数据集和IPC设置下一致优于所评估的生成式基线；跨编码器评估进一步表明其具有跨预训练表征空间的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 表征引导的生成方法对于预训练SSL模型上的数据集蒸馏是有效的，证明了利用SSL表征空间几何结构指导生成过程的价值。

title: Beyond Initialization Loss: A Systematic Study of Token Embedding Initialization Strategies for LLM Vocabulary Extension
summary: Vocabulary extension is an efficient way to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to new languages, but the initialization of newly added token embeddings can strongly affect continued pre-training (CPT) efficiency. We present a systematic study of more than 20 initialization strategies for Hindi vocabulary extension in Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Our comparison spans vocabulary-averaging baselines; external and learned initialization methods, including FOCUS, top-k semantic retrieval, and residual MLP mappings; subword composition; norm calibration; and input-output asymmetry. We find that subword composition methods outperform both vocabulary averaging and external/learned initialization approaches. Within subword composition, asymmetric variants achieve the lowest observed early validation loss and reveal distinct preferences for input and output embedding initialization. The best observed configuration initializes the input embedding matrix with uniform subword averaging and Hindi-specific norm calibration, and the output language modeling head with character-length-weighted subword averaging. Relative to the standard Mean-all baseline, this full initialization pipeline reaches comparable validation loss with over a 6x reduction in CPT steps and exceeds the baseline's 3,500-step MILU-Hindi accuracy after only 500 steps. Finally, we show that initialization loss and initialization bits-per-byte (Init BPB) are unreliable predictors of downstream convergence, whereas lightweight CPT, as few as 50 steps, provides a cost-effective and reliable signal for selecting the best initialization strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了超过20种词汇扩展初始化策略对印地语词汇扩展后继续预训练（CPT）效率的影响。研究发现子词组合方法优于词表平均和外部/学习式初始化方法，其中非对称变体效果最佳。最佳配置采用均匀子词平均+印地语特定范数校准初始化输入嵌入，字符长度加权子词平均初始化输出语言模型头，相比标准基线减少了6倍以上的CPT步数。此外，初始化损失和初始化BPB不能可靠预测下游收敛，而轻量级CPT（仅50步）是选择最佳初始化策略的高性价比可靠信号。
AI.motivation: 词汇扩展是将预训练大语言模型（LLMs）适配到新语言的有效方式，但新添加词元嵌入的初始化策略对继续预训练（CPT）效率有显著影响。现有研究缺乏对不同初始化策略的系统性对比，因此需要全面研究以找到最优初始化方法。
AI.method: 在Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B模型上进行印地语词汇扩展，系统比较了超过20种初始化策略，涵盖词表平均基线、外部/学习式初始化方法（如FOCUS、top-k语义检索、残差MLP映射）、子词组合、范数校准以及输入-输出非对称性等多个维度。
AI.result: 子词组合方法优于词表平均和外部/学习式初始化方法；非对称变体达到最低早期验证损失，输入和输出嵌入有不同偏好。最佳配置为统一子词平均+印地语特定范数校准（输入）和字符长度加权子词平均（输出），相比Mean-all基线实现了6倍以上的CPT步数减少，500步即超过基线3500步的MILU-Hindi准确率。轻量级CPT（50步）是选择最优初始化策略的可靠信号。
AI.conclusion: 词汇扩展的初始化策略对CPT效率有重大影响，子词组合方法特别是非对称变体是最有效的初始化策略。同时，传统的静态评估指标无法可靠预测下游性能，应使用轻量级CPT作为选择初始化策略的信号。

title: Simulation-free and finite-time diffusion model
summary: The performance of generative diffusion models is determined by the choice of the reference diffusion process connecting the empirical and prior distributions. Conventional approaches typically trade off simulation-free training against finite-time generation. We propose a framework for designing the reference process that achieves both simultaneously. The key idea is to prescribe tractable time-dependent conditional distributions and then construct the reference process realizing them as its marginals. This framework reveals that score matching is not fundamental to diffusion-model training but instead emerges naturally through reversal of the reference process. We further show that conditional flow matching arises as the small-noise limit of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一框架来设计扩散模型的参考过程，通过预先指定时间相关的条件分布并构造相应的参考过程，同时实现免模拟训练和有限时间生成。该框架揭示了分数匹配并非扩散模型训练的本质，而是参考过程反转的自然结果，并证明条件流匹配是该框架的小噪声极限。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散模型的性能取决于连接经验分布与先验分布的参考扩散过程，而现有方法通常需要在模拟免训练与有限时间生成之间进行权衡。作者希望设计一种参考过程，能够同时实现两者。
AI.method: 核心思想是首先规定易于处理的时间相关条件分布，然后构造以这些分布为边缘分布的参考过程。通过反转该参考过程，自然地得到扩散模型的训练目标（分数匹配）。
AI.result: 证明分数匹配不是扩散模型训练的必要条件，而是从参考过程反转中自然涌现的；同时表明条件流匹配是该框架在小噪声极限下的特例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为设计参考过程提供了更灵活的途径，能够兼顾模拟免训练与有限时间生成的优点，并统一了扩散模型与流匹配之间的联系。

title: AI World Cup 2026: Benchmarking Large Language Models for End-to-End Football Tournament Prediction
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project repository available in the paper
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now regularly asked to forecast real-world events, but comparisons are often difficult because models receive different information, use different tools, and are evaluated under different rules. This paper reports the completed \emph{AI World Cup} benchmark, in which ten LLM-based assistants made a single pre-tournament forecast of the entire 2026 FIFA World Cup. Every submission used the same tournament snapshot, prompt, JSON schema, and scoring procedure. The forecasts covered group-stage scores, group rankings, the knockout bracket, final placings, confidence values, and short explanations. After all 104 matches had been played, GPT-5.5 Thinking finished first with 744 points, followed by GPT-5.5 with 717, Gemini with 699, and Qwen 3.7 with 687. GPT-5.5 Thinking was also the only model to select Spain, which defeated Argentina 1--0 in the final, as champion. The final ranking was driven mainly by knockout performance: total score was strongly correlated with knockout points ($r=0.986$), but showed little relationship with group-stage match points ($r=0.055$), group-standing points ($r=-0.103$), or their combined pre-knockout score ($r=-0.054$). Match-level accuracy produced a different ordering. Claude Sonnet 4.6 correctly predicted the largest number of group-stage outcomes (63.89\%) but placed sixth overall. Average self-reported confidence was also unrelated to either outcome accuracy ($r=-0.060$) or total score ($r=-0.067$). The results suggest that forecasting a complete tournament tests something different from predicting matches one at a time, while also showing how strongly a bracket-based leaderboard can depend on scoring design. The benchmark materials, raw responses, and scoring code are released to support replication and future extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了"AI世界杯"基准测试：十个基于LLM的助手对2026年FIFA世界杯全部赛程进行赛前预测，在统一的输入、提示、数据格式和评分规则下对比。GPT-5.5 Thinking以744分夺冠，且是唯一正确预测西班牙夺冠的模型。结果显示总排名主要由淘汰赛表现驱动（r=0.986），而非小组赛预测准确率，且模型自报置信度与最终成绩无关。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越常被用于预测真实世界事件，但由于不同模型获得的信息、使用的工具和评估规则各不相同，模型之间的对比往往缺乏公平性和可重复性。
AI.method: 设计并完成了AI World Cup基准测试：十个LLM-based助手使用相同的比赛快照、提示词、JSON格式和评分程序，独立对2026年FIFA世界杯进行完整的赛前预测，覆盖小组赛比分、小组排名、淘汰赛对阵、最终名次、置信度和简短解释，并对104场比赛实际结果进行统一评分。
AI.result: GPT-5.5 Thinking以744分夺冠，其后依次是GPT-5.5（717）、Gemini（699）、Qwen 3.7（687）。总排名与淘汰赛得分高度相关（r=0.986），与小组赛得分（r=0.055）、小组排名得分（r=-0.103）几乎无关。若按逐场预测准确率排序，Claude Sonnet 4.6的小组赛预测准确率最高（63.89%），但总分仅排第六。模型自报置信度与准确率（r=-0.060）和总分（r=-0.067）均无关。
AI.conclusion: 完整锦标赛预测测试的是不同于逐场预测的能力；基于淘汰赛对阵的排行榜对评分设计非常敏感。研究公开了全部基准材料、原始响应和评分代码，以支持复现和后续扩展。

title: Noise-Aware Shrinkage for Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Differentially private zeroth-order optimization (DP-ZO) enables memory-efficient private fine-tuning of large language models using only forward evaluations. Existing aggregation-based DP-ZO methods reconstruct model updates at a fixed scale, ignoring that the strength of useful signals varies throughout training. Consequently, noise-dominated updates may receive excessive weight and degrade model utility. To address this issue, we propose SAGE, a noise-aware shrinkage method that adaptively attenuates privatized estimates according to their estimated signal quality. SAGE subtracts the known Gaussian noise variance from the observed second moment to estimate the underlying signal energy, stabilizes this estimate through temporal tracking, and compares its current signal-to-noise level with a warm-up reference to derive a bounded shrinkage factor. As pure post-processing, SAGE requires neither additional privacy budget nor model queries and introduces only constant additional state. Our theoretical analysis shows that shrinkage reduces the quadratic update-risk term faster than the linear descent term, preserving useful descent while limiting the influence of noise-dominated updates. Experiments on RoBERTa-large, OPT-1.3B, and OPT-6.7B demonstrate that SAGE outperforms existing baselines in most settings under the same privacy budgets while preserving the forward-only memory efficiency of DP-ZO.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一种噪声感知的自适应收缩方法，用于差分隐私零阶优化（DP-ZO），通过估计信号质量并自适应衰减私有化估计来提升大语言模型微调的效用，且不增加额外隐私预算。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于聚合的DP-ZO方法以固定尺度重建模型更新，忽略了训练过程中有用信号强度会变化的问题。这导致噪声主导的更新可能被赋予过大权重，从而降低模型效用。
AI.method: SAGE通过从观测到的二阶矩中减去已知高斯噪声方差来估计信号能量，通过时间追踪稳定估计，并将其当前信噪比与预热参考比较以推导有界收缩因子。作为纯后处理步骤，不需要额外隐私预算或模型查询，仅引入常数级额外状态。
AI.result: 理论分析表明收缩使二次更新风险项比线性下降项下降更快，在保留有用下降的同时限制噪声主导更新的影响。在RoBERTa-large、OPT-1.3B和OPT-6.7B上的实验表明，在相同隐私预算下SAGE在大多数设置中优于现有基线，同时保持DP-ZO的前向-only内存效率。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过自适应噪声感知收缩有效解决了DP-ZO中固定尺度重建忽略信号强度变化的问题，在相同隐私预算下提升了模型效用，且不牺牲内存效率或增加额外隐私成本。

title: Open-Linguistic Concept Unified Learning for Cross-Site Interpretable Dermatology Image Diagnosis
summary: Human-interpretable computer-aided diagnosis is crucial for clinical decision making. Concept-based models excel by providing transparent reasoning and enabling post-hoc, clinician-in-the-loop interventions. However, their rigid dataset-specific adaptation inherently restricts cross-site generalization. Applying them across diverse modalities, such as dermoscopic and clinical photographs, is challenging due to heterogeneous concept taxonomies varying in availability, granularity, and semantics across cohorts. Consequently, adapting Foundation Vision-Language Models (FVLMs) demands costly label engineering and repeated post-training. Existing intervention mechanisms remain rigidly tied to predefined concepts, lacking adaptability and hindering scalable dermatology CAD deployment. To address these bottlenecks, we propose UniCon, an open-linguistic unified concept learning framework for multimodal interpretable vision-language diagnosis. UniCon resolves these challenges through three contributions: (1) A shared semantic representation space via a unified concept prototype codebook, seamlessly coordinating heterogeneous concept systems across modalities without dataset-specific retraining. (2) Open-linguistic based multi-faceted semantic specifications to overcome sparse textual label limitations, improving boundary sensitivity in uncertain clinical contexts. (3) A robust, cross-site adjustable intervention interface powered by reliability-gated bottleneck aggregation, enabling consistent reasoning and transferable clinician corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that beyond securing top-tier diagnostic accuracy, UniCon successfully bridges disparate clinical taxonomies, unlocking unprecedented cross-site intervention capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/wuchengyu123/UniCon.

AI.tldr: UniCon是一个开放语言统一概念学习框架，用于多模态可解释的计算机辅助皮肤病诊断，通过统一概念原型码本共享语义空间、开放语言多面语义规范和可靠性门控瓶颈聚合的可调干预接口，实现跨站点、跨模态的概念系统泛化与临床干预能力。
AI.motivation: 基于概念的模型在可解释诊断中表现出色，但其数据集特定的刚性适应限制了跨站点泛化；面对皮肤镜与临床照片等多样模态时，概念分类体系在可用性、粒度和语义上存在异质性，导致基础视觉语言模型的适配需要昂贵的标签工程和重复后训练，现有干预机制僵化绑定预定义概念，缺乏适应性，阻碍了可扩展的皮肤科计算机辅助诊断部署。
AI.method: UniCon通过三个核心贡献解决上述问题：(1) 构建统一概念原型码本作为共享语义表示空间，无缝协调跨模态的异构概念系统，无需数据集特定的重新训练；(2) 采用开放语言的多面语义规范来克服稀疏文本标签限制，提升不确定临床情境下的边界敏感度；(3) 设计基于可靠性门控瓶颈聚合的鲁棒跨站点可调干预接口，实现一致的推理和可迁移的临床医生修正。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，UniCon不仅达到顶尖的诊断准确率，还成功弥合了不同的临床分类法，解锁了前所未有的跨站点干预能力。
AI.conclusion: UniCon实现了开放语言统一概念学习框架，有效解决了多模态可解释诊断中概念系统异质性和干预机制僵化的问题，验证了跨站点临床干预的可行性与有效性，代码已开源。

title: ConlangBench: Exploring Language Knowledge and Learning in LLMs through Diverse Constructed Languages
summary: Constructed languages (conlangs) are intentionally created human languages with a rich tradition of linguistic creativity. Despite their potential for studying language learning in large language models (LLMs), existing conlangs remain largely underexplored in LLM research. We present ConlangBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating and training LLMs on 21 existing conlangs. We collect over 21M conlang-English parallel sentence pairs (including 430K pairs across the 20 non-Esperanto conlangs) and 321K vocabulary entries. In bidirectional translation experiments, we find that models perform better on a posteriori conlangs, whose vocabularies are derived from natural languages, reflecting the design characteristics of conlangs. Training on ConlangBench also shows that models can learn all eight conlangs for which sufficient parallel corpora are available, while their learning curves vary depending on how the conlangs were created. Our findings suggest that conlangs provide a unique testbed for investigating how LLMs acquire low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 提出了ConlangBench，首个大规模构造语言评测基准，涵盖21种构造语言、2100万条平行句对和32.1万词汇条目，用于评测和训练大语言模型的低资源语言学习能力。
AI.motivation: 构造语言（conlangs）是人为创造的语言，具有丰富的语言学创造性，为研究大语言模型的语言学习提供了独特的研究场所，但现有的构造语言在大语言模型研究中尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建了覆盖21种现有构造语言的大规模基准ConlangBench，收集了超过2100万条构造语言-英语平行句对（其中2000万条为Esperanto，43万条为其余20种）及32.1万条词汇条目，并在双向翻译任务上对模型进行评测与训练。
AI.result: 双向翻译实验中，模型在先验型（a posteriori）构造语言上表现更好，这类语言的词汇来源于自然语言。训练实验表明，模型能够学习所有具有足够平行语料的8种构造语言，且学习曲线因构造语言的创建方式不同而有所差异。
AI.conclusion: 构造语言为研究大语言模型如何习得低资源语言提供了独特的测试平台，其设计特征与模型学习表现之间存在密切关联。

title: Trajectory-Guided Forget-Recover Network for Continual LLM Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning aims to eliminate the influence of sensitive data on a model. In the real world, unlearning requests arrive continually, which gives rise to two challenges. First, an unlearning intervention may redistribute target-related computation across remaining pathways, allowing previously forgotten knowledge to re-emerge. Second, repeated unlearning interventions may progressively reduce the model capacity needed to preserve retained utility. To address these challenges, we propose the Trajectory-guided Forget-Recover Network (TFR-Net). TFR-Net tracks channel-level risk across requests. It separates persistent target-related channels from transient hotspots and suppresses only the persistent ones. TFR-Net also recovers model capacity by reactivating dormant channels. These channels make strong contributions to retained utility and show low current and historical forget risk. The recovery is accepted only when retained-utility degradation remains within a predefined tolerance. Experiments on four datasets show that TFR-Net consistently achieves a more favorable trade-off between unlearning effectiveness and retained utility than representative baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹引导的遗忘-恢复网络（TFR-Net），用于解决连续机器遗忘学习中的两个关键挑战：遗忘干预导致的旧知识重现问题，以及连续遗忘导致的模型容量下降问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的遗忘请求是持续到达的，这带来两个挑战：（1）遗忘干预可能将目标相关计算重分配到剩余通道，使已遗忘知识重新出现；（2）重复遗忘操作会逐步消耗保留有用功能所需的模型容量。
AI.method: TFR-Net在请求间跟踪通道级风险，区分持久目标相关通道与瞬时热点通道，仅抑制持久通道。同时通过重新激活休眠通道来恢复模型容量（这些通道对保留效用贡献大且遗忘风险低），并且仅在保留效用退化在预定容忍范围内时接受恢复。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，TFR-Net在遗忘效果与保留效用之间实现了比代表性基线更优的权衡。
AI.conclusion: TFR-Net通过精细的通道级风险跟踪和有条件的容量恢复机制，有效解决了连续遗忘场景中知识重现和容量衰减两个核心问题。

title: Towards Improving Sequential Decision-Making in LLM Agents via Experience Memory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables, 5 appendices, accepted at Neuro-Symbolic Intelligence for LLMs and Autonomous Agents workshop at IJCAI 2026
summary: Large language models have improved substantially on single-shot reasoning tasks, but their performance in sequential decision-making is less well understood. We study this on fully-observable two-player zero-sum games, which provide ground-truth evaluation: outcomes are determined by the rules, and optimality of individual moves can be computed or approximated, without relying on a judge model. Across model tiers, LLMs play suboptimally in simple games such as tic-tac-toe or Connect Four, and lose to MCTS opponents. Obfuscations that preserve the game tree but rewrite its surface form leave performance largely unchanged, indicating the gap is not fully explained by recall of memorized strategies. Motivated by this performance gap, we introduce an agentic framework enhanced with an experience memory designed for the sequential setting and addressing common challenges of sequential decision-making such as credit assignment. We show that post-game reflection and rule extraction yield measurable improvements on tic-tac-toe without modifying the model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在完全可观测双人零和博弈中的顺序决策能力，发现LLM在简单游戏（井字棋、四子棋）中表现次优且输给MCTS对手；通过保持游戏树但重写表面形式的混淆实验表明性能差距并非源于记忆策略回忆。为此提出一个带经验记忆的智能体框架，通过赛后反思和规则提取在不修改模型权重的情况下提升井字棋性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在单次推理任务上表现优异，但其顺序决策能力尚未被充分理解。本文选择完全可观测的双人零和博弈作为测试平台，因为其结果由规则决定，单个走子的最优性可计算或近似，无需依赖裁判模型，从而能对LLM的决策能力进行客观严格评估。
AI.method: 1) 在井字棋和四子棋等简单博弈中系统性评估不同层级LLM的决策表现，与MCTS对手对比；2) 设计混淆实验：保持游戏树结构不变但重写博弈的表面形式（如符号、术语），以检验性能差距是否由记忆策略回忆导致；3) 提出一个智能体框架，引入适合顺序决策场景的经验记忆机制，解决信用分配等顺序决策常见挑战；4) 通过赛后反思和规则提取实现性能提升，且不修改模型权重。
AI.result: 不同层级的LLM在井字棋和四子棋等简单博弈中均表现出次优决策，输给MCTS对手；混淆实验显示性能差距基本不变，说明差距并非主要由记忆策略回忆造成；提出的带经验记忆的智能体框架结合赛后反思和规则提取，在井字棋上取得了可测量的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM的顺序决策能力与其单次推理能力存在显著差距，且该差距不能归因于简单的记忆策略回忆。通过引入智能体框架中的经验记忆、赛后反思和规则提取等机制，可以在不修改模型权重的情况下有效缩小这一差距，为提升LLM在顺序决策任务中的表现提供了可行路径。

title: Provably Learning Multi-Head Attention with Queries
summary: We study the problem of learning multi-head softmax attention from black-box input-output access. The learner may query arbitrary real-valued token sequences and observe only the scalar output at the final token. Recent work gives an algorithm using $O(d^2)$ value queries to recover the single-head parameters $(W,v)$. For multiple heads, the same work establishes identifiability under the assumption that the heads occupy pairwise orthogonal subspaces. Applying the single-head recovery algorithm separately to the heads additionally requires bases for these subspaces to be known. We recover a canonical representation by merging heads with the same $W_h$, summing their corresponding $v_h$, and discarding a merged head when this sum is zero, without these subspace assumptions. By varying the number of copies of a token, our algorithm obtains samples of a rational function whose interpolation separates the canonical heads. Additional queries formed by adding selected token vectors then match the same head across different queries. When the oracle outputs and all subsequent computations are exact, the learner chooses its query vectors at random and recovers the canonical pairs $\{(W_h,v_h):h\in[H]\}$ up to permutation with probability one. When $H$ is known, it uses exactly $4Hd^2-2H+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H+1$. If only a known upper bound $H_0$ is available, the algorithm uses $4H_0d^2-2H_0+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H_0+1$. For approximate oracle outputs, we give conditions under which the parameter error is at most a model- and query-dependent constant multiple of the output error. Finally, we extend our result to a one-layer Transformer with multi-head attention followed by a bias-free ReLU feed-forward network. Under additional conditions, we recover a functionally equivalent Transformer without relying on a separate algorithm for learning the feed-forward network.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从黑盒输入输出访问中学习多头softmax注意力的问题。作者提出了一种算法，通过改变token的副本数量并利用有理函数插值来分离头部，从而恢复多头注意力的规范表示 {(W_h, v_h)}，无需正交子空间假设，在精确计算下以概率1将参数恢复至置换等价，并扩展到带ReLU前馈网络的一层Transformer。
AI.motivation: 现有工作对单头注意力给出O(d^2)次值查询的恢复算法，但对多头注意力仅在对头部占据两两正交子空间且已知这些子空间基的假设下可行。实际中这些假设往往过于严格，需要一种不依赖正交性假设的多头注意力学习算法。
AI.method: 算法通过改变同一token的副本数量，获得一个有理函数的样本；利用有理函数插值将规范头部分离。再通过添加选定token向量构造额外的查询，将同一头部在不同查询间匹配。当H已知时，使用恰好4Hd^2-2H+1次值查询，最大序列长度为2H+1；若仅已知上界H0，则使用4H0d^2-2H0+1次查询。算法还考虑了近似输出下的误差传播条件，并扩展到带无偏ReLU前馈网络的一层Transformer。
AI.result: 在精确计算条件下，算法以概率1恢复规范对{(W_h, v_h)}（置换等价）。在有噪声的情况下，给出了参数误差至多为输出误差的模型和查询依赖常数倍的充分条件。对带ReLU前馈网络的一层Transformer，在附加条件下无需单独学习前馈网络即可恢复功能等价的Transformer。
AI.conclusion: 该工作大幅放宽了多头注意力可学习性的假设条件，通过合并具有相同W_h的头部并丢弃零和头部的规范表示方法，实现了无需正交子空间假设的多头参数恢复，并展示了向更复杂Transformer架构的推广可行性。

title: CIGTSurv: Clinical Information Guided Tri-modal Survival Prediction with Local Prototype Association and Global Feature Alignment
summary: Multimodal learning has significantly advanced survival prediction by integrating pathology images with genomic data. However, clinical information, despite its critical role in reflecting a patient' s overall health, remains underutilized due to its discrete, sparse, and low-dimensional nature. Furthermore, the inherent heterogeneity across these modalities pose significant challenges in modeling cross-modal interactions. In this paper, we propose CIGTSurv, a Clinical Information Guided Tri-modal framework for Survival prediction. Specifically, we first design a holistic text template and use pretrained foundation models to transform clinical tabular data into high-dimensional tokenized embeddings. Using clinical information as an anchor, we then introduce a dual-level interaction mechanism: 1) a local prototype association (LPA) module based on cross-attention to explicitly learn token-level correspondences between different modalities, and 2) a global feature alignment (GFA) loss based on Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to implicitly enhance cross-modal distribution consistency. Extensive experiments on five TCGA cancer cohorts demonstrate that CIGTSurv achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) survival prediction performance. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Daijing-ai/CIGT-Surv.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIGTSurv，一个以临床信息引导的三模态生存预测框架，通过将临床表格数据转化为高维token化嵌入，并引入局部原型关联（LPA）与全局特征对齐（GFA）的双层交互机制，在五个TCGA癌症队列上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习虽然已通过整合病理图像与基因组数据显著提升生存预测性能，但临床信息因其离散、稀疏和低维特性而被低估利用；同时，多模态间的异质性给跨模态交互建模带来重大挑战。
AI.method: 1) 设计整体文本模板，利用预训练基础模型将临床表格数据转换为高维token化嵌入；2) 以临床信息为锚点，引入双层交互机制：基于交叉注意力的局部原型关联（LPA）模块用于学习跨模态token级对应关系，以及基于最大均值差异（MMD）的全局特征对齐（GFA）损失用于隐式增强跨模态分布一致性。
AI.result: 在五个TCGA癌症队列上的大量实验表明，CIGTSurv达到了最先进的生存预测性能。
AI.conclusion: CIGTSurv有效利用临床信息作为锚点引导三模态（病理图像、基因组数据、临床信息）交互，解决了临床数据低维稀疏及跨模态异质性问题，显著提升了生存预测性能，代码已开源。

title: SLAMFormer-$\infty$: Infinite SLAM Transformer for Unbounded Frontend and Backend Processing
summary: We introduce the Infinite SLAM Transformer (SLAMFormer-$\infty$), the first geometric transformer capable of supporting both long-range frontend and backend processing without an explicit distance bound. Instead of relying on a first-frame-anchored formulation, SLAMFormer-$\infty$ employs memory conditions to define flexible coordinate systems and scales for input frames, enabling more expressive structural conditioning. Built upon this formulation, the frontend preserves efficient local computation, while the backend jointly optimizes long-range trajectories and scene geometry in a globally consistent manner. Experimental results demonstrate that SLAMFormer-$\infty$ achieves superior or highly competitive performance in both trajectory estimation and scene reconstruction across large-scale datasets. Notably, SLAMFormer-$\infty$ generalizes to extremely long trajectories, successfully operating on sequences exceeding $17\mathrm{km}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无限SLAM Transformer（SLAMFormer-∞），这是首个能够支持无显式距离边界的长距离前端和后端处理的几何Transformer。通过使用记忆条件定义灵活的坐标系和尺度，取代首帧锚定公式，该模型在前端保持高效局部计算的同时，后端能够以全局一致的方式联合优化长距离轨迹和场景几何。实验表明其在大型数据集上达到优越或极具竞争力的轨迹估计和场景重建性能，并能推广到超过17公里的极长轨迹序列。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的SLAM方法通常依赖首帧锚定公式，受限于显式距离边界，无法有效支持极长距离的SLAM任务。作者旨在提出一种无距离界限的几何Transformer架构，以同时支持长距离前端和后端处理。
AI.method: SLAMFormer-∞采用记忆条件（memory conditions）替代首帧锚定公式，为输入帧定义灵活的坐标系和尺度，从而实现更具表达力的结构条件化。在前端设计中保留高效的局部计算，在后端中通过全局一致的方式联合优化长距离轨迹和场景几何。
AI.result: 在大型数据集上，SLAMFormer-∞在轨迹估计和场景重建任务中均取得优越或极具竞争力的性能。特别地，该模型展现出对极长轨迹的泛化能力，成功处理超过17公里的序列。
AI.conclusion: SLAMFormer-∞通过创新的记忆条件公式消除了传统Transformer SLAM方法的距离界限限制，证明了其在超长距离场景中同时实现高效轨迹估计和全局一致场景重建的可行性，为大规模SLAM提供了新的架构范式。

title: ChronoLens: Measuring Language Change Across Time, Languages, and Linguistic Levels
summary: Historical language change affects morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, yet computational studies typically examine these levels with incompatible representations and therefore cannot determine whether they evolve together across languages. We address this problem by asking how the magnitude and direction of change vary across linguistic levels, languages, and historical periods within a single analytical space. We introduce ChronoLens, a framework that combines frozen multilingual language models, feature-aligned crosscoders, and post-hoc linguistic interventions, and apply it to 44.98 million documents and approximately 17.2 billion tokens from five parliamentary traditions spanning 1803--2026. The resulting sparse representations agree substantially more strongly with linguistic statistics than dense embeddings or a pooled sparse autoencoder ($ρ=0.72$ versus $0.29$ and $0.28$), and reveal that morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics generally change by comparable amounts within a language, while languages differ markedly in when, how far, and in which direction they change. These findings show that historical language change is a structured, multidimensional process: similar magnitudes can conceal different trajectories, and meaningful cross-linguistic comparison requires measuring both distance and direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoLens框架，在统一分析空间中联合测量多个语言层（形态、句法、语义、语用）的历时变化方向与幅度，基于44.98百万文档、17.2亿token的五种议会语料（1803–2026）发现：语言层内变化幅度相近，但不同语言的变化时间、距离和方向差异显著。
AI.motivation: 历史语言变化涉及形态、句法、语义和语用等多个层面，但现有计算研究通常使用不兼容的表示方法分别处理各层面，无法判断这些层面在不同语言中是否共同演化。需要一个统一的分析空间来比较跨语言、跨层面的变化的幅度和方向。
AI.method: 提出ChronoLens框架，结合三部分：(1) 冻结的多语言语言模型；(2) 特征对齐的crosscoders（跨编码器）生成稀疏表示；(3) 事后语言学干预（post-hoc linguistic interventions）。应用于五种议会传统、44.98百万文档约17.2亿token，时间跨度1803至2026年。
AI.result: 稀疏表示与语言学统计的一致性显著优于稠密嵌入和池化稀疏自编码器（ρ=0.72 vs 0.29和0.28）。发现同一语言内形态、句法、语义和语用的变化幅度大致相当，但不同语言在变化发生的时间、幅度和方向上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 历史语言变化是结构化的多维过程：相似的变化幅度可能掩盖不同的变化轨迹，有意义的跨语言比较需要同时测量距离和方向。

title: Lightweight Chunk Selection for Mobile Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: RAG improves the factual grounding of LLM by incorporating external knowledge, but deploying RAG on mobile and edge devices remains challenging because retrieved context increases computation and memory. A direct way to reduce this cost is to retain only one retrieved chunk before generation, but the top-ranked retrieved chunk is not always the most evidence-supporting one, since retrieval similarity does not necessarily imply evidential sufficiency. Existing context-reduction methods can improve context quality, but often require additional LLMs or compressors that are costly under a strict mobile budget. In this paper, we study lightweight RAG chunk selection as an evidence-alignment problem. Our selector combines three complementary feature sources: question hidden states that represent LLM-side query intent, MoE routing-derived expert signals that capture the generator's internal routing structure, and retrieved chunk embeddings that preserve candidate-side evidence geometry. A compact multilayer perceptron maps these features to an evidence prototype in the chunk embedding space, and the candidate most aligned with this prototype is selected by cosine similarity. For stricter deployment budgets, we further introduce an optional task-aware feature selection strategy to reduce the selector input dimension. To support supervised evaluation, we construct semantic chunk-correctness labels based on evidence sufficiency rather than answer-string containment. Experiments show that the proposed selector consistently improves rank-1 evidence selection over mobile-applicable baselines by an average of 2.5%. These results suggest that using LLM-side query representations and MoE routing information and aligning them with retrieval-side candidate embedding is an effective and parameter-efficient strategy for mobile-applicable RAG chunk selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的RAG块选择方法，将其建模为证据对齐问题。选择器融合了三个互补特征源（问题隐状态、MoE路由专家信号、检索块嵌入），通过一个紧凑的多层感知机映射到证据原型并用余弦相似度选择最对齐的候选块。在移动端约束下比基线平均提升2.5%的rank-1证据选择准确率。
AI.motivation: RAG通过引入外部知识改善LLM的事实基础性，但在移动端和边缘设备部署困难，因为检索上下文增加了计算和内存开销。直接只保留一个检索块虽然能降低成本，但排名最高的检索块不一定是最具证据支持的，因为检索相似性不等于证据充分性。现有上下文缩减方法虽然能提高上下文质量，但往往需要额外的LLM或压缩器，在严格的移动端预算下代价昂贵。
AI.method: 将轻量级RAG块选择建模为证据对齐问题。选择器结合三种互补特征源：(1) 问题隐状态，代表LLM侧的查询意图；(2) MoE路由衍生的专家信号，捕获生成器内部路由结构；(3) 检索块嵌入，保留候选侧的证据几何结构。一个紧凑的MLP将这些特征映射到块嵌入空间中的证据原型，通过余弦相似度选择与原型最对齐的候选。为适应更严格部署预算，还引入可选的task-aware特征选择策略来减小选择器输入维度。此外，构建基于证据充分性而非答案字符串包含的语义块正确性标签以支持监督评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，提出的选择器在移动端可应用的基线上，rank-1证据选择准确率平均提升2.5%。
AI.conclusion: 使用LLM侧的查询表示和MoE路由信息，并将其与检索侧候选嵌入对齐，是一种参数高效且有效的移动端适用RAG块选择策略。

title: State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking
summary:
Transformer-based architectures have dominated sequence modeling, largely due to the expressive power of attention mechanisms. However, for a class of deterministic state tracking tasks---such as parity checking, modular counting, and parenthesis matching---attention may be overkill. In this paper, we show that \textbf{state propagation alone is sufficient}.
  We propose the \textbf{Complex State Propagator (CSP)}, a minimalistic recurrent architecture that \textbf{only propagates hidden states} across layers without output projections at intermediate steps. The state is represented as a complex-valued vector, updated via input-dependent rotations in the complex domain. To enable deep propagation without gradient vanishing or degradation, we introduce a \textbf{block-level skip connection} alongside element-wise complex normalization and SiLU activation at sequence boundaries. Applied with Focal Loss, CSP achieves \textbf{100\% accuracy} with perfect F1 scores across canonical tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Complex State Propagator (CSP)，一种极简递归架构，仅通过复数域中依赖输入的旋转来传播隐藏状态，无需中间输出投影，即可在确定性状态追踪任务（如奇偶校验、模数计数、括号匹配）上达到100%准确率和完美F1分数。
AI.motivation: Transformer虽在序列建模中占据主导地位，但其注意力机制对于一类确定性的状态追踪任务（如奇偶校验、模数计数、括号匹配）而言是过度设计的。这些任务本质上仅需状态的传播与更新，无需复杂的全局注意力交互。
AI.method: CSP采用仅传播隐藏状态的极简递归架构：状态以复数值向量表示，通过输入依赖的复数旋转进行更新；引入块级跳跃连接防止梯度消失或退化，并在序列边界处使用逐元素复数归一化和SiLU激活函数；配合Focal Loss进行训练。
AI.result: 在经典确定性状态追踪任务上，CSP达到了100%准确率和完美的F1分数，验证了仅靠状态传播即可完成此类任务。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，对于确定性状态追踪任务，状态传播本身已足够，无需复杂的注意力机制，为此类任务提供了极简且高效的解决范式。

title: Progressive Learning of a Diffusion-based Inpainting Model for Separating Overlapped Fingerprints
summary: Overlapped friction ridge patterns are a recurring problem in latent fingerprints recovered from crime scenes and in live-scan scenarios where residual fingerprints on the sensor may corrupt subsequent acquisitions. Existing approaches for separating overlapped fingerprints either rely on rule-based orientation field completion that requires strong domain knowledge or train end-to-end deep neural networks that do not account for domain-specific considerations. This work introduces a diffusion-based pipeline for separating component fingerprints from an image containing overlapping friction ridge patterns. We formulate the separation problem as an inpainting task and progressively learn a diffusion model for this task in multiple stages. Starting from a pre-trained Stable Diffusion model, we progressively incorporate a fingerprint prior, add the ability to complete partial fingerprints, and finally propose \textbf{overlap-aware inpainting} that reconstructs each component print using a diffusion inpainting model based on multi-channel conditioning. Experiments on two public datasets demonstrate that component fingerprints reconstructed using the proposed diffusion-based inpainting method can match with their mated counterparts with very high probability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的指纹重叠分离管道，将重叠指纹分离问题建模为图像修复（inpainting）任务，通过多阶段渐进式训练（从预训练的Stable Diffusion出发，逐步引入指纹先验、部分指纹补全能力，最终提出基于多通道条件的重叠感知修复），在两个公开数据集上实现了重建指纹与配对指纹的高概率匹配。
AI.motivation: 重叠摩擦脊模式是犯罪现场潜在指纹提取和活体扫描场景中反复出现的问题，现有方法要么依赖需要强领域知识的基于规则的取向场补全，要么训练不考虑领域特定考量的端到端深度神经网络，二者均存在局限。
AI.method: 提出一种基于扩散的分阶段分离管道：将分离问题形式化为图像修复任务，从预训练的Stable Diffusion模型出发，经多阶段渐进式学习，依次引入指纹先验、添加部分指纹补全能力，最终提出基于多通道条件的重叠感知修复（overlap-aware inpainting），利用扩散修复模型重建每个组成指纹。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上的实验表明，使用所提出的基于扩散的修复方法重建的组成指纹能够以非常高的概率与其配对的真实指纹成功匹配。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型结合领域先验和重叠感知修复策略可有效解决重叠指纹分离问题，重建结果在指纹匹配任务中表现优异，为该领域提供了一种无需强领域规则约束的新范式。

title: Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection for Multi-Focus Image Fusion
summary: Multi-focus image fusion (MFIF) aims to generate an all-in-focus image from multiple images of the same scene focused at different regions. Most existing deep learning-based methods lack explicit interaction between the source images, which limits their performance and interpretability. This paper presents a novel Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection Network (CSNet), to bridge direct information exchange for MFIF. Specifically, by contrasting the clarity differences between source images within our proposed Clarity Contrast Attention Module (CCAM), we mutually enhance sharp features while suppressing blurry ones. This allows us to identify the exactly focused regions in each source and locate the focused-defocused boundaries. Moreover, the Defocus Spread Effect (DSE) degrades pixels in all source images around the boundaries. To further refine these ambiguous areas, we introduce a Similarity Selection Strategy, which reconstructs an initial clear image from source images and selects optimal pixels by comparing the similarity among them. Through this interactive approach, CSNet effectively preserves focused regions as well as recovering natural boundaries to fuse an all-in-focus output. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance both quantitatively and qualitatively. Our code is available on Github: https://github.com/ZYC-HUST/CSNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CSNet的新型多聚焦图像融合网络，通过清晰度对比注意力模块（CCAM）促进源图像间的直接信息交互，并引入相似性选择策略来处理焦散效应引起的边界模糊区域，最终达到最先进的融合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数基于深度学习的多聚焦图像融合方法缺乏源图像之间的显式交互，这限制了融合性能的提升和模型的可解释性。因此需要一种能够建立源图像直接信息交换机制的融合方法。
AI.method: 提出Clarity Contrast Attention Module（CCAM），通过对比源图像之间的清晰度差异，相互增强清晰特征并抑制模糊特征，从而精确定位聚焦区域和聚焦/失焦边界。针对Defocus Spread Effect（DSE）导致边界周围像素在所有源图像中退化的问题，引入Similarity Selection Strategy，从源图像重建初始清晰图像，并通过比较像素间相似性选择最优像素来精炼模糊区域。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CSNet在定量和定性评估上均达到了最先进的性能，代码已公开在GitHub上。
AI.conclusion: 通过源图像间的显式交互机制（包括清晰度对比和相似性选择），CSNet能够有效保留聚焦区域并恢复自然的边界区域，从而实现高质量的全聚焦图像融合。

title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
summary: Physical AI policies require inference throughout their lifecycle, including model evaluation, cloud reinforcement learning rollout, edge GPU serving, and onboard deployment. Although these settings share the same checkpoint and action semantics, they often rely on separate inference programs. To unify them, we build PhyAI, a Physical AI inference engine with a single runtime that keeps architecture-specific conditioning, solver, cache, and output logic in model adapters while sharing graph execution, kernels, memory management, and parallel services. The same codebase runs vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) on single or multiple GPUs across onboard, edge, and cloud deployments. We used the adapter interface to add MiniCPM-Robot on the day of its release. PhyAI achieves 1.40x-4.65x speedups over the official implementations of pi0, pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MiniCPM-Robot. On Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID it reduces latency from 2.46 to 1.18 s on eight H20 GPUs (CFG=2, TP=4), a 2.08x speedup. Specialized runtimes remain faster in several configurations, so our goal is one runtime with competitive latency rather than the fastest result in every case. Detailed profiles reveal why different models need different execution policies: on a Hopper-series GPU at batch size one, the pi0.5 action expert accounts for 8.8% of FLOPs but 57.2% of latency; at batch size 32 its share drops to 13.5% and throughput reaches about 100 samples/s. Cosmos3 remains generation-dominated and gains only 14.3% throughput as batch size increases from 1 to 16. We further introduce the control-time Roofline, which distinguishes inference-bound from environment-bound control; the measured pi0.5 points on four LIBERO suites are environment-bound while Cosmos3 stays inference-bound. Code and benchmarks: https://github.com/mingti-org/phyai.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PhyAI，一个统一的物理AI推理引擎，通过共享图执行、内核、内存管理和并行服务，同时用模型适配器保留架构特定的逻辑，使同一代码库能在车载、边缘和云环境中运行VLA模型和世界动作模型，相比官方实现取得1.40x-4.65x加速，并引入了控制时间Roofline用于区分推理受限与环境受限的控制。
AI.motivation: 物理AI策略在生命周期各阶段（模型评估、云端RL rollout、边缘GPU服务、车载部署）虽然共享相同的检查点和动作语义，却往往依赖不同的推理程序，缺乏统一的推理方案，导致工程重复和性能不一致。
AI.method: PhyAI采用单一运行时架构，将架构特定的条件逻辑、求解器、缓存和输出逻辑封装在模型适配器中，而图执行、内核、内存管理和并行服务共享；通过适配器接口支持VLA模型和WAM模型在单/多GPU、车载/边缘/云端的部署；引入控制时间Roofline分析来区分推理受限与环境受限的控制场景，并利用详细profile指导不同模型的执行策略。
AI.result: PhyAI在pi0、pi0.5、GR00T N1.7和MiniCPM-Robot上相比官方实现取得1.40x-4.65x加速；在Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID上将延迟从2.46秒降至1.18秒（8×H20、CFG=2、TP=4），实现2.08x加速。分析显示pi0.5的动作专家在batch size为1时占FLOPs的8.8%但占延迟的57.2%，batch size为32时降至13.5%且吞吐约100 samples/s；Cosmos3始终由生成主导，batch size从1增至16仅提升14.3%的吞吐。MiniCPM-Robot在发布当天即可通过适配器接口集成。
AI.conclusion: PhyAI证明了单一统一运行时可以跨物理AI推理全生命周期获得具有竞争力的延迟，尽管某些专用运行时在特定配置下仍然更快，但统一方案在工程效率和模型快速适配方面具有明显优势；通过控制时间Roofline分析可以理解不同模型在不同环境下推理与环境的瓶颈边界。

title: Consensus Measures for Unstructured Biomedical Text Annotations
summary: Biomedical literature is increasingly mined for knowledge beyond the questions it was written to answer. Because the target concepts are not known in advance, annotators prefer open-ended labels, whose agreement is hard to quantify. We study soft inter-rater reliability for annotators providing unstructured texts for biomedical annotation tasks. Synthetic experiments show that soft reliability can be quantified using a variety of semantic equivalence measures, and that the choice of measure affects failure modes of the estimation. Embeddings are scalable, but limited when differentiating similar but distinct concepts. Large language models are promising, but limited by scalability for estimating agreement by chance. Finally, we suggest measures based on natural language inference as a sensible compromise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生物医学文献注释中开放标签的软性评分者间信度度量问题，通过合成实验比较了多种语义等价度量方法，并提出基于自然语言推理的测度作为合理折中方案。
AI.motivation: 生物医学文献挖掘越来越多地超出原写作目的，注释者需要提供开放式的标签（非预定义类别），因为目标概念事先未知。这种开放性标签的一致性难以量化，因此需要研究软性评分者间信度的度量方法。
AI.method: 通过合成实验比较多种语义等价度量方法，包括嵌入（embeddings）和大语言模型（LLMs），评估它们在软性信度估计中的表现、可扩展性和失败模式。同时探索基于自然语言推理（NLI）的度量方法。
AI.result: 软性信度可以使用多种语义等价测度量化，但测度的选择会影响估计的失败模式。嵌入方法可扩展但难以区分相似但不同的概念；大语言模型有潜力但受限于计算偶然一致的扩展性；自然语言推理基础的措施被认为是合理的折中方案。
AI.conclusion: 对于生物医学注释任务中的开放式标签，应选择合适的软性信度度量方法，基于自然语言推理的度量在准确性和可扩展性之间提供了平衡，有望成为标准实践。

title: On the Implicit Flatness Bias of Sharpness-Aware Minimization: A Linear Stability Analysis with Quantitative Hyperparameter Bounds
summary: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) improves generalization by seeking parameters whose loss is robust to local adversarial perturbations, but the quantitative mechanism underlying its implicit bias toward flat minima remains unclear. In particular, the perturbation radius $ρ$ is typically treated as an isolated tuning parameter, despite defining the neighborhood in which SAM measures sharpness. We analyze mini-batch SAM near an interpolating minimum through linear stability. Under local linearization and gradient-noise alignment assumptions, we prove that every linearly stable minimum satisfies $λ_{\max}\leq\sqrt[3]{bΓ/(2ρη^2)}$, where $λ_{\max}$ is the largest Hessian eigenvalue, $b$ is the batch size, $η$ is the learning rate, and $Γ$ bounds the gradient norm. The bound quantitatively characterizes SAM's implicit flatness bias: holding the other quantities fixed, a smaller batch size, a larger learning rate, or a larger radius restricts linearly stable SAM to flatter minima. It also exposes a necessary trade-off: $ρ$ should be large enough to promote flatness, yet remain local enough to preserve the approximation and stable training. We validate this prediction in a controlled study of 900 models on CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 and VGG-19, where increasing $ρ$ is consistently associated with a smaller largest Hessian eigenvalue across batch-size and learning-rate settings. Finally, we instantiate the analysis in Taylor-Locality Controlled SAM (TLC-SAM), which adjusts $ρ$ using the observed Taylor-approximation error and further reduces the top Hessian eigenvalue relative to fixed-radius SAM. Our results provide quantitative hyperparameter bounds and a stability--locality perspective for analyzing and designing SAM variants.

AI.tldr: 本文通过线性稳定性分析揭示了SAM（Sharpness-Aware Minimization）隐式平坦性偏置的定量机制，证明了最优条件$λ_{\max}\leq\sqrt[3]{bΓ/(2ρη^2)}$，并以此推导出批大小、学习率和扰动半径三者间的相互制约关系，进而提出自适应调整半径的TLC-SAM变体，在CIFAR-100上验证了更小的最大Hessian特征值。
AI.motivation: SAM通过对抗扰动提升泛化性能，但其对平坦极小值的隐式偏置缺乏定量理解。扰动半径ρ通常被视为孤立的调参变量，而其实际定义了SAM度量sharpness的邻域，需要从理论上厘清其与批大小、学习率的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 在小批量随机优化场景中，对SAM在线性插值极小值附近进行线性稳定性分析。在局部线性化与梯度噪声对齐假设下，推导出所有线性稳定极大值满足的Hessian最大特征值上界$λ_{\max}\leq\sqrt[3]{bΓ/(2ρη^2)}$。基于此理论结果，提出Taylor-Locality Controlled SAM（TLC-SAM），利用观测到的Taylor近似误差动态调整ρ。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100上对900个模型（ResNet-18和VGG-19）进行受控实验，验证了增大ρ与更小最大Hessian特征值之间的一致性关联，且该关联在不同批大小和学习率设置下均成立。TLC-SAM相比固定半径的SAM进一步降低了最大Hessian特征值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为SAM提供了定量的超参数界，揭示了ρ需足够大以促进平坦性、又需保持局域性以维持近似有效性和训练稳定性的本质权衡，为分析和设计SAM变体提供了稳定性—局域性视角。

title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces
comment: 8 pages of main text, 7 figures, with a supplementary appendix
summary: Data agents enable natural-language analytics over organizational workspaces, where relevant evidence may be scattered across databases, structured files, long documents, and multimedia. Existing benchmarks largely isolate structured querying, retrieval, or open-ended analysis, leaving heterogeneous evidence discovery, complete tabular outputs, and deterministic evaluation insufficiently unified. We introduce DataSpace, a benchmark in which data agents produce verifiable tabular results from task-local heterogeneous workspaces. It contains 410 cross-language tasks and 7,439 artifacts totaling 15.01 GB across CSV, JSON, SQLite, Markdown, PDF, and video. DataSpace also served as the official evaluation benchmark for the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents for Complex Data Analysis competition. Each agent receives only a question and workspace and returns the complete requested tabular result. We construct DataSpace with DataSpace-Builder, an execution-grounded framework comprising cross-language transformation, constraint-aware relational sampling, modality routing and artifact rendering, and human review and task repair by 11 domain experts. A deterministic evaluator performs header-invariant column alignment, type- and precision-aware normalization, and order-aware row comparison. Across six recently released frontier multimodal models and five widely used agent harnesses, the best accuracy reaches 66.34%, while harness choice creates a 15.36-point spread with the backbone fixed. Multimodal evidence integration and joins consistently reduce accuracy across all six backbones. These results show that DataSpace remains unsaturated and identify key challenges for improving data-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: DataSpace 是一个用于评估数据代理（data agent）在复杂异构工作空间中执行自然语言分析任务的基准测试，包含410个跨语言任务和7,439个工件（15.01 GB），采用执行落地框架构建并以确定性评估器验证表格结果。在六个前沿多模态模型和五种代理框架下，最佳准确率仅达66.34%，表明该基准尚未饱和。
AI.motivation: 现有基准大多将结构化查询、信息检索和开放式分析割裂开来，未能统一覆盖异构证据发现、完整表格输出和确定性评估这三个关键维度，导致数据代理在真实组织工作空间中的综合能力无法被有效衡量。
AI.method: 提出 DataSpace-Builder 执行落地框架，包括跨语言变换、约束感知的关系采样、模态路由和工件渲染、以及11位领域专家的人工审查和任务修复。配套设计确定性评估器，实现头部不变的列对齐、类型和精度感知的归一化、以及顺序感知的行比较。
AI.result: 在六个前沿多模态模型和五种广泛使用的代理框架下，最佳准确率为66.34%；固定骨干网络时，代理框架的选择造成15.36个百分点的性能差异；多模态证据整合和连接操作在所有六个骨干网络上均一致地降低了准确率。
AI.conclusion: DataSpace 基准尚未饱和，能够有效区分不同数据代理的性能，并揭示了多模态证据整合与跨模态连接是当前数据代理面临的关键挑战，为提升数据代理可靠性指明了方向。

title: NanoMorph-3D: An End-to-End Physics-Driven Unrolling Framework for Nanomaterial Reconstruction
summary: Precise 3D characterization of nanomaterials is essential for unlocking structure-property relationships. However, standard electron tomography is fundamentally limited by the missing wedge problem. Consequently, conventional algorithms suffer from severe geometric distortions, a challenge further complicated by pervasive noise interference. Current learning-based methods either rely on physics-blind post-processing or employ end-to-end architectures constrained by local receptive fields, failing to capture complex 3D topologies. We propose NanoMorph-3D, a unified end-to-end framework grounded in a comprehensive Nanomorphological Taxonomy. Powered by a large-scale synthetic dataset explicitly modeling non-linear electron attenuation, we design a Physics-Driven Unrolled Network mapping proximal gradient descent into a learnable architecture. To capture complex internal topologies, we formulate a hierarchical attention mechanism with Physics-Normalization for long-range 3D dependencies and scale invariance. Crucially, our Dual-Domain strategy leverages Sinusoidal Attention to explicitly model physical projection trajectories, enforcing strict sinogram consistency to mitigate missing wedge artifacts. Finally, an unsupervised dual-stream mechanism bridges the simulation-to-reality gap. Experiments demonstrate NanoMorph-3D reconstructs diverse topologies with superior fidelity and speed.

AI.tldr: 提出NanoMorph-3D，一个统一的端到端框架，通过物理驱动的展开网络、层次化注意力机制和双域策略解决电子断层扫描中的missing wedge问题，实现纳米材料的高保真3D重构。
AI.motivation: 标准电子断层扫描受missing wedge问题限制，导致几何畸变和噪声干扰；现有学习方法要么依赖物理盲处理，要么受限于局部感受野，无法捕捉复杂3D拓扑结构，因此需要一种能精确表征纳米材料3D结构的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出NanoMorph-3D：(1) 基于纳米形态学分类法构建物理驱动展开网络，将近端梯度下降映射为可学习架构；(2) 设计带物理归一化的层次化注意力机制，捕捉长程3D依赖和尺度不变性；(3) 采用双域策略，利用正弦注意力显式建模物理投影轨迹，强制正弦图一致性以缓解missing wedge伪影；(4) 使用无监督双流机制弥合仿真到现实的差距；训练数据基于大规模合成数据集，显式建模非线性电子衰减。
AI.result: 实验表明NanoMorph-3D能以更高的保真度和更快的速度重构多样拓扑结构的纳米材料。
AI.conclusion: NanoMorph-3D通过物理驱动的学习架构成功解决了missing wedge和噪声问题，实现了快速且高保真的3D纳米材料重构，为结构-性能关系研究提供了有力工具。

title: Cross-Lingual Bias in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis of English and Swahili
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multilingual contexts, yet safety alignment and bias evaluation remain overwhelmingly English-centric. We investigate whether social biases generalise across languages by submitting 4,900 symmetric English--Swahili prompt pairs to GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash across nine demographic bias axes, yielding 19,600 completions evaluated for stereotype prevalence, sentiment, refusal behaviour, and cross-lingual semantic similarity. Our findings show that bias transforms rather than transfers: stereotype rates shifted by up to 12 percentage points on specific axes, Gemini's neutral-sentiment rate doubled in Swahili, and GPT-5.2 refused 169 prompts in English and zero in Swahili, consistent with refusal behaviour anchored to English-language surface forms at the behavioural level. Over 55% of prompt pairs produced semantically dissimilar completions across both models. These reinforce the idea that English-only bias audits do not produce adequate coverage for multilingual deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过4,900组对称的英语—斯瓦希里语提示词对，对GPT-5.2和Gemini 2.5 Flash在九个社会偏见维度上进行跨语言偏见评估。结果表明偏见在跨语言中发生"转换"而非"转移"：刻板印象率在特定维度上波动高达12个百分点，Gemini在斯瓦希里语中中性情绪率翻倍，GPT-5.2在英语中拒绝169个提示而在斯瓦希里语中零拒绝。超过55%的提示对在两种模型下产生语义不相似的完成结果，有力证明仅基于英语的偏见审计无法为多语言部署提供充分覆盖。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的安全对齐与偏见评估过分集中于英语，缺乏对多语言环境下社会偏见是否可泛化的系统研究。作者旨在探究偏见在不同语言间是直接迁移还是发生结构性变化，以揭示英语中心评估的局限性。
AI.method: 构建4,900组对称的英语—斯瓦希里语提示词对，跨越九个社会偏见轴，分别输入GPT-5.2和Gemini 2.5 Flash，收集19,600个生成结果。从四个维度进行系统评估：刻板印象普遍性、情绪倾向、拒绝行为及跨语言语义相似度。
AI.result: 发现偏见在跨语言间发生转化而非简单转移：特定维度上刻板印象率变化幅度高达12个百分点；Gemini在斯瓦希里语中中性情绪率翻倍；GPT-5.2在英语中拒绝169个提示但在斯瓦希里语中零拒绝（表明拒绝行为在行为层面锚定于英语表层形式）；两模型超过55%的提示对产生语义不相似的输出。
AI.conclusion: 英语单语的偏见审计不足以覆盖多语言部署场景的安全需求。模型的安全行为（如拒绝机制）和偏见表现高度依赖于语言表面形式，跨语言偏见评估应成为大语言模型安全评测体系的必要组成部分。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to learn through interaction, but sparse trajectory-level rewards reveal success without identifying which intermediate decisions deserve credit. Training-only privileged skills can provide denser supervision by allowing the same frozen policy snapshot to rescore fixed tokens from skill-free trajectories while conditioned on task-matched procedural skills. Existing methods, however, do not jointly calibrate teacher scores across interaction steps, relate teacher confidence to realized returns, and integrate the resulting signal into native reward-to-advantage construction. We introduce Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping (ADRS), a framework for constructing return-associated token-level credit for multi-turn language agents. ADRS centers and normalizes privileged token scores within each step, modulates them with a return-associated Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) gate based on within-group confidence--return association, and incorporates the gated token signal into native RL credit construction. Together, these components determine what the teacher prefers, when that preference is return-relevant, and how it enters the native reinforcement-learning credit path, while keeping rollouts and inference skill-free. Finally, experiments across three interactive benchmarks show that ADRS consistently improves performance on long-horizon tasks, with gains persisting across RL backbones, reduced-data settings, unseen tasks, and extended training. For anonymous review, our code is available at the following the link: https://github.com/gitrxh/ADRS-arxiv

AI.tldr: ADRS是一个面向多轮语言智能体的自蒸馏奖励塑形框架，通过步内中心化/归一化的特权技能分数、基于回报关联的Teacher Value Advantage门控，以及将门控信号整合进原生强化学习信用分配路径，在三个交互式基准上持续提升长程任务性能。
AI.motivation: 智能体的强化学习面临轨迹级稀疏奖励难以定位中间决策贡献的问题。训练时使用的特权技能虽可提供更密集的监督信号，但现有方法未能在跨交互步骤上联合校准教师分数、将教师置信度与实际回报关联，也未能将该信号整合进原生的reward-to-advantage构建中。
AI.method: ADRS包含三个核心组件：(1) 在每一步内对特权token分数进行中心化和归一化；(2) 通过基于组内置信度-回报关联的Teacher Value Advantage (TVA)门控来调节token信号；(3) 将门控后的token级信号融入原生强化学习信用构建路径。整个流程保持rollout和推理阶段无技能依赖。
AI.result: 在三个交互式基准上的实验表明，ADRS在长程任务上持续提升性能，且提升效果在不同RL骨干、减少数据量、未见任务以及延长训练等设置下均保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: ADRS系统地解决了特权技能分数校淮、教师置信度与回报关联以及信号整合三大问题，为多轮语言智能体的奖励塑形提供了一种有效的自蒸馏框架，并在多种设置下验证了其泛化性与稳健性。

title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learning rate decays more rapidly with compute. For model--data allocation, IsoFLOP analysis reveals a slight data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. For MoE architecture, larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity, while moderate expert granularity remains consistently effective and the preferred fraction of activated capacity assigned to shared experts remains stable across scales. Guided by these findings, we train LLaDA MoE v2, a 30B-A3B dLLM, from scratch on 23.5T tokens. With approximately 65\% as many pretraining tokens as Qwen3, LLaDA MoE v2 approaches Qwen3 on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning alone, it outperforms SDAR Chat on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains close to Qwen3 on several tasks. These results establish practical scaling laws and design principles for MoE dLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了扩散语言模型（dLLM）中混合专家（MoE）架构的扩展规律，发现其在优化超参数、计算分配和架构缩放方面与自回归（AR）模型存在定量差异，并基于这些发现训练了LLaDA MoE v2（30B-A3B，23.5T tokens），该模型在多个基准上接近乃至超越Qwen3等强基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型是自回归建模的替代方案，但MoE dLLM的缩放行为尚未被系统理解。理解其与AR模型在缩放趋势上的差异，对于高效训练大规模扩散MoE模型至关重要。
AI.method: 系统刻画MoE dLLM在优化超参数（名义批量大小、学习率）、模型-数据分配（IsoFLOP分析）和MoE架构（专家池规模、专家粒度、共享专家比例）三方面的缩放规律，并与AR模型报告的趋势进行定量对比；基于发现的规律训练LLaDA MoE v2。
AI.result: 1) 优化方面：最优名义批量大小随计算量的增长更快，最优学习率衰减更迅速；2) 数据分配方面：IsoFLOP分析显示最优token预算增长快于激活侧模型计算；3) 架构方面：更大规模偏好更大的专家池，中等专家粒度始终有效，共享专家占比保持稳定。训练的LLaDA MoE v2用约65%的预训练token即在多个基准上接近Qwen3，并在SFT后于七项推理/编程基准中超过SDAR Chat。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了MoE dLLM的实际缩放规律和设计原则，表明MoE dLLM与AR模型在缩放行为上存在本质差异，其规律可指导大规模扩散MoE模型的训练配置选择，且以更少数据即可达到有竞争力的性能。

title: Efficient Video Dataset Distillation via Cluster-Guided Prototype Blending
summary: Video dataset distillation aims to compress a large video dataset into a compact surrogate set that preserves its training utility. Most existing approaches synthesize condensed videos through iterative optimization, whose cost is amplified by the temporal dimension. Rather than further reducing the number of optimized variables, we investigate whether effective distilled videos can be constructed without gradient-based optimization of the stored videos. Such a construction-based approach must address three challenges: selecting informative temporal segments, covering diverse intra-class variations under a limited videos-per-class budget, and increasing the information carried by each stored sample. To this end, we propose ProtoBlend, an efficient select-allocate-blend framework. First, teacher-guided temporal clip selection retains a high-confidence segment from each source video. Second, cluster-guided prototype allocation partitions the selected clips in the teacher feature space and assigns one distilled slot to each intra-class cluster. Third, each prototype is blended with an in-cluster anchor, while their teacher predictions are combined using the same coefficient to provide mixture-source supervision. Experiments on four trimmed action-recognition benchmarks demonstrate that ProtoBlend achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off without iterative optimization of the distilled videos.

AI.tldr: ProtoBlend提出了一种无需梯度优化即可构建视频蒸馏数据集的select-allocate-blend框架，通过教师引导的时间片段选择、聚类引导的原型分配和原型混合，在四个动作识别基准上实现了有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据集蒸馏方法通常通过迭代优化合成紧凑视频，其成本因时间维度而放大。作者质疑是否可以在不进行基于梯度的存储视频优化的情况下构建有效的蒸馏视频，从而避免迭代优化的高计算开销。
AI.method: ProtoBlend包含三个步骤：(1) 教师引导的时间片段选择，从每个源视频中保留高置信度片段；(2) 聚类引导的原型分配，在教师特征空间中对所选片段进行聚类，并为每个类内簇分配一个蒸馏槽位；(3) 每个原型与簇内锚点进行混合，同时以相同系数组合教师预测以提供混合来源监督。
AI.result: 在四个修剪后的动作识别基准上进行实验，ProtoBlend在无需迭代优化蒸馏视频的情况下实现了有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: ProtoBlend证明了无需梯度优化的构建式方法也能有效进行视频数据集蒸馏，在保持竞争性精度的同时显著提升了效率。

title: Hi-TTRL: Regulating Consensus with Hints for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models without labeled data by updating the policy with pseudo-labels constructed through majority voting. While effective, the reward signal assigned from majority voting is highly sensitive to consensus strength, defined as the frequency of the most common answer within a rollout group. In TTRL, consensus strength plays a dual role: it reflects both the reliability of the pseudo-label and the distribution of advantages. Low consensus can amplify updates from unreliable pseudo-labels through disproportionately large advantages, whereas high consensus reduces reward contrast and ultimately yields vanishing gradients. In this paper, we introduce Hi-TTRL, a test-time reinforcement learning framework that utilizes hints during sampling to regulate rollout consensus strength. Hi-TTRL first estimates consensus strength from a partial rollout group. When the consensus strength falls outside a target interval, it invokes a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) hint sampler. The sampler targets the power-transformed prefix distribution and uses finite-step approximate sampling to generate rollout prefixes as hints. By tuning the power exponent, Hi-TTRL generates hints with a sharpened or flattened power target, steering rollout consensus strength toward the target interval. Experiments on multiple datasets and backbones show that Hi-TTRL consistently improves over standard TTRL, with ablations and consensus-steering analyses validating the effectiveness of adaptive hint-guided consensus regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hi-TTRL，一个测试时强化学习框架，通过提示（hints）调节滚动输出组的共识强度，从而改进TTRL中因共识强度不当导致的伪标签不可靠和梯度消失问题。
AI.motivation: TTRL利用多数投票构造伪标签来更新策略，但奖励信号对共识强度高度敏感：低共识会通过不成比例的大优势放大不可靠伪标签的更新，高共识则降低奖励对比度导致梯度消失。现有TTRL方法未对此进行有效调节。
AI.method: Hi-TTRL在采样过程中使用提示调节滚动输出共识强度。首先从部分滚动组估计共识强度；当共识强度落在目标区间之外时，调用MCMC提示采样器，该采样器以幂变换前缀分布为目标，通过有限步近似采样生成滚动前缀作为提示。通过调节幂指数，生成尖锐或平坦的幂目标分布，将滚动共识强度引导至目标区间。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和骨干模型上的实验表明，Hi-TTRL一致优于标准TTRL。消融实验和共识引导分析验证了自适应提示引导的共识调节的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Hi-TTRL通过自适应调节滚动共识强度，有效平衡了伪标签可靠性与奖励对比度之间的矛盾，为测试时强化学习提供了一种新的共识调控机制。

title: SAKI: Score-Aware Low-Rank Key Indexing for Long-Context KV Retrieval
summary:
Existing low rank KV cache methods preserve either model weights or key variance, neither of which directly reflects the attention scores used during inference. We derive the expected attention score distortion caused by rank r key compression and show that it yields a covariance weighted low rank objective. Under a margin condition, controlling this distortion also improves top k recall. The optimal rank r solution has a closed form asymmetric factorization obtained from the SVD of the covariance weighted query key operator. This motivates SAKI, a training free KV cache index that directly preserves attention scores rather than key reconstruction quality.
  Across LLaMA 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Mistral 7B v0.1, and Llama 3.2 3B, SAKI outperforms key PCA at every tested rank. At rank 32, it removes 13 to 30 percent of PCA's remaining top 64 recall error, including improvements from 0.748 to 0.799 on LLaMA 3.1 8B and from 0.786 to 0.850 on Qwen 2.5 7B. It improves 68 to 89 percent of attention heads per model, with the largest gains in deeper layers. Predicted score MSE reductions closely match empirical measurements, with a Pearson correlation of 0.997, while ablation studies confirm that the gains arise from optimizing the attention score objective rather than covariance weighting alone. Analysis of the scoring operator further explains why weight only, invariant subspace, and key reconstruction methods can be suboptimal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAKI，一种免训练的KV缓存索引方法，通过直接优化注意力分数目标而非键重建质量来压缩KV缓存。SAKI基于协方差加权的低秩目标，其最优秩r解可通过SVD闭式求解，在多模型上优于键PCA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的低秩KV缓存方法（如键PCA）保留模型权重或键方差，但这些都不直接反映推理过程中实际使用的注意力分数。由于注意力分数是推理的关键，需要一种直接以注意力分数失真为目标优化的方法。
AI.method: 推导出秩r键压缩引起的期望注意力分数失真，将其转化为协方差加权的低秩目标。在边际条件下，控制该失真可提升top-k召回率。最优秩r解通过对协方差加权的查询-键算子进行SVD得到闭式非对称分解，由此构建SAKI索引。
AI.result: 在LLaMA 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Mistral 7B v0.1和Llama 3.2 3B上，SAKI在所有测试秩下均优于键PCA。秩32时，SAKI消除了PCA剩余top-64召回误差的13%-30%，如LLaMA 3.1 8B从0.748提升至0.799，Qwen 2.5 7B从0.786提升至0.850。68%-89%的注意力头得到改善，深层增益最大。预测分数MSE减少与实测高度吻合（Pearson相关系数0.997），消融实验确认性能提升源于注意力分数目标的优化。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化注意力分数比优化键重建质量更有效；SAKI在免训练条件下显著提升KV缓存压缩性能，并揭示了仅权重、不变子空间和键重建方法次优的原因。

title: Solver-Aware Decompositions for Programming-by-Example: When Dividing Requires Knowing how to Conquer
summary: Decomposition-based Programming-by-example (PBE) scales performance by splitting tasks into subtasks that a learned synthesizer solves: a decomposer predicts intermediate subgoals, and a synthesizer generates programs conditioned on them. Current approaches train the decomposer to imitate ground-truth ( GT) subgoals, implicitly treating decomposition quality as intrinsic to the task. We challenge this assumption: for bounded solvers with fixed inductive biases, GT decompositions reflect the annotator's factorization choices - not the solver's search dynamics. A decomposer trained to match GT decompositions may therefore propose subgoals that are logically valid yet intractable for the solver. We propose Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that retains supervised training on GT subgoals as a structural scaffold, while additionally optimizing the decomposer via direct feedback from a frozen synthesizer. Subgoals are rewarded based on the synthesizer's loss on the target program - a signal of subtask difficulty that encourages decompositions the solver can act on. Our experiments reveal an accuracy paradox: higher agreement with GT decompositions does not improve synthesis success - even though the synthesizer was trained on the very same GT data the decomposer is optimized to mimic. SAD instead learns decompositions that trade GT alignment for solver tractability, yielding consistent gains in synthesis and end-to-end task accuracy across two PBE domains. Moreover, SAD solves tasks that a GT decomposition oracle fails - empirical evidence that GT decompositions are not universally optimal for bounded solvers, and that decomposition quality is solver-relative, not intrinsic.

AI.tldr: 提出Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD)训练框架，在保留GT子目标监督的基础上，利用冻结合成器的损失信号优化分解器，使分解器生成对求解器可处理的子目标，而非简单模仿人类标注的GT分解，从而提升程序合成成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分解的PBE方法训练分解器模仿GT子目标，隐含假设分解质量是任务内在属性。但GT分解反映的是标注者的因子化选择，而非有界求解器的搜索动态，可能导致逻辑有效但对求解器不可解的子目标。
AI.method: SAD框架结合两路信号训练分解器：(1) 监督学习GT子目标作为结构支架；(2) 使用冻结的合成器对分解器生成子目标提供直接反馈，以合成器在目标程序上的损失作为子目标难度信号进行奖励，鼓励分解器生成求解器可操作的分解。
AI.result: 实验揭示了accuracy paradox：与GT分解的一致性提高并不提升合成成功率。SAD学习到牺牲GT对齐换取求解器可处理性的分解，在两个PBE领域取得一致的合成和端到端任务精度提升；SAD还能解决GT分解oracle无法解决的难题，证明GT分解对有界求解器并非普遍最优。
AI.conclusion: 分解质量是求解器相对的而非任务内在的，GT分解对有界求解器并非最优，面向求解器可处理性优化分解是提升PBE性能的有效方向。

title: GUI-Lens: Coarse-to-Fine Cropping for GUI Grounding with General-Purpose VLMs
summary: GUI grounding maps natural-language instructions to click locations and is essential for reliable GUI agents. The task remains difficult on high-resolution, densely populated interfaces because a vision-language model (VLM) may recognize a requested control without locating it precisely enough for interaction. Most existing methods provide various forms of localization assistance, but still rely on a direct click prediction, allowing visual ambiguity or an inaccurate initial estimate to propagate to the final result. In this paper, we introduce GUI-Lens, a coarse-to-fine grounding framework that allows a general-purpose VLM to determine the target through active visual observations. Specifically, GUI-Lens extracts OCR text and detected UI components from the screenshot and presents their positions as coordinate references. Using the instruction, the current view, and these references, the VLM selects the region and scale of the next view, which is cropped and enlarged to provide finer visual details. This process continues over successively focused views until the target is determined. Proposed crops and clicks are checked against the instruction throughout the process, and the final local position is mapped back to the original screen coordinates. Experiments on four GUI grounding benchmarks and three general-purpose VLM backends show that GUI-Lens improves overall grounding accuracy by up to 24.9 percentage points and achieves state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.5.

AI.tldr: GUI-Lens是一个粗到细的GUI定位框架，通过主动视觉观察和逐步缩放裁剪，让通用视觉语言模型在无需直接点击预测的情况下，通过OCR文本和UI组件坐标参考逐步聚焦目标区域，最终将局部坐标映射回原始屏幕坐标，在四个基准和三个VLM后端上最高提升24.9个百分点准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI定位方法依赖直接的点击坐标预测，视觉歧义或不准确的初始估计会直接传播到最终结果，导致高分辨率、密集界面上的定位精度不足。需要一个能够通过逐步观察来消除歧义的框架。
AI.method: GUI-Lens采用粗到细的定位框架：先从屏幕截图提取OCR文本和UI组件并将其位置作为坐标参考；然后利用指令、当前视图和坐标参考，让VLM选择下一视图的区域和缩放级别；通过不断裁剪和放大逐步获得更精细的视觉细节，直至确定目标；整个过程持续校验提议的裁剪和点击是否符合指令，最后将局部坐标映射回原始屏幕坐标。
AI.result: 在四个GUI定位基准和三个通用VLM后端的实验中，GUI-Lens相比基线最高提升24.9个百分点准确率，并在GPT-5.5后端上达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过逐步聚焦的主动视觉观察替代一次性点击预测，能够有效缓解GUI定位中视觉歧义传播的问题，显著提升高分辨率密集界面上的定位准确率。

title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs). Our preliminary experiments revealed a phenomenon: SFT suffers from severe task conflicts under multi-stage training, whereas RL enables stable coexistence across diverse tasks. Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks. We provide a theoretical explanation for this mechanism by analyzing multi-task gradient interference. Our results reveal a distinction: interference in SFT is norm-limited, scaling with the absolute gradient magnitude, whereas interference in RL is variance-limited, bounded by the gradient variance induced by advantage normalization and on-policy optimization. This small variance bound yields near-orthogonal optimization directions across tasks. Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文发现SFT和RL在多任务推理增强中表现出根本不同的行为：SFT在多阶段训练下存在严重的任务冲突，而RL允许任务稳定共存。通过参数级分析，发现RL产生稀疏且近似正交的参数更新，并提供了理论解释：SFT的干扰受梯度绝对值（范数）限制，而RL的干扰受梯度方差限制，从而产生近似正交的优化方向。基于此提出Parallel-RL范式，将多任务训练解耦，显著提升效率和灵活性。
AI.motivation: 探究SFT与RL在大语言模型多任务推理增强中表现差异的根本原因，理解任务冲突的机制，从而解决多任务训练中的效率与效果问题。
AI.method: 1）通过初步实验揭示SFT与RL在多任务训练中的行为差异现象；2）从参数层面进行实证分析，观察RL产生稀疏且近似正交的跨任务更新；3）分析多任务梯度干扰，从理论上区分SFT的范数限制干扰与RL的方差限制干扰；4）基于该理论提出Parallel-RL多任务解耦训练范式。
AI.result: SFT存在严重的任务冲突，而RL可实现任务的稳定共存；RL的参数更新呈稀疏且近似正交特性；SFT的干扰受梯度范数限制，RL的干扰受梯度方差限制（主要由优势归一化和在线策略优化引起），方差较小从而保证跨任务优化方向近似正交；Parallel-RL范式显著提升了多任务训练的效率和灵活性。
AI.conclusion: SFT与RL的干扰机制本质不同（范数限制vs方差限制），这是导致两者多任务行为差异的根源；利用RL的方差限制特性设计Parallel-RL可实现高效的多任务解耦训练，为大规模多任务LLM训练提供了新的方向。

title: FinVerse: Financial Time-Series Benchmark
summary: As time-series foundation models have emerged, the need for benchmarks that can evaluate their forecasting ability in meaningful ways has become increasingly important. Existing time-series forecasting benchmarks provide useful standardized comparisons, but they often evaluate heterogeneous series with uniform error-based metrics. Strong performance under such metrics does not necessarily imply that a model's forecasts will support the best real-world decisions across domains. For example, in stock forecasting, correctly predicting whether a price will rise or fall can be more directly relevant to realized returns than minimizing point-wise forecast error alone. To this end, we introduce FinVerse, a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that takes a first step toward more realistic evaluation. The released FinVerse data artifact contains 116,897 financial time series with 171.1M observations, of which 60,232 series with 17.4M observations are selected as evaluated targets based on their economic relevance to financial decisions. Unlike generic forecasting benchmarks that primarily emphasize uniform point-forecast or probabilistic accuracy, FinVerse defines 11 metric families comprising 78 evaluation metrics and assigns the most appropriate evaluation metrics to each individual time series based on its underlying economic meaning. Our analysis of 43 public time-series forecasting foundation models shows that strong performance under generic forecasting criteria does not necessarily translate into useful financial forecasts. This finding highlights the need for domain-aware benchmarks that evaluate models under objectives closer to real-world decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinVerse，一个金融领域的时间序列预测基准，包含116,897个金融时间序列（1.711亿观测值），定义11个度量族、78个评估指标，并根据每个时间序列的经济含义为其分配最合适的评估指标。对43个时间序列基础模型的评估表明，在通用预测标准下表现优异并不一定转化为有用的金融预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列预测基准通常用统一的基于误差的指标来评估异构序列，但强预测性能并不一定意味着模型能支持最优的跨领域真实决策。例如在股票预测中，正确预测涨跌方向可能比最小化逐点预测误差对实际收益更直接相关。因此需要一种更贴近真实决策的、领域感知的基准。
AI.method: 构建FinVerse数据工件：包含116,897个金融时间序列共1.711亿个观测值，其中60,232个序列（1,740万观测值）因其与金融决策的经济相关性被选为评估目标。与通用基准不同，FinVerse定义了11个度量族共78个评估指标，并根据每个时间序列的潜在经济含义为其分配最合适的评估指标。
AI.result: 对43个公开的时间序列预测基础模型的分析显示，在通用预测标准下表现优异的模型并不一定能够生成有用的金融预测，揭示了通用基准与领域特定决策之间可能存在显著脱节。
AI.conclusion: 该发现强调了对领域感知基准的需求，即需要在更贴近真实决策目标的条件下评估模型，而不是仅依赖通用的误差指标。

title: LeanMem: Simple and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents to sustain interactions and reliably leverage distant history. However, existing memory systems typically process heterogeneous dialogue content through a uniform summarization and retrieval pipeline, leading to either excessive token consumption or irreversible loss of fine-grained evidence. We argue that historical dialogue content should be handled differently according to its compressibility, temporal dynamics, and fidelity requirements. Based on this insight, we propose LeanMem, a lightweight long-term memory framework. LeanMem first filters out low-value content, then stores informative segments as compact profile memory, temporally structured event memory, or source-grounded record memory, depending on the nature of the information. During maintenance, only dynamically evolving event memories are selectively updated, avoiding redundant consolidation of stable profiles and immutable records. During inference, LeanMem dynamically selects memory types and allocates retrieval budgets according to query-specific evidence demands, assembling relevant evidence on demand. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S with GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen3-8B, LeanMem improves accuracy over the strongest memory-based baseline in every setting, by up to 15.1 points, at the lowest or near-lowest construction cost, inference tokens, and latency. The code and datasets are included in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: LeanMem是一个轻量级长期记忆框架，根据对话内容的可压缩性、时间动态和保真度需求，将历史对话分别存储为档案记忆、事件记忆和记录记忆三种类型，并通过选择性更新和按需检索来降低token消耗、保留细粒度证据。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S基准上，基于GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B的LeanMem在所有设置下均优于最强记忆基线方法，准确率最高提升15.1个百分点，同时保持最低或接近最低的构建成本、推理token和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的长期记忆系统对异构对话内容采用统一的摘要和检索流程，导致两个问题：要么token消耗过多，要么细粒度证据不可逆丢失。作者认为应根据内容的可压缩性、时间动态性和保真度要求对不同历史对话区别对待，据此提出LeanMem框架。
AI.method: LeanMem包含三个核心环节：(1) 存储阶段：先过滤低价值内容，然后将信息性片段按信息性质分别存储为紧凑的档案记忆（个人档案）、时间结构化的事件记忆（动态事件）或基于来源的记录记忆（不可变记录）；(2) 维护阶段：仅对动态演化的事件记忆进行选择性更新，避免对稳定档案和不可变记录的冗余整合；(3) 推理阶段：根据查询具体的证据需求动态选择记忆类型并分配检索预算，按需组装相关证据。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S基准上，使用GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B，LeanMem在所有设置下均超越了最强记忆基线，准确率最高提升15.1个百分点，同时实现了最低或接近最低的构建成本、推理token和延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分不同记忆类型并采用差异化的存储、维护和检索策略，LeanMem证明了按信息性质分类处理长期记忆能够同时兼顾准确性与效率，为LLM智能体的长期记忆系统提供了一种轻量高效的解决方案。

title: 3DGSI-Assessor: A Large-Scale Dataset and An LMM-based Method for 3D Gaussian Splatting Image Quality Assessment
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a dominant representation for real-time novel view synthesis (NVS), yet its storage footprint makes compression indispensable for practical deployment. 3DGS training and compression introduce representation-specific distortions such as floating artifacts and surface scattering, which conventional image quality assessment (IQA) metrics fail to capture. Moreover, the independent compression of geometric and color attributes may lead to decoupled dimension-specific distortions that must be diagnosed separately, yet existing metrics report only a single overall score. To address these gaps, we present 3DGS-IEval-15K+, a large-scale, multi-dimensional IQA dataset for compressed 3DGS, comprising 15,200 images from 10 diverse scenes, produced by 6 representative 3DGS algorithms at systematically designed compression levels and rendered from 20 strategically selected viewpoints spanning both training views and challenging novel views, annotated with 45,600 mean opinion scores (MOSs) across overall, geometry, and color quality. Based on 3DGS-IEval-15K+, we propose 3DGSI-Assessor, an all-in-one 3DGS IQA framework that integrates global semantic and dimension-specific local features within a large multimodal model (LMM), predicting all three dimensions in a single forward pass. 3DGSI-Assessor achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3DGS-IEval-15K+, and exhibits competitive generalization on other NVS benchmarks. Dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/YukeXing/3DGSI-Assessor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3DGS-IEval-15K+，一个大规模、多维度的压缩3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）图像质量评估（IQA）数据集，包含15,200张图像、45,600个MOS评分（覆盖整体、几何和颜色三个维度），并在此基础上提出3DGSI-Assessor，一个基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的一体化3DGS质量评估框架，通过单个前向传播同时预测三个质量维度。
AI.motivation: 3DGS已成为实时新视角合成（NVS）的主导表示，但存储开销大，压缩必不可少。然而，3DGS训练和压缩引入的特定失真（如浮动伪影、表面散射）无法被传统IQA指标捕获；此外，几何和颜色属性的独立压缩可能产生解耦的维度特定失真，现有指标只报告单一总体分数，无法分别诊断这些问题。
AI.method: 构建大规模多维度IQA数据集3DGS-IEval-15K+：包含10个场景、6种代表性3DGS算法、系统设计的压缩级别、20个策略性选择的视角（涵盖训练视角和挑战性新视角），共15,200张图像，标注45,600个MOS（覆盖整体、几何、颜色三个维度）。在此基础上提出3DGSI-Assessor框架，在大型多模态模型（LMM）中集成全局语义特征和维度特定局部特征，通过单次前向传播同时预测三个质量维度。
AI.result: 3DGSI-Assessor在3DGS-IEval-15K+数据集上达到最先进的性能，并在其他NVS基准上展现出具有竞争力的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了3DGS压缩场景下缺乏多维度IQA评估的空白，提出的数据集和评估框架为该领域提供了标准化基准和高效评估工具，代码与数据集将公开。

title: Looking under the Wrong Lamppost: On the Limitations of Automated Translation Quality Estimation
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP 2026), Trento, Italy, September 2026
summary: Automation of Translation Quality Estimation (QE) has emerged as a widely discussed approach to managing translation quality at scale, and a growing number of tools and technologies have been released in pursuit of this goal. However, the proliferation of new QE systems has not always been accompanied by robust, transparent, and reproducible research and testing. This gap deserves critical scrutiny. This paper examines some fundamental limitations of the QE technology from both theoretical and empirical perspectives, arguing that current QE systems are structurally ill-equipped to serve as reliable standalone tools in real-world translation workflows. The reviewed evidence suggests that QE suffers from a range of interrelated and largely unresolved limitations. Most fundamentally, the evaluation of the quality of translation at the level of isolated segments is problematic because it tends to miss out on cohesion, coherence, and stylistic and rhetorical text features. In addition, empirical research documents several other limitations and flaws, including failure to generalize, systematic biases, overfitting and distribution collapse, performance gaps, error annotation challenges, and data scarcity. These are structural limitations arising from the complexity of human language and translation as a cognitive and communicative act - limitations that more data and better architectures have so far not overcome. Consequently, segment-level QE scores should not be used as a standalone basis for routing, release, or review bypass in production; we argue future work should focus on automating human evaluation grounded in MQM.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论和实证两个角度审视翻译质量估计（QE）技术的根本局限，论证当前基于片段级别的QE系统在结构上不适合作为真实翻译工作流中可靠的独立工具，并主张未来应转向基于MQM的自动化人工评估。
AI.motivation: 随着翻译质量估计自动化成为大规模质量管理的主流方向，大量工具和系统涌现，但这些系统的研究普遍缺乏稳健性、透明性和可复现性。作者认为这种研究与实践之间的鸿沟值得批判性审视，因此有必要系统性地考察QE技术的基本局限性。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与实证研究综述相结合的方法。理论层面论证片段级翻译质量评估在结构上无法捕捉语篇的衔接、连贯、风格和修辞特征；实证层面系统梳理了已有研究记录的QE系统在泛化失败、系统性偏差、过拟合与分布崩塌、性能差距、错误标注挑战和数据稀缺等方面的证据。
AI.result: 研究发现QE存在一系列相互关联且基本未解决的局限：片段级质量评估天然遗漏语篇层面特征；实证研究记录了大量结构性问题，包括泛化失败、系统性偏差、过拟合、分布崩塌、性能差距、标注困难和数据稀缺。这些限制根本上源于人类语言的复杂性以及翻译作为认知与交际行为的本质，更多数据和更好的架构未能克服这些限制。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为片段级QE分数不应作为生成路由、发布或审校跳过的独立依据；未来研究应聚焦于以MQM（多维质量指标）为基础、自动化地进行人工评估。

title: ED-DiT: Physics-Guided Diffusion Pretraining for Transferable Molecular Representations from Electron Density
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Pretraining has shown strong potential for learning transferable representations, yet it remains underexplored for electron-density-based molecular learning. Electron density provides a continuous three-dimensional description of molecular electronic structure, capturing both local spatial patterns and global physical quantities. This raises a key question: can electron-density fields be used for self-supervised pretraining to learn a shared representation that transfers across diverse electronic-structure-related tasks? We propose ED-DiT, a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer for self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds. ED-DiT learns reusable representations by reconstructing corrupted and partially masked log-density fields across diffusion noise levels. An electron-number consistency constraint is further introduced to preserve the total electronic mass. The pretrained encoder can be adapted to property prediction, open-/closed-shell classification, molecule-electron-density retrieval, and molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction. Experiments on six EDBench tasks show that ED-DiT consistently outperforms the same architecture trained from scratch, especially under limited supervision. For molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction, it reduces RMSE from 2.2474 to 1.3753 and surpasses the available baseline. With only 10% labels, it improves orbital energy prediction RMSE from 0.0293 to 0.0138. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-guided electron-density pretraining for learning transferable molecular representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ED-DiT，一种物理引导的扩散Transformer，用于电子密度点云的自监督预训练。通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重建被破坏和部分掩码的对数密度场，并引入电子数一致性约束来保持总电子质量，ED-DiT学习到可迁移的分子表示。在六个EDBench任务上，该方法一致优于从零训练的相同架构，尤其在小样本监督下表现突出。
AI.motivation: 预训练在迁移表示学习中已展现强大潜力，但在基于电子密度的分子学习中尚未被充分探索。电子密度提供了分子电子结构的连续三维描述，能够捕获局部空间模式和全局物理量，因此作者提出关键问题：能否利用电子密度场进行自监督预训练，学习一个可跨多种电子结构相关任务迁移的共享表示。
AI.method: 提出ED-DiT，一个物理引导的扩散Transformer架构。核心方法包括：(1) 在扩散噪声水平上重建被破坏和部分掩码的对数密度场作为自监督预训练任务；(2) 引入电子数一致性约束以保持总电子质量这一物理不变量；(3) 预训练编码器可适配多种下游任务，包括性质预测、开壳层/闭壳层分类、分子-电子密度检索以及分子条件电子密度预测。
AI.result: 在六个EDBench任务上的实验表明，ED-DiT一致优于从零训练的同架构模型，尤其在有限监督条件下优势明显。分子条件电子密度预测任务中，RMSE从2.2474降至1.3753并超越现有基线；在仅使用10%标签时，轨道能量预测RMSE从0.0293改善至0.0138。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了物理引导的电子密度预训练在获得可迁移分子表示方面的有效性，表明电子密度场可以作为自监督预训练的有效数据模态，为电子结构相关的下游任务提供了更强的表示基础。

title: ChartAnno: Evaluating MLLMs for Chart Annotation Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in chart understanding, generation, and editing, but their ability to annotate existing charts remains underexplored. Annotating charts is a common yet challenging communicative task, requiring models to infer intended messages, interpret chart semantics, and place appropriate textual or graphical elements. To address this gap, we introduce ChartAnno, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation. It contains 1,200 real-world charts with paired code and annotation instructions across three levels of instruction specificity. We evaluate 10 representative MLLMs under two primary input settings: (1) chart code alone and (2) both chart code and chart image, and further include a chart image-only ablation study. Results show that proprietary models remain stronger overall, although large-scale open-source models narrow the gap. More specific instructions improve annotation quality, while inferring abstract intent remains most difficult for current MLLMs. Providing chart images brings limited overall gains, with improvements mainly appearing in design-related metrics. These findings highlight chart annotation generation as a challenging task requiring semantic grounding and effective annotation design. Code and data will be released in a future version.
