summary: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world workflows where they act on persistent operational data. Before deployment, these systems need to be verified against business requirements that govern workflow execution and data evolution. However, existing approaches do not provide such system-level guarantees, as they mainly constrain or analyse behaviour at the agent's interface level. We study here the verification of agentic systems comprising a single LLM and a tool orchestration harness over relational operational data. We formalise them as Stateful Tool-Enabled Agentic Deployments (STEADs), give their semantics, define the problem of verifying them against First-Order Computation Tree Logic (FO-CTL) specifications, and show that it is undecidable. We identify sufficient conditions for exact preservation of FO-CTL specifications under a finite-domain restriction, over which verification is PSPACE-complete. The key requirement is that renaming opaque identifiers in the data must correspondingly rename the selected tool calls. We show that LLM-driven agents can violate this condition and introduce a canonical deployment wrapper that guarantees it for arbitrary base agents while preserving already-equivariant behaviour. We prove that computing canonical representations required by this construction is graph-isomorphism-hard. Finally, we illustrate our framework on an LLM agent orchestrating a case-management workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM驱动的智能体系统在部署前的形式化验证问题。作者将这类系统形式化为带状态的工具启用智能体部署（STEADs），给出其语义，并证明对FO-CTL规范的验证问题不可判定；在有限域限制下，若数据中不透明标识符的重命名与工具调用选择一致，则验证为PSPACE-完全。作者提出了保证该条件的规范部署包装器，并证明其计算是图同构困难的。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的智能体系统正被部署到真实工作流中，操作持久化的运营数据。部署前需要验证这些系统是否满足管控业务需求（工作流执行和数据进化）。然而，现有方法主要在智能体接口层面约束或分析行为，无法提供系统层面的保证。
AI.method: 1) 将系统形式化为STEADs（Stateful Tool-Enabled Agentic Deployments），定义其操作语义；2) 定义对FO-CTL规范的可满足性验证问题，证明在一般情形下不可判定；3) 在有限域限制下，识别使得FO-CTL规范精确保持的充分条件（标识符重命名与工具调用选择的一致性）；4) 引入规范部署包装器以保障该条件，证明其计算复杂度为图同构困难；5) 在案例管理工作流上进行实例验证。
AI.result: 验证问题在一般情形下不可判定；在有限域限制下，当重命名不透明标识符会相应重命名所选工具调用时，FO-CTL验证为PSPACE-完全。LLM驱动的智能体可能违反该条件，所引入的规范部署包装器可对任意基础智能体保证该条件同时保持已有的等变行为，但计算规范表示是图同构困难的。
AI.conclusion: 作者为LLM智能体系统的部署前验证奠定了理论基础，明确了可判定性与复杂度的边界，并提供了保证所需性质的可构造方法，尽管其计算代价较高。该框架已在案例管理工作流中展示。

title: MT-Web2Code: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Multi-Turn Regional Reconstruction and Localized Modification
summary: Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in web UI generation. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on single-turn full-page generation from scratch, overlooking the iterative workflow of real-world frontend engineering, where developers repeatedly reconstruct missing regions and modify localized elements within existing codebases. To bridge this gap, we introduce MT-Web2Code, the first multimodal coding benchmark for multi-turn Macro-Level Regional Reconstruction and Micro-Level Localized Modification, which contains 102 tasks spanning 16 vertical domains. To construct deterministic repair trajectories without costly turn-level human annotation, we develop a scalable Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine that iteratively injects structural and stylistic defects into golden pages. We further propose a dual-axis evaluation protocol that measures target-region fidelity and the preservation of unaffected content, where regional reconstruction is assessed by a 5-dimensional VLM-based rubric and localized modification by deterministic pixel-grounded alignment. Experiments on 13 frontier coding agents reveal that current agents struggle to faithfully reconstruct target regions while preserving unaffected content, lack fine-grained visual-code alignment for localized edits, and suffer from error snowballing over multiple turns. Beyond benchmarking, our deterministic evaluation metrics provide fine-grained feedback signals that may facilitate future research on training iterative UI coding agents. Our evaluation code and data will soon be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MT-Web2Code，这是首个面向多轮网页UI编码的基准，涵盖宏层面区域重建与微层面局部修改两类任务，包含16个垂直领域的102个任务，并配套可扩展的反向腐蚀轨迹引擎和双轴评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM基准仅关注单轮全页面生成，忽略了真实前端工程中迭代式的工作流程——开发者在既有代码库中反复重建缺失区域和修改局部元素。这一差距使得现有基准无法评估模型在多轮迭代编码场景中的真实能力。
AI.method: 提出Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine，通过向金标准页面迭代注入结构和风格缺陷来构造确定性的修复轨迹，无需昂贵的逐轮人工标注。同时提出双轴评估协议：(1) 宏层面区域重建采用5维VLM评分标准评估目标区域保真度；(2) 微层面局部修改采用确定性的像素级对齐评估未受影响内容的保持度。
AI.result: 在13个前沿编码智能体上的实验显示：现有智能体难以在忠实重建目标区域的同时保持未受影响内容；缺乏细粒度的视觉-代码对齐能力以进行局部编辑；在多轮任务中遭受错误滚雪球效应。
AI.conclusion: MT-Web2Code弥补了多轮迭代UI编码评估的空白，其确定性评估指标提供了细粒度的反馈信号，有望促进迭代式UI编码智能体的训练研究。

title: ANNOTARES: A Dataset for Extracting Logical Structures from German Statutory Texts
summary: The automatic structural analysis of legal texts is a cornerstone of legal technology, yet the extraction of their logical components remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the task of identifying and segmenting legal conditions (Tatbestand) and legal consequences (Rechtsfolge) within German statutory texts. To support this task, we present ANNOTARES (Annotations of Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge Sequences), a novel dataset comprising German law texts with span-level annotations. Spanning three distinct legal codes, the dataset is designed to evaluate both domain-specific performance and cross-statute generalizability. We benchmark diverse architectural approaches: a rule-based baseline, CRFs, BiLSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF, and modern Transformer-based models, including BERT variants and LLM-based methods. Our results demonstrate that BERT and LLM-based models achieve superior performance in capturing the complex syntactic structures of legal language. We release our dataset to facilitate further research in automated legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出德语法律文本中法律要件（Tatbestand）与法律后果（Rechtsfolge）的识别与分割任务，构建了ANNOTARES数据集（含三个不同法典的跨度级标注），并系统对比了从规则基线、CRF、BiLSTM到BERT和LLM等多种方法，结果表明BERT和LLM类模型在捕捉法律语言复杂句法结构方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 法律文本的自动结构分析是法律技术的基石，但法律文本中逻辑成分（法律要件与法律后果）的提取仍是重大挑战，现有研究缺乏针对该任务的数据集和系统性的方法基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含三个不同德国法典的跨度级标注数据集ANNOTARES；系统性基准测试了多种架构，包括基于规则的方法、CRF、BiLSTM、BiLSTM-CRF，以及现代基于Transformer的模型（BERT变体和基于LLM的方法）。
AI.result: BERT和基于LLM的模型在捕捉法律语言的复杂句法结构方面取得了最优性能；数据集覆盖多个法典，可评估领域特定表现和跨法规泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 发布该数据集以促进自动化法律推理的进一步研究，验证了预训练语言模型在法律文本逻辑结构分析中的有效性。

title: POEM: Phase-Aware $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ Feature Rotation for Time Series Forecasting Under Periodicity Drift
summary: Deep learning has advanced time series forecasting, but periodicity drift, in which cycle timing and phase vary over time, remains a challenging problem. Existing methods predominantly model these sequences on fixed time grids, suffering from a limited ability to accommodate phase-related variation. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{POEM}, a phase-aware forecasting framework based on latent feature rotation using the special orthogonal group in two dimensions, denoted by $\mathrm{SO}(2)$. POEM aims to reduce the phase-related variability by learning a phase-correction coordinate and applying an invertible $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-based rotation to paired latent features. To extrapolate this correction coordinate, Directional Phase Increment Attention (DPIA) retrieves historical phase increments from similar temporal contexts and integrates them into future phase corrections. Experiments demonstrate that POEM achieves competitive performance, while qualitative visualizations suggest that the learned phase-aware transformation makes latent trajectories more regular.

AI.tldr: 提出POEM框架，利用SO(2)特殊正交群的潜在特征旋转来对齐时间序列中的相位漂移问题，通过学习相位校正坐标并用DPIA注意力机制外推相位增量，减少时序预测中的周期时序和相位变化带来的挑战。
AI.motivation: 深度学习方法虽然在时间序列预测中取得了进展，但周期性漂移（周期时序和相位随时间变化）仍然是一个难题。现有方法主要基于固定时间网格建模，难以适应与相位相关的变化，导致预测能力受限。
AI.method: 提出POEM相位感知预测框架，核心包括：(1) 利用二维特殊正交群SO(2)对成对潜在特征施加可逆旋转，学习相位校正坐标以减少相位相关可变性；(2) 提出方向性相位增量注意力（DPIA），从相似时间上下文中检索历史相位增量并整合到未来相位校正中，实现校正坐标的外推。
AI.result: 实验表明POEM取得了具有竞争力的预测性能，定性可视化显示所学习的相位感知变换使得潜在轨迹更加规则化。
AI.conclusion: 通过SO(2)旋转进行相位校正结合DPIA实现相位增量外推，POEM有效缓解了周期性漂移问题，改善了潜在表征的规律性，证明了相位感知建模在时间序列预测中的有效性。

title: Rethinking Modality Reliability in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Observations
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) integrates text, audio, and vision to infer human affect, yet real-world multimodal observations are often incomplete. Existing methods for incomplete-observation MSA mainly follow two paradigms. Reconstruction-based methods recover missing information from observed modalities, while joint-representation methods learn directly from incomplete inputs. Although effective, these methods usually treat modality reliability only implicitly within representation learning or fusion design rather than modeling it explicitly. We argue that modality reliability is a central variable in incomplete-observation settings. Failure to model it explicitly gives rise to two related issues. The first is reliability mismatch, in which the affective evidence retained by each modality varies across samples and missing rates. The second is reliability propagation bias, in which messages from degraded modalities may adversely affect cross-modal interaction and predictive performance. To address these issues, we propose MRCF, a Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework for MSA with incomplete observations. MRCF contains a Reliability-Aware Branch that estimates sample-specific modality reliability from intramodal quality cues and cross-modal semantic consistency, a Reliability-Guided Interaction Branch that uses the estimated scores to modulate cross-modal information flow, and a Reliability-Calibrated Fusion Module that integrates reliability and semantic cues for final prediction. Experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS show that MRCF achieves strong performance under standard incomplete-observation protocols. Further analyses provide evidence that explicit reliability modeling helps mitigate reliability mismatch and reliability propagation bias during interaction and fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出MRCF框架，通过显式建模模态可靠性来解决不完整多模态情感分析中的可靠性失配和可靠性传播偏差两大问题。
AI.motivation: 现有不完整多模态情感分析方法（重建式和联合表征式）通常隐式处理模态可靠性，导致两个问题：一是可靠性失配（各模态保留的情感证据随样本和缺失率变化），二是可靠性传播偏差（退化模态信息在跨模态交互中产生负面影响）。
AI.method: 提出MRCF（Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework），包含三个核心组件：1）Reliability-Aware Branch，从模态内质量线索和跨模态语义一致性估计样本级模态可靠性；2）Reliability-Guided Interaction Branch，用估计的可靠性分数调制跨模态信息流；3）Reliability-Calibrated Fusion Module，整合可靠性和语义线索进行最终预测。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS三个数据集上，MRCF在标准不完整观测协议下取得了强性能。进一步分析表明，显式可靠性建模有助于缓解可靠性和语义融合过程中的可靠性失配及可靠性传播偏差。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模模态可靠性是不完整多模态情感分析中的关键，MRCF通过可靠性感知、引导交互和校准融合三个组件有效解决了现方法的不足，提升了不完整观测下的情感分析性能。

title: From Multi-Resolution Cells to Gigapixel Whole Slide Images Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their hierarchical variants have achieved strong performance in Computational Pathology (CPath). However, most are pre-trained on single-resolution Whole Slide Images (WSIs), limiting their generalization across arbitrary resolutions. Gigapixel WSIs inherently contain diagnostic patterns at multiple scales, including cellular morphologies, tissue architectures, and global context, mirroring how expert pathologists examine WSIs. We introduce Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT), a model that hierarchically aggregates multi-resolution information from cellular to tissue and WSI levels. MRPT employs a biologically meaningful Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) mechanism to capture scale-independent interactions and enforces multi-resolution semantic consistency by aligning embeddings across resolutions, yielding robust and generalizable WSI representations. Pre-trained in a multi-resolution self-supervised manner on 624M patches, 2.4M regions, and 36K WSIs, MRPT learns rich coarse-to-fine histopathology features. Extensive experiments on 34 diverse datasets show that MRPT surpasses recent foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, and Visual Question Answering (VQA) for WSI understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多分辨率金字塔Transformer（MRPT），一种在计算病理学中层级聚合多分辨率信息（从细胞到组织再到全切片）的视觉基础模型，通过连续跨分辨率注意力机制和分辨率间的语义一致性约束，在624M补丁、2.4M区域和36K WSIs上进行多分辨率自监督预训练，在34个数据集上超越现有基础模型和多模态大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有Vision Transformer及其层级变体主要基于单分辨率WSI预训练，难以在不同分辨率下泛化。而千兆像素级WSI天然包含多种尺度的诊断模式（细胞形态、组织结构、全局上下文），类似于病理学家多尺度观察的方式。因此需要一种能够层级聚合多尺度信息的模型。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT)，核心包括：(1) 金字塔式层级结构，从细胞级到组织级再到WSI级聚合多分辨率信息；(2) Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA)机制，用于捕获尺度无关的交互；(3) 跨分辨率嵌入对齐，强制多分辨率语义一致性；(4) 在624M补丁、2.4M区域和36K WSIs上进行多分辨率自监督预训练。
AI.result: 在34个不同数据集上的广泛实验表明，MRPT在癌症亚型分类、组织表型分析和 WSIs 视觉问答（VQA）等任务上均超越了近期的基础模型和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模多分辨率特征并约束其语义一致性，多分辨率预训练能显著提升WSI表征的鲁棒性和泛化能力，为计算病理学提供了一个更强的通用视觉基础模型。

title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
summary: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出逻辑预预训练（Logic-PPT）策略，利用形式推导（formal derivations）作为语言模型的初始化方法，在1000亿token的大规模训练场景下显著加速语言技能习得，并揭示了形式推导诱导的低秩、谱集中的表示几何结构有助于模型压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有预预训练任务（如Dyck语言、过程算法）依赖于狭窄的基元，无法捕捉自然语言的丰富表达能力；且以往研究仅在小规模token预算下进行，难以洞察技能涌现和表示动态。因此需要一种更原理性的初始化策略，以赋予模型更强的结构和语言偏差。
AI.method: 提出逻辑预预训练（Logic-PPT），利用形式推导作为预预训练数据。形式推导需要抽象机制——同时绑定变量、连接量词与关系依赖、在长上下文中组合谓词-论元结构——这些机制与自然语言核心能力高度对齐。将其作为预训练初始化阶段，随后在1000亿token规模下评估下游语言任务。
AI.result: 在1000亿token规模训练下，逻辑预预训练显著加速技能习得：相比标准初始化，在语言任务上以少360亿token达到80%准确率，并优于其他预预训练基线。机制分析显示，形式推导诱导持续的结构重组，产生低秩、谱集中的表示空间；该内部几何结构使模型可通过剪枝实现更好的压缩，即使在约33%稀疏度下仍匹配稠密基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑预预训练是一种有效且原理性的初始化策略，不仅加速语言习得，还通过塑造表示空间的内在几何结构为实现可压缩性（如剪枝）提供了额外优势，为理解预训练表示动态和高效模型部署提供了新视角。

title: CausalOPD: First-Wrong-Step Supervision for Distilling Causal Chain Reasoning
summary: Many critical reasoning tasks, including clinical diagnosis, legal judgment, and industrial fault diagnosis, require step-dependent causal chains in which early errors propagate and correct conclusions can mask invalid reasoning. Although large language models perform well on such tasks, privacy, latency, and controllability motivate distillation into locally deployable models. Standard trajectory imitation does not correct process errors on the student's own rollout distribution. We propose CausalOPD, a curriculum online process distillation framework. A knowledge-augmented teacher first provides trajectories grounded in domain-specific causal rules, entity relations, and structural constraints. The student then generates on-policy trajectories, and the teacher identifies the first wrong step, defined as the earliest transition that verifiably violates available constraints. Starting from the verified prefix, short-horizon reinforcement learning repairs this localized failure. A causal-stage curriculum advances from evidence-level to mechanism-level and conclusion-level errors, following their propagation order. Across three domains, CausalOPD improves average path correctness by 23.4 percentage points over sequence-level online process distillation and reduces the right-label-wrong-reasoning rate from 15.7% to 4.4%. The domain-specific 8B students also surpass both evaluated proprietary references in path correctness across all domains.

AI.tldr: CausalOPD是一个课程式在线过程蒸馏框架，通过知识增强教师识别学生首次错误步骤，并用短视距强化学习修复局部失败，显著提升局部部署模型在因果链推理任务中的路径正确性。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断、法律判决和工业故障诊断等关键推理任务需要逐步依赖的因果链，早期的错误会传播，且正确的结论可能掩盖无效的推理过程。虽然大语言模型在这些任务上表现良好，但隐私、延迟和可控性需求促使模型需要蒸馏到本地部署的小模型中。标准的轨迹模仿无法在学生的自分布上纠正过程错误，因此需要新的蒸馏框架。
AI.method: CausalOPD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 知识增强教师提供基于领域因果规则、实体关系和结构约束的推理轨迹；(2) 学生生成on-policy轨迹后，教师识别首次错误步骤（即最早违反约束的转换），从已验证前缀出发，通过短视距强化学习修复局部失败；(3) 因果级课程推进，按传播顺序从证据级错误到机制级再到结论级错误进行教学。
AI.result: 在三个领域上，CausalOPD相比序列级在线过程蒸馏将平均路径正确性提升了23.4个百分点，并将"标签正确但推理错误"的比例从15.7%降至4.4%。领域特定的8B学生模型在所有领域的路径正确性上超越了两种专有参考模型。
AI.conclusion: CausalOPD通过结合课程学习、在线过程蒸馏和短视距强化学习，有效解决了因果链推理任务中过程错误的传播问题，使小规模局部部署模型在推理路径质量上超越大模型基线。

title: Unequal Verdicts: Investigating Gender Bias in LLM-Based Fake News Detection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated fact-checking, yet their susceptibility to gender bias in this context remains underexplored. This study presents the first systematic investigation of gender bias in LLM-based fake news detection using real-world data. We augment the LIAR benchmark with three gender variants of speaker job titles (Neutral, Male, Female) for each statement to test whether veracity judgments vary solely based on gender presentation. Six state-of-the-art LLMs are evaluated across multiple bias and fairness metrics. All models exhibit gender sensitivity: 9.79%-35.13% of statements receive inconsistent labels across the three variants, with Male-Female comparisons showing 6.5%-23.6% flip rates. Two primary bias manifestations are identified: instability (inconsistent judgments) and directionality (systematic favoritism). Five models show statistically significant directional effects, with the strongest effects displaying male-skeptic patterns. These findings demonstrate that gender bias undermines both reliability and fairness in LLM-based fake news detection, highlighting the need for bias-aware evaluation and mitigation strategies. The augmented dataset is publicly released to support future research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性研究了LLM在假新闻检测中的性别偏见，通过将LIAR基准数据集增强为说话者职位标题的三种性别变体（中性、男性、女性），评估了六个SOTA LLM的表现。结果显示所有模型均表现出性别敏感性，9.79%-35.13%的语句在三种变体间标签不一致，男-女对比的翻转率达6.5%-23.6%。研究识别出两种偏见表现形式：不稳定性（判断不一致）和方向性（系统性偏好），其中五个模型表现出统计显著的方向性效应，最强效应呈现"男性怀疑"模式。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM已被广泛用于自动化事实核查，但该场景下的性别偏见问题尚未被系统探索。事实核查的公正性对公众信任至关重要，而性别偏见会直接损害LLM在此任务中的可靠性与公平性，因此需要系统性的研究与量化。
AI.method: 将LIAR基准数据集中的每一条语句扩展为三种性别变体（中性、男性、女性）的说话者职位标题，在保持陈述内容不变的前提下，仅改变标题的性别呈现方式。随后在六个SOTA LLM上进行评估，使用多种偏见与公平性指标，包括标签不一致率、翻转率以及方向性效应的统计显著性检验。
AI.result: 所有六个模型均表现出性别敏感性：9.79%-35.13%的语句在不同性别变体间标签不一致，男-女对比的翻转率为6.5%-23.6%。识别出两种主要偏见表现形式：不稳定性（inconsistency）和方向性（directionality）。五个模型表现出统计显著的方向性效应，最强效应呈现男性怀疑（male-skeptic）模式。
AI.conclusion: 性别偏见同时损害了LLM在假新闻检测中的可靠性和公平性，凸显了开发偏见感知的评估与缓解策略的必要性。研究发布了增强数据集以支持后续研究。

title: How Many Labels Are Enough? ALDA: Active Learning Deployment Advisor for Medical Image Classification
summary: Active learning (AL) promises to reduce the cost of medical imaging projects by lowering the number of clinical labels required. However, practical deployment requires committing to a sampling strategy before the full annotation budget is spent, and choosing the wrong strategy can increase rather than decrease costs. We propose Active-Learning Deployment Advisor (ALDA), a deployment-oriented framework for AL method selection under clinical performance constraints. Given a short pilot phase, ALDA fits a parametric learning-curve model to each candidate strategy, estimates whether that strategy is expected to reach a required clinical performance target, and predicts the number of expert annotations needed to do so. In addition to absolute annotation cost, ALDA introduces a deployment window that quantifies the sensitivity of this cost estimate to uncertainty in the clinical threshold. The final recommendation follows a risk-aware rule: among strategies with near-optimal predicted cost, ALDA prefers the strategy with the narrowest deployment window, the most robust to threshold revisions. Experiments on four medical imaging classification domains show that ALDA predicts the deployment-optimal method from a pilot of 15-30% of the intended budget and reduces annotation costs by up to 82% compared with a poor strategy choice. Rather than introducing a new sampling heuristic, ALDA provides a practical decision layer that answers a deployment-critical question: how many labels are enough?

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALDA框架，用于在临床性能约束下为主动学习（AL）方法选择提供部署导向的决策支持。ALDA通过短试点阶段拟合学习曲线模型，预测各候选策略达到临床性能目标所需的标注数，并引入"部署窗口"量化成本估计对临床阈值不确定性的敏感度，最终采用风险感知规则推荐最稳健的策略。在四个医学影像分类数据集上，ALDA可从15-30%预算的试点中预测部署最优方法，相比不良策略选择最高减少82%标注成本。
AI.motivation: 主动学习承诺降低医学影像项目的标注成本，但实际部署中必须在完整标注预算花完之前就选定采样策略，而选错策略反而可能增加成本。现有研究缺乏在部署约束下预选AL方法的实用框架，因此需要一个能在试点阶段就对候选策略进行前瞻性评估和选择的决策层。
AI.method: ALDA框架包含以下关键步骤：(1) 在短试点阶段（占预期预算15-30%）对每个候选策略拟合参数化学习曲线模型；(2) 估计每个策略达到临床性能目标的期望概率并预测所需专家标注数量；(3) 引入部署窗口概念，量化标注成本估计对临床阈值不确定性的敏感度；(4) 采用风险感知决策规则：在预测成本接近最优的策略中，优先选择部署窗口最窄、对阈值修订最稳健的策略。
AI.result: 在四个医学影像分类领域上的实验表明，ALDA可以仅从占预期预算15-30%的试点数据中准确预测部署最优的AL方法。相比选择不佳策略所带来的标注成本，ALDA最高可减少82%的标注成本。
AI.conclusion: ALDA并非提出新的采样启发式方法，而是提供了一个实用的决策层，回答了部署关键问题："多少标注才够？"它帮助实践者在标注预算完全消耗之前，做出风险可控的AL策略选择，同时兼顾临床性能目标和成本敏感性。

title: HalluTruthQA-4K: A Fine-Grained Corpus and Annotation Process for Arabic Hallucination Detection and Truth Verification
summary: Large language models can generate fluent Arabic answers while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify and verify. Existing Arabic hallucination resources often assign a binary label to an entire response, indicating whether it is hallucinated or non-hallucinated, but provide limited information about the exact erroneous content, the reason for the error, or the correct factual answer. We present HalluTruthQA-4K, an expanded version of the HalluTruthQA resource containing 4,000 expert-curated Arabic question-answering instances across four knowledge-intensive domains: Islamic knowledge, history, science, and geography. Serving as the official dataset for Track 2 of the HalluScoring 2026 shared task, HalluTruthQA-4K extends our original corpus to 4,000 instances. Each instance pairs an Arabic question with a model-generated response, a verified reference answer, and five plausible distractors. Hallucinated responses are additionally annotated with character-level erroneous spans, human-written explanations, and hierarchical hallucination types. The corpus contains 1,643 hallucinated and 2,357 non-hallucinated responses, with 1,843 annotated erroneous spans. We describe the resource construction and annotation methodology, including question selection, controlled answer generation, candidate construction, expert annotation, independent verification, adjudication, and quality control. We also document the annotation guidelines, taxonomy, data format, inter-annotator agreement, and corpus statistics. HalluTruthQA-4K provides a reusable resource for hallucination detection, span-level error localization, explanation generation, factual verification, and the broader evaluation of factual reliability in Arabic language models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HalluTruthQA-4K，一个扩展的阿拉伯语问答幻觉检测数据集，包含4,000个专家标注实例，覆盖伊斯兰知识、历史、科学和地理四个领域。每个实例包含问题、模型生成回答、参考答案和五个干扰项，幻觉回答额外标注了字符级错误片段、人工解释和分层幻觉类型。该数据集作为HalluScoring 2026共享任务Track 2的官方数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语幻觉资源仅对整条回答做二元标注（幻觉/非幻觉），缺乏对具体错误内容、错误原因和正确答案的细粒度信息，难以支持精确的错误定位和解释生成。
AI.method: 通过问题选择、受控答案生成、候选构建、专家标注、独立验证、仲裁和质量控制等流程构建数据集；开发了包含字符级错误跨度、人工解释和分层幻觉类型的标注体系，并记录了标注指南、分类法、数据格式及标注者间一致性。
AI.result: 数据集包含1,643条幻觉回答和2,357条非幻觉回答，共1,843个标注的字符级错误跨度，涵盖四个知识密集型领域。
AI.conclusion: HalluTruthQA-4K为阿拉伯语大模型的幻觉检测、跨度级错误定位、解释生成和事实验证提供了可复用的细粒度评测资源。

title: DiagLoop: A Counterfactual Data Flywheel with Stage-Localized Reinforcement for Diagnostic LLMs
summary: Causal diagnostic models must explain how conclusions follow from evidence because diagnoses guide repairs and treatments. Yet serious cases are scarce, records rarely contain reasoning paths, and data transfer poorly across configurations, complicating local deployment. We present DiagLoop, a counterfactual data flywheel that converts codified physical relations or clinical guidelines, authored once per mechanism family, into training supervision beyond recorded cases. A training-only teacher proposes counterfactual worlds by varying causes, contexts, and observations, while an independent hybrid checker admits only valid worlds. The student reasons through symptom abstraction, causal-chain construction, and root-cause attribution. Stage-specific criteria identify its earliest failure. For nonterminal failures, a bounded repair probes downstream competence, and the resulting weakness profile guides subsequent data generation. Stage-localized reinforcement learning updates only the model-generated continuation, while replay and preservation reduce forgetting. The same criteria govern admission, attribution, reward, and regeneration through checks separate from the proposer. Using only synthesized scenarios and no case-level expert reasoning annotations, the resulting 8B model improves strict path correctness over the strongest conventional baseline. Gains are 11.6 points across eight industrial systems and 5.5 points across ten disease categories. Gains over a deranged-routing control are 3.9 and 2.3 points, respectively. The model also exceeds the evaluated proprietary references in both domains, even when they receive few-shot examples or the specification in context.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiagLoop，一个反事实数据飞轮框架，利用一次性编码的物理/临床指南生成训练监督数据，通过教师-检查器-学生循环和分阶段RL实现因果诊断推理，仅用合成场景便使8B模型在两个域上超越最强基线和专有参考模型。
AI.motivation: 因果诊断模型必须解释结论如何从证据中得出（因为诊断指导维修和治疗），但严重案例稀缺、记录中缺少推理路径、数据在不同配置下迁移效果差，导致本地部署困难。
AI.method: DiagLoop包含三个核心组件：(1) 训练期教师通过改变原因、上下文和观察来提出反事实世界；(2) 独立的混合检查器仅接纳有效世界；(3) 学生通过症状抽象、因果链构建和根因归因进行推理。分阶段标准识别最早失败点，非终止失败通过有界修复探测下游能力，弱项画像指导后续数据生成。通过分阶段局部RL仅更新模型生成的延续，用回放和保留减少遗忘，检查标准统一管理接纳、归因、奖励和再生成。
AI.result: 仅用合成场景且无需案例级专家推理标注，8B模型在最严格路径正确性上超过最强常规基线：在八个工业系统上提升11.6点，在十个疾病类别上提升5.5点。相对于乱序路由控制分别提升3.9和2.3点。在两种域中均超过评估的专有参考模型，即使后者获得少样本示例或上下文规范。
AI.conclusion: DiagLoop证明了反事实数据飞轮加独立检查机制可以在缺乏真实因果标注的情况下生成高质量训练数据，使较小的开源模型在因果诊断推理上超越专有大模型，为本地部署提供可行路径。

title: Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation: A Closed-Form Attention Jacobian Bound and a Test on a Real Pretrained Model
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Part II of a two-part series; see the companion paper "A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations" (Part I)
summary:
A companion paper studies when activation patching and weight-space ablation agree, inside an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream. For the one composition in that model where two carriers are architecturally dependent, an attention head and its own layer's normalization-MLP composition, it derives an exact first-order interaction formula, zero when only the MLP is ablated and second-order bounded when the head is also ablated. That result is confined to a single residual block and checked only on small transformers on a synthetic task.
  This paper extends the result past both limits. First, the interaction from ablating carriers spanning several layers decomposes exactly into same-block terms, one per touched layer, plus a cross-layer remainder on which the decomposition makes no claim of smallness. Second, we isolate that remainder exactly, for two layers, as a double integral of a mixed second derivative, and name the missing ingredient needed to bound it: a Jacobian bound for the attention sub-block. We derive this bound in closed form and verify it, without a single violation, against Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct's real weights, though we do not yet chain it across layers. We also give, in closed form, the curvature constant the companion paper's bound leaves unexhibited.
  Third, on that same model, we search for and find an emergent circuit for indirect object identification, never designed into it, using the original activation-patching method for this task, and test collapse, dissociation, and interaction on it. The result is mixed: a shared carrier emerges across all five tested instances, collapse and dissociation hold on most but not all, and a nonzero interaction is measurable on three of five, at layer pairs outside the same-block case the companion theorem covers.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了姊妹论文中关于激活修补与权重空间消融一致性的理论结果，将其从单残差块推广到多层，推导出跨层交互的精确分解与余项的双重积分表达式，并在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上封闭形式验证了注意力子块的Jacobian界。同时在该模型上发现了间接宾语识别这一未设计的新兴电路，并对其进行了坍缩、解离与交互测试。
AI.motivation: 姊妹论文在理想化条件计算模型中推导了激活修补与权重空间消融一致性的精确一阶交互公式，但该结果仅限于单个残差块且仅在小型Transformer上验证。本文旨在将此结果推广到多层场景，扩大其适用性，并在真实规模的模型上验证相关理论界，同时探索该理论框架在未设计的新兴电路上的实证表现。
AI.method: 1) 将跨越多个层的载体的消融交互精确分解为每个触及层的同块项加上跨层余项；2) 将两层情形下的余项精确分离为混合二阶导数的双重积分，并指出需要注意力子块的Jacobian界来界定该余项；3) 以封闭形式推导该Jacobian界，并在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的真实权重上逐项验证；4) 补充了姊妹论文未展示的曲率常数；5) 使用原始激活修补方法在该模型上搜寻间接宾语识别的新兴电路，并测试其坍缩、解离与交互性质。
AI.result: 多层交互分解精确成立；跨层余项被精确隔离为双重积分形式；Jacobian界以封闭形式推导并在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的真实权重上无一例违反地通过验证（但尚未跨层链式验证）；曲率常数以封闭形式给出。在间接宾语识别任务上，五个测试实例中均出现共享载体，但坍缩和解离在大部分（非全部）实例上成立，五分之三的实例在姊妹定理未覆盖的层对上测得非零交互。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将交互公式从单层推广到多层，并在真实规模的模型上验证了关键理论界，但跨层余项的链式有界性仍未解决。实证结果显示，新兴电路上的坍缩与解离性质并非完全一致，且存在姊妹定理未覆盖的层间交互，说明理论结果与真实模型行为之间仍有差距，需要进一步研究。

title: Detecting Pose Estimation Failures via Keypoint Self-Consistency
summary: One common approach to pose estimation involves predicting object keypoints in an image, followed by using Perspective-n-Point algorithms to compute the object's rotation and translation relative to the camera. While rotations preserve object shapes, this property is often neglected in keypoint-based pose estimation methods, where keypoints are typically predicted independently from each other. As imprecise keypoint predictions negatively affects pose estimation accuracy, it also limits its reliability in downstream tasks. In this work, we explore whether such inaccurate pose estimates can be identified by simply examining spatial locations between 2D keypoints. We propose a set of hand-crafted geometric features that capture the self-consistency of keypoint predictions, including pairwise distances, reprojection consistency, as well as render and mask consistency. Despite its simplicity, a logistic regression classifier trained on these features reliably detects pose estimation failures, outperforming confidence-based approaches like conformal keypoint predictions that rely solely on keypoint uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用手工设计的几何特征来检测基于关键点的姿态估计中的失败样本。这些特征包括成对距离、重投影一致性和渲染/掩模一致性，用于捕捉关键点预测的自一致性。一个简单的逻辑回归分类器即可可靠地检测姿态估计失败，优于仅依赖关键点不确定性的置信度方法（如共形关键点预测）。
AI.motivation: 基于关键点的姿态估计方法通常独立预测关键点，忽略了旋转保持物体形状这一几何性质，导致不精确的关键点预测会降低姿态估计精度并影响下游任务的可靠性。现有方法缺少对不准确姿态估计的识别手段。
AI.method: 提出一组手工设计的几何特征来捕捉关键点预测的自一致性，包括：(1) 成对距离特征；(2) 重投影一致性特征；(3) 渲染和掩模一致性特征。使用逻辑回归分类器基于这些特征检测姿态估计失败。
AI.result: 仅使用简单的手工几何特征和逻辑回归分类器就能可靠地检测姿态估计失败，性能优于基于置信度的方法，如共形关键点预测（该类方法仅依赖关键点不确定性）。
AI.conclusion: 关键点之间的几何自一致性信息对于检测姿态估计失败具有重要价值，即使采用简单的分类器也能获得优于复杂置信度方法的效果，为姿态估计的可靠性提升提供了低成本方案。

title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
summary: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. The system integrates six main modules (alignment, distance, similarity, search, generation metrics, and BLAST homology search), operating at character, word, token, line, and residue levels. Its C++-based algorithms compile to WebAssembly, so core operations run locally by default without any installation or data upload. The interface reports scores with their "evidence" (alignments, edit paths, metric matches, search hits, and homology traces), making methods inspectable, debuggable, and comparable on shared inputs. Internal benchmarks show speedups of up to 2,500x over the Python predecessor, faster global/local alignment than a general-purpose native C aligner, and exact agreement with independent references under declared settings. For homology search, the scoped client-side blastn path closely matches NCBI BLAST+ rankings and statistics under matched parameters. A curated showcase and Learn mode present canonical algorithms and metrics as reusable demonstrations. string2string Studio is open-source and freely available at string2string.org.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了string2string Studio，一个基于浏览器的交互式字符串到字符串分析平台，支持NLP、计算生物学和数字人文领域，涵盖比对、距离、相似度、搜索、生成度量和BLAST同源搜索六大模块。核心算法由C++编译为WebAssembly，本地运行无需安装或上传数据，性能比Python版本快达2500倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的字符串分析方法通常分散在不同工具中，缺乏统一、可交互、可检查的界面，且许多工具需要安装或上传数据，存在隐私和易用性问题。作者旨在构建一个统一的、可检查的、高性能且保护隐私的字符串到字符串分析平台。
AI.method: 平台采用C++实现核心算法并编译为WebAssembly，在浏览器中本地运行。系统包含六个模块（比对、距离、相似度、搜索、生成度量、BLAST同源搜索），在字符、单词、token、行和残基等不同粒度操作。界面报告分数并附上"证据"（比对结果、编辑路径、度量匹配、搜索命中和同源痕迹），使方法可检查、可调试和可比较。提供精选展示和Learn模式供教学使用。
AI.result: 内部基准测试显示，相比Python版本速度提升高达2500倍；全局/局部比对速度快于通用原生C比对器；在声明的设置下与独立参考精确一致。同源搜索的客户端blastn路径在匹配参数下与NCBI BLAST+的排名和统计量高度一致。
AI.conclusion: string2string Studio是一个开源、免费可用的交互式平台（string2string.org），将高性能、可检查性和用户友好性结合在浏览器环境中，为跨领域的字符串分析提供了完整解决方案。

title: LAEF: A Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation Model Towards Point-of-Care Diagnostics
summary: Point-of-care cardiac devices such as smartwatches and handheld ECG recorders typically capture 1--2 leads, yet existing ECG foundation models are architecturally constrained to fixed 12-lead inputs, degrading or failing under these reduced configurations. We introduce LAEF (Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation), a 7M-parameter ECG foundation model that can natively process any lead subset without zero-padding or architectural modification. LAEF represents ECGs as variable-size spatiotemporal graphs with physiologically motivated intra- and inter-lead connectivity, processed by a Graph Attention Network that scales naturally with active lead count.Pre-trained on 9.2M 12-lead ECGs via masked node modelling with stochastic lead sampling, LAEF learns representations robust to lead configuration. Across 18 downstream datasets, LAEF is on par with specialized 12-lead baselines over 12$\times$ larger at full lead availability. Under direct point-of-care-oriented diagnostics (1--2 leads), it outperforms all zero-padded alternatives on 17 out of 18 datasets with with a single randomly sampled lead and on 14 out of 18 with 2 leads, with an average AUROC gain of +3.2 points. Representation analysis links this advantage to architectural lead-agnosticism, and a lead-importance study across 164 cardiovascular conditions shows population-level performance is stable across single standard input leads while still recovering established clinically lead-condition associations.

AI.tldr: LAEF是一款7M参数的导联无关ECG基础模型，通过将心电图表示为可变大小的时空图并由图注意力网络处理，能够原生支持任意导联子集（如1-2导联的可穿戴设备场景），在18个下游数据集上超越12倍规模的专用基线。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴心脏设备（如智能手表和手持ECG记录仪）通常仅捕获1-2个导联，但现有ECG基础模型架构上被限制为固定的12导联输入，在减少导联配置下性能退化甚至失效。这阻碍了基础模型在院外和即时检测（point-of-care）场景中的应用。
AI.method: LAEF将ECG表示为可变大小的时空图，构建具有生理学依据的导联内（intra-lead）和导联间（inter-lead）连接，由Graph Attention Network处理，其规模随活动导联数自然伸缩。在920万条12导联ECG上通过带随机导联采样的掩码节点建模进行预训练，使模型学习到对导联配置鲁棒的表征。
AI.result: 在18个下游数据集中，LAEF在完整导联可用时与12倍规模的专用12导联基线性能相当。在1-2导联的即时检测诊断场景下，单随机导联时在17/18个数据集上优于所有零填充替代方案，双导联时在14/18上胜出，平均AUROC提升+3.2个点。表示分析揭示了架构导联无关性的优势来源；164种心血管疾病的导联重要性研究显示，群体水平性能在各标准单导联上保持稳定，同时保留了已知的临床导联-疾病关联。
AI.conclusion: LAEF通过图结构化的导联无关设计，有效弥合了12导联基础模型与低导联可穿戴设备之间的鸿沟，在不牺牲全导联性能的前提下实现了对任意导联子集的原生支持，为ECG基础模型在即时检测场景的临床应用提供了可行的架构方案。

title: When Teachers Mislead: Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-Policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising student-sampled trajectories with dense token-level teacher signals. Recent selective OPD methods improve this process by prioritizing signals that are confident, informative, or learnable. However, the assumptions overlook a fundamental failure mode of language models: their token-level judgments can be driven by input-agnostic language priors, formatting conventions, or stereotyped reasoning templates rather than task-specific evidence. We refer to such optimization-relevant but weakly input-grounded supervision as spurious signals in OPD, which may produce large gradients while contributing little task-improving direction. To mitigate this issue, we propose SA-OPD, a Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation framework that identifies and filters misleading token-level supervision based on input-groundedness and optimization impact. SA-OPD introduces a lightweight input-groundedness proxy estimating whether a token-level distillation signal truly depends on the input. It then filters only tokens that simultaneously exhibit low input-groundedness and extreme distillation divergence, thereby removing high-impact spurious updates and achieving fine-grained OPD optimization. Extensive experiments on both large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) settings demonstrate that SA-OPD consistently outperforms Vanilla OPD and competitive selective methods. These results establish input-groundedness as a key dimension for OPD supervision selection and offer a simple, effective strategy for mitigating spurious updates.

AI.tldr: 提出SA-OPD框架，通过检测输入接地性（input-groundedness）和优化影响来识别并过滤蒸馏信号中的虚假信号（spurious signals），提升On-Policy蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性OPD方法关注信号的置信度、信息量或可学习性，但忽略了语言模型token级判断可能由与输入无关的语言先验、格式惯例或刻板推理模板驱动，这类虚假信号会产生大梯度但缺乏任务改善方向，损害蒸馏效果。
AI.method: SA-OPD引入轻量级输入接地性代理来估计token级蒸馏信号是否真正依赖输入，然后仅过滤同时满足低输入接地性和极端蒸馏分歧两个条件的token，从而去除高影响的虚假更新，实现细粒度的OPD优化。
AI.result: 在LLM和VLM两种设置下的大量实验表明，SA-OPD一致优于Vanilla OPD和有竞争力的选择性方法。
AI.conclusion: 输入接地性应当成为OPD监督选择的key维度，SA-OPD提供了一种简单有效的缓解虚假更新策略。

title: GVCCTurbo: Rate-Compute Quality Scheduling for Codebook Driven Generative Compression
summary: Codebook-driven generative compression uses a pretrained image or video generator as a zero-shot visual prior and transmits compact codebook indices to guide reconstruction at ultra-low bitrate. Current codecs tie each finite-rate correction to a fresh prior evaluation, so shortening the sampler also removes correction slots that carry target-dependent information. We propose GVCCTurbo, a BPP-driven scheduler that separates expensive prior refreshes from codebook corrections: after calibrating an atom-count operating point and skip-gap ratio once per protocol, it maps a target codebook-payload bitrate to a trajectory length and refresh period, making BPP a schedule input instead of a fixed consequence of sampler length. The same endpoint-prediction and finite-rate steering interface covers GVCC-style rectified-flow video and DDCM-style diffusion image compression, preserving zero-training deployment and compatibility with future distilled priors. Native 1080p curves position the complete zero-shot codec in the ultra-low-bitrate regime. In a controlled 720p Wan-GVCC study, the scheduler cuts prior evaluations from 20 to 9 for a $\sim\!44\%$ measured decoding-time reduction shared across the whole schedule family, at a small shared LPIPS cost on high-motion content; within that family, uniform refresh thinning (pure-skip) is a boundary point, and the BPP-aware interior point trades $2.9\%$ fewer codebook-payload bits for consistently higher PSNR at comparable LPIPS. These results support BPP-to-compute scheduling as a controllable extension of sampler-length tuning, without requiring the allocated point to dominate every boundary point.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GVCCTurbo，一种BPP驱动的调度器，将昂贵的先验刷新与码本校正解耦，使比特率(BPP)成为调度输入而非采样器长度的固定结果，在超低比特率下显著降低计算开销并保持重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有码本驱动生成式压缩编解码器将每个有限率校正与一次新的先验评估绑定，缩短采样器会同时移除携带目标相关信息的校正槽位，导致难以在低比特率下兼顾计算效率与重建质量。需要一种将比特率与计算调度解耦的机制。
AI.method: 提出BPP驱动的调度器GVCCTurbo：每个协议仅校准一次原子计数工作点和跳步间隔比，随后将目标码本载荷比特率映射为轨迹长度和刷新周期；统一端点预测与有限率引导接口，兼容GVCC风格的整流流视频压缩和DDCM风格的扩散图像压缩，保持零训练部署。
AI.result: 在720p Wan-GVCC受控实验中，调度器将先验评估次数从20次降至9次，解码时间减少约44%；BPP感知的内部点相比纯跳步边界点少用2.9%码本载荷比特，同时在可比LPIPS下持续获得更高PSNR。原生1080p曲线定位于超低比特率区间。
AI.conclusion: BPP到计算量的调度可作为采样器长度调优的可控扩展，无需调度点支配所有边界点即可获得优势，为零训练部署的超低比特率生成式压缩提供了更高效的计算-质量权衡方案。

title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
summary: We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling underflows floating-point precision, which zeroes out a large fraction of attention weights and renders the affected attention heads partially blind. We analyze this failure mode, characterize its impact, and examine four mitigation strategies. We further demonstrate its occurrence in state-of-the-art pretrained models based on ALiBi. Comprehensive pretraining experiments with 148M-parameter decoder models help us to disentangle its effects from out-of-context degradation. We find that ALiBi's failure mode can substantially impair token retrieval while having only a minor effect on standard decoder benchmarks. We propose four training-time mitigation strategies and evaluate them individually and in combinations, finding that log-scaled distances yield the most consistent improvements in passkey retrieval. Despite this problem, default ALiBi slopes remain a surprisingly strong baseline, particularly for needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Based on these findings we provide concrete recommendations on how to train models with ALiBi.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了ALiBi位置编码的一个被忽视的失败模式：其线性偏置缩放在浮点精度下发生下溢，导致大量注意力权重被清零，使受影响的注意力头部分"失明"。通过在148M参数的解码器模型上的综合预训练实验，发现该问题会严重损害token检索能力，但对标准解码器基准影响较小；提出的对数缩放距离缓解策略在passkey检索上表现最稳定。
AI.motivation: ALiBi（Attention with Linear Biases）位置编码被广泛使用，但其线性偏置缩放在长上下文场景下可能因浮点下溢而导致注意力权重被错误清零，这一失败模式此前未被系统研究。作者希望深入理解这一问题的成因、影响范围，并探索可行的缓解方案。
AI.method: 首先分析ALiBi线性偏置缩放下溢的机理，评估其对注意力权重的冲击；随后在148M参数解码器模型上开展全面的预训练实验，将失败模式的影响与out-of-context退化效应分离；提出四种训练时缓解策略（含log缩放距离），并分别及组合评估其在token检索和标准基准上的效果。
AI.result: ALiBi失败模式会显著损害passkey检索（token检索）能力，但对标准解码器基准影响很小；在四种缓解策略中，log缩放距离在passkey检索上带来最一致的改进；尽管存在此缺陷，默认ALiBi斜率在needle-in-a-haystack检索中仍是令人意外强的基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于实验发现，作者给出了使用ALiBi训练模型的具体建议：需警惕线性偏置下溢导致的注意力头部分失明问题，并推荐采用log缩放距离作为改进方案，同时保留默认ALiBi斜率作为稳健基线。

authors: Nelson Aloysio Reis de Almeida Passos
title: Learning and Clustering on Temporal Graphs: Principles, Primitives, and Pooling
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 (Nectar Track)
summary: This work focuses on the problem of learning on temporal graphs, with particular emphasis on the task of clustering: obtaining coarse-grained representations by aggregating information from nodes, edges, and temporal dynamics - a task related to pooling in machine learning on graphs, or community detection in network science. Although graph neural networks reach state-of-the-art performance across many downstream graph tasks, their advantage over established descriptive and inferential clustering algorithms is far less settled, especially under demands of efficiency and recovery accuracy. We frame this tension through three linked perspectives: principles, connecting graph learning and community detection through shared spectral foundations and detectability thresholds in stochastic block model regimes; primitives, making spectral clustering and multislice modularity optimization tractable through GPU-accelerated temporal backends; and pooling, viewing principled community detection as a theory-grounded coarse-graining operator for temporal graphs. Our results indicate that algorithmic methods remain the appropriate tool where attributes are absent or weak - scalability rather than accuracy being the binding obstacle - while neural models are most compelling when structural, temporal, and attribute signals align. By making temporal clustering scalable, GPU-accelerated primitives suggest a route toward theory-grounded pooling, while raising a central question: when does community-based coarse-graining preserve the dynamics needed for downstream learning tasks?

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了时序图上的聚类/粗粒度化问题，从理论原理（谱基础与可检测性阈值）、计算原语（GPU加速的时态聚类算法）和池化算子（将社区检测作为图池化）三个视角对比了图神经网络与传统算法方法的优劣，指出传统算法在缺乏属性信号时仍是最优选择，而神经网络在结构-时序-属性信号对齐时更具优势。
AI.motivation: 尽管图神经网络在众多下游图任务上达到SOTA性能，但在聚类/粗粒度化任务上，其相较于传统描述性和推断性聚类算法的优势并不明确，尤其在效率和恢复准确性要求下。作者希望通过三个关联视角（原理、原语、池化）系统梳理这一张力，澄清两种范式各自适用的场景。
AI.method: 论文从三个层面展开分析：(1) 原理层面——通过谱基础和随机块模型（SBM）下的可检测性阈值将图学习与社区检测联系起来；(2) 原语层面——通过GPU加速的时态后端使谱聚类和多切片模块度优化变得可计算；(3) 池化层面——将基于理论的社区检测视为时序图上的有理论依据的粗粒度化/池化算子。
AI.result: 结果表明：当节点属性缺失或较弱时，传统算法方法仍是更合适的选择——此时瓶颈是可扩展性而非准确性；而神经网络模型在结构、时序和属性信号对齐时最能发挥优势。此外，GPU加速的时序聚类原语为实现有理论基础的池化提供了可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一个核心开放问题：社区驱动的粗粒度化在何种条件下能保留下游学习任务所需的动力学信息？这为未来时序图池化研究指明了方向，即需要建立社区检测与图表示学习之间更坚实的理论桥梁。

title: Is Inter-Seed Cross-Play Enough? Evaluating the Robustness of Zero-Shot Coordination Algorithms to Implementation Details
summary: AI agents deployed in real-world settings must be capable of coordinating with humans and other AI agents they have not encountered before. Zero-shot coordination (ZSC) algorithms aim to achieve this by specifying high-level learning rules such that independently engineered agents can coordinate with each other at test time. Rigorous evaluation of ZSC algorithms remains difficult: ideally, multiple independent implementations of each proposed algorithm must be used, reflecting the variation that arises when independent parties interpret and implement the same specification. In practice, however, ZSC algorithms have almost exclusively been evaluated using a single implementation trained across different random seeds, with only a handful of works additionally varying the neural network architecture. This leaves open questions about robustness to specification ambiguities and implementation details. In this work, we provide the first systematic evaluation of this robustness. We introduce a new evaluation scheme, cross-implementation cross-play, varying implementation details that prior work has shown to affect the performance of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms, and we evaluate Other-Play, a popular ZSC algorithm, with this scheme. Our findings are encouraging and suggest that, for Other-Play, the standard ZSC evaluation is, in fact, a reasonable proxy for this more thorough cross-implementation evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了零样本协调（ZSC）算法对实现细节差异的鲁棒性，提出了"跨实现跨博弈"（cross-implementation cross-play）评估方案，并发现标准ZSC评估实际上可以作为更彻底的跨实现评估的合理代理。
AI.motivation: ZSC算法旨在使独立设计的AI智能体在测试时能与未见过的智能体（包括人类和其他AI）协调。然而现有ZSC算法的评估几乎都只使用单一实现配合不同随机种子训练，很少改变神经网络架构，这忽略了实现规范中歧义和实现细节带来的不确定性，关于算法对规范歧义和实现细节鲁棒性的问题尚未解答。
AI.method: 提出了一个新的评估方案——cross-implementation cross-play，系统性地变化先前研究中已知影响多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法性能的实现细节，并以此方案评估了流行的ZSC算法Other-Play。
AI.result: 评估结果令人鼓舞：对于Other-Play算法，标准的ZSC评估方法实际上是更彻底的跨实现评估的一个合理代理，表明该算法对实现细节的差异具有一定的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 标准ZSC评估在实践中可作为跨实现评估的有效替代方案，这对ZSC领域的研究者具有实际指导意义，但该结论目前仅针对Other-Play这一具体算法，未来需要在更广泛的ZSC算法上进行验证。

title: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition
summary: In organic chemistry papers and patents, molecular structures, reaction schemes, and experimental conditions are often presented as molecular structure depictions, reaction diagrams, and complex tables or figures. Such information is difficult for general-purpose document parsing systems to directly convert into machine-readable data. This limits data production for organic chemistry knowledge base construction and for AI for Chemistry tasks such as reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, condition recommendation, molecular property prediction, and drug molecule design. This report introduces MinerU.Chem, a document parsing system for organic chemistry literature integrated into the MinerU online platform. Built on top of MinerU's general document parsing pipeline, MinerU.Chem adds five chemistry-specific modules: chemistry relevance filtering, molecular structure detection, molecule identifier extraction, molecular structure recognition, and reaction scheme parsing. Together, these modules convert organic-chemistry-related image regions in documents into a Molecule Summary List and a Reaction Summary List. For molecular structure recognition, MinerU.Chem uses CARBON (Complex Atomic Representation and Bonding Object Notation) as its core representation. CARBON enables recognition results to preserve both the visual layout of the original image and complex chemical semantics, while supporting the export of standard downstream formats such as MolFile and SMILES. On the SMILES-evaluable subset of MolRecBench-Wild (N=2,392), MinerU.Chem's molecular structure recognition module achieves a SMILES exact-match accuracy of 93.02%, outperforming the best evaluated comparison system, GPT-5.6-Sol (74.87%), by 18.15 percentage points. The system has been integrated into the MinerU online platform and is available at https://mineru.net/OpenSourceTools/Extractor .

AI.tldr: MinerU.Chem是一个集成在MinerU在线平台上的有机化学文献文档解析系统，在通用文档解析管道之上增加了五个化学专用模块（化学相关性过滤、分子结构检测、分子标识符提取、分子结构识别和反应方案解析），将文档中的化学图像区域转换为分子摘要列表和反应摘要列表。其分子结构识别基于CARBON表示，支持导出MolFile和SMILES等标准格式，在MolRecBench-Wild子集上SMILES精确匹配准确率达93.02%，大幅超越对比系统GPT-5.6-Sol（74.87%）。
AI.motivation: 有机化学文献中的分子结构、反应方案和实验条件以图像和复杂表格呈现，通用文档解析系统难以直接转换为机器可读数据，限制了有机化学知识库建设和AI for Chemistry任务（如反应预测、逆合成、条件推荐、分子性质预测和药物分子设计）的数据生产。
AI.method: 在MinerU通用文档解析管道之上构建五个化学专用模块：化学相关性过滤、分子结构检测、分子标识符提取、分子结构识别（基于CARBON表示，既保留原始图像视觉布局又保留复杂化学语义）、反应方案解析。最终将化学图像区域转为Molecule Summary List和Reaction Summary List，并支持导出MolFile、SMILES等下游标准格式。
AI.result: 在MolRecBench-Wild的SMILES可评估子集（N=2,392）上，MinerU.Chem的分子结构识别模块SMILES精确匹配准确率达93.02%，比最佳对比系统GPT-5.6-Sol（74.87%）高出18.15个百分点。系统已集成到MinerU在线平台并公开可用。
AI.conclusion: MinerU.Chem有效解决了有机化学文献中结构化数据自动提取的难题，在分子结构识别准确性上显著领先现有系统，为有机化学知识库构建和AI for Chemistry下游任务提供了可靠的数据生产工具。

title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
summary: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain preferences, task histories, tool routines, and learned skills across sessions. Yet whether retained experience actually improves them over time has not been systematically tested. We introduce PAST-Bench, a benchmark designed to isolate this question. Each agent runs through ordered sequences of fresh-session tasks under matched conditions that turn retained experience on and off. It spans 26 scenarios and 204 episodes across memory, procedural reuse, information gathering, and update. We report both later-task gains and whether those gains follow the intended save, retrieve, and update pathway. Across seven base models and four agent frameworks, improvement is real but uneven across capabilities. Agents with the same headline gain can differ markedly in whether that gain is supported by evidence of the intended pathway. Guided by these findings, we develop Hermes+, which extends Hermes with five targeted interventions across stages of the agent loop. Hermes+ raises the average gain from retained experience and provides clearer pathway evidence, with its strongest improvement on tasks requiring outdated state to be replaced, although the effect remains capability- and model-dependent. Together, PAST-Bench and Hermes+ provide an evaluation and diagnostic foundation for studying how persistent agents can progress from retaining experience to systematically improving through it. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench

AI.tldr: 作者提出PAST-Bench基准，专门用于隔离测试个人AI智能体是否真正从保留的跨会话经验中改进。实验覆盖7个基础模型和4个智能体框架，发现改进真实存在但不均衡且路径证据缺失。基于此开发Hermes+，在智能体循环各阶段加入五项干预，提高了平均增益并提供更清晰的路径证据。
AI.motivation: 个人AI智能体会在跨会话中保留偏好、任务历史、工具例程和技能，但保留的经验是否真的能随时间提升其行为表现，此前从未被系统性测试过。作者希望系统性隔离并验证这一递归自我改进的核心问题。
AI.method: PAST-Bench包含26个场景和204个回合，通过配对条件开关保留经验，在记忆、程序复用、信息收集和更新四类能力上测量后续任务增益，并追踪"保存-检索-更新"路径证据。基于诊断结果，Hermes+在智能体循环的不同阶段引入五项针对性干预。
AI.result: 在7个基础模型和4个框架下，改进真实存在但不均衡；相同表观增益的智能体在路径证据上可能差异显著。Hermes+提升平均增益并提供更清晰的路径证据，在需要替换过期状态的任务上改进最强，但效果仍依赖能力和模型。
AI.conclusion: PAST-Bench和Hermes+共同为研究持久智能体如何从"保留经验"走向"系统化通过经验改进"提供了评估与诊断基础。

title: To Describe or Construct Statistical Learning Models Using the Category-theoretical Language
summary: Statistical learning is a fascinating field that has long been the mainstream of machine learning/artificial intelligence. A large number of results have been produced which can be widely applied to real-world problems. It also leads to many research topics and also stimulates new research. This report summarizes some classical statistical learning models and well-known algorithms, especially for amateurs, and provides a category-theoretic perspective on understanding statistical learning models. The aim is to attract researchers from other fields, including basic mathematics, to participate in the research related to statistical learning.

AI.tldr: 本文简要介绍了统计学习领域中的经典模型和著名算法，并从范畴论（category theory）的角度为理解统计学习模型提供了新的视角，旨在吸引包括基础数学在内的其他领域研究者参与统计学习的相关研究。
AI.motivation: 统计学习作为机器学习和人工智能的主流方向，已产生大量可应用于实际问题的成果，但作者希望吸引其他领域（特别是基础数学）的研究者参与统计学习相关研究，因此需要提供一个清晰的概述和跨学科的理解框架。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性报告，首先总结了经典的统计学习模型和知名算法（面向初学者），然后引入范畴论作为分析工具，为理解统计学习模型提供了一种类范畴的抽象视角。
AI.result: 文章提供了一份面向初学者的统计学习经典模型与算法汇总，并提出了一种基于范畴论视角的统计学习理解方式，作为连接统计学习与基础数学研究者的桥梁性工作。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望通过这篇报告降低统计学习的入门门槛，并借助范畴论的抽象视角激发其他领域研究者的兴趣，从而促进统计学习与基础数学等领域的交叉研究。

title: AutoSND: From Execution Evidence to Structural Policies for Automated Network Dismantling Heuristic Discovery
summary: Network dismantling is fundamental to analyzing the robustness and vulnerability of complex systems, yet practical heuristics must balance effectiveness and computational efficiency, and are usually designed manually by researchers. Existing large language model based automatic heuristic design methods can generate and screen candidates, yet they have difficulty further transforming candidate quality or failure states during execution into structural-level guid- ance for subsequent generation. We propose AutoSND, a three stage tree search framework for complete network dismantling pro- grams. Stage I broadly explores from simple heuristics and archives execution evidence. Stage II compiles candidate records into struc- tural policies concerning local signals, neighborhood access, and state update ranges. Stage III continues tree search conditioned on these policies and obtains the final quality prioritized and speed prioritized candidates, AutoSND-Q/S. Experiments on 12 real world networks and 3 large real world networks show that AutoSND achieves better search performance and stability and discovers more competitive and structurally interpretable network disman- tling programs. The final candidates form an interpretable structure that uses residual degree as the backbone, adjusts node order with bounded local signals, and restricts the state update range. Code is available at https://github.com/MirrorNew/AutoSND.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoSND，一种三阶段树搜索框架，用于自动设计完整的网络拆解（network dismantling）程序，能够将候选方案在运行过程中的成功与失败状态转化为结构化策略，指导后续搜索，最终生成质量优先和速度优先的候选方案（AutoSND-Q/S），在12个真实网络和3个大规模真实网络上表现出更优的搜索性能和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 网络拆解是分析复杂系统鲁棒性和脆弱性的基础任务，但实际启发式算法需要在效果与计算效率之间权衡，且通常由研究者手工设计。现有基于大语言模型的自动启发式设计方法虽然能生成和筛选候选方案，但难以将执行过程中的候选质量或失败状态转化为结构化层面的指导信息以供后续生成使用，导致搜索效率有限。
AI.method: AutoSND采用三阶段树搜索框架：第一阶段从简单启发式出发广泛探索并存档执行证据；第二阶段将候选记录编译为涉及局部信号、邻域访问和状态更新范围的结构化策略；第三阶段基于这些策略继续树搜索，最终获得质量优先的AutoSND-Q和速度优先的AutoSND-S候选方案。
AI.result: 在12个真实网络和3个大规模真实网络上的实验表明，AutoSND相比基线方法取得了更好的搜索性能和稳定性，能够发现更具竞争力且结构可解释的网络拆解程序。最终候选方案形成了一种可解释结构：以残差度（residual degree）为骨干，用有界局部信号调整节点顺序，并限制状态更新范围。
AI.conclusion: AutoSND通过三阶段树搜索框架有效解决了LLM自动启发式设计中候选质量与失败状态难以转化为结构化指导的问题，生成的可解释、高性能网络拆解程序验证了该方法的有效性，并为自动算法设计提供了新的范式。

title: IRIS: Visual-Semantic Binding for Forgery-Resistant Watermarking of Diffusion Images
summary: Most in-generation diffusion watermarks embed patterns independent of the image that carries them, and attackers transplant the marks onto images the generator did not produce, resulting in forgery. Binding the mark to visual semantics prevents such transplantation, yet existing bindings anchor to a proxy image rather than the image they mark. Realizing visual-semantic binding inside generation faces two challenges. The mark derives from the image itself yet enters the sampling trajectory before that image exists, and may itself shift the semantics it binds. The binding also meets opposite sensitivity demands, breaking under semantic change while holding through common processing. We present IRIS, a training-free watermarking scheme that embeds an Intrinsic Ring Identifier from Semantics. IRIS reads a content code from the non-watermarked generated image, derives a one-time ring from the code and a secret key, returns to the final low-noise steps of the same trajectory and blends the ring in, after the semantics it binds are settled. To meet the opposite sensitivity demands, the code is read through a canonicalization shared between embedding and detection, holding through common distortions and mild regeneration while flipping under semantic change. Detection recomputes the ring from the query image and the key alone, and the mark therefore fails on a foreign or spliced image, with acceptance tracking semantic displacement. On three prompt datasets IRIS detects reliably and stays close to its same-seed non-watermarked counterpart, a fidelity prior in-generation marks do not reach. While forgeries transfer fixed-pattern marks and regeneration strips post-hoc marks, IRIS alone among the compared marks withstands both.

AI.tldr: IRIS是一种无需训练的扩散模型水印方案，它从非水印生成图像中读取内容码，与密钥共同推导出一次性环形标记，在采样轨迹的最后低噪声步骤将其融合回图像中，实现视觉语义绑定的水印嵌入。检测时仅需从查询图像重算环形并配合密钥，即可在语义改变时失效并防止伪造移植。
AI.motivation: 现有生成水印大多嵌入与图像内容无关的固定模式，攻击者可将其移植到生成器未产生的图像上造成伪造。虽然将水印与视觉语义绑定可防止移植，但现有的绑定方法锚定在代理图像而非被标记图像本身，且生成过程中实现视觉语义绑定存在两大困难：水印源于图像本身却需在图像存在前进入采样轨迹，且水印可能改变其所绑定的语义；同时绑定需要满足相反的敏感性需求——语义变化时断裂、常见处理下保持稳定。
AI.method: IRIS从非水印的生成图像中读取内容码，由内容码与密钥推导一次性环形标记（one-time ring），再回到同一采样轨迹的最后低噪声步骤，在语义已确定后将该环形融合入图像中。为满足相反的敏感性需求，内容码通过嵌入与检测共享的规范化（canonicalization）机制读取，使其在常见扰动和轻度再生下保持、语义改变时翻转。检测时仅凭查询图像与密钥重算环形，陌生图像或拼接图像上水印失效，接收度随语义位移变化。
AI.result: 在三个提示数据集上，IRIS检测可靠，且与同种子无水印版本保持接近的保真度，达到了现有生成前水印（in-generation marks）无法实现的保真水平。在伪造转移固定模式水印和再生去除后置水印两种攻击下，IRIS是所比较的水印方案中唯一同时抵抗二者的方法。
AI.conclusion: IRIS通过内容码派生一次性环形并将标记嵌入到语义已稳固的轨迹末端，成功实现了真正绑定于被标记图像本身的视觉语义水印；它既能抵御伪造移植又能抵抗再生剥离，在可靠性、保真度与鲁棒性之间取得了现有方法未能达到的平衡。

title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the states actually visited by the agent. Moreover, token-level supervision fails to capture the turn-level structure of tool interactions. To address this, we propose TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that derives supervision directly from execution-conditioned hindsight. It then constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons and selects reliable supervision through cross-horizon directional agreement. Finally, the selected hindsight signal is normalized across sibling rollouts and used to adaptively modulate RL advantages while preserving their original optimization direction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of TurnSight. Our codes are available at https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight.

AI.tldr: 提出了TurnSight，一个基于回合级事后自我蒸馏的框架，通过执行条件的事后监督、跨视野方向一致性选择可靠信号，并在同层rollout间归一化后自适应调制RL优势，解决长视野工具集成推理中细粒度信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法在长视野TIR场景中依赖轨迹级监督，难以进行细粒度信用分配。已有的on-policy自我蒸馏方法虽能提供更密集信号，但其上下文通常来自ground-truth答案或检索技能，无法反映agent实际访问的状态。此外，token级监督无法捕捉工具交互的回合级结构。
AI.method: TurnSight框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 从执行条件的事后视角（execution-conditioned hindsight）直接推导回合级监督；(2) 构建多个不同前瞻视野（lookahead horizon）的事后视图，通过跨视野方向一致性（cross-horizon directional agreement）筛选可靠监督；(3) 将选定的事后信号在同层rollout（sibling rollouts）间归一化，用于自适应调制RL优势，同时保持原始优化方向。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的广泛实验验证了TurnSight的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TurnSight通过回合级事后自我蒸馏提供了更细粒度的信用分配信号，有效解决了长视野工具集成推理中的监督稀疏与结构感知缺失问题。

title: Amortized Interventional Forecasting for Multivariate CIR Processes
summary: Mean-reverting dynamics are pervasive in finance, and the Cox--Ingersoll--Ross (CIR) process is a standard model for the time series they produce, from short rates to credit default swap (CDS) spreads. Yet CIR models capture only \emph{correlated} co-movement, not \emph{causal} influence between series, so they cannot answer the system's response when one series is externally shocked, which observational conditionals confound with historical co-movement. We make two contributions. First, an amortized model for distributional causal effect estimation that frames trajectories as time-stamped observations and predicts the calibrated multi-horizon shock response without retraining per scenario. Second, a causal multivariate CIR data-generating process that supplies the paired observational and interventional ground truth that real markets cannot. We instantiate and calibrate the framework on CDS spreads as a testbed. CIR-ACTIVA's validity is established on synthetic ground truth, independent of how well the simulator matches reality, while practical grounding is assessed by backtesting the generated traces against real CDS data. Against observational and amortized causal-inference baselines, CIR-ACTIVA leads on both causal selectivity in the joint distribution and horizon-resolved calibration, retaining its selectivity once the interventional law varies over the horizon, with gains concentrating at short horizons. This opens up a class of what-if queries on coupled spread systems, CDS stress testing among them, that observational forecasters cannot answer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIR-ACTIVA框架，结合一个可摊销的分布因果效应估计模型与一个因果多元CIR数据生成过程，用于在信贷违约互换（CDS）利差系统中估计多时域的外生冲击响应，解决了CIR模型只能捕捉相关联动而无法回答因果"what-if"问题这一局限。
AI.motivation: CIR过程是金融中建模均值回归时间序列的标准模型，但它只能刻画序列间的相关联动，无法揭示系统在某一序列受到外部冲击时的因果反应。观测条件分布会将历史联动与因果效应混为一谈，导致传统预测模型无法回答CDS利差压力测试等what-if问题。因此需要一个能够估计分布因果效应的框架，并需要在真实市场无法提供配对干预数据的情况下构造可验证的合成数据生成过程。
AI.method: 作者提出两个核心贡献：（1）一个摊销式的分布因果效应估计模型，将轨迹视为带时间戳的观测，无需针对每个场景重新训练即可预测经过校准的多时域冲击响应；（2）一个因果多元CIR数据生成过程，用于生成配对的观测数据与干预数据作为真实市场无法提供的ground truth。框架以CDS利差作为测试平台进行实例化与校准，并通过合成ground truth验证有效性，用真实CDS数据回测生成轨迹以评估实际贴合度。
AI.result: 在与观测基线及摊销因果推断基线对比中，CIR-ACTIVA在联合分布的因果选择性以及按时域分辨的校准性上均领先；当干预律随时间域变化时仍能保持选择性，且在短时域上收益最为集中。
AI.conclusion: 该框架开辟了一类针对耦合利差系统的what-if查询，包括CDS压力测试，这是传统观测预测模型无法回答的问题。

title: Taming the Implicit: Dual-Channel Risk-Aware Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Continual Multimodal Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is widely believed to inherently resist catastrophic forgetting in continual post-training of multimodal large language models. Under pronounced task distributional shifts, however, forgetting across representative RFT algorithms escalates sharply. This stems from the implicit reward-variance regularization inherent to RFT, which proves incapable of suppressing uncontrolled optimization risk. We propose Risk-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), the first dual-channel framework for explicit risk governance in continual RFT. On the policy channel, Risk-Aware Policy Scaling adaptively calibrates per-sample update magnitude via rollout reliability and Fisher-inspired local predictive sensitivity; on the data channel, Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling reorganizes training batches through dynamic risk stratification, steering optimization toward informative yet stable samples. As a plug-and-play strategy requiring no cross-task memory, RAPO generalizes to any RFT algorithm without modification. On the public MLLM-CL benchmark, RAPO reduces final forgetting by 79.8% relative to its RLOO backbone while retaining new-task competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出风险感知策略优化（RAPO），这是首个用于持续强化微调（RFT）中显式风险治理的双通道框架。RAPO通过策略通道的风险感知策略缩放和数据通道的风险感知动态桶采样，在任务分布剧烈偏移下显著抑制灾难性遗忘，在MLLM-CL基准上较RLOO基线减少79.8%的最终遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有观点认为强化微调（RFT）天然抵抗多模态大语言模型持续后训练中的灾难性遗忘，但在剧烈任务分布偏移下，代表性RFT算法的遗忘显著加剧。其根源在于RFT固有的隐式奖励方差正则化无法抑制失控的优化风险，因此亟需显式的风险治理机制。
AI.method: 提出双通道框架RAPO：在策略通道上，风险感知策略缩放利用 rollout 可靠性和Fisher启发的局部预测敏感性自适应校准每个样本的更新幅度；在数据通道上，风险感知动态桶采样通过动态风险分层重组训练批次，将优化导向信息丰富且稳定的样本。该方法为即插即用策略，无需跨任务记忆，可推广至任意RFT算法而无需修改。
AI.result: 在公开的MLLM-CL基准上，RAPO相较其RLOO骨干将最终遗忘降低79.8%，同时保持新任务的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RAPO证明了通过显式风险治理可以有效解决持续RFT中因任务分布偏移引发的灾难性遗忘问题，且具有通用性和即插即用特性，无需跨任务记忆开销。

title: S$^3$-Diff: Structural Semantic Synergy Diffusion Model for High Fidelity Super Resolution of Pathological Images
summary: Digital pathology relies on high-resolution whole slide images for accurate diagnosis, yet limitations in imaging devices, storage, and transmission often make lower-resolution pathology images more common in clinical workflows. Current super-resolution techniques often tend to smooth diagnostically relevant morphology, leading to over-smoothed textures and semantic drift that compromise downstream clinical interpretation. To this end, we develop the Structural Semantic Synergy Diffusion Model (S3-Diff), a diffusion framework for high-fidelity super-resolution of pathological images. The core of S3-Diff is Specimen-aware Structural Anchoring (SSA), which combines prognosis-aware tissue support extracted by a fixed SAM with LR-HR gradient discrepancies to generate a specimen-specific structural anchor to preserve pathological morphology. Concurrently, we introduce Structure-guided Semantic Fidelity Tuning (SSFT) to adapt DINOv3 representations using SSA-derived structural supervision. SSFT combines the adapted semantic energy with LR-derived edge and grayscale cues. The resulting control guides denoising to suppress stochastic artifacts and maintain structural consistency. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that S3-Diff consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both reconstruction quality and downstream survival analysis performance. The source code will be made public.

AI.tldr: S3-Diff是一个用于病理图像超分辨率的扩散模型框架，通过标本感知结构锚定（SSA）和结构引导语义保真度调整（SSFT）两项核心机制，在提升图像重建质量的同时保持病理形态学结构和语义的一致性，并在下游生存分析任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中低分辨率病理图像更为常见，而现有超分辨率技术往往过度平滑诊断相关的形态学特征，造成纹理过度平滑和语义漂移，从而影响下游临床判读。作者希望开发一种能够保持病理形态学结构高保真度的超分辨率方法。
AI.method: S3-Diff由两部分组成：(1) Specimen-aware Structural Anchoring (SSA)，结合固定SAM提取的预后感知组织支持与低分辨率-高分辨率梯度差异，生成标本特异性结构锚点以保留病理形态；(2) Structure-guided Semantic Fidelity Tuning (SSFT)，利用SSA的结构监督适配DINOv3表征，将适配后的语义能量与LR来源的边缘和灰度线索结合，作为控制信号引导去噪过程，抑制随机伪影并维持结构一致性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，S3-Diff在重建质量和下游生存分析性能上均持续优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: S3-Diff通过将结构性锚定与语义保真度调整协同集成到扩散框架中，有效解决了病理图像超分辨率中的结构退化和语义漂移问题，为数字病理学中低分辨率图像的临床应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: WorldCup Arena: Prospective, Leakage-Free Evaluation of Frontier LLMs on a Live Tournament
summary: Benchmarks that measure the forecasting ability of large language models are almost always retrospective: the event has happened, the answer is somewhere on the Web, and the evaluation must defend itself against memorisation. We report the opposite design. Over the 39 days of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, six frontier LLMs -- all with extended thinking and native server-side web search -- were asked before every kickoff, one match at a time, to fill in a seven-market prediction card for all 104 matches, plus 12 group winners and a pre-tournament outright pool; no answer existed when the question was asked, so the evaluation is leakage-free by construction rather than by filtering, and the frozen archive holds 4,494 scored predictions. What the tournament establishes is a set of behaviours the six systems share. On match outcome they average 63.9%, level with backing the bookmaker's favourite -- which is in fact what they usually do. They agree with one another far more often than they are right, so a majority vote adds nothing. They under-commit to draws and to goals, and crowd their scoreline picks onto a single prototypical result. Accuracy tracks how lopsided a fixture is rather than how much is known about it: it collapses in the closest ties, where the dossiers are richest, while questions about the tournament as a whole are answered well. On this task the current generation of frontier systems is not sharply differentiated: the standings hold up at the top and the bottom across the run and churn in the middle, and the margins stay narrow throughout. The briefing dossiers, fixtures and official results are released as a benchmark, together with the scoring code.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个前瞻性（而非回顾性）的LLM预测能力基准测试：在2026年FIFA世界杯39天赛程中，六个前沿LLM在每场比赛开球前被要求填写预测卡片，覆盖104场比赛、12个小组出线队和赛前冠军池，共4,494个评分预测，由于提问时答案尚不存在，该评测从构造上杜绝了数据泄漏。结果显示这些系统在比赛结果上平均准确率63.9%，与押注博彩公司热门持平，彼此高度趋同导致多数投票无增益，对平局和进球数估计不足，比分预测过度集中在某类原型结果上，且预测准确度与比赛悬念程度负相关。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估LLM预测能力的基准几乎都是回顾式的——事件已发生、答案已在网上，评测必须费力防止记忆泄漏。作者希望设计一种从根本上无泄漏的前瞻性评测设计，真实考察LLM的前瞻预测能力，而非信息检索或记忆复现能力。
AI.method: 在2026年FIFA世界杯的39天内，让六个具有扩展思维和原生服务端网络搜索能力的前沿LLM，在每场比赛开球前逐一填写包含七个市场的预测卡片，覆盖全部104场比赛、12个小组出线队以及赛前的冠军池投注，最终冻结了一个包含4,494个评分预测的存档，并发布了简报材料、赛程和官方结果以及评分代码。
AI.result: 六个系统在比赛结果上的平均准确率为63.9%，与押注博彩公司热门持平（这实际上也是它们通常的做法）。系统之间的相互一致性远高于正确率，多数投票无增益。它们对平局和进球数投入不足，比分预测过度集中于单一的原型结果。准确率跟随比赛的悬殊程度而非已知信息量变化：在最接近的比赛中准确率崩溃（尽管此时档案资料最丰富），而对整个赛事的问题回答良好。排名稳定：顶部和底部保持稳定，中间层频繁变动但差距始终狭窄。
AI.conclusion: 该任务显示当前这一代前沿LLM系统彼此并无明显分化：榜首榜尾排名长期稳定、中间频繁洗牌但差距始终狭小。研究将完整的数据集作为基准发布，为未来LLM前瞻预测能力的评测提供了一个无泄漏的设计范本。

title: UNVaMP: Neural Knowledge Tracing with Variational Regularization of Latent Knowledge Dynamics
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, Proceedings of the 19th International Conference on Educational Data Mining , Seoul, Republic of Korea, June-2026
summary:
We introduce the Unified Neural Variational Measurement of Proficiency (UNVaMP) architecture, a knowledge tracing method that integrates observed student-item interactions with internal memory to produce evolving latent representations of student knowledge. These representations support accurate predictions of future responses while enabling explicit control over the smoothness of estimated learning trajectories. UNVaMP can be configured as either a purely neural model or a hybrid model that predicts responses through an interpretable measurement function over the latent space. We show that a pure neural configuration (UNVaMP-MLP) achieves the strongest predictive performance among compared models on three out of four datasets. Meanwhile, a hybrid configuration (UNVaMP-MIRT, using a 1PL MIRT measurement function) lags only slightly behind UNVaMP-MLP, indicating that the predictive cost of interpretability is modest.
  Beyond predictive accuracy, UNVaMP provides the following: a principled mechanism for controlling volatility when estimating student latent variables, quantification of uncertainty over student knowledge state estimates, and flexible input specification that supports heterogeneous student-item interaction features. In addition, the hybrid UNVaMP-MIRT configuration generates interpretable moment-in-time student knowledge state estimates. Using an experimental dataset, we show that auxiliary inputs induce structured changes in the predictive behavior of UNVaMP-MIRT, consistent with sensitivity to underlying structure beyond response correctness. Furthermore, through a simulation study, we show that UNVaMP yields well-behaved knowledge state estimates under controlled measurement conditions. In total, these results indicate that UNVaMP is both useful for real-world education systems and capable of recovering underlying structure from student-item interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UNVaMP架构，一种统一神经变分知识追踪方法，通过整合学生-题目交互与内部记忆生成动态潜在知识表征，兼顾预测准确性与可解释性，并支持学习轨迹平滑度控制、不确定性量化和异构输入特征。
AI.motivation: 知识追踪需要同时实现高精度的未来响应预测和对学生知识状态的合理解释，但现有方法通常在预测性能与可解释性之间难以兼顾，且缺乏对学习轨迹平滑性、不确定性量化和异构特征输入的系统支持。作者旨在提出一种统一架构，在保持预测准确性的同时提供可解释的、可控制的、稳健的知识状态估计。
AI.method: UNVaMP采用神经变分框架，将可观测的学生-题目交互与内部记忆整合为随时间演化的潜在知识表征。该架构支持两种配置：纯神经模型（UNVaMP-MLP）通过MLP直接预测响应；混合模型（UNVaMP-MIRT）将潜在知识表征输入1PL MIRT测量函数以获得可解释的响应预测。此外，UNVaMP提供学习轨迹波动性的原则性控制机制、知识状态估计的不确定性量化以及支持异构学生-题目交互特征的灵活输入规范。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验中，UNVaMP-MLP在三个数据集上取得最强预测性能；UNVaMP-MIRT的预测表现仅略逊于UNVaMP-MLP，表明可解释性的预测代价很小。基于实验数据集的辅助输入实验显示其能引发UNVaMP-MIRT预测行为的结构化变化，表明模型对响应正确性之外的潜在结构敏感；模拟研究也表明UNVaMP在受控测量条件下能产生稳定的知识状态估计。
AI.conclusion: UNVaMP既适用于真实教育系统，又能从学生-题目交互中恢复潜在底层结构。其混合配置在仅付出很小预测代价的情况下提供了可解释的知识状态估计，同时纯神经配置可达到最先进的预测性能，使研究者能够在准确性与可解释性之间灵活权衡。

title: Shielding for Higher-Order Safety
summary: Safety shields are runtime enforcement mechanisms that restrict the actions of a controller to guarantee safety. Classical shields are usually synthesised for state predicates: the current physical state is either safe or unsafe, and the shield disables precisely those actions that can force the system into an unsafe state in the future. In many cyber-physical applications this view is too coarse. A vehicle approaching an obstacle should not only avoid collision, but also respect speed regulations, force limits induced by acceleration, and jerk limits to prevent injuries. From a physical perspective, these requirements are predicated over the derivatives of the state. This paper develops a finite-state safety-game construction for such high-order smoothness constraints. We define differential safety properties using finite differences over a discretised state space, characterise their expressiveness, and reduce shield synthesis to an ordinary safety game over a history state space. We give a synthesis algorithm whose shields store exactly $k$ past states for properties of order $k$ and prove that this memory is necessary. We describe an iterative synthesis procedure for a maximally permissive shield that operates over hierarchies of derivative constraints. The algorithm solves constraints iteratively in increasing order and uses the solution at each iteration to prune the state space for the next constraint. This makes shield synthesis more efficient in practice, as the algorithm refrains from exploring large regions of the state space that are known to be unsafe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对高阶光滑性约束（如速度、加速度、加加速度限制）的安全盾牌合成方法，通过有限差分定义微分安全属性，将合成问题归约为历史状态空间上的普通安全博弈，并提出迭代合成算法以高效生成最大允许的安全盾牌。
AI.motivation: 经典安全盾牌仅处理状态谓词，即物理状态安全与否的二值判断，这在许多信息物理系统中过于粗粒度。例如车辆避障不仅需要避免碰撞，还需要遵守速度限制、由加速度引起的力约束以及防止伤害的加加速度限制——这些需求本质上是关于状态导数的谓词，经典方法无法直接处理。
AI.method: 1) 在离散化状态空间上用有限差分定义微分安全属性并刻画其表达能力；2) 将盾牌合成归约为历史状态空间上的普通安全博弈；3) 提出合成算法，对于k阶性质，盾牌仅需存储k个过去状态，并证明该记忆量是必要的；4) 设计迭代合成流程，按导数约束的层级递增顺序求解，每步利用已解约束来剪枝状态空间。
AI.result: 给出了盾牌合成算法及其必要记忆量的理论证明，并展示了迭代合成过程中通过逐步剪枝不安全状态空间从而提升实际合成效率的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将安全盾牌的适用范围从单纯的状态谓词扩展到高阶导数性质，并通过分层迭代合成策略在保证最大允许性（maximally permissive）的同时提高了合成效率。

title: Test-Time Augmentation for Tabular-to-Image Classifiers under Distribution Shifts
summary: Tabular-to-image methods that convert tabular data into visual representations have emerged as a novel paradigm for leveraging the high performance of deep learning models. Despite their advantages, the robustness of these methods under distribution shifts remains under explored. Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) is an effective approach in image classification to improve model generalization and robustness, where predictions over multiple transformed views of each input are aggregated. This work evaluates the impact of TTA techniques on predictive performance under Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) for representations generated by tabular-to-image methods. Six tabular-to-image encoding methods were considered: TINTO, IGTD, DeepInsight, BIE, DistanceMatrix, Fotomics. Twenty-five TTA techniques were used, organized into six types: Geometric, Photometric, Structural, Frequency/Encoding, Mixup, and Composite. We employed two datasets from the TableShift benchmark (HELOC and Voting) that provide in-distribution and OOD test subsets designed to evaluate the effect of distribution shifts on tabular data. The results indicate that TTA improves OOD performance, with composite and photometric strategies providing the best trade-off between robustness and variance. In contrast, frequency-domain transformations that alter the encoder's feature-to-intensity mapping consistently degrade performance. These findings highlight TTA as a promising approach for improving the robustness and generalization of classifiers trained on image representations derived from tabular data, particularly under distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了测试时增强（TTA）技术对表格到图像（tabular-to-image）编码方法在分布偏移（OOD）场景下预测性能的影响。研究涵盖6种编码方法和25种TTA技术，在TableShift基准的两个数据集（HELOC和Voting）上验证，发现复合和光度类TTA策略能有效提升OOD鲁棒性，而频域变换会一致地降低性能。
AI.motivation: 表格到图像方法作为利用深度学习模型高表现力的新兴范式，其在分布偏移下的鲁棒性尚未被充分探索。测试时增强在传统图像分类中已被证明能提升泛化和鲁棒性，但其对表格到图像表示的影响缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 选用6种表格到图像编码方法（TINTO、IGTD、DeepInsight、BIE、DistanceMatrix、Fotomics），应用25种TTA技术（分为几何、光度、结构、频率/编码、Mixup和复合六类），在TableShift基准的HELOC和Voting两个数据集上，对In-Distribution和OOD测试子集进行对比评估。
AI.result: TTA能够提升OOD性能；复合策略和光度策略在鲁棒性与方差之间取得最佳平衡；而改变编码器特征到强度映射关系的频域变换会一致性地降低模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 测试时增强是提升基于表格数据图像表示的分类器在分布偏移下鲁棒性和泛化能力的可行途径，其中复合和光度类策略值得优先考虑，而频域变换应避免使用。

title: SocietyBench: Forecasting Counterfactual Social-World Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. A complementary social ability, namely how well a model understands and forecasts the way real social events unfold, has barely been measured. We introduce SocietyBench, an end-to-end benchmark that takes a one-line event topic, collects Web news and social-media posts across five platforms, distills them into a date-indexed timeline that keeps factual events and a public-opinion layer separate, and then turns every cutoff date on that timeline into an audited bank of forecasting questions. Questions are scored on two orthogonal 100-point axes: probability calibration and temporal accuracy. Before any model sees a timeline, a three-phase procedure replaces every named entity and shifts every date by a per-event constant, turning a real arc into a counterfactual social world -- structurally identical to what happened, but stripped of the surface labels a model could match against pre-training memory. On five heterogeneous events and 125 prediction points in Chinese and English editions, the strongest of six frontier LLMs reaches only 75.0 out of 100, against a trivial anchor of 50. The two axes come apart: a model can be calibration-strong but time-weak, or the reverse. Three agent frameworks built on a shared base model fail to improve on that base, and two model-free heuristics trail every LLM. Per-event gaps reach 21.4 points on a single axis, which is our main argument for evaluating on several events rather than one. All anonymized timelines, question banks, ground truth, and scoring code are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SocietyBench，一个端到端的社会事件预测基准。它从Web新闻和社交媒体中构建日期索引的带匿名化处理的时间线，并生成校准和时序两个正交维度的预测问题。最强的六款前沿LLM仅达到75.0/100分，且校准能力和时序能力可以解耦，基于同一基础模型的agent框架无法提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM及agent的基准测试大多聚焦于"完成任务"的能力（修bug、操作浏览器/GUI），而模型理解和预测真实社会事件演进这一互补的社会能力几乎未被测量。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: SocietyBench采用端到端流程：输入一行事件主题，从五个平台收集新闻和社交媒体帖子，提炼为按日期索引的时间线（将事实事件和公众舆论分层），每个截止日期生成经过审核的预测问题库。评分采用概率校准和时序准确性两个正交的100分轴。关键创新是三阶段匿名化流程：替换所有命名实体并按每个事件的常数平移日期，将真实事件弧线转化为反事实社会世界，防止模型匹配预训练记忆。
AI.result: 在五个异质事件和125个预测点（中英文两个版本）上，最强的前沿LLM仅达到75.0/100分（基线为50）。两个轴可以解耦：模型可能在校准上强而时序上弱，或反之。基于同一基础模型构建的三个agent框架未超越基础模型，两个无模型启发式方法落后于所有LLM。单轴上单个事件差距可达21.4分。
AI.conclusion: SocietyBench揭示了LLM在真实社会事件预测方面的显著不足，且校准与时序能力是正交的。单个事件的评估不足以代表模型整体能力，需在多个事件上评测。所有匿名时间线、问题库、真实标签和评分代码均已开源，为该领域提供了可复现的基准资源。

title: Compass: Degradation-Simulated Reciprocal Learning with Lightweight Needle RWKV for Multimodal Crack Segmentation under Missing Modalities
comment: This paper has been accepted by ACM MM 2026
