summary: In multimodal crack segmentation for industrial facilities, the key challenge is preventing missing modalities from degrading pixel-level performance while maintaining low computational cost. Existing methods struggle to address semantic degradation caused by missing modalities. We propose Compass, a lightweight network for robust crack segmentation under arbitrary missing modalities. Compass comprises Degradation Simulation Distillation (DSD), Needle Block, and Evidential Topology-Preserving Fusion (ETPF). DSD constructs a degradation simulation stream that mimics more severe missing conditions and performs reciprocal distillation with the original stream, decoupling complete perception from degradation adaptation. Within DSD, Feature-Aware Prototype Transmitter (FAPT) performs modality agnostic prototype-guided feature completion to maintain semantic integrity under incomplete modality conditions. As a lightweight backbone, Needle injects crack-direction cues into WKV modulation and combines connectivity-aware gating with anisotropic context probing for structure-aware modeling. ETPF fuses multimodal features via Dempster-Shafer evidential combination with uncertainty-gated decoding, preserving crack topology while suppressing unreliable features. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance under diverse missing modality scenarios. Even with 90\% depth modality missing on CrackDepth, Compass achieves F1 of 0.8216 and mIoU of 0.8434 with only 2.58M parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/Karl1109/Compass.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Compass，一个轻量级网络用于任意模态缺失下工业设施裂缝分割，通过Degradation Simulation Distillation（DSD）、Needle Block和Evidential Topology-Preserving Fusion（ETPF）三大组件，在缺失模态下保持像素级分割性能且计算成本低。在CrackDepth上即使90%深度模态缺失，仍以2.58M参数达到F1 0.8216、mIoU 0.8434的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 工业设施多模态裂缝分割中，模态缺失会导致像素级性能大幅退化，现有方法难以解决模态缺失引起的语义退化问题，同时还需满足低计算成本的实际需求。
AI.method: Compass由三个核心组件构成：(1) DSD通过构建模拟更严重缺失条件的降级模拟流，与原流进行互蒸馏，解耦完整感知与降级适应；其中FAPT进行模态无关的原型引导特征补全以维持语义完整性。(2) Needle作为轻量骨干，将裂缝方向线索注入WKV调制，结合连通性感知门控与各向异性上下文探测进行结构感知建模。(3) ETPF通过Dempster-Shafer证据融合与不确定性门控解码融合多模态特征，在抑制不可靠特征的同时保持裂缝拓扑结构。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的多种缺失模态场景下取得SOTA性能。在CrackDepth数据集上，即使90%深度模态缺失，Compass仅以2.58M参数即达到F1 0.8216和mIoU 0.8434。
AI.conclusion: Compass通过解耦完整感知与降级适应、轻量结构感知骨干以及证据拓扑保持融合，在极低参数量的条件下有效缓解了任意模态缺失导致的裂缝分割性能退化问题。

title: FedCritic-MIMO: Communication-Efficient Serverless Federated Critic Learning for Massive-MIMO Resource Control in Open and Disaggregated 6G RANs
comment: Submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper proposes FedCritic-MIMO, a communication-efficient serverless federated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for AI-native resource control across independently deployable cell-level controllers in open and disaggregated 6G RANs. Controllers share no trainer, retain local actors and personalized critic components, and exchange only compatible shared critic parameters. FedCritic-MIMO targets reuse-$1$ multi-cell massive-MIMO OFDMA deployments, where RAN controllers jointly manage user scheduling, per-stream power allocation, beamforming, interference, and long-term QoS with limited inter-controller signaling. Each base station locally executes its actor without centralized training or actor federation, while critic knowledge is exchanged peer-to-peer over an interference-aware graph. It enables this collaboration through wireless-aware event triggering, adaptive layer-wise top-$k$ sparse critic exchange with error feedback, and balanced interference-aware fusion. We establish conditional finite-time stationarity and consensus guarantees for the balanced, compressed peer-to-peer critic recursion under a fixed-policy, frozen-target critic-regression model. In strongly interference-coupled reuse-$1$ simulations, FedCritic-MIMO achieves the best performance-communication tradeoff among heuristic, independent-learning, centralized-training, and communication-ablation baselines. It achieves the highest held-out throughput, improves user-rate distribution and mean SINR, increases QoS satisfaction, and attains the lowest interference cost per delivered bit among learning baselines. It reduces critic-communication overhead by $76\%$ relative to uncompressed distributed critic exchange. These results demonstrate that serverless exchange of compatible shared critic parameters can coordinate RAN controllers without centralized trajectory collection or parameter-server aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedCritic-MIMO，一种面向6G开放解聚RAN的通信高效无服务器联邦多智能体强化学习框架。该框架中RAN控制器不共享训练器、保留本地actor和个性化critic组件，仅交换兼容的共享critic参数，通过无线感知事件触发、自适应分层top-k稀疏critic交换与误差反馈、以及平衡干扰感知融合实现协作。在强干扰耦合的reuse-1大规模MIMO OFDMA场景中，该框架相比多种基线取得最佳性能-通信权衡，并将critic通信开销降低76%。
AI.motivation: 在开放与解聚的6G RAN架构中，独立部署的小区级控制器需要协作管理资源，但传统集中式训练和参数服务器聚合方式面临轨迹收集成本高、跨域信息交换受限、以及紧耦合资源控制带来的通信开销问题。亟需一种在有限控制器间信令约束下实现高效智能协调的机制。
AI.method: FedCritic-MIMO采用无服务器（serverless）联邦多智能体强化学习架构：各基站本地执行actor（不参与联邦化），仅通过干扰感知图进行critic参数的端到端（peer-to-peer）交换。具体机制包括：无线感知事件触发（决定何时交换）、自适应分层top-k稀疏critic参数交换与误差反馈（减少通信量）、以及平衡干扰感知融合（聚合邻居critic知识）。在理论层面，基于固定策略、冻结目标critic回归模型建立了条件有限时间平稳性与一致性保证。
AI.result: 在强干扰耦合的reuse-1多小区大规模MIMO-OFDMA仿真中，FedCritic-MIMO在启发式、独立学习、集中训练和通信消融等多类基线中取得最佳性能-通信权衡。它实现了最高的留出吞吐量，改善了用户速率分布与平均SINR，提升了QoS满意度，并在学习基线中达到每交付比特最低的干扰成本。相比未压缩的分布式critic交换，critic通信开销降低了76%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明：通过无服务器方式交换兼容的共享critic参数即可有效协调RAN控制器，无需集中式轨迹收集或参数服务器聚合。这为在开放解聚6G RAN中实现通信高效、去中心化的AI原生资源控制提供了可行的架构方案。

title: LiveEvalBench: Toward Open-World Evaluation for Web Generation
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable of synthesizing executable frontend projects, yet existing benchmarks still treat web generation as a static evaluation problem. We argue that frontend artifacts demand a different paradigm: they are interactive rather than static, admit diverse yet equally valid implementations, and evolve faster than rigid pipelines can accommodate. To address these gaps, we present LiveEvalBench, an automated framework that reformulates web-generation evaluation as an agentic, adaptive, and extensible process. LiveEvalBench instantiates evaluation as a collaborative review workflow, in which a Build Engineer, a Code Engineer, and a UI Tester collectively gather evidence across the full lifecycle of a frontend project, from deployment and code inspection to browser-based interaction. To handle implementation diversity, an adaptive protocol couples shared rubrics for cross-model comparability with implementation-grounded criteria tailored to each artifact. The framework further supports incremental integration of new evaluator roles and assessment dimensions without pipeline redesign. Experiments across diverse real-world web-generation scenarios show that LiveEvalBench aligns closely with human expert judgment and provides fine-grained insights into frontier models' web generation capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/wyysteelhead/LiveEvalBench

AI.tldr: LiveEvalBench是一个将前端项目生成评估从静态评估范式转换为智能体化、自适应、可扩展的自动化框架，通过构建工程师、代码工程师和UI测试员三位协作者的审查工作流，从部署、代码检查和浏览器交互等全生命周期收集证据，并采用共享评分标准与实现相关标准相结合的自适应协议来处理实现多样性。实验表明该框架与人类专家判断高度一致，能为前沿模型的网页生成能力提供细粒度洞察。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将网页生成视为静态评估问题，但前端工件的本质是交互式而非静态的，允许多样但同样有效的实现，且演进速度快于刚性管线。这些特性使得传统静态评估范式无法充分衡量模型生成的网页质量。
AI.method: 将评估实例化为协作审查工作流：包含Build Engineer（部署）、Code Engineer（代码检查）和UI Tester（浏览器交互）三个角色共同收集证据；采用自适应协议，将用于跨模型可比性的共享评分标准与针对每个工件定制的实现相关标准相结合；支持增量集成新的评估角色和评估维度而无需重新设计管线。
AI.result: 在多样化的真实网页生成场景中，LiveEvalBench与人类专家判断高度一致，并能够提供关于前沿模型网页生成能力的细粒度洞察。
AI.conclusion: 将网页生成评估从静态转向智能体化、自适应和可扩展的范式是有效且必要的，LiveEvalBench为此提供了可用的自动化框架与实现。

title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
summary: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit. We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments. Based on these findings, we study how to build more effective training environment distributions from two dimensions: **diversity** and **difficulty structure**. For diversity, we propose **Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)** to obtain diverse environment sets. For difficulty structure, we propose **Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)**, which organizes curriculum learning through two difficulty levels: harness weakening and state-scale progression. Experiments show that AES and HDC effectively improve multimodal agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文发现简单地增加多模态环境数量并不总能提升智能体训练效果，并通过实验分析了当前多模态环境分布中的局限性。基于此，作者提出从多样性和难度结构两个维度构建更有效的训练环境分布：Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)用于获取多样化环境集合，Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)通过两级难度（束缚弱化和状态规模递进）组织课程学习。实验表明两种方法均能有效提升多模态智能体训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通过构建大规模多模态环境池训练智能体，但作者发现简单地增加环境数量并不总是有益，需要分析当前多模态环境分布中的局限性，以构建更有效的训练环境分布。
AI.method: 从两个维度构建训练环境分布：1) 多样性维度，提出Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)选择多样化的环境集合；2) 难度结构维度，提出Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)，通过束缚弱化（harness weakening）和状态规模递进（state-scale progression）两个难度层级组织课程学习。
AI.result: 实验证明AES和HDC均能有效提升多模态智能体的训练效果。
AI.conclusion: 环境多样性选择和难度课程结构是构建有效多模态训练环境分布的关键因素，二者结合能够取得更好的智能体训练效果。

title: Quantization Effects on Biomedical LLM Reliability
summary: When decoder language models are used as classifiers, predicted class probabilities depend on implementation choices, including the prompt template, verbalizer (label-to-token mapping), and scoring rule, that are rarely treated as experimental variables. We present a controlled evaluation of three Mistral-7B variants (Base, BioMistral, and Instruct) on PubMed RCT sentence classification (n=2000) under FP16, INT8, and INT4 precision using four answer-text prompt templates. Our primary finding is that the probability extraction protocol dominates apparent calibration. Switching from summed to mean token log-likelihood scoring reverses the calibration ranking between models: BioMistral average expected calibration error increases from 0.097 to 0.289, whereas Instruct decreases from 0.237 to 0.096, while accuracy changes by less than 1 percentage point for the specialized models but 4-6 percentage points for the base model. Prompt template choice produces accuracy differences of 7-24 percentage points, comparable to or larger than model-level effects. On one template, BioMistral outperforms Instruct although the overall mean favors Instruct by only 1.3 percentage points. For BioMistral and Instruct, INT8 quantization changes accuracy and F1 by only 1-2 percentage points relative to FP16, whereas the base model shows larger INT8 effects on some templates (up to +4.2 percentage points). INT4 produces heterogeneous but non-catastrophic effects. Temperature scaling reduces expected calibration error under summed scoring for both models but only for that scoring rule. A fine-tuned PubMedBERT reference achieves 82.7% accuracy but uses about 176000 labeled training examples, precluding direct comparison. These results demonstrate that prompt template design and scoring normalization are first-order experimental decisions when evaluating decoder language model calibration.

AI.tldr: 本论文对三个Mistral-7B变体（Base、BioMistral、Instruct）在PubMed RCT句子分类任务上进行受控评估，发现概率提取协议（token对数似然取均值vs求和）主导表观校准效果，提示模板和评分归一化方式是评估解码器语言模型校准时的首要实验决策。
AI.motivation: 解码器语言模型作为分类器时，预测类别概率严重依赖于实现选择（提示模板、verbalizer、评分规则），但这些因素很少被视为实验变量，导致校准评估结果可能失真。
AI.method: 在FP16、INT8、INT4三种精度下，使用四种答案文本提示模板，对三个Mistral-7B变体在PubMed RCT句子分类（n=2000）上进行受控评估，比较求和与平均token对数似然两种评分规则，并用温度缩放测试校准改进效果。
AI.result: 评分规则从求和改为取均值会反转模型间的校准排名（BioMistral的ECE从0.097升至0.289，Instruct从0.237降至0.096）；提示模板造成7-24个百分点的准确率差异；INT8量化对专业模型影响仅1-2个百分点，而Base模型在某些模板上差异可达+4.2个百分点；温度缩放仅在求和评分下有效。
AI.conclusion: 提示模板设计和评分归一化是与模型选择同等重要的第一阶实验决策，结论的稳健性取决于这些实验变量的控制。

title: TARL: Transaction-Aware Reliable Ledgers for Executable Memory Management in Long-Term Agents
summary: Persistent memory helps long-term agents retain knowledge, yet a single update error can repeatedly distort future retrieval and reasoning. Most existing systems reduce memory updating to a binary Write/Hold decision, which cannot distinguish whether new information should be added, ignored, used to revise an outdated belief, rejected as unreliable, or deferred for verification. These choices may share the same binary label while producing fundamentally different memory states. We introduce TARL, a memory state update framework that maps each statement to one of five executable actions. TARL identifies the affected memory, resolves its temporal scope, compares source reliability, and updates accepted, pending, and rejected ledgers. It is further trained by comparing the memory states produced by alternative update operations, encouraging the model to select the operation that leads to the correct result. We also introduce TARL-Mem, a benchmark with fine-grained action labels and next-state targets. Across in-domain, cross-source, temporal, counterfactual, and sequential evaluations, TARL improves action prediction and state recovery, reduces memory pollution, preserves conflicting evidence, and limits cumulative corruption. The complete model implementation is provided in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TARL，一个将长期记忆中每条陈述映射为五种可执行操作（添加、忽略、修订、拒绝、延迟验证）的记忆状态更新框架，并配套提出TARL-Mem基准数据集。TARL通过比较不同更新操作产生的记忆状态来训练模型选择最优操作，在多种评估场景下有效提升动作预测和状态恢复能力，减少记忆污染并抑制累积错误。
AI.motivation: 现有持久记忆系统的更新机制被简化为二值的写/保持决策，无法区分新信息应被添加、忽略、用于修订过时信念、拒绝为不可靠信息，还是延迟验证。这些本质上不同的更新选择可能共享相同的二值标签，却产生完全不同的记忆状态，导致单次更新错误在后续检索和推理中被反复放大。
AI.method: TARL框架将每条陈述映射为五种可执行动作之一，通过四步流程工作：识别受影响的记忆、解析其时间范围、比较来源可靠性、更新已接受/待定/已拒绝三个账本。训练采用对比记忆状态的方法，通过比较替代更新操作产生的记忆状态，促使模型选择导向正确结果的操作。同时构建了TARL-Mem基准，包含细粒度动作标签和下一状态目标。
AI.result: 在域内、跨来源、时间性、反事实和序列化评估中，TARL在动作预测和状态恢复方面均优于基线，有效减少了记忆污染、保留了冲突证据、并限制了累积性信息损坏。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆更新从二值决策细化为五分类可执行操作，并引入记忆状态对比训练策略，能够显著提升长期智能体记忆管理的可靠性和鲁棒性，为后续记忆更新研究提供了框架与基准。

title: SlimVLM: Sensitivity-aware Dynamic Structured Pruning with Adaptive Visual Token Selection for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in processing and understanding both text and images, their large parameter sizes lead to significant computational overhead, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices. While pruning has been effective for compressing Large Language Models (LLMs), directly applying it to VLMs leads to significant performance drops, largely due to redundant visual tokens interfering with importance estimation. To this end, we propose SlimVLM, a structured pruning framework designed to compress VLMs while preserving their task performance. We introduce an adaptive visual token selection strategy for VLMs that leverages average text-to-visual attention scores to assess the importance of visual tokens, removing redundant ones during pruning based on a set threshold, thereby optimizing the importance calculation. Recognizing the varying tolerance to sparsity across different modules, we also propose a Sensitivity-aware dynamic pruning mechanism that determines the appropriate pruning ratio for each module by calculating the linear reconstruction error between the outputs of the pruned and unpruned modules, ensuring overall performance stability. Experimental results show that SlimVLM outperforms existing methods across multiple multimodal benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: SlimVLM是一个面向视觉-语言模型（VLM）的结构化剪枝框架，通过自适应视觉token选择和敏感性感知的动态剪枝机制，在压缩模型参数的同时保持任务性能，在多个多模态基准上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: VLM虽在多模态理解上表现出色，但参数量过大导致计算开销显著，难以在资源受限设备上部署。虽然剪枝在LLM上有效，但直接应用于VLM会因冗余视觉token干扰重要性估计而导致性能显著下降。
AI.method: SlimVLM提出两个核心机制：(1) 自适应视觉token选择策略，利用平均文本到视觉注意力分数评估视觉token的重要性，在剪枝过程中基于设定阈值移除冗余token，优化重要性计算；(2) 敏感性感知的动态剪枝机制，通过计算剪枝前后模块输出的线性重建误差来确定每个模块合适的剪枝比例，保证整体性能稳定。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SlimVLM在多个多模态基准上优于现有方法，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: SlimVLM通过针对VLM特点设计的剪枝策略，有效解决了直接剪枝导致性能下降的问题，实现了在保持性能的同时显著压缩VLM模型。

title: Bi-semantic Chemical Embedder for Joint Representation Learning of SMILES and Natural Language
summary: Transformer models have revolutionized natural language processing (NLP), and text-based molecular representations like SMILES have successfully extended these architectures to chemistry. However, domain-adaptive pre-training often causes models to overfit to chemical syntax, catastrophically forgetting their foundational semantic capabilities. To address this challenge, we introduce CheMatE, a chemistry-oriented embedding model that jointly captures molecular structure and domain-specific natural language within the same representation space. Built on a ModernBERT backbone, CheMatE learns bi-semantic representations through a two-stage training procedure: continued masked language modeling (MLM) followed by a Matryoshka contrastive learning stage via Multiple Negative Ranking Loss (MNRL). First, we train the model using MLM on a novel, large-scale corpus of SMILES-annotated, long-context scientific documents that were constructed and curated from FineWeb and ChemPile (comprising 10.4B and 11.5B tokens, respectively). Subsequently, the model undergoes contrastive learning using a synthetic dataset of SMILES-text pairs algorithmically derived from our original training corpus. This design exposes the model to SMILES-enriched scientific literature, enabling bi-semantic understanding. We evaluate CheMatE across a range of downstream tasks covering molecular property prediction and scientific language understanding. Our results demonstrate that coupling our custom-curated datasets with this sequential training strategy yields robust, highly transferable representations. By effectively unifying structural and contextual signals within a single text-based framework, CheMatE achieves competitive performance across both specialized chemistry models and general-purpose language model baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CheMatE，一个基于ModernBERT的化学导向嵌入模型，通过两阶段训练（连续掩码语言建模+Matryoshka对比学习）在统一表示空间中联合捕获分子结构和化学领域自然语言语义，在分子性质预测和科学语言理解任务上取得具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的领域自适应预训练会导致Transformer模型过度拟合化学语法（如SMILES），灾难性地遗忘其基础语义能力。现有方法难以在分子结构和化学领域自然语言之间建立统一表示，因此需要一个能够同时捕捉结构信号和上下文语义信号的化学嵌入模型。
AI.method: CheMatE基于ModernBERT骨干网络，采用两阶段训练策略：(1) 第一阶段使用MLM在大规模SMILES注释长文科学文档语料上进行持续预训练，该语料由FineWeb和ChemPile构建和策展，分别包含10.4B和11.5B tokens；(2) 第二阶段通过Matryoshka对比学习，使用从原始训练语料中算法推导合成的SMILES-文本对进行多负样本排名损失（MNRL）训练。这种设计使模型暴露于富SMILES的科学文献，实现双语义理解。
AI.result: CheMatE在分子性质预测和科学语言理解等多个下游任务上进行了评估，结果表明自定义策展数据集与顺序训练策略相结合能够产生鲁棒且高度可迁移的表示。模型在统一结构信号和上下文信号于单一文本框架方面取得了具有竞争力的性能，超越了专门的化学模型和通用语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: CheMatE通过精心设计的训练语料和两阶段顺序训练策略，成功在单一文本框架内融合了分子结构和化学领域自然语言的表示，证明了结构-语义联合建模在化学AI领域是可行且有效的方向，为后续工作提供了新的范式。

title: Less Traffic, Better Outcomes: Competition-Aware Request Dispatch in Real-Time Ad Exchanges
comment: Accepted for presentation at AdKDD 2026, the premier workshop on artificial intelligence for advertising, held in conjunction with the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
summary: Real-time bidding (RTB) ad exchanges typically forward nearly all incoming requests to demand-side platforms (DSPs), even though only a small fraction receive bids. This over-distribution weakens auction outcomes: DSPs throttle participation under compute and budget constraints, reducing the effective use of limited bidding capacity. We present a competition-aware request dispatch framework that uses distributional bid prediction and probabilistic forwarding to decide whether each request should be sent to each DSP. The system adapts per-DSP thresholds over time through lightweight policy optimization to track non-stationary market conditions. We evaluate the framework through four sequential online experiments on a production platform serving over 20 billion daily requests. A full multi-DSP deployment reduces DSP request volume under the policy by 34.2% while increasing net revenue by 4.6% (p<0.001) in a recent 14-day window after an initial DSP adaptation period. Further analysis highlights strong heterogeneity across traffic segments and reveals that aggregate metrics can be misleading. Segment-level and per-DSP analyses suggest that the policy surfaces comparative advantages among DSPs, improving monetized outcomes without increasing overall request volume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个竞争感知的请求分发框架，通过分布性出价预测和概率性转发来决定是否将每个RTB请求发送给各DSP，并采用轻量级策略优化在线适应非平稳市场条件。在日产超200亿请求的生产平台上进行的四个序贯在线实验表明，完整的多DSP部署可将DSP请求量减少34.2%，同时净收入提升4.6%（p<0.001）。进一步分析揭示了流量段间的强异质性，并表明该策略能够凸显DSP间的比较优势。
AI.motivation: RTB广告交易所几乎将所有请求转发给DSP，但实际只有少数被出价。这种过度分发导致DSP在计算和预算约束下"节流"参与，削弱了拍卖效果，限制了有限竞价能力的有效利用。因此需要一种能够感知竞争环境的请求分发机制来优化出价资源的分配。
AI.method: 提出一个竞争感知的请求分发框架：(1) 使用分布性出价预测（distributional bid prediction）建模每个DSP对各请求的出价分布；(2) 采用概率性转发（probabilistic forwarding）决定是否将每个请求发送给每个DSP；(3) 通过轻量级策略优化（lightweight policy optimization）随时间调整各DSP的阈值，以追踪非平稳的市场条件；(4) 在生产平台上进行了四个序贯在线实验来验证框架效果。
AI.result: 全多DSP部署在DSP初始适应期后的14天窗口中，将DSP请求量减少34.2%，同时净收入提高4.6%（p<0.001）。进一步分析表明不同流量段之间存在强烈异质性，聚合指标可能具有误导性；段级和DSP级分析显示该策略能够凸显DSP之间的比较优势，在不增加总请求量的情况下改善变现效果。
AI.conclusion: 竞争感知的请求分发框架能够在不增加请求总量的前提下同时减少DSP请求压力并提升净收入，实现"更少请求、更好效果"的目标。研究还强调段级和DSP级分析的重要性，因为聚合指标可能掩盖重要的异质性效应。

title: Geospatial-Prior Guidance for 3D Semantic Scene Completion
summary: Inferring complete 3D geometry and semantics from onboard images remains challenging because occlusions and restricted fields of view leave large scene regions underconstrained. Although satellite imagery provides wide-area context, appearance cues alone offer limited structural guidance and may be unreliable because of spatial or temporal discrepancies. We present GeoScene, a geospatially guided framework that jointly uses satellite imagery and structured OpenStreetMap cues as soft priors for 3D semantic scene completion. GeoScene learns complementary voxel-wise reliability weights for onboard observations and geospatial guidance, and uses them to control feature refinement in observed and unobserved regions. This design preserves local visual evidence while exploiting large-scale road and building structure beyond onboard visibility. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate that GeoScene consistently improves both geometric and semantic completion under the geospatial-prior-assisted setting, with the most pronounced benefits for large-scale static and geospatially structured classes.

AI.tldr: GeoScene是一个地理空间引导框架，联合使用卫星图像和结构化OpenStreetMap线索作为软先验，用于3D语义场景补全。通过学习体素级可靠性权重，在保留车载局部视觉证据的同时，利用车载视野之外的大尺度道路和建筑结构信息。在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI-360上的实验表明，该方法在几何和语义补全方面均取得了一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 车载图像的遮挡和受限视野导致大范围场景区域欠约束，难以推断完整的3D几何与语义信息。虽然卫星图像能提供广域上下文，但仅靠外观线索对结构引导有限，且因空间或时间差异可能不可靠。
AI.method: GeoScene提出地理空间引导框架，联合使用卫星图像和结构化OpenStreetMap线索作为软先验。核心是学习互补的体素级可靠性权重，用于车载观测和地理空间引导，并以此控制已观测和未观测区域的特征细化，从而在保留局部视觉证据的同时充分利用车载视野之外的大尺度结构信息。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI-360数据集上的实验表明，GeoScene在几何和语义补全任务上均持续优于基线，尤其对大规模静态和地理空间结构化类别提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: GeoScene验证了将卫星图像和OSM结构化线索作为软先验注入3D语义场景补全的有效性，通过可靠性加权机制平衡了车载局部证据与外部地理空间信息，为超出车载视野的大场景补全提供了可行方案。

title: CRS-Triage: Confidence- and Reliability-Aware Selective Triage under Incomplete Clinical Evidence
summary: Emergency triage requires reliable decisions within a short time period. However, the available electronic health record (EHR) data, including structured data and clinical text, are often incomplete, unreliable, and inconsistent. This makes machine learning (ML)-based triage prediction more challenging, as existing ML models typically rely on complete and reliable EHR data to accurately predict patients' acuity levels. To address this, we propose confidence- and reliability-aware selective triage (CRS-Triage) to predict patients' acuity levels with a confidence score. By comparing the confidence score with a predefined threshold, CRS-Triage can selectively determine whether the model should make the decision or defer the case. Specifically, CRS-Triage separately evaluates the reliability of structured data and clinical text and then jointly considers the consistency between the two modalities to estimate the confidence of each prediction. Moreover, to reduce the risk of missing high-acuity patients, namely under-triage, CRS-Triage prefers to assign patients slightly higher acuity levels, namely over-triage, by penalizing under-triage errors. Experiments on the MIMIC-IV-ED dataset show that CRS-Triage achieves strong predictive performance. It also provides a better risk-coverage trade-off and remains reliable when the available EHR data are incomplete, degraded, or inconsistent across modalities.

AI.tldr: CRS-Triage是一个面向急诊分诊的置信度与可靠性感知选择性预测框架，通过分别评估结构化数据和临床文本的可靠性并联合考虑跨模态一致性来计算置信度，结合阈值实现选择性决策，同时通过惩罚欠分诊错误来降低高危患者漏诊风险。在MIMIC-IV-ED数据集上验证了其在数据不完整、退化或跨模态不一致情况下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊需要在极短时间内做出可靠决策，但电子健康记录（EHR）数据（包括结构化数据和临床文本）常不完整、不可靠且不一致。现有机器学习模型通常依赖完整可靠的数据来准确预测患者病情严重程度，这在实际临床场景中难以满足，因此需要一种能处理数据质量问题的分诊预测方法。
AI.method: CRS-Triage分别评估结构化数据和临床文本两种模态的可靠性，联合考虑两模态间的一致性来估计每个预测的置信度分数。通过将置信度与预设阈值比较，模型可选择自行决策或将病例延迟处理。此外，通过惩罚欠分诊错误，使模型倾向于给出稍高（过诊）而非偏低（欠诊）的病情等级，降低高危患者漏诊风险。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV-ED数据集上，CRS-Triage展现出较强的预测性能，提供了更好的风险-覆盖率权衡（risk-coverage trade-off），并且在EHR数据不完整、退化或跨模态不一致的情况下仍能保持可靠。
AI.conclusion: CRS-Triage通过置信度驱动的选择性预测机制，有效解决了数据质量不佳条件下的急诊分诊预测难题，在保证预测性能的同时提高了系统的可靠性，尤其对高危患者具有更安全的保护。

title: When Outputs Disperse, Does Epistemic Revision Follow? A Black-Box Coupling Diagnostic for Machine Collectives
summary: Collective intelligence research treats disagreement as evidence of epistemic diversity: if agents express different views, the group should retain capacity to revise. In LLM collectives this proxy can break: agents can produce diverse-looking arguments while preserving the same conclusion. We operationalize dispersion-revision coupling: the degree to which an intervention that verifiably increases the dispersion of a collective's outputs in embedding space is accompanied by genuine revision of its epistemic stance rather than premise-preserving reformulation. The diagnostic is black-box: it operates on generated text alone and makes no claims about the internal representations of the generating models. Two channels are measured independently: an output channel, the Coherence Index (CI), verifies that the intervention changed output dispersion; an epistemic channel, per-turn stance annotation, measures whether the collective revised. We propose CI with the Meta-Predictive Clarity System (MPCS), which inserts a Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP) when outputs over-converge, as a reusable method for estimating this coupling regime. We evaluate five-agent collectives from two configurations (gpt-4o-mini and gemini-2.5-flash; 310 paired episodes per condition). On gpt-4o-mini, conditional dissent improves false-premise recovery by +17.7 points (p<1e-6) while static persona diversity harms recovery (-8.1, p=.007). On gemini-2.5-flash, the same intervention at a comparable budget yields no gain (26.1% vs 27.1%, p=.84) despite a verified dispersion drop; the two treatment effects differ from each other (z=3.79, p<.001). Mechanism tagging shows Gemini preserves the false premise via intra-framework dissent: 94% of tagged post-RDP responses reformulate rather than concede (vs 24% on GPT). We recommend reporting per-intervention stance shift and premise-preservation rate alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"离散-修正耦合"诊断框架，用于检测LLM集体中输出多样性是否真正反映认知立场修正，而非仅表面改述。通过输出通道（Coherence Index）和认知通道（每轮立场标注）双通道黑盒测量，并引入Meta-Predictive Clarity System（MPCS）配合Re-Differentiation Protocol（RDP）估计耦合状态。实验发现GPT-4o-mini条件性异议可提升虚假前提恢复17.7个点，而Gemini-2.5-flash虽验证了离散度变化却无立场修正收益（框架内改述占94%）。
AI.motivation: 传统集体智能研究将分歧视为认知多样性的代理指标，但在LLM集体中该代理可能失效：模型能生成外观多样的论证却保持相同结论。因此需要一种能区分"真实立场修正"与"保留前提的改述"的诊断方法，以验证多样性干预是否真正促进集体认知演进。
AI.method: 提出双通道黑盒诊断框架：(1) 输出通道——使用Coherence Index（CI）验证干预是否确实改变了输出在嵌入空间的离散度；(2) 认知通道——对每轮输出进行立场标注，测量集体是否真正修订了认知立场。在此基础上提出Meta-Predictive Clarity System（MPCS），当输出过度收敛时插入Re-Differentiation Protocol（RDP）。实验采用五主体集体配置（GPT-4o-mini和Gemini-2.5-flash），每条件310个配对片段，并进行机制标记分析。
AI.result: GPT-4o-mini上条件性异议使虚假前提恢复提升+17.7点（p<1e-6），而静态人格多样性反而损害恢复（-8.1，p=.007）；Gemini-2.5-flash上相同干预在可比预算下无增益（26.1% vs 27.1%，p=.84），即使已验证离散度下降。两模型处理效应差异显著（z=3.79，p<.001）。机制标记显示Gemini通过框架内异议保留虚假前提，94%的RDP后响应为改述而非让步（GPT仅24%）。建议在报告准确率的同时报告单位干预立场转变率和前提保留率。
AI.conclusion: 不同LLM配置对多样性干预的响应机制存在本质差异：多样性干预必须同时验证离散度变化和立场修正，才能避免将"表面多样化"误判为"认知演进"。论文建议将立场转变率和前提保留率作为集体智能评估的标准补充指标。

title: SEER: A Self-Grounded Evidence Interface for Controlled Spatial Relation Classification
summary: Spatial relation questions require a model to identify the queried subject and object before comparing their layout. Yet a VLM can recognize both entities and still answer from the wrong instance or an ambiguous global view. We ask whether making query-specific evidence explicit can mitigate this failure and propose SEER (Self-grounded Evidence for Entity-Relation Reasoning), a training-free inference-time evidence interface for frozen VLMs. SEER hides candidate relations during pair localization, constructs a query-specific view with explicit subject/object roles, and retains the full image and sparse box geometry as complementary evidence. For relation-choice protocols with exact inverse support, an optional refinement swaps the entity roles and changes the forward decision only when exactly one visual state obeys the corresponding inverse relation. On an image-disjoint GQA-Train900 test frozen before model scoring, SEER pools to +3.94 [2.17,5.72] over Full; the gain remains positive under label-independent grounding-order counterbalancing and on the 535 rows whose entity names are unique. The unchanged protocol yields +4.35 to +11.79 on all 2,434 filtered EmbSpatial pair-relation questions across three models. Matched controls separate local refocus from role-explicit conditioning. These results establish query-specific evidence construction as the principal intervention, with reciprocal consistency as a smaller protocol-specific refinement.

AI.tldr: SEER是一种无需训练的推理时证据接口，通过隐藏候选关系、构建查询特定的主体/客体角色视图，并保留完整图像和稀疏框几何作为补充证据，来缓解视觉语言模型在空间关系推理中因错误实例或模糊全局视图而导致的失败。
AI.motivation: 空间关系问题要求模型先识别查询的主体和客体，再比较它们的布局。然而，VLM即使能识别两个实体，仍可能从错误的实例或模糊的全局视角作答。作者质疑：能否通过使查询特定的证据显式化来缓解这一失败。
AI.method: SEER提出三种核心机制：(1) 在对定位阶段隐藏候选关系，避免配对偏差；(2) 构建带有显式主体/客体角色的查询特定视图；(3) 保留完整图像和稀疏框几何作为补充证据。此外，在具有精确逆支撑的关系选择协议中，可选细化步骤交换实体角色，并仅在恰好一个视觉状态符合相应逆关系时改变前向决策。
AI.result: 在图像不相交的GQA-Train900测试集上，SEER比Full基线平均提升+3.94个点（置信区间[2.17,5.72]）；在标签无关的定位顺序对抗平衡下及实体名称唯一的535行上增益仍为正。在未改变的协议下，三个模型在全部2,434条过滤后的EmbSpatial配对关系问题上提升+4.35至+11.79。匹配对照实验将局部重聚焦与角色显式条件化分离开来。
AI.conclusion: 查询特定证据构建是主要干预手段，而互逆一致性是较小的协议特定细化。该结果表明SEER作为一种训练无关的推理时接口，能有效提升冻结VLM的空间关系推理能力。

title: GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery
summary: Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GENESIS，一个可解释的混合因果发现框架。它通过将图构建分解为可解释的决策点（三节点结构基序打分、统计证据整合、领域知识补充），实现每条边的决策可追溯（decision traceability），在100%可追溯的前提下，其SHD性能优于纯统计方法并与LLM辅助方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法存在两个核心缺陷：(1) 纯统计方法在低样本量下难以消解结构歧义；(2) LLM辅助混合方法虽然通过语义推理改善结构恢复，但其推理过程对每条边的决策影响不透明，无法解释为何包含或排除某条边。在实际应用中不存在ground-truth DAG，每个结构决策都必须独立可辩护，因此需要形式化"决策可追溯性"这一要求。
AI.method: GENESIS框架分为两个阶段：(1) 首先识别并评分三节点结构基序（链、叉、对撞），建立透明的结构先验；(2) 逐步将结构先验与观测证据整合，仅在统计证据不足时引入领域知识。每条边的决策通过可审计的证据来源（统计证据、Markov Blanket一致性或显式领域推理）解决，从而保证决策可追溯性。
AI.result: 实验表明GENESIS在所有设置下均达到100%的决策可追溯性。在基准数据集上，GENESIS在大部分数据集的所有样本规模下，其结构汉明距离（SHD）优于纯统计因果发现方法，且性能与最先进的LLM辅助方法相当。
AI.conclusion: GENESIS证明了可解释性可以作为因果发现的一等公民目标，在不牺牲性能的前提下实现完全可追溯的因果图构建。这为实际应用中需要独立论证每条边合理性（无ground-truth）的场景提供了可行方案。

title: SAT-Edge-Agent: Hardware-in-the-Loop Edge-Agent Orchestration for Onboard Satellite Intelligence
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, and 10 tables. Code and sanitized research artifacts are available at https://github.com/keithhegit/SAT-Edge-Agent
summary: Onboard satellite intelligence requires a task layer that translates mission intent into local tool calls, exposes execution state, and returns machine-consumable artifacts under communication and power constraints. We present SAT-Edge-Agent, a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) edge-agent system deployed on a commercial off-the-shelf ARM-based heterogeneous edge system-on-chip. A browser workspace and FastAPI agent coordinate a local OpenAI-compatible language service with a project-internal YOLO-style oriented-object-detection endpoint that returns FAIR1M metadata-backed structured results. Two fixed FAIR1M workloads, one single-image and one serial two-image request, were repeated 20 times each and completed 20/20 attempts. Mean Full-Agent latency was 29.353 s and 60.937 s, with empirical P95 values of 31.166 s and 66.882 s. Mean detector time was 861.386 ms and 1510.920 ms, only 2.93% and 2.48% of the corresponding Full-Agent means. Profiling indicates that most visible latency occurs outside detector execution. Mean CPU utilization was 20.761% and 20.482%. A 200-ms NPU-load field averaged 100% for both workloads, but it represents a shared-accelerator software field rather than detector-only occupancy or calibrated utilization. The public evidence package provides sanitized request-level records, redacted JSON, normalized SSE examples, and scripts reproducing the reported statistics. These results establish a reproducible HIL boundary for observable satellite edge-agent orchestration, but do not establish detector accuracy, a new geolocation method, calibrated energy efficiency, or flight readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAT-Edge-Agent，一个部署在商用ARM异构边缘SoC上的硬件在环（HIL）卫星边缘智能体系统。通过浏览器工作区与FastAPI代理协调本地OpenAI兼容语言服务和面向目标检测端点，在两个FAIR1M固定工作负载下重复20次均全部成功完成，平均完整智能体延迟为29.353秒和60.937秒，但检测器仅占总延迟的约2.5-3%。结果表明了可复现的卫星边缘智能体编排边界，但不涉及检测精度、定位方法或飞行就绪性。
AI.motivation: 卫星在轨智能需要任务层将任务意图转换为本地工具调用、暴露执行状态并在通信和功耗约束下返回机器可消费的工件。现有工作缺乏可复现的端到端边缘智能体编排实证。
AI.method: 在商用ARM异构边缘SoC（硬件在环）上部署SAT-Edge-Agent系统：浏览器工作区与FastAPI代理协调本地OpenAI兼容语言服务，以及项目内部YOLO风格定向目标检测端点，该端点返回FAIR1M元数据支撑的结构化结果。执行20次重复实验，分别处理单图像和串行双图像请求，测量完整智能体延迟、检测器时间、CPU利用率及NPU负载。
AI.result: 两个工作负载均完成20/20次。平均完整智能体延迟为29.353秒和60.937秒，经验P95为31.166秒和66.882秒。平均检测器时间为861.386毫秒和1510.920毫秒，仅占完整智能体均值的2.93%和2.48%。平均CPU利用率为20.761%和20.482%。200毫秒NPU负载字段在两个工作负载中均平均为100%，但表示共享加速器软件字段而非检测器专属占用率。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了可复现的卫星边缘智能体编排HIL边界，但未建立检测精度、新地理定位方法、校准能效或飞行就绪性。公开证据包提供脱敏的请求级记录、编辑过的JSON、规范化SSE示例及复现统计的脚本。

title: Learning Biomechanically Plausible Human Motion from Sparse Radar Point Clouds
summary: Radar-based human pose estimation has focused on improving learning algorithms while representing the body as unconstrained keypoint coordinates. We address the underexplored dimension of anatomical fidelity by integrating a full-body skeletal model into a differentiable, end-to-end trainable radar-based pose estimation framework, in which the pose network is supervised through forward kinematics while subject-specific geometry is fitted beforehand. Subject-specific body segment proportions are predicted from radar point cloud features to scale a biomechanical skeleton. A motion prediction network maps temporal radar sequences to generalized coordinates, and differentiable forward kinematics converts predicted joint angles into 3D positions. A contact classification loss encourages physically plausible foot-ground interaction. Under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation on 11 healthy participants performing rehabilitation exercises, the framework achieves 6.456 +/- 1.759 cm mean per-joint position error (MPJPE), 8.083 +/- 0.884 degrees mean per-joint angle error (MPJAE), 0.935 +/- 0.009 contact classification F1, and 3.4 +/- 1.3 % scaling error. This proof-of-concept study demonstrates the feasibility of recovering interpretable biomechanical descriptors from a single low-cost radar sensor in a controlled laboratory setting, a prerequisite for future clinical motion analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于雷达的全身体骨架模型可微端到端姿态估计框架，通过前向运动学监督姿态网络，并结合接触分类损失，在11名健康受试者的康复运动数据集上实现了6.456cm的平均关节位置误差。
AI.motivation: 现有基于雷达的人体姿态估计主要聚焦于改进学习算法，但将人体表示为不受约束的关键点坐标，忽略了解剖学保真度这一维度。
AI.method: 将全身体骨骼模型集成到可微的端到端可训练的雷达姿态估计框架中：(1) 从雷达点云特征预测受试者特定的身体节段比例以缩放生物力学骨架；(2) 运动预测网络将时序雷达序列映射到广义坐标；(3) 可微前向运动学将预测的关节角度转换为3D位置；(4) 接触分类损失促进物理上合理的脚-地面交互。
AI.result: 在11名健康受试者执行康复运动的留一受试者交叉验证中，框架实现了MPJPE为6.456±1.759 cm，MPJAE为8.083±0.884度，接触分类F1得分为0.935±0.009，缩放误差为3.4±1.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证研究证明了在受控实验室环境中从单个低成本雷达传感器恢复可解释的生物力学描述符的可行性，这是未来临床运动分析的先决条件。

title: Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning
summary: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online without access to ground-truth supervision. SAFT leverages intrinsic structural priors to regularize the VLM's latent space via LoRA adapters. We rigorously evaluate SAFT across a spectrum of base model capabilities to demonstrate its versatility. Our results show that SAFT consistently denoises the reward landscape, yielding faster policy convergence and substantially improved alignment (EPIC distance) relative to the underlying base model, suggesting that failures can often be attributed to structural brittleness rather than semantic misunderstanding. By replacing extensive human preference annotation with structural inductive biases inherent to the task, SAFT offers a scalable path for stabilizing text-conditioned RL and underscores the broader value of incorporating task structure as a general inductive bias.

AI.tldr: SAFT是一种自监督方法，通过利用任务内在的结构先验对VLM的潜在空间进行LoRA适配器正则化，在线精炼嘈杂的奖励信号，无需真值监督即可加速策略收敛并提升对齐度。
AI.motivation: 手动设计奖励函数是RL的主要瓶颈；基于VLM的文本-观测相似度奖励虽然规避了人工设计，但奖励信号嘈杂不可靠，限制了部署中的直接效用。
AI.method: SAFT（Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning）通过LoRA适配器利用内在结构先验对VLM的潜在空间进行正则化，以自监督方式在线精炼不完美的奖励信号，无需真值监督。
AI.result: 在多种基础模型能力谱系上验证表明，SAFT能持续对奖励景观去噪，带来更快的策略收敛和显著改善的对齐度（EPIC距离），且失败往往源于结构脆弱性而非语义理解错误。
AI.conclusion: SAFT通过用结构归纳偏置替代大量人工偏好标注，为稳定文本条件RL提供了可扩展的路径，证明了将任务结构作为通用归纳偏置的价值。

title: CARE-Bench: Benchmarking Patient-Facing LLM Triage
comment: Code and data are available at GitHub and Hugging Face. Submitted as a preprint
summary: Patient-facing medical LLMs and agents increasingly answer symptom questions before clinician contact, where the key safety question is what action the user should take next. We introduce CARE-Bench, a source-grounded benchmark that evaluates sequential patient-facing triage as a four-label per-turn current-action task. CARE-Bench contains 500 cases and 1,059 evaluated patient-disclosure prefixes reconstructed from medical dialogue, consultation, and follow-up-question sources. We evaluate 11 models on 269 held-out rounds under unprompted and minimally prompted open-ended protocols, using a fixed GPT-5.5 mapper to code each response into the four-label action space. Unprompted macro-F1 remains low, ranging from 31.2 to 50.4. Prompting improves 10 of 11 models, with prompted macro-F1 ranging from 46.9 to 63.4, but substantial threshold errors remain. Prompted models often recommend care before needed clarification is obtained; when the correct action was to ask for more information, only 33.5% of prompted outputs preserved the step. The persistence of these errors after prompting suggests that patient-facing triage is not a simple prompting problem and supports explicit evaluation of action timing before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CARE-Bench，一个基于来源的基准测试，用于评估面向患者的医疗分诊系统作为四标签逐轮当前动作任务。对11个模型在269轮保留轮次上的评估显示，即使经过提示，模型的宏F1分数仍较低（46.9-63.4），且存在大量阈值错误，表明面向患者的分诊不是一个简单的提示工程问题。
AI.motivation: 面向患者的医疗LLM和智能体越来越多地在临床接触前回答症状问题，其中关键的安全问题是用户下一步应该采取什么行动。然而，现有的评估方法未能系统地评估这种顺序性的分诊决策能力，需要专门的基准来衡量模型在分诊过程中的动作时序选择是否安全。
AI.method: 构建了CARE-Bench基准测试，包含500个案例和1,059个评估的患者披露前缀，来源于医疗对话、咨询和后续提问数据。将其定义为四标签逐轮当前动作任务。在无提示和最小提示的开放端协议下评估11个模型共269轮保留轮次，使用固定的GPT-5.5映射器将每个响应编码到四标签动作空间中。
AI.result: 无提示的宏F1较低，范围为31.2至50.4。提示使10/11模型得到改善，提示后宏F1范围为46.9至63.4，但仍存在大量阈值错误。当正确动作是询问更多信息时，只有33.5%的提示输出保留了该步骤，模型常常在获得必要澄清之前就推荐了护理建议。
AI.conclusion: 提示后的错误持续存在表明面向患者的分诊不是一个简单的提示问题，支持在部署前对动作时序进行显式评估。这强调了需要专门的评估框架来确保患者安全。

title: When Do Fewer Visual Tokens Accelerate Multimodal Inference? A Break-Even Study Across Decision Locations and Hardware
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct on RTX 3090 and A100 PCIe GPUs
summary: Fewer visual tokens do not guarantee lower end-to-end latency. We evaluate break-even with a reproducible protocol that accounts for decision overhead, shared work, and the operators each policy can avoid. A stage-level decomposition reconciles these components with measured end-to-end latency. In a 30-example pilot, the two tested autoregressive probes remain slower than Full despite state reuse. A lightweight post-vision predictor yields paired confidence intervals below zero on RTX 3090 and A100 and remains significant after a conservative all-pairs Holm correction. A pre-vision image-size rule also yields intervals below zero on both GPUs, although neither comparison remains significant after the same correction. Pre-vision routing has a structural opportunity unavailable to post-vision pruning: it can avoid preprocessing and vision encoding. On A100, this opportunity outweighs a nearly eightfold larger downstream token reduction by the post-vision policy. Reported quality is conditional on examples answered correctly by Full and is not benchmark accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地评估了视觉语言模型中减少视觉token对端到端延迟的实际影响，发现更少的视觉token并不保证更低的端到端延迟。通过可复现的实验协议和阶段级分解，作者对比了全量（Full）处理与多种稀疏化策略（后视觉自回归预测量化裁剪、前视觉图像尺寸规则）的盈亏平衡点。结果显示后视觉预测器在两种GPU上显著降低延迟，而前视觉路由虽在结构上可避免预处理和视觉编码，其机会优势在统计显著性上弱于后视觉策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为减少视觉token数量就能降低推理延迟，但这种假设忽视了决策开销、共享工作以及各策略能避免的算子差异。作者旨在通过精确的盈亏平衡分析和端到端延迟分解，揭示视觉token稀疏化的真实延迟收益。
AI.method: 采用可复现的实验协议，将延迟分解为三个阶段以调和各组件与测得的端到端延迟。在30个示例的试点中，设计了两类策略：（1）后视觉自回归预测器，在视觉编码后预测并裁剪不重要的token；（2）前视觉图像尺寸规则，在视觉编码前根据图像尺寸决定是否跳过全部视觉处理。使用配对置信区间和全对Holm校正进行统计显著性检验，在RTX 3090和A100两种GPU上验证。
AI.result: 两种自回归预测器即使使用状态复用，仍比Full方案慢。轻量级后视觉预测器在RTX 3090和A100上均产生配对置信区间低于零的结果，且通过Holm校正后仍显著。前视觉图像尺寸规则在两种GPU上的区间也低于零，但Holm校正后不再显著。在A100上，前视觉路由的结构性机会（避免预处理和视觉编码）超过了后视觉策略接近8倍的下游token缩减收益。质量报告以Full回答正确的样本为条件，并非基准准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token稀疏化的延迟收益高度依赖策略结构：后视觉预测器在统计上能稳定带来端到端延迟降低，而前视觉路由虽具备更大的结构优化潜力（可跳过预处理和编码阶段），但其在严格统计校正下的显著性不足。端到端延迟优化必须考虑完整的计算图而非仅关注token数量的减少，且任何质量对比都应在统一条件下进行。

title: Operationally Feasible Synthetic Power-Grid Scenarios via Learning the AC-Operable Joint Distribution
summary: Synthetic power-grid scenarios are essential for planning, resilience assessment, contingency analysis, and data-driven power-system applications. Recent synthetic grid generation methods have improved structural realism and operational feasibility by incorporating engineering knowledge through post-generation validation, optimization, or physics-aware generation. However, generated scenarios may still exhibit low AC feasibility and robustness, limiting their practical value for downstream power-system studies. This paper proposes a feasibility-aware distribution-learning framework that learns the AC-operable joint distribution of network topology, branch electrical parameters, and time-varying load profiles. Instead of enforcing feasibility after generation, the proposed framework incorporates AC power-flow convergence and operational constraints into hierarchical diffusion-based distribution learning. This enables the generator itself to produce operationally feasible grid scenarios through efficient diffusion sampling. The hierarchical architecture decomposes the high-dimensional generation task into three engineering-motivated stages: topology and bus-attribute generation, branch-parameter generation conditioned on the generated structure, and load-profile generation conditioned on both network structure and electrical characteristics. Experiments on benchmark systems demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves operational feasibility and contingency robustness while maintaining strong statistical fidelity and eliminating optimization-based post-processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可行性感知的分布学习框架，通过分层扩散模型学习AC可运行的电力网络拓扑、支路参数和负荷分布联合分布，使生成器本身即可直接产生运行可行的电网场景，无需后处理优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的合成电网生成方法虽然在结构真实性和运行可行性上有所改进，但生成场景仍可能表现出较低的AC可行性和鲁棒性，限制了其在下游电力系统研究中的实际价值。传统方法在生成后强制验证和优化，缺乏生成阶段即可嵌入学知识的机制。
AI.method: 提出可行性感知的分布学习框架：将AC潮流收敛和运行约束纳入分层扩散生成模型中，分三个工程驱动的阶段进行生成——(1)拓扑和母线属性生成、(2)基于生成结构的支路参数生成、(3)基于网络结构和电气特性的负荷曲线生成。生成过程中直接嵌入AC可行性约束，替代生成后的优化后处理。
AI.result: 在基准电力系统上的实验表明，该框架显著提升了生成场景的运行可行性和事故鲁棒性，同时保持了较强的统计保真度，并消除了基于优化的后处理步骤。
AI.conclusion: 通过在生成过程中而非生成后嵌入AC运行约束，分层扩散框架能够在保持统计真实性的同时产出高AC可行性且强鲁棒性的合成电网场景，为下游电力系统研究提供更实用的数据支持。

title: Failure-Informed Image Self-Augmentation for Multimodal Large Language Model Self-Improvement
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across vision-language tasks, but their progress depends heavily on large-scale, high-quality multimodal data that are costly to annotate. Self-augmentation offers a promising alternative by enabling models to expand their own training data without external supervision. However, existing MLLM self-augmentation methods are largely text-centric, while image augmentation remains underexplored and typically relies on generic or handcrafted transformations that are weakly aligned with the model's actual incapability. We propose Failure-informed Image Self-Augmentation (\textbf{FISA}), a framework for MLLM self-improvement that constructs augmented images from the model's own failure cases. Our method generates visually challenging yet answer-preserving image complications, verifies their utility through self-examination, and applies dual fidelity filtering to avoid semantic distortion. Experiments on visual question answering benchmarks show that the proposed method consistently improves performance across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings. Further experiments validate the compatibility of FISA with existing textual self-augmentation approaches, the superior data efficiency of the synthesized samples over generic image augmentation baselines, and the practical effectiveness of the proposed filtering strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出FISA框架，从模型自身的失败案例中构建增强图像，通过自检验证和双保真度过滤实现MLLM自我改进，在VQA基准上显著提升分布内和分布外性能。
AI.motivation: MLLM的性能依赖大规模高质量多模态数据，但标注成本高昂。现有自增强方法多为文本中心，图像增强未被充分探索，且通常使用与模型实际能力弱点关联不足的通用或手工变换。
AI.method: FISA框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 从模型自身失败案例中生成视觉上具有挑战性但保持答案不变的图像复杂化；(2) 通过自我检查验证生成样本的效用；(3) 应用双重保真度过滤以避免语义扭曲。
AI.result: 在VQA基准上，FISA在分布内和分布外设置下均一致提升性能；与现有文本自增强方法兼容；相比于通用图像增强基线具有更高的数据效率；过滤策略在实际中有效。
AI.conclusion: FISA证明了从失败案例驱动图像自增强的有效性，为MLLM自改进提供了新范式，且与文本增强方法互补兼容。

title: Morphology-Aware Implicit Super-Resolution Network for Pathological Images
summary: Accurate diagnosis in Digital Pathology (DP) relies on high-resolution whole-slide images, yet clinical deployment is often limited by hardware costs. Super-Resolution (SR) offers a promising alternative by computationally enhancing low-resolution acquisitions. However, existing SR methods frequently struggle to preserve fine-grained cellular morphology, leading to texture oversmoothing and blurred structural boundaries under complex tissue variability. To address this issue, we propose Morph-ISR, a morphology-aware implicit super-resolution framework for DP that restores diagnostically relevant details with sub-pixel precision. Morph-ISR reformulates SR as a continuous coordinate-based reconstruction problem and integrates an Implicit Position-aware Kernel Generator (IPKG) to adaptively model spatially varying tissue morphology. To further enhance structural fidelity, a Morphological Fidelity Prior (MFP) is introduced, leveraging semantic guidance from a pre-trained cell segmentation network to enforce boundary-preserving and region-aware reconstruction, thereby improving the representation of critical cellular boundaries and nuclear textures. Experiments on TCGA and SurGen datasets show that Morph-ISR achieves the best LPIPS and ST-LPIPS among the evaluated methods, reducing them by up to 38.37% and 39.55%, respectively, over the second-best methods while maintaining strong PSNR and SSIM. These results demonstrate superior preservation of diagnostically relevant cellular boundaries and nuclear textures, while compact parameterization and high throughput support efficient edge deployment. Code and trained models will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Morph-ISR，一种面向数字病理图像的形态学感知隐式超分辨率框架，通过坐标连续重建、自适应核生成器以及基于预训练细胞分割网络的形态保真先验，在TCGA和SurGen数据集上实现了最佳LPIPS和ST-LPIPS（较次优方法降低38.37%和39.55%），有效保留了诊断相关的细胞边界和核纹理。
AI.motivation: 数字病理诊断依赖高分辨率全切片图像，但临床部署受限于硬件成本。超分辨率技术可通过计算增强低分辨率图像，但现有方法在复杂组织变异下难以保留精细细胞形态，存在纹理过度平滑和结构边界模糊的问题。
AI.method: Morph-ISR将超分辨率重构为连续坐标建模问题，包含两个核心组件：(1) 隐式位置感知核生成器（IPKG），自适应建模空间变化的组织形态；(2) 形态保真先验（MFP），利用预训练细胞分割网络的语义引导，强化边界保持与区域感知重建。
AI.result: 在TCGA和SurGen数据集上，Morph-ISR在LPIPS和ST-LPIPS指标上均达到最优，较第二名分别降低38.37%和39.55%，同时保持较强的PSNR和SSIM，且参数紧凑、吞吐量高，支持边缘部署。
AI.conclusion: Morph-ISR通过形态学感知的隐式超分辨率框架，显著优于现有方法在数字病理场景下对诊断相关细胞边界和核纹理的保留能力，兼顾性能与部署效率，具有临床转化潜力。

title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
comment: 15 pages of main text plus appendices; 12 tables. Code, per-seed data and all negative results at https://github.com/BiomeMakers/OmegaS-LLM
summary:
Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step.
  Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session.
  Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A^3), but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds.
  Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included.
  Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omega-S，一种仅从权重矩阵计算的正则化惩罚项，用于缓解大语言模型微调时的灾难性遗忘。它在Llama-3-8B上以LoRA方式从代码微调到散文，在HumanEval上相比无正则化将保留率从62.9%提升到84.1%。该方法无需旧数据、Fisher矩阵或旧权重副本，仅需三行代码，额外开销低于4%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在新数据上微调会退化其已学到的能力（灾难性遗忘）。现有的缓解方法（如EWC、权重衰减）通常需要旧数据、Fisher矩阵或旧权重副本，这在实际中受限。作者旨在提出一种纯粹从当前权重矩阵计算、无需额外存储或历史信息的轻量级正则化方法。
AI.method: Omega-S是从权重矩阵单独计算的正则化惩罚项，目标函数基于Tr(A^3)构造，具备拓扑特性。它作为drop-in惩罚项加入现有训练循环，只需三行代码。作者还进行了机制测量（而非仅断言），通过对四个因子对权重的弹性分析，发现三个因子弹性低于1e-4，而度方差项为9e-3，表明实际起作用的惩罚是对节点度方差的约束。作者还提出了一个对比保持（contrast-preserving）的构造变体，但该变体在所有十个种子上使保留效果更差。
AI.result: 在Llama-3-8B上使用LoRA，从代码微调到散文，以HumanEval为指标，在10个种子上：相比无正则化，9/10个种子保留更多原始能力（pass@1从0.173提升到0.238，保留率从62.9%提升到84.1%，sign test p=0.011，Wilcoxon p=0.006）；10/10胜过调优的权重衰减（p=0.002）；8/10胜过调优的EWC（p=0.014）。作者还量化了相同配置重复实验的标准差为0.104，这在低秩语言模型微调文献中尚属首次报告。
AI.conclusion: Omega-S提供了一种简单、低成本、无需历史数据的正则化方法，能显著改善LLM微调时的能力保留。同时，作者强调通过机制测量揭示方法实际生效的因子（度方差而非拓扑结构），并公开了所有代码、逐种子结果及负面结果记录。此外，重复实验标准差的量化表明所有种子配对比较都应考虑该噪声边界。

title: AgenticECO: An Agentic Framework for ECO on 3D Integrated Circuits
summary: As Moore's law slows, the industry is turning to three-dimensional integration; yet in merged 3D-IC flows, routed designs expose bond-level defects with no 2D analogue, and post-route engineering change orders (ECO) remain manual, expertise-bound work. Worse, the standard edit-then-fully-reroute practice entangles a repair with router churn, so a signoff number cannot be attributed to the edit that motivated it. We present AgenticECO, an evidence-gated tool-using agent workflow for 3D-IC ECO on the open-source TaiWei flow, paired with EcoRoute, a minimal-disturbance ECO-routing layer that drives the unmodified pinned router so a repair is attributable to its edit. Across nine matched natural defect cases under identical budgets, AgenticECO clears seven versus two for both full reroute and stock repair, at 0.66\% mean disturbance over cleared cases and zero clock nets touched, and a cross-backbone rerun under the same sealed contract clears all nine. Controlled studies show that the repair moves are necessary under preservation, that occupancy-aware choice buys legal landings rather than repair success, and that under tightened clocks minimal disturbance flips accept versus reject. Three preregistered visual studies localize the pixel instrument's edge to contested landing sites, and a preregistered blind diagnostic exactly restores every held-out injected defect, the only arm with zero wrong edits. Every accepted result passes routing, fresh extraction, max/min timing, DRC, and structural-equivalence gates. Code, environment, and per-episode audit artifacts are released as supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticECO，一个基于证据门控的工具使用智能体工作流，用于3D-IC工程变更指令（ECO），并配套EcoRoute最小扰动ECO布线层，使修复可与编辑归因。在九个匹配的自然缺陷案例中以相同预算清除七例（对比全重布线和支持修复的两例），平均扰动0.66%且零时钟网络受影响，跨骨干线路在相同密封合约下清除全部九例。
AI.motivation: 随着摩尔定律放缓，业界转向3D集成，但合并3D-IC流程中布线后的设计会暴露无2D对照的键合级缺陷；后布线ECO仍依赖人工和专家知识。更严重的是，标准的"编辑后全重布线"做法将修复与布线器的churn纠缠在一起，导致签核数字无法归因于引发它的编辑。
AI.method: 提出AgenticECO，一个证据门控的工具使用智能体工作流，运行在开源TaiWei 3D-IC流程上；并配以EcoRoute，一个最小扰动ECO布线层，通过驱动未修改的固定引脚布线器使修复可归因于其编辑。
AI.result: 在九个匹配的自然缺陷案例和相同预算下，AgenticECO清除七例（对比全重布线和库存修复的两例），清除案例平均扰动0.66%且零时钟网络受影响；跨骨干线路以相同密封合约运行清除全部九例。受控研究表明修复动作在保持（preservation）下是必要的，占用感知选择带来合法落点而非修复成功；收紧时钟下最小扰动翻转"接受vs拒绝"。三个预注册视觉研究将像素工具的优势定位在有争议的落点位置；预注册盲诊断恰好恢复所有保留的注入缺陷，是唯一具有零错误编辑的臂。所有接受结果均通过布线、全新提取、最大/最小时序、DRC和结构等价门控。
AI.conclusion: AgenticECO配EcoRoute在3D-IC ECO任务上显著优于全重布线和库存修复基线，实现低扰动、可归因、零错误编辑的修复；精确归因到编辑本身，并通过严格的多项签核门控验证。代码、环境和逐轮审计工件作为补充材料发布。

title: XiDepth: a Lightweight and Efficient Network for Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation has emerged as an appealing solution to design lightweight and effective models for deployment on computationally constrained devices due to its reduced reliance on expensive depth sensors. By eliminating the need for ground-truth annotations and leveraging the simplicity of monocular camera setups, this approach facilitates cost-effective data collection and broad applicability across fields such as computer vision and robotics. A critical challenge is achieving resource-efficient neural networks without compromising the overall performance. State-of-the-art models generally adopt depth-wise convolutions and attention mechanisms; however, these functions often incur high energy costs and face compatibility issues in embedded environments. To address this, we propose XiDepth, a lightweight architecture based on the XiNet operator block, designed to enhance feature extraction while maintaining low computational complexity and energy demand. On the KITTI dataset, XiDepth achieves state-of-the-art performance with only 0.8M parameters. Tests on a Raspberry Pi 4 further confirm its suitability for real-world embedded applications, reducing FLOPs by 40% and energy consumption by 35% compared to leading methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XiDepth，一种基于XiNet算子块的轻量级自监督单目深度估计架构，仅需0.8M参数即在KITTI数据集上达到最先进性能，并在树莓派4上验证了其嵌入式适用性，相比主流方法FLOPs降低40%、能耗降低35%。
AI.motivation: 自监督单目深度估计因其无需昂贵深度传感器和地面真值标注而具有广泛适用性，但现有最先进模型采用的深度可分离卷积和注意力机制能耗高且与嵌入式环境存在兼容性问题。研究动机是在保持性能的同时实现资源高效的神经网络。
AI.method: 提出XiDepth轻量级架构，基于XiNet算子块设计，旨在增强特征提取能力的同时保持低计算复杂度和低能耗，替代传统深度可分离卷积和注意力机制。
AI.result: 在KITTI数据集上以仅0.8M参数达到最先进性能；在树莓派4上的测试表明，相比主流方法FLOPs降低40%，能耗降低35%，验证了其在嵌入式环境中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: XiDepth证明了通过创新的算子块设计，可以在资源受限的嵌入式设备上实现高性能自监督单目深度估计，兼顾精度、计算效率和能耗效益。

title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
summary: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one source layer explains 56% of variance in the target's keys and 32% in values, rising to 79% and 65% with multiple source layers. Building on this, we design a closed-form ridge mapper that operates per head and proceeds in three steps. First, for each target layer we select the top-k most predictive source layers and concatenate their KV as input. Second, we strip RoPE from the keys before mapping, so the fit is position-free and reusable across context lengths. Third, we fit ridge regression on a small calibration set of 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens each. Surprisingly, across six pairs in three families, this linear mapper retains 73-98% of the receiver's standalone-prefill accuracy on four pairs, while two degrade sharply. A nonlinear MLP recovers up to +37 pp HellaSwag retention on the failures. The mapper runs 2.7-25x faster than re-prefill and remains stable across multi-turn handoff, making cross-model KV cache transfer practical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模型KV缓存迁移技术，允许模型家族中不同大小的模型在切换时复用源模型的KV缓存，跳过预填充阶段。研究发现跨模型KV对之间存在显著的线性结构，基于此设计了一个封闭形式的逐头岭回归映射器，在500条校准序列上即可拟合，保留73-98%的接收模型独立预填充精度（四对模型对上），且运行速度比重新预填充快2.7-25倍。
AI.motivation: 生产部署中经常在模型家族的不同大小模型之间切换（如成本-质量级联、会话中途切换、路由），每次切换都迫使接收模型从头支付预填充（prefill）计算开销，导致显著延迟和算力浪费。作者希望消除这一开销，让接收模型直接复用源模型的KV缓存。
AI.method: 首先发现跨模型KV对（匹配KV对，即KV头数和每头维度相同）之间存在显著的线性结构。其次设计一个封闭形式的岭回归映射器，逐头操作，分三步：(1) 对每个目标层选择top-k个最具预测力的源层并拼接其KV作为输入；(2) 映射前先剥离RoPE位置编码，使拟合与位置无关，可跨上下文长度复用；(3) 在500条FineWeb-Edu序列（各1024 token）的小型校准集上拟合岭回归。对线性映射失败的模型对，使用非线性MLP进行恢复。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族的六对模型对上，线性映射器在四对上保留了73-98%的接收模型独立预填充精度，两对显著退化。非线性MLP在失败对上恢复了高达+37个百分点的HellaSwag保留率。映射器运行速度比重新预填充快2.7-25倍，并在多轮对话切换中保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型KV缓存迁移是实用的，其核心在于利用跨模型KV之间可学习的线性/非线性映射关系，以极小校准成本（500条序列）实现接收模型跳过预填充，同时保持大部分精度并显著提速，为模型家族间的高效切换提供了可行方案。

title: MissClick: Exploiting Digit-Serialized Coordinates to Attack GUI Grounding Models
summary: Recent GUI visual grounding models generate screen coordinates as sequences of digit tokens that are parsed into numerical values and mapped to executable clicks. The security implications of this coordinate generation process have been largely overlooked. We observe that each coordinate digit is predicted as a categorical token, yet after parsing, changing a hundreds-place digit by one changes the corresponding numerical coordinate component by 100 units, which can induce a large displacement of the executed click. This observation motivates attack objectives that account for the numerical and place-value structure of coordinate outputs rather than treating them as ordinary text. Moreover, untargeted and targeted attacks impose different success conditions--displacing the click outside the correct region versus into an attacker-specified region--and therefore benefit from different objectives. We propose MissClick, a simple and effective white-box adversarial attack with two goal-specific objectives: MissClick-U maximizes soft-coordinate displacement for untargeted disruption, while MissClick-T minimizes a place-weighted target-digit loss for targeted hijacking. Compared with existing attacks against GUI grounding models on OS-Atlas and UGround across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, MissClick-U achieves untargeted success rates of 75.07\% and 72.93\% (+16.62 and +30.72 pp), and MissClick-T achieves targeted success rates of 44.86\% and 62.67\% (+31.73 and +47.06 pp). Attack objective comparison further shows that soft-coordinate displacement yields the highest untargeted attack success rate, whereas place-weighted target-digit optimization yields the highest targeted attack success rate, revealing distinct objective preferences for the two attack goals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MissClick，一种针对GUI视觉基础模型坐标生成过程的白盒对抗攻击框架。该攻击利用坐标数字被作为分类token逐位预测的特点，设计了两种目标特定的攻击目标：MissClick-U（最大化软坐标位移，实现非定向破坏）和MissClick-T（最小化按位加权目标数字损失，实现定向劫持）。在OS-Atlas和UGround上跨桌面、web和移动平台，非定向攻击成功率分别达75.07%和72.93%，定向攻击成功率分别达44.86%和62.67%，显著优于现有攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI视觉基础模型将屏幕坐标生成为数字token序列并解析为数值以执行点击，但这一坐标生成过程的安全隐患被严重忽视。由于每个坐标数字被预测为分类token，改变百位数字1个单位会导致坐标产生100个单位的位移，从而造成点击大幅偏移。此外，非定向和定向攻击的成功条件不同，需要不同的攻击目标函数，而现有攻击未考虑坐标输出的数值与位值结构。
AI.method: 提出MissClick，一种简单的白盒对抗攻击框架，包含两个目标特定的目标函数：(1) MissClick-U：最大化软坐标位移（soft-coordinate displacement），用于非定向破坏；(2) MissClick-T：最小化按位加权目标数字损失（place-weighted target-digit loss），用于定向劫持。该方法考虑了坐标输出的数值和位值结构，而非将其视为普通文本token。
AI.result: 在OS-Atlas和UGround模型上跨桌面、web和移动平台进行测试：MissClick-U非定向攻击成功率达75.07%和72.93%（较现有攻击提升16.62和30.72个百分点）；MissClick-T定向攻击成功率达44.86%和62.67%（较现有攻击提升31.73和47.06个百分点）。攻击目标对比实验表明软坐标位移目标对非定向攻击最优，而按位加权目标数字优化对定向攻击最优，揭示了两种攻击目标对目标函数的不同偏好。
AI.conclusion: GUI基础模型的坐标生成过程存在明显安全漏洞，且非定向与定向攻击需要采用不同的目标函数才能达到最佳效果。MissClick证明了针对坐标数值结构的攻击设计能显著提升攻击成功率，为GUI基础模型的安全研究提供了新的视角，也警示需要更关注此类模型坐标输出的鲁棒性与安全性。

title: Keep the Needle, Prune the Haystack: Defect-Preserving Token Pruning for Efficient Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Zero-shot visual anomaly detection has achieved remarkable progress, with recent vision-only approaches further improving performance while simplifying the inference pipeline. However, existing methods typically perform dense computation over all images and spatial tokens, despite the fact that normal samples dominate real-world scenarios and anomalies usually occupy only small regions. Token pruning offers a promising solution, but introduces an asymmetric pruning risk in anomaly detection: retaining normal tokens mainly incurs redundant computation, whereas removing anomalous tokens may eliminate the only evidence for detection and localization. This risk is particularly severe in early layers, where pruning provides the greatest computational benefit but anomaly semantics remain unreliable. We propose KeepAD, a defect-preserving token pruning framework that formulates token selection as high-recall, anomaly-aware routing. In shallow layers, KeepAD combines coverage-preserving selection over local $2\times2$ patch neighborhoods with deterministic anomaly rescue to reduce the risk of discarding subtle defects. In deeper layers, frozen normal and abnormal prototypes guide pruning under an image-adaptive token budget, aggressively removing low-risk normal tokens while preserving local anomaly evidence. Dense-to-sparse self-distillation further supervises early token routing without introducing additional inference overhead. Experiments on six industrial and seven medical zero-shot anomaly detection benchmarks show that KeepAD reduces the token retention ratio to below $20\%$, while limiting the average degradation in image-level and pixel-level AUROC to within $2.7$ percentage points. At the most aggressive operating point, KeepAD achieves a $7.9\times$ speedup over the strongest CLIP-based baseline.

AI.tldr: KeepAD是一个缺陷保留的token剪枝框架，用于零样本视觉异常检测。通过高召回率的异常感知路由实现token选择：浅层结合局部2×2邻域覆盖保留与确定性异常救援，深层利用冻结的正常/异常原型在图像自适应token预算下进行剪枝，配合稠密到稀疏的自蒸馏。在六个工业和七个医学基准上将token保留率降至20%以下，AUROC平均下降仅2.7个百分点以内，最激进配置下相对最强CLIP基线获得7.9倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本视觉异常检测方法对所有图像和空间token进行稠密计算，但实际场景中正常样本占主导且异常通常只占据小区域，造成大量冗余计算。直接引入token剪枝存在非对称剪枝风险：保留正常token只增加冗余计算，而移除异常token可能消除检测和定位的唯一证据，尤其在浅层剪枝收益最大但异常语义最不可靠。
AI.method: KeepAD包含三个核心组件：(1) 浅层采用覆盖保留的局部2×2补丁邻域选择与确定性异常救援机制，降低丢弃细微缺陷的风险；(2) 深层利用冻结的正常与异常原型，在图像自适应token预算下激进移除低风险正常token同时保留局部异常证据；(3) 稠密到稀疏的自蒸馏监督早期token路由，不引入额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在六个工业和七个医学零样本异常检测基准上，KeepAD将token保留率降至20%以下，图像级和像素级AUROC平均退化限制在2.7个百分点以内。在最激进的运行点，相对最强的CLIP基线实现7.9倍加速。
AI.conclusion: KeepAD通过异常感知的token路由框架，在显著降低计算开销的同时保持异常检测和定位精度，验证了token剪枝在零样本异常检测中的可行性和有效性。

title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction
summary: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).

AI.tldr: 提出稀疏权重分解（SWD）方法，将预训练Transformer的线性投影权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子，其共享中间坐标可作为可寻址的电路单元，无需训练独立替换网络即可支持电路提取工作流，在更低数据需求下达到与强基线相当的保真度。
AI.motivation: 稠密预训练Transformer不会自然暴露可解释的电路提取单元。现有方法通过学习辅助稀疏表示或训练稀疏模型来获得这些单元，但会引入大量额外计算开销，且分析所基于的表示与原始预训练模型之间存在保真度差距。需要一种无需替代网络、直接基于原始预训练模型进行电路提取的方法。
AI.method: SWD将预训练线性投影的权重矩阵重参数化为两个稀疏因子矩阵，二者共享的中间坐标作为独立可寻址的电路单元。该参数化表示支持与学习稀疏特征方法相同的评分、选择和消融电路提取工作流，但无需训练单独的替换网络。还提出零数据变体，无需任何数据即可进行机制可解释性分析。
AI.result: 在单矩阵替换实验中，SWD使用不到强基线1%的训练数据即达到与Transcoder等基线相当的保持保真度。在匹配替换保真度下，SWD在GPT-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3.5-27B上以更少的激活读写边和更少的选择单元达到相同的电路充分性和必要性目标。此外对全部注意力和MLP权重矩阵进行微调后，SWD仍能有效支持全模型替换。
AI.conclusion: SWD提供了一种高效、保真的稀疏重参数化方案，消除了替代网络训练带来的计算开销和保真度差距，同时支持大规模模型的全模型电路提取，并具备零数据变体以扩展机制可解释性分析的应用范围。

title: Agents Catching Agents: Shortcut Cascades and Benchmark Gaming in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace. We ask whether such committees can be gamed by shortcuts, cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public datasets spanning text (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports), imaging (NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert) and tabular ICU records (SUPPORT2), Gemini committees resist these cues in isolation (flip 5-16%), yet a socially plausible shortcut spreads: when two peers assert the same wrong answer, the holdout under test adopts it in 38% of cases, as does a false "pre-screen" system flag, on both capability tiers. Of three oversight agents, a gate cannot separate adoption from honest agreement (false-positive rate 100%); a same-lineage judge reading only the transcript flags adoption on text (precision 100%, recall 93%) but collapses onto the gate in imaging; a referee that privately re-queries the holdout transfers to imaging (77-88% precision, 13-21% false-positive rate). Tripling a cue's visual salience does not move contagion, whereas a second peer voice raises it by half again. Gaming a hidden rubric is near-silent: only 1/10 text and 1/134 imaging drifters name the rubric they moved toward. What games a committee is social plausibility, and only a referee independent of self-report catches it. Code: https://github.com/criticaldata/benchmaxxing

AI.tldr: 本文研究临床决策支持系统中语言模型智能体委员会是否可被"捷径"（shortcuts）所操控，即基准测试奖励但临床医生会忽略的线索。通过对6个公共数据集的7个队列（涵盖文本、影像和表格数据）进行测试，发现委员会在孤立情况下对线索有较好抵抗（翻转率5-16%），但社会性合理的捷径会传播：当两个同伴给出相同错误答案或被"预筛查"系统标记时，受测智能体在38%的案例中会采纳该错误。三种监督智能体中，门控无法区分采纳与真诚同意（误报率100%），同源裁判在文本上有效但在影像上失效，而独立重询的仲裁者在影像上表现良好（77-88%精确率，13-21%误报率）。结论是委员会最容易被社会性合理性的欺骗所影响，只有独立于自我报告的仲裁者能识别。
AI.motivation: 随着临床决策支持系统向多语言模型智能体委员会协作的方向发展，需要考察这些委员会是否可以被基准测试奖励但临床医生会忽略的"捷径"所欺骗，从而评估其可靠性和安全性。
AI.method: 在6个公共数据集的7个队列上进行系统实验，涵盖三种模态：文本（MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、MIMIC-CXR报告）、影像（NIH ChestX-ray14、MIMIC-CXR-JPG、CheXpert）和表格ICU记录（SUPPORT2）。测试委员会对孤立线索的抵抗能力、社会性捷径（同伴一致错误、预筛查误报）的传播效应，并评估三种监督智能体（门控、同源裁判、独立仲裁者）检测采纳的能力。
AI.result: 委员会在孤立线索下翻转率仅5-16%，但社会性合理捷径显著有效：两个同伴一致错误导致38%的采纳率，预筛查假标志在两个能力层级均同样有效。门控无法区分采纳与真诚同意（误报率100%），同源裁判在文本上精确率100%、召回率93%但在影像上失效，独立仲裁者迁移到影像领域表现良好（77-88%精确率，13-21%误报率）。视觉显著性增加三倍不影响传染，但第二个同伴声音使其增加50%。只有1/10文本和1/134影像漂移者提到其所趋近的隐藏评分标准。
AI.conclusion: 委员会的脆弱性源于社会性合理的欺骗而非基准线明显的捷径，且仅有独立于自我报告的仲裁者能够有效检测这种操控，这对临床决策支持系统的安全性设计具有重要启示。

title: MultiCompose: Multi-Concept Personalized Composition with Per-Subject Attribute Binding
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models enable personalization of specific visual concepts from a small number of reference images. However, generating a single image that contains multiple personalized subjects, each bound to user-specified attributes such as clothing, accessories, and held objects, remains largely unaddressed. Without explicit spatial constraints, concurrently activated concept checkpoints produce overlapping cross-attention responses, causing per-subject identity degradation and attribute misalignment. Moreover, no established benchmark jointly evaluates these two failure modes in the personalized multi-subject setting. We present MultiCompose, a composition framework that decouples per-concept personalization from multi-subject inference. A semantic preservation regularization maintains attribute binding capacity during fine-tuning, while a two-phase inference procedure automatically establishes subject layout and composes per-concept predictions through spatially exclusive masks. We further introduce MSP-Bench, a benchmark that jointly evaluates identity fidelity (ID), attribute binding accuracy (BIND), and attribute misalignment (MIS) through a dual-pathway protocol. Experiments show that MultiCompose outperforms existing methods on both conventional metrics and MSP-Bench, confirming the benchmark's ability to reveal failure modes that conventional metrics overlook. Code is available at https://github.com/I2-Multimedia-Lab/MultiCompose

AI.tldr: 提出MultiCompose框架解决文本到图像扩散模型中多个个性化主体共同生成时的身份退化与属性错位问题，并引入MSP-Bench基准联合评估身份保真度、属性绑定准确性和属性错位三个维度。实验表明MultiCompose在传统指标和MSP-Bench上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型的个性化方法虽能从少量参考图像学习特定视觉概念，但无法有效处理多个个性化主体同时出现在单张图像中且各自绑定用户指定属性（如服装、配饰、手持物）的场景。在缺乏显式空间约束时，同时激活的概念检查点会产生重叠的交叉注意力响应，导致主体身份退化和属性错位。此外，现有基准未能联合评估这两种失败模式。
AI.method: MultiCompose框架包含两大核心组件：(1)语义保持正则化（semantic preservation regularization），在微调阶段维持概念主体的属性绑定能力；(2)两阶段推理过程（two-phase inference），自动确立各主体的空间布局，并通过空间互斥掩码（spatially exclusive masks）组合各概念的预测结果。同时提出MSP-Bench基准，采用双路径协议（dual-pathway protocol）联合评估身份保真度（ID）、属性绑定准确性（BIND）和属性错位（MIS）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明MultiCompose在传统评估指标和MSP-Bench基准上均优于现有方法，同时验证了MSP-Bench基准能够揭示传统指标所忽视的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦单概念个性化与多主体推理、引入语义保持正则化和空间互斥掩码，MultiCompose有效解决了多主体个性化生成中的身份退化与属性错位问题；MSP-Bench为多主体个性化场景提供了更全面的联合评估基准。

title: Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching
summary: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Acceleration Matching (AM)的轨迹推断新算法，通过将插值问题提升到相空间并回归显式条件加速度场，避免轨迹模拟和昂贵预处理，在多个基准问题上达到或超越现有算法性能。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹推断算法存在计算挑战：依赖预处理子程序来强制平滑性，或依赖基于模拟的训练目标，两者都可能代价高昂。需要一种更高效的方法来克服这些局限。
AI.method: 将原始插值问题提升到相空间（相位空间），回归到一个显式的条件加速度场上，该场可生成随机平滑轨迹且与给定边际分布一致。训练算法仅需位置数据，避免训练中的轨迹模拟，且无需昂贵的预处理。
AI.result: 大量数值实验表明，AM算法在多个现有文献基准问题上与现有算法具有竞争力或优于现有算法。
AI.conclusion: AM算法通过相空间提升和条件加速度场回归，有效解决了轨迹推断中的计算效率问题，同时保持或提升了轨迹质量。

title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. We introduce HazMart, a human-written dataset set in an autonomous AI shopkeeper scenario. Unlike prior work that relies on providing hints in prompts to test faithfulness (e.g., "A Stanford professor said it should be Answer A"), we propose a novel replacement-based technique, which we call Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR), that directly intervenes in the reasoning chain to substitute in unsafe or illogical thoughts (e.g., "Wait, the answer must be Option B [was Option A] because it is the most fitting"). DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B exhibits high faithfulness (97.5%) but fails to reject Unsafe Reasoning (12.3%), while QwQ-32B is more robust (73.9% safety) at the cost of lower faithfulness (74.7%). Mechanistic analyses of QwQ-32B reveal that these properties are represented by anti-correlated internal directions peaking at the action-commit token. Finally, we demonstrate that representation steering can independently amplify the safety direction, increasing safe behavior by 9 percentage points while maintaining base capabilities.

title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
summary: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alternating or uppercase against a lowercase context concentrates attention on those textual spans. In text this effect is universal, holding across every evaluated non-reasoning model. We frame it as a previously under-explored latent property of pretrained transformers rather than a prescriptive method. Our investigation reveals a central attention-performance divergence: while this "casing effect" robustly shifts attention, its impact on downstream accuracy is non-trivial, increased concentration does not inherently improve task accuracy and, in high-entropy contexts like alternating case, can degrade it. We further identify a boundary condition: the deliberative "thinking" phase in reasoning models acts as a semantic buffer that mitigates typographic sensitivity in text. Extending the study to VLMs, we find the effect transfers partially: the same prompt-side casing reorganizes cross-modal attention along two coupled axes, predominantly a macroscopic disengagement from the image toward the text prompt, and secondarily a concentration of the residual visual attention on the target region. By isolating casing as a zero-shot mechanism for attention steering that requires no model access or fine-tuning, we provide a new foundational understanding of how pretraining internalizes typographic emphasis.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大小写字母变换（casing effect）对大型语言模型（LLMs）内部注意力分配的调节作用，发现将目标文本格式化为交替大小写或全大写（相对于小写上下文）能集中注意力于该文本片段。该效应在13个模型（9个LLM和4个VLM）中普遍存在，但注意力的集中并不必然提升下游任务准确性，在高熵场景（如交替大小写）甚至可能降低性能。推理模型的"思考"阶段可作为语义缓冲区缓解文字敏感性，VLM中该效应部分迁移，主要表现为图像向文本提示的宏观注意力脱离。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉感知中，大写字母是自然的显著性线索，能吸引注意。作者推测LLM可能存在类似的属性——字母大小写可以调节内部注意力分配，但此前这一潜在属性尚未被系统探索，也未被作为零样本的注意力操控手段加以利用。
AI.method: 在13个模型（包括9个LLM和4个VLM，涵盖多种分词方案）上进行系统实证分析，通过在文本中将目标信息格式化为交替大小写或全大写（置于小写上下文中），追踪注意力分布变化，并评估其对下游任务准确率的影响。同时分析推理模型与非推理模型的差异，以及VLM中跨模态注意力的重组模式。
AI.result: 发现：(1) casing effect在所有被评估的非推理模型中普遍存在，能将注意力集中于目标文本跨度；(2) 存在注意力-性能出离现象：注意力集中不必然提升准确率，在高熵上下文（交替大小写）中可能损害性能；(3) 推理模型的思考阶段充当语义缓冲区，减轻了文字敏感度；(4) VLM中效应部分迁移，表现为沿两条耦合轴线的重组织——宏观上图像向文本提示的注意力脱离，以及残差视觉注意力集中在目标区域。
AI.conclusion: 大小写变换可作为零样本的注意力引导机制，无需模型访问或微调。这项工作提供了对预训练模型如何内化排版强调的新基础性理解，揭示了一个此前未充分探索的预训练Transformer潜在属性。

title: PRISM: Powerful Time Series to Image (TS2I) Representations for Multivariate Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins applications in predictive maintenance, finance, and cloud computing, however performance remains sensitive to representation choices, especially in multivariate settings. While transforming time series into images has shown success in forecasting and classification, it remains unclear how multivariate, high-dimensional series should be mapped to multi-channel images and whether vision backbones can match time-domain baselines in TSAD. We introduce PRISM, a plug-and-play meta-workflow enabling systematic construction and evaluation of image-based representations for multivariate TSAD.
