Our evaluation spanning over 7,000 experiments shows that well-designed PRISM configurations are competitive with 24 time-domain baselines, achieving the best VUS-PR on 10 of 14 datasets, with an average improvement of 41% over the best competing method on those datasets. Further, we identify channelization - how the channel dimension of multi-channel images is constructed - as a critical and previously understudied design dimension, and introduce MSM, a novel statistics-based scheme achieving 11-27% gains over PCA-based alternatives. Finally, ImageNet-pretrained encoders transfer effectively to TSAD, with frozen encoders retaining 92% of fine-tuned performance while training 1.8 times faster. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Smendowski/PRISM.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个即插即用的元工作流，系统性地构建和评估基于图像表示的多变量时间序列异常检测方案。通过超过7000个实验，PRISM配置在14个数据集上的10个中取得最佳VUS-PR，平均优于最佳对比方法41%。论文还提出MSM通道化方案（较PCA方案提升11-27%），并发现ImageNet预训练编码器可有效迁移到TSAD，冻结编码器保留92%的微调性能且训练速度快1.8倍。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）在预测性维护、金融和云计算等领域至关重要，但性能对表示选择高度敏感，尤其在多变量场景下。虽然将时间序列转换为图像在预测和分类任务中已获成功，但多变量高维序列如何映射为多通道图像、以及视觉骨干网络能否匹配时域基线在TSAD中的表现，仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 提出PRISM，一个即插即用的元工作流，支持系统化构建和评估基于图像的多变量TSAD表示。工作流包含多个设计维度，其中特别识别出"通道化"（channelization）——即多通道图像中通道维度如何构建——是一个关键但此前被忽视的设计维度。为此提出MSM（一种基于统计的新方案），并系统性地对比PCA等替代方案。整个方法通过超过7000个实验进行全面评估。
AI.result: 1) 精心设计的PRISM配置可与24个时域基线竞争，在14个数据集的10个上取得最佳VUS-PR，平均提升41%；2) MSM方案较PCA替代方案获得11-27%的提升；3) ImageNet预训练编码器可有效迁移，冻结编码器保留92%的微调性能且训练快1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 图像化表示经过合理设计后可以匹配甚至超越时域基线的TSAD性能；通道化维度是影响多变量TSAD图像表示效果的关键设计因素；预训练视觉编码器的迁移学习在TSAD任务上具有高效性和有效性。代码已开源。

title: GDPevo: Evaluating Agent Self-Evolution on Real Business Tasks
summary: Agent self-evolution updates an agent's persistent state from prior experience and reuses it to solve related tasks more effectively. Evaluating self-evolution is difficult: existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of economically valuable task domains, do not always design training and test tasks such that test-time gains can be attributed to training experience, and remain vulnerable to data contamination. We present GDPevo, an evolution-native benchmark grounded in GDP-related enterprise workflows, together with the fully automated data pipeline that generates it. Its core mechanism, rule hybridization, decomposes each enterprise workflow into atomic business rules, distributes subsets of these rules across training tasks, and recombines them in held-out test tasks so that test-time gains are attributable. GDPevo spans CRM, ERP, finance, healthcare, legal, and data-centric workflows. Its V1 release contains 120 tasks in 12 groups, with five training and five held-out test tasks per group. Full automation enables the pipeline to expand the suite to 240 tasks in 24 groups (V2) within two days, providing a practical response to contamination. Using GDPevo, we evaluate four agents, each comprising a harness and a model, under four supervision types. Self-evolution consistently improves held-out accuracy by up to 16.44 percentage points. But the best evolved agents remain far below the fully informed oracle ceiling of 91.6%, indicating that the self-evolution ability of current agents remains far from fully realized. We publicly release the pipeline, benchmark, and full evaluation results at https://github.com/Prism-Shadow/GDPevo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GDPevo，一个基于GDP相关企业工作流、原生支持智能体自我进化评估的基准测试，配备全自动数据生成流水线。其核心机制"规则杂交"将企业工作流分解为原子业务规则，分散到训练任务并在测试任务中重组，确保测试收益可归因于训练经验。V1含120个任务（12组），可自动扩展至V2的240个任务（24组）以应对数据污染。实验显示自我进化最多提升16.44个百分点的留出集准确率，但最佳进化智能体仍远低于91.6%的全知oracle上限。
AI.motivation: 现有的自我进化评估基准存在三大局限：对经济价值高的任务域覆盖有限、训练与测试任务设计不足以保证测试收益可归因于训练经验、易受数据污染影响。因此需要一种进化原生（evolution-native）的基准来可靠地评估智能体自我进化能力。
AI.method: GDPevo采用"规则杂交"（rule hybridization）核心机制：将每个企业工作流分解为原子业务规则，将规则子集分配到训练任务中，再在留出的测试任务中重组这些规则，从而确保测试性能提升可严格归因于训练经验。基准覆盖CRM、ERP、金融、医疗、法律和数据中心等工作流。全自动流水线支持快速扩展到更大规模的V2版本（240任务/24组），以缓解数据污染。评估四个智能体（各含一个框架和模型）在四种监督类型下的表现。
AI.result: 自我进化在所有设置下一致地提升了留出测试准确率，最高提升16.44个百分点。但最佳进化后智能体仍远低于91.6%的全知oracle上限，表明当前智能体的自我进化能力尚未充分实现。
AI.conclusion: GDPevo提供了一种可归因、防污染、可扩展的自我进化评测范式，实证表明自我进化有效但远未达到理论上限，当前智能体的自我进化能力仍有巨大的提升空间。基准、流水线和评测结果已公开。

title: Towards Reliable and Reproducible Fetal Brain Biometry: A Deep Learning Approach Using MRI
summary: Fetal brain biometry is essential for quantitative assessment of brain development, supporting gestational age estimation, developmental monitoring, and detection of abnormalities. In clinical practice, measurements are manually performed, making them time-consuming and prone to variability. While automated approaches have been proposed, reproducible methods remain limited, particularly those providing anatomically interpretable landmark localization. We present a fully automated deep learning-based framework for reliable and reproducible brain biometry from 3D super-resolution-reconstructed fetal brain MRI. The proposed four-step pipeline derives biometric parameters by jointly estimating linear measurements and their corresponding anatomical landmarks. A 3D convolutional neural network is trained to regress landmark coordinates from brain segmentation label maps, followed by measurement-specific geometric optimization to refine landmark positions and compute measurements. The pipeline is evaluated on two publicly available fetal MRI datasets comprising 150 volumes (gestational age range: 20-37 weeks) acquired across different scanners and protocols, assessing five key biometric measurements across varying acquisition settings and providing a comprehensive evaluation of both measurement accuracy and landmark localization using quantitative metrics and visual assessment. Compared with the only available automated pipeline, the proposed method achieves comparable or improved accuracy for most measurements. In conclusion, we introduce a straightforward pipeline for reliable biometry estimations, with efficiency, interpretability and scalability that support integration into clinical workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种全自动的深度学习框架，用于从3D超分辨率重建的胎儿脑MRI中进行可靠的脑部生物测量。该流程通过四步管线，联合估计线性测量值及其对应的解剖学标志点，在150个体积（孕周20-37周）的两个公开数据集上评估了五项关键生物测量指标，相比现有的自动管线取得了相当或更优的精度。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑部生物测量对定量评估大脑发育至关重要，但临床实践中手工测量费时且易变；虽然已有自动方法被提出，但可重复性强且能提供解剖学可解释地标定位的方法仍然有限。
AI.method: 提出一个四步全自动管线：(1) 使用3D卷积神经网络从脑分割标签图中回归地标坐标；(2) 通过测量特定的几何优化精炼地标位置并计算测量值；(3) 在两个公开胎儿MRI数据集（150个体积，孕周20-37周，不同扫描仪和协议）上进行评估；(4) 对五项关键生物测量指标进行定量和视觉评估。
AI.result: 与唯一可用的自动流水线相比，该方法在大多数测量指标上达到相当或更高的精度；在测量准确性和地标定位方面均进行了全面评估。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种简单直接的生物测量管线，兼具效率、可解释性和可扩展性，支持集成到临床工作流程中。

title: A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues
summary: Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues (ESMs) have become a key structure for biomedical disease modeling and pharmacological screening, yet their functional characterization often relies on simplistic metrics like peak force, discarding critical kinetic information. This is partially due to the high level of mathematical complexity which mechanistic models introduce to capture these dynamics. Hence, exactly the complexity prevents scalable application and widespread adaptation in the field. Here we present a Physics-Flavored Neural Network (PFNN) that automates the kinetic phenotyping of ESMs. Our architecture integrates a stretched-exponential physical model into a CNN-Transformer, enabling the extraction of physically meaningful parameters directly from force-time profiles. To address the scarcity of labeled biological data, we employ a hybrid training paradigm: the model develops a "physical intuition" on synthetic data before undergoing unsupervised self-alignment on unlabeled real-world measurements. Our results demonstrate that this physics-flavored approach achieves high-fidelity parameterization across diverse contractile phenotypes and cell lines, including Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy models. Our scalable, self-improving pipeline bridges the gap between idealized biophysics and noisy \emph{in vitro} data, providing a robust tool for high-throughput biophysical research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种物理风味神经网络（PFNN），将拉伸指数物理模型集成到CNN-Transformer架构中，用于自动化骨骼肌组织（ESMs）的动力学表型分析。该网络通过混合训练范式（合成数据预训练+无监督真实数据自对齐）解决标注数据稀缺问题，能够从力-时间曲线中提取物理意义明确的参数，并在包括杜氏肌营养不良模型在内的多种收缩表型和细胞系中实现高保真参数化，为高通量生物物理研究提供了可扩展的自改进工具。
AI.motivation: 骨骼肌组织的功能表征通常依赖峰值力等简化指标，忽略了关键的动力学信息。尽管机理模型能捕捉这些动态，但其较高的数学复杂性阻碍了规模化应用和领域内的广泛采用。因此，需要一种既能提取丰富动力学信息又具备可扩展性的自动化工具。
AI.method: 提出物理风味神经网络（PFNN），将拉伸指数（stretched-exponential）物理模型集成到CNN-Transformer架构中，从力-时间曲线直接提取物理意义明确的参数。采用混合训练范式：先在合成数据上建立"物理直觉"，再通过无监督自对齐在未标注的真实测量数据上微调，以应对标注生物数据稀缺的问题。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该物理风味方法在多种收缩表型和细胞系（包括杜氏肌营养不良模型）中实现了高保真参数化，验证了方法的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法架起了理想生物物理学与含噪体外数据之间的桥梁，提供了可扩展、自改进的高通量生物物理研究工具，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Computing Actual Causes for Neural Network Predictions under Structured Causal Inputs
summary: Explaining the predictions of neural networks is a central challenge in trustworthy AI. Existing explanation methods, such as those based on feature attribution or minimal sufficient sets, typically treat input features as independent, which can yield misleading explanations when inputs exhibit structured dependencies. We address this by formalizing explanations as Halpern-Pearl (HP) actual causes, modeling input dependencies using Boolean Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We compute HP causes by applying bound propagation and branch-and-bound techniques, while providing formal guarantees of completeness and minimality. Our experiments show that we substantially outperform brute-force and ILP baselines in scalability, and outperform heuristic search as graph size grows, computing all minimal actual causes on instances with search spaces of up to $2.3\times10^{13}$ candidate (cause, contingency) pairs, on SCMs with up to 28 nodes, within a 180s per-instance budget. In a case study, we further show that ignoring input dependencies inflates the number of reported causes, 14.9% of which are spurious under our SCM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将神经网络预测解释形式化为Halpern-Pearl实际原因，利用布尔结构因果模型建模输入依赖，并通过边界传播和分支定界技术计算所有最小实际原因，在可扩展性和完备性上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有解释方法（如特征归因或最小充分集）通常假设输入特征相互独立，当输入存在结构化依赖时会产生误导性解释。
AI.method: 将解释形式化为HP实际原因，用布尔结构因果模型（SCM）建模输入依赖；采用边界传播（bound propagation）和分支定界（branch-and-bound）技术计算HP原因，并提供完备性和最小性的正式保证。
AI.result: 在可扩展性上大幅优于暴力搜索和ILP基线，且随图规模增大优于启发式搜索；在包含28个节点、搜索空间达2.3×10^13个候选（原因，应急集）对的SCM上，可在180秒预算内计算所有最小实际原因。案例分析表明忽略输入依赖会使报告的原因数量膨胀，其中14.9%在SCM下是虚假的。
AI.conclusion: 通过SCM建模输入依赖并结合精确搜索技术，可以高效、完备地计算最小实际原因，显著提升解释的可靠性。

title: TDVR: Joint Text Disambiguation and Viewpoint Reasoning for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: Zero-shot 3D visual grounding aims to localize specific objects based on textual descriptions and 3D visual input. However, the effectiveness of existing methods is significantly hindered by the ambiguous query text and deficient viewpoints. To address these issues, we propose TDVR, a training-free reasoning framework that disambiguates the input text and infers accurate viewpoints for zero-shot 3D visual grounding. First, we construct semantic 3D scene graph from the detected instances in the 3D point cloud. Subsequently, we put the original query, appearance and spatial relationship descriptions into the LLM for fusion, thereby disambiguating the initial input. We leverage chain-of-thought reasoning to generate the structured representation of disambiguated query. Then taking the scene graph and structured query as input, we get the optimal view via viewpoint reasoning to solve the problem of missing viewpoints during grounding. Based on the obtained optimal viewpoint, we further discriminate the distracting objects, enabling the model with the ability to distinguish similar instances. After that, we match the category text and appearance images with the query by computing the similarity of feature vectors. Finally, the target object was identified by integrating the viewpoint score, confusion score, category score, and appearance score. Compared with previous methods, our TDVR has stronger capabilities in viewpoint reasoning, similar object discrimination, and ambiguous query understanding. Experimental results on the public ScanRefer dataset show that our method outperforms the existing state-of-the-art methods by 15.25% and 14.46% in Acc@0.25 and Acc@0.5 respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of our TDVR in addressing ambiguous query text and deficient viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TDVR，一个无需训练的零样本3D视觉定位推理框架，通过语义3D场景图构建、LLM辅助的查询消歧、链式思维推理生成结构化查询、视点推理获取最优视角、干扰物体区分以及多维度特征评分融合，在ScanRefer数据集上分别以15.25%和14.46%的绝对提升超越现有最优方法（Acc@0.25和Acc@0.5）。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本3D视觉定位方法受到两个关键问题的制约：一是查询文本存在歧义（ambiguous query text），难以精确定位目标；二是输入视点不充分（deficient viewpoints），导致定位过程中视角信息缺失。这些问题显著影响了定位的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: TDVR框架包含以下核心步骤：(1) 从3D点云检测实例构建语义3D场景图；(2) 将原始查询、外观描述和空间关系描述输入LLM进行融合以实现查询消歧，并通过链式思维推理生成结构化的消歧查询；(3) 基于场景图和结构化查询进行视点推理，获得最优视角；(4) 在最优视角下判别干扰物体，提升相似实例的区分能力；(5) 分别计算类别文本、外观图像与查询的特征向量相似度；(6) 综合视点评分、混淆评分、类别评分和外观评分四维分数来最终识别目标对象。
AI.result: 在公开的ScanRefer数据集上，TDVR在Acc@0.25和Acc@0.5两个指标上分别超越现有最先进方法15.25%和14.46%，验证了该框架在解决歧义查询文本和视点不足问题上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TDVR通过训练无关的推理框架，在视点推理、相似物体判别和歧义查询理解三个方面展现出更强的能力，有效解决了零样本3D视觉定位中的查询歧义和视点缺失问题。

title: Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment
summary: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, presenting a severe temporal credit-assignment challenge across the multi-step denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents by prepending learnable, position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This independent readout mechanism extracts latent reward evidence without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. The resulting dense, differentiable reward signal throughout the full denoising process facilitates two alignment strategies. For training, Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) distills reward-guided updates along on-policy trajectories, bypassing the computationally expensive rollouts of standard policy gradients. For inference, Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) steers trajectories via magnitude-matched reward gradients without parameter updates. Empirically, at high noise levels (u = 0.8), the registers reach the highest pairwise accuracy among the evaluated latent reward models. Furthermore, RG-OPD outperforms online reinforcement learning baselines while reducing GPU hours by up to 33x, and RGS establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods, strictly enhancing both alignment and perceptual metrics. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent Reward Registers（隐式奖励寄存器）机制，通过向冻结的Diffusion Transformer输入序列中预置可学习的位置无关寄存器标记，直接从中间噪声隐变量估计终端偏好奖励，从而解决扩散模型对齐人类偏好的时间信用分配难题。配套提出RG-OPD训练策略（通过轨迹蒸馏实现免rollout的策略梯度，节省最高33倍GPU时间）和RGS推理策略（无需参数更新的奖励梯度引导采样），在高噪声水平下取得最优对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型与人类偏好对齐方法通常依赖最终生成样本上的稀疏终端奖励，在多步去噪过程中存在严重的时间信用分配问题——中间步骤无法获得有效的奖励信号，导致生成质量与偏好对齐受限。
AI.method: 1) Latent Reward Registers：在冻结DiT的输入序列中预先插入可学习的、位置无关的寄存器标记，从中间噪声隐变量直接估计终端偏好，独立读出而不干扰生成器的隐藏状态或速度场，从而获得全去噪过程的稠密可微奖励信号。2) Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD)：沿on-policy轨迹蒸馏奖励引导的更新，避免标准策略梯度所需的高计算成本rollout。3) Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS)：通过幅度匹配的奖励梯度引导采样轨迹，无需任何参数更新。
AI.result: 在高噪声水平（δ=0.8）下，寄存器模型在评估的潜在奖励模型中取得最高成对准确率。RG-OPD在性能上超越在线强化学习基线，同时将GPU训练时间降低最高33倍。RGS在训练无关（training-free）方法中取得新的最先进结果，同时提升对齐指标和感知质量指标。
AI.conclusion: Latent Reward Registers提供了一种架构无关的稠密奖励估计方案，有效解决了扩散模型对齐中的时间信用分配问题。RG-OPD在显著降低计算成本的同时超越在线RL基线，RGS作为零训练方法也取得SOTA效果，两者覆盖了训练与推理两个维度的对齐策略，验证了该机制的广泛适用性。

title: KnowHal: A Knowledge-Driven Benchmark for Comprehensive Multimodal Hallucination Evaluation
summary: Hallucination remains a critical challenge for developing trustworthy Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing benchmarks mainly focus on entity, attribute, and relation hallucinations, knowledge-related failures are often investigated separately, lacking a unified evaluation framework across different hallucination dimensions. To overcome this, we propose \textbf{KnowHal}, a benchmark that explicitly incorporates knowledge hallucination into multimodal hallucination evaluation spanning four dimensions: entity, attribute, relation, and knowledge. KnowHal constructs paired positive and negative questions over shared images and entities, enabling controlled comparisons among perceptual errors, knowledge-related errors, and false-premise acceptance. The benchmark contains 1,800 samples across 10 domains and 50 categories, constructed through a semi-automated pipeline combining LLM assistance, CLIP-based filtering, and human verification. We evaluate 14 representative MLLMs on KnowHal and conduct extensive analyses. Results show that the knowledge dimension consistently presents the greatest challenge for nearly all evaluated models, while most models exhibit substantial performance degradation on negative questions, revealing limited robustness to false premises. By unifying four hallucination dimensions with paired question design, KnowHal addresses an important gap in existing evaluation frameworks and enables a more comprehensive assessment of hallucinations in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KnowHal基准，将知识幻觉纳入多模态大语言模型幻觉评估，涵盖实体、属性、关系和知识四个维度，通过配对的正负问题设计实现统一评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM幻觉基准主要关注实体、属性和关系幻觉，知识与感知错误常被分开研究，缺乏统一的多维度幻觉评估框架，难以全面衡量模型在不同幻觉维度上的表现。
AI.method: KnowHal基准采用半自动化构建流程（结合LLM辅助、CLIP过滤和人工验证），在共享图像和实体上构造配对的正负问题，覆盖10个领域50个类别共1800个样本，并从实体、属性、关系和知识四个维度评估幻觉。
AI.result: 对14个代表性MLLM的评估显示：知识维度对几乎所有模型都是最大挑战；大多数模型在负问题上的表现显著下降，暴露出对错误前提的鲁棒性不足。
AI.conclusion: KnowHal通过统一四个幻觉维度并采用配对问题设计，弥补了现有评估框架的空白，能够对MLLM幻觉进行更全面的评估，有助于推动可信MLLM的发展。

title: AgenticVAU: Multi-Agent Explore-Verify Reasoning for Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) focuses on comprehensively interpreting abnormal events in videos, requiring models to identify anomalous occurrences, discover their supporting evidence, and explain the underlying causes beyond simple anomaly detection. Existing VAU methods often rely on specialized training or limited observations, restricting generalization or evidence coverage. Although single-agent alternatives support adaptive video observation, they still integrate exploration, observation, and decision-making within a unified reasoning process, offering limited role specialization and structured evidence coordination. To address these limitations, we present AgenticVAU, a training-free multi-agent framework that casts VAU as an explore--verify process, where the system first discovers potential anomalies and then verifies them through targeted observations. To achieve this, four specialized agents are introduced to handle visual-rule construction, search planning, video observation, and final decision, respectively. These agents communicate through an anchor registry, a shared evidence memory that binds each observation. Guided by this agent framework, AgenticVAU interleaves broad temporal exploration, dense local verification, and cross-interval comparison until sufficient evidence is collected. We conduct extensive experiments on the ECVA, UCF-Crime, and MSAD subsets of VAU-Bench, the results show that AgenticVAU outperforms zero-shot inference and reinforcement learning-based baselines, demonstrating the value of multi-agent collaboration for video anomaly understanding.

AI.tldr: AgenticVAU是一个免训练的多智能体框架，将视频异常理解建模为"探索-验证"过程，通过四个专业化智能体（视觉规则构建、搜索规划、视频观察、最终决策）协作，并借助锚点注册表共享证据记忆，在ECVA、UCF-Crime和MSAD基准上优于零样本推理和强化学习基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视频异常理解（VAU）方法依赖专门训练或有限观察，限制了泛化能力或证据覆盖范围；单智能体方法虽支持自适应观察，但将探索、观察与决策整合在统一推理过程中，缺乏角色专业化和结构化的证据协调。因此需要一种训练自由、多智能体协作的框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: AgenticVAU将VAU形式化为探索-验证过程：系统首先发现潜在异常，再通过针对性观察进行验证。框架引入四个专职智能体——视觉规则构建、搜索规划、视频观察和最终决策，各智能体通过锚点注册表（anchor registry）这一共享证据记忆进行通信。该框架交替执行广泛的时序探索、密集的局部验证和跨区间比较，直到收集到充分证据。
AI.result: 在VAU-Bench的ECVA、UCF-Crime和MSAD子集上进行的大量实验表明，AgenticVAU在零样本推理和基于强化学习的基线上均取得更优性能，验证了多智能体协作在视频异常理解中的价值。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的多智能体协作框架能够有效提升视频异常理解的表现，角色分工与结构化证据协调可以弥补现有单智能体和依赖训练方法在泛化性与证据覆盖上的不足。

title: Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models
summary: Muon is a recent optimizer that orthogonalizes the update to each weight matrix with a Newton-Schulz iteration, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm. Almost all the evidence for it comes from Transformer models, and its behavior on state-space models is largely unreported. We compare Muon with AdamW on Mamba-2 130M under a controlled protocol that varies only which weight groups are trained with Muon. The benefit is localized. Muon on the output projection alone beats Muon on the input projection or on both. The advantage is mainly one of token efficiency. It holds on two corpora and two token budgets, and persists when training continues well past the compute-optimal point. Conditioning does not explain the gain. Muon lowers the condition number of whichever projection it trains, but the better-conditioned input projection is not the one that helps.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了Muon优化器与AdamW在Mamba-2 130M状态空间模型上的性能，发现Muon的优势高度局部化：仅对输出投影层使用Muon效果最佳，甚至优于同时对输入和输出投影使用Muon。该优势主要体现在token效率上，在两个语料库和两个token预算下均成立，且训练超过计算最优点后仍然持续。进一步分析表明，这一收益不能用矩阵条件数来解释——虽然Muon降低了所训练投影的条件数，但条件数更好的输入投影并未带来更优效果。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器（通过Newton-Schulz迭代在谱范数下对权重矩阵更新进行正交化）已在Transformer模型上展现出良好效果，但其在状态空间模型（如Mamba-2）上的行为几乎未被报道。本文旨在填补这一空白，实证探究Muon在非Transformer架构中的适用性及其收益来源。
AI.method: 采用受控实验协议，在Mamba-2 130M模型上对比Muon与AdamW，唯一变量是哪些权重组使用Muon训练（输入投影、输出投影或两者兼用），并在两个语料库和两个token预算下验证，同时训练超过计算最优点以检验持续性，最终通过条件数分析检验收益是否源于矩阵条件改善。
AI.result: 发现Muon的收益具有强局部性：仅对输出投影使用Muon的效果优于仅对输入投影使用或两者都用。收益主要体现在token效率上，在两个语料库和两个token预算下均成立，且超算训练持续有效。条件数分析显示Muon确实降低了所训练投影的条件数，但条件数更优的输入投影并未带来更好性能，说明条件数不能解释收益。
AI.conclusion: Muon在状态空间模型上的收益是高度局部的，集中体现在输出投影层且主要表现为token效率提升，其机理与传统条件数解释不符，需要更深入的理论探讨来解释这一选择性收益现象。

title: Does Forgetting Transfer Across Modalities? A Real-World Benchmark for Cross-Modal Knowledge Unlearning Evaluation
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), like Large Language Models (LLMs), may memorize sensitive, copyrighted, or harmful knowledge from their pretraining corpora. Removing such knowledge is essential for building trustworthy AI systems. However, existing studies primarily focus on forgetting within individual modalities. Although recent work has begun to explore cross-modal consistency in unlearning, the cross-modal transfer of real-world knowledge unlearning remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce UNLINK-VL, a real-world benchmark for cross-modal knowledge unlearning in VLMs. Under a post-hoc unlearning setting in which the original forget and retain corpora are unavailable, UNLINK-VL selects visually identifiable real-world entities as unlearning targets and associates them with corresponding images and one-hop and multi-hop facts derived from Wikidata. The benchmark comprises four complementary subsets that evaluate direct forgetting of target knowledge, the propagation of forgetting through relational knowledge, the preservation of related non-target knowledge, and robustness to semantically equivalent queries. We train models under text-only and multimodal unlearning settings and evaluate forgetting effectiveness and retained utility across textual, visual, and cross-modal scenarios. Extensive experiments reveal a pronounced asymmetry in cross-modal transfer: multimodal unlearning remains effective under textual evaluation, whereas text-only unlearning transfers poorly to visual and cross-modal scenarios. Meanwhile, the evaluated methods largely preserve the models' general capabilities. These findings demonstrate that relying solely on intra-modal evaluation, particularly text-only evaluation, may substantially overestimate the effectiveness of knowledge unlearning in VLMs, underscoring the need for cross-modal unlearning and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UNLINK-VL，一个面向视觉语言模型（VLM）的跨模态知识遗忘基准。该基准基于真实世界实体，包含四个子集，分别评估目标知识直接遗忘、关系知识传播、非目标知识保留以及语义等价查询鲁棒性。实验发现跨模态转移存在显著不对称性：多模态遗忘在文本评估下有效，而纯文本遗忘难以迁移到视觉和跨模态场景，说明仅依赖单模态评估会高估 VLM 知识遗忘的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有知识遗忘研究主要关注单模态内部遗忘，尽管已有工作开始探索跨模态一致性，但 VLM 中真实世界知识遗忘的跨模态迁移问题仍未被充分研究。为了构建可信的 AI 系统，需要移除 VLM 从预训练语料中记忆的敏感、版权或有害知识，因此迫切需要系统化研究跨模态知识遗忘。
AI.method: 论文提出 UNLINK-VL 基准，在无法访问原始遗忘和保留语料的后置遗忘设置下，从 Wikidata 中选择视觉上可识别的真实世界实体作为遗忘目标，并关联对应图像及一跳和多跳事实。基准包含四个互补子集：直接遗忘评估、关系知识传播评估、非目标知识保留评估、语义等价查询鲁棒性评估。在文本和多元模态两种遗忘设置下训练模型，并在文本、视觉和跨模态场景中评估遗忘效果和保留效用。
AI.result: 实验揭示了跨模态迁移的显著不对称性：多模态遗忘在文本评估中保持有效，而纯文本遗忘在视觉和跨模态场景中迁移效果较差。同时，评估的方法大多能保留模型的通用能力。这些发现表明仅依赖单模态评估（尤其是纯文本评估）会大幅高估 VLM 中知识遗忘的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了跨模态遗忘和评估的必要性。仅进行单模态（特别是纯文本）评估会显著高估 VLM 知识遗忘的实际效果，跨模态评估对于准确衡量和保护 VLM 的信任度至关重要。

title: OmniPack: Unified Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on audio-visual understanding tasks, but processing long and highly redundant visual and audio token sequences incurs substantial computational overhead, demanding aggressive token compression for efficient deployment. Existing methods often degrade at low token budgets: pre-LLM compression may discard structurally important and globally distributed evidence, whereas inner-LLM compression often underexploits query-conditioned audio-visual collaboration. To address these limitations, we propose OmniPack, a training-free framework that coordinates structural compression before the LLM with task-relevant semantic refinement within the LLM. Before the LLM, OmniPack removes structural redundancy through modality-specific importance, global coverage, and similarity-aware merging. After sufficient multimodal interaction, it further consolidates diverse, task-relevant representations through textual guidance and audio-visual collaboration. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks with three Omni-LLM backbones demonstrate that OmniPack consistently achieves the best performance-efficiency trade-off across diverse retention ratios, outperforming all existing methods. Notably, on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, OmniPack preserves 98.0% of the original performance while reducing FLOPs to 16.7%, and still retains 92.9% of the original performance with only 6.8% of the original FLOPs.

AI.tldr: OmniPack是一个针对全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）的训练无关token压缩框架，通过LLM之前的结构压缩与LLM内部的任务相关语义细化相结合，在极端低token预算下实现了最优的性能-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM在音频-视觉理解任务上表现出色，但处理长且高冗余的视觉和音频token序列带来大量计算开销。现有方法在低token预算下性能退化严重：LLM之前的压缩可能丢弃结构重要和全局分布的证据，而LLM内部的压缩往往未能充分利用查询条件下的音频-视觉协作。
AI.method: OmniPack包含两部分：(1) LLM之前，通过模态特定重要性、全局覆盖和相似性感知合并来消除结构冗余；(2) 在充分的多模态交互之后，通过文本引导和音频-视觉协作进一步整合多样化、任务相关的表示。整体为训练无关（training-free）框架。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试、三个Omni-LLM骨干上，OmniPack在不同保留率下均取得最优性能-效率权衡。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上，保留98.0%原始性能的同时将FLOPs降至16.7%；在仅6.8%原始FLOPs下仍保留92.9%的原始性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniPack通过协调LLM前后的互补压缩策略，有效解决了低token预算下全模态压缩的难题，实现了显著的效率提升同时保持极高的性能保留率，优于所有现有方法。

title: Assessment of Conditional Diffusion Model for Synthetic Histopathology Image Generation
summary: Synthetic histopathology image generation has emerged as an approach that may address data scarcity in computational pathology, yet current evaluation methodologies may not fully assess synthetic data quality for medical applications. This work investigates and addresses limitations in existing evaluation metrics, investigating an approach for assessing synthetic histopathology image quality through domain-specific metrics and downstream task validation. We show that conventional synthetic data evaluation metrics such as Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS) may have limitations when applied to histopathology images due to their reliance on ImageNet-pretrained feature extractors. To address these limitations, we propose for consideration modified FID and IS approaches utilizing foundation models pretrained on digital pathology datasets, supplemented by precision-recall based metrics as part of an additional quality assessment. Using conditional denoising diffusion models trained on four benchmark datasets, with a two-step training approach, we generated synthetic datasets with systematically varied quality characteristics. We also measured the correlation between the synthetic data quality metrics with downstream nuclei segmentation performance using common metrics including the aggregated Jaccard index (AJI+) and the Dice coefficient. The study results suggest that pathology-specific metrics may provide improved discriminative power. Specifically, the modified Inception Score indicates higher correlation with downstream task performance (r=0.6096 with AJI+, p=0.0122), compared to the original IS (r=0.0708, p=0.7944). Our observations indicate that increasing the variety of generated training data has a higher positive correlation with segmentation model performance than improving the visual fidelity of individual generated images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了合成组织病理学图像质量评估方法，指出现有指标（FID、IS）因依赖ImageNet预训练特征提取器而存在局限，提出基于病理学基础模型改进的指标，并发现数据多样性比视觉保真度对下游分割任务性能影响更大。
AI.motivation: 合成组织病理学图像生成有望解决计算病理学中的数据稀缺问题，但现有评估方法可能无法充分评估合成数据质量。传统指标如FID和IS依赖ImageNet预训练特征提取器，可能不适用于组织病理学图像领域。
AI.method: 提出使用基于数字病理数据集预训练的基础模型改进FID和IS指标，并辅以precision-recall指标进行额外质量评估。使用条件去噪扩散模型在四个基准数据集上采用两步训练方法，生成具有系统性质量差异的合成数据集，并测量合成数据质量指标与下游核分割性能（AJI+、Dice系数）的相关性。
AI.result: 病理特异性指标具有更好的判别能力。改进的Inception Score与下游任务性能相关性更高（与AJI+相关系数r=0.6096，p=0.0122），而原始IS相关性很弱（r=0.0708，p=0.7944）。增加生成训练数据的多样性比提升单个生成图像的视觉保真度对分割模型性能的正相关性更高。
AI.conclusion: 基于病理学预训练基础模型的评估指标更能反映合成组织病理学图像在下游任务中的实际效用，且数据多样性是影响下游分割性能的关键因素，而非仅追求视觉逼真度。

title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards
summary: Reasoning-based guard models improve LLM safeguards, but decoding explicit rationales for every interaction makes them costly to deploy. Although latent-reasoning methods reduce token generation by moving reasoning into continuous states, they remain underexplored for safety moderation and lack an inspection interface for deployment. In this paper, we propose LatentGuard, an efficient and inspectable safeguard framework that brings continuous latent reasoning to guard models. LatentGuard uses a staged curriculum to progressively compress task-aligned textual rationales into compact latent states, enabling safety verdicts to be predicted directly from continuous representations. To preserve inspectability, an isolated auxiliary decoder generates compact audit artifacts on demand, keeping rationale generation off the standard inference path. Experiments show that LatentGuard-8B improves mean weighted F1 from 83.95 to 84.91 over GuardReasoner-8B, while reducing critical-path reasoning cost from 268.56 generated rationale tokens to 1.60 latent reasoning tokens. Its audit decoder achieves an audit utility score of 85.75, demonstrating an efficient and inspectable path toward deployable LLM safeguards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LatentGuard，一种高效且可检查的LLM安全防护框架，通过分阶段课程学习将文本推理压缩为连续潜在状态，使安全判定直接从连续表示中预测，同时利用独立的辅助解码器按需生成审计伪影（仅1.60个潜在推理token vs 268.56个显式推理token），将平均加权F1从83.95提升至84.91，审计效用得分达85.75。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于推理的guard模型虽能提升LLM安全性，但每次交互都解码显式推理过程导致部署成本高昂。潜在的推理方法虽可减少token生成，但在安全审核领域探索不足，且缺乏部署所需的检查接口。
AI.method: LatentGuard采用分阶段课程学习（staged curriculum），逐步将任务对齐的文本推理压缩为紧凑的潜在状态，使安全判定能直接从连续表征中预测。为保证可检查性，使用一个隔离的辅助解码器按需生成紧凑审计伪影，将推理生成从标准推理路径中分离出来。
AI.result: LatentGuard-8B在平均加权F1上比GuardReasoner-8B从83.95提升至84.91；关键路径推理成本从268.56个生成的推理token降至1.60个潜在推理token；审计解码器达成85.75的审计效用得分。
AI.conclusion: LatentGuard展示了高效且可检查的LLM安全防护部署路径，在提升安全指标的同时大幅降低推理成本，并通过按需审计机制解决了可检查性问题。

title: UHP Detection: LVLMs have their Unique Hallucination Pattern in the Consistency Space
summary: Large vision--language models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong multimodal reasoning capabilities but remain prone to hallucination, where model predictions are not grounded in visual evidence. Existing black-box hallucination detection methods estimate uncertainty through a single consistency metric, implicitly assuming that model uncertainty can be adequately characterized by a single measure. However, hallucinations exhibit diverse manifestations of uncertainty across different behavioral probes, making a single measure insufficient to characterize their underlying behavior. We propose \emph{Unique Hallucination Pattern (UHP) Detection}, a fully black-box framework that models hallucination as a structured uncertainty pattern defined by two axes: perturbation modality (image vs.\ text) and logical polarity (a statement vs.\ its negation). Their intersection produces four complementary consistency groups that capture distinct manifestations of model uncertainty, from which both within-group and between-group features are extracted to train a lightweight classifier. Through comprehensive experiments on AMBER and PhD across three LVLMs, UHP Detection consistently outperforms prior black-box and white-box baselines, with improvements of up to $+18.72\%$ AUC-ROC and $+20.07\%$ AUC-PR over the strongest black-box methods. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate that each consistency group contributes complementary information and that their combination forms a structured hallucination pattern. Furthermore, cross-dataset evaluation shows that this learned pattern generalizes across benchmarks, indicating that hallucination behavior reflects a model-specific consistency pattern. \textbf{Code is publicly available at} https://github.com/amirezzati/uhpdet.

AI.tldr: 提出UHP Detection框架，将幻觉检测建模为结构化不确定性模式，通过扰动模态（图像vs文本）与逻辑极性（陈述vs否定）两个轴交叉产生四个互补一致性组，提取组内及组间特征训练轻量分类器。在AMBER和PhD基准上跨三个LVLM优于现有黑盒及白盒方法，AUC-ROC最高提升+18.72%，AUC-PR最高提升+20.07%。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒幻觉检测方法通过单一一致性指标估计不确定性，隐含假设模型不确定性可由单一度量充分表征。然而幻觉在不同行为探针下表现出多样化的不确定性形态，单一度量不足以刻画其潜在行为。
AI.method: 提出UHP（独特幻觉模式）检测框架。具体而言：（1）将幻觉建模为结构化不确定性模式，由两个轴定义：扰动模态（图像vs文本）和逻辑极性（陈述vs其否定）；（2）两轴交叉产生四个互补一致性组，捕获模型不确定性的不同表现；（3）从组内和组间提取特征训练轻量分类器进行幻觉检测。
AI.result: 在AMBER和PhD基准上跨三个LVLM进行综合实验，UHP检测一致优于现有黑盒和白盒基线，相对于最强黑盒方法AUC-ROC提升高达+18.72%，AUC-PR提升高达+20.07%。消融实验表明每个一致性组贡献互补信息，组合形成结构化幻觉模式。跨数据集评估显示学习到的模式可跨基准泛化。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉行为反映的是模型特定的结构化一致性模式，而非单一不确定性度量。该框架通过多维度一致性组的互补组合实现更鲁棒的幻觉检测，且该模式具有跨基准泛化能力。代码已公开。

title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility
summary: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar "budget," or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over 2 billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.

AI.tldr: 本文对大规模语言模型的"测试时扩展"（test-time scaling）进行了系统性的理论梳理，沿三个轴展开：将测试时扩展形式化为自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理并区分三种结构 regime；将评估对象视为整个推理系统，提出区分端到端系统性能与候选库诊断的评估原则，并引入可恢复或界定常见重复采样指标的评估画像；以及定义推理协议的可复现性要求，区分精确重放与分布可复现性。文章还组织了开源权重推理生态系统，在多个基准上应用这些原则，并发布了超过20亿条完整推理轨迹的数据集。
AI.motivation: 当前"测试时扩展"一词涵盖了多种结构迥异的推理算法——包括单轨迹顺序扩展、采样完整候选并通过投票或验证聚合、以及在未完成部分状态上进行搜索。这些算法在统计结构、计算核算和失败模式上各不相同，但现有研究往往将它们视为可互换的单一标量"预算"下的等价物，或仅报告准确率而不说明产生该结果的推理协议，导致跨研究结果难以比较。作者旨在建立一套系统的理论框架来解决这一混乱局面。
AI.method: 作者从三个轴对测试时扩展进行系统化：(1) 将测试时扩展形式化为在自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理，区分三种结构 regime：单轨迹顺序扩展、叶级扩展（带终止归约）、前缀级扩展； (2) 将评估对象视为整个推理系统，提出分离端到端系统性能与候选库诊断的评估原则，引入评估画像（evaluation profile），其坐标及简单泛函可恢复或界定常见的重复采样指标，并对计算量和不确定性提出协议匹配的报告要求；(3) 明确推理协议的可复现性要求，区分精确重放与分布可复现性，并识别支持各自所需的工件。此外，作者还按模型侧和接口机制组织了开源权重推理生态系统，在三个基准（广泛知识、符号推理、竞赛数学）上应用上述原则。
AI.result: 作者开发了一套系统的测试时扩展理论框架，提出了三种结构 regime 的形式化分类、评估画像工具以及精确重放与分布可复现性的区分。他们还组织并分类了开源权重推理生态系统，将原则应用于广泛知识、符号推理和竞赛数学基准，并组装了超过20亿条完整推理轨迹的数据集，附带逐步丰富的验证器和token级信号以供发布。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为测试时扩展研究提供了统一的概念基础和评估标准，使不同推理协议下的结果具有可比性，并明确了可复现性的层级要求。通过发布大规模推理轨迹数据集，为社区后续研究提供了基础设施，推动了测试时扩展领域的规范化发展。

title: Oilbird: Training-Free Speculative Decoding with Keys the Verifier Already Computes
summary: Training-free speculative decoding drafts by matching an exact suffix of the context against a pool of earlier context. That lookup misses correct drafts already in the pool, most visibly on tool-calling traffic, where a request repeats almost everything but the few values minted for it, and where one rejected token discards the correct continuation behind it. We diagnose the failure position by position across ten benchmarks and find it to be a problem of addressing rather than of coverage: on our densest tool-calling benchmark, about half of what the strongest exact-match drafter misses is present in the pool yet unreachable by exact matching. We therefore propose a second, semantic draft source: the same pool, re-keyed by the hidden state the verifier has already computed at each committed token, together with a merge that lets it ride inside an existing lexical drafter's tree. In three published drafters, at matched pool and budget, it lifts accepted length by 24-29%. Oilbird reaches 4.4x autoregressive decoding speed on API-Bank, against 3.9x for the strongest training-free baseline in our harness and 2.0x for EAGLE-3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于语义检索的训练无关投机解码方法。该方法利用验证器在每个已接受token上计算的隐藏状态重新索引上下文池，并合并到现有词法草稿器的树中，解决了精确匹配草稿器在工具调用场景下匹配失败的问题，在三个已发表的草稿器中提升接受长度24-29%。
AI.motivation: 训练无关的投机解码通过将上下文的精确后缀与先前上下文池匹配来生成草稿，但这种方法会错失池中已存在的正确草稿。尤其在工具调用流量中，请求几乎完全重复，仅少数token为新生成，且一个被拒绝的token会丢弃其后的正确延续。作者通过十个基准逐位置诊断发现，问题在于寻址而非覆盖率——在最密集的工具调用基准上，最强精确匹配草稿器遗漏的草稿中约一半存在于池中但无法通过精确匹配命中。
AI.method: 提出第二种语义草稿来源：使用同一个上下文池，但以验证器在每个已提交token上已计算的隐藏状态作为新的键进行重新索引；配合一种合并机制，使该语义草稿源能够嵌入到现有词法草稿器的树中共同工作。
AI.result: 在三个已发表的草稿器中，在匹配的池大小和预算条件下，接受长度提升24-29%。在API-Bank基准上，所提方法（Oilbird）达到4.4倍自回归解码加速，而最强训练无关基线和EAGLE-3分别为3.9倍和2.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义检索作为第二草稿源并合并到词法草稿树中，显著提高了训练无关投机解码的草稿接受率与解码速度，尤其在工具调用高重复场景下优势明显。

title: FlowForm: Synergizing Fluid Physics with Topological Consistency for Satellite Flood Synthesis
summary: Developing robust flood assessment models requires high-quality paired satellite imagery, yet such data remain scarce for flood-specific image generation. Although generative models provide a promising means of data augmentation, existing methods often yield implausible spatial layouts of flooded regions and distort scene structures. We propose FlowForm, a framework for satellite flood synthesis that integrates SWE-inspired latent regularization with structure-aware conditioning. The Flood Descriptor Module (FDM) imposes differentiable penalties on residuals of the steady-state Shallow Water Equation in auxiliary latent fields at the diffusion bottleneck. The Terrain Anchor Adapter (TAA) injects depth, semantic, and edge features at four encoder scales of the U-Net. We further curate FloodScape, a large-scale, high-resolution dataset comprising paired satellite images acquired before and after disasters. In addition to standard image-generation metrics, we evaluate the consistency of flooded regions, zero-shot generalization to a geographically held-out flood event, and sensitivity to individual components. Across all reported comparisons, FlowForm achieves higher visual fidelity, greater similarity between paired images, and stronger consistency of flooded regions.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowForm框架，通过SWE启发的潜在空间正则化与结构感知条件注入，实现高保真的卫星洪水影像合成，并构建了大型洪水配对数据集FloodScape。
AI.motivation: 高精度洪水评估模型需要大量高质量配对卫星影像，但此类数据稀缺。现有生成模型虽可用于数据增强，却常产生不合理的洪水区域空间布局并扭曲场景结构，亟需更准确的洪水影像生成方法。
AI.method: FlowForm包含两大核心模块：1) Flood Descriptor Module (FDM)，在扩散模型瓶颈层的辅助潜在场中对稳态浅水方程残差施加可微惩罚，实现SWE启发的潜在正则化；2) Terrain Anchor Adapter (TAA)，在U-Net四个编码器尺度注入深度、语义和边缘特征，实现结构感知条件引导。此外构建了FloodScape大规模高分辨率灾前/灾后配对卫星影像数据集。
AI.result: 在标准图像生成指标、洪水区域一致性、对地理上留出洪水事件的零样本泛化能力以及各组件敏感性等评测中，FlowForm均表现更优，实现了更高的视觉保真度、更强的配对图像相似性和更一致的洪水区域生成。
AI.conclusion: FlowForm通过物理正则化与多尺度结构条件相结合，有效解决了洪水影像生成中空间布局不合理与结构失真的问题，为洪水评估模型的训练提供了高质量的数据增强手段。

title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentStream框架，将自进化智能体置于可配置的任务流（隔离/顺序/交错三种流式场景）中进行统一评估，系统性地探究模型能力、方法架构和流式场景三因素如何共同影响智能体的自进化表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化LLM智能体的研究大多采用独立的单任务评估方式，忽视了真实流式场景中智能体需要适应多样化且复杂任务流的实际情况，导致对自进化智能体在真实场景下行为模式的理解存在空白。
AI.method: 提出AgentStream统一评估框架：1) 将已有的智能体基准组织为可配置的任务流；2) 在测试时实例化三种流式场景（隔离Isolated、顺序Sequential、交错Interleaved），逐步变化任务流的范围和领域构成；3) 对五种代表性自进化方法在三个前沿基础模型上进行组合式评估，解耦模型能力、方法架构和流式场景三者的联合影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 自进化的可靠性在不同流式场景间存在差异；2) 自进化的收益受模型能力门控，且与模型强度呈非单调关系；3) 没有任何单一方法在所有模型和场景中占据支配地位。
AI.conclusion: 自进化智能体应在真实任务流而非孤立单任务设置下进行评估。研究结果为跨模型和流式场景选择自进化方法提供了具体指导。

title: MAFIA: Query-Only Memory Attacks via Probing and Factual Injection against Audited LLM Agents
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents rely on rich context for long-horizon reasoning and acting, yet their memory modules expose a persistent attack surface for malicious records, making the study of memory poisoning threats imperative. However, existing query-only attacks often fail to remain effective in two realistic and prevalent settings: large-scale benign memory pools and active input auditing. Consequently, current approaches fall short when facing the dual challenges of high retrieval competitiveness and rigorous semantic checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAFIA, a query-only Memory Attack framework via probing and Factual Injection against Audit, tailored to this extended threat model. Specifically, MAFIA introduces: (1) a placement strategy that ensures retrieval-competitive injection via memory probing, budget allocation, and scheduling; and (2) a payload design that bypasses audits using compact factual cloaks, preserving malicious effects while maintaining high semantic similarity. Extensive evaluations reveal that MAFIA achieves up to a 90.7% attack success rate while suppressing audit detection from a peak of 83.3% to at most 7.4%, exposing critical vulnerabilities across agentic memory systems. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/JiamingChen1234/MAFIA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAFIA，一种基于探测和事实注入的仅查询内存攻击框架，针对大规模良善记忆池和主动输入审计的双重现实挑战，通过检索竞争性注入策略和审计绕过载荷设计，实现了最高90.7%的攻击成功率，同时将审计检测率从83.3%压制到7.4%以下。
AI.motivation: 现有的仅查询攻击在两种现实且普遍的场景中失效：大规模良善记忆池（需要高检索竞争力）和主动输入审计（需要严格的语义检查），因此亟需一种能够同时应对双重挑战的内存投毒攻击方法。
AI.method: MAFIA框架包含两大核心组件：(1) 放置策略——通过内存探测、预算分配和调度实现检索竞争性注入；(2) 载荷设计——利用紧凑事实伪装层（factual cloaks）绕过审计，在保持高语义相似性的同时保留恶意效果。
AI.result: 大量评估表明MAFIA可实现最高90.7%的攻击成功率，并将审计检测率从峰值83.3%压制到最多7.4%，揭示了智能体记忆系统的关键漏洞。
AI.conclusion: MAFIA暴露了增强记忆的LLM智能体在面对扩展威胁模型时的严重安全脆弱性，凸显了记忆模块投毒攻击研究的紧迫性和必要性。

title: Geo-Embed: Towards Unified Multimodal Embeddings for Urban Understanding
summary: Geospatial and urban applications increasingly require models to compare heterogeneous evidence across street-view imagery, remote-sensing observations, text descriptions, region proposals, and temporal change cues. However, existing multimodal embedding models and benchmarks are still largely designed and evaluated around general-purpose image-text matching, leaving unclear whether unified embedding space can support heterogeneous geospatial tasks involving spatial relationships, fine-grained semantics, and temporal changes. To address this gap, we make three key contributions. First, we introduce GeoMEB, a large-scale multimodal embedding benchmark that standardizes 45 urban evaluation tasks across retrieval, visual question answering, change detection, classification, and visual grounding, together with training collections comprising 1.32M examples and 286K evaluation queries. Second, we present Geo-Embed, a unified embedding model that adapts a shared vision-language backbone to instruction-conditioned query-target matching over heterogeneous geospatial inputs, including single images, multiple images, text, regions, and masks. On GeoMEB, Geo-Embed achieves the strongest overall performance among representative multimodal embedders, with a 15.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline. These results motivate future geospatial embedders that organize training and evaluation around explicit query-target relations, including semantic, cross-view, region-level, and temporal correspondence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoMEB基准和Geo-Embed模型，解决地理空间与城市应用中异构多模态证据（街景图像、遥感影像、文本、区域提议、时序变化）的统一嵌入空间问题。GeoMEB标准化了45个城市评估任务（涉及检索、VQA、变化检测、分类和视觉定位），包含132万训练样本和28.6万评估查询；Geo-Embed将共享视觉-语言骨干适配为指令条件化的查询-目标匹配，在GeoMEB上较最强基线相对提升15.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态嵌入模型和基准主要围绕图像-文本匹配设计，未明确验证统一嵌入空间能否支撑涉及空间关系、细粒度语义和时间变化的地理空间异质任务，存在明显研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建GeoMEB大规模多模态嵌入基准，覆盖45个城市评估任务（检索、VQA、变化检测、分类、视觉定位），配套132万训练样本和28.6万评估查询；2) 提出Geo-Embed统一嵌入模型，将共享视觉-语言骨干适配为指令条件化的查询-目标匹配机制，支持单图、多图、文本、区域和掩码等异质地理空间输入。
AI.result: Geo-Embed在GeoMEB上取得最优综合性能，较最强基线相对提升15.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明应以显式查询-目标关系（语义、跨视角、区域级、时间对应）组织和训练未来的地理空间嵌入模型，为后续研究指明方向。

title: ADMITBench: A Safety-Governed Reference Framework for Evaluating the Admissibility of Industrial LLM Advisories
summary: This white paper presents ADMITBench, a reference framework for evaluating industrial LLM advisories at the level of the proposed action. The framework implements a versioned, safety-governed evaluation contract that checks whether a recommendation is supported by the available evidence, permitted under the stated authority and procedure, and acceptable under the plant-specific consequence checks encoded in the selected evaluation profile. In this report, \emph{safety-governed} means that eligibility is determined through explicit, non-compensatory checks derived from a versioned plant profile; it does not mean that the evaluator, model, or plant has been safety-certified. Release 0.1.0 is a public reference implementation for technical and research evaluation, not an authorisation for physical execution.

AI.tldr: ADMITBench 是一个用于评估工业 LLM 建议的参考框架（v0.1.0），在拟议行动层面检查建议是否得到证据支持、在权限与程序范围内，以及是否符合特定工厂的后果检查。该版本仅用于技术和研究评估，不授权物理执行。
AI.motivation: 工业环境中 LLM 生成的建议需要被严格评估，以确保其在证据、权限和工厂特定后果方面满足安全治理要求。作者构建一个标准化参考框架来系统化这类评估。
AI.method: 框架实现了一个版本化的、受安全治理的评估契约，通过显式的非补偿性检查（由版本化的工厂配置文件派生）来判断建议是否合格。评估发生在拟议行动层面，检查包括证据支持、权限与程序合规性，以及所选评估配置中的工厂特定后果检查。
AI.result: 发布 ADMITBench Release 0.1.0 作为公开参考实现，用于技术和研究评估用途，但不作为物理执行的授权。
AI.conclusion: ADMITBench 提供了首个针对工业 LLM 建议的标准化评估参考框架，但必须明确其范围仅限于技术/研究评估，不构成安全认证或物理执行授权。

title: LiteMVS: Efficient Multi-View Stereo with Foundation Distillation and Expert Aggregation
summary: Real-time 3D perception is crucial for robotics, augmented reality, and embodied intelligence applications. Existing multi-view stereo (MVS) methods primarily rely on geometric correspondences, which often fail in textureless or repetitive regions, while monocular depth models leverage strong image-level priors but lack robust multi-view geometric constraints. More importantly, in robotics and embodied manipulation scenarios, high-quality 3D geometry is not only essential for static reconstruction, but also serves as a critical foundation for learning temporally consistent 4D representations. To obtain visual representations with stronger structural awareness and greater potential for spatiotemporal extension, we present LiteMVS, a lightweight multi-view depth estimation model that integrates plane-sweep geometric reasoning with strong monocular semantic and structural priors. The central idea of LiteMVS is to efficiently inject high-level monocular knowledge, obtained from lightweight segmentation models and large-scale vision foundation models, into a multi-view stereo framework. In particular, LiteMVS enriches the cost volume with semantic descriptors and employs a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) formulation to enable adaptive geometric aggregation across depth hypotheses. Moreover, geometric priors distilled from vision foundation models further strengthen monocular guidance without increasing inference cost. Through this design, LiteMVS not only improves depth estimation and 3D reconstruction quality in static scenes, but also provides a more reliable geometric foundation for subsequent temporal modeling and 4D representation learning. Experiments on ScanNetv2 and 7-Scenes demonstrate that LiteMVS achieves high-quality depth prediction and 3D reconstruction while maintaining competitive efficiency.

AI.tldr: LiteMVS是一种轻量级多视图深度估计模型，通过将平面扫描几何推理与单目语义及结构先验（来自轻量级分割模型和大规模视觉基础模型）高效融合，提升静态场景深度估计和3D重建质量，同时为后续时间建模和4D表示学习提供更可靠的几何基础。在ScanNetv2和7-Scenes数据集上验证了高效性。
AI.motivation: 现有MVS方法依赖几何对应关系，在无纹理或重复纹理区域容易失败；单目深度模型虽有强图像先验但缺乏多视图几何约束。此外，机器人及具身智能场景中不仅需要静态重建，还需要为时域一致的4D表示学习提供高质量的3D几何基础。
AI.method: LiteMVS将轻量级分割模型和大规模视觉基础模型提取的高层单目知识（语义描述子和几何先验）注入多视图立体匹配框架。具体地：(1) 用语义描述子丰富代价体；(2) 采用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）公式实现跨深度假设的自适应几何聚合；(3) 从视觉基础模型中蒸馏几何先验以增强单目引导，且不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 在ScanNetv2和7-Scenes数据集上，LiteMVS在深度预测和3D重建质量上取得高质量结果，同时保持了有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将单目语义与结构先验高效注入多视图立体框架，LiteMVS在静态场景重建中优于纯几何方法的鲁棒性，并为4D表示学习和时域建模提供了更可靠的几何基础，展示了多视图几何与单目先验融合的有效性。

title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
summary: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five representative domains, each containing 100 interconnected subtasks ordered by increasing difficulty and opportunities for cross-task skill reuse. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, in-context learning performs comparably to explicit skill maintenance on average, suggesting that much of the improvement arises from adaptation to prior context and feedback rather than reusable skill abstraction alone. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that less capable models tend to accumulate larger, more fragmented collections of task-specific skills. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContinualSkillBench，一个用于上下文持续技能学习的动态评估框架，涵盖五个领域各100个互联子任务。实验发现顺序执行普遍提升性能但增益因模型和领域而异；上下文学习与显式技能维护平均表现相当，表明改进主要来自对先前上下文和反馈的适应而非可复用技能抽象；但显式技能在需要可复用流程或精确输出的任务上具有选择性优势；能力较弱的模型倾向于积累更大更碎片化的任务特定技能集合。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体框架通过外部技能库赋予大语言模型解决复杂任务的能力，但现有研究尚不清楚这些系统是否能有效演进技能，以及演进后的技能是否真正提升任务求解能力。为了弥合这一认知缺口，作者引入动态评估框架来系统研究上下文中的持续技能学习。
AI.method: 构建ContinualSkillBench评估框架，覆盖五个代表性领域，每个领域包含100个按难度递增排列且支持跨任务技能复用的互联子任务。通过设计实验比较顺序执行与显式技能维护两种范式下的性能差异，并分析技能积累的规模与碎片化程度。
AI.result: 顺序执行普遍改善性能但收益在模型和领域间差异显著；上下文学习在平均表现上可与显式技能维护匹敌；显式技能在需要可复用流程或精确输出任务上具有选择性优势；能力较弱的模型倾向于积累更大、更碎片化的任务特定技能。
AI.conclusion: 当前的上下文技能演进机制能够支持持续适应，但仍难以将经验一致地整合为稳健且可迁移的技能，这是未来研究需要攻克的瓶颈。

title: CPrefix: A Combinatorial Tensor Framework for Structured Discrete Color Mappings
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE ICIP 2026 Workshop on Computational Color Imaging (CCIW 2026). Withdrawn from the proceedings because the author was unable to attend the conference
summary:
Discrete multi-channel mappings are typically represented through sampled values, providing accurate evaluations but limited insight into their underlying structure. We introduce CPrefix, a combinatorial observable representation for discrete mappings, realized within a unified tensor framework that enables representation, reconstruction, and structural analysis.
  The framework is based on a counting tensor induced by multinomial counting observables. Its support forms a discrete Pascal simplex, not as a constraint on the observable space, but as a latent combinatorial representation from which mappings are reconstructed. This formulation separates the combinatorial organization of a mapping from its measured values, exposing the observable structure underlying the mapping.
  The framework is validated on ICC display and printer profiles through latent reconstruction and perceptual gamut transport. Accurate reconstruction demonstrates that color mappings admit faithful observable representations, while reconstruction residuals provide insight into the compatibility of the underlying mapping with the proposed representation.
  Although demonstrated on color transformations, the framework is independent of the physical interpretation of the observables, making it applicable to structured multi-channel mappings arising from color imaging, spectral measurements and other discrete systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CPrefix，一种基于多項式计数的张量框架，用于离散多通道映射的组合可观测表示，支持表示、重建与结构分析，并在ICC显示与打印配置文件上验证。
AI.motivation: 离散多通道映射通常通过采样值表示，虽然能精确评估，但难以揭示其底层结构。现有方法缺乏一个统一的框架来同时实现表示、重建和结构分析，因此需要一种组合观测表示来揭示映射的可观测结构。
AI.method: 引入计数张量（counting tensor），由多项计数可观测（multinomial counting observables）诱导生成。该张量的支撑集构成离散Pascal单纯形（Pascal simplex），并非作为可观测空间的约束，而是作为潜在组合表示用于重建映射。该框架将映射的组合组织方式与其测量值分离，从而暴露映射底层的可观测结构。
AI.result: 在ICC显示与打印配置文件上验证：通过潜在重建和感知色域传输实现了高精度重建，表明颜色映射具有忠实的可观测表示；重建残差揭示了映射与所提出表示的兼容性信息。
AI.conclusion: 虽然以颜色变换为示例，但该框架不依赖于可观测量的物理解释，适用于颜色成像、光谱测量及其他离散系统中出现的结构化多通道映射。

title: Intertemporal Preference Steering in Qwen3 via Contrastive Activation Addition
summary: We study linear representations of temporal horizon in the large language model Qwen3-32B and use them to change the model's time-related preferences, recommendations, and capabilities. We train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to find a short-term versus long-term direction in the model's residual stream, and evaluate contrastive activation-addition steering on a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task, and a TravelPlanner capability benchmark. The central result is that temporal-horizon directions can be identified with simple contrastive linear probes and then used for steering to induce large, bidirectional preference changes. On an out-of-distribution monetary choice task that varies reward size and delay, steering strongly shifts the model's indifference threshold between smaller-sooner and larger-later rewards in both directions. We further show improvements on a planning-related capability metric under moderate temporal steering. These results suggest that model intertemporal preferences are measurable and steerable, which is relevant for AI systems that give advice involving delayed costs and benefits, and for safety questions about long-horizon planning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型Qwen3-32B中时间地平线的线性表示，通过对比线性探针识别短期与长期方向，并利用对比激活加法进行引导，实现了模型跨期偏好的双向大幅改变，同时在某些规划能力指标上展现了适度提升。
AI.motivation: 理解并控制大语言模型的时间相关偏好、推荐和能力对于AI系统在涉及延迟成本效益的建议以及长期规划的安全性问题至关重要。作者旨在探究模型的时间地平线是否可测量且可引导。
AI.method: 在教师强制的时间选择答案上训练对比线性探针，在模型的残差流中寻找短期与长期方向；随后在保留的二进时间选择任务、分布外的货币跨期选择任务以及TravelPlanner能力基准上评估对比激活加法引导的效果。
AI.result: 时间地平线方向可通过简单的对比线性探针识别，并用于引导产生大规模、双向的偏好改变。在分布外货币选择任务中，引导在两个方向上强烈改变模型在"更小更早"与"更大更晚"奖励之间的无差异阈值；在中度时间引导下，规划相关能力指标也有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 模型跨期偏好是可测量且可引导的，这一发现对提供延迟成本收益建议的AI系统以及长期规划的安全性问题具有重要意义。

title: BanglaWild: An In-the-Wild Bengali Scene Text Recognition Benchmark for OCR and Vision-Language Models
summary: In-the-wild Bengali scene text recognition is largely unmeasured: existing resources target handwritten documents or constrained sign-board parsing, report only aggregate edit-distance metrics, and evaluate either conventional OCR or VLMs, never both on the same in-the-wild data. To address this gap, we introduce BANGLAWILD, a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images, each paired with a verbatim gold transcription, two categorical axes, four diagnostic attributes, and an orthographically standard form where the in-image text deviates from canonical spelling. We evaluate fifteen VLMs and three conventional OCR systems under three prompting strategies, fine-tune 6 open-source models with LoRA, and complement edit-distance metrics with an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our results reveal a persistent gap in which larger models within the same family do not outperform smaller ones. Our fifteen-class error taxonomy shows that visual mis-recognition accounts for ~60% of errors in the strongest systems, while conjunct-related errors contribute under 2%, challenging a long-standing assumption in Bengali OCR research; the same visual dominant profile also holds across architectures, including the one conventional baseline that reads Bengali reliably. Prompt language mainly affects cross-script drift and LoRA reduces catastrophic failures in weak models without lifting the ceiling on already competent ones. Code and data will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BANGLAWILD基准，包含2,535张孟加拉语自然场景文本图像，并附有逐字转录、分类轴、诊断属性和标准拼写形式。作者评估了15个视觉语言模型和3个传统OCR系统，发现同一模型族内更大模型并不优于更小的模型；视觉误识别约占最强系统错误的60%，而连字相关错误不到2%，挑战了孟加拉OCR领域的长期假设。
AI.motivation: 自然场景下的孟加拉语文本识别缺乏系统性测量：现有资源仅针对手写文档或受限的招牌解析，只报告聚合编辑距离指标，且从未在同一自然场景数据上同时评估传统OCR和视觉语言模型，导致该领域的性能现状缺乏可靠认知。
AI.method: 构建了BANGLAWILD基准（2,535张图像，含逐字金标准转录、两个分类轴、四个诊断属性及正字法标准形式）；评估15个VLM和3个传统OCR系统，采用三种提示策略；对6个开源模型进行LoRA微调；用LLM-as-a-Judge补充编辑距离指标；构建15类错误分类法进行错误分析。
AI.result: 发现同一模型族内更大模型不优于更小模型的持续性能差距；视觉误识别占最强系统约60%的错误，而连字相关错误不足2%，颠覆了孟加拉OCR研究中的既有假设；提示语言主要影响跨脚本漂移，LoRA微调降低弱模型的灾难性失败但无法提升已有能力的模型上限。
AI.conclusion: 孟加拉语自然场景文本识别的核心瓶颈在于视觉层面的误识别而非连字处理，未来研究应聚焦于提升模型的视觉感知能力；提供公开可复现的基准与数据以推动该领域发展。

title: When Efficiency Becomes Fragility: Exploiting Dynamic Routing Vulnerabilities in Adaptive UAV Tracking
summary: Resource constraints on UAV platforms have driven a paradigm shift in aerial tracking, from pursuing performance toward balancing accuracy with efficiency. Adaptive Transformer Trackers, which leverage an input-dependent dynamic routing architecture, have emerged as a representative solution to this challenge. However, we reveal that behind this computation-on-demand flexibility hides a critical structural flaw: the Lipschitz singularity of computational path decisions, which has an unbounded local Lipschitz constant at discrete layer-skipping decision boundaries. This mathematical discontinuity renders adaptive tracking networks inherently unstable: tiny input perturbations can be amplified at the gating modules, causing dramatic changes in the inference topology. We formally characterize this singularity in the context of adaptive tracking architectures and, for the first time, identify it as a directly exploitable new attack surface. This insight reveals a previously overlooked and highly vulnerable topological path space attack surface. Based on this, we propose the Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) framework. API generates imperceptible perturbations to precisely manipulate the gating decisions, forcing the inference onto altered computational paths. The severe inconsistency between the original and the inverted paths dismantles the representation capability of the model. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art adaptive trackers demonstrate that API achieves superior perturbation stealthiness, more effective attack, and faster inference speeds. This work opens a new dimension for the security analysis of dynamic tracking networks and provides a theoretical warning for constructing robust adaptive tracking architectures in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自适应Transformer跟踪器中计算路径决策的Lipschitz奇异性这一结构性缺陷，并首次将其识别为可直接利用的新型攻击面，据此提出对抗性路径反转（API）框架，通过生成难以察觉的扰动精确操控门控决策，迫使推理沿改变的计算路径进行，从而破坏模型表征能力。实验表明API在扰动隐蔽性、攻击有效性和推理速度上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 无人机平台资源受限推动航空跟踪从追求性能转向平衡精度与效率，自适应Transformer跟踪器通过输入依赖的动态路由架构成为代表性解决方案。但作者揭示这种按需计算灵活性背后隐藏着关键的结构性缺陷——计算路径决策的Lipschitz奇异性，在离散跳层决策边界处具有无界的局部Lipschitz常数，导致自适应跟踪网络本质上不稳定：微小输入扰动可在门控模块处被放大，引发推理拓扑的剧烈变化。此前该漏洞未被发现和利用。
AI.method: 作者首先在自适应跟踪架构的上下文中形式化刻画了路径决策的Lipschitz奇异性，识别出一个此前被忽视且高度脆弱的拓扑路径空间攻击面。基于此发现，提出对抗性路径反转（API）框架，通过生成不可感知的扰动来精确操控门控决策，迫使推理沿改变的计算路径进行，利用原始路径与反转路径之间的严重不一致性来瓦解模型表征能力。
AI.result: 在最新自适应跟踪器上的大量实验表明，API在三个关键维度上表现出优势：扰动隐蔽性更强（生成不可感知的扰动）、攻击效果更有效（更有效地瓦解模型表征能力）、推理速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为动态跟踪网络的安全分析开辟了新维度，为未来构建鲁棒的自适应跟踪架构提供了理论预警。

title: MuRA: Multi-Rank Adaptation for Efficient and Effective Test-Time Vision-Language Generalization
summary: Vision-language models exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities but suffer significant performance degradation under distribution shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) via Low-Rank Adaptation offers a parameter-efficient solution, we identify a fundamental bottleneck in current methods: the reliance on static rank configurations. Because visual inputs inherently possess varying information densities, a fixed rank forces an inevitable optimization compromise, leading to underfitting on complex scenes and overfitting on simple ones. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Rank Adaptation (MuRA), a novel framework that dynamically selects and fuses adaptation modules of varying capacities based on token-level visual complexity. MuRA synergizes Multi-Rank Orthogonal Decomposition to provide a superior, knowledge-preserving initialization, and Unified Component Fusion with Continuous Router Updating to sustainably learn semantic-to-rank mappings. Furthermore, we provide rigorous theoretical justifications mathematically proving the necessity and gradient stability of this adaptive mechanism. Crucially, MuRA's dynamic design uniquely thrives at the deepest visual layer, capitalizing on the shortest gradient backpropagation path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MuRA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across extensive domain generalization and cross-dataset benchmarks while significantly reducing both computational and memory overhead.

AI.tldr: MuRA是一种针对视觉-语言模型测试时自适应的多秩适应框架，通过动态选择与融合不同容量的适应模块，解决固定秩配置导致的优化折衷问题，在领域泛化和跨数据集基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型的测试时自适应方法依赖静态秩配置，但视觉输入天然具有不同的信息密度，固定秩会导致复杂场景下欠拟合、简单场景下过拟合的根本性优化矛盾。
AI.method: MuRA包含三个核心组件：1) 多秩正交分解提供知识保持的初始化；2) 统一组件融合与连续路由器更新，学习语义到秩的映射；3) 基于词元级视觉复杂度的动态秩选择与融合。同时提供数学上严格的理论证明支撑自适应机制的必要性与梯度稳定性。
AI.result: 在广泛的领域泛化和跨数据集基准上取得最先进精度，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。MuRA在深层视觉层表现尤为突出，利用最短梯度反向传播路径的优势。
AI.conclusion: MuRA通过自适应秩选择有效解决了静态秩配置的优化折衷问题，证明了多秩动态适应机制在视觉语言模型测试时自适应中的有效性和高效性。

title: Socially Grounded Agentic AI: Coordinating Plural Perspectives through Social Theory
comment: Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse social contexts, alignment can no longer be framed as the optimization of a single, unified set of values. Instead, systems must be able to recognize, represent, and respond to multiple legitimate perspectives. This has led to growing interest in pluralistic alignment, which seeks to move beyond one-size-fits-all models of appropriate behaviour. However, current approaches often lack a clear account of how values are socially organized, contested, and coordinated in practice. In this paper, we argue that social theory provides essential conceptual and design resources for addressing these challenges. Drawing on established traditions in sociology, we show how perspectives can be understood as structured by roles, shaped through interaction, and distributed across fields of power and expertise. We translate these insights into concrete implications for AI system design, including role-based representations, structured coordination among perspectives, and context-sensitive evaluation. For agentic systems, this requires aligning not only final outputs, but also the role activations, deliberative traces, aggregation rules, and feedback loops through which those outputs are produced. Our contribution is to reposition pluralistic alignment as a problem of socially grounded coordination rather than output diversification. We outline a design space for systems that engage multiple perspectives in structured and accountable ways, and we identify directions for future work to implement and empirically evaluate these approaches in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文从社会学理论出发，将多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）重新定义为"社会性协调"问题而非简单的输出多样化问题，并提出基于角色、互动与权力场域的AI系统设计空间。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在日益多元的社会语境中部署，传统的单一价值观对齐范式已不再适用。虽然多元对齐受到广泛关注，但现有方法缺乏对价值观如何在实践中被社会组织、竞争与协调的清晰理论说明，导致系统设计缺乏概念基础。
AI.method: 本文采用社会学理论分析的方法，借鉴社会学中关于角色、互动和权力场域的成熟传统，将视角（perspectives）理解为：由角色结构化的、通过互动塑造的、分布在权力与专业领域中的。进而将这些社会学洞见转化为具体的AI系统设计启示，包括基于角色的表征、视角间的结构化协调机制、以及情境敏感的评价方法。
AI.result: 作者提出了一个面向智能体系统的对齐框架，要求不仅对齐最终输出，还要对齐角色激活（role activations）、审议轨迹（deliberative traces）、聚合规则（aggregation rules）和反馈回路（feedback loops）这些产生输出的过程要素。文章勾勒了一个让系统以结构化、可问责的方式参与多元视角的设计空间，并指出了未来在真实场景中实施和实证评估的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 多元对齐应被重新定位为"社会性协调"问题：AI系统需要以一种在结构上可解释、在过程上可问责的方式管理多元视角之间的关系，而非简单地为不同群体生成多样化的输出。社会学理论为这一重新定位提供了必要的概念和设计资源。

title: CARE-X: Towards Clinically Useful Radiology VLMs with Auxiliary Supervision, Reward-Aligned Learning, and Tool-Augmented Measurement
summary: A clinically useful chest X-ray system must go beyond fluent report generation: it should classify findings with tunable decision thresholds, localize them spatially, and derive the anatomical measurements upon which many diagnoses depend. Today's Vision-Language Models (VLMs) treat these as separate problems, if they address them at all, leaving a gap between what radiologists need and what generative models provide. We introduce CARE-X, a chest X-ray VLM that narrows this gap by unifying auxiliary discriminative supervision with reward-aligned generation. CARE-X augments its generative backbone with focal-loss classification and composite-loss grounding heads, co-trained alongside the language-modeling objective. This auxiliary supervision produces discriminative diagnostic predictions with tunable decision thresholds and precise spatial localization while also improving report quality, providing evidence that structured prediction and generation reinforce one another. Building on this foundation, Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization (DAPO) leverages task-specific reward signals for report generation, visual question answering (VQA), and spatial grounding, directly optimizing the clinical quality metrics that matter in practice. The result is state-of-the-art performance on the majority of metrics across four report-generation benchmarks, 94.0% VQA accuracy on ReXVQA (+6.0 pp over the next-best baseline), and generative spatial decoding that reaches near parity with dedicated detection heads. Separately, to address measurement-dependent diagnoses, we couple Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct with native tool-calling capabilities for invoking deterministic measurement tools, while retaining full visual access to the image. This hybrid inference yields +43.6 pp average F1 over perception-only baselines across five measurement-dependent conditions.

AI.tldr: CARE-X是一个胸部X光视觉语言模型（VLM），通过将辅助判别监督（焦点损失分类头和复合损失定位头）与基于奖励对齐的生成（DAPO策略优化）相统一，同时引入工具调用能力实现确定性解剖测量，在报告生成、视觉问答、空间定位和测量依赖诊断等多个任务上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 临床可用的胸部X光系统不仅要能生成流畅的报告，还需要可调阈值地分类发现、空间定位异常，以及进行解剖测量。现有VLM将这些任务视为相互独立的问题（甚至根本不处理），导致生成模型与放射科医生实际需求之间存在明显差距。
AI.method: CARE-X采用三项核心技术：(1) 在生成骨干上增加焦点损失分类头和复合损失定位头作为辅助监督，与语言建模目标联合训练；(2) 提出解耦剪枝与动态采样策略优化（DAPO），利用任务特定奖励信号（报告生成、VQA、空间定位）直接优化临床质量指标；(3) 将Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct与原生工具调用能力耦合，用于调用确定性测量工具，同时保留完整图像视觉访问，实现混合推理。
AI.result: 在四个报告生成基准上大多数指标达到最先进性能；ReXVQA上VQA准确率达94.0%（比次优基线高6.0个百分点）；生成式空间解码接近专用检测头性能；在五种测量依赖条件下，混合推理相比仅感知基线平均F1提升43.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结构化判别预测与生成可以相互促进增强，统一辅助判别监督与奖励对齐生成是缩小放射科医生需求与生成模型能力之间差距的有效途径，工具调用与视觉模型融合能够解决依赖测量的诊断任务。这项工作为临床级胸部X光AI系统提供了综合性框架。

title: Implementing Causal Perception: Competing SCMs and Situated Fairness
summary: Causal perception occurs when agents with competing Structural Causal Models (SCMs) of the same system infer different probability distributions, including the hypothetical distributions implied by each agent's SCM under the same set of interventions. It shapes how agents reason about the system and how they perceive its fairness. Causal perception is a promising probabilistic framework, but it has remained purely theoretical. This work provides the first implementation of the causal perception framework of Álvarez and Ruggieri (2025). We operationalize structural (agents disagree on the causal graph) and parametrical (agents agree on the causal graph but disagree on its weights) causal perception. We design algorithms for computing interventional and counterfactual distributions and propose suitable distance measures to quantify the disagreement. Using the German Credit dataset, we illustrate how causal perception affects accuracy and fairness in a multi-expert decision setting. We show that the perception verdict is sensitive to the choice of distance metric and threshold. We also show that causal perception changes fairness assessments and threshold-based decisions. Bias proves situated with respect to the agent's SCM, demonstrating that competing worldviews in fairness problems cannot be ignored.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实现了Álvarez和Ruggieri (2025)提出的因果感知(causal perception)框架，将结构性和参数性因果感知操作化，设计了计算干预分布和反事实分布的算法及距离度量，并在德国信用数据集上展示了因果感知对多专家决策场景中准确性和公平性的影响。
AI.motivation: 因果感知是一个有前景的概率框架，但此前仅停留在纯理论层面，缺乏实际实现和实证验证，无法展示其在真实场景中的应用价值。
AI.method: 将因果感知操作化为结构性（代理人对因果图有分歧）和参数性（代理人对因果图一致但对权重有分歧）两种类型；设计计算干预分布和反事实分布的算法；提出合适的距离度量来量化代理人间的不一致。
AI.result: 在德国信用数据集上，因果感知影响多专家决策设置中的准确性和公平性；感知判决对距离度量和阈值选择敏感；因果感知改变公平性评估和基于阈值的决策；公平性相对于代理人的SCM具有情境性。
AI.conclusion: 公平性问题中的竞争性世界观不能被忽视，偏见相对于代理人的结构因果模型而言是情境化的。

title: NCGR: Noise-Conditional Gated Rectification for Camera Extrinsic Perturbations in BEV 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-based bird's-eye-view (BEV) 3D detection typically assumes accurate and fixed camera extrinsics. In detectors using spatial cross-attention (SCA), extrinsic perturbations displace the image-plane projections of BEV reference points, causing queries to sample features from incorrect regions and degrading detection performance. To address this failure mode, Noise-Conditional Gated Rectification (NCGR) is proposed to compensate for projection errors without explicitly estimating a full six-degree-of-freedom extrinsic correction. For each query-camera pair, a 2D rectification offset is predicted and modulated by a camera-level gate to rectify the base projection before native deformable sampling. During training, the perturbation-derived quantities used to construct the condition and gate are gradually replaced through scheduled interpolation by counterparts generated from an auxiliary scalar predicted from camera features. This transition enables blind inference without perturbation metadata. During training, a weight-shared clean-teacher/perturbed-student pair is used, and the rectification module is supervised by a BEV-consistency objective between the two branches. NCGR is evaluated on nuScenes with simulated dynamic and static extrinsic perturbations. In a five-camera dynamic stress test, NCGR achieves 39.69% NDS, compared with 28.00% for BEVFormer and 33.23% for CAPE. Under clean extrinsics, NCGR maintains performance comparable to that of BEVFormer.

AI.tldr: NCGR是一种针对相机外参扰动下BEV 3D检测的噪声条件门控校正模块，通过预测2D校正偏移并经相机级门控调制来补偿投影误差，无需显式估计完整6自由度外参校正，并在动态扰动测试中显著提升NDS性能。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的BEV 3D检测通常假设外参准确且固定，但实际中外参扰动会导致空间交叉注意力中BEV参考点在图像平面上的投影发生偏移，使查询从错误区域采样特征，从而严重降低检测性能。
AI.method: NCGR为每个查询-相机对预测一个2D校正偏移，并通过相机级门控进行调制，以在原生可变形采样之前校正基础投影。训练期间通过调度插值将基于扰动的条件量逐步替换为由相机特征预测的辅助标量，从而支持无需扰动元数据的盲推理。同时采用权重共享的干净教师/扰动学生双分支结构，通过BEV一致性目标监督校正模块。
AI.result: 在nuScenes五相机动态应力测试中，NCGR达到39.69% NDS，显著优于BEVFormer的28.00%和CAPE的33.23%；在干净外参下性能与BEVFormer相当。
AI.conclusion: NCGR有效补偿了外参扰动引起的投影误差，在保持干净外参下性能不受损的同时，显著提升了面对外参扰动时的鲁棒性，且不依赖推理时的扰动元数据。

title: The Transformer Revolution, Part 1: Dynamic Processing through Output- Weight Interconnections
comment: v1: 7 Sections, References, Appendix, Tables (2 tables), Figures Part A (6 figures), Figures Part B (42 figures), Figures Part C (5 figures)
summary: This paper offers a new interpretation of the Transformer during inference. Against the "stochastic parrot" view that large language models merely reproduce statistical regularities learned in training, we argue that Transformers construct and apply prompt-dependent transformations whose parameters are generated during inference. We call this form of computation SIDPP: Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing. The Transformer is interpreted as a system that transforms concepts by means of concepts. Token vectors are the concepts to be transformed; parameterized transformations defined by matrices and vectors are the transforming concepts. These may be static, when fixed through training, or dynamic, when generated from the input sequence. Mechanically, they correspond to groups of simple neural networks. The Transformer's architectural novelty lies in output-weight interconnections, through which the outputs of some networks determine the weights of others, alongside ordinary output-input interconnections. By means of these interconnections, the system constructs transformations from the prompt and uses them to modify token representations. The contribution of dynamic processing grows with prompt length and may equal or exceed that of static processing, a phenomenon we call strong prompt sensitivity. This account bears on interpretability, predictability, control, and the design of smaller, more sustainable systems. Finally, since the human neural system possesses the mechanisms required to implement SIDPP, we argue that a form of SIDPP may, in principle, be neurally realized in the cerebral cortex. We therefore conjecture that human language processing may itself be a form of SIDPP produced by a functional architecture relevantly similar to that of the Transformer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对Transformer推理过程的新解读：Transformer在推理期间构造并应用提示依赖的变换，其参数在推理时动态生成（称为SIDPP），而非仅复现训练中的统计规律。
AI.motivation: 反驳"随机鹦鹉"观点——即认为大型语言模型只是复现训练中学到的统计规律。作者认为这种观点忽略了Transformer在推理时的动态计算能力，需要一种新的计算范式来准确描述其本质。
AI.method: 提出SIDPP（Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing）框架：将token向量视为被变换的概念，由矩阵和向量定义的参数化变换视为"变换性概念"。这些变换可以是静态的（训练固定）或动态的（从输入序列生成），机械上对应于成组的简单神经网络。Transformer的架构创新在于输出-权重互连，使某些网络的输出决定其他网络的权重，从而从提示中构造变换并修改token表示。
AI.result: 动态处理的贡献随提示长度增长，可能等于或超过静态处理（称为"强提示敏感性"）。该框架对可解释性、可预测性、可控性以及设计更小更可持续的系统有启示。进一步论证了人类神经系统具备实现SIDPP的机制，推测人类语言处理可能本身就是一种SIDPP。
AI.conclusion: Transformer不只是统计鹦鹉，而是一种通过概念转换概念的动态计算系统。该解释不仅对AI系统设计有意义，还推测人类大脑皮层可能以类似SIDPP的功能架构实现语言处理，为计算神经语言学提供了新的理论视角。

title: UniEvo-RS: Omni-Prompt Unified Remote Sensing Segmentation with Representative Exemplar-Driven Prototype Evolution
summary: Prompt-driven vision-language models (VLMs) hold immense promise for accelerating dense remote sensing (RS) annotation, but static models suffer from severe performance degradation when deployed on novel scenes, unseen categories, or visually confusing backgrounds. Moreover, existing unified paradigms primarily rely on intra-image specific prompts, lacking flexible task routing to adapt to multi-intent operational workflows. In practical batch mapping, annotators typically refine a small set of representative samples before processing large datasets. Motivated by this practice, we propose UniEvo-RS, an omni-prompt unified RS segmentation framework equipped with representative exemplar-driven prototype evolution. First, we construct a multi-instruction prompt dataset that unifies text-driven and visual-driven prompts within a single architecture, establishing a dynamic task-routing mechanism for highly diverse RS annotation scenarios. Second, we introduce a representative feedback-driven, training-free prototype evolution mechanism. By contrasting manual annotations with initial predictions on exemplars, UniEvo-RS distills prediction errors into positive and negative prototypes. These prototypes enhance LLM query recall and suppress spatial background noise under a fixed-budget clustering memory. Extensive experiments show that UniEvo-RS unifies diverse prompting tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance across most settings. Crucially, with minimal interaction on a few exemplars, it enables training-free, progressive accuracy enhancement on unseen categories during batch annotation.

AI.tldr: UniEvo-RS 是一个面向遥感密集标注的统一提示分割框架，通过代表性样本驱动的原型进化机制，实现训练-free的渐进式精度提升，统一了多种文本和视觉提示任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示驱动视觉语言模型在遥感场景中面临性能退化问题（如新场景、未见类别、混淆背景），且统一范式缺乏灵活的任务路由以适应多意图工作流。实际批处理标注中标注者通常会先优化少量代表性样本再处理大规模数据集，但现有方法未利用这一实践。
AI.method: 1) 构建多指令提示数据集，在同一架构内统一文本驱动和视觉驱动提示，建立动态任务路由机制；2) 引入代表性反馈驱动的免训练原型进化机制，通过对比手工标注与初始预测，将预测错误蒸馏为正/负原型，增强LLM查询召回并抑制空间背景噪声，在固定预算聚类记忆下工作。
AI.result: 实验表明UniEvo-RS统一了多种提示任务，在大多数设置下达到最先进性能；关键地，通过少量示例的最小交互，能在批量标注中对未见类别实现免训练的渐进式精度提升。
AI.conclusion: UniEvo-RS通过代表性示例驱动的原型进化，实现了遥感密集标注场景下多样提示任务的统一，并以极低交互成本获得免训练的持续性能提升，为实际批处理标注工作流提供了有效方案。

title: TACT: Taxonomy-Aligned Post-Training for Pedagogically Adaptive English Tutoring
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide conversational practice for English-as-a-second-language (ESL) learners. Effective ESL tutoring, however, requires more than fluent response generation: a tutor must select an appropriate pedagogical action based on learner behavior and dialogue context. Human-tutoring research offers principles for adaptive support, but they are often task-specific and remain insufficiently integrated into LLM-based ESL tutor training and evaluation. We present TACT (Taxonomy-Aligned Conversational Tutor), a human-grounded framework for post-training and evaluating pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors. Drawing on established literature, we develop two complementary taxonomies: the Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy with 13 tutor response strategies and the Student-Move Taxonomy characterizing learner behavior by move type and status. Using these taxonomies, we construct TACTCorpus, which enriches 260 authentic teacher-student conversations with 32,379 annotations and quality-controlled augmented training data.
