We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through supervised fine-tuning followed by taxonomy-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization, producing TACTutor and optimizing it for scaffolding quality rather than reference imitation alone. On TACTBench, a strategy-balanced diagnostic benchmark comprising 78 authentic tutoring contexts, TACTutor improves over its backbone by 20.30% and outperforms all evaluated proprietary baselines under the same protocol, while maintaining backbone performance on established external educational benchmarks; in a blinded study with 50 learners, it also receives the highest overall mean rating among the evaluated tutors. We release the data, benchmark, and model weights, providing an open foundation for developing pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TACT框架，一个基于人类辅导研究的人类归纳框架，用于训练和评估具有教学适应性的LLM驱动的ESL辅导系统。通过构建两个互补的分类学（13种辅导策略和学生学习行为分类），构建了包含260段真实师生对话、32,379条注释的TACTCorpus数据集，并使用监督微调加分类学对齐的GRPO优化方法训练出TACTutor模型，在TACTBench基准上相比基座模型提升20.30%，超过所有商业基线，并在50名学习者的盲评研究中获得最高评分。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型越来越多地被用于ESL学习者的对话练习，但有效的ESL辅导不仅需要流畅的回复生成，还需要根据学习者的行为和对话上下文选择适当的教学动作。现有的基于人类辅导研究的适应性支持原则通常具有任务特定性，且未充分整合到基于LLM的ESL辅导训练和评估中。
AI.method: 基于已有文献，开发两个互补的分类学：Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy（13种辅导回复策略）和Student-Move Taxonomy（按移动类型和状态刻画学习者行为）。基于分类学构建TACTCorpus，丰富260段真实师生对话，包含32,379条注释和质量控制的增强训练数据。使用监督微调加分类学对齐的Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练，得到TACTutor模型。
AI.result: TACTutor在TACTBench（含78个真实辅导情境的策略平衡诊断基准）上相比基座模型提升20.30%，在相同协议下优于所有评估的商业基线，同时保持基座模型在既有外部教育基准上的性能。在50名学习者的盲评研究中获得最高的总体平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 研究数据、基准和模型权重均已发布，为开发具有教学适应性的ESL辅导系统提供了开放基础。

title: StreamDAM: Presence-Aware Memory for Real-Time Streaming Video Object Segmentation
summary: Quality-tier video object segmentation (VOS) trackers such as DAM4SAM top accuracy leaderboards, but they are measured offline, one frame at a time with no clock. Under an honest streaming protocol at 30 frames per second, where a frame that misses its budget is served the last mask already computed, the winner collapses: the rich memory that makes it accurate is too slow to keep up, and what it emits is blind to whether the object is even present. We trace both failures to one place, the tracker's memory pipeline, and rebuild it for streaming. \method{} makes the memory machinery itself run at frame rate through in-model optimization rather than a bolted-on fallback, and governs it with a single learned presence signal that decides what enters memory, how far back the tracker reads, when to withhold output, and when to re-detect. A mechanism analysis shows why a fixed policy cannot win: the control that helps when an object truly disappears is the one that hurts when it is merely hard to see, so the choice must be made per frame. Across four benchmarks and five modern baselines, \method{} is the strongest streaming tracker, recovers nearly all of the offline model's accuracy under the clock, and on the hardest content exceeds the offline model it is built from.

AI.tldr: 本文针对VOS跟踪器在离线评估中表现优异但在真实30fps流式协议下性能崩溃的问题（富记忆管道速度慢且缺乏目标存在感知），提出了\method{}方法——通过模型内优化让记忆机制本身以帧率运行，并用单一学习到的存在信号统一控制记忆写入、读取范围、输出抑制和重检测。机制分析表明固定策略无法获胜，因为对目标真正消失有益的控制在目标难以看见时反而有害，因此必须逐帧决策。在四个基准和五个现代基线上，\method{}是最强的流式跟踪器，在时钟限制下恢复了离线模型几乎全部精度，在最难内容上甚至超过其构建所基于的离线模型。
AI.motivation: 离线VOS跟踪器（如DAM4SAM）在排行榜上精度最高，但它们是一帧一帧无时钟限制地离线评估的。在诚实的30fps流式协议下（错过预算的帧被提供上一帧已计算的掩码），这类跟踪器性能崩溃：其精度来源——丰富的记忆管道——速度太慢跟不上帧率，且输出的结果对目标是否仍在画面中毫无感知。
AI.method: \method{}通过模型内优化而非外部兜底方案，使记忆机制本身在帧率下运行。它使用一个单一的学习到的存在信号，统一决定四件事：什么内容进入记忆、跟踪器回溯读取多远的记忆、何时抑制输出、何时触发重新检测。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集和五个现代基线上，\method{}是表现最强的流式跟踪器。在时间时钟限制下，它恢复了离线模型几乎全部的精度；在最具挑战性的内容上，其精度甚至超过了它所基于构建的离线模型。
AI.conclusion: 固定策略无法在流式VOS中获胜，因为"目标真正消失时"与"目标仅难以看见时"需要相反的控制策略，这种权衡必须逐帧自适应决策。重建记忆管道并引入学习到的存在信号，可以同时解决流式场景下的速度瓶颈与鲁棒性问题。

title: A game theory for foundation models shows new paths to rational cooperation through similarity inference
summary: As autonomous agents powered by foundation models are increasingly integrated into social and economic systems, understanding the principles governing their collective behavior is essential for ensuring safety and cooperation. Classical game theory, the dominant framework for modeling rational interaction, is built upon the assumption of `decoupled agency,' where agents treat their own decision-making as independent of the environment and other actors. Modern AI agents, however, jointly predict their own future actions alongside external observations. Here, we report a striking finding: when interacting in stylized social dilemmas, foundation model agents engaging in optimal planning consistently converge to stable cooperation, directly contradicting classical game-theoretic predictions of mutual defection. To understand this phenomenon, we introduce the `embedded Bayesian agent,' a theoretical model for foundation model agents. By shifting from decoupled to embedded agency, these agents model themselves as part of the universe they inhabit, maintaining epistemic uncertainty about their own decision-making algorithms. We show that by inferring whether others are behaviorally similar, an embedded agent treats its own deliberation during planning as evidence: a decision to cooperate predicts a similar decision by a similar partner. We formalize this mechanism of similarity inference through the `embedded equilibrium,' a novel solution concept replacing the Nash equilibrium to provide a foundational game theory for the social behavior of modern AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基础模型智能体在最优规划下进行社会困境博弈时，能稳定收敛到合作，与经典博弈论预测的相互背叛相矛盾。作者提出"嵌入式贝叶斯智能体"模型和"嵌入式均衡"概念，为现代AI智能体的社会行为建立新的博弈理论基础。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型驱动的自主智能体深入社会和经济系统，需要理解其集体行为规律以确保安全和合作。经典博弈论基于"解耦能动性"假设，即智能体将自身决策独立于环境和他人，但现代AI智能体在预测外部观测的同时会联合预测自身未来行动，这使得经典框架不再适用，需要新的理论模型。
AI.method: 作者引入"嵌入式贝叶斯智能体"理论模型，将智能体视为宇宙的一部分而非外部观察者，对其自身决策算法保持认知不确定性。关键机制是"相似性推断"：在规划过程中，智能体将自身决策视作证据——自己选择合作可预测相似合作伙伴也选择合作。通过这一机制形式化定义"嵌入式均衡"作为替代纳什均衡的新解概念。
AI.result: 实验表明基础模型智能体在风格化社会困境中进行最优规划时，始终收敛到稳定合作，直接违背经典博弈论中相互背叛的预测。理论分析证明嵌入式均衡能够解释这一现象。
AI.conclusion: 从"解耦能动性"转向"嵌入能动性"为现代AI智能体提供了一种新的博弈理论基础，"嵌入式均衡"取代纳什均衡，为理解和设计安全、合作的AI集体行为提供了理论基础。

title: When and Where to Look: Adaptive Visual Evidence Scheduling for Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Efficient long-video understanding requires vision--language models (VLMs) to reason over a small number of frames selected as sparse visual evidence. Existing relevance-based methods rely on static one-shot selection with fixed frame budgets and candidate pools, while agent-based schedulers achieve adaptivity through costly multi-round reasoning and interactive search. We propose EcoFrame, a training-free framework for low-overhead query-adaptive visual evidence scheduling. EcoFrame leverages the VLM's inference feedback to determine when to increase the frame budget and where to search for additional candidate evidence. Specifically, entropy-gated budget scheduling uses output uncertainty to stop early when the current evidence is sufficient or progressively expand the frame budget otherwise. Meanwhile, attention-guided candidate proposal converts frame-level attention into a temporal prior, enabling dense local search in informative regions while preserving global coverage when attention is diffuse. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate that EcoFrame achieves a better accuracy--efficiency trade-off across multiple VLM backbones. On Qwen2.5-VL, EcoFrame achieves an average accuracy of 64.4, surpassing BOLT at 63.5, while providing a $1.85\times$ speedup over AKS and BOLT. Compared with the agent-based A.I.R., EcoFrame maintains comparable accuracy with up to a $13.5\times$ inference speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/EcoFrame.

AI.tldr: EcoFrame是一个免训练的低开销查询自适应视觉证据调度框架，通过熵门控的预算调度和注意力引导的候选提案，在长视频理解中实现了比现有方法更优的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法存在两方面不足：相关性静态一次性选择方法缺乏适应性，受限于固定的帧预算和候选池；基于智能体的调度方法虽然具备自适应性，但依赖昂贵的多轮推理和交互式搜索。如何在保持自适应的同时降低推理开销是核心挑战。
AI.method: EcoFrame包含两个关键组件：(1) 熵门控预算调度：利用VLM推理输出的不确定性（熵）决定是否提前停止或逐步扩展帧预算；(2) 注意力引导候选提案：将帧级注意力转换为时间先验，在信息密集区域进行稠密局部搜索，同时在注意力分散时保持全局覆盖。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU上，EcoFrame在多个VLM骨干上取得更好的准确率-效率权衡。在Qwen2.5-VL上平均准确率达64.4，超越BOLT的63.5，对比AKS和BOLT提供1.85倍加速；对比基于智能体的A.I.R.保持相当准确率的同时实现最高13.5倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: EcoFrame验证了利用VLM自身推理反馈进行自适应帧调度的有效性，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低推理开销，为高效长视频理解提供了实用的免训练解决方案。

title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by generating and aggregating multiple candidate answers, yet many pipelines use fixed per-query budgets that spend the same compute on easy and difficult prompts. These fixed budgets are also difficult to inspect because they do not explain why a given prompt receives a particular number of samples. We propose adaptive} test-time scaling with a lightweight fuzzy controller that maps interpretable signals, including estimated prompt complexity and model confidence, to a per-query sampling budget. The controller assigns fewer samples to easier or more confident prompts and more samples to harder or less certain prompts, making inference-time compute inspectable rather than fixed or opaque. We evaluate under a fair-alignment protocol with matched decoding settings and controlled answer selection, and compare against best-of-$N$, compute-aware scaling, and self-certainty-based baselines on question-answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across models and datasets, adaptive fuzzy control improves over several standard baselines and remains close to a selector-matched full-budget control while reducing the average number of samples. These findings suggest that interpretable adaptive sampling is a practical direction for more efficient test-time reasoning in large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模糊控制器的自适应测试时扩展方法，通过可解释的信号（如提示复杂度与模型置信度）为每个查询动态分配采样预算，在保持推理质量的同时减少平均采样数。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时扩展方法（如LLM推理中的多候选答案生成）普遍使用固定的每查询预算，导致简单和困难提示消耗相同计算量，且难以解释为何某个提示获得特定数量的采样。这种固定预算不透明且计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出一个轻量级模糊控制器，将可解释信号（包括估计的提示复杂度和模型置信度）映射到每查询的采样预算。模糊控制器为简单或高置信度的提示分配更少的样本，为困难或低置信度的提示分配更多的样本，使推理计算量可检查而非固定或黑箱。
AI.result: 在公平对齐协议下（匹配解码设置和受控答案选择），与best-of-N、计算感知扩展和基于自置信度的基线相比，自适应模糊控制在问答和数学推理任务上优于多个标准基线，同时在减少平均样本数的前提下，接近选择器匹配的全预算控制性能。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的自适应采样是大语言模型中更高效的测试时推理的一个实用方向。

title: Low-Dimensional High-Leverage Subspace Optimization: Beyond Full-Parameter Coupled Training for Neural Network Quantization
summary: Low-bit quantization suffers severe accuracy degradation on compact networks, rooted in the dominant full-parameter coupled training paradigm that ignores parameter subspace heterogeneity. Their limited feature redundancy leaves little room to absorb quantization errors. Conventional pipelines adopt monolithic optimization: PTQ reconstructs fixed pretrained models without improving inherent quantization friendliness; QAT updates all parameters jointly, suffering from gradient coupling between backbone weights and calibration parameters. In this paper, we identify normalization affine parameters as a low-dimensional high-leverage subspace dominating quantization robustness, and propose Normalization Affine Preconditioning (NAP) for targeted subspace optimization. For PTQ, NAP freezes backbone weights and fine-tunes only affine parameters under the target fake-quantization graph on full-precision models, proactively boosting quantization friendliness before downstream reconstruction. For QAT, we introduce an alternating QAT-NAP schema that decouples feature learning and numerical calibration, breaking the performance ceiling of saturated joint training. Theoretical analysis confirms BN affine parameters fully cancel the channel-wise affine component of quantization distortion, while nonlinear rounding and clipping residuals form the irreducible error boundary; distillation-guided NAP acts as directional flatness optimization, projecting teacher-student logit mismatch onto the restricted subspace. Experiments on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 show NAP recovers severely collapsed low-bit quantization, consistently boosts reconstruction-based PTQ, and outperforms saturated full-parameter QAT with negligible tuning cost. This work reveals the principle of targeted low-dimensional subspace optimization, offering a new perspective beyond full-parameter coupled training for efficient deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归一化仿射预条件（NAP）用于低比特量化中低维子空间定向优化。核心发现是BN仿射参数（缩放和平移因子）构成控制量化鲁棒性的低维高杠杆子空间。针对PTQ，NAP冻结主干权重仅微调仿射参数以主动提升量化友好性；针对QAT，提出交替式QAT-NAP模式解耦特征学习与数值校准。理论证明BN仿射参数可完全抵消量化失真的通道级仿射分量，实验显示NAP能恢复严重坍塌的低比特量化并超越饱和的全参数QAT。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化在紧凑网络上遭受严重精度退化，根本原因是主导的全参数耦合训练范式忽视了参数子空间的异质性。紧凑网络有限的特征冗余使其难以吸收量化误差，而现有方法（PTQ/QAT）均采用整体优化策略，存在梯度耦合和单调优化天花板，无法有效提升量化的内在友好性。
AI.method: 提出Normalization Affine Preconditioning (NAP)框架：(1) 针对PTQ，冻结主干权重，仅在目标伪量化图下微调仿射参数，在下游重建前主动提升量化友好性；(2) 针对QAT，设计交替式QAT-NAP模式，将特征学习与数值校准解耦，打破饱和联合训练的性能天花板。(3) 蒸馏引导的NAP作为方向性平坦度优化，将教师-学生logit失配投影到受限子空间。理论分析证明BN仿射参数可完全抵消通道级仿射量化失真分量，非线性舍入与裁剪残差构成不可约误差边界。
AI.result: 在ImageNet和CIFAR-100上的实验表明，NAP能够恢复严重坍塌的低比特量化，一致性地提升基于重建的PTQ性能，并超越饱和的全参数QAT，同时只产生可忽略的额外调参成本。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作揭示了低维子空间定向优化的原理，为高效深度学习提供了一种超越全参数耦合训练的新视角。BN仿射参数被识别为控制量化鲁棒性的关键低维高杠杆子空间，通过针对性的子空间优化而非整体参数优化，可以有效提升低比特量化的精度上限。

title: Should We Type or Talk to LLM Agents? A Comprehensive Study of Voice and Keyboard Input Perturbations
summary: Human input reaches language models by typing or speaking, and each channel leaves a distinct signature: orthographic noise for keyboards; for voice, disfluency from conventional transcription and restructuring from AI-backed dictation tools. How do they impact an LLM's performance? In this paper we present HIVE (Human Input-Variation Engine), a suite of voice transcription perturbations and QWERTY keyboard perturbations. We use HIVE to evaluate how robust models are to these perturbations. We present seven findings. (i) Voice transcription perturbations lower accuracy across every instruction-tuned model we test, and it is the structure of the transcription rather than its fillers that carries the cost. (ii) QWERTY keyboard perturbations cost less, and a model absorbs a lot of them before accuracy falls away. (iii) Both trace back to one cause, how many of the question's tokens survive the perturbation: destroying a token is what hurts, while adding new ones alongside it costs little. (iv) The gap between the two channels appears only where the answer must be constructed or deduced; on multiple choice there is none. (v) The harm does not solely come from test-set contamination. (vi) It cannot be trained away with lightweight adaptation. (vii) A thinking budget recovers the keyboard channel almost entirely but leaves the spoken registers untouched, and compressed speech is worse with it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HIVEs（人类输入变异引擎），系统研究了语音转录扰动和QWERTY键盘扰动对LLM性能的影响，通过七项发现揭示了两种输入通道扰动影响模型的不同机制。
AI.motivation: 人类与语言模型的交互主要通过打字或语音两种渠道进行，每种渠道都带有独特的扰动特征（键盘的拼写噪声、语音的转录不流畅和AI辅助重组）。然而，这些扰动如何影响LLM的性能尚未被系统研究，理解这些影响对开发和部署实际应用至关重要。
AI.method: 提出HIVE（Human Input-Variation Engine）扰动套件，包含语音转录扰动和QWERTY键盘扰动两类。作者使用HIVE对多种指令微调模型进行鲁棒性评估，通过七项系统性实验揭示扰动对模型性能的影响模式。
AI.result: 核心发现：（i）语音转录扰动在所有指令微调模型上降低准确率，且成本来自转录结构而非填充词；（ii）键盘扰动代价较小，模型可吸收大量扰动；（iii）两种扰动的根本原因是问题中token的存活数量——破坏token造成伤害，新添加的token成本低；（iv）两种通道的差距仅出现在需要构造或推导的答案上，选择题上无差异；（v）损害不仅来自测试集污染；（vi）轻量级适应无法消除该问题；（vii）思维预算（thinking budget）几乎完全恢复键盘通道性能，但对语音转录无效，且压缩语音在思维预算下表现更差。
AI.conclusion: 两种输入通道的扰动对LLM性能影响机制不同：键盘扰动可通过推理增强缓解，而语音转录扰动更顽固且对推理增强具有抗性，暗示语音输入通道对LLM构成更严峻的鲁棒性挑战。

title: GeoMAR: Unleashing Geometrically Aligned Features for Masked Autoregressive Blind Face Restoration
summary: Codebook-based blind face restoration (BFR) often suffers from ambiguous conditioning features and a fragile prediction mechanism under severe degradation. To address these challenges, we propose GeoMAR, a framework designed to unleash geometrically aligned features with masked autoregressive (MAR) refinement for robust face restoration. For feature conditioning, we introduce a dual-input extraction pipeline to extract component-based geometric descriptions with explicit, spatially faithful anchors. These textual priors are integrated with low-quality (LQ) features via an Aligned Geometric Priors Injector, which employs a KV-Q exchange strategy to generate geometrically aligned features. For prediction mechanism, we reformulate the one-step mapping into a multi-step MAR process. This coarse-to-fine generation progressively refines complex facial regions based on increasingly reliable context. Experiments on one synthetic and three real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GeoMAR achieves highly competitive perceptual quality and coherent visual structures compared with existing methods. The code is available at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/GeoMAR.git.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoMAR框架，通过双输入几何特征提取与掩码自回归（MAR）多步细化，解决基于码本的人脸复原中条件特征模糊和预测机制脆弱的问题，在合成与真实基准上取得竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 基于码本的盲人脸复原（BFR）在严重退化下常面临两个核心挑战：1）条件特征存在歧义，缺乏清晰的空间锚定；2）一步映射的预测机制脆弱，难以在复杂退化下生成可靠结果。
AI.method: 1) 双输入提取管道：提取组件级几何描述，包含显式且空间忠实的锚点，作为文本先验；2) 对齐几何先验注入器（Aligned Geometric Priors Injector）：采用KV-Q交换策略将文本先验与低质量（LQ）特征集成，生成几何对齐特征；3) 将一步映射重构为多步掩码自回归（MAR）过程，通过由粗到细的生成逐步细化复杂面部区域。
AI.result: 在1个合成和3个真实世界基准上，GeoMAR相比现有方法获得了具有竞争力的感知质量与连贯的视觉结构。
AI.conclusion: GeoMAR通过几何对齐的特征条件与MAR多步预测机制，有效缓解了码本BFR框架中条件歧义与预测脆弱的问题，实现了高质量且结构连贯的人脸复原。

title: ReflectRL: Learning from Golden Negative Trajectories via Reflective-to-Direct Reasoning
summary: On-policy training has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, and is often enhanced by golden trajectories from stronger expert models. However, when the expert fails on harder problems, existing trajectory-guided methods lose their main source of supervision, and these failed trajectories are typically discarded as negative samples. We argue that such failures, which we call Golden Negative Trajectories, can still provide valuable reasoning signals when treated not as demonstrations to imitate, but as flawed trajectories to reflect upon. We identify a Reflection Advantage: for hard problems, reflecting on a flawed trajectory can be easier and more effective than solving the problem directly from scratch. Motivated by this, we propose ReflectRL, a lightweight plug-and-play framework that learns from Golden Negative Trajectories during on-policy training. ReflectRL first uses these trajectories to elicit Reflective Reasoning, then applies Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition to transfer the acquired reasoning behavior back to Direct Reasoning. Experiments across 9 benchmarks, 4 LLM backbones, and 4 on-policy training methods show that ReflectRL consistently improves reasoning performance with minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReflectRL框架，利用"黄金负轨迹"（专家模型失败但包含有价值推理信号的轨迹）来增强大语言模型的在线策略训练。通过反射推理和反射到直接策略转换两阶段，在9个基准、4个骨干模型和4种在线训练方法上一致提升推理性能，且开销极小。
AI.motivation: 现有基于专家轨迹引导的在线策略训练方法在专家失败于难题时失去主要监督来源，这些失败轨迹通常被当作负样本丢弃。作者认为这些失败轨迹虽不能作为示范模仿，但可作为缺陷轨迹进行反思，为难题提供有价值的推理信号。
AI.method: 提出ReflectRL框架，包含两个阶段：(1) 利用黄金负轨迹激发反射推理能力；(2) 通过反射到直接策略转换（Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition）将反思行为迁移回直接推理模式。该框架是轻量级、即插即用的。
AI.result: 在9个基准、4个LLM骨干和4种在线策略训练方法上，ReflectRL一致性地提升了推理性能，且引入的计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 失败轨迹不应被简单丢弃，通过反思视角利用黄金负轨迹可以为大语言模型的推理训练提供额外监督信号，这是一种有效且低成本的策略增强方式。

title: ParVL: Parallel Scaling and Expandable Compute Allocation for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Existing scaling strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically expand either model parameters or sequential inference computation, incurring substantial memory or latency overhead. More importantly, most existing methods fail to alter the rigid, fixed computation allocation between the Vision Transformer and the Large Language Model components, limiting task-specific optimization. To address this, we introduce the Parallel Vision-Language (ParVL) scaling framework for MLLMs, which scales parallel computation by reusing the existing ViT and LLM backbone parameters across multiple vision and language branches. This framework raises a central question: given a fixed backbone parameter budget, how should additional shared-backbone computation be allocated between the vision and language modalities? We instantiate each parallel computational stream with branch-specific prefix parameters over a shared backbone, and train the entire model end-to-end via full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on roughly 13B tokens. We systematically study the computation-allocation trade-off between the ViT encoder and LLM decoder. ParVL improves overall multimodal performance over same-recipe single-branch baselines, and the best evaluated vision--language allocation varies across tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/YangYangGirl/ParVL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ParVL（Parallel Vision-Language）扩展框架，通过复用现有ViT和LLM骨干参数构建多个并行的视觉/语言分支，在不增加模型参数量和推理延迟的情况下扩展并行计算，并在固定骨干参数预算下系统研究视觉与语言模态间的计算分配权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM扩展策略要么扩展模型参数、要么扩展顺序推理计算，导致大量内存或延迟开销；更重要的是，大多数方法无法改变ViT和LLM组件之间固定的计算分配，限制了任务特定的优化空间。
AI.method: ParVL框架通过在共享骨架上为每个并行计算流实例化分支特定的前缀参数（prefix parameters），将参数复用扩展到多个视觉和语言分支；整个模型通过全参数监督微调在约130亿token上进行端到端训练，并系统研究视觉编码器与语言解码器之间的计算分配权衡。
AI.result: ParVL在相同训练配方的单分支基线上提升了整体多模态性能，且最优视觉-语言计算分配随任务不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: ParVL通过并行计算扩展和分支特定的计算分配，为MLLM提供了一种新的扩展维度，并且验证了不同任务需要不同的视觉-语言计算分配比例。

title: Multi-Camera Trajectory Forecasting with Trajectory Tensors
comment: To appear in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (tPAMI)
summary: We introduce the problem of multi-camera trajectory forecasting (MCTF), which involves predicting the trajectory of a moving object across a network of cameras. While multi-camera setups are widespread for applications such as surveillance and traffic monitoring, existing trajectory forecasting methods typically focus on single-camera trajectory forecasting (SCTF), limiting their use for such applications. Furthermore, using a single camera limits the field-of-view available, making long-term trajectory forecasting impossible. We address these shortcomings of SCTF by developing an MCTF framework that simultaneously uses all estimated relative object locations from several viewpoints and predicts the object's future location in all possible viewpoints. Our framework follows a Which-When-Where approach that predicts in which camera(s) the objects appear and when and where within the camera views they appear. To this end, we propose the concept of trajectory tensors: a new technique to encode trajectories across multiple camera views and the associated uncertainties. We develop several encoder-decoder MCTF models for trajectory tensors and present extensive experiments on our own database (comprising 600 hours of video data from 15 camera views) created particularly for the MCTF task. Results show that our trajectory tensor models outperform coordinate trajectory-based MCTF models and existing SCTF methods adapted for MCTF. Code is available from: https://github.com/olly-styles/Trajectory-Tensors

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多相机轨迹预测（MCTF）这一新问题，即预测移动物体在跨相机网络中的运动轨迹。作者提出了"轨迹张量"（Trajectory Tensors）这一新编码技术，并开发了多个编码器-解码器MCTF模型，采用Which-When-Where方法预测物体在哪些相机中出现、何时出现以及出现在相机视图中的位置。实验在600小时、15个相机视角的自建数据库上进行，结果表明轨迹张量模型优于基于坐标轨迹的MCTF模型以及改编用于MCTF的现有单相机轨迹预测（SCTF）方法。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法主要集中于单相机轨迹预测（SCTF），但实际应用中（如监控、交通监测）广泛使用多相机网络。单相机视角受限导致不足以进行长期轨迹预测，而多相机网络可以提供更广阔的视野和更长时间跨度的轨迹追踪，因此需要专门针对多相机场景的轨迹预测框架。
AI.method: 提出了一个MCTF框架，采用Which-When-Where方法：预测物体出现在哪些相机中、何时出现、以及在相机视图内何处出现。关键创新是"轨迹张量"概念，这是一种跨多个相机视图编码轨迹及其不确定性的新技术。基于此，开发了多个编码器-解码器MCTF模型来处理轨迹张量。
AI.result: 论文构建了一个包含600小时视频数据、15个相机视角的自建数据库用于MCTF任务，并在其上进行了大量实验。结果表明，所提出的轨迹张量模型在MCTF任务上优于基于坐标轨迹的MCTF模型，也优于将现有SCTF方法改编用于MCTF的结果。
AI.conclusion: 多相机轨迹预测（MCTF）是一个有效且必要的新研究方向，轨迹张量作为一种编码跨视角轨迹及其不确定性的方法被证明优于传统坐标轨迹方法。该框架可支持在监控和交通监测等广泛应用场景中实现长期、稳健的轨迹预测。

title: UniWorld-Design: From Pixel Generation to Layer-Native Design
summary: We introduce UniWorld-Design, a framework that redefines image generation from flat pixel synthesis to structured visual composition, with semantic RGBA layers as the atomic units of generation, understanding, and editing. Our key insight is that pixels define how an image is rendered, whereas layers define how an image is created, understood, and edited. Just as human designers create and manipulate visual content through layers rather than raw pixels, UniWorld-Design equips multimodal generative models with a layer-native design space. UniWorld-Design comprises two models. The Text-to-RGBA (T2RGBA) model generates standalone RGBA assets directly from text. The Image-to-Layer (I2L) model conditions on a finished image, a global instruction and per-layer prompts, and jointly produces ordered, complete semantic RGBA layers. Its instruction interface supports top-level decomposition, recursive decomposition and targeted extraction, making layering an instruction-addressable operation for agentic editing. Because I2L learns complete semantic objects rather than visible-pixel partitions, its layers stay usable when moved or removed. On the Crello benchmark, I2L reduces per-layer RGB L1 error by 37% and achieves a 34% relative improvement in Alpha Soft IoU over Qwen-Image-Layered. Separately, T2RGBA achieves the highest CLIP Score, outperforming LayerDiffuse and OmniAlpha.

AI.tldr: UniWorld-Design是一个将图像生成从平面像素合成重定义为结构化视觉组合的框架，以语义RGBA图层作为生成、理解和编辑的原子单元。该框架包含T2RGBA（从文本生成独立RGBA素材）和I2L（将完整图像分解为有序、完整的语义RGBA图层）两个模型，在Crello基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统图像生成以像素为基本单元，忽略了对图像内容进行创建、理解和编辑的核心需求来自语义层面的结构化表示。正如人类设计师通过图层而非原始像素来操作视觉内容，多模态生成模型也应具备图层原生的设计空间。
AI.method: 提出UniWorld-Design框架，由两个模型组成：1) T2RGBA模型直接从文本生成独立的RGBA资产；2) I2L模型以成品图像、全局指令和逐层提示为条件，联合生成有序、完整的语义RGBA图层。I2L的指令接口支持顶层分解、递归分解和目标提取，使分层成为可指令寻址的编辑操作。
AI.result: 在Crello基准上，I2L将逐层RGB L1误差降低37%，Alpha Soft IoU相对改进34%（对比Qwen-Image-Layered）。T2RGBA在CLIP Score上超越LayerDiffuse和OmniAlpha，达到最优表现。
AI.conclusion: UniWorld-Design通过将图层作为多模态模型的原子生成单元，实现了从像素合成到结构化视觉组合的范式转变。由于I2L学习的是完整的语义对象而非可见像素分割，其图层在被移动或移除时仍然保持可用性，为智能体编辑提供了更强大的基础。

title: CLIP-EBC: CLIP Can Count Accurately through Enhanced Blockwise Classification
comment: This is the author's accepted manuscript. The final version is published in ICME 2025
summary:
We propose CLIP-EBC, the first fully CLIP-based model for accurate crowd density estimation. While the CLIP model has demonstrated remarkable success in addressing recognition tasks such as zero-shot image classification, its potential for counting has been largely unexplored due to the inherent challenges in transforming a regression problem, such as counting, into a recognition task. In this work, we investigate and enhance CLIP's ability to count, focusing specifically on the task of estimating crowd sizes from images. Existing classification-based crowd-counting frameworks have significant limitations, including the quantization of count values into bordering real-valued bins and the sole focus on classification errors. These practices result in label ambiguity near the shared borders and inaccurate prediction of count values. Hence, directly applying CLIP within these frameworks may yield suboptimal performance.
  To address these challenges, we first propose the Enhanced Blockwise Classification (EBC) framework. Unlike previous methods, EBC utilizes integer-valued bins, effectively reducing ambiguity near bin boundaries. Additionally, it incorporates a regression loss based on density maps to improve the prediction of count values. Within our backbone-agnostic EBC framework, we then introduce CLIP-EBC to fully leverage CLIP's recognition capabilities for this task. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EBC and the competitive performance of CLIP-EBC. Specifically, our EBC framework can improve existing classification-based methods by up to 44.5% on the UCF-QNRF dataset, and CLIP-EBC achieves state-of-the-art performance on the NWPU-Crowd test set, with an MAE of 58.2 and an RMSE of 268.5, representing improvements of 8.6% and 13.3% over the previous best method, STEERER. The code and weights are available at https://github.com/Yiming-M/CLIP-EBC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CLIP-EBC，首个完全基于CLIP模型的精准人群密度估计方法。通过引入增强分块分类（EBC）框架，采用整数分箱和基于密度图的回归损失，解决了现有分类式人群计数框架中标签模糊和预测值不准确的问题。实验表明，EBC框架在UCF-QNRF数据集上可提升现有方法最多44.5%，CLIP-EBC在NWPU-Crowd测试集上达到SOTA，MAE为58.2，RMSE为268.5。
AI.motivation: CLIP模型在零样本图像分类等识别任务上表现出色，但其在计数/回归任务上的潜力尚未被探索。现有基于分类的人群计数框架存在两个关键缺陷：使用连续实值分箱导致边界附近标签模糊，以及仅关注分类误差导致计数预测不准确，直接应用CLIP到这些框架中性能可能不佳。
AI.method: 首先提出增强分块分类（EBC）框架，采用整数分箱替代实值分箱以减少边界模糊性，并引入基于密度图的回归损失以提升计数值预测精度。EBC框架是骨干网络无关的，在此框架基础上引入CLIP-EBC，充分利用CLIP的识别能力完成人群计数任务。
AI.result: EBC框架在UCF-QNRF数据集上可将现有基于分类的方法提升最多44.5%；CLIP-EBC在NWPU-Crowd测试集上达到SOTA性能，MAE为58.2，RMSE为268.5，相比之前最优方法STEERER分别提升了8.6%和13.3%。
AI.conclusion: CLIP-EBC证明了CLIP模型在计数任务上的潜力，通过EBC框架有效地将识别能力转化到回归任务中，实现了人群密度估计的SOTA性能，代码和权重已公开。

title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: Real-time video editing requires low-latency causal generation with bounded computational resources while preserving source fidelity and long-term temporal consistency. We present JoyAI-Video-Edit, a 16B-parameter autoregressive diffusion framework for real-time, open-ended video editing without access to future frames or a predefined video duration. Our method combines chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation, Source-Anchored Distribution Matching Distillation (SA-DMD), and Long-Horizon Autoregressive Distillation to reduce train--inference mismatch, preserve source fidelity during two-step generation, and mitigate accumulated temporal drift. Extensive automatic and human evaluations show that JoyAI-Video-Edit substantially outperforms existing streaming editors and remains competitive with strong offline systems on both short and long videos. The complete system achieves end-to-end 720p video editing at approximately 30 FPS on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Video-Edit.

AI.tldr: JoyAI-Video-Edit是一个16B参数的自回归扩散框架，用于无需未来帧或预设时长的实时开放视频编辑。通过分块自回归适配、源锚定分布匹配蒸馏（SA-DMD）和长视距自回归蒸馏，在单张Nvidia B200 GPU上实现720p视频约30 FPS的端到端编辑，同时保持源保真度和长时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 实时视频编辑需要低延迟因果生成、受限计算资源，同时保持源保真度和长期时间一致性，现有方法难以同时满足这些要求。
AI.method: 提出JoyAI-Video-Edit框架，结合三种关键技术：(1) 分块自回归适配以支持因果流式生成；(2) 源锚定分布匹配蒸馏（SA-DMD）以在两步生成中保持源保真度；(3) 长视距自回归蒸馏以缓解累积时间漂移、减少训练与推理的不匹配。
AI.result: 大量自动化和人工评估显示，JoyAI-Video-Edit显著优于现有流式编辑系统，在长短视频上均与强离线系统竞争。完整系统在单张Nvidia B200 GPU上实现720p视频约30 FPS的端到端编辑。
AI.conclusion: JoyAI-Video-Edit证明了通过架构设计和蒸馏策略的组合，自回归扩散模型可以实现实时、开放的视频编辑，兼具流式生成的效率和离线系统的质量，且代码已开源。

title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
summary: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address these challenges, we propose Video-DR, featuring a decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking that compels exhaustive cross-frame visual grounding prior to web retrieval. Our framework adopts a two-stage training recipe: supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), enabling autonomous exploration that breaks the imitation-learning ceiling. Furthermore, we curate Video-DR-Bench, a human-AI collaborative benchmark comprising 200 complex, multi-hop VQA instances. Empirical results demonstrate that our Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B establishes a new state-of-the-art of 64.0% average accuracy, surpassing proprietary Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) by 5.0 points and significantly outperforming GPT-5 (52.5%) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (57.5%). The 30B-A3B variant achieves 59.3%, competitive with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and demonstrating the effectiveness of our training paradigm even at compact scale. Code: https://github.com/Osilly/Vision-DeepResearch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR)，将多模态智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流，通过解耦的感知-探索流水线和阶段式工具解锁来克服模态偏差和参数知识泄漏问题，并在自建的Video-DR-Bench基准上以35B-A3B模型达到64.0%的平均准确率，超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet（59.0%）、Gemini 2.5 Pro（57.5%）和GPT-5（52.5%）。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体主要处理静态图像，缺乏对连续视频流进行密集时空定位和开放网络探索的能力。初步评估发现当前模型存在两大瓶颈：(1)模态偏差——智能体倾向于绕过视觉工具直接使用文本搜索；(2)参数知识泄漏——模型依赖内部记忆而非真正的工具增强执行。这些问题阻碍了智能体在复杂视频问答场景中的真实推理能力。
AI.method: Video-DR采用以下核心设计：(1)解耦的感知-探索流水线，将视频感知与网络探索分离；(2)阶段式工具解锁，强制在网页检索之前进行穷尽式的跨帧视觉定位；(3)两阶段训练策略：先进行监督微调（SFT），再使用组相对策略优化（GRPO），使智能体能够自主探索并突破模仿学习的天花板；(4)构建Video-DR-Bench基准，包含200个复杂多跳VQA实例，采用人机协作方式进行标注。
AI.result: Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B在Video-DR-Bench上达到64.0%的平均准确率，比Claude-4.5-Sonnet（59.0%）高出5.0个百分点，显著超越GPT-5（52.5%）和Gemini 2.5 Pro（57.5%）。其30B-A3B变体达到59.3%，与Claude-4.5-Sonnet持平，验证了训练范式的有效性即使在较小规模下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: Video-DR通过解耦感知-探索架构和GRPO强化学习训练，有效解决了视频多模态智能体中的模态偏差与知识泄漏问题，在视频问答任务上实现了当前最优性能。实验结果同时表明，即使在30B规模的紧凑模型下，该训练范式也能达到与顶级闭源大模型相当的性能，具有很好的可扩展性。

title: Perceptual Anchoring: Prototype-Guided Text Calibration for Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) partitions an image into semantically distinct regions based on arbitrary text descriptions, without learning any additional parameters. However, existing methods typically focus on improving visual representations while treating text embeddings that encode only generic category concepts as fixed classification references. The resulting semantic gap between these generic concepts and the visual representations that capture the specific appearances of target instances often causes incomplete masks and erroneous predictions in non-target regions. Inspired by the symbol-percept correspondence underlying perceptual anchoring, we propose Prototype-Guided Text Calibration (PTC) for training-free OVSS. In the Perceiving stage, PTC selects reliable visual evidence based on initial matching scores to construct category-specific visual prototypes. In the Anchoring stage, PTC uses these prototypes to calibrate their corresponding text embeddings, with the calibration strength adaptively adjusted based on the amount of visual evidence. Consequently, the calibrated text embeddings align more accurately with instance-specific visual representations while preserving generic category semantics and open-vocabulary generalization. Moreover, PTC requires neither additional training nor external models and can serve as a plug-and-play module for existing methods. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks show that PTC significantly enhances the performance of six representative methods and yields more complete and accurate segmentation results. These results validate PTC as a simple and effective approach to improving visual-text alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PTC（原型引导文本校准）的训练免开放词汇语义分割方法，通过视觉原型校准文本嵌入来缩小通用类别概念与实例特定视觉表征之间的语义差距，无需额外训练或外部模型，可即插即用地提升现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练免开放词汇语义分割方法主要聚焦于改进视觉表征，而将仅编码通用类别概念的文本嵌入视为固定的分类参考，这导致通用概念与捕获目标实例具体外观的视觉表征之间存在语义差距，造成分割掩码不完整以及非目标区域的错误预测。
AI.method: PTC包含两个阶段：（1）感知阶段（Perceiving stage）：基于初始匹配分数选择可靠的视觉证据，构建类别特定的视觉原型；（2）锚定阶段（Anchoring stage）：利用这些原型校准对应的文本嵌入，并根据视觉证据的数量自适应调整校准强度。校准后的文本嵌入与实例特定的视觉表征更精确地对齐，同时保留通用类别语义和开放词汇泛化能力。PTC无需额外训练和外部模型，可作为即插即用模块。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PTC显著提升了六种代表性方法的性能，产生了更完整、更准确的分割结果。
AI.conclusion: PTC被验证为一种简单有效的改善视觉-文本对齐的方法，为训练免开放词汇语义分割提供了一种轻量且通用的解决方案。

title: Enfold: Folding World Model Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control
summary: World generative models are typically used through what they produce: a rendered future, a video-conditioned action, or latent context computed by a costly generative branch. We argue that their more reusable asset is the computation that constructs a future. As a generator transforms a corrupted future into a coherent trajectory, its intermediate states organize appearance, spatial layout, and interaction across levels of abstraction. Can this future-generative computation be internalized in a representation inferred from the present alone? We present Enfold, which transfers this computation into a representation predicted from the current visual context and language instruction. During training, multi-level states exposed as the generator processes the observed future supervise a current-only encoder. The learned representation is fed back to condition future generation and is read by task heads without allowing task gradients to reshape the encoder. At deployment, action prediction no longer executes the generator. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-robot tasks, Enfold supports strong control while reducing action latency by $3.7\times$ relative to Fast--WAM, Enfold-Flash reaches $10.1\times$. Representation analyses show that it suppresses nuisance variation and preferentially captures changes that emerge over longer horizons. When the current scene is altered by human intervention, both the generated continuation and the executed actions adapt, which is inconsistent with fixed trajectory replay. These results recast a world generator as a source of predictive control representations: its future need not be materialized at every step if its internal structure can be enfolded into the present.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Enfold方法，将世界生成模型在构造未来轨迹时产生的中间计算状态内化为仅从当前视觉上下文和语言指令预测的表征。在训练时，生成器处理观察到的未来时暴露的多层级状态监督当前编码器；推理时无需执行生成器即可进行动作预测。在LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0和真实机器人任务上，Enfold实现强控制性能的同时将动作延迟相较Fast-WAM降低3.7倍，Enfold-Flash达到10.1倍。表征分析表明其能抑制无关变化并优先捕捉长期跨度变化，且对人工干预能自适应调整，排除了固定轨迹回放的可能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界生成模型通常通过其产出物（渲染的未来帧、视频条件动作或生成分支计算的潜在上下文）来使用，但这些都不是最可复用的资产。作者认为生成器构建未来时的计算过程本身更具价值——生成器将损坏的未来转换为连贯轨迹时，其中间状态在不同抽象层次上组织外观、空间布局和交互信息。核心问题是：能否将这种未来生成计算内化为仅从当前状态推断的表征，从而在部署时无需执行昂贵的生成器。
AI.method: Enfold的核心训练策略是：在训练阶段，让世界生成模型处理观察到的未来轨迹，暴露其多层级中间状态，这些状态作为监督信号训练一个仅依赖当前视觉上下文和语言指令的编码器。学到的表征一方面反馈用于条件化未来生成，另一方面被任务头读取用于动作预测，但任务梯度不允许回传重塑编码器，从而保持表征的生成语义。部署阶段，动作预测不再执行生成器。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0和真实机器人任务上，Enfold具备强控制性能，动作延迟相对Fast-WAM降低3.7倍，Enfold-Flash达到10.1倍。表征分析表明Enfold能抑制无关扰动变化，并优先捕获较长时间跨度内涌现的变化。当当前场景被人为干预改变时，生成续帧和执行动作均能自适应调整，说明并非固定轨迹回放。
AI.conclusion: 该工作重新定位了世界生成模型的价值：其未来不必在每一步都实体化，只要其内部结构可以被折叠（enfold）进当前表征中。这为将生成式预测计算转化为高效的控制表征提供了新范式，在保持控制性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
